title: Continue or Restart? The Limits of Early Failure Prediction in Coding Agents
summary: Early stopping promises to reduce compute costs for autonomous coding agents by terminating unpromising runs early. Deciding when to abandon a run requires separating baseline issue difficulty from the trajectory of an individual attempt. We study the distinction in 147,002 execution traces from two public corpora spanning four model-framework settings. Comparing pre-execution issue context against early execution prefixes, we evaluate linear count models, initial-turn text embeddings, task-conditional rankers, and a fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B monitor. Although early prefixes modestly improve cross-task outcome ranking, within-task discrimination remains near chance across early landmarks (5k-20k tokens): initial-turn embeddings and 20k-token task-conditional models yield AUCs around 0.50, and three-seed neural evaluations across 32,406 attempts at 20k tokens achieve a mean within-task AUC of 0.50 [0.48, 0.51] across tasks of varying solve rates. To evaluate how these predictions translate into stopping decisions, we replay score-guided and matched random restarts under shared token budgets alongside uninterrupted continuation. Under a 75k-token cap, learned restarting improves resolution over matched random restarting by up to 1.98 percentage points. An exact algebraic decomposition resolves this paradox: the gain over random restarting stems almost entirely from between-task stopping allocation (avoiding stops on easy issues), whereas attempt-level selection within a task contributes near zero (-0.11 to +0.24 percentage points). Across all four settings at the 75k cap (and 216 of 224 tested budget-threshold configurations overall), uninterrupted continuation achieves higher solve rates at lower mean token cost than both restart policies. Practical evaluations of early stopping must therefore establish attempt-level discrimination and demonstrate net compute savings relative to continuation.

AI.tldr: 论文质疑自主编码智能体“早停”的可行性：在147,002条执行轨迹上，attempt级别的进展预测接近随机（AUC≈0.50），所谓早停收益几乎全部来自任务间分配而非尝试内选择；且在绝大多数预算配置下，不中断地继续执行在更高解决率和更低平均token成本上都优于重启策略。
AI.motivation: 早停被认为能降低自主编码智能体的算力成本，但判断是否放弃一次运行，需要把问题本身的难度与单次尝试的进展轨迹区分开。作者想检验：早期执行前缀能否提供任务内的（attempt级）判别信号，以及这种预测能否真正转化为净计算节省。
AI.method: 使用来自两个公开语料库、覆盖四种“模型-框架”设置的147,002条执行轨迹。比较执行前的issue上下文与早期执行前缀（5k–20k token），评估四类方法：线性计数模型、初始轮文本嵌入、任务条件排序器、微调Qwen3-0.6B监控模型；并对32,406次尝试做三种子神经评估。再用共享token预算的replay实验，对比分数引导重启、匹配随机重启与不中断继续，并用精确代数分解拆分任务间与任务内贡献。
AI.result: 早期前缀仅略微改善跨任务的结果排序，任务内判别在各早期节点均接近随机：初始轮嵌入与20k token任务条件模型AUC约0.50，三种子评估在20k token处平均任务内AUC为0.50 [0.48, 0.51]。在75k token上限下，学习式重启比匹配随机重启最多提升1.98个百分点；但这些提升几乎全部来自任务间停止分配（避免在简单issue上停止），attempt级选择贡献约在-0.11至+0.24个百分点。四种设置在75k上限下（以及224个预算-阈值配置中的216个）不中断继续均以更低平均token成本获得更高解决率。
AI.conclusion: 早停的实用评估必须同时满足两点：证明存在attempt级判别能力，并证明相对于“继续执行”有净计算节省。仅靠任务难度分层带来的表面收益不足以支撑早停策略。

title: Testing Agentic Service Systems: An Agentic Living Lab Methodology Across the Physical-Digital Continuum
comment: 46 pages, 8 figures. It has been accepted as a research paper at SOC4IA 2026 (ICSOC 2026 Workshop)
summary: Task success is insufficient for testing agents that act for principals, change persistent business state, and affect physical processes: a useful result may be unauthorized, leave obligations unresolved, or depend on the execution substrate. We propose an Agentic Living Lab methodology organized around three questions: what is the test unit, who and what participate, and under what reality is the test executed? The unit is a service episode containing delegated roles, obligations, world state, and evidence. The method separates agents under test from environment actors and distinguishes real humans, human traces, rule surrogates, and agent-based proxies. Realization Profiles, capability-declared Reality Substrate bindings, Grounding Profiles, and Semantic Delta disclosures make changes across software, enterprise systems, simulation, and physical settings explicit. A four-plane reference architecture separates experiment control, participants, world realization, and evidence evaluation, with cross-cutting authority and governance controls. Runtime semantics distinguish intent, normative admission, and factual reconciliation. Real stakeholder grounding, participant calibration or validation, and governed feedback are required for the Living Lab claim, but not synchronous human participation in every run. Released JSON Schemas, deterministic fixtures, and a limited reference runner make selected rules machine-checkable; they are not a complete platform or empirical validation. Constructed travel and industrial designs illustrate authorization and fulfillment failures, proxy sensitivity, and substrate changes. Agent quality, proxy validity, and cross-substrate effect stability remain empirical questions.

AI.tldr: 提出"Agentic Living Lab"方法论：以服务事件为测试单元，围绕测试单元、参与者、真实化三大问题组织智能体评测，并用四平面参考架构与运行时语义区分意图、规范性准入与事实核对。
AI.motivation: 任务成功率不足以评测那些代表委托人行动、改变持久业务状态并影响物理过程的智能体：有用结果可能越权、遗留未了义务或依赖执行底座；因此需要新的评测方法论。
AI.method: 提出三问框架（测试单元为何、谁与什么参与、在何种现实下执行）。单元为含委托角色、义务、世界状态与证据的服务事件；区分被测智能体与环境参与者（真人、人类轨迹、规则替代、智能体代理）；引入实现画像、可声明能力的现实底座绑定、接地画像与语义增量披露；四平面参考架构（实验控制、参与者、世界实现、证据评估）加跨切面权责治理；运行时区分意图、规范准入与事实核对；并发布JSON Schema、确定性fixture与有限参考运行器。
AI.result: 构造的旅行与工业设计示例展示了授权与履约失败、代理敏感性及底座变化；所发布schema、fixture与参考运行器使部分规则可机器校验，但并非完整平台或实证验证。
AI.conclusion: Living Lab主张需真实利益相关者接地、参与者校准/验证与受治理反馈，但不要求每次运行都有同步人类参与；智能体质量、代理有效性与跨底座效应稳定性仍是待实证的开放问题。

title: UnityBench-Mini3D: Evaluating LLM Agents for 3D Game Development in Unity
summary: Game development stresses coding agents in ways general software engineering does not: correctness depends on how engine APIs, serialized scene state, and runtime behavior interact, not on source code alone. Existing benchmarks mainly target platforms such as Godot and heavily rely on LLM judges or coarse task-level outcomes. We present UnityBench-Mini3D, a benchmark of 77 project-level Unity tasks organized around seven expert-defined skill categories rather than tutorials or genres, with three difficulty tiers. Each task pairs a complete Unity project with natural-language requirements and is evaluated using 1,178 held-out, human-authored milestone tests covering scene structure, component configuration, and runtime behavior. This in-engine evaluation provides deterministic partial credit, localizes failures, and distinguishes partial implementations from complete solutions without relying on subjective judges. Across 21 models and 9 coding harnesses, the average pass rate reaches 80.9% on easy tasks but falls to 35.2% on hard tasks, with just 57.7% overall. UnityBench-Mini3D provides a reproducible, diagnostic testbed distinguishing systems across difficulty levels.

AI.tldr: 提出 UnityBench-Mini3D：面向 Unity 项目级编程的基准，含 77 个按七类专家技能、三档难度组织的任务，以 1178 个人工编写的里程碑测试在引擎内确定性评测，揭示模型在简单任务可达 80.9% 但困难任务仅 35.2%（整体 57.7%）的能力断层。
AI.motivation: 游戏开发对编码代理的挑战不同于通用软件工程：正确性取决于引擎 API、序列化场景状态与运行时行为的交互，而非仅源码。现有基准多针对 Godot 等平台，且严重依赖 LLM 裁判或粗粒度任务级结果，缺乏细粒度、可复现的诊断能力。
AI.method: 构建 77 个 Unity 项目级任务，按七个专家定义的技能类别（而非教程或游戏类型）组织，分三个难度层级；每个任务配完整 Unity 工程与自然语言需求，并用 1178 个留出的人工编写里程碑测试进行引擎内评测，覆盖场景结构、组件配置与运行时行为，提供确定性部分得分与失败定位。
AI.result: 在 21 个模型与 9 个编码框架（harness）上评测：简单任务平均通过率 80.9%，困难任务降至 35.2%，整体仅 57.7%，显示明显难度分层差异。
AI.conclusion: UnityBench-Mini3D 提供了可复现、具诊断性的测试平台，能在不同难度上区分系统能力，且无需主观裁判即可区分部分实现与完整解。

title: Small agents should know what their tools do
summary: Small open language models can call tools, but they do not reason about what a call does: they delete without asking, repeat writes, re-read state they already hold, and issue one call per turn where a short program would do. We introduce EffectWorld, an executable world of effect-typed tools in which every tool declares its effect, whether it is idempotent, and which resources it reads and writes. These declarations let a replay verifier decide whether a trace is effect-safe without labels or judge models, let an executor run tool programs of several dependent calls in one turn, and let a compiler-style optimizer turn wasteful traces into verified training signal; together they make EffectWorld a benchmark of effect safety and call efficiency. Low-rank adapters trained on this data deliver large gains: on Qwen3-4B, they raise task success from 53% to 99% in distribution, from 52% to 81% on a held-out split with unseen task kinds and distractor tools, and from 74% to 83% on an unseen domain, with about a third of the output tokens. The gains carry over to other model families. On the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard (BFCL), the adapter matches the base model's live accuracy and raises multi-turn accuracy from 21.9 to 26.6, and a recipe with near-miss declines lifts the BFCL average above the base model's while matching its irrelevance detection. Along the way we uncover and fix a pitfall that in-domain evaluation alone would miss: refusal templates in widely used public tool-use corpora teach a small model not to call tools, cutting BFCL non-live accuracy from 88.0 to 31.4, and filtering them restores 84.8. We also find that positive examples, not negative ones, carry the learning: suppression and preference objectives on the verified negatives add nothing over an SFT-only control, while targeted positives move exactly the behaviour they show.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EffectWorld：一个带"效果类型"标注的可执行工具世界，用于评测与训练小模型对工具调用副作用安全性和调用效率的推理能力，并通过验证器、执行器与优化器自动生成训练信号，显著提升小模型表现。
AI.motivation: 小型开源模型虽能调用工具，但并不理解调用的后果：会不经确认就删除、重复写入、重复读取已有状态、每轮只发一个调用而本可用简短程序完成。缺乏对"效果安全"与"调用效率"的显式建模和评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 EffectWorld 可执行环境，每个工具声明其效果类型、是否幂等、读写哪些资源。基于这些声明实现：(1) 无需标签/评判模型的重放验证器判断轨迹是否效果安全；(2) 执行器支持单轮内运行多个相互依赖调用的工具程序；(3) 编译器式优化器将浪费轨迹转为经验证的训练信号。用该数据训练低秩适配器（LoRA）。
AI.result: Qwen3-4B 上任务成功率：分布内 53%→99%，未见任务类型与干扰工具的留出集 52%→81%，未见领域 74%→83%，输出 token 约减至三分之一。迁移到其他模型族同样有效。BFCL 上适配器与基座实时准确率持平，多轮准确率 21.9→26.6；近失误拒绝配方使 BFCL 平均分超过基座且保持无关检测。另发现并修复隐患：公开工具使用语料中的拒答模板会教小模型不调用工具，使 BFCL 非实时准确率从 88.0 掉到 31.4，过滤后恢复到 84.8。
AI.conclusion: 正例而非负例承载学习：在验证负例上的抑制与偏好目标相比纯 SFT 对照组无增益，而针对性正例恰好改变其展示的行为。效果类型化环境可作为自动验证与高效训练信号来源。

title: Beyond Structural Unification: A Perspective and Roadmap on Unified Multimodal Models
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Linguistic Principles for Foundation Models
summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) emerge as a promising way to combine understanding and generation within a single architecture. We argue that current approaches mainly achieve structural unification, which can create a Unification Paradox: shared interfaces, token spaces, and parameters do not guarantee an overall capability gain and may degrade individual capabilities. In this position paper, we identify five critical layers in which unification must be rethought: (1) Asymmetric Input Unification, where models must estimate the utility and reliability of each modality rather than treating all modalities equally; (2) Factorized Representation Unification, where semantic abstraction and fine-grained reconstruction should use separate but coordinated capacity; (3) Stateful Reasoning Unification, where models should maintain and revise a shared multimodal belief state across understanding and generation; (4) Synergistic Optimization Unification, where conflicting understanding and generation objectives require coordinated optimization; and (5) Multi-Centric Systemic Evaluation, where benchmarks must evaluate systemic competence, capability preservation, and cross-task robustness rather than isolated outcomes. We argue that progress requires moving beyond structural unification toward functional unification across the full system.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出当前统一多模态模型（UMMs）仅停留在"结构统一"层面，由此产生"统一悖论"：共享接口、token空间和参数并不必然带来整体能力提升，反而可能损害单项能力。作者提出应在五个关键层面重新思考统一，从结构统一走向功能统一。
AI.motivation: 现有UMMs把理解与生成融合进单一架构，但多为结构性统一（共享接口/词表/参数）。这种表面统一未必带来能力增益，甚至可能降低理解或生成的单项性能，因此需要重新界定"统一"的真正含义。
AI.method: 以立场论文形式，提出并剖析"统一悖论"，进而识别出统一必须重构的五个层次：(1) 非对称输入统一，模型需评估各模态的效用与可靠性而非一视同仁；(2) 因子化表示统一，语义抽象与细粒度重建应使用分离但协同的容量；(3) 有状态推理统一，在理解与生成间维护并修正共享的多模态信念状态；(4) 协同优化统一，理解与生成目标存在冲突，需协调优化；(5) 多中心系统性评测，基准应评估系统能力、能力保持与跨任务鲁棒性而非孤立结果。
AI.result: 论文未报告实验结果，其贡献在于概念框架：将统一问题分解为输入、表示、推理、优化、评测五个维度，并论证结构统一不足以保证能力提升。
AI.conclusion: UMMs的进展需超越结构统一，转向覆盖整个系统的功能统一，即按上述五个层次重新设计架构、训练与评测。

title: The Complexity of Strategizing Against No-Regret Learners: Pure When It Is Easy, Hard Even When Mixed
summary:
We study the computational complexity of clairvoyant strategy optimization against a known online learner in finite-horizon repeated games. In general-sum games with bounded payoffs, unless $\mathsf{P}=\mathsf{NP}$, no polynomial-time optimizer can achieve a reward within $cT$ of the reward of the optimal pure-action sequence for an absolute constant $c>0$, even when allowed to output explicitly represented mixed strategies at every round. Our hardness result strengthens prior work along two complementary axes: it extends to a broader class of learning dynamics, including widely used mean-based algorithms, answering an open question of Assos, Dagan, and Rajaraman (2025) for learners beyond multiplicative weights; and it permits mixed outputs while retaining the weaker pure-sequence benchmark. Thus, neither mixed strategies nor algorithmic specificity removes the computational obstruction in general-sum games. In sharp contrast, zero-sum games exhibit the reverse phenomenon: deterministic pure actions suffice for efficiently recovering the leading surplus guarantees previously obtained through mixed play against Follow-the-Regularized-Leader (FTRL) opponents.
  Thus, the two regimes form a striking mirror image: mixed play cannot overcome general-sum hardness even against a pure benchmark, whereas pure play retains the full surplus guarantees of mixed strategies in zero-sum games.

AI.tldr: 研究已知在线学习器下先验（clairvoyant）策略优化的计算复杂度：一般和博弈中即使允许混合策略输出，也难在多项式时间逼近最优纯动作序列；零和博弈中则纯动作即可恢复混合策略的全部领先收益保证，形成"镜像"对比。
AI.motivation: 探索针对已知在线学习器的先验策略优化问题的计算复杂度，回答 Assos、Dagan 和 Rajaraman (2025) 关于乘性权重之外学习器（如 mean-based 算法）的开放问题，并厘清混合策略与算法特异性能否消除一般和博弈中的计算障碍。
AI.method: 在有限期重复博弈中，以最优纯动作序列的收益作为基准（benchmark），构建多项式时间不可近似性归约，证明除非 P=NP，不存在能在 cT 内逼近该基准的多项式时间优化器；同时扩展困难性至更广的学习动态类（含 mean-based 算法），并允许每轮显式输出混合策略。另一方面在零和博弈中对阵 FTRL 对手，分析确定性纯动作能否保持混合策略的领先收益（surplus）保证。
AI.result: 一般和博弈：除非 P=NP，任何多项式时间优化器都无法在常数 c>0 下达到最优纯动作序列收益的 cT 邻域内，即使允许输出显式混合策略；困难性覆盖包括 mean-based 算法在内的更广学习动态。零和博弈：确定性纯动作足以高效恢复此前通过混合策略对阵 FTRL 对手所获得的领先收益保证。
AI.conclusion: 两个 regime 呈鲜明镜像：一般和博弈中混合策略无法突破困难性（即便基准仅是纯策略），而零和博弈中纯策略即可保留混合策略的全部领先收益保证。因此混合策略与算法特异性均无法消除一般和博弈的计算障碍。

title: Characterizing Privacy Leakage in Spiking Neural Networks: A Systematic Analysis of Temporal Dynamics, Stochasticity, Neuronal Dynamics and Learning Mechanisms
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) encode information not only in whether neurons fire but also in when they fire, and this temporal dimension shapes what a trained network reveals about its training data. Biologically inspired firing patterns can reduce membership leakage in SNNs without changing the network architecture, which positions temporal dynamics as a design variable for privacy. A change in firing behavior, however, alters stochasticity, spike timing, neuronal response, and the learning problem at once, so harnessing this effect requires identifying which of these properties produces it. This study traces that origin by separating temporal representation, stochasticity, intrinsic neuron dynamics, and learning within a common experimental framework, evaluated under a black-box membership inference attack across image and tabular benchmarks. Varying the temporal representation shows that burst-like firing patterns reduce leakage relative to regular spiking, but at a cost in accuracy. Injecting randomness into the input, spike timing, and spike trains does not reproduce this reduction in leakage, which shows that the reduction arises from how spikes are arranged in time rather than from noise. The privacy benefit further depends on where these firing patterns originate. When neurons generate these patterns through their own adaptive dynamics, leakage falls while accuracy is preserved, so privacy no longer comes at the expense of performance. The learning algorithm then sets the baseline leakage. Under evolutionary training, the attack already performs near chance level, leaving temporal dynamics little room to improve privacy further. Privacy in SNNs is therefore not an inherent property of spikes but a product of how temporal activity is generated, processed, and learned, which offers a principled basis for designing neuromorphic systems that protect sensitive data.

AI.tldr: 该研究在统一实验框架下分离时间表征、随机性、神经元内在动力学与学习算法四个因素，通过黑盒成员推理攻击发现：泄漏的降低源于脉冲在时间上的排布（而非噪声），且当爆发式放电由神经元自适应动力学自发产生时，可在保持精度的同时降低成员泄漏；学习算法决定基线泄漏水平，演化训练下攻击已接近随机猜测。
AI.motivation: SNN同时在"是否放电"和"何时放电"上编码信息，时间维度会影响网络对训练数据的暴露程度，生物启发的放电模式有望在不改架构的前提下降低成员泄漏。但放电行为的改变会同时影响随机性、脉冲时序、神经元响应与学习问题，因此必须厘清究竟是哪一因素带来隐私收益，才能将其作为隐私设计变量加以利用。
AI.method: 构建统一实验框架，将时间表征、随机性注入（输入、脉冲时序、脉冲序列）、神经元内在动力学与学习算法分离开来分别考察；在图像与表格基准上以黑盒成员推理攻击评估泄漏程度，并与精度进行权衡分析。
AI.result: 爆发式放电模式相较规则放电可降低泄漏但牺牲精度；向输入、脉冲时序与脉冲序列注入随机性均无法复现该泄漏下降，说明收益来自脉冲的时间排布而非噪声；当爆发模式由神经元自适应动力学自身产生时，泄漏下降且精度得以保持；演化训练下攻击已接近随机水平，时间动力学几乎无进一步改进空间。
AI.conclusion: SNN的隐私性并非脉冲的固有属性，而是时间活动如何被生成、处理与学习的产物；这为设计保护敏感数据的神经形态系统提供了有原则的依据。

title: ReCoPII: A Relation-Grounded Framework for Building Contextual PII Masking Datasets
summary: Training contextual masking systems for personally identifiable information (PII) requires examples distinguishing maskable from preservable mentions of one entity type, but privacy restrictions limit access to real data. Author-based augmentation (SPY) labels mentions unrelated to the author as non-PII, presuming a single data subject and overlooking others. We propose ReCoPII (Relation-grounded Contextual PII masking), a framework that builds such data without this premise: it plans ontology-constrained entity relations, writes insertion sentences with placeholders, reconstructs annotations with code, checks the result with a separate LLM, and derives MASK/KEEP labels from entity relations. On Korean documents from six domains, it yields ReCoPII-Ko, a corpus with relation, privacy, and MASK/KEEP annotations, which we validate. Across 300 pairs, four annotators agree with 88.42% of its sampled KEEP labels, against 26.27% for SPY-style augmentation of the same sources. Classifiers trained on it over-mask less than under that reference on a matched test. Contextual masking fine-tuned jointly with a PII detector removes most over-masking of detection alone within a fixed leakage budget; on human-verified entity records, the four detectors meeting it over-mask at most 5.04% with at most 4.18% leakage. The detector is comparable to XLM-R-large on KDPII with about a quarter of its parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出ReCoPII框架，摆脱"单一数据主体"假设，用关系约束合成带MASK/KEEP标注的上下文PII遮蔽数据，产出韩语语料ReCoPII-Ko，显著提升标注质量并降低过度遮蔽。
AI.motivation: 训练上下文PII遮蔽系统需要区分同一实体类型中"应遮蔽"与"应保留"的样本，但隐私限制使真实数据难以获取。现有SPY式作者增强假设只有单一数据主体，将非作者相关提法一律标为非PII，忽略了文档中的其他主体，导致KEEP标签错误。
AI.method: ReCoPII：先规划本体约束下的实体关系，撰写带占位符的插入句，用代码重建标注，交由独立LLM校验，再依据实体关系推导MASK/KEEP标签。在六个领域的韩语文档上构建ReCoPII-Ko语料，含关系、隐私与MASK/KEEP标注，并进行了验证。
AI.result: 300对样本中四位标注者对其KEEP标签认同率88.42%，而SPY式增强仅为26.27%。在其上训练的分类器在匹配测试集上过度遮蔽更少；与PII检测器联合微调后，在固定泄漏预算下消除大部分过度遮蔽，四个达标检测器过度遮蔽≤5.04%、泄漏≤4.18%。检测器以约四分之一参数量达到KDPII上XLM-R-large的水平。
AI.conclusion: 关系约束的合成数据可高质量替代受隐私限制的真实数据，纠正SPY式假设的标注偏差；联合微调的上下文遮蔽与检测方案能在低泄漏下显著抑制过度遮蔽，且模型轻量高效。

title: RELAY: One Query, Two Roles for Sequential Recommendation
summary: Sequential recommendation must combine semantic preferences with behavioral associations to deliver accurate rankings at low inference cost. Sharing history selection connects preference representation directly to the behavioral evidence used in candidate scoring. We present RELAY, a compact sequential recommender built around one query, two roles: semantic readout and behavioral-memory routing. A single learned query forms a semantic preference representation and reuses its attention to route direct-history and transition evidence into candidate scores. Candidate-conditioned gates calibrate the two memory channels for each candidate. RELAY trains both roles with a single catalog likelihood and produces the final ranking in one forward pass. Full-catalog experiments on six datasets show that RELAY achieves the highest Recall@5 and NDCG@5 among the compared methods on every dataset, improving over the previous best model by 14.22% and 17.88% on average. With 2.044 million predictor parameters, RELAY reduces predictor size by 65.12% and achieves a 1.75~1.79$\times$ inference speedup over the previous best model.

AI.tldr: RELAY 是一种紧凑的序列推荐模型，用一个学习到的 query 同时承担"语义读出"和"行为记忆路由"两个角色，在单次前向传播中完成全目录排序，精度更高且更省参数、更快。
AI.motivation: 序列推荐需要同时结合语义偏好与行为关联，才能在低推理成本下给出准确排序。作者认为"共享历史选择"能把偏好表示直接与候选打分所用的行为证据联系起来，从而避免两套机制割裂。
AI.method: 以单一可学习 query 构建语义偏好表示，并复用其注意力把直接历史证据和转移（transition）证据路由到候选分数中；再用候选条件门控（candidate-conditioned gates）为每个候选校准这两条记忆通道；两个角色用统一的目录似然（single catalog likelihood）联合训练，一次前向即完成最终排序。
AI.result: 在六个数据集的全目录实验中，RELAY 在所有数据集上的 Recall@5 与 NDCG@5 均为对比方法中最高，平均较此前最佳模型提升 14.22% 和 17.88%；预测器仅 204.4 万参数，规模减少 65.12%，推理速度提升 1.75~1.79 倍。
AI.conclusion: 单一 query 复用注意力即可统一语义表示与行为证据路由，兼顾精度、参数效率与推理速度，说明紧凑的共享历史选择设计在序列推荐中是有效方向。

title: ObjectTwin: Measuring the Asset Correspondence Gap for Capture-Anchored Digital Twins
summary: Object-wise reconstruction increasingly inserts generated meshes into captured scenes as editable proxies for observed objects. This use creates a requirement absent from isolated-asset scores and pose estimates: at the captured metric state, the proxy should reproduce calibrated observations of the same instance. We present ObjectTwin, a scan-grounded measurement protocol that freezes the instance, cameras, scan-projected support and recorded depth, metric anchor, and evaluation denominator, then replaces only the object representation. The resulting asset correspondence gap measures lost observation agreement relative to scan-derived visible geometry without treating the scan as complete physical ground truth. Across two indoor RGB-D capture domains and two generation backends, visible, anchored generated assets lose 0.302-0.497 MaskIoU under this replacement. Every tested scene-level estimate is positive, while same-input generator preference reverses across capture domains. Coverage and overlap-depth analyses locate disagreement in both visible support and surface placement; the evaluated conservative pose refinement does not systematically recover it. These results establish capture correspondence as a separately measurable interface between generated-asset quality and stronger physical or task-level evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出ObjectTwin——一种基于扫描的测量协议，用于衡量生成网格作为可编辑代理时与实采观测的一致性，发现存在显著对应差距且现有指标无法体现。
AI.motivation: 将生成网格插入采集场景作为可编辑代理时，代理应在采集的度量状态下复现同一实例的标定观测；而孤立资产评分与位姿估计无法捕捉这一需求。
AI.method: ObjectTwin协议冻结实例、相机、扫描投影支撑区、记录深度、度量锚点与评估分母，仅替换物体表示，从而测量"资产对应差距"——相对扫描派生可见几何的观测一致性损失，且不将扫描视为完整物理真值。
AI.result: 在两个室内RGB-D采集域与两种生成后端上，可见且锚定的生成资产在替换后损失0.302–0.497 MaskIoU；所有测试的场景级估计均为正；同输入下生成器偏好随采集域反转；覆盖与重叠深度分析表明差异同时源于可见支撑与表面放置；保守位姿精修无法系统性挽回。
AI.conclusion: 采集对应性应作为介于生成资产质量与更强物理/任务级评估之间的独立可测接口。

title: KORA: Deterministic-First Execution Control for AI Workloads
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and benchmark available at https://github.com/Krako-Labs/KORA
summary: AI applications often invoke a model before they determine whether inference is necessary. That default is useful for ambiguous generative tasks, but it is poorly matched to work that is structured, deterministic, policy-bound, lookup-oriented, or directly verifiable. KORA introduces deterministic-first execution control: a pre-inference control layer that represents requests as task paths, attempts deterministic or structured routes first, validates route outcomes, records telemetry, and escalates to a model-candidate path only when deterministic handling is insufficient. This paper presents KORA as a deterministic-first execution-control architecture and reports bounded evidence from reproducible benchmark and validation workloads. In a reproducible 100-task deterministic-heavy benchmark, KORA-controlled execution avoided 80 of 100 simulated model invocations versus a naive direct baseline, with zero mismatches in the deterministic subset. The workload is intentionally deterministic-heavy: it includes categories such as FAQ lookup, policy/rule checking, schema or format validation, deterministic transformation, and a smaller set of model-needed ambiguous or generative tasks. A separate synthetic customer-support local/no-network validation workload demonstrates route measurement and avoided model-call accounting in an application-shaped setting. These results support bounded model-invocation reduction and validation visibility in documented workloads. They do not establish production behavior, real-provider outcomes, energy outcomes, API-cost reduction, or broad superiority.

AI.tldr: KORA提出"确定性优先"的执行控制架构：在调用模型前先尝试确定性/结构化路由并验证结果，仅在不足时才升级到模型，100任务基准中避免了80次模型调用且确定性子集零错误。
AI.motivation: 当前AI应用默认在判断推理是否必要之前就调用模型，这一习惯适合模糊生成任务，但对结构化、确定性、策略约束、查找型或可直接验证的工作并不合适，造成不必要的模型调用。
AI.method: 构建预推理控制层，将请求表示为任务路径；优先执行确定性或结构化路由，验证路由结果并记录遥测，仅当确定性处理不足时升级至模型候选路径。以可复现基准与合成客服本地/无网络验证负载进行评估。
AI.result: 100任务确定性偏重基准中，相比朴素直接基线避免了80/100次模拟模型调用，确定性子集零不匹配；合成客服场景展示了路由测量与节省模型调用的核算。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在文档化负载中实现有限的模型调用削减与验证可见性，但未证明生产行为、真实提供商结果、能耗、API成本降低或广泛优越性。

title: Counting the Bandages: On measuring the time that AI saves
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Replaces the author's earlier TSB proposal (SSRN 6682338). Code and data: https://github.com/solomonshalom/tsb-bench. Also archived on Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.23557773
summary: I consider what it means for AI assistance to save time. I contrast a stopwatch view, on which time saved is whatever the clock records, with a ledger view, on which it is a counterfactual that has to be read next to the errors the work lets through, and I argue for the latter. The argument has four parts. I define a model-free pair of quantities, time saved and excess escaped defects, and one decision number built from them: the break-even defect cost. I give a baseline model of checking in which, until the model is good enough not to check, a calibrated worker's escaped-defect rate does not depend on how good the model is; checking time grows with the logarithm of the model's error rate; and over-trust buys minutes on the clock at a larger cost in total minutes. I show what randomized studies can and cannot identify, and I replicate METR's developer study from its public data: the same 246 issues support a slowdown of 19% or 24% depending on the estimand (34% without adjusting for a chance imbalance), and AI helped on somewhere between 3% and 82% of them. Finally, I restate the published record, with stated bounds in place of imported point assumptions. In GDPval's own review-every-output workflow, review time alone caps GPT-5's speedup at 3.6x; the consultants outside the frontier were faster, and more often wrong. Last, I test two of the model's predictions in a small pre-specified experiment on AI reviewers checking AI drafts of the same kind of brief, built from SEC filings made after the models' training data were collected. Told the drafter's true error rate, the reviewer checked more as it rose, but all-or-nothing, switching near where its prompt's costs break even. Told that the drafter erred ten times less often than it did, it checked 7 fewer of 9 figures and let a wrong figure through in 22.5% of briefs instead of none: faster and worse, entirely through reduced effort.

AI.tldr: 作者主张用"账本观"而非"秒表观"评价AI省时：省时是需与漏过错误并列阅读的反事实量，而非时钟记录。提出免模型指标（省时、超额逃逸缺陷、盈亏平衡缺陷成本）、检查基线模型，并复现METR研究与GDPval记录，最后用小规模预注册实验检验模型预测。
AI.motivation: 当前普遍以时钟记录的时间节省（"秒表观"）衡量AI辅助价值，忽视了工作提速同时可能放过的错误，导致对省时的评估片面、甚至误导（如过度信任、少检查）。作者希望给出一个把漏检错误纳入考量的评估框架。
AI.method: 1) 定义一对免模型量（省时、超额逃逸缺陷）及由二者构成的决策数——盈亏平衡缺陷成本；2) 建立检查基线模型，推导：在模型好到无需检查前，校准工作者的逃逸缺陷率不随模型质量变化；检查时间随模型错误率对数增长；过度信任在时钟上省几分钟却以更大总分钟为代价；3) 分析随机研究可识别与不可识别之处；基于METR公开数据复现开发者研究；4) 用有界区间重述GDPval等已发表记录；5) 在后期SEC文件构建的简报上做预注册实验，检验两条模型预测。
AI.result: METR同一246个议题支持19%或24%的减速（视估计量而定，未校正偶然失衡为34%），AI在其中3%–82%的议题上有帮助；GDPval审阅全输出流程中，仅审阅时间就将GPT-5加速上限压至3.6倍，前沿外顾问更快但更常出错；实验中，被告知真实错误率时审查者随错误率上升而更多检查，但呈全有或全无、在提示成本盈亏点附近切换；被告知起草者错误率低十倍时，9个数字少查7个，22.5%的简报放过错误数字（原为零），更快更差且完全源于努力减少。
AI.conclusion: 评价AI节省时间应采用账本观：省时必须与漏过的错误及盈亏平衡缺陷成本一同解读，用有界区间替代输入的点估计假设。检查努力的质量与激励（而非仅模型能力）深刻决定AI辅助的真实得失，过度信任会以更少努力换取更快但更差的结果。

title: Generation and Verification: Human-Agent Collaboration for Safety-Critical Automotive Software Engineering
summary: Research on coding agents mainly focuses on generation quality. Yet, safety-critical automotive software makes two additional demands. It prioritizes verification, since every change is reviewed, traced to a requirement, and checked against industry standards such as MISRA and AUTOSAR before it can be committed. It is also a narrow domain, written against layered architectures, embedded resource constraints, and organization-specific interface conventions that are scarce in the data general-purpose LLMs are trained on. We present a coding assistant for automotive C/C++ that addresses both demands. First, it exposes three tools to the user over the Model Context Protocol (generate, edit, and verify), allowing developers to run verify on any code on demand rather than relying on the agent to check its own output. Second, rather than using a general-purpose model, we customize the underlying LLM for the automotive domain through prompt engineering and fine-tuning. We construct a dataset from automotive production code of AUMOVIO, where each function is paired with the requirement texts and Unified Modeling Language (UML) behavior it must satisfy. In a two-week pilot on active production projects, developers report verify as the most-used tool and confirm using it on their own code and not only on generated output. Comparing model customization strategies, 75% prefer the faster prompt-engineered configuration. MISRA- and AUTOSAR-inspired pattern checkers indicate that prompt engineering achieves a lower number of violations on C, while fine-tuning shows better conformance with architecture patterns for C++.

AI.tldr: 提出面向汽车C/C++的编码助手，通过MCP暴露生成/编辑/校验三个工具，并用提示工程与微调定制领域LLM；两周试点显示verify最常用、75%偏好提示工程配置，提示工程在C上违规更少、微调在C++架构一致性上更优。
AI.motivation: 现有编码代理研究侧重生成质量，而汽车安全关键软件额外要求：1）以验证为中心，每次改动需评审、追溯需求并符合MISRA/AUTOSAR等标准；2）领域狭窄，涉及分层架构、嵌入式资源约束与组织特定接口约定，这类数据在通用LLM训练语料中稀缺。
AI.method: 1）基于MCP向用户暴露generate、edit、verify三个工具，使开发者可按需对任意代码运行校验，而非依赖代理自查；2）不用通用模型，而以AUMOVIO生产代码构建数据集（每个函数配对需求文本与UML行为），通过提示工程与微调定制底层LLM；3）在生产项目上开展两周试点，对比两类定制策略，并用MISRA/AUTOSAR风格模式检查器评估。
AI.result: 试点中开发者报告verify为最常用工具，且用于自身代码而非仅生成代码；75%的开发者偏好更快的提示工程配置；检查器显示提示工程在C上违规数量更少，微调在C++架构模式符合性上更好。
AI.conclusion: 将验证显式暴露为工具并针对领域定制模型，可同时满足汽车软件对验证优先与领域狭窄的双重需求；两种定制策略各有侧重（C侧重提示工程、C++架构一致性侧重微调），提示工程因效率更受开发者青睐，但结论基于两周试点与模式检查器，需更大规模验证。

title: People's Views on Smiley Emoji on WeChat Platform, Positive Emotion and Sarcasm
summary: Emoji can easily lead to misunderstanding. On WeChat, [Smile] is often used by the elderly to express positive emotions such as joy and praise, but young people often regard [Smile] as sarcasm. In this case, misunderstandings can easily occur. In order to confirm the existence of this phenomenon and analyze people's understanding of emoji, this study selected 20 smiley emoji on WeChat platform and directly asked people's opinions on these emoji through questionnaires, including whether they recommend others to use, and rating of emotion joy, praise, sarcasm. Analyses were performed based on the total sample and by age group. The results showed that [Smile] and [Bye] were interpreted in opposite ways by older people and younger people. Older people thought they represented positive emotion (joy, praise), while younger people thought they represented sarcasm. Such emojis are easy to misunderstand. On the other hand, some emojis like [Yeah!], both the old and the young have a similar understanding that it represents a positive emotion.

AI.tldr: 研究通过问卷让被试对微信20个微笑类表情的使用推荐度及喜悦、称赞、讽刺含义评分，证实[微笑]等表情在老年与青年间存在反向解读，而[耶]等表情跨代理解一致。
AI.motivation: 微信表情易引发误解，如长辈用[微笑]表达喜悦与称赞，年轻人却视为讽刺；作者希望证实该现象并分析人们对表情的理解差异。
AI.method: 选取微信平台20个微笑类表情，采用问卷调查直接询问使用推荐意愿，并对喜悦、称赞、讽刺三种情绪含义评分；分别基于总样本和年龄分组进行分析。
AI.result: [微笑]和[再见]被老年人与年轻人反向解读：老年人认为是积极情绪（喜悦、称赞），年轻人认为是讽刺，易致误解；而[耶]等表情两代人理解较为一致，均视为积极情绪。
AI.conclusion: 微笑类表情的语义理解存在显著代际差异，部分表情易造成跨代沟通误解，部分表情则语义稳定，提示需关注表情使用的语境与对象。

title: How Learning Selects Equilibria and When It Leads to Collusion
summary: We study how learning algorithm design shapes equilibrium selection in infinite-horizon discounted Markov games with finite states and actions. Each episode, players choose smooth best responses to beliefs about opponents' policies, test them using noisy observations, and resample rejected beliefs or explore at rates determined by increasing transformations of their discounted values. We show that stochastically stable states induce approximate stationary Nash equilibria maximizing the minimum transformed discounted value across players, with transformations governing which players selection favors. In repeated games with bounded recall of noisy public signals, longer recall weakly increases the selected minimum transformed value. In repeated Cournot games, every stochastically stable state induces an approximate public perfect equilibrium whose minimum discounted profit across firms exceeds the Cournot-Nash benchmark. Collusion is therefore inevitable under these conditions and learning dynamics. For symmetric firms, selected profits can approach the monopoly benchmark arbitrarily closely. These results offer a novel equilibrium-selection perspective on algorithmic collusion.

AI.tldr: 研究学习算法设计如何决定无限期折扣马尔可夫博弈中的均衡选择，证明随机稳定状态诱导出最大化"最小变换折扣价值"的近似平稳纳什均衡；在有限记忆重复古诺博弈中，学习动态下合谋不可避免，对称企业利润可任意接近垄断水平。
AI.motivation: 既有研究多关注算法能否学会合谋，但缺乏对"学习规则设计本身如何塑造均衡选择"的统一理论刻画。作者希望从均衡选择（随机稳定性）视角解释算法合谋现象，说明合谋并非偶然，而是特定学习动态下的必然结果。
AI.method: 构建有限状态动作的无限期折扣马尔可夫博弈模型：每期玩家对对手策略信念做光滑最优反应，用带噪观测检验，并以随折扣价值递增变换所决定的速率重采样被拒信念或探索；用随机稳定性分析刻画长期选择，并结合有限记忆含噪公共信号的重复博弈与重复古诺博弈进行推演。
AI.result: 随机稳定状态诱导最大化各玩家最小变换折扣价值的近似平稳纳什均衡，变换形式决定选择偏向谁；有界记忆重复博弈中，记忆越长选中的最小变换价值弱增；重复古诺中每个随机稳定状态诱导近似公共完美均衡，其最小折扣利润高于古诺-纳什基准，对称企业利润可任意接近垄断基准。
AI.conclusion: 学习算法设计（反应光滑性、检验噪声、探索/重采样速率对价值的依赖）系统性地决定均衡选择，是算法合谋的关键驱动因素；结果为算法合谋提供了新的均衡选择理论视角，并提示可通过设计学习规则而非仅靠市场结构来规制合谋。

title: GNBG-C: A Unified and Configurable Benchmark Generator for Constrained Continuous Optimization
summary: Many real-world optimization tasks are governed not only by what should be optimized, but also by what is allowed: a solution must first satisfy physical, operational, safety, budgetary, or structural requirements before its objective value becomes meaningful. Yet benchmark design for constrained continuous optimization often treats these restrictions as fixed properties of predefined test instances. Existing generators and benchmark suites provide essential foundations for reproducible comparison, but they either focus primarily on configurable objective landscapes or expose constraint properties within limited, predefined regimes, making it difficult to ask targeted questions about constraint-induced difficulty: whether an optimizer struggles because feasible regions are small, boundaries are restrictive, variables are tightly coupled, or constraint information is poorly scaled. We introduce GNBG-C, a Generalized Numerical Benchmark Generator for Constrained Continuous Optimization. The central idea is to treat the feasible region itself as a configurable object rather than as an inseparable attachment to a fixed test function. By generating controlled constraint regimes around the known GNBG global minimizer, the generator enables systematic studies in which feasibility pressure can be varied while preserving that point as a global minimizer of the constrained problem. This allows researchers to examine how optimizers discover feasibility, handle constraint pressure, and improve objective quality under diverse and controllable feasibility conditions. GNBG-C therefore provides a flexible and auditable framework for probing the strengths and weaknesses of constrained continuous optimizers under targeted forms of feasibility-side difficulty.

AI.tldr: 提出GNBG-C，一个将可行域本身作为可配置对象的约束连续优化基准生成器，可在保持GNBG全局最优解的同时系统调节可行性压力。
AI.motivation: 现有约束优化基准多把约束视为固定测试实例的属性，生成器要么主要配置目标景观，要么只在有限预设机制下暴露约束特性，难以针对性地研究"约束导致困难"的具体来源（可行域小、边界苛刻、变量强耦合、约束缩放差）。
AI.method: 核心思想是把可行域当作可配置对象而非绑定在固定测试函数上的附属物：围绕已知的GNBG全局最优解生成受控的约束机制，在保持该点仍为约束问题全局最优的前提下，系统变化可行性压力。
AI.result: 支持在多样且可控的可行性条件下考察优化器如何发现可行解、应对约束压力、提升目标质量，提供灵活且可审计的框架来探测约束连续优化器的优势与弱点。
AI.conclusion: GNBG-C为针对"可行性侧困难"的约束连续优化研究提供了可配置、可复现、可审计的基准生成框架。

title: MedJev: Evaluating Zero-Shot System-One Decision Making in Medicine
summary: System One decision models such as Jev answer structured questions in a single forward pass without generating text, offering fast and computationally efficient clinical decision support. We evaluate MedJev, an open System One model that runs locally on a laptop, across ten medical benchmarks spanning medical knowledge, diagnosis, and patient level prediction using MIMIC IV and MIMIC IV ED. We compare MedJev against zero shot LLM baselines, published GPT results, and supervised models. MedJev achieves accuracies of 72.5 percent on MedQA, 75.4 percent on USMLE, and 80.1 percent on NEJM, approaching published GPT 4 performance while maintaining well calibrated confidence estimates (ECE 0.028 to 0.063). On patient level tasks, MedJev achieves an AUROC of 0.926 for In Hospital Mortality, exceeding XGBoost (0.902), but underperforms supervised models on operational outcomes such as ED Triage Admission (0.745 vs. 0.809). Patient level predictions also exhibit substantial miscalibration (In Hospital Mortality ECE 0.286). We introduce a lightweight, two parameter recalibration method that adapts predictions to local patient populations using 50 to 200 labeled examples, reducing ECE to 0.007. Our findings establish open System One models as a promising zero shot baseline for medical AI, combining competitive predictive performance with low computational cost and efficient local calibration. We release our code and evaluation harness to support future research.

AI.tldr: 评估开源System One模型MedJev在10个医学基准上的表现，并与LLM零样本、GPT已发表结果及监督模型对比，提出轻量重校准方法。
AI.motivation: System One决策模型（如Jev）单次前向即可回答结构化问题、不生成文本，计算高效，适合本地临床决策支持，但缺乏系统性医学评估。
AI.method: 在涵盖医学知识、诊断及基于MIMIC IV/IV ED的患者级预测共10个基准上测试MedJev，对比零样本LLM、已发表GPT结果和监督模型；并提出仅两个参数、用50–200个标注样本适配本地人群的轻量重校准方法。
AI.result: MedQA 72.5%、USMLE 75.4%、NEJM 80.1%，接近已发表GPT-4，置信度校准良好（ECE 0.028–0.063）；院内死亡AUROC 0.926超XGBoost(0.902)，但ED分诊入院(0.745 vs 0.809)不及监督模型，患者级预测校准差（ECE 0.286）；重校准后ECE降至0.007。
AI.conclusion: 开源System One模型是有前景的医学AI零样本基线，兼顾竞争力性能、低算力成本与高效本地校准；作者开源代码与评估框架。

title: When Connectivity Misleads: Guiding Agentic Search with Contrastive Evidence Paths
summary: Search agents can use cross-document graphs to discover sources through multi-hop connections and choose subsequent actions based on candidate rankings and relationships within a limited observation window. However, documents may rank highly because their numerous connections make them easier to reach, without necessarily providing more valuable evidence. Graph diffusion methods such as Personalized PageRank (PPR) aggregate propagation contributions from multiple sources, allowing highly connected distractor nodes to crowd the observation window. Flat node scores also obscure cross-document evidence trails, limiting continued exploration. We propose Contrastive Evidence Paths (CEP), which scores candidates by their strongest individual paths on a query-conditioned document graph and calibrates these scores against the same graph's background visitation distribution to mitigate structural bias. CEP ranks candidates by the calibrated scores and retains the corresponding source paths. Building on CEP, we develop Structured Corpus Interaction (SCI), which organizes candidates and their connecting paths into a structured Map, enabling agents to verify source documents and pursue missing information through expansion from anchor documents. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus and TREC-COVID show that SCI achieves state-of-the-art answer accuracy and nDCG@10 with the lowest generation cost. Compared with the strongest baselines by task performance, maximum reductions in tool calls and total generation costs exceed 50% and 40%, respectively. Further analysis confirms that SCI with CEP suppresses ranking inflation induced by structural connections and improves gold recall and exploration efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出对比证据路径(CEP)与结构化语料交互(SCI)，用最强单路径打分并对背景访问分布校准以抑制结构偏置，在检索搜索智能体任务上取得SOTA且成本更低。
AI.motivation: 跨文档图搜索中，高度连接的干扰文档因易被到达而获得高排名，PPR等扩散方法会聚合多源贡献，使干扰节点挤占有限观测窗口；扁平节点分数也掩盖了跨文档证据链，限制后续探索。
AI.method: CEP按查询条件化文档图上的最强单条路径为候选打分，并用同一图的背景访问分布校准分数以缓解结构偏置，同时保留对应源路径；在其上构建SCI，将候选及其连接路径组织为结构化Map，使智能体能核验源文档并从锚点文档扩展补全缺失信息。
AI.result: 在BrowseComp-Plus与TREC-COVID上，SCI取得SOTA答案准确率与nDCG@10且生成成本最低；相比最强基线，工具调用与总生成成本最大降幅分别超过50%和40%；分析显示CEP抑制结构连接导致的排名膨胀并提升金标召回与探索效率。
AI.conclusion: 以单路径证据加背景校准替代扩散聚合，可有效去偏并保留可追溯的证据链，配合结构化Map能显著提升搜索智能体的效果与效率。

title: Task-Utility IQA: Rethinking Image Quality Assessment in Embodied Tasks
summary: Image quality assessment (IQA) underpins embodied imaging pipelines by judging whether visual quality satisfies downstream tasks, yet most existing methods learn task-agnostic scores aligned with generic human ratings on static benchmarks. This objective mismatches embodied and interactive settings, where image adequacy depends on task goals, context, and action requirements that shape an agent's decisions. We argue that IQA should shift from score regression to goal-conditioned judgment defined by embodied task utility. To this end, we propose an MLLM-based embodied IQA agent framework that reasons about task requirements, grounds quality evidence, and produces decision-facing assessments. A compact VisDrone evidence study shows that conventional perceptual metrics and generic MLLM-based IQA scores are weak proxies for downstream VLM task success, while a task-conditioned utility score better predicts whether visual input supports the target task. These findings support a task-utility-oriented reframing of IQA for embodied, explainable, and decision-aware visual perception.

AI.tldr: 论文主张图像质量评价(IQA)应从"通用分数回归"转向"由具身任务效用定义的目标条件化判断"，并提出基于多模态大模型(MLLM)的具身IQA智能体框架。
AI.motivation: 现有IQA方法在静态基准上学习与通用人类评分对齐的任务无关分数，与具身/交互场景不匹配——后者中图像"是否够用"取决于任务目标、上下文与动作需求。需要重新定义IQA目标。
AI.method: 提出MLLM-based具身IQA agent框架：推理任务需求、定位(grounding)质量证据、输出面向决策的评估。并用VisDrone数据上的小型证据研究，对比传统感知指标、通用MLLM-IQA分数与任务条件化效用分数对下游VLM任务成功率的预测能力。
AI.result: 在VisDrone证据研究中，传统感知指标与通用MLLM-IQA分数对下游VLM任务成功的预测能力较弱(代理性差)，而任务条件化效用分数能更好预测视觉输入是否支撑目标任务。
AI.conclusion: 支持以任务效用为导向重构IQA，服务于具身、可解释、决策感知的视觉感知；将IQA从分数回归转为目标条件化判断。

title: Calibrated for Which Policy? Conformal Uncertainty for Fixed World Models Under Intervention
summary: Changing a deployment policy can invalidate a world model's uncertainty while leaving the physical transition mechanism and predictor unchanged. For one-step prediction, if source and target laws share the conditional mechanism $P(Y|X)=Q(Y|X)$, then the intervention is identified by the pre-outcome change of measure $w(X)=dQ_X/dP_X$. For policy-controlled dynamics this ratio factors into state-occupancy and action-propensity terms. Weighted conformal calibration transports marginal coverage to the target law; with an estimated ratio $\hat w$, $P_Q\{Y \in C_{\hat w}(X)\} \ge 1-α-TV(Q,\hat Q) \ge 1-α-E_P|w-\hat w|$. Population log-loss regret for a source-versus-target domain classifier bounds the same ratio error. If $h$ is its clipped target posterior, $ρ$ is the target-domain prior, and $Δ(h)$ is population log-loss regret, then $E_P|w-\hat w_h| \le (1/(ργ))\sqrt{Δ(h)/2}$. An exact cancellation improves the dependence from a generic odds-map bound of order $γ^{-2}$ to $(ργ)^{-1}$. Our experiments use a released DINO-feature world model and physical Franka trajectories. Under the strongest controlled state-action shift, ordinary 90% conformal sets cover 55.0%, whereas oracle and learned-ratio calibration cover 91.0% and 90.9%. The learned surrogate remains within 0.9% total variation of the target law. Calibration is relative to the deployment law: the model can remain fixed while calibration follows the intervention. We machine-check in Lean 4 the finite-support algebraic and causal identities used in the classifier-regret argument, including its coverage-composition step.

AI.tldr: 论文研究部署策略变更后世界模型不确定性失效的问题：当源域与目标域共享条件机制 P(Y|X)=Q(Y|X) 时，用预先观测的测度比 w(X)=dQ_X/dP_X 识别干预，并通过加权共形校准把覆盖保证迁移到目标分布，同时用域分类器的对数损失遗憾界定比率误差。
AI.motivation: 改变部署策略会使世界模型的不确定性保证失效，尽管物理转移机制与预测器本身不变。作者希望在不重新训练模型的前提下，让校准随干预迁移到目标部署分布。
AI.method: 1) 利用条件机制不变性做干预识别，测度比在策略控制动力学下分解为状态占用项与动作倾向项；2) 加权共形校准，验证覆盖下界为 1-α-TV(Q,Q̂) ≥ 1-α-E_P|w-ŵ|；3) 用源-目标域分类器的总体对数损失遗憾界定比率误差，得到 E_P|w-ŵ_h| ≤ (1/(ργ))√(Δ(h)/2)，精确消去使依赖从 γ^{-2} 优化到 (ργ)^{-1}；4) 在 Lean 4 中机器验证有限支撑下的代数与因果恒等式。
AI.result: 实验使用已发布的 DINO-feature 世界模型与真实 Franka 轨迹。在最强受控状态-动作偏移下，普通 90% 共形集覆盖率仅 55.0%，而 oracle 与学习比率校准分别达到 91.0% 和 90.9%；学习代理与目标分布的总变差在 0.9% 以内。
AI.conclusion: 校准应相对于部署分布而非源分布：模型可以保持不变，而校准随干预迁移。论文同时用 Lean 4 机器检查了分类器遗憾论证中的有限支撑代数与因果恒等式，包括覆盖复合步骤。

title: Enhancing Deep Learning Model Performance through Data Generation Strategies: Classification of Olive Tree Diseases
summary: Deep learning models are highly effective in a wide range of domains, particu larly in plant disease diagnosis. However, their performance is often limited by challenges such as insufficient data and class imbalance. In our work, we propose a comprehensive data generation strategy to overcome these limitations. First, we apply various data generation techniques, including traditional augmentation methods, CutMix, MixUp, and synthetic image generation using Deep Convolu tional Generative Adversarial Networks (DCGANs), to create new data samples. Second, we exploit this generated data in three scenarios: (S1) balancing class distribution in the original dataset, (S2) increasing the number of samples per class, and (S3) expanding the dataset while maintaining balanced classes. Third, we evaluate the impact of these data distributions (S1, S2, S3) on model perfor mance using the EfficientNetV2B0 architecture with pre-trained and fine-tuned weights. The experimental results show a substantial improvement in classifica tion accuracy, emphasizing the critical role of data diversity and class balance. These findings highlight the effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed strat egy of data generation and distribution for enhancing dataset quality, offering promising applications in plant disease detection and precision agriculture.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出综合性数据生成策略（传统增强、CutMix、MixUp、DCGAN合成图像）并结合三种数据分布场景（S1类别平衡、S2各类样本增加、S3扩充同时保持平衡），在EfficientNetV2B0上验证可显著提升植物病害分类精度。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在植物病害诊断中效果显著，但受限于数据不足与类别不平衡，导致模型性能受限；需通过数据生成与合理分布策略提升数据集质量。
AI.method: 第一步采用多种数据生成技术：传统数据增强、CutMix、MixUp，以及基于DCGAN的合成图像生成；第二步将生成数据用于三种场景：(S1)平衡原始数据集的类别分布，(S2)增加每类样本数量，(S3)在保持类别平衡的同时扩充数据集；第三步使用预训练与微调权重的EfficientNetV2B0架构评估三种数据分布对模型性能的影响。
AI.result: 实验结果显示分类准确率有显著提升，表明数据多样性与类别平衡对性能起关键作用；所提数据生成与分布策略在提升数据集质量方面有效且具适应性。
AI.conclusion: 综合数据生成与分布策略可有效缓解数据不足和类别不平衡问题，提升植物病害检测性能，在精准农业中具有应用前景。

title: PROBE: Frontier Coding Agents Find Different Bugs Than Maintainers Fix
summary: Proactive bug discovery is an important software-engineering problem. Even though coding agents are already widely deployed in this domain, their capabilities remain understudied. In particular, the challenging task of finding all bugs that human maintainers would repair across an entire repository has not been studied yet. To close this gap, we introduce PROBE, a benchmark consisting of all 2,457 bugs fixed over the course of 18 months across 20 diverse GitHub repositories, together with a method for matching candidate findings to this partial reference set. We evaluate coding agents across frontier models and find they all achieve a recall of below $21\%$ and a precision of less than $9\%$ with respect to the reference set. While stronger models increase recall substantially from $8\%$ to $17\%$, they do not improve precision. Surprisingly, despite the low precision, LLM and human evaluators still judge $85\%$ of findings valid. Crucially, we find that found bug distributions are similar across agents but differ substantially from those of bugs fixed by maintainers. The practical relevance of bug discovery and the low recall of frontier models make this benchmark a valuable resource for both model users and developers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PROBE 基准，涵盖 20 个 GitHub 仓库 18 个月内修复的全部 2,457 个 bug，用于评估编码智能体主动发现 bug 的能力；结果显示前沿模型召回率低于 21%、精确率低于 9%，且发现的 bug 分布与维护者修复的 bug 分布显著不同。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体已广泛用于主动 bug 发现，但其能力缺乏系统研究；尤其是"找出整个仓库中所有会被人类维护者修复的 bug"这一挑战性任务此前未被研究，存在评估空白。
AI.method: 构建 PROBE 基准：收集 20 个多样化的 GitHub 仓库在 18 个月内修复的全部 2,457 个 bug，作为部分参考集，并提出将智能体候选发现与该参考集匹配的方法；随后在多个前沿模型上评估编码智能体的召回率与精确率，并辅以 LLM 与人工评估。
AI.result: 所有模型召回率低于 21%、精确率低于 9%；更强模型将召回率从 8% 提升至 17%，但精确率未提升；尽管精确率低，LLM 与人工评估者仍认为 85% 的发现是有效的；各智能体发现的 bug 分布相似，但与维护者修复的 bug 分布差异显著。
AI.conclusion: bug 发现具有实际重要性，而前沿模型召回率偏低，使 PROBE 成为对模型使用者和开发者都有价值的基准资源。

title: Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Reasoning for Dyadic Relationship Recognition
summary: Dyadic relationship recognition aims to identify the latent social relationship between two individuals from their multimodal interactions. Existing methods typically project heterogeneous cues into a shared representation and optimise a flat classification objective, overlooking that relationships may rely on different interaction patterns. For instance, distant relationships can often be inferred from direct behavioural correspondence, whereas close relationships are better reflected by coordinated affective, behavioural, and multimodal responses. To address this limitation, we propose HiRe-DRR, a Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Reasoning framework that organises relationship evidence from three complementary perspectives: feature level, interaction type, and relationship hierarchy. HiRe-DRR decomposes facial, bodily, acoustic, and textual cues into low- and high-level representations and constructs homogeneous and heterogeneous cross-participant interactions. We further introduce the Mixture-of-Interaction Transformer (MoI-Former), which treats diverse interactions as specialised experts and employs relation-aware sparse routing to identify relationship-relevant evidence while preserving contextual interaction information. The proposed Hierarchical Conditional Loss (HC-Loss) exploits the hierarchical nature of social relationships through coarse-to-fine supervision, enabling structured relationship reasoning. Extensive experiments on three dyadic relationship benchmarks demonstrate that HiRe-DRR outperforms recent representative image-, video-, and multimodal methods. Our routing analysis further reveals that distant relationships tend to rely on low-level homogeneous interactions, whereas closer relationships focus on high-level heterogeneous interactions. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tw-repository/HiRe-DRR.

AI.tldr: 提出HiRe-DRR分层多模态交互推理框架，从特征层级、交互类型、关系层级三视角建模二元社会关系，通过MoI-Former与分层条件损失实现，在三个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将异构线索投影到共享表示并优化扁平分类目标，忽视了不同关系依赖不同交互模式：远距离关系多由直接行为对应推断，亲密关系则需协调的情感/行为/多模态响应。
AI.method: 将面部、身体、声学、文本线索分解为低/高层表示，构建同质与异质跨参与者交互；提出Mixture-of-Interaction Transformer（MoI-Former），把多样交互视为专家并用关系感知稀疏路由筛选关系相关证据；提出Hierarchical Conditional Loss（HC-Loss），以由粗到细监督利用关系层级性。
AI.result: 在三个二元关系基准上优于近期代表性的图像、视频与多模态方法；路由分析显示远距离关系依赖低层同质交互，亲密关系侧重高层异质交互。
AI.conclusion: 分层建模特征、交互与关系结构能有效提升二元关系识别，并揭示了关系距离与交互类型间的可解释关联。

title: Bayesian Replicator Dynamics and the Inversion of Strict Dominance in Bimatrix Games
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures. The following article has been submitted to Chaos
summary: Replicator dynamics, the central model of evolutionary game theory, describe populations evolving under selection and agents learning by trial and error. They also admit a third use: continuous-time Bayesian inference, in which an agent planning against an opponent accumulates evidence for each candidate strategy. Here we show that this use divides all two-player games into two classes. With the standard expected-utility payoff, the dynamics can be expressed as Bayesian updating only in games (with any number of actions) where no player has a dominant strategy. The logarithmic payoff of Ay and Erb admits the Bayesian representation in every game. Coordination, anti-coordination, and cyclic games share qualitative dynamics under both payoff definitions, with equilibria displaced and selection thresholds shifted. In contrast, the flows of every game with a dominant strategy are reversed between the payoff definitions, with the strictly dominant strategy eliminated under logarithmic payoffs. Cooperation therefore emerges in the Prisoner's Dilemma, and games of common interest converge to mutual defection. For two-action games the classification is complete and rests on an exact Hamiltonian structure shared by both payoff definitions. The structure gives a behavioural test: cycles in the classic Matching Pennies game have amplitude-independent period (isochronous) under logarithmic payoffs, but not under expected utility. Logarithmic evidence integration thus determines which strategic outcomes dynamical selection can reach, wherever learning approximates Bayesian updating.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明复制子动力学的"连续时间贝叶斯推断"解释会将所有两人博弈分为两类：标准期望效用下仅无占优策略的博弈可作贝叶斯表示，而对数收益（Ay–Erb）下所有博弈都可；两种收益定义下有占优策略的博弈流完全反向，严格占优策略在对数收益下被淘汰，从而使囚徒困境出现合作、共同利益博弈收敛到互相背叛。
AI.motivation: 复制子动力学有三种用途（选择下的种群演化、试错学习、对对手规划时的连续时间贝叶斯证据积累）。作者想厘清第三种"贝叶斯推断"解释在多大范围的博弈中成立，以及不同收益定义（期望效用 vs. 对数收益）如何改变选择动力学与可达的策略结果。
AI.method: 将复制子动力学改写为连续时间贝叶斯更新形式，分别在标准期望效用收益与Ay–Erb对数收益下刻画可表示性；对两人博弈给出二分分类（任意动作数），并对两动作博弈构造精确的哈密顿结构以完成分类；用Matching Pennies的周期是否为等时（振幅无关周期）作为行为检验。
AI.result: 期望效用下，仅当无玩家拥占优策略时动力学可写成贝叶斯更新；对数收益下任意博弈均可。协调、反协调、循环博弈在两种收益下定性动力学相同，但均衡位置与选择阈值发生偏移。所有含占优策略的博弈在两种收益间流向反转，严格占优策略在对数收益下被消除：囚徒困境出现合作，共同利益博弈收敛到互相背叛。两动作博弈的分类是完备的，并基于两种收益共有的精确哈密顿结构；Matching Pennies在对数收益下周期等时，而期望效用下则不等时。
AI.conclusion: 对数证据整合决定了动力学选择能到达哪些策略结果（凡学习近似贝叶斯更新之处），并提供了可实验检验的行为判据。

title: Dynamical coarse-graining of neural-network training
summary: Dynamical coarse-graining of neural networks gives macroscopic observables and enables training to be predicted, and controlled in a state space far smaller than the parameter space. In this paper, we first define the learning operator following the training law of neural networks and establish a descent theorem for the learning operator, which serves to determine whether the operator is sufficient to characterize the learning dynamics. Then the exact closure theorem and the dynamic coarse-graining theorem are presented in sequence. The three theorems established in this paper provide a systematic framework for constructing and assessing dynamical coarse-grained models of neural-network training. Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of the theorems with a finite-width nonlinear ReLU network. Its dynamic coarse-grained model for a fixed pattern is exactly derived and composed of five independent moments. The model exactly predict the training outputs and evolving learning operator. The framework may also guide the development of approximate coarse-grained models for more general neural networks when exact closure is unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出学习算子并建立下降定理、精确闭合定理与动态粗粒化定理三大框架，用于构造与评估神经网络训练的动态粗粒化模型，并在有限宽度非线性ReLU网络上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 神经网络的动态粗粒化有望在远小于参数空间的状态空间中给出宏观可观测量，从而预测和控制训练过程；但缺乏系统框架来判断粗粒化模型是否足以刻画学习动力学，因此需要建立可判别、可构造的理论基础。
AI.method: 首先依据神经网络训练规律定义学习算子，并证明其下降定理，以判定该算子能否充分刻画学习动力学；随后依次给出精确闭合定理和动态粗粒化定理，形成构造与评估动态粗粒化模型的系统框架；最后在有限宽度非线性ReLU网络上针对固定模式推导精确的粗粒化模型，该模型由五个独立矩组成。
AI.result: 所推导的粗粒化模型能够精确预测训练输出与演化中的学习算子；三个定理共同构成评估粗粒化模型是否充分、是否精确闭合的判据，并已在ReLU网络上得到具体验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为神经网络训练的动态粗粒化提供了系统性理论框架；当精确闭合不可得时，其思想还可指导更一般网络的近似粗粒化模型开发。

title: OmniBrain-0: A Unified Agentic Model for Embodied Intelligence
comment: Technical Report; 40 pages, 27 figures, 8 tables; Project Page at https://public-bots.github.io/OmniBrain-0/
summary: General-purpose embodied intelligence requires robots to coordinate diverse skills over long horizons, track task progress, and recover from failures. Specialist policies alone do not ensure task-level reliability, while powerful multimodal agents rely on costly reasoning and external experience that compact models struggle to reproduce. We introduce OmniBrain-0, a lightweight unified embodied agent that coordinates manipulation and navigation through a shared high-level decision model, integrating task understanding, planning, progress tracking, and feedback-driven recovery. Our progressive training framework combines embodied pretraining, domain-specialized agent distillation, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). It distills powerful teachers' interaction experience into manipulation and navigation experts, then consolidates their decision capabilities into OmniBrain-0. Unification therefore occurs within the learned decision model rather than only at the tool interface. We further introduce Rubric-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), a data flywheel in which a Meta-Agent turns execution evidence into refined rubrics, step-level reminders, and verified trajectories for domain-expert updates before their reconsolidation into OmniBrain-0 through MOPD. We evaluate OmniBrain-0 on LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, RoboCasa365, RoboTwin 2.0, and R2R-CE Val-Unseen, as well as multiple real-world manipulation tasks. OmniBrain-0 combines strong cross-domain task performance with substantially lower inference and execution overhead than its closed-source teacher, demonstrating efficient transfer and consolidation of embodied capabilities into a compact unified agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniBrain-0，一个轻量级统一具身智能体，用共享的高层决策模型协调操作与导航，并通过渐进式训练（具身预训练+领域专家蒸馏+多教师在线策略蒸馏 MOPD）以及评分引导的递归自我改进（RSI）数据飞轮，将强大教师模型的交互经验整合进紧凑模型，实现跨域任务表现强、推理与执行开销低。
AI.motivation: 通用具身智能需要机器人在长时程中协调多种技能、跟踪任务进度并从失败中恢复。但单一专家策略难以保证任务级可靠性，而强大的多模态智能体依赖昂贵推理和外部经验，紧凑模型难以复现。因此需要一个轻量、统一且高效的高层决策智能体。
AI.method: 1）共享高层决策模型统一整合任务理解、规划、进度跟踪与反馈驱动恢复；2）渐进式训练框架：具身预训练 → 领域专用智能体蒸馏（将教师交互经验蒸馏到操作与导航专家）→ 多教师在线策略蒸馏 MOPD（将各专家决策能力合并到 OmniBrain-0），实现决策模型层面的统一而非仅工具接口层面；3）Rubric-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement（RSI）：Meta-Agent 将执行证据转为精炼评分标准、步骤级提醒和已验证轨迹，用于更新领域专家，再经 MOPD 重新整合。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa365、RoboTwin 2.0、R2R-CE Val-Unseen 以及多个真实世界操作任务上评估，OmniBrain-0 兼具强跨域任务性能，且推理与执行开销显著低于其闭源教师模型。
AI.conclusion: 具身能力可被高效地迁移并整合进紧凑的统一智能体，验证了"决策层统一 + 多教师在线蒸馏 + 递归自我改进"路线的有效性与效率优势。

title: Is the education gap in generative AI use smaller than the internet's was at a similar level of use? Evidence from 16 European countries
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures. Code, data and outputs are provided as ancillary files
summary: New technologies are usually adopted first by people with more formal education. This paper asks whether the education gap in generative AI use in 2025 is smaller or larger than the internet's gap in the same country in the year when overall internet use was at a similar level. It uses public Eurostat survey data on ICT usage by individuals aged 16 to 74. Each country's 2025 rate of generative AI use in the last three months is matched to the internet year whose overall last-three-months use was closest, within 5 percentage points, and the gap between people with high (ISCED 5 to 8) and low (ISCED 0 to 2) completed education is measured as a log ratio and as a percentage-point difference. Sixteen of 35 countries could be matched; most of the others were early internet adopters. In the matched countries, the generative AI gap was smaller in 13 of 16 countries on the log ratio (median change -0.625, 95% bootstrap interval -0.969 to -0.291, two-sided sign test p = 0.021) and in 15 of 16 on the percentage-point gap (median change -27.6 points, interval -32.2 to -16.8, p = 0.0005). The point-gap result keeps its sign in every generative-AI-versus-internet sensitivity analysis with 8 or more countries, including comparisons restricted on both sides to ages 25 to 54 and 55 to 74, but its size is sensitive to matching that takes education composition into account (about -10 to -11 points in 7 and 8 countries). The ratio result is fragile: it fails the decision rule when countries matched at their first internet observation are removed (9 of 11, p = 0.065). The analysis follows an unpublished plan whose timing cannot be verified, so it is not presented as pre-registered. The results describe unadjusted education contrasts in a non-random set of countries, not an education effect, and do not generalise to the EU as a whole.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了2025年生成式AI使用中的教育差距与同一国家互联网普及率相当时的教育差距，发现匹配到的16国中生成式AI的百分点差距普遍更小，但效应大小与结论稳健性有限。
AI.motivation: 新技术通常先被受教育程度较高者采用，作者想检验生成式AI的教育使用差距相对互联网时代是扩大还是缩小，以判断扩散不平等是否加剧。
AI.method: 使用Eurostat 16–74岁个人ICT使用调查数据；将各国2025年近三个月生成式AI使用率匹配到总体使用率最接近（差异≤5个百分点）的互联网年份，以对数比和百分点差衡量高（ISCED 5–8）与低（ISCED 0–2）教育群体差距，并用bootstrap区间与符号检验。
AI.result: 35国中16国可匹配。对数比差距在13/16国更小（中位变化-0.625，95%区间-0.969至-0.291，p=0.021）；百分点差距在15/16国更小（-27.6点，区间-32.2至-16.8，p=0.0005）。百分点结果在多种敏感性分析中方向一致，但考虑教育构成匹配后约为-10至-11点；对数比结果在剔除首次互联网观测国后不稳健（9/11，p=0.065）。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI的教育使用差距在百分点上小于可比互联网时期，但结论受匹配方法与样本选择影响；结果为非随机国家样本中的未调整教育对比，非教育因果效应，不能推广至整个欧盟，且分析未预注册。

title: Physiognomy Revisited: How Vision-Language Models Encode Sensitive Attributes Through Image Transformation
summary: Emergent generative AI technologies, while remarkably beneficial across several tasks and domains, can suffer from unforeseen vulnerabilities and difficult-to-anticipate failure modes. Such failure modes can disparately affect vulnerable communities. This paper investigates two well-known vision language models (VLMs) and inspects how these models encode protected identities while generating images. We show that when VLMs are requested to transform human face images to reflect race identities (e.g., Hispanic, Black, White, or Asian) and sexual orientation (e.g., gay or straight), VLMs often comply with such requests. We demonstrate that compliance (and refusal) is non-deterministic, group-sensitive, and generated images are statistically distinguishable, often accentuating deep-seated stereotypes. We further show that representation biases introduced during image generation can re-emerge in textual reasoning and characterization tasks. Finally, we show that this worrisome finding is not limited to racial identity or sexual orientation, image generation can perpetuate bias around criminality, raising concerning possibilities of AI-assisted profiling.

AI.tldr: 研究两个视觉语言模型在图像生成中对受保护身份（种族、性取向）的编码，发现顺从/拒绝是随机且群体敏感的，生成图像可统计区分并强化刻板印象，且偏差会回流到文本推理，并延伸至犯罪性偏见。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI存在难以预见的失败模式，可能对弱势群体造成不成比例的影响，需考察VLM如何在生成图像时编码受保护身份。
AI.method: 对两个主流视觉语言模型进行审计实验：要求其将人脸图像转换为特定种族（如西班牙裔、黑人、白人、亚裔）和性取向（同性恋/异性恋）身份，统计分析顺从率、拒绝率的确定性、群体差异，以及生成图像的统计可区分性与刻板印象；并测试图像生成偏差是否影响文本推理与描述任务，进一步考察犯罪性相关偏见。
AI.result: 模型对身份转换请求常予以顺从；顺从与拒绝具有非确定性、群体敏感性；生成图像在统计上可区分并常放大深层刻板印象；图像生成引入的表征偏差会在文本推理与人物刻画任务中重现；偏差不限于种族与性取向，还延伸至犯罪性，带来AI辅助画像的风险。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型的图像生成会系统性编码并放大受保护身份偏见，且可跨模态传播，构成对弱势群体的差异化风险与AI辅助画像的隐忧，需引起重视。

title: Curriculum-Driven Deep Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Far-Range Rocket Landing
comment: This is the extension of our previous paper that got accepted in ICAART 2026
summary: Autonomous vertical landing of reusable launch vehicles is a critical yet formidable challenge in aerospace engineering, primarily due to highly nonlinear dynamics, stringent precision require- ments, and inherent environmental uncertainties. While reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising alternative to traditional model-based control, existing approaches frequently rely on flat training paradigms and highly simplified initial conditions, drastically limiting their real-world applicability. This paper proposes a comprehensive curriculum-driven deep reinforcement learning framework designed to master both far-range navigation and precision landing. By employing a three-stage curriculum augmented with a critic warm-up procedure and a rehearsal mechanism to prevent catastrophic forgetting, alongside a high-dimensional observation vector utilizing a full 3 X 3 rotation-matrix, the agent is trained to navigate from an initial horizontal distance of 1,000 to 1,500 units vastly farther than prior benchmarks before executing a soft touchdown. Crucially, we intro- duce a redesigned reward function that reduces unnecessary computational overhead and addresses limitations of earlier formulations, including poorly calibrated reward components and potentially conflicting optimization objectives. The redesigned function bounds the per-step reward magnitude by (O(1)), while its progress term accumulates the total distance closed over the trajectory. The available 100,000-episode results report a 99.98% success rate for the proposed policy and 68.31% for the baseline under the evaluation conditions. In the evaluation, the proposed policy retained 69.1% of its initial fuel capacity and achieved a mean final distance from the pad centre of 7.07 units, compared with 13.10 units for the baseline. Landing visualizations are available in Video 1 and Video 2.

AI.tldr: 提出课程驱动的深度强化学习框架，实现火箭远距离导航与高精度软着陆，成功率99.98%。
AI.motivation: 可重复使用运载器自主垂直着陆面临强非线性、高精度要求与环境不确定性；现有RL方法依赖平面化训练范式和过度简化的初始条件，且奖励函数存在量纲失配与目标冲突问题，限制实际应用。
AI.method: 采用三阶段课程学习，配合critic预热与防灾难性遗忘的回放机制；观测向量采用完整3×3旋转矩阵的高维表示；并重新设计奖励函数，使单步奖励幅度约束在O(1)，进度项累计轨迹中的总接近距离。初始水平距离设为1000–1500单位，远超此前基准。
AI.result: 在10万回合下，所提策略成功率99.98%，基线为68.31%；保留初始燃料的69.1%，最终距着陆台中心平均7.07单位，基线为13.10单位。
AI.conclusion: 课程驱动训练、结构化观测表示与规范化奖励设计相结合，可显著提升远距离自主着陆的成功率、燃料效率与着陆精度，为RL在运载器着陆中的实用化提供可行路径。

title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
summary: Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction. However, scaling this process faces two bottlenecks: constructing heterogeneous, verifiable environments is costly, and manual Harness iteration cannot keep pace with growing task diversity and complexity. A key insight is that tasks with different modalities and surface forms can share the same underlying capability requirements. We therefore introduce The Trinity, a recursive self-improvement framework coupling world generation with Harness evolution through three roles: Creator, Explorer, and Evolver. Drawing on verified execution trajectories, Evolver shifts the basis of task organization from surface categories to shared requirements, reorganizing the original task tree into a hierarchical capability tree. We introduce Capability-Driven Real2Sim2Real: for heterogeneous tasks at the same node, Creator abstracts their common requirements into simplified, verifiable simulated worlds for capability learning, while evaluation on original tasks measures transfer. Along this capability tree, Explorer progressively evolves reusable capability modules through selective inheritance, forming a Harness tree whose validated updates accumulate across iterations within a fixed topology. The resulting Harnesses specialize in different capabilities, motivating a Capability-Aware Harness Router that uses public task information to select compatible module configurations from the tree. Our evolved Harnesses improve mean performance by 34 points across 28 training benchmarks and 26 points across 18 unseen benchmarks, including two real-world embodied tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 "The Trinity" 递归自我改进框架，将世界生成与 Harness 演化通过 Creator/Explorer/Evolver 三角色耦合，并以"能力树"替代表面任务分类，配合 Capability-Driven Real2Sim2Real 与路由机制，在 28 个训练基准与 18 个未见基准上分别提升 34 与 26 分。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能可视为人类引导下世界与智能体通过交互的协同演化，但规模化面临两个瓶颈：构建异构、可验证的环境成本高昂；人工 Harness 迭代速度跟不上任务多样性与复杂度的增长。核心洞见是不同模态与表面形式的任务可共享相同的底层能力需求。
AI.method: 三角色递归框架：Evolver 基于已验证执行轨迹，将任务组织依据从表面类别转为共享需求，把原任务树重组为分层能力树；Creator 对同一节点上的异构任务抽象出简化、可验证的模拟世界（Capability-Driven Real2Sim2Real），在原任务上评估迁移；Explorer 沿能力树通过选择性继承逐步演化可复用能力模块，形成固定拓扑下跨迭代累积验证更新的 Harness 树；再用 Capability-Aware Harness Router 依据公开任务信息选择兼容的模块配置。
AI.result: 演化后的 Harness 在 28 个训练基准上平均性能提升 34 分，在 18 个未见基准上提升 26 分，其中包括两个真实世界具身任务。
AI.conclusion: 以"共享能力需求"而非表面模态/形式来组织任务，可让世界构建与 Harness 演化相互促进、递归自我改进，并获得可迁移到未见任务的能力模块与有效路由。

title: Before the First Edit? Measuring When Coding-Agent Guidance Actually Arrives
summary: When a coding-agent harness promises guidance before the first source edit, what event does it actually intercept? We audit five separate events: policy assignment, request eligibility, trigger, plan delivery, and observed source-content change. A prescribed-action comparison exposes the coverage of three gate rules but cannot tell us how an agent would continue after receiving a plan. We therefore run local agents on public software issues and hash Python files before and after each executed action. In a pilot-guided, 76-arm study using Qwen2.5-Coder 14B, 15 arms change Python source across seven tasks and three repositories. Guidance precedes every observed first change, but every change uses a structured editor and the study misses its prespecified 20-arm coverage target. Post hoc local tests find seven changed arms that pass the tested target and regression selectors; four of those seven use incomplete regression lists. Public PAUSE and SI2CA trajectories add source-text changes bracketed by adjacent reads, but lack synchronized filesystem states and cannot identify exact first mutations. The audit makes the timing claim testable within a stated source scope. These data do not show that planning improves repair correctness or covers shell-first writes in live agent runs.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计"编码智能体在首次修改源码前获得指导"这一承诺究竟拦截了哪个事件，并对76臂本地实验进行检验。
AI.motivation: "pre-edit guidance"承诺模糊：政策分配、请求资格、触发、计划交付、实际源内容变化是五个不同事件，需澄清并检验可测试性。
AI.method: 审计五个分离事件；用规定动作对照暴露三条门规则覆盖范围；在公开软件issue上运行Qwen2.5-Coder 14B本地智能体，对每次执行动作前后的Python文件做哈希，形成76臂先导研究；对PAUSE与SI2CA公开轨迹作补充分析。
AI.result: 15臂在7个任务、3个仓库中修改了Python源码；所有观测到的首次变更前均有指导，但全部经结构化编辑器，未达预设20臂覆盖目标。事后本地检验中7个变更臂通过目标与回归选择器，其中4个回归列表不完整。PAUSE/SI2CA轨迹显示源码变更夹在相邻读取之间，但缺乏同步文件系统状态，无法确定确切首次变异。
AI.conclusion: 该审计使时间性主张在明确源码范围内可检验；但数据不能证明规划提升修复正确性，也未覆盖真实智能体运行中的shell优先写入。

title: LociArt: A Unified Paradigm for Free-Style Local Video Stylization
summary: Video stylization typically transforms entire scenes, while local artistic editing requires precise region--style association, spatial control, and temporal consistency. We introduce LociArt, a unified paradigm for free-style local video stylization that explicitly specifies where to stylize and what style to apply while preserving non-target content. At its core, GRNStyle builds on Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) and introduces a polar style-aware mask that embeds style identities as equal-norm directions within selected regions. Complementary representation--geometry conditioning combines encoded mask features with raw-mask spatial support, integrating spatiotemporal context with geometric control. To provide paired supervision, we develop an automated pipeline combining global stylization, video object removal, matting, and compositing, and construct the LociArt-100K Dataset with 100K local stylization pairs. We further establish the LociArt Benchmark, comprising 80 source videos and 84 target masks covering 168 foreground/background stylization cases, with a Style Prototype Similarity (SPS) evaluation scheme for regional style quality and complementary measures of non-target preservation and temporal consistency. Experiments show that GRNStyle outperforms existing methods in regional style quality and spatial control while maintaining strong temporal consistency. Qualitative examples further illustrate joint stylization of multiple regions with the same or different learned styles, despite training only on single-region, single-style pairs. Together, these components provide a unified foundation for learning and evaluating controllable local video stylization. Project page: https://higherhu.github.io/lociart/.

AI.tldr: 提出 LociArt 统一范式与 GRNStyle 方法，实现可控的局部视频风格化，并构建 LociArt-100K 数据集与 LociArt Benchmark 评测体系。
AI.motivation: 现有视频风格化多针对整场景，而局部艺术编辑需要精确的区域-风格关联、空间控制与时间一致性，并保持非目标内容不变，现有方法难以满足。
AI.method: GRNStyle 基于生成式精炼网络（GRN），引入极坐标风格感知掩码，将风格身份编码为区域内等范数方向；采用表示-几何条件化，结合掩码编码特征与原始掩码空间支撑，融合时空上下文与几何控制。通过全局风格化+视频对象移除+抠图+合成的自动化流程构建 100K 配对数据集。
AI.result: 在区域风格质量与空间控制上优于现有方法，同时保持较强时间一致性；定性结果展示可对多区域进行同风格或不同风格联合风格化，尽管仅用单区域单风格配对训练。另提出 Style Prototype Similarity (SPS) 评测方案及非目标保持与时间一致性指标。
AI.conclusion: LociArt 为可控局部视频风格化的学习与评测提供了统一基础。

title: Learning-Augmented Coordination Mechanisms
comment: This paper has been accepted to the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Abstract abridged due to arXiv length limit
summary: The inefficiency of decentralized resource allocation is classically measured by the Price of Anarchy (PoA) and the Price of Stability (PoS). The most widely studied and foundational class of these models are atomic and non-atomic congestion games, for which a robust theory quantifying the inefficiency of equilibria is well-established. To mitigate the effects of selfish behavior, we employ Coordination Mechanisms, which modify resource costs to incentivize socially improved equilibria. However, standard Coordination Mechanisms assume unknown, adversarial demand, restricting positive results mainly to specialized networks such as parallel links. We address this limitation by studying learning-augmented coordination mechanisms, where the mechanism is endowed with a potentially inaccurate prediction of the demand. We study general atomic and non-atomic congestion games with polynomial latency functions of degree $d$. Our main positive result is a learning-augmented coordination mechanism tuned by a confidence parameter $β$ which achieves a "best of both worlds" type of result: approximately optimal performance for an accurate prediction without sacrificing the worst-case guarantee of a good equilibrium (PoS). We further establish bounds on PoA-Robustness (worst equilibrium performance under cost modification). Our construction relies on transforming approximate equilibria of the original game into exact equilibria of the modified game using an approximate potential function. We complement our positive results with impossibility results. We first show that requiring all equilibria to have optimal social cost under an accurate prediction precludes bounded robustness. We also show a strong error tolerance limit in non-atomic games: even infinitesimal prediction errors can cause the performance of a mechanism with optimal consistency to revert to the original PoA.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究带学习增强的协调机制，用于一般原子与非原子拥塞博弈（多项式延迟函数），在需求预测可能不准的情况下实现"两全其美"：预测准确时逼近最优，预测不准时仍保持有界的PoS保证，并给出相应的不可能性结果。
AI.motivation: 标准协调机制假设需求未知且对抗性，导致正面结果仅限于并行链路等特殊网络；作者希望通过引入（可能不准确的）需求预测来突破这一限制，扩大协调机制在一般拥塞博弈中的适用范围。
AI.method: 针对度数为d的多项式延迟函数下的一般原子/非原子拥塞博弈，设计由置信参数β调优的学习增强协调机制；核心技巧是用近似势函数将原游戏的近似均衡转化为修改后游戏的精确均衡，并分析PoA-Robustness（成本修改下最差均衡表现）。
AI.result: 主要正面结果：所提机制在预测准确时达到近似最优性能，同时不牺牲最差情况下的PoS保证；并给出PoA-Robustness的界。不可能性结果：(1) 若要求预测准确时所有均衡都达到最优社会成本，则鲁棒性无法有界；(2) 非原子博弈存在强误差容忍极限——即使无穷小的预测误差，也可使具备最优一致性的机制退化回原始PoA。
AI.conclusion: 学习增强协调机制能在一般拥塞博弈中兼顾一致性与鲁棒性，但存在结构性权衡：全均衡最优性与有界鲁棒性不可兼得，且非原子博弈对预测误差极其敏感。这为机制设计在预测质量与最坏情况保证之间的取舍提供了理论刻画。

title: Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?
summary: Large language model (LLM)-driven agent scaffold evolution improves agent workflows through iterative candidate generation and evaluation. Evaluation both guides subsequent search and determines the final scaffold, but evaluating every candidate on the full task set incurs substantial execution costs. We investigate how evaluation budgets can be allocated across these two roles. Our experiments show that sparse feedback can sustain productive evolution, while additional targeted evaluation improves final selection. Replay analyses further show that shared informative items and a common scoring reference support comparisons among closely matched candidates. Motivated by these findings, we propose \method, an evaluation allocation framework that combines sparse search-time feedback with targeted final confirmation. A short fully evaluated warm-up establishes a shared informative core and calibrates a response model whose item parameters remain fixed during search. After search, \method refits the model and applies paired successive halving, reusing accumulated observations and executing only missing evaluations. Across four benchmarks and two evolution frameworks, \method achieves higher mean performance than full evaluation in most settings while using approximately half as many evaluation cells.

AI.tldr: 提出评估预算分配框架，用稀疏搜索反馈加定向最终确认，在约一半评估成本下取得优于全量评估的平均性能。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的智能体脚手架进化需要迭代生成并评估候选，但评估每个候选在全任务集上执行成本高；论文研究如何把评估预算分配给"引导搜索"和"确定最终选择"这两个角色。
AI.method: 实验发现稀疏反馈足以维持有效进化，额外定向评估有助于最终选择；回放分析显示共享信息量高的题目和统一评分基准支持近似候选间比较。据此提出评估分配框架：先用短的全量评估热身，建立共享信息核心并校准一个题目参数在搜索期间保持固定的响应模型；搜索结束后重拟合模型并采用配对逐次减半（paired successive halving），复用已有观测、只补充缺失评估。
AI.result: 在四个基准和两个进化框架上，方法在多数设置下平均性能高于全量评估，而评估单元数约为其一半。
AI.conclusion: 评估预算可区分地分配给搜索引导与最终选择，稀疏反馈加定向确认是高效且有效的脚手架进化评估策略。

title: FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading
summary: Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to predicting the sentiment of each article in isolation and operate as black boxes, which limits contextual understanding and hinders deployment in high-stakes financial decision-making. To this end, we introduce FinLLM-KG, a model-agnostic framework that combines causal LLMs with a financial knowledge graph, in order to inject temporally grounded, company-level knowledge from SEC 10-K filings at inference time, without updating model weights. Within FinLLM-KG, context is supplied either as a natural-language company profile or as a small set of relevance-ranked factual triples. This enables sentiment predictions to account for broader firm-level information rather than the article alone, at almost zero computational cost and for any causal LLM. In addition, attributing each article-level sentiment score to individual sentences and to the retrieved knowledge-graph facts makes the evidence behind the prediction inspectable, thereby enhancing explainability and supporting human-in-the-loop review. Simulations demonstrate that FinLLM-KG consistently improves portfolio performance over the state-of-the-art baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出FinLLM-KG框架，用金融知识图谱为因果LLM在推理时注入公司级10-K知识，实现更准确、可解释且低成本的金融情感分析，并提升投资组合表现。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练的金融LLM情感分析方法仅限于孤立预测每篇文章的情感，且为黑箱模型，缺乏上下文理解，难以用于高风险金融决策。
AI.method: 模型无关框架：将因果LLM与金融知识图谱结合，在推理时（不更新权重）注入来自SEC 10-K文件的、具有时间依据的公司级知识；上下文以自然语言公司简介或少量相关性排序的事实三元组形式提供；并将情感分数归因到句子与检索到的图谱事实以增强可解释性。
AI.result: 模拟实验表明FinLLM-KG持续优于SOTA基线，提升投资组合表现；几乎零计算成本，适用于任意因果LLM。
AI.conclusion: 通过知识图谱增强上下文并支持人机协同审查，FinLLM-KG在准确性、可解释性与成本之间取得平衡，适合高风险金融决策部署。

title: Counterfactual Profile Perturbations for Recommendation Explanations: A Reproducibility Study
summary: This reproducibility paper explores the counterfactual explanation technique known as Learning to eXplain Recommendations (LXR). Prior work has shown that LXR can reliably identify perturbations that, if applied to a user's profile, cause the user's top ranked item to no longer be recommended, thereby explaining the item's recommendation as a function of the user's rating choices. In this paper, we extend this work in multiple ways. We expand the scope of the original LXR study to look at explanations for items other than the most highly recommended item, finding that LXR is also effective at this version of the task. We consider alternate baselines for LXR, including item popularity and latent factor similarity, and we see that for some tasks these alternatives work surprisingly well. We also examine the impact of item popularity, finding that LXR offers better explanation quality (shorter perturbations) when less popular items are being explained. Finally, we conduct a brute-force exploration of a subset of the perturbation space in order to estimate a lower bound for optimal perturbation size against which LXR and other such methods can be compared.
