AI.tldr: 对推荐系统反事实解释方法LXR进行复现与扩展研究，评估其在更广任务上的解释效果、与流行度/隐因子相似性基线的对比、物品热门度的影响，并估计最优扰动长度下界。
AI.motivation: LXR先前被证明能为用户最高排名推荐物品生成有效扰动解释，但其适用范围、相对其他基线方法的优势以及解释质量的理论极限尚不清楚，需要系统性地复现与检验。
AI.method: 扩展原始LXR研究：将解释任务推广到非最高排名物品；引入物品流行度与潜在因子相似性等替代基线进行对比；分析物品流行度对扰动长度的影响；通过暴力枚举部分扰动空间估计最优扰动规模的下界。
AI.result: LXR在解释非最高排名物品时同样有效；某些替代基线（如流行度和隐因子相似性）在部分任务上表现出乎意料地好；被解释物品越不流行，LXR生成的扰动越短、解释质量越高；并给出了可与其他方法对比的最优扰动规模下界估计。
AI.conclusion: LXR具有较好的可复现性与任务泛化性，但并非在所有情境下都显著优于简单基线，且其解释质量受物品流行度影响；所估计的最优扰动下界为后续反事实解释方法的评估提供了参照标准。

title: Learning and Reasoning with Geometry: How Generation Helps Spatial Understanding
summary: Image and video generators can produce spatially consistent visual content, but how to use this capability to improve spatial understanding remains underexplored. We study this problem from two perspectives: geometric supervision during training and explicit geometric evidence during inference. To this end, we introduce a unified geometric understanding and generation model (GeoUG) that integrates depth and multi-view generation with spatial understanding. First, we design a multi-scale depth codec that enables metric-depth generation using a pretrained visual autoencoder, and show that joint training yields task-dependent gains in spatial understanding. Second, we introduce 3DCueBench to control geometric difficulty while balancing selected 2D cues, and find that generated depth provides larger reasoning gains on questions requiring fine-grained geometric discrimination. Building on this finding, we develop adaptive interleaved reasoning, in which GeoUG first drafts an answer and then decides whether to generate geometric evidence to confirm or revise it. We train this decision through reinforcement learning, balancing accuracy gains over retaining the draft against generation cost. GeoUG achieves circular accuracies of 97.9%, 90.8%, and 94.2% on CV-Bench-3D, 3DCueBench, and DA-2K with fewer generation calls than always generating.

AI.tldr: GeoUG统一模型将深度/多视角生成与空间理解结合，提出多尺度深度编解码器与自适应交错推理，在多个3D基准上取得高分且减少生成调用。
AI.motivation: 图像/视频生成器能产生空间一致的视觉内容，但如何借此提升空间理解仍未被充分探索；论文从训练期的几何监督与推理期的显式几何证据两个角度切入。
AI.method: 1) 设计多尺度深度编解码器，基于预训练视觉自编码器实现度量深度生成并联合训练；2) 构建3DCueBench以控制几何难度并平衡2D线索；3) 提出自适应交错推理，模型先草拟答案，再决定是否生成几何证据以确认/修正，并通过强化学习训练该决策以权衡准确率收益与生成成本。
AI.result: 在CV-Bench-3D、3DCueBench、DA-2K上圆形准确率分别为97.9%、90.8%、94.2%，且生成调用次数少于"总是生成"策略；生成深度对需细粒度几何辨别的题目增益更大。
AI.conclusion: 生成能力可作为显式几何证据反哺空间理解，且按需生成比无条件生成更高效，联合训练带来任务相关的增益。

title: ResCom: Activation Residual Compensation for Large Language Model Quantization
comment: 25 pages (10 pages main text + appendix), 9 figures, 20 tables
summary: Low-bit weight--activation quantization reduces the memory and computation needed to deploy large language models, but activation rounding can still degrade accuracy after calibration. Reconstruction from rounded inputs cannot distinguish activations within the same quantization bin. We propose ResCom, a low-rank correction that uses the activation rounding residual to compensate for the resulting layer-output error. An output-aware calibration procedure selects residual directions by their contribution to output reconstruction and computes the correction in closed form, without gradient training or updates to the calibrated weights. On Llama-3-8B with 4-bit weights and activations, rank-32 attention corrections reduce WikiText-2 perplexity from 7.708 to 7.147, improve MMLU by 2.89 percentage points, and raise five-shot GSM8K accuracy from 23.96 to 36.16 percent. Evaluations on models from 1B to 70B parameters and on held-out C4 test the method beyond this setting. The evaluated FP32 implementation adds 2.25 percent to 4K prefill time; a separate compact-storage implementation retains a 27.7 percent peak-memory reduction relative to FP16.

AI.tldr: ResCom 提出一种低秩校正方法，利用激活舍入残差补偿量化层的输出误差，在无需梯度训练、不改动已校准权重的前提下显著改善 4-bit 权重量化模型精度。
AI.motivation: 低比特权重-激活量化可降低大模型部署的内存与计算开销，但激活舍入会在校准后仍损害精度；仅从已舍入输入做重构无法区分落入同一量化区间的激活，导致输出误差难以消除。
AI.method: 利用激活舍入残差构造低秩校正项以补偿层输出误差；采用输出感知的校准流程，依据各残差方向对输出重构的贡献进行选择，并以闭式解计算校正参数，无需梯度训练，也不更新已校准权重。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3-8B（4-bit 权重与激活）上，rank-32 的注意力校正将 WikiText-2 困惑度从 7.708 降至 7.147，MMLU 提升 2.89 个百分点，五-shot GSM8K 从 23.96% 提升至 36.16%；并在 1B–70B 模型及 C4 留出集上验证了泛化性。FP32 实现使 4K prefill 时间增加 2.25%，紧凑存储版本相对 FP16 仍保持 27.7% 的峰值内存降低。
AI.conclusion: 基于舍入残差的低秩闭式校正能有效弥补激活量化误差，在精度与部署开销间取得良好平衡，具备跨模型规模与数据集的适用性。

title: CohortFlow: A Steerable Clinical Cohort Curation Agent with Localized Semantic Correction
summary: Language model agents for clinical cohort curation should accommodate evolving eligibility criteria without repeatedly processing unchanged requirements. We introduce CohortFlow, a steerable agent that represents natural language corrections as localized updates to a structured cohort specification and reconciles them with a persistent execution graph. Explicitly recorded semantic dependencies enable affected computations to be selectively invalidated while preserving valid prior results. On 100 scenarios derived from clinical-trial eligibility criteria, comprising 126 correction turns, localized steering achieves 77.0% requirement micro-F1 versus 76.4% for full regeneration using the same 8B model, a small numerical advantage that is not statistically significant ($p=0.493$). It reduces mean correction latency by 64.8% after completion and 44.3% during execution, with 38.1% fewer model calls. In a separate proof-of-concept evaluation over MIMIC, all 13 cohort states execute successfully, while correction trajectories demonstrate selective preservation of unaffected computations and recomputation of changed or dependent nodes. Together, these results show that localized semantic steering can substantially reduce correction latency and model calls while maintaining strong requirement-level accuracy.

AI.tldr: CohortFlow：将临床队列的自然语言修正表示为结构化规格的局部更新，并与持久执行图对齐，通过记录语义依赖只失效受影响的计算，从而在保持需求级准确率的同时大幅降低修正延迟与模型调用次数。
AI.motivation: 面向临床队列构建的语言模型智能体需要随纳排标准演化而调整，但现有方法往往对未变动的需求反复全量重算，代价高、延迟大。
AI.method: 提出可操控智能体CohortFlow：(1) 把自然语言修正解析为对结构化队列规格的局部更新；(2) 将更新与持久执行图reconcile；(3) 显式记录计算间的语义依赖，据此选择性失效受影响节点，保留有效的历史结果。
AI.result: 在100个基于临床试验纳排标准的情景（含126轮修正）上，局部操控的需求micro-F1为77.0%，全量重生成（同8B模型）为76.4%，差异不显著（p=0.493）；修正延迟平均降低64.8%（完成后）/44.3%（执行中），模型调用减少38.1%。在MIMIC的概念验证中，13个队列状态全部成功执行，轨迹显示未受影响计算被保留、变更或依赖节点被重算。
AI.conclusion: 局部语义操控可在保持较强需求级准确率的前提下，显著降低修正延迟和模型调用；准确率优势有限，主要收益在于效率，MIMIC验证仍属概念性。

title: CIVER: Causal Intervention Verification for Reliable Code Review
summary: Code review is essential for maintaining software repositories by identifying defects, improving code quality, and supporting reliable software evolution. With the growing adoption of LLM-based coding agents, an increasing number of code contributions and repository changes are generated by these agents. Consequently, LLM-based code review agents are becoming increasingly prevalent to evaluate these contributions and maintain software quality. However, LLM reviewers often generate lengthy reviews containing numerous potential issues, many of which are false positives or lack sufficient evidence. These unreliable reviews can mislead developers and downstream coding agents, motivating the need to distinguish actionable findings from unsupported claims. We propose CIVER, a causal intervention-based framework that identifies the core issues underlying code-review findings and distinguishes genuine defects from false positives. CIVER integrates three modules: a review module assesses findings, an intervention module generates repair-oriented perturbations, and a verifier module scores review reliability. Through joint optimization via expert iteration, the three modules identify genuine defects by responding to targeted repairs while remaining stable under unrelated changes. Extensive experiments on SWE-Review-Bench demonstrate that CIVER correctly identifies 77% of genuine defects through targeted repairs. Cross-project and downstream repair evaluations further demonstrate that CIVER generalizes across repositories and improves coding agents' task success rates, highlighting its effectiveness for reliable automated code review.

AI.tldr: 提出 CIVER——基于因果干预的代码审查框架，通过"审查-干预-验证"三模块区分真实缺陷与误报。
AI.motivation: LLM 代码审查代理生成的评审冗长且含大量误报或无据问题，会误导开发者与下游编码代理，需区分可执行发现与无支撑声明。
AI.method: CIVER 含三模块：review 模块评估发现、intervention 模块生成面向修复的扰动、verifier 模块对审查可靠性打分；通过专家迭代联合优化，使系统对定向修复敏感、对无关改动稳定。
AI.result: 在 SWE-Review-Bench 上正确识别 77% 的真实缺陷；跨项目与下游修复评估显示可跨仓库泛化，并提升编码代理任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 因果干预式验证能有效过滤 LLM 审查误报，提升自动代码审查的可靠性与下游实用性。

title: Confident First, Reflective Second: Reinforcement Learning of Confidence-Preserving Reflection for Video Understanding
summary: Video models answer from sampled frames and may miss the decisive moment. A common remedy is to commit to an answer, re-examine the video, and confirm or revise it, a loop now mainly learned with reinforcement learning (RL). We find that RL erodes the initial answer, a phenomenon we term confidence erosion, where confidence means the label-verified reliability of the initial answer instead of self-reported certainty: because errors can be repaired later, a correct initial answer earns less reward, and the initial answer stalls even as the final answer's gain over it rises. We propose the principle confident first, reflective second: the initial answer must stay reliable on its own, above a floor set by a reference policy, and reflection may only add to it. Our method, CoFire, implements this principle with one mechanism for each erosion channel: reward incentives, parameter drift, and gradient interference. CoFire reaches 67.0% mean accuracy on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench, 1.7 points above the strongest compared 7B method, and improves initial-answer and final accuracy over outcome-reward RL by 4.1 and 3.7 points on average: a stronger initial answer carries through to a stronger final one.

AI.tldr: 视频模型基于采样帧作答时可能错过关键瞬间，常见做法是"先作答—再看视频—确认或修正"的循环，多用强化学习训练，但RL会侵蚀初始答案的可靠性（confidence erosion）。作者提出"先自信、后反思"原则及CoFire方法，最终模型平均准确率达67.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有反思式视频问答主要用RL学习"作答-重看-修正"循环，但由于错误可在后续被修复，一个正确的初始答案获得的奖励反而更少，导致初始答案质量停滞甚至退化（confidence erosion），即使最终答案相对初始答案的提升在增大。
AI.method: 提出"先自信、后反思"（confident first, reflective second）原则：初始答案须独立可靠，不低于参考策略设定的下限，反思只能在其基础上增益。方法CoFire针对三种侵蚀渠道——奖励激励、参数漂移、梯度干扰——各设一种机制加以约束。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、MLVU、LongVideoBench上平均准确率67.0%，比最强对比7B方法高1.7分；相比结果奖励RL，初始答案与最终答案准确率平均分别提升4.1和3.7分。
AI.conclusion: 更强的初始答案可传导为更强的最终答案，说明保护初始答案可靠性是提升反思式视频推理的有效途径。

title: Optimality and Impossibility in Multidimensional Strategyproof Facility Location
summary: We study facility location in multidimensional normed spaces with the objective of minimizing social cost, the sum of agents' distances to their nearest facility. A deterministic mechanism selects $k$ facility locations based on the reports of $n$ agents and is strategyproof (SP) if no agent can reduce her distance by misreporting her location. We establish optimal approximation ratios and impossibility results. For a single facility in the Euclidean plane, we prove that the optimal approximation ratios among deterministic SP mechanisms are exactly those obtained by Goel and Hann-Caruthers [SCW 2023] for the coordinate-wise median (CM): $\frac{\sqrt{2(n^2+1)}}{n+1}$ for odd $n\ge3$ and $\sqrt{2}$ for even $n\ge4$. We remove the anonymity assumption from their optimality result. However, CM is not always optimal in non-Euclidean spaces: we give an SP mechanism that minimizes social cost exactly in $\ell_\infty^d$, whereas CM has a tight uniform approximation ratio of $2$ already in the plane. We then consider two facilities in $\ell_p$ spaces with $1<p<\infty$ and prove two impossibility results for every $n>2$. In the plane, no deterministic SP mechanism has a finite approximation ratio. In higher dimensions, the same impossibility holds for anonymous deterministic SP mechanisms. Finally, a reduction using distant agents and a limiting argument extends both impossibility results to every $k>2$ with $n>k$.

AI.tldr: 研究多维赋范空间中最小化社会成本的设施选址机制设计，给出确定性策略防串谋（SP）机制的最优近似比与不可能性结果。
AI.motivation: 设施选址中社会成本最小化的SP机制近似比在多维赋范空间（尤其非欧空间、多设施情形）尚不清楚，需确定最优界与不可能性边界。
AI.method: 针对单设施欧氏平面证明坐标中位数（CM）的最优性（去掉匿名性假设）；在ℓ∞^d中构造精确最优的SP机制；对ℓ_p空间中两个设施，用不可行性证明与"远距离代理+极限论证"归约到k>2。
AI.result: 单设施欧氏平面最优近似比恰为CM的√(2(n²+1))/(n+1)（奇数n≥3）与√2（偶数n≥4）；ℓ∞^d中可精确最小化社会成本，而CM在平面紧界为2；ℓ_p中两设施：平面无有限近似比，高维对匿名确定性SP机制同样不可能，并推广到k>2、n>k。
AI.conclusion: CM在欧氏平面单设施下最优但非普适最优；非欧空间与多设施情形存在强不可能性，刻画了多维SP设施选址的可行性边界。

title: GAS-PFN: Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Zero-Shot Traffic Forecasting
summary: Traffic forecasting requires modeling complex temporal dynamics and the spatial dependencies imposed by road topology. Supervised graph-based models achieve strong performance, but are often trained for a particular dataset and sensor graph, making deployment to new or evolving networks costly. Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) offer a zero-shot alternative by learning in-context inference from synthetic task priors, which provide an explicit mechanism for encoding domain-specific assumptions. Existing forecasting PFNs, however, do not explicitly represent the graph-structured dependencies governing traffic dynamics. To combine graph-aware traffic modeling with zero-shot adaptation, we introduce the Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Network (GAS-PFN). GAS-PFN incorporates sampled road topology into its synthetic task prior through random-walk diffusion, teaching the model to learn graph-coupled dynamics during pretraining. Its co-designed inference architecture uses two mask-conditioned passes through a shared Transformer backbone to separately model sensor-specific temporal dynamics and spatiotemporal interactions among neighboring sensors before integrating their representations for prediction. This design enables GAS-PFN to use target-network structure and context without parameter updates. Across six benchmarks at the 90-minute horizon, GAS-PFN reduces MSE by 34.0% on average relative to TimePFN, its closest PFN-based predecessor. It also reduces MSE by 27.7% on average relative to four recent industry-developed general-purpose zero-shot forecasters. In this comparison, all models receive 90 minutes of contiguous recent history, and any additional context is drawn from each dataset's chronological training split. These results indicate that aligning PFN priors and inference architectures with graph structure improves in-context learning for zero-shot traffic forecasting.

AI.tldr: GAS-PFN将采样路网拓扑通过随机游走扩散编码进合成任务先验，并设计两遍掩码条件的共享Transformer推理架构，实现无需参数更新的零样本交通预测。
AI.motivation: 监督式图模型性能强但绑定特定数据集与传感器图，迁移到新网络成本高；PFN可零样本上下文学习，但现有预测PFN未显式建模交通的空间图依赖。
AI.method: 构建图感知的合成任务先验，用随机游走扩散将采样道路拓扑注入数据生成过程，预训练中学习图耦合动态；推理端用共享Transformer骨干执行两次掩码条件前向，分别建模单传感器时间动态与邻接传感器时空交互，再融合表征预测，无需微调即可利用目标网络结构与上下文。
AI.result: 在6个基准、90分钟预测跨度上，MSE相比TimePFN平均降低34.0%，相比4个近期工业界通用零样本预测器平均降低27.7%（均给定90分钟连续历史）。
AI.conclusion: 将PFN先验与推理架构对齐图结构，可显著提升零样本交通预测的上下文学习效果。

title: 3, 7, 14, 17, 42: Instruction Tuning Installs and Sharpens Number-Choice Heuristics in Language Models
summary: We measure, without sampling error, the probability a language model assigns to each integer from 1 to N when asked for a random number. For a fixed prompt the model defines one probability vector, which we compute by summing over each integer's scored spellings rather than estimate by sampling, removing the noise that limits earlier studies [1, 4]. We evaluate 18 open-weight model lines at five ranges up to N = 100, under 29 decoding configurations, on two inference stacks; 15 of them have matched base and instruction-tuned checkpoints that both give usable answers. Instruction tuning makes the distribution less uniform in all 15 pairs. It installs one heuristic, round-number avoidance, and sharpens another, endpoint avoidance. Base checkpoints do not avoid round numbers once the endpoints are removed from those sets; tuned checkpoints avoid them, multiples of 10 almost completely. Base checkpoints return the endpoints 1 and N at 0.30 to 0.60 of the interior rate; tuned checkpoints almost never return them. A preference for odd numbers is consistent across tuned checkpoints only at N = 100, where base checkpoints also show it weakly. Endpoint avoidance and the odd preference fit the account Kubovy and Psotka [6] proposed for human number choice; round-number avoidance is not part of that account, and the midpoint avoidance it predicts is essentially absent, with one slight exception at N = 100. Tuning does not install a new favourite integer shared across models: above N = 10 no modal integer is shared by more than 42 percent of tuned conditions, and P (17) rises in 10 of 15 pairs and falls in 5. The concentration is present in the model's own distribution: at temperature 1.0, nucleus truncation at top-p 0.95 adds a median of 0.035 to the total variation distance.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过精确计算（而非采样估计）测量语言模型在"随机数"提示下对1至N每个整数的概率，系统比较18个开放权重模型系列的基座与指令微调版本、多种范围和解码配置，揭示指令微调如何塑造模型的数字选择偏好。
AI.motivation: 先前研究依赖采样估计随机数分布，存在采样噪声。作者希望无采样误差地获得模型对每个整数的精确概率，并系统性地考察指令微调对数字偏好分布的影响，同时检验人类数字选择理论（Kubovy & Psotka）是否适用于语言模型。
AI.method: 对固定提示，通过对每个整数的所有拼写形式打分求和得到概率向量，而非采样估计。评估18个开放权重模型系列，N至100的五个范围，29种解码配置，两种推理栈，其中15个具有可用的基座-指令微调配对。
AI.result: 指令微调在全部15对中使分布更不均匀：引入"回避整数"启发式并强化"回避端点"；基座模型去除端点后不回避整数，微调后几乎完全回避10的倍数；基座返回端点1和N的比率仅为内部值的0.30–0.60，微调几乎从不返回；奇数偏好仅在N=100时稳定出现；端点回避和奇数偏好符合人类理论，但回避整数不属于该理论，且预测的中点回避基本不存在；微调未安装跨模型共享的"最爱整数"（P(17)在10/15对中上升）；温度1.0下top-p 0.95核截断使总变差距离中位数增加0.035。
AI.conclusion: 指令微调系统性地重塑了模型的数字选择分布，引入并强化了特定的启发式（回避整数、回避端点），部分与人类数字选择行为一致但并非完全吻合，且未产生跨模型统一的最爱数字。解码配置本身也会影响分布集中度。

title: Preserving rare-item recall under a storage budget: quantization, distillation, and the limits of teacher fidelity
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Supplementary data and code included as ancillary files
summary: Under a fixed embedding-storage budget, recommenders can use a small full-precision model, a distilled student, or a higher-rank low-precision model. We asked which choice preserves rare-item recall and whether teacher fidelity reflects it in seven dataset-backbone cells: matrix factorization on Gowalla, Last.fm, Amazon Video Games, Steam, Goodbooks-10k and MovieLens-20M, and LightGCN on Amazon Video Games. Seven candidates fit in 168 bytes per user or item row: 40-dimensional Bayesian personalized ranking (BPR), two 40-dimensional unbiased knowledge distillation (UnKD) students, and factorizations of a 300-dimensional teacher's scores at ranks 40, 80, 155 and 300, stored in 32, 16, 8 and 4 bits. Each test set was evaluated once after fixing candidates and confirmatory analyses. The rank-300 4-bit factorization used 13% of teacher storage and retained 95-103% of its tail recall@20 and 93-97% of its NDCG@20 in every cell. The rank-40 factorization had the lowest tail recall in every cell; the 4-bit factorization had 1.2-12.7 times its tail recall and 0.99-1.46 times its NDCG. UnKD students retained 56-102% of teacher tail recall. In all ten prespecified comparisons across five prospective-expansion cells, the 4-bit factorization had higher tail recall, with simultaneous 95% intervals excluding zero. Teacher-hit retention, the share of the teacher's relevant tail hits also found by a model, ordered 23 of 147 candidate pairs differently from tail recall and identified the wrong tail-recall leader in 3 of 7 cells: models can find relevant tail items the teacher misses. In these cells, spending bytes on rank rather than precision preserved rare-item recall at 7.5 times the arithmetic per score. Compressed recommenders should be judged by total tail recall, not teacher fidelity alone.

AI.tldr: 在固定嵌入存储预算下，高秩低精度（秩300、4比特）分解比小全精度模型或蒸馏学生更能保留长尾物品的召回，且教师保真度不能替代尾部召回作为评价标准。
AI.motivation: 探究在固定每行168字节的嵌入存储预算下，应选择"小全精度模型""蒸馏学生"还是"更高秩但低精度模型"，并检验教师保真度（teacher fidelity）是否能反映稀有/长尾物品的召回表现。
AI.method: 在7个数据集-骨干网络组合（Gowalla、Last.fm、Amazon Video Games、Steam、Goodbooks-10k、MovieLens-20M上的矩阵分解，以及Amazon Video Games上的LightGCN）中比较7种候选：40维BPR、两个40维UnKD蒸馏学生，以及将300维教师打分分解为秩40/80/155/300并分别以32/16/8/4比特存储的版本。固定候选与分析后各测试集仅评估一次，并做10组预设对照比较。
AI.result: 秩300的4比特分解仅用教师13%存储，在所有组合中保留教师95-103%的tail recall@20与93-97%的NDCG@20；秩40分解在所有组合中尾部召回最低，4比特版本为其1.2-12.7倍尾部召回。UnKD学生保留56-102%教师尾部召回。10组预设比较中4比特分解尾部召回更高且95%区间不含零。教师命中保留率（teacher-hit retention）与尾部召回在147对中的23对排序不一致，并在7个组合中3个错误识别尾部召回领先者。
AI.conclusion: 在相同字节预算下，把预算用于提高秩而非精度可在7.5倍的每分数算术量下保留稀有物品召回；压缩推荐系统应以整体尾部召回而非仅教师保真度来评估。

title: Any3R: Feedforward 3D Reconstruction from Any Camera Type
summary: Geometry foundation models recover camera poses and dense geometry from a set of images with a feed-forward network, but they expect pinhole images. That assumption is inside the backbone too: the positional encoding and the training loss both bind an image position to a direction in space, and both depend on the lens. We condition both on the dense ray field, the unit direction through every pixel, which describes any central camera without a lens type, distortion coefficients or a bound on field of view. Angular coordinates give the rotary encoding the measured ray angle of each patch, evaluated per view, and solid-angle weighting scales the point loss by the area each pixel covers on the sphere, so neither the encoding nor the supervision depends on the lens. Any3R is therefore a feed-forward model that takes any central camera, and is robust to mixing many camera types per scene, with no retraining per lens. On a benchmark of thirteen central cameras across three datasets, where every method reconstructs with its own predicted camera poses, it is the most consistently accurate method. Any3R enables scalable 3D reconstruction from heterogeneous crowdsourced and archival imagery collections sourced across diverse camera types. Project page: https://jingong-chen.github.io/Any3R/

AI.tldr: Any3R：以密集光线场为条件改造几何基础模型的骨干，使前馈式相机位姿与稠密几何重建摆脱针孔假设，统一处理任意中心相机。
AI.motivation: 现有几何基础模型（如DUSt3R类）默认输入为针孔图像，且这一假设深入骨干：位置编码和训练损失都依赖镜头，将图像位置绑定到空间方向。这限制了其在鱼眼、全景等异构相机影像上的使用，且无法在同一场景中混合多种相机类型，需针对每种镜头重训练。
AI.method: 用密集光线场（每个像素的单位方向）作为条件，无需指定镜头类型、畸变系数或视场角上限。具体提出角坐标驱动的旋转编码：按视角为每个patch提供实测光线角度；并用立体角加权缩放点损失，按像素在球面上覆盖的面积加权。由此编码与监督均与镜头无关，形成对任意中心相机可用的前馈模型Any3R。
AI.result: 在覆盖三个数据集、十三种中心相机的基准上，各方法均使用自身预测的相机位姿进行重建，Any3R是最稳定准确的方法；对场景内混合多种相机类型具有鲁棒性，无需按镜头重新训练。
AI.conclusion: 将骨干中的位置编码与损失统一以光线场为条件，可把中心相机几何从针孔假设中解耦，使几何基础模型支持异构相机集合，为众包与档案影像的大规模三维重建铺路。

title: Distributed LLM Inference via Communication-Efficient Speculative Decoding
summary: Distributed speculative decoding has emerged as a promising approach for device--server collaborative large language model (LLM) inference, but its decoding speedup is often limited by the vocabulary-scale communication overhead. In existing distributed speculative decoding methods, exact rejection sampling requires transmitting full token distributions over the LLM vocabulary between the device and the server, which becomes costly in bandwidth-constrained environments. To address this issue, we propose DISCO, a communication-efficient framework for distributed speculative decoding, that eliminates vocabulary-scale distribution transfer while preserving the exact target distribution. DISCO achieves this by introducing a server-side replica of the draft small language model (SLM), which enables the server to locally obtain the draft-side distribution required for rejection sampling. As a result, DISCO exchanges only drafted token indices and scalar probability values between the device and the server. Experimental results on multiple datasets show that DISCO consistently achieves higher decoding speedup than existing distributed speculative decoding methods, particularly under stringent bandwidth constraints.

AI.tldr: DISCO 提出通信高效的分布式推测解码框架，通过在服务器端复刻草稿小模型，消除词汇表规模的分布传输，仅交换草稿 token 索引和标量概率，在保持精确目标分布的同时显著提升带宽受限下的解码加速。
AI.motivation: 现有分布式推测解码需在设备与服务器间传输整个词汇表规模的 token 分布以进行精确拒绝采样，在带宽受限环境开销巨大，限制了加速效果。
AI.method: 在服务器端部署草稿小语言模型（SLM）的副本，使服务器能本地获得拒绝采样所需的草稿侧分布；从而设备与服务器之间只需交换草稿 token 索引和标量概率值，而非全词汇分布。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，DISCO 相比现有分布式推测解码方法持续获得更高的解码加速，尤其在严格带宽约束下优势明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过在服务器端复刻草稿模型避免词汇表规模通信，DISCO 在保持精确目标分布的前提下实现通信高效且加速更高的分布式推测解码。

title: Why and How to Do Science When AI Is Better at It: A Framework Grounded in Human Understanding and Direction
summary: As AI begins to match or exceed human researchers at core scientific tasks, two questions become pressing: \emph{why} should humans keep doing science, and \emph{how} should they use AI when they do? This paper argues that the second can be answered only by answering the first. It holds that one indispensable aim of science is \emph{durable, collective human understanding of the world, pursued in service of human ends and values}. From this principle it derives a two-part test for when a research task can be delegated to AI. The first part, \emph{human understanding}, requires that the scientific community remain able to explain, defend and contest the resulting claims, and retain the skills to do so. The second, \emph{human direction}, requires that judgments about which questions matter and what findings mean stay with accountable humans. Applying the test to each phase of research in the Contributor Roles Taxonomy (CRediT) yields recommendations that fields can tailor to their questions and methods. The framework differs from existing guidance in three ways. It rests on an account of what science is for rather than on integrity norms. It holds even if AI outperforms human researchers, rather than depending on AI's current limitations. And it judges each use of AI by its effects on human understanding and direction rather than by the type of tool, across every phase of research, including peer review and the training of new researchers. It closes with the reforms needed to keep science aimed at human understanding and direction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以"持久的、集体的人类理解"为科学不可或缺的目标，并由此推导出AI研究任务委派的两部分检验（人类理解与人类方向），应用于CRediT各研究阶段以给出可定制建议。
AI.motivation: 随着AI在核心科学任务上追平或超越人类研究者，"人类为何还要做科学"与"人类该如何使用AI做科学"成为紧迫问题；后者只有通过回答前者才能解答。
AI.method: 从科学应以人类目的与价值服务、实现持久集体人类理解这一原则出发，构建两项检验：(1)人类理解——科学共同体仍能解释、辩护与质疑所产生的主张并保有相应技能；(2)人类方向——关于哪些问题重要、结果意味着什么的判断仍由可问责的人类掌握。将检验逐项应用于CRediT贡献者角色分类中的各研究阶段。
AI.result: 得出可按领域问题与方法定制的AI委派建议；框架与现有指南有三点不同：基于科学目的而非诚信规范、在AI优于人类时仍成立而非依赖AI当前局限、按对人类理解与方向的影响而非工具类型评判每一次使用，覆盖包括同行评审与新人培养在内的全部研究阶段。
AI.conclusion: 为使科学继续以人类理解与方向为目标，论文最后提出所需的相关改革。

title: Do Coding Agents Still Need a Debugger? Frontier-Model-Based Fault Localization at the Accuracy Ceiling
summary: Background: To localize a fault, a coding agent can reason from source code alone or use debugger assistance by running the program and stepping through it in an interactive debugger. While earlier agents struggled with static execution tracing and debugger operation, frontier LLMs have improved at both. Objective: We evaluate how accurately coding agents localize faults without tools across original and transformed programs, how much debugger assistance improves accuracy and at what cost, and how agents use it when optional. Methods: We seed 610 single-line faults into 144 LeetCodeDataset solutions and rewrite each faulty program with five recipes of behavior-preserving transformations. Agents based on Sol 6.1, Luna 6, and Qwen 3.8 localize each fault with no, optional, or encouraged debugger assistance. Results: Without tools, the agents localized 98.2 to 99.9% of faults in original and 96.7 to 99.9% in transformed programs, losing accuracy mainly where recipes restructured loops and conditions. Encouraged assistance removed 63% and 61% of Luna 6's and Qwen 3.8's remaining transformed errors (+2.1 and +1.3 percentage points) at 14.7 to 27.0 times the token use, while Sol 6.1 stayed at 99.9%. With optional assistance, Luna 6 and Qwen 3.8 still gained +1.5 and +1.3 points, though the agents used the interactive debugger in only 0.2 to 6.2% of runs. Conclusions: On short, precisely specified programs, current coding agents localize nearly all faults from source code alone, and debugger assistance removes most errors that remain. Given the choice, agents executed the program far more often than they stepped through it, yet kept most of the benefit.

AI.tldr: 在144个LeetCodeDataset解法中注入610个单行故障，并用5种保持行为的变换重写程序，评估Sol 6.1、Luna 6、Qwen 3.8在无工具/可选/鼓励调试器三种条件下定位故障的准确率与代价。
AI.motivation: 需要弄清楚：现代前沿LLM编码智能体在无工具时定位故障有多准、调试器辅助能带来多少准确率提升及代价、以及在辅助可选时智能体是否真的会用调试器。既有工作多停留在早期智能体难以静态追踪与操作调试器的阶段。
AI.method: 向144个LeetCodeDataset解法注入610个单行故障，并用5种保持行为的变换配方重写每个故障程序；三个基于Sol 6.1、Luna 6、Qwen 3.8的智能体分别在无辅助、可选调试器、鼓励调试器三种设置下定位故障，比较准确率、残余错误消除率与token开销。
AI.result: 无工具时原始程序定位准确率98.2–99.9%、变换后96.7–99.9%，误差主要出现在循环与条件被重构处。鼓励辅助使Luna 6和Qwen 3.8的残余变换误差分别消除63%和61%（+2.1、+1.3个百分点），代价是14.7–27.0倍token；Sol 6.1保持99.9%。可选辅助下二者仍获+1.5、+1.3点提升，但仅在0.2–6.2%的运行中真正使用交互式调试器。
AI.conclusion: 在短小、规格明确的程序上，当前编码智能体仅凭源码即可定位几乎全部故障；调试器辅助能消除大部分残余错误但成本极高。给定选择时，智能体更多是运行程序而非单步调试，却仍保留了大部分收益。

title: Zero-Shot Multimodal Event Spotting in Soccer Broadcasts
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference at the IEEE International Symposium on Multimedia: ISM 2026
summary: Automatic soccer event spotting supports highlight generation, video indexing, and sports analytics, but existing methods depend on large annotated datasets and soccer-specific training. We present a zero-shot framework that detects, classifies, and temporally localizes events in full-length soccer broadcasts without task-specific parameter training. Each match is segmented into overlapping clips represented by a compact visual storyboard and the aligned commentary transcript, which a general-purpose multimodal model processes jointly. On three manually annotated matches containing 130 events, the best configuration achieves 72.0% F1@5s and outperforms SoccerNet-trained CALF and NetVLAD++ in a cross-dataset setting, while the storyboard representation reduces inference cost by 72% compared with individual frames. We further analyze the effects of model family, input representation, and prompt optimization, and introduce an evidence-grounded excitement-scoring stage that ranks detected events with natural-language explanations for highlight selection.

AI.tldr: 提出零样本足球事件检测框架，用通用多模态模型联合处理storyboard与解说文本，无需任务特定训练即可检测、分类并时间定位事件，F1@5s达72.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有足球事件检测方法依赖大规模标注数据和足球领域专用训练，成本高且泛化性受限。
AI.method: 将整场比赛切分为重叠片段，每段用紧凑视觉storyboard加对齐解说文本表示，由通用多模态模型联合处理；并引入基于证据的精彩度打分阶段，用自然语言解释对事件排序。
AI.result: 在三场人工标注、共130个事件的比赛上，最佳配置取得72.0% F1@5s，跨数据集设置下优于经SoccerNet训练的CALF和NetVLAD++；storyboard相比逐帧输入降低72%推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 零样本多模态方案可在无任务特定训练下有效完成足球事件检测与定位，并支持可解释的精彩片段筛选；论文还分析了模型族、输入表示与提示优化的影响。

title: Noise Shapes the Surplus: Strategic Play Against No-Regret Learners
summary:
Recent work has shown that, in zero-sum games, an optimizer can extract $Ω(\sqrt{T})$ strategic surplus---cumulative payoff above the minimax benchmark---against noiseless no-regret learners with a constant step size. However, in practice, learners often act on perturbed payoff scores and use decaying learning rates $η_t$. Since existing extraction mechanisms rely on exact scores, a natural question is whether noise shields the learner from exploitation and eliminates surplus altogether.
  We address this question for the widely used class of Follow-the-Regularized-Leader (FTRL) algorithms. Under standard regularity conditions, we establish three results, none of which assumes independence of the noise. First, under summability conditions, passive play of a strategy fixed independently of the horizon earns at most constant surplus. Second, we design a new mechanism that exploits the learner's noise-dependent response: a clairvoyant optimizer who knows the update rule and the limiting mean response secures $Ω(1/η_T)$ surplus whenever that mean is profitable. Third, even when that mean is not profitable, active alternating play extracts $Ω(\sum_{t<T}η_t)$ surplus by exploiting the learner's movement rather than its location, under suitable responsiveness and stability conditions.
  Finally, at the canonical learning rate $η_t\propto t^{-1/2}$, we recover the noiseless $Ω(\sqrt{T})$ rate for mean-zero, finite-variance perturbations---whether fresh with arbitrary temporal dependence or accumulated from i.i.d. increments---provided the limiting mean response is profitable.

AI.tldr: 研究带噪声和衰减学习率的FTRL学习者在零和博弈中是否仍可被利用，给出三种利用机制及对应收益速率，并在η_t∝t^{-1/2}时恢复Ω(√T)。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明，在零和博弈中，优化器可对无噪声、常步长的无悔学习器提取Ω(√T)的策略盈余。但实践中学习者常基于受扰动的支付分数并用衰减学习率，现有机制依赖精确分数，因此需回答：噪声能否保护学习者、消除盈余。
AI.method: 针对FTRL算法，在标准正则条件下（不假设噪声独立）构造三种机制：1）可加性条件下固定策略的被动玩法；2）利用学习者对噪声的响应、知晓更新规则与极限平均响应的先知式利用机制；3）通过交替主动玩法利用学习者的"移动"而非"位置"。
AI.result: 1）可加性条件下被动固定策略至多获得常数盈余；2）若极限平均响应有利可图，先知优化器获得Ω(1/η_T)盈余；3）即使该均值不利，在适当响应性与稳定性条件下，主动交替玩法获得Ω(∑_{t<T}η_t)盈余；4）在η_t∝t^{-1/2}、零均值有限方差扰动下恢复无噪声的Ω(√T)速率。
AI.conclusion: 噪声并不能消除策略盈余：即便有扰动支付和衰减学习率，FTRL学习者仍可被系统性利用，且在典型学习率下盈余速率与无噪声情形同阶。

title: Lipi-Ghor: A Large-Scale, Diarized, Multi-Domain Bengali Speech Corpus and a Scalable Pipeline for Building It
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the Speech and Audio Language Models Workshop (2nd Edition), pages 190-201, 2026
summary:
Bengali, spoken by over 230 million people, remains severely under-resourced in spoken language research. Existing open Bengali ASR corpora are confined to short, read or crowd-sourced speech and lack speaker diarization and long-form audio.
  We present Lipi-Ghor, a large-scale weakly-supervised Bengali speech corpus comprising 885 hours of audio sourced from 998 YouTube videos across 596 unique channels, spanning 17 diverse domains including audiobooks, drama, religious sermons, news, and regional dialects. Each recording is annotated in SSTT format (Speaker, Speech, Transcription, Timestamp), which combines automated diarization with Bengali YouTube caption tracks.
  To our knowledge, Lipi-Ghor is the first Bengali speech corpus to pair large-scale coverage with speaker-diarized, long-form audio annotations, both of which are absent from existing open Bengali resources. We also present the construction methodology as a replicable pipeline for any language with a sufficient captioned YouTube presence. Targeted channel curation across a handful of rich domains yields corpus scales that were previously out of reach for low-resource languages.
  We benchmark four widely-used ASR models under zero-shot and fine-tuned conditions. All four degrade consistently on emotive, dialectal, and long-form content. Because caption targets are noisy, we also release a human-annotated gold evaluation split, verified by 17 volunteer annotators over 30 hours of human-in-the-loop correction and stratified across all 17 domains.
  We release our original contributions (video-ID lists, diarization output, pipeline code, and the gold annotations) under CC-BY-4.0, and distribute caption-derived transcripts for research use only; no raw audio is redistributed.

AI.tldr: Lipi-Ghor：885小时孟加拉语弱监督长音频语料，带说话人分离与SSTT标注，附人工校验金标评测集与ASR基准。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语（超2.3亿使用者）语音研究资源严重匮乏；现有公开语料仅限短时朗读或众包语音，缺乏说话人分离和长时音频，无法支撑长音频与真实场景ASR研究。
AI.method: 从596个频道的998个YouTube视频中采集885小时音频，覆盖17个领域（有声书、戏剧、宗教布道、新闻、方言等）；用自动说话人分离结合YouTube字幕轨生成SSTT（说话人、语音、转写、时间戳）标注；另由17名志愿者经30小时人机协作校正，构建分层覆盖17个领域的人工金标评测分片；并对4个主流ASR模型做零样本与微调基准测试。
AI.result: 首个兼具大规模覆盖与说话人分离长音频标注的孟加拉语语料；4个ASR模型在情感性、方言和长音频内容上均一致性能下降；为低资源语言提供可复制的频道精选构建流水线。
AI.conclusion: 少量丰富领域的定向频道筛选即可达到此前低资源语言难以企及的语料规模；贡献（视频ID、分离输出、流水线代码、金标）以CC-BY-4.0发布，字幕衍生转写仅限研究使用，不重分发原始音频。

title: Cross-Day Compatibility of Daily Item Embeddings: An Empirical Study of Alignment, Scale Management, and CTR Adaptation
comment: 19 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Supplementary material: 10 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables. Includes the complete 48-configuration inventory
summary: Daily item co-occurrence embeddings are paired with next-day behavior without future-behavior leakage. Multi-day click-through rate (CTR) training therefore mixes versions whose directions and norms may differ for the same item. We compare Word2Vec and an item-graph XSimGCL adaptation across initialization, inheritance, post-processing, training constraints, and downstream augmentation. The inventory contains 48 configurations, including 32 common-protocol CTR evaluations. Observed metrics are reported as relative percentage changes from the corresponding Word2Vec baseline (0%), with raw values and exact dataset sizes withheld. Three findings emerge. First, multiple upstream interventions improve compatibility and CTR. ID-init and orthogonal alignment increase cosine by 51.2% and 93.4%, and GAUC by 2.2% and 2.6%, relative to ordinary Word2Vec. Retrieval and geometry remain insufficient downstream surrogates. Second, warm starts perform strongly but accumulate scale. The day-matched norm increase over Word2Vec reaches 102.5% after eight days; daily global rescaling limits it to 8.2% and attains the highest observed GAUC increase, 4.0%. Third, CTR learning through a dimensionality-reducing encoder further adapts to residual drift. Against dimension-matched random-projection, SVD, and untrained-network controls, trained encoders attain the highest cross-day cosine for four of six upstream methods. The other two rank third and second in train-to-test cosine. These industrial results support complementary roles for upstream stabilization, inherited-scale management, and downstream task learning.

AI.tldr: 比较 Word2Vec 与图嵌入 XSimGCL 在跨天 CTR 训练中的版本漂移问题；上游稳定化、继承尺度管理与下游任务学习三者互补，可提升兼容性与 CTR。
AI.motivation: 每日物品共现嵌入按天配对次日行为以避免未来信息泄漏，但多日 CTR 训练会混用同一物品在不同版本间方向与范数不一致的嵌入，造成兼容性与漂移问题。
AI.method: 在 48 组配置（含 32 组统一协议 CTR 评估）上对比 Word2Vec 与物品图 XSimGCL 变体，考察初始化、继承、后处理、训练约束与下游增强；指标以相对 Word2Vec 基线的百分比变化报告，并做维度匹配的随机投影、SVD、未训练网络等对照。
AI.result: (1) ID 初始化与正交对齐使余弦提升 51.2%/93.4%，GAUC 提升 2.2%/2.6%，但检索与几何指标不足以作为下游代理；(2) 热启动效果强但累积尺度，八天后范数增 102.5%，每日全局重缩放降至 8.2% 并取得最高 GAUC 增幅 4.0%；(3) 经降维编码器的 CTR 学习可进一步适应残余漂移，6 种上游方法中 4 种取得最高跨天余弦。
AI.conclusion: 工业级结果表明，上游嵌入稳定化、继承尺度管理和下游任务学习各自作用互补，需协同设计以缓解多日嵌入漂移。

title: PrinGS: Privacy Preservation in Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has rapidly become the preferred representation for high-fidelity novel view synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. However, the learned representation encodes sensitive visual information including human faces, license plates, documents, and computer screens, raising significant privacy concerns when trained splats are shared or deployed. In this work, we address the underexplored problem of privacy preservation in Gaussian Splatting by proposing a representation-level anonymization framework that directly anonymizes a trained splat. Given a trained splat and a user-provided reference view identifying sensitive content, our method localizes the corresponding regions in the underlying 3D representation and directly anonymizes them, ensuring that the sensitive information is absent from all subsequently rendered novel views while preserving the overall scene geometry and visual fidelity. We achieve this post-training anonymization in less than 1 second. Furthermore, we extend our framework with a privacy-by-design training strategy that prevents sensitive content from being embedded into the representation during optimization, enabling the generation of privacy-preserving splats directly from training images. Our method achieves a remarkably low Face Similarity Measure (FSM) of 9.79% at a retained Face Detection Rate (FDR) of 39.47% and makes sensitive text completely unreadable with an OCR Character Error Rate of 1.00. Our work aims to serve as the primary stepping stone towards privacy-aware 3D representations and motivates further research along these directions.

AI.tldr: 提出表示层匿名化框架，对已训练的3DGS splat直接去隐私，并扩展到隐私友好训练。
AI.motivation: 3DGS学到的表示隐含人脸、车牌、文档、屏幕等敏感信息，共享或部署训练好的 splat 时存在隐私风险，此前研究不足。
AI.method: 给定训练好的 splat 和用户提供的参考视图，定位底层3D表示中的敏感区域并直接匿名化；另提出隐私设计训练策略，使敏感内容在优化时不被嵌入。
AI.result: 训练后匿名化耗时不到1秒；FSM 9.79%、保留FDR 39.47%；敏感文字OCR字符错误率1.00（完全不可读）；保持场景几何与视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: 为隐私感知3D表示提供起点，鼓励后续研究。

title: Exponential Wake-Up Overshoot in Explicit Gaussian Point-Process Filters
comment: 26 pages, 3 figures, 13 tables; main text with Appendices A-G (proofs, experimental protocol, additional results). A four-page version has been submitted to IEEE Signal Processing Letters
summary: When events resume after a long silence, explicit Gaussian point-process filters amplify the first update exponentially in the silence duration. We give the exact distribution of this update and a computable index that predicts when it overshoots. For the explicit (single-scoring-step) filter and its implicit posterior-mode counterpart, we derive second-order silence expansions of the state variance with opposite-sign logarithmic corrections. The crossing index determines when the post-wake prediction exceeds the resumed rate, separating the bin width at which the amplification exponent reaches one from the larger width at which the true rate is overshot. At fixed bin width, the implicit filter's expected loss grows logarithmically with silence duration, whereas a continuous-time counterexample rules out a bound uniform in bin width and silence duration. Experimental evaluation confirms these predictions in all 73 crossing cells and on exchange trade data, while variance caps reduce explicit overshoot but mostly hurt the implicit filter.

AI.tldr: 该文分析长时间静默后事件恢复时高斯点过程滤波器的放大现象，给出更新的精确分布与可计算的越界指数，并比较显式EM类滤波器与隐式后验模态滤波器的静默渐近行为。
AI.motivation: 长时间静默后首个事件更新会导致滤波器预测被指数放大（随静默时长），现有工作缺乏对此放大的精确刻画及其何时超过真实率的判据。
AI.method: 推导首个更新的精确分布，构造"越界指数"预测过冲；对显式（单评分步）滤波器及其隐式后验模态版本，给出状态方差的二阶静默展开（对数修正符号相反）；用连续时间反例分析损失的一致有界性。
AI.result: 越界指数区分了放大指数达到1的分箱宽度与真实率被过冲的更大宽度；固定分箱宽度下隐式滤波器期望损失随静默时长对数增长，且不存在对分箱宽度与静默时长一致有界的损失；实验在73个越界单元及交易所成交数据上验证预测；方差上限缓解显式过冲但多损害隐式滤波器。
AI.conclusion: 显式与隐式高斯点过程滤波器在静默后行为不对称，显式易过冲、隐式损失无一致界；越界指数可作为实用的诊断判据，方差上限并非普适补救。

title: From Structural Feedback to Prompt Policies: Learning Faithful Text-to-Image Prompt Editors
summary: Prompt optimization should improve the image a user receives without changing the scene the user requested. Yet stylistic rewriting can weaken object attributes and relations even when global text--image similarity remains high. We propose StruPO, a structure-aware prompt editor that uses a calibrated scene graph as a shared representation for policy conditioning and image-grounded supervision. The graph exposes what should be preserved, while deletion, reordering, and insertion provide a token-aligned way to modify the prompt. This turns structural feedback from an external critique into a training signal for a reusable editing policy. Learning from that signal requires handling both uncertain grounding and stochastic image generation. StruPO retains grounding confidence through smooth reward shaping and averages multiple images for each edit before computing group-relative advantages. Experiments span three disjoint 2K-prompt test sets and four frozen generation backbones, with comparisons to learned prompt optimizers, iterative structural feedback, diffusion-model fine-tuning, and inference-time attention control. StruPO improves the faithfulness--aesthetics trade-off, with consistent gains in relational fidelity. Independent automatic evaluators and a 15-annotator study provide complementary evidence, and human preference margins increase with relation complexity. Controlled ablations connect these gains to graph conditioning, local editing, and image-grounded learning. The resulting policy produces reusable optimized text in one pass after graph calibration, without an iterative critique--rewrite loop.

AI.tldr: StruPO：以校准场景图为共享表示的结构感知提示词编辑器，用删除/重排/插入做token对齐编辑，并把结构反馈转成可复用策略的训练信号（平滑奖励+多图平均的优势估计），在3个2K测试集和4个冻结生成骨干上提升关系保真度与保真-美学权衡。
AI.motivation: 提示优化应提升图像质量而不改变用户请求的场景，但风格化改写即使全局文图相似度仍高，也会削弱对象属性与关系。现有做法（学习式优化器、迭代结构反馈、扩散微调、推理时注意力控制）难以在保留结构的同时稳定优化。
AI.method: 用校准后的场景图作为策略条件与图像监督的共享表示：图显式给出需保留的内容，删除/重排/插入实现对token对齐的局部编辑；将结构反馈从外部评价转为训练信号以学习可复用编辑策略。针对定位不确定与生成随机性，采用平滑奖励塑形保留grounding置信度，并对每个编辑生成多张图取平均后再计算组相对优势。
AI.result: 在3个互不重叠的2K提示测试集、4个冻结生成骨干上，与学习式提示优化器、迭代结构反馈、扩散模型微调、推理时注意力控制相比，StruPO改善保真度-美学权衡，关系保真度一致提升；自动评测与15人标注研究互为佐证，人类偏好优势随关系复杂度增加而扩大。
AI.conclusion: 消融表明增益来自图条件、局部编辑与图像接地学习的共同作用。该方法在图校准后单次推理即可产出可复用的优化文本，无需迭代式"批评-重写"循环。

title: AGDecode: Semantic Attribute Grammar Derivatives for Safety-Constrained Decoding of Large Language Models
comment: 28 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. Rocq mechanization available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21287418
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, motivating techniques that guarantee the structural and semantic correctness of generated programs. Constrained decoding enforces correctness during generation by restricting token choices to those that admit at least one valid completion. While existing approaches can enforce syntactic constraints and selected semantic properties such as type safety, they either target specific properties or rely on operational pruning mechanisms that are difficult to generalize to data-dependent, inductive program properties. We present AGDecode, a programmable framework for semantic constrained decoding based on least-fixed-point semantics. AGDecode extends attribute grammars to partially constructed syntax trees, and reduces semantic constrained decoding to a realizability problem over such trees. The framework compiles semantic specifications into systems of relational constraints that are discharged by external verification oracles, such as SMT and CHC solvers, cleanly separating language semantics from constraint-solving machinery. We prove that our approach is sound and complete relative to an ideal verification oracle. In practice, solvers inevitably encounter uncertain queries; conservatively, our system can reject tokens for soundness or speculatively continue to generate until later queries resolve the entire generation. We mechanize the core metatheory in Rocq and evaluate the framework on semantic-constrained generation of C programs, enforcing path-sensitive safety properties including null-pointer safety, division-by-zero freedom, and initialized-variable usage. Our results demonstrate that solver-backed semantic constrained decoding can enforce rich semantic guarantees while incurring modest computational overhead at regular program boundaries.

AI.tldr: AGDecode：基于最小不动点语义的可编程语义约束解码框架，将属性文法扩展到部分语法树，把语义约束解码归约为可实现性问题，并编译为外部求解器（SMT/CHC）处理的关系约束系统。
AI.motivation: LLM 生成代码时需保证结构与语义正确。现有约束解码可保证语法，以及类型安全等少数语义性质，但要么只针对特定性质，要么依赖难以推广到数据相关、归纳式程序性质的运行期剪枝机制。
AI.method: 将属性文法推广到部分构建的语法树；把语义约束解码归约为部分树上的可实现性问题；把语义规约编译成关系约束系统，交由 SMT、CHC 等外部验证算子求解，从而实现语言语义与约束求解机制的分离。理论上证明相对理想验证算子具有可靠性与完备性；实践中对求解器不确定查询可采用保守拒绝（保可靠性）或推测性继续生成直至后续查询确定。
AI.result: 在 Rocq 中机械化核心元理论；在 C 程序生成上评估，强制路径敏感的零指针安全、除零自由、变量初始化使用等性质，证明可在常规程序边界处以适度计算开销实现丰富语义保证。
AI.conclusion: 求解器支持的语义约束解码可行，能表达并强制数据相关、归纳式的丰富语义性质，为 LLM 代码生成提供可靠性与实用性兼具的保障路径。

title: Sybil-Proofness of Generalized Adaptive Clinching and Implications for Blockchain Mechanism Design
comment: Abstract shortened to comply with arXiv's character limit
summary:
The adaptive clinching auction of Dobzinski, Lavi, and Nisan (FOCS'08) is a cornerstone of mechanism design with budget-constrained bidders, and it has since inspired a broad range of extensions to substantially richer market settings. Adaptive clinching enjoys compelling guarantees: it is Pareto optimal, and truthful bidding is a dominant strategy whenever budgets cannot be overreported. In many real-world environments, however, identities are cheap to create, making resilience to Sybil attacks an additional requirement. Whether the guarantees of adaptive clinching survive when a bidder can split its budget across fake identities has remained open. We introduce a generalized framework for adaptive clinching and prove that it satisfies Sybil-robust incentive compatibility: a bidder cannot benefit from splitting into any finite number of identities with arbitrary value reports, provided their aggregate reported budget does not exceed the bidder's enforceable true budget. Sybil resilience thus joins the list of ideal properties of adaptive clinching.
  Our work is motivated by practical problems in decentralized finance, where automated market makers (AMMs) are among the most widely used applications. We design a new AMM mechanism that extends classical adaptive clinching in two ways: it supports a two-sided market and protects against two-sided strategies, and it allows the supply function to depend on the auction state. Its one-sided special case is captured by our generalized adaptive clinching framework, and our proof techniques show that the full two-sided mechanism simultaneously satisfies Sybil-robust incentive compatibility and a relaxed notion of Pareto optimality. We argue that these guarantees are essentially the best possible via impossibility results. More broadly, our work reveals new connections between classical algorithmic game theory and modern decentralized blockchains.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自适应clinch拍卖在Sybil攻击下的鲁棒性，提出广义自适应clinch框架，证明其满足Sybil鲁棒激励兼容，并据此设计支持双边市场与状态依赖供给函数的AMM机制。
AI.motivation: Dobzinski等（FOCS'08）的自适应clinch拍卖是预算约束机制设计的基石，具有Pareto最优与占优策略真实性，但前提是预算不可虚报、身份不可伪造。现实中身份创建成本极低（如区块链环境），投标人可拆分预算为多个虚假身份，其保证是否在Sybil攻击下存活此前尚属开放问题，且该问题在DeFi的AMM场景中具有实际意义。
AI.method: 提出广义自适应clinch拍卖框架，证明其满足Sybil鲁棒激励兼容性：只要各虚假身份报告预算之和不超过真实可执行预算，投标人无法通过拆分为任意有限个身份并任意报告估值而获利。进一步设计新型AMM机制，扩展经典clinch：支持双边市场并防御双边策略，允许供给函数依赖拍卖状态；其单边特例由广义框架刻画，并给出相应不可能性结果论证保证的最优性。
AI.result: 广义自适应clinch框架满足Sybil鲁棒激励兼容；完整双边AMM机制同时满足Sybil鲁棒激励兼容与松弛版Pareto最优性；不可能性结果表明确保这些保证在本质上是最好可能的。
AI.conclusion: Sybil鲁棒性可作为自适应clinch拍卖的理想性质之一，与传统性质并存；该工作连接了经典算法博弈论与现代去中心化区块链，并为AMM设计提供理论基础。

title: Frankly Speaking: The Company Election Integrity Keeps in Congressional Communication
summary: Election integrity is a shared commitment in American politics, but Democrats and Republicans in Congress increasingly mean different things by it. Analyzing 10,420 congressional e-newsletters sent from 2010 to 2025, we examine how the two parties invoke election terms such as ``integrity,'' ``security,'' and ``fraud.'' Using diachronic word embeddings, which track semantic change through how words are used in context, we measure how differently each party uses each term, how much each party shifts, and whether they share nearest semantic neighbors. We show that members of Congress do not need different words to tell different stories about elections. They need only place those same words in different company. Across nearly every term and year, the two parties surround election-integrity vocabulary with entirely different words. That divergence is easy to miss, because most election vocabulary is no more divergent than other words used at roughly the same frequency, and neither party's usage shifted more than the other's. Only a subset of terms grew more divergent, most notably ``certification,'' while ``rigged'' and ``stolen'' entered election discourse after 2020 and polarized there. By 2024, Democrats surround ``voter,'' ``election,'' and ``integrity'' with the language of access and administration. Republicans surround the same terms with ``citizenship verification,'' ``noncitizen voting,'' and ``border security.'' For one party, integrity means protecting eligible voters' ability to cast a ballot. For the other, it means protecting the electoral process from illegitimate ballots. Election officials, who must administer a single system under both definitions, inherit this tension.

AI.tldr: 分析2010-2025年国会议员10,420份电子通讯，用历时词嵌入发现两党用相同选举词汇但搭配词完全不同，形成"同词异义"的分歧叙事。
AI.motivation: 选举诚信是美国两党共同承诺，但两党对其含义的理解日益分化；作者想揭示这种分歧如何在语言使用层面体现，而非仅在立场层面。
AI.method: 收集2010-2025年10,420份国会电子通讯；用历时词嵌入（diachronic word embeddings）追踪"integrity""security""fraud"等选举词汇在语境中的语义变化，量化两党对每词用法的差异度、各党偏移程度，以及是否共享最近语义邻居。
AI.result: 两党几乎在每个词和每一年都用完全不同的词围绕选举词汇。该分歧易被忽视：多数选举词汇的分歧度并不高于同频词，且两党偏移幅度相当。仅部分词分歧加大，尤以"certification"为著；"rigged""stolen"在2020年后进入选举话语并在此极化。到2024年，民主党围绕"voter""election""integrity"用"access""administration"类语言，共和党则用"citizenship verification""noncitizen voting""border security"。
AI.conclusion: 两党无需不同词汇即可讲述不同选举故事——只需把相同词汇置于不同语境。对一方，integrity意为保护合格选民的投票权；对另一方，意为保护选举过程免受非法选票侵害。管理单一选举体系的选举官员被迫承受这一张力。

title: ACOR: incremental evidence accumulation towards real-time DNA storage reconstruction
summary: DNA offers high-density, durable storage by encoding digital information into synthetic strands and retrieving it through sequencing. Sequence reconstruction combines noisy copies of each strand before downstream decoding. Conventional offline methods typically reconstruct completed read clusters, separating reconstruction from ongoing read collection. Streaming reconstruction offers a way to overlap evidence processing with sequencing and reduce the computation remaining before downstream decoding. We present ACOR, a streaming consensus reconstruction method that records $k$-mer transitions and boundary support in a persistent ledger, then decodes through length-constrained beam search and priority-based selection at cluster closure. Evaluation on real and simulated DNA-storage datasets showed competitive recovery. On our own short-read next-generation sequencing (NGS) wet-lab library, ACOR combined near-complete recovery with second-scale reconstruction of more than ten million reads. A smaller public benchmark was completed in a fraction of a second. Parallel ACOR achieved speedups of tens to over a thousand-fold relative to the tested serial baseline configurations. Sparse storage reduced high-context memory requirements, while parallel execution accelerated reconstruction computation. ACOR is designed for streaming readout pipelines that process assigned reads while sequencing continues.

AI.tldr: ACOR：一种流式共识重建方法，用持久账本记录k-mer转换与边界支持，配合长度约束束搜索与优先选择，在测序进行中同步完成DNA存储序列重建。
AI.motivation: DNA存储密度高、耐久，但序列重建通常采用离线方式，需等读段簇完整后再处理，与测序过程分离，导致下游解码前的计算量大、流水线无法重叠。
AI.method: ACOR在持久账本中记录每条链的k-mer转换与边界支持证据；簇闭合时通过长度约束的束搜索（beam search）进行解码，并用基于优先级的选优策略确定共识序列；支持并行执行与稀疏存储以降低高上下文内存需求。
AI.result: 在真实与模拟DNA存储数据集上取得有竞争力的恢复率；自建短读NGS湿实验室库上实现近完全恢复，并在秒级重建超过一千万条读段；较小公开基准在不到一秒内完成；并行ACOR相对串行基线加速数十倍至上千倍。
AI.conclusion: ACOR面向流式读出流水线，在读段被分配后即边测序边重建，兼顾恢复质量、速度与内存效率，适合持续产出的DNA存储测序场景。

title: Beyond the Estimate: Wiener-Informed Decoding for Easier Training of Pixel-Space Flow Models
summary: Learning velocity fields directly in pixel space is difficult and slow. We show that coarse second-order image statistics can ease this task: frozen Wiener estimates improve velocity learning, with gains extending beyond the linear predictions they explicitly provide. Moreover, we observe similar but complementary gains from frozen bases and pixel decoding. These observations motivate Wiener-informed Decoding (WiD), which uses statistical knowledge both for direct prediction and to organize decoder computation without modifying native blocks. WiD combines a trainable Wiener prediction path with coefficient interfaces that inject features into the native decoder and return its predicted coefficient corrections, with these components initialized with data statistics. All introduced parameters, including the spectrum and coordinate transforms, are trained jointly under the original pixel-space velocity objective. Across model scales and decoder architectures, WiD accelerates training and improves generation quality with modest parameter overhead. It also yields smoother gradient trajectories and remains effective with representation alignment. WiD improves class-conditional and text-to-image generation across different resolutions. On ImageNet 256 x 256, PixelDiT-XL with WiD reaches FID 1.53 after 500 epochs, achieving comparable quality to PixelDiT with 37.5% fewer training epochs. Statistical denoisers contribute beyond the estimate: their computational structure can also ease pixel-space training.

AI.tldr: 提出WiD（Wiener-informed Decoding），利用冻结的Wiener二阶统计估计作为先验，既做直接预测又用于组织解码器计算，在像素空间加速扩散/流模型训练并提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 直接在像素空间学习速度场（velocity field）困难且缓慢，作者希望借助粗粒度二阶图像统计来降低学习难度。
AI.method: 观察到冻结Wiener估计、冻结基与像素解码能带来互补增益；据此设计WiD：将可训练的Wiener预测路径与系数接口结合，把特征注入原生解码器并返回预测的系数修正，组件用数据统计初始化；包括谱与坐标变换在内的所有新参数在原始像素空间速度目标下联合训练，且不修改原生模块。
AI.result: 跨模型规模与解码器架构，WiD加快训练并提升生成质量，参数开销小；梯度轨迹更平滑，且与表示对齐兼容。ImageNet 256×256上PixelDiT-XL+WiD在500轮达到FID 1.53，比PixelDiT少37.5%训练轮数达到相当质量。
AI.conclusion: 统计去噪器不仅提供估计本身，其计算结构也能简化像素空间训练；WiD在类条件和文生图任务、不同分辨率下均有效。

title: From Slices to Volumes: Comparing 2D, 2.5D, and 3D Residual Networks for Pulmonary Nodule Malignancy-Risk Classification
summary:
Purpose: To compare 2D, 2.5D, and 3D residual networks for pulmonary nodule malignancy-risk classification and evaluate momentum-contrast pretraining, mild augmentation, and exclusion of indeterminate ratings.
  Methods: A retrospectively prepared LIDC-IDRI cohort contained 2,654 nodules labeled benign, indeterminate, or malignant using median radiologist ratings. Patient-disjoint splits comprised 1,876 training, 382 validation, and 396 test nodules. Representations included one axial slice, five neighboring slices, and a local CT volume. Each track evaluated a randomly initialized baseline, momentum-contrast pretraining followed by fine-tuning, and supervised training with mild augmentation. Checkpoints were selected by validation Macro-F1. The 2D experiments used three seeds; 2.5D and 3D results were single-run estimates. A separate binary experiment excluded indeterminate nodules.
  Results: Augmented models achieved test Macro-F1 values of $0.6134\pm0.0075$ for 2D, $0.6537$ for 2.5D, and $0.5403$ for 3D; the 2D uncertainty denotes population standard deviation across seeds. Corresponding accuracies were $0.6128$, $0.6869$, and $0.5455$. Augmentation improved Macro-F1 within every track, whereas the tested pretraining recipes reduced it. Binary Macro-F1 values were $0.8227$, $0.8664$, and $0.7554$, respectively.
  Conclusion: Augmented 2.5D achieved the highest observed performance. Differences in preprocessing, optimization, capacity, and replication limit attribution to dimensionality. Labels reflect radiologist-assessed malignancy risk rather than pathology-confirmed cancer. Code and experimental results are available at https://github.com/CT-DeepLearning-Team/CT-2D-2.5D-3D-DeepLearning.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较2D、2.5D、3D残差网络在肺结节恶性风险分类上的表现，并评估动量对比预训练、轻度数据增强及排除不确定标签的影响；结果显示轻度增强的2.5D模型表现最佳（Macro-F1约0.65）。
AI.motivation: 现有研究难以公平比较不同维度表示（单切片、多切片、局部体积）对肺结节恶性风险分类的影响，且预训练策略与数据增强的作用尚不明确。
AI.method: 基于LIDC-IDRI回顾性队列（2654个结节，按放射科医生中位数评级标注良/不确定/恶性），患者不交叉划分为训练1876/验证382/测试396。表示包括单轴位切片（2D）、5层相邻切片（2.5D）和局部CT体积（3D）。每条轨迹对比随机初始化基线、动量对比预训练+微调、以及带轻度增强的监督训练；以验证集Macro-F1选取检查点。2D用3个随机种子，2.5D与3D为单次运行；另做排除不确定结节的二分类实验。
AI.result: 增强模型测试Macro-F1为2D 0.6134±0.0075、2.5D 0.6537、3D 0.5403；准确率分别为0.6128、0.6869、0.5455。增强在各轨迹均提升Macro-F1，而所测试的预训练方法反而降低性能。二分类Macro-F1分别为0.8227、0.8664、0.7554。
AI.conclusion: 增强的2.5D模型取得最高性能；但因预处理、优化、容量及重复性差异，难以将优势完全归因于维度。标签为放射科医生评估的恶性风险而非病理确诊癌症。代码与结果已公开。

title: Don't Pick a Winner: Knowledge Conflicts Need a Prior, Not a Rule
comment: 49 pages (9 main text + appendix and supplementary material), 14 figures
summary: A retrieval-augmented language model answers from two sources, the retrieved context and its own knowledge, and the two disagree whenever the context is incomplete or wrong. Existing methods settle the disagreement with a rule fixed at design time: follow the context, amplify it in proportion to how far it moves the model, or trust the model's memory. Each rule is confidently wrong in some deployment. In a decision-theoretic model of two sources, the score of any fixed rule is linear in the share of reliable contexts while the best attainable score is convex, so every fixed rule is beaten wherever it is not exactly optimal; and a symmetric divergence between the two sources, the signal adaptive decoding uses, carries no information about which one is right. Resolving a conflict therefore needs two inputs that no existing method keeps: evidence about each source separately, and a prior on how often the context is right. We test these claims on GRACE, a benchmark that intervenes on the knowledge-graph context of a fixed question, so that what the model knows, what the context says and what is true are measured separately. There, every baseline from four families is strong on right contexts or on wrong ones, never on both. We then build the two inputs: the model states its knowledge as notes, a small policy voices each note with a calibrated confidence, a reader answers in two voices, and a selector commits or abstains under a prior $π$ applied as an exact prior shift. With $π$ set to the true share of right contexts, the system is above the best baseline at every mixture of GRACE contexts, by up to 26 points. Its overall score is 45.3 and 35.0 (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, Llama-3.1-8B), against 29.4 and 27.5 for the best baseline. On preregistered ClashEval it beats same-backbone CK-PLUG and TCR by 12 and 26 points. Where the model lacks the knowledge, the gains vanish, as the theory predicts.

AI.tldr: 论文指出检索增强语言模型中"固定冲突解决规则"在任何部署下都必然在某些情境中出错，主张解决冲突需要两个现有方法都未保留的输入：对每个来源的独立证据，以及关于上下文正确频率的先验。作者据此在GRACE基准上构建了"笔记—置信度—双声阅读—先验选择"系统，并显著超越四类基线。
AI.motivation: RAG模型同时依赖检索上下文与自身知识，当二者冲突时，现有方法（跟随上下文、按影响力放大、信任记忆）都用设计时固定的规则裁决。这些规则在某些部署中会"自信地犯错"，因此需要一个能自适应、且在理论上可证明优于固定规则的方法。
AI.method: 先从决策论上建模双来源问题：证明任何固定规则的得分关于可靠上下文比例是线性的，而最优得分是凸的，故固定规则除最优点外处处被击败；同时证明两来源间的对称散度（adaptive decoding所用信号）不含"谁对"的信息。据此构建系统：模型以"notes"形式陈述自身知识，小策略网络为每条note给出校准置信度，reader以两种"声音"作答，selector在先验π（以精确先验偏移方式注入）下决定commit或abstain。并构建GRACE基准，对固定问题的知识图谱上下文进行干预，从而分别测量模型所知、上下文所述与真实答案。
AI.result: 在GRACE上，来自四个家族的基线均是"在正确上下文或错误上下文之一上强"，无法兼顾。当π设为真实正确上下文比例时，该系统在GRACE所有上下文混合比例上均高于最佳基线，最多领先26个点；总分45.3与35.0（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B、Llama-3.1-8B），对比最佳基线29.4与27.5。在预注册的ClashEval上，相较同骨干的CK-PLUG与TCR分别领先12和26个点。当模型缺乏相关知识时，增益消失，与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 冲突解决不是选择某条更聪明的固定规则，而是显式保留两来源的独立证据并引入上下文可靠性的先验；理论上可证固定规则必被击败，实验上验证了该方法在混合上下文分布下的稳健优势及其边界条件（模型缺乏知识时无增益）。

title: Context Is a Pipeline, Not a Window: Information Attrition in LLM Agent Harnesses
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23614755
summary: LLM agents are judged by two numbers: the size of the context window, and how often the final answer is correct. Both numbers miss a third thing: how much of a tool's output is lost before the model ever sees it. We measured this loss in a real tool-using agent. The agent finds the cause of injected faults by reading Linux kernel traces. The context window was almost empty: across 720 runs, the single largest prompt used only 5.75% of it. Yet a third of all tool results (3,827 of 11,189) were cut before they reached the model, and every cut result became broken JSON. The harness cut each result by slicing its JSON text at a fixed length. This does not shorten a result evenly. It deletes whatever data sits near the end. One field reached the model in only 4.7% of calls. A second field, in the very same results, reached the model in 99.3% of calls. Which field held the fault's evidence depended on when the faulty process started: early or late in the trace. The agent's diagnosis accuracy matched this same split. So we ran controlled experiments to test one question: did the data loss cause the drop in accuracy? This paper makes four contributions. First, we model an agent's context as a five-stage pipeline, with a measured failure at each stage. Second, we replay 864 real tool results, including one from a production trace where the shipped cut deletes all 128 records of the fault's evidence. Third, a controlled experiment shows that the cut's real cost appears first as extra work, not as wrong answers: 43% more tool calls, twice the computation, and yield falling from 0.61 to 0.31. The agent still finds the right answer when it has another way to reach it. Fourth, a survey of seven agent frameworks finds two that cut tool output the same unsafe way. Whether the data cut truly causes the accuracy drop is still an open question.

AI.tldr: 本文测量了工具型LLM Agent中"工具输出被截断而未被模型看到"的数据损失，将其建模为五阶段上下文流水线，并通过回放864条真实工具结果与受控实验证明：固定长度切分JSON会造成近1/3工具结果损坏，其代价首先表现为额外工作量（工具调用+43%、计算翻倍、yield 0.61→0.31），而非错误答案。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM Agent评价只看两个数字：上下文窗口大小与最终答案正确率，二者都忽略了"工具输出在模型看到之前损失了多少"这一关键环节。作者怀疑这类数据损失可能是诊断准确率下降的隐性原因。
AI.method: 以通过阅读Linux内核trace来定位注入故障根因的真实Agent为对象，统计720次运行中的上下文占用与工具结果截断情况；将Agent上下文建模为五阶段流水线并逐阶段测量失败率；回放864条真实工具结果（含一条生产trace中截断删除全部128条证据记录的案例）；设计受控实验检验数据损失是否导致准确率下降；并调研7个Agent框架的截断实现。
AI.result: 上下文窗口几乎未用满（最大单次prompt仅占5.75%），却有1/3工具结果（3827/11189）在被模型看到前被切断且全部变成非法JSON；同一结果中一个字段仅4.7%调用可达、另一字段达99.3%，而证据所在字段取决于故障进程出现时机，诊断准确率也随之分裂。受控实验中，截断首先带来额外工作量：工具调用+43%、计算量翻倍、yield由0.61降至0.31；若存在替代路径，Agent仍能找到正确答案。7个框架中有2个采用同样不安全的截断方式。
AI.conclusion: 数据截断造成的损失真实存在且在评估中被系统性忽视，其首要代价是效率与成本而非答案错误；截断是否直接导致准确率下降仍是开放问题，需要在评估指标中显式纳入"输出损失"这一维度。

title: Tight Characterizations of AMM Mechanism Design under Weak Efficiency
comment: Abstract shortened to comply with arXiv's character limit
summary:
Miner extractable value (MEV) poses a persistent challenge for blockchain ecosystems. It arises from the fact that a block builder can exploit its unilateral control over transaction inclusion and ordering to extract profit, potentially at users' expense. Recent work has explored consensus-aided mechanism design to mitigate MEV. This approach combines generic consensus-layer guarantees with application-layer mechanisms that use these guarantees to address application-specific MEV problems.
  Prior work exemplifies this approach for automated market makers (AMMs). When the consensus layer offers fair sequencing, which orders transactions according to their arrival times, their proposed mechanism achieves incentive compatibility (IC) and weak local efficiency (wLE). Informally, IC rules out profitable strategic deviations by users and builders. Meanwhile, wLE ensures that after execution, any order willing to trade at the initial price cannot benefit from further trade with the pool at the ending marginal price.
  In this work, we resolve the main open question left by prior works: whether IC and wLE can be achieved under plain consensus (e.g., current Ethereum) without fair sequencing. We prove that no deterministic, anonymous batch AMM can achieve both properties. The impossibility holds even when the consensus layer guarantees censorship resilience and block space is unlimited, establishing the first separation between censorship resilience and fair sequencing in the context of decentralized mechanism design.
  Our impossibility proof combines three strategic capabilities: creating Sybil identities, over-reporting budgets, and misreporting values. We further show the tightness of our impossibility result: removing any one from the strategy space restores feasibility under censorship resilience. Specifically, we construct a mechanism achieving IC and wLE for each restricted setting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在普通共识（无公平排序）下，AMM 能否同时实现激励相容（IC）与弱局部效率（wLE），并证明确定性匿名批量 AMM 无法同时满足二者，从而首次在去中心化机制设计中区分了抗审查与公平排序。
AI.motivation: 已有工作借助共识层公平排序为 AMM 实现 IC 与 wLE，但公平排序并非现有区块链（如以太坊）的默认保证；本文旨在回答：仅凭普通共识（即使具备抗审查与无限区块空间）能否实现这两个性质。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为确定性、匿名批量 AMM 的机制设计问题；利用三种策略能力（创建 Sybil 身份、虚报预算、虚报估值）构造不可能性证明，并针对每种受限策略空间分别构造满足 IC 与 wLE 的机制以验证结论的紧性。
AI.result: 证明不存在确定性匿名批量 AMM 能在普通共识下同时满足 IC 与 wLE，即使共识层保证抗审查且区块空间无限；该不可能性依赖 Sybil、超报预算与虚报估值三者联合。删除任一能力后，在抗审查条件下可恢复可行性并给出具体机制。
AI.conclusion: 抗审查并不蕴含公平排序，二者在去中心化机制设计中可严格分离；实现 IC 与 wLE 需在共识层公平排序或限制用户策略空间之间做出取舍。

title: LLM Hallucination Detection via Low-rank Multilinear Decomposition
summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate fluent yet factually incorrect responses, raising concerns about their reliability. Recent hallucination detectors increasingly exploit internal representations, but extracting informative signals from high-dimensional hidden states remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on selected activations or pooling-based compression, potentially overlooking discriminative information distributed across Transformer layers, feature modes, and tokens. We propose LOTUS (Low-rank Order-statistic TUcker-based Subspace learning), a multilinear low-rank decomposition framework for hallucination detection that extracts compact representations from LLM hidden states while reducing dependence on labeled data. Our approach first summarizes variable-length token representations using complementary statistical descriptors that capture peak activations, activation distributions, and cross-layer changes. We then leverage low-rank multilinear decomposition to extract compact representations that capture the underlying structure of LLM hidden states, which are subsequently used to train a lightweight hallucination classifier. Experiments across multiple LLMs and question-answering benchmarks demonstrate improved hallucination detection performance over recent state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 LOTUS 多线性低秩分解框架，从 LLM 隐藏状态中提取紧凑表征用于幻觉检测，在多模型与问答基准上优于现有 SOTA。
AI.motivation: LLM 常生成流畅但事实错误的回答；现有基于内部表征的幻觉检测器难以从高维隐藏状态中提取有效信号，往往只依赖选定激活或池化压缩，会遗漏分布在图层、特征模态和 token 上的判别信息。
AI.method: LOTUS 先用互补统计描述子（峰值激活、激活分布、跨层变化）对变长 token 表征做汇总；再用低秩多线性（张量）分解提取捕捉隐藏状态结构信息的紧凑表征；最后训练一个轻量幻觉分类器，并降低对标注数据的依赖。
AI.result: 在多个 LLM 和问答基准上，幻觉检测性能超过近期 SOTA 基线。
AI.conclusion: 多线性低秩分解是一种有效、数据效率较高的隐藏状态表征方法，可提升 LLM 幻觉检测的可靠性。

title: QESChunker: A Single Objective Unifies Overlapping and Non-Overlapping Chunking for RAG
summary: Chunking is a fundamental preprocessing step in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), yet most existing chunkers rely primarily on heuristics. We introduce the Question--Evidence-Supervised Chunker (QESChunker), to our knowledge the first method for constructing static chunk indices from question--evidence supervision. QESChunker constructs document-specific chunk indices by optimizing over human-annotated or LLM-generated question--evidence pairs, without access to held-out test queries. We formulate non-overlapping and overlapping index construction through a unified question--evidence utility-maximization objective, turning chunking into a supervised combinatorial optimization problem. Under the non-overlap constraint, the objective decomposes over chunks and can be optimized exactly in polynomial time by dynamic programming. When overlap is allowed, the objective becomes monotone submodular; exact optimization is NP-hard, but our greedy achieves a $(1-1/\sqrt{e})$-approximation. Across two self-constructed and three public datasets, both variants outperform existing chunking methods in complete-evidence recall in nearly all evaluated settings, under the same overlap regime and a fixed hybrid retriever. These results recast chunking as supervised, budget-aware index construction for evidence retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出 QESChunker，首个利用问题–证据监督构建静态分块索引的方法，将分块形式化为有监督组合优化问题，并在无重叠/重叠两种情形下分别给出精确 DP 与近似贪心算法。
AI.motivation: RAG 中的分块是关键预处理步骤，但现有分块器多依赖启发式规则，缺乏监督信号与理论保证。
AI.method: 利用人工标注或 LLM 生成的问题–证据对构建文档专属分块索引（不使用测试查询）；以问题–证据效用最大化为统一目标，将无重叠与重叠索引构建统一为有监督组合优化。无重叠时目标可按块分解，用动态规划多项式时间精确求解；允许重叠时目标为单调子模，精确求解 NP-hard，贪心算法可达 (1−1/√e) 近似。
AI.result: 在两个自建与三个公开数据集上，在相同重叠机制和固定混合检索器条件下，两种变体在几乎所有设置中的完整证据召回率均优于现有分块方法。
AI.conclusion: 将分块重新定义为面向证据检索的、有监督且预算感知的索引构建问题。

title: Learning to Read Braille: Benchmarking and Improving Braille Recognition Capabilities of VLMs
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/kartik0806/BrailleBench
summary: Despite rapid progress in visual understanding and document transcription, modern vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with a fundamental accessibility task: reading Braille from images. We introduce BrailleBench, a manually curated benchmark of 259 real-world Grade-1 and Grade-2 Braille images. We evaluate proprietary, open-weight, OCR-specialized, and tool-assisted multimodal systems and find that standalone general-purpose models perform poorly at directly transcribing Braille images, whereas tool-assisted systems perform much better. We design a synthetic Braille generation pipeline with diverse layouts and image perturbations. A 2B VLM model trained on our synthetic data reaches 87% exact match on Grade-1 and 61% on Grade-2 BrailleBench, outperforming standalone VLMs and achieving the highest Grade-2 exact match score among the evaluated systems. We further show that high accuracy on synthetic validation data does not guarantee high accuracy on real photographs in our experiments: models trained on prior synthetic data reach up to 96% on their synthetic validation set but at most 3.26% on Grade-1 BrailleBench. Our results identify an accessibility-relevant capability gap in multimodal systems and show that targeted synthetic supervision can improve real-world Braille transcription.

AI.tldr: 提出BrailleBench真实盲文图像基准与合成生成流水线，表明通用VLM直接盲文识别能力差，针对合成数据训练的2B模型可在真实照片达87%（Grade-1）/61%（Grade-2）精确匹配，并揭示合成验证高分不等于真实图像高分。
AI.motivation: 视觉理解与文档转录进展迅速，但现代视觉语言模型仍难以完成从图像读取盲文这一基础无障碍任务，且缺乏真实场景评测基准与训练数据。
AI.method: 人工构建含259张真实一级/二级盲文图像的BrailleBench基准；评测闭源、开源、OCR专用及工具辅助多模态系统；设计含多样版式与图像扰动的合成盲文生成流水线，并用其训练2B VLM。
AI.result: 独立通用模型直接转录表现差，工具辅助系统明显更优；2B模型达Grade-1 87%、Grade-2 61%精确匹配，Grade-2为所评测系统中最高；先前合成数据训练的模型在合成验证集可高达96%，但在真实Grade-1基准上最多仅3.26%。
AI.conclusion: 多模态系统存在与无障碍相关的盲文识别能力缺口；针对性合成监督能提升真实盲文转录，但合成数据高分不能保证真实照片泛化。

title: Knowledge distillation across teacher architectures for compact diabetic retinopathy grading
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 18 tables. Submitted to PLOS ONE
summary: Diabetic retinopathy grading from retinal fundus photographs is important but difficult to deploy on resource-constrained hardware. We conducted a controlled study of offline response-based knowledge distillation for five-class diabetic retinopathy grading on APTOS 2019, comparing ResNet-50, MobileNetV3-Large, and Swin Transformer-Tiny (Swin-T) teachers distilled into a MobileNetV3-Small student. A 3 x 4 x 2 grid of teacher, temperature, and hard-label weight was screened at one seed, while six configurations and the no-distillation baseline were evaluated across three seeds. The highest observed single-seed quadratic weighted kappa was 0.9093 (macro-F1 0.6851) for Swin-T at temperature 4 and hard-label weight 0.7; the corresponding three-seed mean was 0.9024, compared with 0.8804 for the baseline. The student used 1.52 M parameters and 5.94 MB, representing an 18.07x parameter reduction relative to Swin-T. Temperature and hard-label weight effects were teacher- and configuration-dependent, while small performance differences were sensitive to random seed. Knowledge distillation produced a compact student with competitive performance under the evaluated protocol, but independent external validation remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 论文在APTOS 2019五分类糖尿病视网膜病变任务上，系统研究了离线响应式知识蒸馏，将ResNet-50、MobileNetV3-Large、Swin-T教师蒸馏到MobileNetV3-Small学生，学生仅1.52M参数/5.94MB，三seed平均QWK 0.9024，优于基线0.8804。
AI.motivation: 糖尿病视网膜病变分级模型在资源受限硬件上难以部署，需在保持性能的同时大幅压缩模型。
AI.method: 以MobileNetV3-Small为学生，对比三种教师；在单一seed上做3×4×2的教师-温度-硬标签权重网格筛选，再对6组配置与无蒸馏基线做三seed评估，指标为二次加权kappa（QWK）与macro-F1。
AI.result: 单seed最佳QWK 0.9093（macro-F1 0.6851），来自温度4、硬标签权重0.7的Swin-T教师；对应三seed均值0.9024，基线为0.8804；学生参数量较Swin-T减少18.07倍。温度与硬标签权重的影响依赖教师与配置，小差异对随机种子敏感。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏可在该协议下得到精简且性能有竞争力的学生模型，但结果仍缺乏独立外部验证。

title: Learning Human Sports Motion Feasibility via Quantile Regression on Tracking Data
summary: We study time-to-arrival (TTA) in sports: the shortest plausible time a player needs to reach an arbitrary location on the pitch given their current kinematic state, estimated as the lower envelope of observed locomotion times. Rather than modeling space ownership through position density estimation or closed-form physics-based models, we cast TTA as a conditional quantile regression problem, estimating the lower quantile of locomotion time so the model learns a player's lower-envelope arrival time. We train the model on optical tracking data from all 64 matches of the PFF FC FIFA World Cup 2022 dataset, and evaluate a lightweight multilayer perceptron against six player-motion models from the literature, re-expressed as TTA predictors, and a learned reachable- hull baseline. Across our evaluation metrics, the MLP consistently outperforms every physics-based baseline. To probe the generality of the learned locomotion model, we further evaluate it on basketball tracking data and a single-game NFL tracking dataset, analyzing the transferability of player motion dynamics across sports. Our project is available at https://github.com/mguti97/TTA-Quantile.

AI.tldr: 本文把足球中的"到达时间"（TTA）建模为条件分位数回归问题，估计球员到达球场上任意位置所需的最短合理时间，并用MLP在世界杯2022光学追踪数据上训练，性能优于六种物理模型与可达凸包基线，且在篮球与NFL数据上具备一定迁移性。
AI.motivation: 空间控制权（space ownership）现有做法依赖位置密度估计或闭式物理运动模型，前者不直接给出到达时间，后者难以刻画真实球员的加速、转向等动力学差异。TTA作为"最短合理到达时间"更能反映球员对空间的掌控能力，但需要一种数据驱动、贴合下限包络的估计方法。
AI.method: 将TTA定义为降低侧观测运动时间的下包络，转化为条件分位数回归，估计运动时间的低分位数，使模型学习球员的下界到达时间；在PFF FC 2022世界杯全部64场光学追踪数据上训练一个轻量级MLP；与6种文献球员运动模型（改写为TTA预测器）及学习型可达凸包基线对比；并迁移至篮球追踪数据与单场NFL数据评估跨运动可迁移性。
AI.result: 在所有评估指标上，MLP一致优于所有物理基线模型；跨运动实验显示所学运动模型在篮球与NFL数据上可进行一定程度的迁移分析。
AI.conclusion: 以分位数回归刻画TTA是有效且优于传统物理建模的方案，轻量模型即可获得更准确的到达时间估计，并具备跨运动的泛化潜力；代码已开源。

title: Stratum: Repository Memory for Coding Agents Beyond the Context Window
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23615180
summary: Context windows have grown a thousand-fold, yet coding agents still start every session with no memory of their past work. They re-read files, retry failed approaches, and forget root causes they established hours earlier. This is not a context-length problem but a memory-architecture problem. Our hypothesis: coding agents need persistent, experience-aware repository memory, so that knowledge survives from one session to the next. Three measurements on real repositories motivate the design. First, mid-size projects already exceed the largest production context windows, and storing knowledge inside the model's key-value (KV) cache costs $10^4$ to $10^5$ times more bytes than storing it as indexed text. Second, across 752 real bug-fix commits, the median fix edits two files, and these files plus their direct imports amount to less than 10% of the repository; the bottleneck is selection, not capacity. Third, even with transitive import reachability and test links, 47% of co-edited file pairs remain structurally disconnected; the knowledge needed for selection must be mined from history and experience. We sketch Stratum, a tiered memory that lives with the repository and serves it through page-safe tools: every response states what was returned, what remains, and what it cost. Retrieval over a store of one million nodes takes 1.7 ms at the median. In a multi-session experiment on eight real bugs, a fresh agent that inherited a prior session's memory, written by a different model, identified the root-cause file in 21 of 24 trials versus 6 of 24 for a retrieval-only baseline (Fisher $p<10^{-4}$), at 4.5x lower median token cost. With the notes of all eight investigations pooled in one store, success remained 8/8.

AI.tldr: 代码智能体需要持久化、经验感知的仓库记忆架构，而非依赖更大的上下文窗口。作者提出分层记忆系统 Stratum，在百万节点存储上检索中位 1.7 ms，多会话实验中根因定位成功率 21/24，远超检索基线的 6/24，且 token 成本降低 4.5 倍。
AI.motivation: 上下文窗口虽已增长千倍，但编程智能体每次会话都从零开始，重复读文件、重试失败方案、遗忘此前确立的根因。这不是上下文长度问题，而是记忆架构问题。三项实证支撑该判断：(1) 中型项目已超出最大生产上下文窗口，把知识存在 KV cache 中比存为索引文本贵 10^4–10^5 倍；(2) 752 个真实修 bug 提交中，中位数只改动两个文件，加上直接导入占比不足 10%，瓶颈是选择而非容量；(3) 即便考虑传递导入可达性与测试链接，仍有 47% 的共编辑文件对结构上不连通，选择所需知识须从历史与经验中挖掘。
AI.method: 提出 Stratum——一种与仓库共生的分层记忆，通过 page-safe 工具服务：每次响应都说明返回了什么、还剩下什么、代价是多少。记忆来源包括仓库历史（如提交、共编辑关系）与智能体过往会话经验。
AI.result: 百万节点存储上检索中位耗时 1.7 ms。在八个真实 bug 的多会话实验中，由另一模型写入记忆的新智能体在 24 次试验中 21 次定位到根因文件，而仅检索的基线为 6/24（Fisher p<1e-4），且中位 token 成本低 4.5 倍。将八次调查的笔记汇总到同一存储后，成功率仍保持 8/8。
AI.conclusion: 持久化、经验感知的仓库记忆能显著提升编码智能体的跨会话表现并降低 token 开销，且记忆可跨模型迁移、可汇聚扩容而不退化。当前为设计构想（"sketch"），评测规模限于八个 bug，需在更大规模与更长会话上验证。

title: Impossibility of No-Regret in Multi-Agent Bidding
summary:
We consider $T$ repeated second-price auctions across $n$ pacing bidders with i.i.d. item arrivals, and show that it is computationally impossible for all bidders to achieve no-regret simultaneously while satisfying their respective budget or return-on-investment constraints. Therefore, in the prominent internet auction systems where buyers simultaneously deploy pacing algorithms or automated bidding agents, we cannot hope to achieve joint no-regret guarantees in general.
  We establish a deterministic relationship that high variance in online bidding systems implies high regret. By showing that one can extract a pacing equilibrium from a low-variance system, we prove PPAD-hardness of attaining joint no-regret.
