We develop a Graph-informed Kriging framework that embeds reusable aerodynamic interaction information into the surrogate mean function. The wind farm is represented as a directed aerodynamic graph, where pairwise turbine interactions defined in a low-dimensional relative-coordinate space are assembled into a farm-scale mean. This structured mean captures the dominant variation in annual energy production (AEP), allowing the Gaussian process to model only the residual structure and uncertainty. Numerical experiments show that Graph-informed Kriging consistently improves AEP prediction accuracy over ordinary and generic-trend Kriging under sparse-data conditions, with increasing benefits as layout dimension and wake-interaction strength grow. Embedded in Bayesian optimization, it substantially improves sample efficiency and achieves competitive solutions for the IEA Wind Task 37 benchmark with about 280 AEP evaluations. In a controlled 16-turbine case, it also outperforms ordinary and multi-fidelity Kriging under the same high-fidelity evaluation budget. The framework is further extended to a 48-turbine wind farm, demonstrating applicability to large-scale CFD-based layout optimization. These results show that Graph-informed surrogate modeling can enable more efficient use of high-fidelity aerodynamic models for reliable large-scale wind farm layout design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图信息克里金（Graph-informed Kriging）框架，将可复用的气动交互信息嵌入代理模型的均值函数，把风电场表示为有向气动图，从而在高维布局空间、稀疏数据下显著提升AEP预测精度与贝叶斯优化样本效率。
AI.motivation: 风机数量增加使风电场布局优化愈发困难，尤其使用高保真气动模型时。传统基于克里金的贝叶斯优化在高维布局空间中样本效率低，因为稀疏训练数据对设计域覆盖有限。
AI.method: 构造有向气动图表示风电场，在低维相对坐标空间中定义成对风机交互，并组装成场级均值函数；该结构化均值捕获AEP的主要变化，使高斯过程只需建模残差结构与不确定性。
AI.result: 数值实验中，稀疏数据下其AEP预测精度持续优于普通与通用趋势克里金，且优势随布局维度和尾流交互强度增加而增大；嵌入贝叶斯优化后，在IEA Wind Task 37基准上约280次AEP评估即获有竞争力解；16风机受控算例中同等高保真预算下优于普通与多保真克里金；并扩展至48风机风电场。
AI.conclusion: 图信息代理建模能更高效地利用高保真气动模型，支持可靠的大规模风电场布局设计。

title: When Retrieval Is Not Enough: Obsolete Facts in Agent Memory
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems (PALM). 23 pages, including supplementary material
summary: Memory-agent benchmarks often collapse retrieval and answer generation into one score, making it hard to tell whether a failure comes from missing an update or from not using an update that was already retrieved. We examine this distinction on the single-hop FactConsolidation task of MemoryAgentBench. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on 6K-history BM25 accuracy drops from 45% to 32% when the retrieved evidence budget grows from 64 to 512 tokens, even though a gold-assisted post-hoc audit finds the newest statement in every retrieved set. Most of the errors occur on questions that also contain an obsolete statement version. Under a frozen prompt and equal four-statement evidence size, replacing one unrelated statement with the obsolete competing statement reduces accuracy from 100% to 44.6% for Qwen2.5 and from 100% to 87.8% for Qwen3-14B, with all 50 harmful paired flips classified as stale. A 32K-history replication likewise favors BM25-64 over BM25-512 (69% versus 58%). These results suggest that retrieving the correct fact is not enough. An obsolete competing statement can be more harmful than an unrelated piece of evidence of the same size.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出"检索到正确更新"不等于"正确使用更新"：在MemoryAgentBench的FactConsolidation任务上，更多检索证据反而降低准确率，因为过时竞争陈述会误导模型，其危害甚至大于等量的无关证据。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆代理基准把检索与答案生成合并为一个分数，无法区分失败是源于"没检索到更新"还是"检索到了却没用上"。作者希望拆解这一区别，并探究检索证据规模与过时信息对下游生成的干扰。
AI.method: 在MemoryAgentBench单跳FactConsolidation任务上实验：Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在6K历史下对比BM25检索64与512 token预算；用gold辅助的事后审计确认最新陈述是否被检索到；设计受控对照实验——冻结提示、固定四条证据长度，仅将一条无关陈述替换为过时的竞争陈述，并在Qwen2.5与Qwen3-14B上验证，另做32K历史复现。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-7B在6K历史上，检索预算64→512 token时准确率从45%降至32%，尽管审计显示每组检索结果都含最新陈述；错误多发生在同时含过时陈述版本的问题上。受控实验中，替换为过时竞争陈述使Qwen2.5准确率由100%降至44.6%，Qwen3-14B由100%降至87.8%，全部50个有害配对翻转均归因于过时信息。32K历史复现同样显示BM25-64优于BM25-512（69% vs 58%）。
AI.conclusion: 检索到正确事实并不充分。等量条件下，过时的竞争陈述比无关证据危害更大，说明记忆系统需关注证据的"可用性"而非仅"可检索性"，并应显式处理版本冲突与过时信息的抑制。

title: ProCerDCL: Query-Efficient Black-Box Probabilistic Verification of Deep Learning Compiler Optimization
summary: We present \tool, a query-efficient framework for black-box probabilistic verification. Given a fixed, sampleable input distribution and a binary property oracle, \tool assesses the property's violation probability $p$ against a threshold $θ$. Under independent sampling and stateless oracle behavior, acceptance asserts $p\leθ$, rejection asserts $p>θ+η$ for a user-specified separation margin, and an inconclusive verdict indicates insufficient evidence for either conclusion. The probability of each type of erroneous verdict is bounded by its specified error budget. To support this three-valued contract efficiently, \tool uses a single sequential test, eliminating the interval family required by the baseline. The test accounts for repeated sampling checks through either corrected exact binomial confidence intervals or an anytime-valid confidence sequence. We apply \tool to probabilistic local model semantic consistency, where the property oracle detects decision-level inconsistencies between reference and compiled executions under a specified perturbation distribution. Our evaluation covers 24 tasks across TorchInductor and TensorRT and examines sampling efficiency, conclusiveness, and diagnostic behavior. For sampling efficiency, we use paired one-model clean-label radius searches: the baseline requires 3.6-4.2 times as many unique samples under matched numerical parameters while providing a weaker decision contract. For model semantic consistency, checks at $θ=10^{-3}$ yield 817 acceptances, 19 inconclusive verdicts, and 4 rejections across 840 input--backend instances from 21 tasks. Case studies of two documented compiler faults further demonstrate what these local verdicts can diagnose.

AI.tldr: 提出查询高效的、三值判定的黑盒概率验证框架，用于检测本地模型语义一致性。
AI.motivation: 在黑盒概率性质验证中，需要以较少采样给出可靠决策。基线方法依赖“区间族”，查询效率低且决策契约较弱；作者希望在给定误差预算下，用一个顺序检验同时支持接受、拒绝、不确定三种结论。
AI.method: 在独立采样、无状态 oracle 假设下，用单一顺序检验替代基线所需的区间族；对重复采样检查，分别采用校正的精确二项置信区间或 anytime-valid 置信序列，将各类错误判定概率控制在指定误差预算内。应用于概率性本地模型语义一致性：oracle 检测参考执行与编译执行在扰动分布下的决策级不一致；并在 TorchInductor 与 TensorRT 的 24 个任务上评估。
AI.result: 匹配数值参数时，基线需要 3.6–4.2 倍的唯一样本数，且决策契约更弱。在 θ=10^-3 下，21 个任务共 840 个输入–后端实例中：817 接受、19 不确定、4 拒绝。两个已记录编译器故障的案例研究进一步说明这些本地判定能诊断的问题。
AI.conclusion: 单一顺序检验能在保持三值错误预算的同时显著提升采样效率，并在真实编译器后端上提供可用的一致性判定与诊断能力。

title: Benchmarking Task Takeover Across Agent Handoffs
summary: As agents collaborate on longer tasks, responsibility may pass between models before the work is complete. The receiving model must build on prior decisions, observations, and actions while addressing the remaining requirements. Evaluating this transition requires connecting the information preserved at handoff to how the receiver continues the work, a relationship that task-success and memory-retention scores alone do not capture. We introduce the Handoff State Continuity Benchmark (HSC-Bench), comprising 1,039 tasks that evaluate two complementary aspects of task takeover: recovering relevant repository evidence and continuing from established conversational, tool, and file-work state. Comparisons across six receiving models show that structured handoff state improves repository evidence recovery for every model and continuation performance for most models. The strongest receivers differ between the two tracks, showing that evidence-recovery rankings alone do not characterize performance when continuing from inherited state. By combining these comparisons with checks of subsequent responses and actions, HSC-Bench evaluates both access to prior evidence and adherence to established commitments and completed work. This provides a basis for selecting receiving models and assessing handoff representations according to the work that must be carried forward.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HSC-Bench（Handoff State Continuity Benchmark），包含 1,039 个任务，用于评估智能体协作中"任务交接"后接收模型能否既恢复相关仓库证据、又从既有会话/工具/文件状态继续工作，弥补仅靠任务成功率和记忆保留分数无法刻画交接质量的不足。
AI.motivation: 智能体协作长任务时，责任常在任务完成前于模型间传递。接收模型必须基于前序决策、观察与动作继续推进剩余需求。但现有评估中，任务成功率与记忆保留分数无法建立"交接时保留的信息"与"接收方如何继续工作"之间的联系，因而需要专门的交接评估基准。
AI.method: 构建 HSC-Bench，含 1,039 个任务，覆盖交接评估的两个互补方面：(1) 恢复相关仓库证据；(2) 从已建立的多轮会话、工具调用与文件工作状态继续执行。对六个接收模型进行对比实验，并结合对后续响应与动作的检查进行评估。
AI.result: 对比显示：结构化交接状态对每个模型的仓库证据恢复均有提升，对多数模型的延续性能也有提升；两条评估轨道上表现最强的接收模型并不相同，说明仅凭证据恢复排名无法刻画"基于继承状态继续工作"的能力。
AI.conclusion: HSC-Bench 同时评估对既有证据的获取以及对既定承诺与已完成工作的遵循，可作为选择接收模型、评估交接表示方式的依据，且评估应依据"需要被延续的工作"来设计。

title: KL-MOPD: Discrepancy-Aware Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation for Generative Recommendation
summary:
Coordinating multiple recommendation objectives (e.g., click and conversion) is critical for real-world generative recommendation (GR). However, since a positive item in GR can be retrieved only when its tokens are successively selected at every decoding step, traditional item-wise methods lack fine-grained token-wise supervision to guide intermediate steps. Motivated by its success in foundation models, we consider introducing multi-objective on-policy distillation (MOPD) into GR to distill two single-objective teachers into a student at each token. Yet, we find that in vanilla MOPD, (i) teachers exhibit unequal distillation difficulty at each token (i.e., token-level imbalance), and (ii) the harder-to-distill teacher varies across tokens (i.e., cross-token inconsistency), leaving each objective poorly learned at certain steps and hindering positive item retrieval for both objectives, leading to suboptimal performance.
  To address this challenge, we propose KL-MOPD (KL-Weighted Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation), a simple yet effective distillation method that allocates token-wise teacher weights proportional to the initial student-teacher token-wise KL divergences, thereby strengthening supervision for the harder-to-distill teacher at every decoding step. Despite its simplicity, we theoretically prove that KL-MOPD strictly outperforms vanilla MOPD in the additive joint recommendation objective under mild conditions. Moreover, KL-MOPD is plug-and-play and computationally efficient, requiring only a one-time pre-training weight calibration with negligible training overhead. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks, a billion-scale industrial dataset, and online A/B tests on our e-commerce advertising platform demonstrate that KL-MOPD significantly improves both individual and joint recommendation performance. The anonymous code is provided for peer review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 KL-MOPD，一种按初始学生-教师 token 级 KL 散度分配教师权重的多目标在线策略蒸馏方法，解决生成式推荐中 token 级不平衡与跨 token 不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐中正样本需在每个解码步依次选中正确 token 才能被召回，传统 item 级多目标方法缺少细粒度 token 级监督。直接引入多目标在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）存在两个问题：(i) 每个 token 上不同教师的蒸馏难度不均衡（token 级不平衡）；(ii) 难蒸馏的教师在不同 token 间发生变化（跨 token 不一致），导致某些解码步上各目标学不好，最终两个目标的正样本召回都受损。
AI.method: KL-MOPD 依据初始学生-教师 token 级 KL 散度按比例分配各教师的 token 级权重，对更难蒸馏的教师在每个解码步加强监督。方法即插即用、计算高效，只需一次性预训练权重校准。
AI.result: 理论上证明在温和条件下 KL-MOPD 在加性联合推荐目标上严格优于 vanilla MOPD。实验上，在三个公开基准、十亿级工业数据集以及电商广告平台线上 A/B 测试中，KL-MOPD 显著提升单目标与联合推荐性能。
AI.conclusion: KL-MOPD 以极简的 KL 加权机制有效缓解多目标蒸馏中的 token 级不平衡与跨 token 不一致，理论有保证、工程开销可忽略，并已在大规模工业场景验证有效。

title: CrowdCC: Jointly Benchmarking Corruption Robustness and Deployment Quantization in Crowd Counting
summary: Crowd-counting models deployed on edge devices face two shifts: inputs are degraded along the capture and transmission pipeline, while models are quantized to satisfy resource constraints. Yet corruption robustness and deployment quantization are typically evaluated separately. We introduce CrowdCC, a controlled corruption benchmark that jointly evaluates these effects using 23 deployment-motivated corruptions at three severity levels, four crowd-counting datasets, and 26 models using A100 TensorRT engines at FP32, FP16, and post-training INT8 precision, paired with throughput and energy measurements from corresponding Jetson Orin NX configurations. The corruptions span six families, with head annotations adjusted when geometry or visibility changes. Our evaluation shows that capture-chain corruptions consistently produce the largest degradation across the evaluated models, while crowd density affects absolute and relative error differently. Clean accuracy does not fully predict corrupted performance. INT8 alters corruption robustness substantially more than FP16, with no systematic direction, and does not consistently improve latency or energy. INT8 inference efficiency is strongly associated with reformat overhead in the compiled engine, while slowdowns are also observed under limited INT8 coverage. Precision changes corrupted-error rankings and robustness-cost frontiers, showing why model selection must consider corruption robustness and measured deployment cost together. The code is available at https://github.com/Tulane-Computer-Architecture-Systems/CrowdCC-Release.

AI.tldr: CrowdCC是一个受控的损坏鲁棒性基准，联合评估边缘设备场景下的输入损坏与模型量化（FP32/FP16/INT8）对人群计数的影响。
AI.motivation: 边缘部署中，输入因采集传输链路退化，模型又需量化以节省资源，但损坏鲁棒性与部署量化通常被分开评估，缺乏二者联合的受控基准。
AI.method: 构建CrowdCC基准：23种部署相关损坏（3个严重度、6大类）、4个数据集、26个模型，使用A100 TensorRT引擎在FP32/FP16/INT8下评测，并配套Jetson Orin NX的吞吐与能耗测量；几何或可见性变化时调整头部标注。
AI.result: 采集链路损坏造成最大性能退化；人群密度对绝对误差与相对误差影响不同；干净精度不能完全预测损坏性能；INT8对鲁棒性的改变远大于FP16且无系统方向，也不稳定提升延迟与能耗；INT8效率与编译引擎的重排开销强相关，覆盖率不足时反而变慢；精度改变损坏误差排名与鲁棒性-成本前沿。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择须同时考虑损坏鲁棒性与实测部署成本，而非仅依据干净精度或单独量化评估。

title: Let the Gate Decide: Per-Lookup Precision for Quantized Conditional Memory in LLMs
summary: Conditional memory layers, such as DeepSeek's Engram, attach large hashed n-gram tables to a language model, and removing them from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash costs 36.8 PopQA points. Low-bit quantization loses long-tail facts first, and the standard remedy, giving more bits to frequently accessed rows, backfires: refining lookups by access frequency is worse than refining them at random. We trace this to the gate that scales each retrieved row. A lookup's quantization error is weighted by its gate, which is small for frequent n-grams, large for the rare n-grams of long-tail entities, and computable from a 1-bit code. GateRQ therefore stores each row as a ladder of 1-bit residual codes, keeps level 1 in GPU memory to compute the gate, and reads deeper levels only for the lookups the gate ranks highest. Without retraining, GateRQ cuts GPU table memory by 7.8x on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, which raises vLLM throughput by 11%-31% over FP8 tables, while losing about 1 PopQA point at 1.50 bits read per lookup and 0.2 points at 2.10 bits across two models.

AI.tldr: GateRQ 利用门控值可指导量化误差分配这一发现，用 1-bit 残差码阶梯表示记忆层行向量，按门控排序优先读取深层比特，实现无需重训的 7.8x 显存压缩与 11%-31% 吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: 条件记忆层（如 DeepSeek 的 Engram）对模型性能贡献显著，但占用大量显存；低比特量化会优先丢失长尾事实，而"按访问频率分配更多比特"的常规做法反而劣于随机分配，需要找到真正决定量化误差敏感度的信号。
AI.method: 指出查表的量化误差被门控（gate）加权：频繁 n-gram 的门控小、长尾实体的稀有 n-gram 门控大，且门控可由 1-bit 码计算。据此将每行存储为 1-bit 残差码阶梯，第 1 层常驻 GPU 用于计算门控，仅对门控排序最高的查询读取更深层。
AI.result: 在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 上无需重训即把 GPU 表内存降低 7.8x，vLLM 吞吐较 FP8 表提升 11%-31%；每次查询读取 1.50 bit 时 PopQA 仅损失约 1 分，2.10 bit 时损失 0.2 分（两个模型验证）。
AI.conclusion: 门控值是比访问频率更合适的比特分配依据，基于门控的按需分级读取能在几乎不损精度的前提下大幅降低记忆层显存并提升推理吞吐。

title: Ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning for explainable differential diagnosis
summary: Effective differential diagnosis depends on well structured and unambiguous patient case descriptions, since incomplete or ambiguous clinical information readily leads to diagnostic errors and inconsistent reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown promising capabilities in medical question answering and clinical reasoning; however, even when achieving competitive performance on medical benchmarks, they often rely on pattern recognition learned from training data rather than grounded clinical evidence, and can generate plausible yet unsupported diagnostic conclusions. Their reasoning remains largely opaque, making it difficult for clinicians to assess the evidence and rationale behind a given recommendation. To address this gap, we propose an ontology-guided, multiagent differential diagnosis framework that replicates the iterative reasoning process of physicians. The framework grounds diagnostic inference in a structured, expert-curated medical knowledge base, enabling interpretation of symptoms, clinical findings, or disease relationships, while decomposing diagnosis into explicit, auditable reasoning steps. This ontology-based grounding constrains inference to evidence-backed associations, reducing hallucination and improving diagnostic transparency, traceability, and consistency. The system then identifies the most discriminative missing symptoms and generates targeted follow-up questions to reduce uncertainty through a process that mirrors to clinical inquiry. Together, these components improve the reliability, explainability, and diagnostic accuracy of AI-assisted differential diagnosis. The source code is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出本体引导的多智能体鉴别诊断框架，将推理锚定在专家构建的结构化医学知识库上，分解为可审计步骤并主动提问最具有鉴别价值的缺失症状。
AI.motivation: 有效鉴别诊断依赖结构化、无歧义的病例描述，而信息不全或模糊易致诊断错误；LLM 虽在医学基准上表现良好，但多为训练数据中的模式识别，缺乏临床证据支撑，易生成貌似合理却无依据的结论，且推理不透明，临床医生难以评估其证据与依据。
AI.method: 本体引导的多智能体框架，模拟医生的迭代推理：以专家整理的结构化医学知识库为本体基础，解释症状、临床发现与疾病关系；将诊断分解为显式、可审计的推理步骤；本体约束使推理限定于有证据支持的关联；再识别最具鉴别力的缺失症状并生成针对性随访问题以降低不确定性。
AI.result: 本体约束减少了幻觉，提升了诊断透明度、可追溯性与一致性；随访提问机制改善了可靠性、可解释性与诊断准确性。摘要未报告具体量化指标。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM推理锚定于专家本体并分解为可审计步骤，配合主动追问，可提升AI辅助鉴别诊断的可靠性、可解释性与准确性；源码已公开。

title: From Ripple to Boundary: Deterministic Impact Boundaries for LLM-Based Software Evolution
summary: The landscape of software evolution is undergoing a fundamental paradigm shift in the era of Large Language Models. As industrial software engineering increasingly transitions toward design-driven code generation, the bottleneck of evolution has shifted from writing code to maintaining deterministic consistency between multi-source design assets and the generated code. When a design asset changes, LLM agents currently lack a deterministic impact boundary to identify which code must be evolved, leading to two failure modes: hallucinating missing changes or breaking unrelated code. Probabilistic approaches, such as semantic retrieval or text-based diffing, fail to capture the structural ripple effects across highly interconnected design dependencies. We propose a paradigm shift from probabilistic semantic retrieval to deterministic structural constraints. We formalize the design assets as a Knowledge Graph and organize them into a content-addressed Merkle Directed Acyclic Graph. Our key insight reveals a topological isomorphism between the logical ripple effect of a design change and the content hash propagation within the DAG. By leveraging this, we transform ambiguous impact analysis into verifiable structural operations. Through a two-phase diffing process, we extract a precise causal chain that defines the exact modification boundary. This boundary enables deterministic context injection, providing the LLM agent with strictly scoped code and design updates, thereby fundamentally guaranteeing evolution safety. As a by-product, the KG serves as an agent-queryable knowledge base for natural language design retrieval. Early deployment on a large-scale industrial payment platform demonstrates that our mechanism successfully computes the exact impact boundary and generates incremental code modifications that meet the expected design changes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用确定性结构约束替代概率语义检索：将设计资产建模为知识图谱并组织成内容寻址的Merkle DAG，利用设计变更的逻辑涟漪效应与哈希传播之间的拓扑同构，精确计算变更影响边界，为LLM代理提供严格受限的上下文注入，保障设计驱动代码演化的安全性。
AI.motivation: LLM时代软件工程转向设计驱动的代码生成，演化瓶颈从写代码变为维护多源设计资产与生成代码间的确定性一致性。设计资产变更时，LLM代理缺乏确定的影响边界，导致两类失败：幻觉出多余改动或破坏无关代码。语义检索、文本diff等概率方法无法捕捉高度互联设计依赖间的结构性涟漪效应。
AI.method: 将设计资产形式化为知识图谱，并组织为内容寻址的Merkle有向无环图；揭示设计变更的逻辑涟漪与DAG中内容哈希传播之间的拓扑同构关系，把模糊的影响分析转化为可验证的结构操作；通过两阶段diffing过程提取精确因果链，界定确切修改边界，实现确定性上下文注入；KG同时作为可查询的自然语言设计检索知识库。
AI.result: 在大型工业支付平台上的早期部署表明，该机制能成功计算精确的影响边界，并生成满足预期设计变更的增量代码修改。
AI.conclusion: 从概率语义检索转向确定性结构约束可从根本上保障LLM驱动的软件演化安全，内容寻址DAG与拓扑同构为核心提供可验证的影响边界，兼具设计检索知识库的附加价值，工业场景初步验证有效。

title: Causal Localization of Evidence Effects in Transformers
summary: Can controlled symbolic inputs reveal attention heads that influence a language model's decisions from natural language evidence? We introduce controlled evidence aggregation (CEA), which varies the counts and order of two symbols in otherwise fixed prompts and measures changes in a frozen Transformer's preference between two answer tokens. The preference is measured by their logit difference; the prompts prescribe no correct answer. Balanced utility causal selection (BUC) identifies compact head sets by jointly evaluating how much ablating their outputs removes the count effect and how closely patching mean outputs between count conditions recovers the effect in both directions. We derive conditional bounds linking head attribution to intervention effects and specifying when the attribution shortlist can be recovered from finite samples. In Pythia-410M, ablating sets of 1-12 heads selected separately for four ordering regimes removes 65.5-91.6% of the count effect. The sets retain their influence on count comparisons not used for selection. To test relevance beyond symbolic inputs, we evaluate a natural language task asking which state is supported by more reports. Ablating eight heads selected only on symbolic yes/no prompts lowers mean accuracy by 8.2 percentage points, versus 0.8 for random sets matched by size and layer. Our results demonstrate that controlled symbolic probes can identify compact attention head sets whose causal influence extends to natural language decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出受控证据聚合(CEA)与平衡效用因果选择(BUC)，从符号输入中识别出紧凑的注意力头集合，其因果影响可迁移到自然语言决策。
AI.motivation: 探究受控符号输入能否揭示影响语言模型基于自然语言证据做决策的注意力头，并建立头部归因与干预效应之间的可恢复性理论保证。
AI.method: CEA在固定提示中改变两个符号的计数与顺序，用两个答案token的logit差衡量模型偏好（不设正确答案）；BUC联合评估消融输出对计数效应的消除程度与双向均值patch的恢复程度，选出紧凑头集；并推导连接头归因与干预效应的条件界及有限样本可恢复性条件。在Pythia-410M上针对四种排序规则分别选头，并测试自然语言任务（哪个州被更多报道支持）。
AI.result: 消融1-12个所选头可消除65.5-91.6%的计数效应，且对未用于选择的计数比较仍保持影响；仅用符号yes/no提示选出的8个头在自然语言任务上使平均准确率下降8.2个百分点，而等规模同层随机头集仅下降0.8。
AI.conclusion: 受控符号探针能识别出紧凑注意力头集合，其因果影响可延伸到自然语言决策，支持从符号实验到自然语言行为的可迁移性。

title: Tessera: Structure-Completed Evidence Units for Web Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Web retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) splits a page into fixed-size text chunks or, in recent visual pipelines, screenshot tiles, and the retrieved item serves at once as the unit of indexing, ranking, and reading. We trace answer evidence from source HTML to reader input over the full English Wikipedia and find that this coupling loses evidence in text and screenshot pipelines alike: evidence present in the source page often fails to reach the reader intact, particularly structured content such as tables and infoboxes, which chunking separates from the headers and context that give it meaning. Stronger extraction, context expansion, and larger reader budgets leave the loss in place. We present Tessera, a training-free evidence delivery layer that decouples what a pipeline retrieves from what its reader reads. Given the pages behind any ranked list, Tessera rebuilds their HTML into fine-grained evidence units, each completed with its page title, section path, and table headers, selects the units relevant to the query, and packs them into the reader context at an unchanged token budget. The index, the retriever, and the reader stay as they are, so Tessera applies to text, screenshot, and agentic pipelines. Across three question answering benchmarks, Tessera improves answer accuracy by 5 to 6 points on text and screenshot pipelines, consistently across readers, retrievers, and reader budgets, and outperforms strong HTML-aware and structure-aware RAG baselines under matched budgets. The gains carry over to multi-step agentic search. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/sarendis56/Tessera.

AI.tldr: Tessera是一个免训练的证据交付层，将"检索单元"与"阅读单元"解耦：把检索到的网页HTML重建为带有页面标题、章节路径和表头的细粒度证据单元，再按token预算打包给读者，在不改动索引/检索器/阅读器的前提下，使文本与截图RAG在三个QA基准上提升5–6个点。
AI.motivation: 现有Web RAG把页面切成固定长度文本块或截图瓦片，同一检索项同时充当索引、排序和阅读单元，导致答案证据（尤其表格、信息框等结构化内容）常无法完整到达读者；更强的抽取、上下文扩展和更大阅读预算都无法消除这一损失。
AI.method: 通过在全部英文维基百科上从源HTML到读者输入追踪证据，量化耦合损失；提出Tessera：重建HTML为细粒度证据单元并补全页面标题、章节路径、表头，按查询筛选相关单元，在相同token预算下打包进阅读上下文，索引、检索器、阅读器均保持不变，适用于文本、截图和智能体流程。
AI.result: 三个QA基准上，文本与截图流程答案准确率提升5–6个百分点，跨不同阅读器、检索器和阅读预算均稳定；在同等预算下优于强HTML感知与结构感知RAG基线，并能延伸到多步智能体搜索。
AI.conclusion: 检索与阅读单元的耦合是Web RAG证据损失的关键原因，解耦式的证据交付（Tessera）是一种免训练、即插即用且普适的改进方案。

title: BoxWorld: Let World Engines Control and Video Generators Render
summary: We tackle the challenge of building real-time interactive video worlds with user-defined behaviors. Such worlds must track object states, apply interaction rules, and render the resulting consequences as users act. Yet existing end-to-end video world models typically learn interaction dynamics within the generator, making it difficult to specify object-level rules and reason about their consequences. In this work, we introduce BoxWorld, which separates interaction reasoning from generative rendering. Given user-specified rules, a coding agent creates a Box World Engine that determines interaction outcomes and exposes the resulting object states through a lightweight interface of layout boxes, persistent object attributes, and dynamic status variables, leaving appearance and physical effects to generative rendering. A Box-State Generative Renderer then renders this evolving state stream into video autoregressively, enabling online control over object motion, state switches, and conditional events. Rendering this state stream is non-trivial: the renderer must respond to object-level state updates in real time while remaining coherent with the generated history. To this end, we introduce a three-stage training strategy that learns object grounding from open-domain videos and state transitions from gameplay videos, both annotated automatically, and finally performs rollout distillation on self-generated histories. We further propose PairedStateBench, a paired benchmark for fine-grained interaction control. BoxWorld substantially outperforms end-to-end world models and remains competitive across multiple public benchmarks. Project page: https://boxworld-web.github.io.

AI.tldr: BoxWorld 将交互推理与生成式渲染解耦：用编码智能体根据用户规则构建"盒世界引擎"来推演物体交互结果，再由 Box-State 生成渲染器将状态流自回归渲染为视频，实现实时、可控的交互视频世界。
AI.motivation: 构建用户可定义行为的实时交互视频世界需要跟踪物体状态、应用交互规则并渲染后果，但现有端到端视频世界模型把交互动力学隐式学进生成器内部，难以指定物体级规则、也难以推理其后果。
AI.method: 分离交互推理与渲染。①编码智能体依据用户规则生成 Box World Engine，输出由布局框、持久物体属性、动态状态变量组成的轻量接口；②Box-State 生成渲染器自回归地把状态流渲染为视频，支持运动、状态切换、条件事件的在线控制；③三阶段训练：从开放域视频学物体定位、从游戏视频学状态转移（均自动标注），并在自生成历史上做 rollout 蒸馏。
AI.result: 提出 PairedStateBench 细粒度交互控制配对基准；BoxWorld 显著优于端到端世界模型，并在多个公开基准上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将交互逻辑外置为显式状态引擎、让生成模型只负责外观与物理效果渲染，是构建可控实时交互视频世界的一条有效路径。

title: Layerwise Repacking: Variable-Length Hybrid-Attention Training without an Extra Redistribution Pass
summary:
Variable-length training creates conflicting parallelism requirements across the layers of a hybrid-attention model. The longest samples require wide sequence-parallel (SP) groups of 16 or 32 ranks for full attention, whose cost grows quadratically with sequence length. Sparse-attention layers, dominated by near-linear MoE work, can instead balance most evaluated workloads within node-local SP8 groups. Reusing the wide groups for these layers pushes their all-to-all communication across nodes, where the observed effective rate is 7.0x lower. Yet switching to smaller groups changes which ranks own each sample; a separate redistribution at every full-sparse boundary would introduce another data transfer.
  Layerwise Repacking keeps each SP16/32 parent for full attention and repacks its samples into node-local sparse children at SP{1, 2, 4, 8}, where hidden states persist between full layers. The layout change rides on the two existing full-layer Ulysses sites: at each, one variable-size all-to-all performs both the head exchange and the sample repacking, so no redistribution pass is added. Because the balance the children can reach depends on which samples share a parent, an auxiliary parent solver rebalances parent membership before the children are formed.
  On all 22 steps with SP16/32 parents among the first 200 training steps of a 1F3S hybrid-attention model (one full-attention layer per three sparse-attention layers), repacking alone reduces the mean end-to-end time by 5.95% and raises model FLOPs utilization (MFU) by 3.75 percentage points over the baseline with repacking disabled; with the improved solver, end-to-end time falls by 7.61% and MFU rises by 4.83 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出 Layerwise Repacking：在混合注意力模型训练中，按层把全局 SP16/32 父组内的样本重打包进节点本地 SP{1,2,4,8} 稀疏子组，并借助已有的 Ulysses 全对全通信顺带完成重分布，端到端时间降低约 5.95–7.61%，MFU 提升 3.75–4.83 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 变长训练下，不同层对并行度需求冲突：全注意力层需宽 SP 组（16/32）以处理最长样本且成本随序列长度平方增长；稀疏注意力/MoE 层仅需节点内 SP8 即可负载均衡，复用宽组会把 all-to-all 推到跨节点（实测有效带宽低 7.0 倍）。但切换小组会改变样本归属，逐层重分布会带来额外数据传输。
AI.method: 保留全注意力层的 SP16/32 父组，在每个全层边界把样本重打包为节点本地 SP{1,2,4,8} 稀疏子组，隐藏状态在全层之间保持常驻；重打包搭车于两处已有的全层 Ulysses 通信点，用一次变长 all-to-all 同时完成头交换与样本重打包，不增加额外重分布。另设父组求解器，在形成子组前先重平衡父组成员，以改善子组可达到的负载均衡。
AI.result: 在 1F3S 混合注意力模型前 200 步中含 SP16/32 父组的全部 22 步上：仅启用重打包即使端到端平均时间降低 5.95%、MFU 提升 3.75 个百分点；叠加改进求解器后时间降低 7.61%、MFU 提升 4.83 个百分点（均相对禁用重打包的基线）。
AI.conclusion: 按层重打包可在不引入额外通信开销的前提下协调全注意力与稀疏注意力层的并行需求，显著提升变长混合注意力模型训练效率，且求解器优化能进一步放大收益。

title: How Stable Are LLM-Generated Proofs Under Program Refactoring? A Stress Test for Verifiable Code Generation
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding
summary: Benchmarks for verifiable code generation usually test a proof against one fixed implementation. We ask whether the same proof remains valid after a program refactoring that preserves behavior. We introduce RefactorProof, which derives 458 Lean-certified variants from the 185 VERINA tasks that compile in our pinned environment while holding the specification and evaluated proof fixed byte-for-byte. VERINA supplies reference proofs for 46 tasks, all from its basic split; the primary model-versus-reference comparisons further match on 21-25 short, non-recursive tasks. Structural refactorings expose substantial brittleness across proof sources: task-normalized structural PSR is 4.3% for the supplied references and 13.3-26.8% for the specialized provers. On the matched tasks, specialized prover proofs nevertheless have higher overall unchanged-proof survival than the supplied reference artifacts: +15.6 points for DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B, +18.8 for Goedel-Prover-V2-32B, and +20.3 for Goedel-Prover-V2-8B; all three 95% CIs exclude zero. The ordering persists after excluding universally survived T1 variants, under family-balanced aggregation, and under alternative deployable valid-proof selection rules. However, unchanged-proof failure is not the same as high repair cost: predefined one-identifier edits repair 51/54 eligible reference structural failures and 58/85 eligible prover failures. RefactorProof therefore measures unchanged-proof stability under program refactoring, not the cost of maintaining a proof after it breaks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RefactorProof 基准，将 VERINA 任务在规格与证明字节不变的前提下做保持行为的程序重构，生成 458 个 Lean 认证变体，用于衡量证明的"未变即存活"稳定性。结果显示结构化重构让参考证明与专用证明器的证明都大幅失效，但在匹配任务上专用证明器的证明存活率显著高于参考证明；同时一次性单标识符修复能修好大多数失败。
AI.motivation: 现有可验证代码生成基准只检验对单一固定实现的证明，未考虑程序重构后证明是否仍成立。作者希望回答：在保持行为的重构后，同一证明是否依然有效，从而揭示证明对实现细节的脆弱性。
AI.method: 基于 185 个在固定环境中可编译的 VERINA 任务，保持规格和方法求值后的证明逐字节不变，施加保持行为的结构化重构，生成 458 个经 Lean 认证的变体；以任务归一化的结构 PSR（证明存活率）为主指标，并在 21–25 个短小非递归的匹配任务上比较模型证明与参考证明，辅以去 T1、家族均衡聚合、可部署有效证明选择规则等稳健性检验，以及单标识符修复实验。
AI.result: 任务归一化结构 PSR 仅为：官方参考证明 4.3%，专用证明器 13.3%–26.8%。在匹配任务上，专用证明器证明的整体未变存活率高于参考工件：DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B +15.6 点、Goedel-Prover-V2-32B +18.8 点、Goedel-Prover-V2-8B +20.3 点，三者 95% 置信区间均不含零，且该排序在多项稳健性检验下保持。修复方面，预定义的单标识符编辑可修复 51/54 个参考结构性失败和 58/85 个证明器失败。
AI.conclusion: RefactorProof 度量的是程序重构下"证明未变即存活"的稳定性，而非证明失效后的维护/修复成本；证明失效并不等于修复代价高。该基准揭示了现有证明来源对实现细节的普遍脆弱性，并为评估证明稳健性提供了可复现的协议。

title: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Behaviorally Adequate Test Generation from Software Requirements
summary:
As large language model agents increasingly compile natural-language requirements into repository-level code, requirement-to-test generation grows in importance to provide validation constraints (or harness) to guide code generation. Yet it remains unclear whether current agents can generate tests that validate the required behavior when the implementation of that behavior is withheld. Existing test-generation benchmarks mostly focus on white-box testing, whereas the requirement--test-related study usually requires evaluation on semantic alignment between the given documents and the generated tests.
  We introduce Req2Test-Bench, a benchmark containing 5,086 execution-validated instances recovered from developer-authored behavior-driven development (BDD) artifacts in 8 open-source projects, spanning 5 programming languages and 4 BDD frameworks. Each instance pairs a natural-language requirement in Gherkin with its developer-written Test Implementation. Given the requirement, target interfaces of the required behavior, an agent must generate a complete, potentially multi-file Test Implementation. Evaluation of 8 agent--model--reasoning configurations reveals a substantial gap between execution success and behavioral adequacy, which is measured strictly as kill-completeness: a kill-complete test kills every mutant that the ground-truth test kills. The best-performing configuration, Codex with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, produces passing tests for 82.8% of instances, yet only 33.8% are behaviorally adequate. We find that (1) scaling up agents yields sharply diminishing returns in behavioral adequacy relative to generation cost; (2) under-specified requirements cause the information gap, including ambiguous setup and implicit expected outcomes; and (3) requirement-grounded harnesses that steer agent non-determinism offer a promising direction for improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出Req2Test-Bench基准，要求智能体在隐藏实现的情况下由Gherkin需求生成可执行的测试实现，并发现现有智能体"执行通过"与"行为充分"之间存在巨大鸿沟。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地将自然语言需求编译为仓库级代码，需求到测试的生成因此成为提供验证约束（harness）的关键手段。但现有测试生成基准多聚焦白盒测试，尚不清楚智能体能否在行为实现被隐藏时生成真正验证所需行为的测试，需求与测试之间的语义对齐缺乏评测。
AI.method: 构建Req2Test-Bench：从8个开源项目的开发者编写的BDD产物中恢复5,086个执行验证通过的实例，覆盖5种编程语言与4种BDD框架。每个实例由Gherkin自然语言需求与其开发者编写的测试实现配对；给定需求与目标接口，智能体需生成完整、可多文件的测试实现。评测8种agent–model–reasoning配置，采用"kill-completeness"严格指标（测试需杀死ground-truth测试所杀死的全部变异体）衡量行为充分性。
AI.result: 最佳配置Codex+DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash有82.8%实例生成通过测试，但仅33.8%行为充分。发现：(1)扩大智能体规模相对生成成本在行为充分性上收益急剧递减；(2)需求欠规范（歧义setup、隐式预期结果）造成信息鸿沟；(3)基于需求约束的harness引导智能体非确定性是改进方向。
AI.conclusion: 现有智能体在需求驱动测试生成上存在"执行成功≠行为充分"的严重落差，且单纯扩大规模效率低；未来应聚焦需求欠规范的消解与需求锚定的harness设计以约束智能体非确定性。

title: ETC-Bench: A Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluation-Side Transcript Canonicalization
summary: Written transcripts of the same speech can differ in ways that are not uniquely determined by the speech signal. We formulate evaluation-side transcript canonicalization (ETC), which maps multiple surface forms to a single canonical form when their differences are not determined by speech. To our knowledge, ETC-Bench is the first and most comprehensive multilingual benchmark for evaluation-side transcript canonicalization, covering 181 phenomenon types across 12 languages. Each instance is a minimal pair that shares a sentence context and differs only in a target span exhibiting one phenomenon. To evaluate both canonicalization success and semantic preservation, we propose Semantic-preserving Exact-match Normalization Accuracy (SENA), which combines exact agreement between independently canonicalized pair members with a pair-relative BERTScore constraint against information loss. We further introduce the Taxonomy-guided Agent Canonicalization Skill (TACS), which provides LLM agents with phenomenon descriptions and explicit canonicalization contracts. Experiments with five baseline configurations and three TACS-based agents show that the agents outperform the baseline systems on shared languages. ETC-Bench provides a systematic testbed for evaluation-side transcript canonicalization across languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"评测侧转写规范化"(ETC)任务、首个覆盖12种语言181类现象的多语言基准ETC-Bench、兼顾规范化成功与语义保持的指标SENA，以及基于分类法引导的智能体规范化技能TACS。
AI.motivation: 同一语音的书面转写可能因不由语音信号决定的因素而不同，会干扰评测的公平性，需要对评测侧转写进行规范化，但此前缺乏系统化的任务定义与评测基准。
AI.method: 定义ETC任务（将差异非语音决定的多表面形式映射为单一规范形式）；构建多语言基准ETC-Bench，实例为共享句子上下文、仅在目标片段上体现某现象的最小对；提出SENA指标（独立规范化后完全一致 + 成对相对BERTScore约束以防信息丢失）；提出TACS，为LLM智能体提供现象描述与显式规范化契约。
AI.result: 在五个基线配置与三个TACS智能体上的实验显示，TACS智能体在共有语言上优于基线系统。
AI.conclusion: ETC-Bench为跨语言评测侧转写规范化提供了系统化测试平台。

title: Rethinking Positional Encoding and Interaction Granularity for CTR Prediction
summary: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction relies on historical behaviors and contextual features to estimate clicks on a target item. Existing Transformer-based CTR models often adopt index-based or temporal positional encodings and token-level causal interaction. However, we observe that most existing positional encodings do not outperform NoPE, while relaxing causal constraints within target-relative temporal groups also yields gains. These observations motivate a fundamental question: what positional encoding and interaction granularity does CTR prediction actually require? To address this question, we propose \textbf{TRIP}, which combines target-aware rank--time positional encoding with temporal-group interaction modeling. Specifically, Factorized Rank Encoding represents each behavior's ordinal position within the historical sequence through a low-rank factorization, while Target-Relative Time Encoding characterizes its temporal distance to the target on a coarse-to-fine scale. This joint design grounds each behavior's positional representation in its sequence context and temporal relation to the current target. Furthermore, Temporal Group-Causal Interaction enriches intra-group representations through bidirectional interaction and masked reconstruction while preserving inter-group causal order. Finally, behavior representations are condensed into compact group summaries for efficient group-level modeling in subsequent layers. Experiments on four public benchmarks show that TRIP improves AUC by up to 4.45\% relative to the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: TRIP 将"目标感知的秩—时间位置编码"与"时间组交互建模"结合，替代传统索引/时间位置编码与token级因果交互，在四个公开CTR基准上AUC最高相对提升4.45%。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer类CTR模型多采用基于索引或时间的位置编码及token级因果交互，但作者观察到：多数已有位置编码并不优于NoPE；且在目标相对的时间组内放松因果约束反而带来增益。由此提出核心问题——CTR预测究竟需要什么样的位置编码与交互粒度。
AI.method: TRIP含三部分：(1) Factorized Rank Encoding：用低秩分解表示行为在历史序列中的序数位置；(2) Target-Relative Time Encoding：以由粗到细的尺度刻画行为到目标的时间距离；二者联合使位置表示同时扎根于序列上下文与目标的时间关系。(3) Temporal Group-Causal Interaction：组内用双向交互与掩码重建增强表示，组间保持因果顺序，并将行为表示压缩为紧凑组摘要以支持后续层的高效组级建模。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准上，TRIP相对最强基线AUC最高提升4.45%（相对值）。
AI.conclusion: CTR预测更适合目标相对的位置信息与"组内双向、组间因果"的交互粒度，而非细粒度token级因果与常规位置编码；该设计兼顾效果与效率。

title: Evaluating Federated Vision-Language and Vision-Only Models for Privacy-Aware Breast Cancer Imaging
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) shows promise for breast imaging, but limited labeled data, institutional data fragmentation, and privacy concerns hinder centralized training. We investigate a privacy-aware federated learning framework combining pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) with client-level differential privacy. We compare general-purpose CLIP models, biomedical BiomedCLIP, and an ImageNet-pretrained ViT-B/16 baseline on two public breast imaging datasets, with and without differential privacy. We also evaluate a CLIP ViT-B/16 ablation that removes the text pathway. Evaluation includes patient-level ROC-AUC with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, baseline comparisons, threshold sensitivity, inter-model agreement, and communication cost. Under federated learning, all five models achieve high normal-versus-sick discrimination (ROC-AUC: 0.940-0.990). However, acquisition year alone achieves 0.974 on the same test partition, raising concerns about confounding rather than genuine pathology recognition. Benign-versus-malignant discrimination remains uncertain (ROC-AUC: 0.504-0.637), with all confidence intervals including 0.50. Removing the text pathway preserves classification accuracy while halving communication cost. Differential privacy reduces ROC-AUC by 0.375, attributable to perturbing the full model state rather than only trainable parameters. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating confounding, predictive reliability, privacy implementation, and deployment efficiency when developing federated AI systems for breast imaging.

AI.tldr: 在联邦学习下用VLM（CLIP/BiomedCLIP）做乳腺影像分类，虽有隐私保护优势且"正常vs异常"区分度高，但该性能可能来自采集年份等混杂因素，良恶性判别接近随机。
AI.motivation: AI在乳腺影像有潜力，但标注数据有限、机构数据割裂、隐私问题阻碍集中式训练；需要评估隐私感知的联邦学习框架是否真正学到病理特征而非伪相关。
AI.method: 联邦学习框架结合预训练视觉-语言模型（CLIP、BiomedCLIP、ImageNet ViT-B/16基线及去除文本通路的CLIP消融）与客户端级差分隐私，在两个公开乳腺影像数据集上对比（含/不含DP）；评估指标包括患者级ROC-AUC及bootstrap 95%CI、基线比较、阈值敏感性、模型间一致性、通信开销。
AI.result: 五个模型"正常vs异常"AUC达0.940–0.990，但仅用采集年份即达0.974，提示混杂；良恶性判别AUC 0.504–0.637，CI均含0.50。去除文本通路保持精度并减半通信成本。DP使AUC下降0.375，源于扰动整个模型状态而非仅可训练参数。
AI.conclusion: 开发联邦乳腺影像AI时须重视混杂因素、预测可靠性、隐私实现方式与部署效率；高AUC可能反映伪相关而非真实病理识别。

title: DuplexTune: Coupled-State Replay for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Adaptation
summary: Sparse expert execution does not remove the stored states needed to adapt a mixture-of-experts language model. We present DuplexTune, a framework for replaying coupled hidden states through pretrained attention and expert modules. Trainable width bridges connect two residual streams to the backbone. Bridge warm-up precedes backbone adaptation, with router weights kept frozen. We analyze the implicit state-recovery equation and identify the convergence and replay conditions needed for reconstruction. On Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, the single-H800 evaluation reports 38.8 GB peak memory, versus 64.8 GB for supervised fine-tuning with checkpointing, and throughput of 25.1 versus 19.9 samples/s. DuplexTune achieves 67.2% MMLU, 75.6% GSM8K, and 7.69 MT-Bench, with a weaker multilingual score than the checkpointed baseline. The results characterize a configuration-dependent tradeoff among state storage, throughput, and adaptation quality.

AI.tldr: DuplexTune 通过双残差流桥接与隐藏状态回放，降低 MoE 语言模型适配时的状态存储开销，同时提升吞吐，但在多语言能力上存在取舍。
AI.motivation: 稀疏专家激活虽减少计算，但适配 MoE 模型仍需存储大量隐藏状态（如 SFT 的激活/检查点），造成显存与吞吐压力。
AI.method: 提出 DuplexTune：用可训练宽度桥连接两条残差流，将耦合隐藏状态经预训练注意力与专家模块回放；先桥热身再适配骨干，路由器权重冻结；并分析隐式状态恢复方程的收敛与回放条件。
AI.result: Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B 单卡 H800：峰值显存 38.8 GB（检查点 SFT 为 64.8 GB），吞吐 25.1 vs 19.9 samples/s；MMLU 67.2%、GSM8K 75.6%、MT-Bench 7.69，多语言分数弱于基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画出状态存储、吞吐与适配质量之间依赖配置的权衡关系。

title: Plenty of Room in the Middle: Revealing Opportunities on a GPU Cluster via Fine-Grained Monitoring
comment: 19 pages, 12 figures, 4 tables. Originally written in fall 2024
summary:
GPU clusters have become essential computing resources for AI and scientific research in academia and industry. However, their high cost and growing demand often result in long queueing delays. While previous monitoring efforts have operated at second- or minute-level frequencies, they primarily informed job-level scheduling for clusters and lacked the detail needed to optimize GPU-level utilization.
  This paper presents an in-depth study of a university research GPU cluster, analyzing resource usage at 100 ms intervals. We have developed a lightweight monitoring tool that leverages Nvidia's DCGM library to capture fine-grained "compute utilization" metrics within GPUs. Deployed on a cluster with 89 nodes and 319 GPUs, our tool collected data over several months. This paper focuses on a 10-day period with 7,399 jobs submitted by 150 users from 12 departments. Our study reveals three key findings: (1) the GPU cluster exhibits significant underutilization, with over 70% of jobs using less than 20% of GPU memory and 50% averaging below 5% Streaming Multiprocessor (SM) utilization; (2) 80% of jobs have a drastic mismatch between their requested and actual durations, significantly limiting the scheduler's effectiveness; and (3) the multi-GPU jobs we examined show highly periodic communication patterns. These findings suggest there is plenty of room in the middle: substantial utilization gains are available through better job scheduling and GPU multitasking, independent of hardware or application improvements.
  Our monitoring solution is available as open-source software at https://github.com/als244/gpu_server_monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文对某大学研究GPU集群进行100ms粒度细粒度监测，揭示GPU资源严重低利用率、作业请求时长与实际严重不匹配、多GPU作业通信高度周期性三大问题，表明通过改进调度与GPU多任务可带来大量利用提升。
AI.motivation: GPU集群成本高、需求大导致排队延迟长；已有监测多为秒级或分钟级，仅服务作业级调度，缺乏优化GPU级利用率所需细节。
AI.method: 基于Nvidia DCGM库开发轻量监测工具，捕捉GPU内部细粒度"计算利用率"指标，以100ms间隔在含89节点、319块GPU的集群上连续采集数月数据；重点分析10天内150名用户、12个院系提交的7399个作业。
AI.result: (1) 严重低利用：超70%作业使用不足20%显存，50%作业平均SM利用率低于5%；(2) 80%作业请求时长与实际时长严重不符，限制调度器效果；(3) 多GPU作业通信模式高度周期性。
AI.conclusion: 存在大量"中间地带"提升空间：无需硬件或应用改进，仅通过更好的作业调度与GPU多任务即可显著提升利用率；监测工具已开源。

title: A Fine-Grained Empirical Study of Upstream Security Events and Downstream Mitigation in Maven
summary: Open-source vulnerability mitigation spans upstream libraries and the downstream projects that depend on them. Upstream, a vulnerability progresses through a public report when one exists, a fix, a fixed release, and NVD disclosure. Downstream, a project mitigates it by adopting the fixed release, and the timeliness of this adoption is measured relative to these events. Prior work studies the two sides separately, so it is unclear whether downstream exposure stems from delayed upstream release, delayed downstream adoption, or both. We address this gap by following 832 CVEs in the Maven ecosystem from the upstream fix to its adoption by each exposed downstream project. We classify upstream fixes as \textit{silent} or \textit{transparent}, recover the order of report, fix, release, and NVD disclosure, and link vulnerable artifacts to their downstream dependents. We then compare this order with downstream adoption and dependabot usage. We find that delay arises on both sides. Upstream, the fixed release comes before NVD disclosure for about 82\% of CVEs, for both silent and transparent fixes. For the other 17.9\%, downstream projects have no fix to adopt for days to more than four months after disclosure. Downstream, exposure is concentrated, with the top 10\% of CVEs accounting for 72.1\% of it. Of 1,677 observed adoptions, 85.3\% happen after NVD disclosure, rising to 88.3\% for silent fixes released before disclosure. Most adoptions come through routine dependency updates. Adoptions with dependabot version updates have a median release-to-adoption delay of 10.4 days, compared with 110.6 days without dependabot. Yet version updates were configured at adoption time for only 8.5\% of total adoptions. We translate these findings into implications for upstream maintainers, downstream developers, and dependency-automation tools.

AI.tldr: 本文追踪Maven生态832个CVE从上游修复到下游采用的全过程，发现延迟同时存在于上游发布与下游采用两端，且下游暴露高度集中，Dependabot等自动化工具显著缩短采用延迟但配置率极低。
AI.motivation: 以往研究将上游漏洞修复与下游项目采用分开考察，无法判断下游暴露究竟源于上游发布延迟、下游采用延迟还是两者兼有，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 跟踪Maven生态中832个CVE，从上游修复到每个暴露下游项目的采用；将上游修复分为silent与transparent，还原报告、修复、发布、NVD披露的事件顺序，将易受影响工件与其下游依赖者关联，并与下游采用行为及dependabot使用情况进行对比。
AI.result: 延迟在两端均存在：约82%的CVE其修复版本先于NVD披露发布（silent与transparent均如此），其余17.9%下游在披露后数天至四个多月才有无可采用的修复；暴露高度集中，前10%的CVE占72.1%；1,677次采用中85.3%发生在披露后，silent修复情形升至88.3%；多数采用经由常规依赖更新；有dependabot版本更新时发布到采用的中位延迟为10.4天，无则为110.6天，但仅8.5%的采用在采用时配置了版本更新。
AI.conclusion: 下游漏洞暴露是上游发布与下游采用双重延迟共同造成的结果，且依赖自动化工具能大幅缩短采用时延却配置不足；研究为上游维护者、下游开发者及依赖自动化工具提供了实践启示。

title: Agentic Data Sampling Framework for Multilingual ASR via Linguistic-Aware Error-Driven Optimization
summary: Multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) has achieved rapid progress with large-scale pretrained models and multilingual speech corpora. Previous studies have proved the pivotal role of data sampling in multilingual ASR performance. However, existing sampling strategies largely rely on time-consuming manual, heuristic-based designs. To address this, we propose a linguistic-aware agentic data sampling framework that introduces a data sampling LLM agent into the multilingual ASR training loop. The agent is driven by a linguistically grounded rubric that analyzes ASR errors from phonological, morphological, and syntactic perspectives, and uses the resulting feedback together with training statistics, budget constraints, and algorithm profiles to select domain-level, sample-level, and token-level sampling strategies. This design turns evaluation results into adaptive data-selection decisions rather than treating WER/CER as final endpoints only. We conduct experiments on twelve Common Voice languages using Whisper-medium as the ASR backbone. The results show that our method achieves performance better than full-data training while using less training data and lower computational resources, and substantially accelerates training convergence compared to conventional sampling strategies.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种语言学感知的智能体数据采样框架，将LLM智能体引入多语种ASR训练循环，用语言学评分表分析ASR错误并自适应选择领域级、样本级、词元级采样策略，在12种Common Voice语言上以Whisper-medium为骨干，用更少数据和算力超过全量训练表现并加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 多语种ASR数据采样对性能至关重要，但现有采样策略依赖耗时的人工设计和启发式规则，缺乏自适应能力；同时WER/CER通常只作为最终评价指标，评估结果未能反馈到数据选择决策中。
AI.method: 构建linguistic-aware agentic数据采样框架，将数据采样LLM智能体嵌入多语种ASR训练回路；智能体由语言学驱动的评分表（rubric）引导，从音系、形态、句法三个层面分析ASR错误，并结合生成的反馈、训练统计、预算约束和算法画像，选择领域级、样本级与词元级采样策略。
AI.result: 在12种Common Voice语言上，以Whisper-medium为ASR骨干进行实验，所提方法在使用更少训练数据和更低计算资源的情况下性能优于全量数据训练，且相比传统采样策略显著加速训练收敛。
AI.conclusion: 将评估结果转化为自适应数据选择决策（而非仅作为WER/CER终点指标）是提升多语种ASR训练效率的有效途径，LLM智能体驱动的语言学感知采样可兼顾性能、数据效率与收敛速度。

title: Coverage Under Contradiction: A Benchmark for Negation-Aware Retrieval
summary: Coverage-evaluation benchmarks quantify whether retrieved evidence covers the different pieces of information needed to satisfy an information need. Existing benchmarks mostly consider factual claims that may already be known to pretrained retrieval components, leaving open whether retrievers find corpus evidence when it contradicts those priors. We study how retrievers behave when their parametric knowledge and the information in a corpus disagree. To do so, we develop a process to augment a nugget-based coverage benchmark with controlled contradictions. For each nugget, we create a negated counterpart and edit its supporting documents to support that negation while preserving the context. Applying this process to CoverageBench, a benchmark measuring information coverage, we create CoverageBench-Negate, spanning six datasets and roughly 63,000 original-edited evidence pairs (one per nugget-document link). We attach rich construction metadata to every pair and additionally provide out-of-family LLM judgments over all pairs and a human audit of a sample. In baseline experiments, BM25 separates original from edited near-twin evidence substantially better than dense retrievers (Qwen3 and Jina), which stay near chance. We release the benchmark on Hugging Face Datasets (nuggets, documents, pairs) together with the construction materials, including the prompts used to create it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoverageBench-Negate，一个通过受控否定编辑构建的覆盖度基准，用于检验检索器在语料证据与参数知识冲突时是否能找到证据。实验发现 BM25 在区分原始与近孪生否定证据上显著优于 Qwen3、Jina 等稠密检索器（后者接近随机水平）。
AI.motivation: 现有覆盖度评测基准多基于事实性论断，这些论断可能已被预训练检索组件"记住"，因此无法判断检索器在语料证据与自身参数知识相矛盾时，是否仍能找到语料中的证据。作者希望研究这种"参数知识与语料信息不一致"情形下检索器的行为。
AI.method: 构建了一套为 nugget-based 覆盖度基准注入受控矛盾的流程：对每个 nugget 生成否定对应版本，并编辑其支持文档以支持该否定，同时保持上下文不变。将流程应用于 CoverageBench，得到 CoverageBench-Negate，覆盖 6 个数据集、约 63,000 组原始-编辑证据对，每对附带丰富构建元数据，并提供全量对的非同族 LLM 判断与抽样人工审核。
AI.result: 基线实验显示，BM25 在区分原始证据与编辑后的近孪生证据上明显优于稠密检索器（Qwen3 与 Jina），后两者表现接近随机。基准数据与构建材料（含生成提示）已在 Hugging Face Datasets 发布。
AI.conclusion: 稠密检索器在面对与参数知识相冲突的语料证据时失效，说明现有评测难以揭示这一缺陷，而否定型近孪生对比是检验检索器"是否真正依赖语料证据"的有效探针。

title: SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding
summary: Perceiving human body motion is critical for multimodal systems that understand and assist people. Yet current evaluations of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) largely focus on objects, scenes, and coarse actions, leaving their ability to reason about the body itself poorly assessed. This is especially challenging from the egocentric perspective, in which the body is only partially visible and motion must be inferred from occluded and temporally distributed cues. We introduce SOMA, a benchmark for fine-grained body-motion understanding from egocentric video, comprising 1,632 human-verified questions across three capability axes: body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reasoning. We evaluate 37 leading closed-source, open-source, and specialized egocentric MLLMs, complemented by an extensive human evaluation. We find that humans also find this task difficult from video alone (68.5% accuracy), yet clearly outperform the strongest MLLM (Qwen3.6-27B), which reaches 50.0% zero-shot accuracy. Our error analysis shows that MLLMs often misread the wearer's own body, misjudge events in time, and are prone to biases such as favoring the right hand or under-counting repetitions. To narrow the gap to human performance and support further progress, we introduce a training dataset of aligned video, body motion, and language supervision, and a multimodal baseline that jointly learns from these modalities. By identifying common failure modes and missing capabilities in current MLLMs, we hope SOMA will inspire future research on body-motion understanding and multimodal reasoning. Full benchmark, training data, and code will be released at: https://cnai.epfl.ch/soma

AI.tldr: 提出SOMA基准，评估MLLM对第一人称视频中细粒度身体运动的理解，发现最强模型仅50%远低于人类的68.5%。
AI.motivation: 当前MLLM评测多聚焦物体、场景与粗粒度动作，缺乏对身体本身推理能力的评估；第一人称视角下身体部分可见、运动需从遮挡与时序线索推断，挑战更大。
AI.method: 构建SOMA基准，含1632个人工验证问题，覆盖身体构型、运动动力学、时序推理三大能力轴；评测37个闭源/开源/专用第一人称MLLM并辅以人工评估；进行误差分析；提供对齐视频-身体运动-语言的训练数据及多模态联合学习基线。
AI.result: 人类仅凭视频准确率68.5%，明显优于最强MLLM（Qwen3.6-27B零样本50.0%）；MLLM常见错误为误读佩戴者自身身体、时序判断错误，以及偏好右手、低估重复次数等偏差。
AI.conclusion: 揭示当前MLLM在身体运动理解上的失败模式与能力缺失，通过训练数据与基线缩小与人类差距，推动后续研究。

title: OA-RAG: Ontology-based Agentic RAG for Faithful LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) perform well across many real-world tasks but remain prone to hallucination, limiting their reliability in domains such as biomedicine and healthcare, where answers must be grounded in established knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates this problem by incorporating external information, but often overlooks logical relationships and relies heavily on the LLM's own reasoning, which can compromise answer faithfulness. We propose OA-RAG, an agent that integrates formal reasoning with LLM reasoning, drawing on both the logical structure and informal annotations of domain ontologies. For each answer, OA-RAG reports the ontology observations used as evidence and a model-assessed grounding level (entailed, supported, related, or unrelated) that characterises the strength of that evidence. Across benchmarks derived from three large-scale ontologies and six real-world medical question-answering tasks, OA-RAG achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated ontology-fine-tuned and popular RAG methods, with particularly strong results on reasoning-intensive tasks. The reported grounding levels also offer a useful indication of answer reliability, with stronger grounding generally associated with higher accuracy. Finally, our results demonstrate the value of ontologies as knowledge sources: OA-RAG is competitive with, and sometimes outperforms, domain-specific RAG systems that draw on sources such as textbooks.

AI.tldr: OA-RAG 将形式化推理与 LLM 推理结合，利用本体库的逻辑结构与非形式化注释，为医学问答生成带证据与接地等级的可信答案。
AI.motivation: LLM 易产生幻觉，在生物医学和医疗等需以既有知识为依据的领域可靠性不足。RAG 虽引入外部信息，但常忽略逻辑关系、过度依赖 LLM 自身推理，导致答案忠实性受损。
AI.method: 提出 OA-RAG 智能体：融合形式推理与 LLM 推理，同时利用领域本体的逻辑结构与非形式化注释；对每个答案报告所用本体观察作为证据，并给出模型评估的接地等级（entailed、supported、related、unrelated）以刻画证据强度。
AI.result: 在源自三个大规模本体和六个真实医疗问答任务的基准上，OA-RAG 在评估的本体微调方法与主流 RAG 方法中整体表现最佳，推理密集型任务尤为突出；接地等级可指示答案可靠性，接地越强准确率通常越高；与使用教科书等领域特定来源的 RAG 系统相比具有竞争力，有时更优。
AI.conclusion: OA-RAG 证明了本体作为知识来源的价值，形式推理与 LLM 推理结合可提升医学问答的忠实性与可靠性。

title: ASNER: Software Architecture Recovery with Adaptive Semantic Neighborhoods and Evidence-Grounded Refinement
summary: Automated software architecture recovery provides architectural context for software engineering and repository-level LLM agents. Existing methods combine structural and semantic signals, but functional relatedness does not necessarily imply shared architectural responsibility. Fixed thresholds or Top-K neighborhoods also ignore repository scale and local similarity distributions, introducing errors that propagate through clustering. Unconstrained LLM refinement may further alter correct assignments without sufficient evidence. We propose ASNER (Adaptive Semantic Neighborhoods and Evidence-Grounded Refinement for Software Architecture Recovery), based on responsibility-aware, project-adaptive relation modeling and evidence-grounded boundary verification. ASNER derives structured file responsibilities with an LLM, constructs semantic neighborhoods that adapt to repository scale and local similarity distributions, and augments a static dependency graph with selected semantic relations and weak directory cues. Community detection recovers the component backbone. A Responsibility-Ownership-Aware (ROA) Agent then examines uncertain boundary files using project-level responsibilities and traceable code evidence, changing assignments only when supported. Experiments on 12 open-source projects spanning C, C++, Java, and Python show that ASNER achieves the best macro-average on all five metrics on the common benchmark, improving ARI and c2c@66 over GAER-GAT by 19.5% and 32.9%, respectively. A downstream evaluation shows that ASNER-guided LocAgent improves file-, module-, and function-level code localization, demonstrating the value of its architectural context for repository-level software engineering tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 ASNER，用自适应语义邻域和证据驱动精化改进软件架构恢复，在12个开源项目上五项指标最优。
AI.motivation: 现有架构恢复方法混淆功能相关性与架构职责；固定阈值/Top-K 忽略仓库规模和局部相似度分布，误差在聚类中传播；无约束 LLM 精化缺乏证据可能改坏正确结果。
AI.method: 1) LLM 提取结构化文件职责；2) 构建随仓库规模与局部相似度分布自适应的语义邻域；3) 在静态依赖图上融合筛选后的语义关系与弱目录线索；4) 社区检测得到组件骨架；5) ROA Agent 基于项目级职责与可追溯代码证据审查边界文件，仅在证据支持时改派。
AI.result: 12个 C/C++/Java/Python 开源项目上，通用基准五项指标宏平均均最优；ARI 和 c2c@66 较 GAER-GAT 分别提升 19.5% 和 32.9%；下游实验显示 ASNER 引导的 LocAgent 在文件、模块、函数级代码定位上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 以职责感知、项目自适应的关系建模与证据约束的边界验证，可有效提升架构恢复质量，并为仓库级软件工程任务提供有价值的架构上下文。

title: Structured Maps for Landmark-Based Route Instructions with LLMs
summary: To generate landmark-based route instructions, models must understand both map geometry and human landmark preferences. Although large language models (LLMs) show great abilities in language tasks, the best way to structure map data for these models is not yet established. This paper proposes a structured text representation for landmark selection tasks in route navigation, utilizing SVG format to encode spatial features. The structured text maintains a geometric connection with rendered map images, allowing language models to directly access spatial and semantic data. Using a new dataset created from human-written route descriptions and OpenStreetMap data, we evaluate models on two tasks: landmark selection at turns and around destinations. Experiments with five LLMs show that the proposed structured text input performs as well as or better than image-based PNG inputs. In addition, task-specific fine-tuning enables smaller local LLMs to effectively leverage map layouts to achieve high selection accuracy. These results demonstrate that structured text is an efficient and lightweight interface for spatial reasoning in human-oriented navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用 SVG 格式的结构化文本表示地图数据，用于路径导航中的地标选择任务，实验表明其效果不逊于甚至优于 PNG 图像输入，且任务微调后小型本地 LLM 也能高效利用地图布局。
AI.motivation: 生成基于地标的路径指令需要模型同时理解地图几何与人类地标偏好，但如何为 LLM 组织地图数据尚未有定论。
AI.method: 提出以 SVG 编码空间特征的结构化文本表示，与渲染图像保持几何对应，使 LLM 可直接访问空间与语义信息；并基于人类路线描述与 OpenStreetMap 构建新数据集，在转角地标选择和目的地周边地标选择两个任务上评估五个 LLM。
AI.result: 结构化文本输入的表现与基于 PNG 图像输入相当或更优；任务特定微调使较小的本地 LLM 能有效利用地图布局，达到较高的选择准确率。
AI.conclusion: 结构化文本是面向人类导航的空间推理中一种高效、轻量的接口。

title: Lossless Compression of Proximity Graph Indexes for Efficient Approximate Nearest Neighbors Search
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, Accepted at CIKM 2026. Code: https://github.com/TusKANNy/kannolo. Reproducibility: https://github.com/tusKANNy/papers_reproducibility/tree/main/cikm2026
summary: Graph-based Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) indexes, such as HNSW, are the backbone of modern vector search. However, their massive memory footprint creates a severe infrastructure bottleneck. While vector quantization is widely adopted to reduce the memory required to store data vectors, the graph's edge structure increasingly dominates total memory usage. Compressing these adjacency lists for online search presents a critical system challenge: because decompression occurs during query processing, i.e., while navigating the graph, memory savings cannot come at the expense of query latency. In this paper, we present a compression technique explicitly tailored for live HNSW routing. By applying offline graph permutations to artificially induce structural locality, we enable the use of SIMD-accelerated integer compressors, such as Stream VByte, for rapid on-the-fly decompression. Evaluated across diverse real-world workloads, we significantly outperform the current state of the art in both compression ratio and query latency. Our experimental results show that we achieve compression ratios up to 52.7% with negligible penalties in latency compared to the uncompressed baseline. Furthermore, our technique has been effectively deployed in production at eBay, achieving up to 44.3% reduction in edge storage with no degradation in query latency.

AI.tldr: 针对HNSW等图索引中邻接表内存占用过大的瓶颈，提出一种面向在线查询路由的边结构压缩技术：通过离线图置换诱导结构局部性，配合SIMD加速的整数压缩器（如Stream VByte）实现快速逐跳解压，在几乎不增加查询延迟的前提下大幅降低内存。
AI.motivation: 基于图的ANN索引（HNSW）是现代向量检索的骨干，但其内存占用巨大，成为基础设施瓶颈。向量量化已能压缩数据向量，但图的边结构（邻接表）日益成为内存占用的主导。直接压缩邻接表的难点在于：解压发生在查询处理过程中（即图导航时），因此内存节省不能以查询延迟为代价。
AI.method: 提出一种专为在线HNSW路由设计的压缩技术：对图进行离线置换（graph permutation），人为诱导边ID的结构局部性，从而使SIMD加速的整数压缩器（如Stream VByte）能够用于查询时的快速即时解压。
AI.result: 在多种真实工作负载上评估，在压缩率和查询延迟两方面均显著优于当前最先进方法；相比未压缩基线，压缩率最高达52.7%，延迟代价可忽略。该技术已在eBay生产环境部署，边存储减少最高44.3%，查询延迟无退化。
AI.conclusion: 通过离线重排边结构并结合SIMD整数压缩，可在保持在线查询延迟不变的前提下有效压缩图索引的邻接表内存，具备实际生产可行性。

title: ORBITAL: Optimization of Robust Brain--Computer Inference Through Architecture-Aware Low-Precision Compression
comment: Submitted to IEEE ISCAS 2027 for Review
summary: Compact electroencephalography (EEG) decoders enable embedded brain--computer interfaces (BCIs), but compression can alter adversarial robustness without proportional hardware savings. We present ORBITAL, a robustness-constrained framework combining hardware-realizable structured compression, recovery-aware operating-point selection, multi-attack evaluation, and native edge validation. Across nine subjects and three seeds on BCI Competition IV-2a, S25-TRADES achieves the highest observed mean true-union robustness among compressed EEGNet models (23.06% vs 21.27% for standard Full), with 26.27% fewer parameters and 25.10% fewer MACs. Matched controls identify TRADES as the main source of robustness recovery, improving S25 union accuracy by 6.74 percentage points over clean recovery (p=0.0039), while per-example analysis reveals boundary redistribution rather than uniform margin expansion. On Jetson Orin Nano, FP16 compression reduces board energy by up to 16.20% and latency by 8.00%. Despite 99.3% prediction agreement, native INT8 Q/DQ incurs about twice the FP16 latency and energy, demonstrating the need for joint robustness and hardware-aware optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出ORBITAL框架，结合结构化压缩、恢复感知选点、多攻击评测与边缘部署验证，在EEG解码器中实现鲁棒性与硬件的联合优化。
AI.motivation: 紧凑EEG解码器用于嵌入式BCI，但压缩可能改变对抗鲁棒性，却未必带来成比例的硬件收益，需联合考虑鲁棒性与硬件效率。
AI.method: ORBITAL框架包含四部分：硬件可实现的结构化压缩、恢复感知的工作点选择、多攻击评估、原生边缘设备验证；采用S25-TRADES方案并设置匹配对照实验。
AI.result: 在BCI Competition IV-2a（9名被试、3个随机种子）上，S25-TRADES平均真并集鲁棒性达23.06%（Full为21.27%），参数减少26.27%、MACs减少25.10%；TRADES使并集准确率较干净恢复提升6.74个百分点（p=0.0039），呈边界重分布而非统一间隔扩大；Jetson Orin Nano上FP16降低能耗16.20%、时延8.00%；INT8 Q/DQ虽预测一致率99.3%，但时延与能耗约为FP16的两倍。
AI.conclusion: 压缩与对抗训练可协同提升EEG解码器鲁棒性，但需与硬件感知优化联合设计；量化格式选择对边缘效率影响显著。

title: Jaxnasium: Embracing PyTrees For Any-Agent, Cross-Suite Reinforcement Learning
summary: Hardware-accelerated reinforcement learning in JAX has gained rapid popularity in recent years and has proven to be a successful method of scaling online reinforcement learning. The resulting ecosystem, however, is fragmented: environment suites define their own interfaces, and algorithm implementations are typically written for a single suite, a single type of space, and either JAX-native or host-based environments. Here we present Jaxnasium, a library for JAX-based reinforcement learning, aiming to make the field more accessible. Jaxnasium represents observation and action spaces as PyTrees, and uses this structure to build networks and support multi-agent processing. Through this, its near-single-file implementations run on discrete, continuous, image, and composite spaces, as well as in multi-agent environments, without any changes to the algorithm code. The same files serve as readable, research-friendly algorithms, as well as importable algorithms for more applied workloads. Through a minimal Gymnasium-style interface and wrappers for 11 suites, over 300 environments are available on which a small PPO implementation with default hyperparameters is able to run. Additionally, through a simple wrapper, we can run Gymnasium and EnvPool environments with the same algorithm and training loop, with no performance loss compared to architectures specifically built for training JAX algorithms on host-based environments. Jaxnasium further provides tools for multi-seed evaluation, hyperparameter sweeps, and project scaffolding. Jaxnasium is open-sourced at https://github.com/ponseko/jaxnasium

AI.tldr: Jaxnasium 是一个基于 JAX 的强化学习库，用 PyTree 统一表示观测/动作空间，使同一份近乎单文件的算法实现可无改动地运行于离散、连续、图像、复合及多智能体环境，并兼容 JAX 原生与宿主端（Gymnasium/EnvPool）环境。
AI.motivation: JAX 加速的在线强化学习生态目前较为碎片化：各环境套件自定义接口，算法实现通常只针对单一套件、单一空间类型，且区分 JAX 原生与宿主端环境，导致复用困难、门槛较高。
AI.method: 将观测与动作空间建模为 PyTrees，并以此结构构建网络与支持多智能体处理；提供最小化的 Gymnasium 风格接口与 11 个套件的封装（300+ 环境）；通过简单 wrapper 让同一算法与训练循环运行 Gymnasium 和 EnvPool 环境；另提供多种子评估、超参扫描与项目脚手架工具。
AI.result: 同一份算法代码无需修改即可覆盖多种空间类型与多智能体场景；小规模默认超参的 PPO 实现可运行于 300+ 环境；在宿主端环境上运行不掉性能，与专为此设计的架构相当。
AI.conclusion: Jaxnasium 通过 PyTree 抽象与统一接口缓解了 JAX 强化学习生态的碎片化，使算法代码兼具可读的研究价值与应用可导入性，并已开源。

title: Executable Archaeology of Programs That Model Programming: Reanimating the Heuristic Compiler (1961) and KBEmacs (1984)
summary: Early AI programs were often also theories of how people think, and programs that wrote programs were, in part, theories of how people program. Here we report on the reanimation of two such programs that offer two seemingly different theories of programming and were developed for quite different purposes. The first, Herbert Simon's Heuristic Compiler (1961), was an experimental model of programming as problem-solving, applying the means-ends analysis methods of the General Problem Solver to investigate the nature of the programming task. The second, KBEmacs (1984), was a working prototype of an intelligent programming assistant developed by MIT's Programmer's Apprentice project, built on the view that expert programmers recognize and combine familiar patterns, or "cliches." It let a programmer build up programs by combining cliches through a stylized English command language. We approach both through the methodology of Executable Archaeology, the study of historical computational systems by running their original code, a process we call "reanimation." Our reanimation of the Heuristic Compiler reproduces the compiled code appearing in Simon's 1963 paper, and our reanimation of KBEmacs reproduces the SQRT sequence of its December 1984 self-test. Examined side by side, the two theories turn out to have much in common: the Heuristic Compiler also works by adapting existing routines, and Simon later argued that search alone requires a large body of programming knowledge. To highlight the reflexivity of this project, we deliberately used a modern AI-assisted programming tool, Anthropic's Claude Code (Opus 5.5), to carry out much of the detailed reanimation work, building on a significant base of existing software. The explicit, executable theories of programming that both systems embodied are largely absent from today's far more capable AI coding assistants.

AI.tldr: 论文通过"可执行考古"（Executable Archaeology）重新运行两个历史AI编程系统——Simon的Heuristic Compiler(1961)与KBEmacs(1984)，并借助现代AI辅助工具Claude Code完成复活工作，发现两者理论实则相通。
AI.motivation: 早期AI程序常兼具"人类思维理论"的性质，而会写程序的程序也隐含编程理论。作者希望以实际运行历史代码的方式检验这些理论，并反思当今强大的AI编程助手是否缺失了这类明确的、可执行的编程理论。
AI.method: 采用"可执行考古"方法，通过"复活"（reanimation）运行原始代码：重跑Heuristic Compiler与KBEmacs，并有意使用Anthropic Claude Code(Opus 5.5)在既有软件基础上完成大量细节性复活工作，以体现项目的反身性。
AI.result: Heuristic Compiler的复活复现了Simon 1963年论文中的编译代码；KBEmacs的复活复现了其1984年12月自测的SQRT序列。两者并置比较显示理论高度相似：Heuristic Compiler同样通过改编已有例程工作，Simon后来也主张单纯搜索需要大量编程知识。
AI.conclusion: 两个系统所体现的显式、可执行的编程理论，在当今能力更强却缺乏此类理论基础的AI编程助手中基本缺席；可执行考古是研究历史计算系统的有效方法。

title: A lightweight C Code Generator for Heterogeneous TinyML Systems
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, accepted by Workshop on Compilers, Deployment, and Tooling for AI (CODAI'25)
summary: Over the past decade, the significant advancements in artificial intelligence have been closely tied to increasingly sophisticated training frameworks and steadily powerful computing hardware. However, the entire ecosystem remains fragmented. On one hand, models are represented with frameworks dependent formats, while on the other hand, new tailored hardware for accelerating novel operators has continued to emerge. To effectively diminish the transfer costs from training to inference, we propose a lightweight C code generator designed for bare-metal heterogeneous systems that incorporate domain-specific accelerators. Through a comprehensive case study on a RISC-V based radar DSP, we demonstrate that by employing an accelerator with ahead-of-time optimizations like weight tuning and bias fusion, our approach achieves a 2.3 times improvement in inference speed and a 20% reduction in binary size compared to the microTVM flow registered with the same accelerator, thus offering another compelling choice for resource-constrained edge devices. The code is open-sourced in Gitlab.

AI.tldr: 提出面向裸机异构系统（含领域专用加速器）的轻量级C代码生成器，降低从训练到推理的迁移成本，在RISC-V雷达DSP上实现推理速度提升2.3倍、二进制体积减少20%。
AI.motivation: AI训练框架与硬件日益复杂，但整个生态高度碎片化：模型以框架依赖的格式表示，同时加速新算子的专用硬件不断涌现，导致从训练到推理的迁移成本高昂，资源受限的边端设备尤其需要轻量方案。
AI.method: 设计一个轻量级C代码生成器，面向集成了领域专用加速器的裸机异构系统；在基于RISC-V的雷达DSP上进行案例研究，采用提前（ahead-of-time）优化，如权重调优（weight tuning）与偏置融合（bias fusion）的加速器方案。
AI.result: 与注册了同一加速器的microTVM流程相比，推理速度提升2.3倍，二进制体积减少20%。代码已在GitLab开源。
AI.conclusion: 该C代码生成器为资源受限的边缘设备提供了除microTVM外的另一有吸引力的选择，能够有效降低训练到推理的迁移代价。

title: Japanese Discourse Structure Analysis Based on Segmented Discourse Representation Theory Using LLMs
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the Asia-Pacific Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics: Student Research Workshop (AACL-SRW 2026)
summary: Discourse parsing based on Segmented Discourse Representation Theory (SDRT) is crucial for capturing the structural dynamics of dialogues. However, most prior research focuses on English, and its effectiveness for Japanese remains unclear owing to the lack of Japanese SDRT corpora. To address this issue, we construct Japanese SDRT corpora by translating existing English SDRT corpora using an LLM. Through a comparative evaluation of prompt-based and fine-tuned LLMs, we show that the models achieve comparable performance between English and Japanese, suggesting the cross-lingual applicability of SDRT-based discourse parsing. In order to investigate why the English and Japanese parsers achieve similar performance, we conduct ablation analyses on discourse markers and contextual inputs. Our results reveal that most of the Japanese discourse markers we examined have little impact, and the models' predictions depend heavily on contextual discourse relations rather than on the content of the context clauses. This structural reliance might explain the comparable performance despite the substantial typological differences between English and Japanese.

AI.tldr: 该文用LLM翻译构建日语SDRT语料库，比较提示与微调模型后发现英日话语解析性能相当，并通过消融实验说明模型主要依赖语境中的话语关系结构而非话语标记或具体内容。
AI.motivation: 基于SDRT的话语解析对刻画对话结构很重要，但已有研究多集中于英语；由于缺乏日语SDRT语料库，其在日语上的有效性尚不明确。
AI.method: 利用LLM翻译现有英语SDRT语料以构建日语SDRT语料；对比提示式与微调式LLM的表现；并针对话语标记与上下文输入开展消融分析，探究英日性能相近的原因。
AI.result: 英日模型表现相当，说明SDRT话语解析具有跨语言适用性；大多数被考察的日语话语标记影响很小，模型预测更依赖上下文中的话语关系结构，而非上下文子句的具体内容。
AI.conclusion: 话语解析模型的结构性依赖或可解释为何在英日类型学差异显著的情况下仍能取得相当性能。

title: AutoRSE: Evaluating LLM Agents as Recommendation Engineers for Self-Evolving Recommender Systems
summary: Recommender Systems Engineer Agents (RSE-Agents), which use LLM-based agents to autonomously improve recommendation algorithms, are emerging as a promising paradigm. However, their capabilities and limitations remain poorly understood due to the lack of a unified, standardized evaluation framework and systematic trajectory-level analysis. To address this gap, we introduce AutoRSE, an evaluation framework spanning six representative industrial-grade recommendation tasks, and conduct a large-scale empirical study of three frontier LLMs across three widely used agent harnesses. Our results show that RSE-Agents consistently enhance the performance of backbones on five of the six tasks, with an average relative improvement of 16.1%, indicating that they can already autonomously improve recommendation performance. However, trajectory-level analysis also reveals that current RSE-Agents function primarily as engineering optimizers rather than algorithmic improvers: their gains are largely driven by hyperparameter tuning, training strategies, and model ensembling, while genuine algorithmic innovations are rare. Since the largest gains in recommender systems often stem from algorithmic advances, this behavior underscores a fundamental limitation of current RSE-Agents. To probe this limitation, we perform idea-injection experiments and show that agents equipped with innovative ideas from frontier research or human experts achieve substantially larger improvements than those relying on self-generated ideas. These results suggest that idea generation is a central bottleneck of current RSE-Agents, highlights a key direction for the future recommendation system research. Our implementation is publicly available on GitHub: https://github.com/Ray-Tiann/AutoRSE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AutoRSE 评测框架，首次系统评估基于 LLM 的推荐系统工程智能体（RSE-Agents），发现其平均带来 16.1% 相对提升，但主要是工程优化而非算法创新，创意生成是核心瓶颈。
AI.motivation: RSE-Agents 作为新兴范式有望自主改进推荐算法，但缺乏统一的标准化评测框架与轨迹级系统分析，导致其能力边界与局限尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建覆盖六类工业级推荐任务的 AutoRSE 评测框架，对三种前沿 LLM × 三种主流智能体框架（harness）开展大规模实证研究，并进行轨迹级分析与"创意注入"实验。
AI.result: 在六个任务中五个上稳定提升骨干模型性能，平均相对提升 16.1%；但增益主要来自超参调优、训练策略与模型集成，真正的算法创新罕见；预注入前沿研究或人类专家创意后提升显著更大。
AI.conclusion: 当前 RSE-Agents 实为"工程优化者"而非"算法改进者"，创意生成是其主要瓶颈，指明了未来推荐系统研究的关键方向。

title: SpeeDiff: Scalable Pixel-Anchored End-to-End Latent Diffusion Model
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026. 29 pages, 17 figures, 14 tables
summary: We present Scalable Pixel-anchored End-to-end Diffusion (SpeeDiff), a latent diffusion method that jointly trains the VAE and the diffusion model from scratch. In principle, joint training allows the diffusion loss gradient to directly guide the VAE encoder, encouraging the formation of a generation-friendly latent space and potentially yielding faster convergence than the conventional two-stage approach with a pretrained frozen VAE. However, a naive end-to-end implementation severely degrades performance, as unrestricted backpropagation of the diffusion loss leads to latent space collapse. Our main technical contribution is a simple yet effective Tweedie Pixel Reconstruction (TPR) loss, which provides additional pixel-level feedback by decoding a predicted clean latent from an intermediate noisy state using Tweedie's formula, thereby alleviating collapse. Furthermore, our method enables jointly scaling a fully transformer-based architecture and enhances representation alignment within the end-to-end framework. Our SpeeDiff-XL model achieves over 140x and 61x faster training compared to Vanilla SiT and REPA, respectively, while attaining an FID of 1.50 without guidance on ImageNet 256x256 generation. With a more efficient 32x compressed VAE, our model further reaches an FID of 1.53 without guidance on ImageNet 512x512 generation.

AI.tldr: SpeeDiff提出联合训练VAE与扩散模型的端到端潜在扩散方法，用Tweedie像素重建损失解决潜空间坍缩，实现极快训练收敛。
AI.motivation: 常规两阶段方法使用冻结的预训练VAE，扩散损失的梯度无法指导VAE编码器，难以形成对生成友好的潜空间。联合训练理论上可加快收敛，但朴素端到端实现因扩散损失无约束反传导致潜空间坍缩、性能严重下降。
AI.method: 提出Tweedie Pixel Reconstruction (TPR) 损失：用Tweedie公式从中间噪声状态解码出预测的干净潜变量，再进行像素级重建，提供额外像素级反馈以缓解坍缩。方法还支持全Transformer架构的联合扩展，并在端到端框架内增强表征对齐。
AI.result: SpeeDiff-XL相比Vanilla SiT和REPA训练分别快140倍和61倍；ImageNet 256×256无引导生成FID达1.50；使用更高效的32倍压缩VAE时，ImageNet 512×512无引导生成FID达1.53。
AI.conclusion: TPR损失是简单有效的关键设计，使端到端联合训练从失效变为可行且高效，兼顾训练速度与生成质量，并可扩展到大规模Transformer架构。

title: How Much Does the Hint Matter? Scope Conditions for Hindsight Self-Distillation in Financial Reasoning
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26), Milan, Italy. Code and data: https://github.com/johnnyhyu/fin-sd
summary: Financial institutions operating under data-residency constraints are restricted to open-weight models small enough to locally host, which trail frontier systems on multi-step quantitative reasoning. On-policy distillation narrows such gaps by supervising a student on its own rollouts, but traditional OPD requires a strong external teacher, and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) conditions on a full reference solution. We ask how much of that signal is necessary. We present Fin-SD, a localized hindsight self-distillation recipe for multi-step reasoning. Given a problem the student fails, the student itself identifies the first incorrect reasoning step and writes a short critique of that step. We truncate the student's trajectory immediately before the error (aiming to obtain a correct prefix), condition a frozen copy of the student on the same prefix plus the hint, and distill that hint-conditioned teacher into the student over a short rollout under reverse KL. No external model contributes a gradient. We apply Fin-SD to GPT-OSS-20B on a custom multi-step financial reasoning benchmark that requires deriving formula inputs from realistic scenarios via accounting conventions. We find: (i) replacing the critique with a generic-feedback control matches Fin-SD's entire 3.03 pp accuracy gain over the base model on the FinanceReasoning Hard subset, suggesting the gain comes from where supervision is applied, not hint content; (ii) the model writing the hint does not need to be stronger than the model receiving it: hints from same-family GPT-OSS-120B, at roughly 6x the parameters, yield no materially greater benefits than self-written hints; and (iii) Fin-SD matches on-policy self-distillation from full reference solutions on accuracy while generating 9.5% fewer tokens. With Fin-SD, general reasoning on MMLU-Pro and a fourteen-metric compliance audit on FinTrust show no material regression.

AI.tldr: Fin-SD是一种面向多步金融推理的局部事后自蒸馏方法：学生模型自行定位首个错误步骤并写简短评注，截断错误前的正确前缀，用冻结的学生副本基于该前缀+提示做教师，在短rollout上以反向KL蒸馏。无需外部模型提供梯度。
AI.motivation: 数据驻留约束下金融机构只能本地部署小规模开源权重模型，其多步定量推理落后于前沿系统。传统OPD需要强外部教师，OPSD依赖完整参考答案，本文探究这一监督信号中究竟有多少是必需的。
AI.method: 对失败题目，由学生自身识别首个错误推理步并写短评注；在错误处截断轨迹以获得正确前缀；冻结学生副本以相同前缀加提示为条件构成教师；以反向KL在短rollout上蒸馏该提示条件教师到学生。另设通用反馈对照、同族大模型提示对照及与完整参考解OPSD对比。
AI.result: 在自定义多步金融推理基准（FinanceReasoning Hard子集）上，Fin-SD使GPT-OSS-20B准确率提升3.03 pp；用通用反馈替换评注可完全复现该增益；约6倍参数的GPT-OSS-120B所写提示无显著更优收益；与完整参考解OPSD准确率相当但生成token少9.5%；MMLU-Pro与FinTrust十四项合规审计无实质性回退。
