AI.conclusion: 增益主要来自监督应用的位置（错误前的正确前缀处）而非提示内容或教师强度；提示可由学生自身产生，无需更强模型或完整参考解，且更省token、不损通用能力与合规性。

title: WAKMan: Workload Aware KVCache Manager
comment: Work done during internship at Capital One
summary: Prefix caching enables a Large Language Model (LLM) servers to reuse the Key-Value (KV) states and accelerate prefill computation stage for requests that share a prefix with earlier prompts, thus reducing latency and serving cost. With limited memory resource, the KV cache eviction policy becomes a decisive factor in determining the overall benefits of prefix caching. Production traffic may have single-turn, multi-turn, agentic, or a mixture of any combination of these request types. Our findings indicate that agentic steps return within seconds and favor recency, while popular prompts and long conversations return after many other requests and favor frequency. Across 20 mixes, no single policy is always best: vLLM's default strategy LRU provides 12% higher cache hits as compared to the frequency-oriented S3FIFO on agentic-heavy mixes but trails it by up to 22% elsewhere, and even a single workload parameter can flip the winner even for any particular mix. We present WAKMan, a workload-aware KV cache manager that picks its eviction policy from live traffic without knowing request types or reading prompts. It improves hit rate over LRU by 5 percentage points on average, with the lowest mean and worst-case optimality gap of all policies.

AI.tldr: WAKMan：一种工作负载感知的 KV cache 管理器，根据实时流量动态选择驱逐策略，无需知道请求类型或读取 prompt，平均比 LRU 命中率高 5 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 前缀缓存的收益受限于内存，KV cache 驱逐策略是关键。生产流量混合单轮、多轮、agentic 等类型：agentic 步骤几秒内返回、偏好新近性(recency)，热门 prompt 和长对话偏好频率(frequency)。20 种混合负载下没有单一最优策略（LRU 在 agentic 混合上比 S3FIFO 高 12% 命中率，其他场景落后达 22%），甚至单个负载参数就能翻转结果。
AI.method: 提出 WAKMan，从实时流量中学习并选择驱逐策略，无需预先知道请求类型或读取 prompt 内容，动态自适应地切换/组合策略。
AI.result: 相比 LRU 平均命中率提升 5 个百分点；在所有策略中平均与最坏情况最优性差距（optimality gap）最小。
AI.conclusion: 在混合且动态变化的生产负载下，固定的驱逐策略难以通用，自适应的工作负载感知策略选择能显著提升前缀缓存收益。

title: Beyond QASecClaw: Agent Scaling, Verifier Feedback, and Evidence Reliability in Software Assurance
summary: Can additional specialist language-model contexts improve software assurance when deterministic tool evidence is already available? We study this question through five experiments spanning authored Java warning controls, OWASP Benchmark assessment, Defects4J test generation, SV-COMP assertion verdicts, and deliberately misleading evidence packages. The evaluated systems use Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, with a 1.5B sensitivity analysis, and complete 13,638 model requests. On eight related development warnings, increasing the context count from 1 to 50 increases token use 49-fold without improving unsafe clearance. On 160 OWASP cases, model configurations trade clearance against unresolved outcomes; the ten-context arm assesses only 96 cases. On 32 SV-COMP tasks, raw verifier feedback raises mean correct model verdicts from 12.7 to 22.0, but also raises incorrect verdicts from one to seven; a JBMC-plus-JVM validation baseline returns 26 correct verdicts and six unresolved outcomes. On two sets of 120 evidence packages, models reject 70-100% of applicable counterexamples, while construction-specific scope checks classify every package correctly. No target defect is discovered in three Defects4J bugs, one unsupported by the test adapter. These descriptive results support deterministic evidence admission for the tested settings, while exposing limits of verdict aggregation, feedback interpretation, and the available evaluation coverage.

AI.tldr: 论文通过五个实验考察：在已有确定性工具证据时，增加专用语言模型上下文能否提升软件保障。结果显示额外上下文大多不带来收益，甚至引入风险，支持“确定性证据准入”策略。
AI.motivation: 探讨在确定性工具证据（如静态分析、验证器输出）已经存在的情况下，额外的专家语言模型上下文是否真能改善软件保障效果，还是徒增成本与风险。
AI.method: 使用Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct（并做1.5B敏感性分析），共完成13,638次模型请求，设计五类实验：Java警告人工控制、OWASP Benchmark评估、Defects4J测试生成、SV-COMP断言判定、以及刻意误导的证据包。
AI.result: Java警告上，上下文从1增至50使token用量增49倍但未改善不安全清除；OWASP 160例中模型在“清除”与“未解决”间权衡，10上下文组仅评估96例；SV-COMP 32任务上验证器反馈将正确判定从12.7升至22.0，但错误判定也从1升至7，而JBMC+JVM基线得26正确、6未解决；两组各120个证据包中模型拒绝70-100%的适用反例，而基于构造的范围检查100%分类正确；Defects4J三个缺陷均未发现（其中一个测试适配器不支持）。
AI.conclusion: 在测试设定下，结果支持采用确定性证据准入而非依赖额外模型上下文；同时揭示了判定聚合、反馈解读及评估覆盖范围方面的局限。

title: A Quantitative Approach to Asch Conformity in Frontier Large Language Models
summary: The Asch conformity experiment has recently gained considerable attention as a way of measuring conformity in large language models (LLMs). While previous studies have focused on demonstrating conformity in LLMs, our work adds a further quantitative layer to this approach. Instead of sampling a frontier LLM on a suite of questions, our approach samples a single question repeatedly, leveraging the probabilistic nature of LLMs to produce a distribution of answers. In doing so, we can compare the distributions of answers before and after the model is presented with the manufactured consensus. Our experiments confirm that frontier LLMs do conform, reinforcing prior literature, and, through our distribution-to-distribution comparisons, provide additional quantitative data on the conditions that lead to conformity and the degree to which it occurs.

AI.tldr: 本文用重复采样单题目的方式，构建答案分布，比较施加人为共识前后的分布变化，从而定量刻画 LLM 的从众（Asch）现象。
AI.motivation: 已有研究多只证明 LLM 存在从众性，缺少量化层面；作者希望在方法上补充精确的定量分析。
AI.method: 不采用多题采样前沿模型，而是对单一问题重复采样，利用 LLM 的概率性得到答案分布；再在呈现“制造共识”后重新采样，进行分布对分布的对比。
AI.result: 实验确认前沿 LLM 确实会从众，印证了既有文献；分布对比进一步给出了从众发生的条件及其程度的定量数据。
AI.conclusion: 重复采样+分布比较可作为一种量化 LLM 从众性的有效方法，为理解从众条件与强度提供更细粒度证据。

title: TaskBridge: Technical Report for SIGIR 2026 eCommerce Challenge
comment: Technical Report on the First-Place Solution for eCommerce Challenge @ SIGIR 2026 eCom Workshop
summary: The SIGIR 2026 eCommerce Challenge Query Reformulation Task evaluates the reformulation of task-oriented queries into expressions suitable for product retrieval, followed by BM25-based retrieval. These queries often imply product needs through activity-level semantics, creating a lexical gap with catalog descriptions. Systems must preserve task intent while adapting the number of reformulations to the Automatic and Interactive protocols. We propose TaskBridge, a catalog-anchored framework comprising Catalog Semantic Anchoring, Unified Five-Candidate Rewriting, and Protocol-Aware Selection. It grounds queries in catalog vocabulary, generates five complementary reformulations, and selects one query for Automatic retrieval or up to four for Interactive retrieval using BM25 scores, query-product reranking, and weighted Jaccard overlap. The selected queries are independently executed using BM25 to produce results in the required six-column format. Experiments demonstrate improved retrieval effectiveness, with multiple complementary queries providing additional gains in the Interactive setting. TaskBridge achieved first place in the SIGIR 2026 eCommerce Challenge.

AI.tldr: TaskBridge 提出以商品目录为锚的查询改写框架，将任务型查询改写成适合商品检索的表达并接 BM25 检索，在 SIGIR 2026 eCommerce Challenge 查询改写任务中获第一名。
AI.motivation: 任务型查询通过活动级语义隐含商品需求，与商品目录描述之间存在词汇鸿沟；系统还需在保持任务意图的同时，按 Automatic 与 Interactive 两种协议调整改写条数。
AI.method: TaskBridge 包含三部分：目录语义锚定（把查询对齐到目录词汇）、统一的五候选改写（生成五个互补改写）、协议感知选择（用 BM25 分数、查询-商品重排和加权 Jaccard 重叠，Automatic 选 1 条、Interactive 最多选 4 条）；选中查询各自独立用 BM25 检索并按六列格式输出。
AI.result: 实验显示检索效果提升，Interactive 设置下多条互补查询带来额外增益；TaskBridge 在 SIGIR 2026 eCommerce Challenge 中获得第一名。
AI.conclusion: 以目录为锚的改写加协议感知的多查询选择是应对任务型查询词汇鸿沟的有效方案，多改写互补在交互式检索中尤为有益。

title: SO-101 Bench: Accessible Spatial Manipulation
summary: Low-cost arms such as the SO-101 have become the most common entry point to robot learning, yet no released policy performs spatially constrained, language-conditioned tasks on them out of the box, and existing SO-101 benchmarks run only on physical hardware with simple tasks and few held-out objects. We introduce SO-101 Bench, a simulated benchmark for language-conditioned spatial manipulation built on an Isaac Lab digital twin of a real SO-101 setup. It has four tasks scored as five families, 138 objects in seen, unseen-instance and unseen-class splits, 916 evaluation episodes with subsets for held-out appearances, rotate-to-fit planning and occlusion memory, and 3,629 simulated demonstrations on which every learned policy is fine-tuned under an equal compute budget. The twin ranks policies as the real robot does: five policies trained without real data, four VLAs and an LLM agent, keep their exact ranking when the same weights run on the physical arm in an unseen environment with unseen objects (Spearman rho = 1.00, MMRV = 0.000), although simulation overestimates success. Across nine VLAs and world-action models, the best learned policies score near 61%, with spatial placement, unseen object classes and rotate-to-fit planning remaining open. An LLM agent that writes code and hands grasping to a learned policy scores 83.2%, and an ablation shows that this lead comes from the choice of harness and the choice of language model.

AI.tldr: 提出 SO-101 Bench：基于 Isaac Lab 数字孪生的语言条件空间操作仿真基准，含 4 任务/5 家族、138 对象三种划分、916 评估回合、3629 演示；仿真与真机策略排名完全一致（ρ=1.00），最佳学习策略约 61%，LLM agent 达 83.2%。
AI.motivation: SO-101 等低成本机械臂已成为机器人学习最常见的入口，但尚无开箱即用、能在其上完成空间受限且语言条件任务的策略；现有 SO-101 基准仅在真实硬件上运行，任务简单、留出物体少，缺乏可复现的仿真评测平台。
AI.method: 构建真实 SO-101 装置的 Isaac Lab 数字孪生仿真基准；设四类任务按五个家族计分，138 个物体划分 seen / unseen-instance / unseen-class，共 916 个评估回合，含留出外观、旋转装配（rotate-to-fit）规划与遮挡记忆子集；提供 3629 条仿真演示，所有学习策略在等算力预算下微调；并做真机迁移验证（5 个未用真机数据的策略，4 个 VLA 加 1 个 LLM agent）与 harness/语言模型消融。
AI.result: 孪生能复现真机排序：同一权重在未见环境与未见物体上真机运行时，5 个策略排名完全保留（Spearman ρ=1.00，MMRV=0.000），但仿真高估成功率。九种 VLA 与世界动作模型中最佳学习策略约 61%；空间放置、未见类别、rotate-to-fit 规划仍为难点。写代码并将抓取交给学习策略的 LLM agent 达 83.2%，消融表明其优势来自 harness 与语言模型的选择。
AI.conclusion: SO-101 Bench 提供了可复现、任务与对象多样、与真机排名一致的仿真评测平台，为低成本机械臂上的语言条件空间操作确立了清晰基线，并指出空间推理类任务与 LLM-agent 架构是后续改进方向。

title: Instruction Capacity: Behavior and Degradation of Language Models under Controlled Load
summary: The quality with which language models follow instructions falls as the load grows, yet there is still no quantity that expresses the limit of a model in units of load with an uncertainty. We propose an instrument in which the load consists of rules that replace single-token words in a text without meaning: such an instruction is atomic, the rules are independent by the construction of the task, and the outcome of every application of a rule is determined by a computable reference answer. Every occurrence of a word to be replaced becomes a Bernoulli trial with a known position in the answer and a known rule number. The statistical model first measures the shape of the dependence of the probability of a right replacement on the text length, the word position, the replacement density, the number of rules and the rule number, then describes it by smooth laws and restores a reference level that does not depend on the choice of the coding. The model yields the instruction capacity - the number of rules held at a given share of right replacements - with an uncertainty. A measurement of GPT-4o mini (2958 requests, 642,430 trials) gave regular laws for every load factor and for the collapse of the answer; the instruction capacity was about 37-38 rules at a share of right replacements of 0.95, and about 18-19 rules at the full replacement density. The code of the instrument, the measurement data and the passport are open, and every number of the passport is recomputed from the published points. The passport of a model serves as the calibration of a future meter of the instruction load of prompts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种"指令负载"测量工具：把负载定义为"替换文本中单词"的规则，每条规则是可计算的伯努利试验；据此用统计模型给出模型的"指令容量"及其不确定度。对 GPT-4o mini（2958 次请求、642,430 次试验）测得其指令容量在 0.95 正确率下约为 37–38 条规则。
AI.motivation: 语言模型遵循指令的质量随负载增加而下降，但目前缺少一种能以"负载单位"表达模型极限并附带不确定度的量化指标，难以进行跨模型校准与比较。
AI.method: 构造负载=替换文本中无意义单字词的规则（指令原子化、规则间独立、结果有可计算参考答案）；每个待替换词的出现是一次位置与规则编号已知的伯努利试验。统计模型先刻画正确替换概率对文本长度、词位置、替换密度、规则数与规则编号的依赖形状，用平滑规律描述并恢复与编码无关的参考水平，从而得到"指令容量"（给定正确率下可承载的规则数）及不确定度。
AI.result: 对 GPT-4o mini 进行 2958 次请求、642,430 次试验的测量，每个负载因子与答案崩溃均呈现规律性法则；0.95 正确率下指令容量约 37–38 条规则，满替换密度下约 18–19 条规则。代码、数据与"护照"（passport）均开放，护照中每个数字可由公开数据点复算。
AI.conclusion: 模型的"护照"可作为未来提示词指令负载计量仪表的标定基础。

title: LoRA on a Budget: Function-Aware Post-Hoc Compression for Adapter Fleets
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a key mechanism for efficiently specializing foundation models into many task- and user-specific variants. Serving many LoRA adapters under a shared resource budget turns post-hoc compression into a two-level allocation problem: rank must be distributed across layers within each adapter and across adapters within the fleet. Although trained LoRAs contain substantial spectral redundancy, spectral reconstruction alone does not determine how much compression an adapter can functionally tolerate. We formulate fleet compression through a functional rank-distortion frontier for each adapter, followed by fleet-level minimax allocation under a shared rank budget. Given exact frontiers, this decomposition is equivalent to joint optimization over all layer ranks. We introduce Functional Rank Allocation (FRA), an unlabeled method for constructing practical frontiers. FRA measures isolated module truncations end to end, uses these measurements as an additive search surrogate solved by dynamic programming, remeasures every complete candidate, and takes the lower-risk envelope with a complementary spectral proposal before exact minimax allocation over the constructed frontiers. Across 78 adapters from three public fleets, FRA improves worst-case and tail utility over uniform spectral compression in constrained-budget regimes. Fixed-budget probes show that isolated costs rank candidates well, but their calibration shifts across proposal shapes; end-to-end verification and the spectral proposal therefore limit functional-search error.

AI.tldr: 提出FRA方法，将多LoRA适配器在共享rank预算下的压缩建模为功能性rank-失真前沿+车队级minimax分配，在78个适配器上优于均匀谱压缩。
AI.motivation: 已有大量LoRA适配器需要共享资源部署，压缩是双层分配问题（层内rank分配+适配器间rank分配）。但仅靠谱重构冗余无法判断适配器功能性可耐受的压缩程度，缺乏可靠的功能性rank-失真前沿来指导分配。
AI.method: 将车队压缩形式化为每个适配器的功能性rank-失真前沿，随后在共享rank预算下做车队级minimax分配；给定精确前沿时该分解等价于所有层rank的联合优化。FRA为无标签方法：端到端测量孤立模块截断；将其作为可加搜索代理，用动态规划求解；对每个完整候选重新测量；与互补的谱提案取低风险包络；最后在前沿上做精确minimax分配。
AI.result: 在三个公开车队的78个适配器上，FRA在受限预算下相比均匀谱压缩提升了最坏情况和尾部效用。固定预算探针显示孤立成本能较好地对候选排序，但其校准随提案形状漂移，因此端到端验证与谱提案能限制功能搜索误差。
AI.conclusion: 功能性前沿+minimax分配是有效且等价于联合优化的分解框架；FRA通过测量-代理-重测-包络流程实现无标签的实用前沿构造，在受限预算场景中提升鲁棒性效用。

title: Does More Thinking Pay Off? Reasoning Cost and Correctness of LLMs in Code Generation and Bug Fixing
summary: Many LLMs now emit an explicit reasoning trace before they write code, but benchmark results for code generation and bug fixing usually report correctness alone. It is therefore unclear how much the extra reasoning contributes relative to the tokens it consumes. We examine this question with 866 Python tasks drawn from HumanEval Pro, MBPP Pro, and BugsInPy under five model settings. We look at the accuracy gain and token overhead of reasoning, the behaviors that appear inside reasoning traces, and whether a shortened trace still leads to a correct solution. Turning reasoning on in Qwen3-32B over five runs improves mean pass@1 on HumanEval Pro from 71.1% to 76.5% and mean tests pass on BugsInPy from 3.5% to 7.9%. On MBPP Pro the improvement from 68.1% to 69.5% is not statistically significant, even though the model uses a median of over 2,000 thinking tokens per task. Across models, a longer median trace does not reliably mean higher accuracy. A qualitative analysis shows that traces mostly choose and check an implementation in code generation, while in bug fixing they mostly locate the fault and plan the repair. We then truncate stored traces offline and ask Qwen3-32B with reasoning off to produce a solution from what remains. Retaining the first half of a trace yields no statistically significant drop in correctness. Stopping when the trace becomes repetitive seldom triggers, and stopping once solution code first appears benefits some models but harms others. Neither rule beats plain fixed truncation. These results suggest that more reasoning is not always better and that studies should report reasoning cost alongside correctness.

AI.tldr: 论文用866个Python任务（HumanEval Pro、MBPP Pro、BugsInPy）在5种模型设置下考察代码生成与修复中显式推理轨迹的收益与代价，发现推理收益不稳定且与token开销不成正比；截断保留前一半轨迹不显著降低正确率，简单定长截断优于各类启发式停止规则。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在写代码前会输出显式推理轨迹，但基准只报告正确率，不报告推理消耗的token；因此无法判断"更多推理"是否真的值得其成本，需要同时量化准确性增益与token开销，并检验更短的推理是否仍能得出正确解。
AI.method: 在866个Python任务（HumanEval Pro、MBPP Pro、BugsInPy）上、5种模型设置下分析：推理带来的准确率增益与token开销、推理轨迹内部的行为模式、以及截断后的轨迹是否仍导向正确解。具体包括：Qwen3-32B五轮重复实验对比开启/关闭推理；跨模型比较轨迹中位长度与准确率的关系；对轨迹做定性分析；离线截断存储轨迹后让关闭推理的Qwen3-32B仅凭剩余内容作答，并比较"保留前一半""出现重复即停""首次出现解答代码即停"与固定截断。
AI.result: Qwen3-32B开启推理后，五轮均值HumanEval Pro的pass@1从71.1%升至76.5%，BugsInPy的tests pass从3.5%升至7.9%；MBPP Pro从68.1%升至69.5%，统计不显著，尽管每任务思考token中位数超2000。跨模型看，更长的中位轨迹并不稳定对应更高准确率。定性分析显示：代码生成中轨迹主要用于选择与检查实现，缺陷修复中主要用于定位错误与规划修复。截断实验中保留轨迹前半部分正确率无显著下降；"重复即停"很少触发；"解答代码首次出现即停"对部分模型有利、对另一些有害；两种启发式均未胜过简单定长截断。
AI.conclusion: 更多推理并不总是更好，推理收益随任务类型和模型而异，且存在大量token浪费；建议后续研究在报告正确率的同时也报告推理成本，并可采用简单定长截断作为可靠且更省的基线策略。

title: Specialization, Diversity, and Scaling in Child-Scale Language Models
summary: Modern language models are trained on far more language than children experience, but we know much less about learning from small, naturalistic datasets. We train small GPT-2 models on transcripts of speech with children from dense home recordings (BabyView) and on synthetic child-directed dialogue (TinyDialogues), varying the amount, source, and diversity of training data. Models trained on one child's language environment predict that environment substantially better than other children's environments. Much of this specialization is lexical and distributional: a simple 5-gram model reproduces the cross-child pattern (r=.91). Training on data from multiple children clearly improves prediction of pooled held-out language relative to training on a single child's input without a similarly clear improvement on grammatical benchmarks. Across data sizes, naturalistic and synthetic training inputs also produce different grammatical and lexical-semantic patterns, with important differences between grammatical phenomena. Together, these results show that small-data language learning depends not only on how much language a model sees, but on which environments it comes from and how well that input matches what the model is asked to predict.

AI.tldr: 该研究用小GPT-2模型在儿童语言环境数据（BabyView真实家庭录音、TinyDialogues合成对话）上训练，考察数据量、来源与多样性对语言学习的影响。结果显示：模型对特定儿童环境有高度特化（主要来自词汇与分布特性，5-gram即可复现，r=.91）；多儿童数据能更好预测合并留出语言，但对语法基准提升不明显；真实与合成数据在不同语法现象上表现各异。语言学习不仅取决于"看到多少"，更取决于"来自哪个环境"及输入与预测目标的匹配度。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型训练数据远超儿童经验，但学界对小规模、自然主义数据下的语言学习机制了解不足。论文旨在探究在小数据条件下，数据量、数据来源与多样性如何影响模型的学习效果，以及儿童式输入能否支撑语言习得。
AI.method: 训练小型GPT-2模型，使用两类儿童导向数据：(1) BabyView——密集家庭录音的儿童语音转写；(2) TinyDialogues——合成儿童导向对话。系统性地变化训练数据的数量、来源和多样性，并用5-gram基线模型及语法/词汇语义基准进行对比评估。
AI.result: (1) 在单个儿童语言环境上训练的模型对该环境的预测显著优于其他儿童环境，表现出特化；(2) 这种特化多为词汇和分布特性，简单5-gram模型即可复现跨儿童模式（r=.91）；(3) 多儿童训练明显改善对合并留出语言的预测，但对语法基准提升不清晰；(4) 不同数据规模下，真实与合成输入在语法和词汇语义上产生不同模式，且各语法现象间差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 小数据语言学习不仅取决于模型接触的语言量，还取决于语言来自哪些环境，以及输入与模型预测任务的匹配程度。数据来源与多样性同数据量一样关键。

title: Modeling Preference Dependencies with Directed Acyclic Graphs for Narrative-Driven Recommendation
summary: Narrative-driven recommendation allows users to express multifaceted needs through free-form text where stated preferences naturally qualify and condition one another. Existing methods typically treat narratives as flat keyword combinations or unconstrained generative queries, failing to capture how complex preferences hierarchically refine and contextualize each other. We propose the Preference Dependency Graph Framework (PDG-F), a narrative-driven recommendation framework centered on explicit preference dependencies. Specifically, PDG-A (PDG-Agent) first parses unstructured requests to organize user preferences and their mutual qualifications into a directed acyclic Preference Dependency Graph (PDG). Through this graph, candidate evidence from the open Web is acquired via directed path retrieval, and final recommendations are determined by topological path ranking. Comprehensive experiments across three diverse domains spanning English and Chinese contexts confirm that PDG-F consistently achieves superior recommendation performance over competitive baselines, open-domain retrieval agents, and frontier language models. Further diagnostic analyses show that our dependency-guided retrieval markedly raises the attainable candidate-pool ceiling, demonstrating the fundamental value of modeling preference dependencies in narrative-driven recommendation.

AI.tldr: 提出偏好依赖图框架PDG-F，用有向无环图显式建模叙事推荐中偏好间的层级依赖关系，并据此指导检索与排序。
AI.motivation: 现有叙事驱动推荐把自由文本当作扁平关键词组合或无约束生成查询，无法刻画复杂偏好之间如何层级化地修饰、限定与语境化。
AI.method: PDG-Agent将非结构化请求解析为偏好及其相互限定关系，构成有向无环的偏好依赖图（PDG）；通过有向路径检索从开放网络获取候选证据，再以拓扑路径排序确定最终推荐。
AI.result: 在英中两种语言、三个不同领域的实验中，PDG-F稳定优于竞争基线、开放域检索智能体及前沿大模型；诊断分析显示依赖引导检索显著提升了候选池上限。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模偏好依赖对叙事驱动推荐具有根本性价值，依赖引导检索能扩大可达候选空间，从而带来一致性能提升。

title: FORESEE-MS: Toward Prospective Spatial Forecasting of Future Multiple Sclerosis Lesions from Baseline FLAIR MRI
summary: Traditional multiple sclerosis (MS) image analysis has primarily focused on retrospectively detecting and segmenting lesions. This study investigates whether baseline FLAIR MRI can identify regions at risk for future lesion formation beyond population-level spatial patterns. We introduce FORESEE-MS, an evaluation protocol that uses a fold-specific population-prior atlas as a baseline and assesses predictions using pooled voxel-level discrimination (AUROC and AUPRC) and within-patient lesion localization (Recall@Top-K%), with patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals. We evaluated five deep learning models (3D U-Net, Attn+ResBlock+VAE, ViT, and two SwinUNETR variants) using 5-fold cross-validation on 39 subjects from the MSSEG-2 dataset. The atlas achieved the highest pooled voxel-level AUROC and AUPRC, with no deep learning model reliably outperforming it on either metric. However, the 3D U-Net and Attn+ResBlock+VAE achieved higher mean voxel-level within-patient Recall@Top-K% than the atlas at all evaluated thresholds, although most paired confidence intervals for the differences included zero. These findings suggest that baseline FLAIR may contain patient-specific predictive information, but in this small cohort, it remains uncertain whether this information improves lesion forecasting beyond a population-prior atlas.

AI.tldr: 研究提出FORESEE-MS评估协议，检验基线FLAIR MRI能否预测未来MS病灶形成。结果：群体先验图谱在池化体素级AUROC/AUPRC上最高，深度学习模型未能可靠超越；但3D U-Net等在患者内Recall@Top-K%上更高，多数置信区间含零，结论不确定。
AI.motivation: 传统MS影像分析多为回顾性病灶检测与分割，本研究想探究基线FLAIR是否能识别超出群体空间模式之外的、未来病灶形成的高风险区域。
AI.method: 提出FORESEE-MS评估协议：以折特异性的群体先验图谱为基线，用池化体素级判别（AUROC、AUPRC）和患者内病灶定位（Recall@Top-K%）评价，并采用患者级bootstrap置信区间。在MSSEG-2数据集39名受试者上5折交叉验证，比较五种深度学习模型（3D U-Net、Attn+ResBlock+VAE、ViT及两种SwinUNETR变体）。
AI.result: 群体先验图谱取得最高的池化体素级AUROC与AUPRC，无深度学习模型能在两项指标上可靠超越；但3D U-Net与Attn+ResBlock+VAE在所有评估阈值下患者内Recall@Top-K%均值高于图谱，尽管多数配对置信区间包含零。
AI.conclusion: 基线FLAIR可能含患者特异性预测信息，但在该小样本队列中，尚不能确定其能否超越群体先验图谱改善病灶预测。

title: Minimax-Optimal Small-Loss Bounds for Online Linear Optimisation on $\ell_p$ Balls
summary: We study full-information online linear optimisation on the unit $\ell_p$ ball in $\mathbb{R}^d$, for fixed $2\le p<\infty$ and losses of dual norm at most one. Let $Δ_T$ denote the cumulative loss of the best fixed action above each round's minimum. A follow-the-regularised-leader (FTRL) algorithm attains, on every loss sequence and without knowing $T$ or $Δ_T$, regret $O_p(1+\min\{Δ_T^{1-1/p},\, d^{1/2-1/p}\sqrt{Δ_T}\})$. Matching lower bounds show that this rate is minimax for each fixed $p$, and its constant $(2+o(1))p/\log p$ is optimal as $p\to\infty$ among guarantees uniform in $d$ and $T$. The algorithm uses a bounded radial regulariser and switches at most once to its quadratic augmentation. On some paths where follow-the-leader (FTL) has regret one, its regret grows with $T$. A switching extension keeps the sharp constant and also guarantees $\mathrm{Reg}_T\le 2\,\mathrm{Reg}_T^{\mathrm{FTL}}$. For i.i.d. losses whose mean has no zero coordinates, we compute the exact $\log T$ coefficient of the expected regret, which separates FTL's variance term from the bias of the regulariser.

AI.tldr: 研究单位ℓ_p球上的全信息在线线性优化，提出带界径向正则化器的FTRL算法，在不依赖T或Δ_T的情况下达到O_p(1+min{Δ_T^{1-1/p}, d^{1/2-1/p}√Δ_T})的regret，并证明其极小极大最优性及常数最优。
AI.motivation: 针对单位ℓ_p球（2≤p<∞）上全信息在线线性优化，双范数损失≤1的设定，希望得到既适应Δ_T（最优固定动作累计损失超出每轮最小值的量）又不需预知T或Δ_T的regret界，弄清最优速率的常数结构。
AI.method: 采用follow-the-regularised-leader（FTRL）算法，使用有界径向正则化器，并在至多一次切换到其二次增广项；另给出切换扩展，使其同时保证Reg_T≤2·Reg_T^FTL。对i.i.d.损失（均值无零坐标）计算期望regret的精确log T系数。
AI.result: 算法对任意损失序列、无需知道T或Δ_T即达O_p(1+min{Δ_T^{1-1/p}, d^{1/2-1/p}√Δ_T})；匹配下界表明该速率对每个固定p是极小极大最优，常数(2+o(1))p/log p在p→∞时对关于d和T一致的保证是最优的。存在FTL regret为1而本算法regret随T增长的路径，切换扩展保持该常数并保证不超过FTL的两倍。
AI.conclusion: 给出了ℓ_p球上在线线性优化的最优自适应regret刻划，明确了常数阶及FTL与正则化的差异，并通过i.i.d.情形的log T系数分离了FTL的方差项与正则化器的偏差。

title: MAREval: A Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating Natural Language Recommendation Explanations
summary: Evaluating natural language explanations in recommender systems is essential for fostering user trust, transparency, and engagement. However, existing evaluation approaches like human evaluations, while accurate, are resource-intensive and impractical at the scale required by modern recommendation platforms. Also, automated methods using single-agent LLMs suffer from prompt sensitivity and inconsistent outputs. To address these challenges, we propose MAREval, a structured multi-agent framework for evaluating recommendation explanations using large language models. MAREval orchestrates (i) a planner agent that uses a novel Chain of Debate (CoD) prompting strategy to coordinate agent roles and enforce logically consistent evaluation plans; (ii) a moderator agent that regulates discussions by mitigating prompt drift; and (iii) an arbitrator agent that aggregates outputs from multiple evaluation rounds and (iv) a Monte Carlo sampling method, improving robustness and alignment with human judgment. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on both public (TopicalChat) and proprietary recommendation datasets, demonstrating that MAREval outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Comprehensive experiments on a public benchmark and a proprietary e-commerce dataset show that MAREval improves alignment with human judgments over strong singleand multi-agent baselines. Stability analyses indicate substantially lower variability across repeated trials. In a large human-annotation gate, MAREval meets production quality thresholds where prior evaluators fall short, and online A/B testing demonstrates statistically significant improvements in engagement and revenue metrics. These results establish MAREval as a scalable and reliable solution for human-aligned evaluation of recommendation explanations in real-world systems

AI.tldr: MAREval：用多智能体LLM框架（规划者+主持人+仲裁者+Monte Carlo采样）评估推荐解释，在公开与电商数据集上对齐人类判断更优、稳定性更高，并通过在线A/B测试验证业务收益。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统自然语言解释的评估对用户信任与透明度至关重要，但人工评估成本高、难以规模化；单智能体LLM自动评估存在提示敏感、输出不一致问题。
AI.method: 提出MAREval多智能体框架：1）planner智能体采用Chain of Debate (CoD)提示协调各角色并保证评估计划逻辑一致；2）moderator智能体缓解讨论中的prompt drift；3）arbitrator智能体聚合多轮评估输出；4）Monte Carlo采样提升鲁棒性与与人类判断的对齐。
AI.result: 在TopicalChat公开数据集与专有电商数据集上优于强单/多智能体基线；重复试验方差显著更低；人工标注门控达到生产质量阈值（此前评估器未达标）；在线A/B测试在参与度与收入指标上有统计显著提升。
AI.conclusion: MAREval是可用于真实系统、可扩展且可靠的人类对齐推荐解释评估方案。

title: Toward Circuit-Aware Mutation Testing for Quantum Programs: Exact Visibility and Execution Planning
summary: Mutation testing assesses test suites by introducing program changes and checking whether tests detect them. In quantum programs, a surviving mutant may leave program behavior unchanged, produce a change hidden by the chosen input or measurement, or remain undetected because statistical evidence is insufficient. We develop a circuit-aware framework to distinguish these causes and guide execution planning and test changes. The framework covers ideal, noiseless programs and mutations that replace one gate or subcircuit. The method traces how a mutation can affect measured outputs and combines established mathematical checks with statistical estimates. For supported cases, we establish conditions under which a test cannot reveal a mutation and exact formulas for its effect when the required state information is available. Under stated assumptions, we bound the mutation score while retaining surviving and unresolved mutants, and identify a restricted circuit family whose mutation effects admit efficient classical classification. The deliverables include a decision procedure, mathematical guarantees, worked examples of test changes and their implementation requirements, and a small-circuit reference implementation for differential expectation tests. These results help testers decide what to execute, what to change, and what remains unknown. The evidence is limited to proofs and executable examples under the ideal model.

AI.tldr: 提出一个电路感知的量子程序变异测试框架，区分变异体存活的三类原因（行为未变、被输入/测量掩盖、统计证据不足），并给出判定流程、数学保证与示例实现。
AI.motivation: 量子程序变异测试中，存活的变异体可能并非测试不足：有的变异根本不改变行为，有的效应被输入或测量隐藏，有的仅因统计证据不够而未被检出。需要区分这些原因以指导执行计划与测试改进。
AI.method: 面向理想无噪声程序与单门/子电路替换型变异，构建电路感知框架：追踪变异对被测输出的影响路径，结合已有数学判据与统计估计；对可支持情形给出测试无法揭示变异的条件，以及在可获得所需状态信息时的精确效应公式；在给定假设下给出保留存活与未决变异体的变异分数界，并识别可被高效经典分类的受限电路族。
AI.result: 交付判定过程、数学保证、测试修改及实现需求的实例分析，以及用于差分期望测试的小规模参考实现，帮助测试者决定执行什么、修改什么以及哪些仍属未知。
AI.conclusion: 框架在理想模型下由证明与可执行示例支撑，能结构化地解释变异体存活原因；证据限于理想模型，尚未覆盖噪声等实际因素。

title: Is Token Confidence Just Chain Length? A Signal-Processing Audit of Reasoning Traces
summary: Reasoning language models answer math problems by writing long chains of thought, and sampling many chains per problem and taking a majority vote raises accuracy at a large cost in generated text. A popular way to cut that cost scores each chain by the model's confidence in each token it writes, where a token is a word or part of a word. The method averages this confidence over a sliding window of 2048 tokens and keeps or stops chains based on the lowest average. We treat the confidence, recorded token by token, as a signal in the sense of audio or radio, and examine the method with standard signal-processing tools such as spectral analysis and statistical tests for detecting a sudden change. We sampled 16 chains for each of 500 problems from two math benchmarks with a small open reasoning model. The windowed-minimum score turns out to measure mostly how long a chain is. Ranking chains by length alone does as well as or better than the confidence score, and once length is accounted for the score carries no information about correctness. Signal processing explains why: the minimum of a longer stretch of a slowly drifting signal is lower by chance alone, and the confidence signal drifts slowly enough that this effect dominates. The spectrum does hold a small signal that length does not explain, since incorrect chains carry more rapid token-to-token fluctuation, but it is too weak to improve the vote. For stopping chains early, neither the sliding average nor a classical change detector beats the simpler choice of sampling fewer chains.

AI.tldr: 该论文用信号处理工具分析"置信度滑窗最小值"评分法，发现该分数主要反映链长而非正确性。
AI.motivation: 对推理模型多链采样取多数投票成本高，流行的做法是用token级置信度的滑窗最小值来剪枝/早停，但其有效性缺乏原理性检验。
AI.method: 将逐token置信度视为类音频/无线电信号，用频谱分析和突变检测等标准信号处理与统计检验方法分析；在两个数学基准上，用小型开源推理模型对500题各采样16条链。
AI.result: 滑窗最小分主要在度量链长；仅按长度排序的排名效果与置信度分相当或更好；控制长度后该分数对正确性无信息。原因是慢漂移信号更长窗口的极小值天然更低。频谱上确有长度不能解释的微弱信号（错误链token间波动更快），但不足以改善投票。早停上，滑窗平均与经典变点检测均不如直接少采样几条链。
AI.conclusion: 这类置信度评分的收益主要由链长混淆驱动；若要降本，简单减少采样链数比复杂置信度剪枝/变点检测更可靠。

title: LESSRec: Level-Specific History Modeling for Semantic ID-Based Recommendation
summary: Semantic ID-based recommendation represents each item as a sequence of semantic tokens obtained through residual quantization. This paradigm generates the next item's tokens autoregressively from coarse to fine, entailing each prediction attending to historical tokens at all semantic levels. However, our inference-time analysis reveals that historical tokens at the target-token's semantic level tend to be more informative, whereas other levels can introduce interference. Motivated by these findings, we propose LESSRec that separately encodes the historical token sequence at each semantic level and restricts attention over historical tokens to the sequence at the target token's semantic level during prediction. To complement these level-specific histories, LESSRec explicitly provides an item-level semantic sequence that represents each historical item's overall semantics in chronological order. The decoder accesses the level-aligned token sequence and the item-level semantic sequence through two separate cross-attention branches and fuses their contexts. We further introduce LESSRec+, which uses separate encoders for different semantic-level histories with the same total parameter count to reduce encoder computation. Extensive experiments across three public datasets and three tokenizers demonstrate the recommendation effectiveness of LESSRec and LESSRec+, with efficiency analyses highlighting the computational benefits of LESSRec+.

AI.tldr: 提出LESSRec，按语义层级分别编码历史token，预测时仅关注目标token所在层级的历史序列，并引入item级语义序列作为补充，通过双交叉注意力分支融合；LESSRec+用多编码器共享总参数进一步降低编码计算。
AI.motivation: 现有语义ID推荐用残差量化把item表示为多层级语义token序列并自回归由粗到细预测，预测时需关注所有语义层的历史token；但推理分析发现目标token所在层级的历史token信息量更大，其他层级反而带来干扰。
AI.method: LESSRec对每个语义层级的历史token序列分别编码，并将历史注意力限制在目标token对应层级的序列上；同时显式提供按时间顺序表示各历史item整体语义的item级语义序列；解码器通过两条独立交叉注意力分支分别访问层对齐token序列与item级语义序列并融合上下文。LESSRec+为不同层级历史使用独立编码器，在总参数量不变的前提下减少编码计算。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集和三种tokenizer上的大量实验验证了LESSRec与LESSRec+的推荐有效性；效率分析显示LESSRec+具有计算优势。
AI.conclusion: 逐层级限制历史注意力并辅以item级语义序列，可有效减少跨层级干扰并提升语义ID推荐性能；LESSRec+在同等参数规模下进一步提升了效率。

title: Beyond Update Counts: A Control Map for Evaluating Test-Time Model Updates
summary: Test-time updating lets a language model change persistent state after training---such as model weights, adapter parameters, or a memory module---before or while answering queries. Existing evaluations often compare systems using update count or frequency and performance measured immediately afterward. These summaries omit what is updated, where, when, and in what order. The same total can therefore hide an important difference: one system may answer after one update while another answers after two. We introduce the Control Map, an evaluation framework that records the committed updates preceding each scored answer and separately evaluates behavioral changes, immediate learning (acquisition), later recall (retention), preservation of unrelated behavior (locality), and performance in new settings. We prove when counts alone determine final state and show, under stated assumptions, how differences between pre-answer histories limit differences in average scores. Using ControlMap, our experiments reveal three insights. First, update scheduling matters: at a 760M-parameter checkpoint, 24 schedules with the same update count yield 19.7%--34.2% accuracy. Second, learning an edit does not guarantee that it lasts or remains contained: all six selected CounterFact LoRA settings learn the new information, while ROME retains edits at all 13 operating points but fails locality at each. Third, no editor performs best consistently across models, benchmarks, and tests. Evaluations should therefore report update histories and assess acquisition, retention, and locality separately.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ControlMap 评测框架，通过记录每次评分回答之前已提交的更新历史，分离评估行为变化、即时学习、后续回忆、无关行为保持与新场景表现，并证明仅用更新计数无法刻画系统差异。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时更新（权重、适配器、记忆模块）评测通常只报告更新次数/频率与更新后立即测得的性能，忽略了"更新了什么、在哪里、何时、以何顺序"发生。同样的更新总数可能掩盖关键差异：一个系统一次更新后作答，另一个两次更新后作答，因而需要更细粒度的评测。
AI.method: 构建 ControlMap 评测框架：记录每个被评分答案之前的已提交更新序列；分别评估行为变化、即时获取（acquisition）、后续回忆（retention）、无关行为保持（locality）以及新设定下的性能。理论上证明计数何时能唯一确定最终状态，并在给定假设下给出更新历史差异对平均分数差异的约束。
AI.result: 在 760M 参数模型上，更新次数相同的 24 种调度方案准确率落在 19.7%–34.2%；6 组 CounterFact LoRA 设置均学会了新信息，而 ROME 在全部 13 个工作点都保持住了编辑却每点都违反 locality；没有任何编辑器在所有模型、基准和测试上始终最优。
AI.conclusion: 仅用更新计数与即时性能的评测不足。评测应报告更新历史，并分别评估获取、保持与局部性；不存在普适最优的编辑器，调度与场景决定表现。

title: kw-bench: Breaking Frontier Harnesses on Real-World Tasks
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Code and tasks: https://github.com/GSequist/kw-bench
summary:
Each new generation of frontier model pushes the edge of what is possible. Inside a harness -- a loop, a shell, a filesystem, the ability to write and run its own code -- a model can take on increasingly difficult work.
  A growing body of work treats the coding-agent harness as infrastructure for knowledge work rather than a coding tool, and a new wave of benchmarks tests it there. Most of them are generative: build a financial model, a memo, a spreadsheet from a brief, judged by a rubric or by another model. Few test the expensive part of knowledge work, which is investigative. In audit, tax, due diligence, regulatory reporting, claims or any dispute over numbers, the answer already exists -- hidden in incomplete and inconsistent evidence spread across systems -- and has to be recovered and defended to the cent.
  We introduce kw-bench, a benchmark built from real engagements specialists described to us. Its first task family is a five-year VAT reconstruction across three generations of SAP -- legacy ECC, a partial S/4HANA migration and a consultant's redesign -- delivered as raw system extracts: page headers, local number formats, partial link tables, no documentation of how anything connects. Grading is deterministic, with no LLM judge.
  We ran four harnesses -- Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and micro-cc -- on the same model, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash, for two hours. The two independent, model-agnostic harnesses delivered (OpenCode 0.542, micro-cc 0.528); the two lab harnesses, away from their home model, delivered nothing (0.00 each). What defeated them was inertia: keeping many weak signals alive across a long session. On a frontier model the task collapses. micro-cc and Claude Code on Claude Opus 5.5 scored 0.9986 and 1.000, in 22 and 25 minutes. A weeks-long engagement now costs minutes and a few dollars; below the frontier, the harness decides how far a model gets.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 kw-bench，一个基于真实审计/税务业务场景的确定性评分基准，首个任务族为跨三代 SAP 系统的五年增值税重建。实验表明：在非前沿模型（DeepSeek v4.1 Flash）上，模型无关的独立 harness（OpenCode 0.542、micro-cc 0.528）远胜远离原生模型的实验室 harness（均为 0.00）；而换用前沿模型 Claude Opus 5.5 后，任务迅速接近满分（0.9986/1.000），harness 差异被抹平。
AI.motivation: 现有 coding-agent harness 正被当作知识工作基础设施，但主流基准多为生成式（造模型、写备忘录、做表格），通过 rubric 或 LLM 评判，很少测知识工作中真正昂贵的"调查/取证"环节——答案已存在于残缺且不一致的证据中，需精确到分地复原并辩护。
AI.method: 构建 kw-bench 基准，任务源自真实业务专家访谈。首个任务族为跨三代 SAP（遗留 ECC、部分迁移的 S/4HANA、顾问重构版）的五年增值税重建，输入为原始系统导出：页眉、本地数字格式、残缺关联表、无连接文档。采用确定性评分，不使用 LLM judge。对同一模型 DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 测试四个 harness（Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、micro-cc），限时两小时；并对前沿模型 Claude Opus 5.5 做对照。
AI.result: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 上：模型无关的独立 harness 取得有效成绩（OpenCode 0.542、micro-cc 0.528），实验室原生 harness 均为 0.00。失败原因是"惯性"——长时间会话中维持众多弱信号的连贯性。Claude Opus 5.5 上：micro-cc 与 Claude Code 分别得 0.9986 与 1.000，耗时 22 和 25 分钟。
AI.conclusion: 原本数周的业务工作可缩短至数分钟、成本几美元。低于前沿能力时，harness 决定模型能走多远；达到前沿水平时，任务本身坍缩为简单问题，harness 差异不再显著。

title: Spine: Compiling Subtask Trees into Structured Context for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
summary:
Long-horizon coding tasks contain nested subtasks. Typically, agents record interactions sequentially into a growing history, causing context inflation and performance degradation. Compressing or trimming the history without explicit subtask boundaries can discard information needed by unfinished subtasks. Conversely, recursive subagent delegation isolates completed subtasks through child agents by assigning every subtask boundary to delegation, which conflates subtask granularity with executing agent choice, adding execution and coordination overhead. We introduce Spine, an interface and runtime that align model context with subtask nesting and completion. An agent declares explicit subtask boundaries through work scopes, allowing the same agent to execute nested subtasks inline while reserving delegation for independent parallel tasks. The runtime organizes execution in SpineTree, a persistent tree recording subtask relations, local interactions, completion states, and returned results. Before each model call, it compiles the tree into model context just in time, retaining unfinished subtasks' interactions and replacing completed subtasks' details with their results, while preserving prefix-cache reuse.
  We integrate Spine into Codex to build SpineCodex. With GPT-5.6 Sol, compared with native Codex, SpineCodex improves SWE-Milestone Score by 11.8% while reducing total cost by 32.4%, improves the average ProgramBench test-pass rate by 17.3%, and improves Mean@5 on eight of the ten evaluated FrontierSWE tasks. On SWE-Milestone, it also achieves a comparable Score to Recursive Subagent at 73.7% lower total cost. We also integrate Spine into Pi through a reusable software package: with Gemini 3.8 Flash and Qwen 3.8 27B, it improves SWE-Milestone Score by 9.5-17.5% and the average ProgramBench test-pass rate by 4.3-8.7% compared with native Pi.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spine：一种让模型上下文与子任务嵌套/完成状态对齐的接口与运行时，通过 work scope 显式声明子任务边界、SpineTree 持久树记录结构，并在每次调用前即时编译上下文，从而在长程编码任务中降低上下文膨胀与成本。
AI.motivation: 长程编码任务含嵌套子任务，顺序记录交互导致历史不断膨胀、上下文膨胀、性能下降；而简单压缩/裁剪历史因缺少子任务边界会丢失未完成子任务所需信息；递归子代理委派把每个子任务边界都变成委派，混淆了子任务粒度与执行代理选择，带来执行与协调开销。
AI.method: 1) 智能体通过 work scope 显式声明子任务边界，同一智能体可就地内联执行嵌套子任务，委派仅保留给独立并行任务；2) 运行时以 SpineTree 持久树组织执行，记录子任务关系、局部交互、完成状态与返回结果；3) 每次模型调用前即时将树编译为模型上下文，保留未完成子任务的交互，把已完成子任务细节替换为其结果，同时保持前缀缓存复用。集成到 Codex 得 SpineCodex，并通过可复用软件包集成到 Pi。
AI.result: GPT-5.6 Sol 下，SpineCodex 相对原生 Codex：SWE-Milestone 分数 +11.8%，总成本 -32.4%；ProgramBench 平均测试通过率 +17.3%；在十个 FrontierSWE 任务中的八个上平均@5 提升。SWE-Milestone 上与 Recursive Subagent 分数相当，但总成本低 73.7%。在 Pi 中，Gemini 3.8 Flash 与 Qwen 3.8 27B 下 SWE-Milestone 分数提升 9.5–17.5%，ProgramBench 平均通过率提升 4.3–8.7%。
AI.conclusion: 显式的子任务边界建模加即时上下文编译，能同时提升长程编码效果与成本效率，且与执行代理选择解耦，具有良好的模型与框架通用性（Codex、Pi 及多模型验证）。

title: A Harness Reducing over-Defensive Writing in Agents by Isolating Objections
summary: When expanding a report, writing with agents may introduce a stronger claim than the article makes and then disclaim it. This is called over-defensive writing. We assume that this is because the agent is writing for responding to an adversarial AI reviewer, instead of a human reader. The defensive context may also influnce the consequent when we simply ban defensive writing in the output through prompts. In order to reduce over-defensive writing, we produce a harness that separates the reviewer, filter, and writer. The writer agent receives only the problems choosen by the filter, which is an independent context. We evaluate this harness on 25 business-project drafts expanded into formal reports, the result shows that the defensive propositions decreased from 59 to 2, which is a 96.61\% reduction, no unsupported factual additions were identified while the source-claim retention rises from 80.35% to 93.12%.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM智能体扩写报告时产生的"过度防御性写作"问题，提出将审稿、过滤、写作分离的harness以缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 智能体扩写报告时可能引入比原文更强的断言再加以免责，形成过度防御性写作。作者假设原因是智能体在应对对抗性AI审稿人而非人类读者；且直接在提示中禁止防御性写作也可能被防御性语境影响。
AI.method: 提出一个harness，将审稿人、过滤器、写作者分离开来，写作者智能体只接收由过滤器筛选出的问题，且处于独立上下文中。
AI.result: 在25份扩写为正式报告的商业项目草稿上评估：防御性命题从59降至2（降低96.61%），未发现无依据的事实添加，源主张保留率从80.35%升至93.12%。
AI.conclusion: 通过上下文隔离的审稿-过滤-写作分离架构，可显著减少过度防御性写作并提升对源文主张的忠实保留。

title: When Is Additional Retrieval Worthwhile? A Cost-Aware Study of Evidence Gain and Answer Reliability in RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can benefit from more sophisticated retrieval, but extra retrieval may be unnecessary for many questions and gains in evidence retrieval may not translate into faithful or correct answers. We study a cost-aware, two-action retrieval policy that chooses between a dense-retrieval-plus-reranking baseline and a hybrid lexical--dense retriever. Rather than classifying baseline retrieval as simply successful or unsuccessful, we estimate the question-specific incremental evidence-retrieval benefit of hybrid retrieval using features available before the routing decision. A regularized linear model and decision threshold are selected using document-grouped cross-validation and frozen prior to held-out evaluation. On 60 previously unseen QASPER training-split articles (188 questions, 169 evidence-evaluable), the policy triggers hybrid retrieval on 46 questions (24.5\%) and obtains the same evidence Hit@10 as always-hybrid retrieval (78.70\%, versus 76.92\% for always-keep). Paired, paper-cluster bootstrap intervals do not establish a reliable utility advantage. We further compare generated answers from a 4-bit Qwen3-4B model under the three retrieval policies. Provisional answer-level assessments show no clear correctness or faithfulness improvement after partial review, despite the evidence-retrieval result. The generation assessments remain model-assisted and lack independent human validation. These results expose an important distinction between retrieving relevant evidence efficiently and improving the reliability of the generated answer. The work is presented as a reproducible empirical study, not a claim of statistically established answer-quality superiority.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究一种成本感知的两动作RAG检索策略，在基线（稠密检索+重排）与混合检索之间路由，用决策前特征估计混合检索的增益；结果显示可减少混合检索触发（24.5%）并保持同等Hit@10，但未建立可靠的效用优势，答案正确性和忠实度亦无明显提升。
AI.motivation: RAG可从更复杂检索中获益，但额外检索对许多问题并不必要，且证据检索的改进未必转化为忠实或正确的答案，故需成本感知的策略性检索。
AI.method: 构建两动作检索策略，在稠密检索+重排的基线与词汇-稠密混合检索器间选择；以路由决策前可得特征估计问题级增量证据检索收益，用文档分组交叉验证选择正则化线性模型与决策阈值，冻结后进行留出评估；在QASPER 60篇未见文章（188问题，169可评估）上评测Hit@10，并用4-bit Qwen3-4B比较三种策略的生成答案。
AI.result: 策略在46/188问题（24.5%）触发混合检索，证据Hit@10达78.70%，与始终混合检索相同（始终保留基线为76.92%）；但成对、论文簇自助法置信区间未能确立可靠的效用优势，生成答案在部分评审下未见明显的正确性或忠实度提升。
AI.conclusion: 高效检索相关证据与提升生成答案可靠性之间存在重要区别；该工作定位为可复现的经验研究，而非答案质量优越性的统计确立。

title: Full Collapse Is Suboptimal: Controlled Partial Neural Collapse for Long-Tailed Recognition
summary: Recent long-tailed recognition (LTR) methods incorporate neural collapse (NC) and align features to a fixed Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF) as a uniform target for all classes. However, forcing tail classes to fully collapse over-contracts their samples and weakens generalization. To address this, we propose a controlled partial neural collapse, realized through two coordinated controls on a backbone: the Class-Adaptive Sparse Activation (CASA) classifier and the ETF-constrained adaptive margin (ETF-AM) loss. Rather than forcing a uniform full collapse, this regime allows head classes to collapse along the ETF while tail classes retain within-class diversity. This prevents the tail from being forced into full collapse, which is suboptimal under imbalance. To set the dimensionality of collapse, CASA induces class-related node specialization through feature-conditioned gating so that tail classes occupy their own feature directions. For the clearance axis, ETF-AM applies a frequency-adaptive margin, with smaller margins for head classes and larger for tail classes. On CIFAR100-LT, ImageNet-LT, Places-LT, and iNaturalist-2018, our method achieves the best overall accuracy over prior methods. In the empirical analysis, within-class spread increases monotonically from head to tail classes, consistent with tail classes retaining variability rather than fully collapsing.

AI.tldr: 提出控制性部分神经坍缩（CPNC）范式，通过类自适应稀疏激活分类器（CASA）与ETF约束自适应间隔损失（ETF-AM），让头部类完全坍缩、尾部类保留类内多样性，在四个长尾基准上取得最佳总体精度。
AI.motivation: 现有长尾识别方法将特征对齐到固定ETF作为所有类的统一目标，强制尾部类完全坍缩会过度收缩其样本、损害泛化能力，因此在类别不平衡下"全体完全坍缩"并非最优。
AI.method: 在骨干网络上施加两个协同控制：1) CASA分类器通过特征条件门控实现类别相关节点专门化，使尾部类占据各自的特征方向，从而设定坍缩维度；2) ETF-AM损失施加频率自适应间隔，头部类间隔小、尾部类间隔大，控制类间清晰度（clearance）轴。
AI.result: 在CIFAR100-LT、ImageNet-LT、Places-LT与iNaturalist-2018上整体精度优于先前方法；实证分析显示类内离散度从头类到尾类单调递增，印证尾部类保留变异性而非完全坍缩。
AI.conclusion: 部分而非统一的神经坍缩更适合长尾场景：按类别自适应地控制坍缩维度与间隔，可兼顾头部类紧致性与尾部类多样性，实现更优的总体精度与泛化。

title: Dirichlet Process Mixtures within Semiparametric Bayesian Networks: A Novel Conditional Density Estimation Approach
summary: Semiparametric Bayesian networks (SPBNs) are flexible probabilistic graphical models for representing joint distributions of continuous variables through lower-dimensional conditional probability distributions (CPDs). Existing SPBN models use kernel density estimators (KDEs) for non-parametric CPD modeling, but their one-component-per-observation mixture representation can lead to increased inference costs and density estimation errors, which can be limiting. In this work, we define a new CPD modeling approach for non-parametric components based on Bayesian non-parametric Dirichlet Process Mixtures (DPMs) within SPBNs. DPMs provide a data-adaptive clustering of observations, yielding a more compact representation while retaining the flexibility of non-parametric density estimation, unlike KDE. This results in lower inference costs while improving density estimation performance. We implement the proposed DPM-based SPBN (DPM-SPBN) by extending the open-source PyBNesian package and evaluate it on synthetic and real-world data. For a given network structure, DPM-based CPDs significantly outperform state-of-the-art Bayesian network models for continuous variables in density estimation, achieving lower absolute log-likelihood errors on synthetic data. We further investigate the impact of the proposed CPD modeling on structure learning methods relying on CPD-based scores. DPM-based SPBNs achieve lower structure learning and density estimation errors than KDE-based SPBNs. Experiments on real-world data corroborate these findings, identifying DPM-based CPD modeling as the most effective alternative among the evaluated non-parametric approaches for continuous variables.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于狄利克雷过程混合(DPM)的半参数贝叶斯网络(DPM-SPBN)，用数据自适应聚类替代KDE的逐观测单成分表示，从而降低推断成本并提升密度估计精度。
AI.motivation: 现有半参数贝叶斯网络(SPBN)的非参数条件概率分布采用核密度估计(KDE)，其“每个观测一个混合成分”的表示导致推断成本高、密度估计误差大。
AI.method: 在SPBN框架内，用贝叶斯非参数狄利克雷过程混合(DPM)构建非参数CPD，实现观测的自适应聚类以获得更紧凑的表示；在开源PyBNesian包中实现DPM-SPBN。
AI.result: 在给定网络结构下，DPM-based CPD在合成数据上密度估计显著优于连续变量SOTA贝叶斯网络，绝对对数似然误差更低；依赖CPD评分的结构学习与密度估计误差也优于KDE-based SPBN；真实数据实验进一步验证。
AI.conclusion: DPM-based CPD建模是所评估的连续变量非参数方法中最有效的替代方案，兼顾灵活性、推断效率与估计精度。

title: Verifiable Efficiency Limits of Innate LLM Planning in Sliding Puzzles
summary: Tool-assisted planning success can reflect external search and verification, leaving a model's unaided planning ability unresolved. We isolate innate planning through complete plans generated in one response without tools or execution feedback. We propose a verifiable framework that decomposes success-weighted plan efficiency as $\mathrm{SPE}=R\times Q\times E$: execution reliability, planning coordination among legal plans, and action economy among completed plans. Trajectory replay and certified optima verify these factors; the joint score includes unsuccessful attempts. We evaluate 8,400 full-plan outputs from seven model conditions on $4\times4$ sliding puzzles, controlling exact horizon and obstacle count in the primary cohort. Models that complete every trial still become less economical at longer horizons, while higher efficiency among completed plans can coexist with poor goal attainment. SPE separates the overall capability hierarchy, while its factors distinguish coordination failure from inefficient completion. The framework makes long-horizon limitations in unaided planning quantitatively verifiable.

AI.tldr: 提出可验证框架SPE=可靠性R×协调性Q×经济性E，用一次性生成完整计划（无工具、无执行反馈）隔离模型的"原生规划能力"，在4×4滑块谜题上评价7种模型条件的8400条完整计划输出。
AI.motivation: 现有工具辅助规划的成功可能来自外部搜索与验证，掩盖模型自身无辅助的规划能力，因此需要隔离并量化"内在规划能力"，尤其在长时程下的局限。
AI.method: 让模型在单次响应中生成完整计划（不使用工具、无执行反馈）；将成功加权计划效率分解为SPE=R×Q×E：执行可靠性R、合法计划间协调性Q、完成计划的行动经济性E；通过轨迹回放与已认证最优解验证各因子，联合得分纳入失败尝试；在4×4滑块谜题上严格控制精确时程与障碍数量。
AI.result: 即便全部试验均能完成的模型，在更长时程下经济性也下降；完成计划中较高效率可与较差目标达成并存。SPE能区分整体能力层级，其分解因子可区分协调失败与低效完成。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使无辅助规划的长时程局限变得可定量验证，并将整体能力与规划失败的具体来源区分开来。

title: BenchMeUp: Building Software Engineering Benchmarks from Natural-Language Specifications
summary:
Software-engineering research relies on benchmarks that evaluate new techniques on a set of problem instances. Unfortunately, manually constructing benchmarks is labor-intensive, as researchers must find suitable instances, prepare execution environments, establish expected outcomes, and validate correctness.
  This paper presents BenchMeUp, an approach for automatically creating software-engineering benchmarks from natural-language specifications. Given a specification defining the desired instances, data sources, and evaluation procedures, BenchMeUp generates search rules and a construction plan, invokes parallel LLM agents that identify candidate instances and construct executable instances, validates the results in fresh execution environments, and packages the instances behind a unified command-line interface. We evaluate the approach on four tasks: program repair, issue reproduction, compiler autotuning, and fixing static-analysis warnings. Targeting 50 instances per task (200 in total), BenchMeUp constructs 198 instances, of which 196 (99\%) are successfully packaged. Search and construction take 36 minutes and \$0.79 per instance, on average. Evaluating eight existing techniques on the generated benchmarks, we find that 189 of 196 packaged instances (96\%) support end-to-end evaluation, allowing users to study the effectiveness of the techniques. Checking every constructed instance against its source, the specification, and its expected outcome, we find that 180 of 198 (91\%) meet all criteria, compared with 10 of 200 instances delivered by Codex (general-purpose coding agent).
  Overall, we show that LLM-based agents can automate benchmark construction across diverse software-engineering tasks and produce executable instances that existing techniques can use, while validity beyond execution still needs to be checked.

AI.tldr: BenchMeUp 利用并行 LLM 智能体从自然语言规格自动构建软件工程基准，在四类任务上构建 198 个实例，91% 满足来源、规格与预期结果的全部标准。
AI.motivation: 软件工程研究依赖基准来评估新技术，但人工构建基准成本高昂，需要寻找合适实例、准备执行环境、确定预期结果并验证正确性。
AI.method: 输入定义实例、数据源与评估流程的自然语言规格，BenchMeUp 生成搜索规则与构建计划，调用并行 LLM 智能体识别候选实例并构建可执行实例，在全新执行环境中验证结果，并以统一命令行接口打包实例。
AI.result: 在程序修复、缺陷复现、编译器自动调优、静态分析告警修复四个任务上目标共 200 个实例，实际构建 198 个，其中 196 个（99%）成功打包；平均每实例搜索与构建耗时 36 分钟、成本 0.79 美元；8 种现有技术中 189/196（96%）实例支持端到端评估；180/198（91%）满足全部有效性标准，而通用编码智能体 Codex 交付的 200 个实例仅 10 个合格。
AI.conclusion: LLM 智能体可跨多样软件工程任务自动构建基准并产出可执行、可供现有技术使用的实例，但执行之外的有效性仍需人工核查。

title: CAMR: Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay for Continual Learning in Large Language Models
summary: Continual learning requires large language models to acquire new knowledge and capabilities while retaining what they have learned. Fine-tuning and replay support acquisition and retention, but deciding whether incoming examples need supervision and which historical examples to revisit remains a challenge. We propose Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay (CAMR), an adaptive framework that jointly controls current-example supervision and historical replay. CAMR combines compatibility checks with a learned memory gate to guide an online policy over three actions: learning incoming examples with general replay, jointly reinforcing compatible related examples, and skipping direct supervision of verified mastered duplicates. The policy learns from acquisition, retention, and training-cost feedback under a bounded per-arrival replay budget. We evaluate CAMR with Qwen3-8B-Base on continual factual updating and cross-task and cross-domain learning. On WikiBigEdit, CAMR consistently leads evaluated methods in Original Match from 3K to 100K facts, reaching 93.66% after just 3K facts and surpassing Full-history Replay (LoRA) after 100K facts. It also achieves the highest final scores on all four selected TRACE tasks and maintains or improves earlier-task performance relative to post-acquisition levels in a sequence spanning financial question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and summarization.

AI.tldr: 提出兼容性感知记忆回放（CAMR），联合控制当前样本监督与历史回放：通过兼容性检查与学习型记忆门在三种动作间做在线决策，并以有界回放预算学习策略，在持续事实更新和跨任务/跨域学习中优于基线。
AI.motivation: 持续学习要求大模型获得新知识同时保留旧能力。微调与回放虽有助于获取与保持，但"新样本是否需要监督"以及"应回放哪些历史样本"仍缺乏有效判定机制。
AI.method: CAMR由兼容性检查和学习型记忆门组成，指导在线策略在三种动作中选择：(1)学习新样本并做通用回放；(2)联合强化兼容的相关样本；(3)跳过已掌握重复样本的直接监督。策略依据获取、保持与训练成本反馈，在每次到达有界回放预算下学习。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B-Base上实验：WikiBigEdit上Original Match在3K至100K事实规模持续领先，3K事实即达93.66%，100K后超过Full-history Replay(LoRA)；TRACE四项任务最终得分均最高；在金融问答、数学推理、代码生成、摘要序列中保持或提升了早期任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 联合决策"是否监督"与"回放什么"的自适应回放框架能有效平衡知识获取、能力保持与训练成本，验证了兼容性感知策略在持续学习中的有效性。

title: Can Complementary Signals Bridge Similarity Islands? Manifold-Augmented Graph Embedding for Multimodal Recommendation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 33 pages, including references and appendices
summary: Multimodal Recommender Systems (MMRS) leverage rich item features to mitigate data sparsity, yet similarity-driven graph construction and propagation can favor semantically similar substitutes over functionally related complements. When behavioral associations connect semantically distant items, complementary signals can remain geometrically isolated, yielding fragmented "Similarity Islands" and semantic drift when standard propagation is applied. To overcome these limitations, we propose MAGE (Manifold-Augmented Graph Embedding), a framework for personalized multimodal ranking that decouples complementarity modeling into offline geometric warping and online topological propagation. The offline phase enhances item representations by extracting complement-aware residual directions via a Soft Conceptor mechanism and injecting them under a local gap-preserving constraint, incorporating co-purchase evidence while controlling the magnitude of geometric perturbation. Synergistically, the online phase employs an asymmetric dual-stream GNN that treats visual features as stable anchors and augmented textual features as flexible probes, fused through a self-calibrated cross-modal mechanism to reconcile shared semantics and modality-specific residual cues. Extensive experiments on four Amazon datasets show that MAGE yields consistent improvements over strong multimodal recommendation baselines. Together with the supporting analyses in the appendix, these results suggest that geometry-aware augmentation can alleviate the semantic mismatch that arises in complementary recommendation settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/Alex-bupt/mage.

AI.tldr: 提出MAGE框架，将互补性建模解耦为离线几何扭曲与在线拓扑传播，缓解多模态推荐中的"相似性孤岛"与语义漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态推荐依赖相似性驱动的图构建与传播，倾向于偏向语义相似的替代品而非功能互补品；当行为关联连接语义疏远物品时，互补信号在几何上孤立，形成"相似性孤岛"，标准传播导致语义漂移。
AI.method: 离线阶段通过Soft Conceptor机制提取互补感知的残差方向，并在局部间隔保持约束下注入共购证据，控制几何扰动幅度；在线阶段采用非对称双流GNN，以视觉特征为稳定锚、增强文本特征为灵活探针，经自校准跨模态机制融合共享语义与模态特定残差线索。
AI.result: 在四个Amazon数据集上相较强多模态推荐基线取得一致提升，附录分析支持几何感知增强可缓解互补推荐场景中的语义错配。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知的增强可有效缓解互补推荐中的语义错配；解耦式设计（离线几何扭曲+在线拓扑传播）为多模态互补推荐提供可行方案。

title: ClusterSplat: Semantic Cluster Selection for 3D Visual Grounding in Gaussian Splatting
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 as a Spotlight paper. Project page: https://jaesung8.github.io/clustersplat/
summary: We study 3D visual grounding in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), where a referring expression should identify a target object as both a rendered 2D mask and a set of explicit 3D Gaussians. Prior methods typically extract 3D targets by applying heuristic thresholding or top-ratio filtering to dense primitive-level relevance scores. However, these scores often vary substantially across scenes and prompts, making such heuristics sensitive and leading to unstable targeting. ClusterSplat addresses this by reframing 3D target selection as cluster-level selection over scene-adaptive candidates. The method first learns instance-aware Gaussian features, forms feature-aware seed voxels, and merges neighboring seed voxels when a description-length criterion decreases, producing a scene-specific set of cluster candidates. Given a referring expression, a query-conditioned cluster scorer ranks the cluster candidates with a lightweight MLP, and the selected cluster directly defines the explicit 3D target while its cluster score is rendered for the 2D mask. On ScanRefer, ClusterSplat achieves the best rendered 2D segmentation and explicit 3D target metrics among the compared 3DGS baselines. It also obtains the best average Ref-LERF scores, supporting the same trend under fine-grained referring descriptions. On ScanNet v2 class name queries, ClusterSplat achieves the strongest rendered 2D results and the highest 3D matching accuracy, while maintaining competitive 3D IoU. Our project page is available at https://jaesung8.github.io/clustersplat/ .

AI.tldr: ClusterSplat将3DGS中的3D视觉定位重构为簇级选择问题：先学习实例感知高斯特征并构建场景自适应候选簇，再用查询条件MLP对簇打分，选中簇同时定义显式3D目标并渲染出2D掩码。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖对稠密图元级相关性分数做启发式阈值或top-ratio过滤来提取3D目标，但这些分数在不同场景和提示下波动大，导致定位不稳定。作者希望避免脆弱的启发式，把目标选择提升到更稳定的簇层级。
AI.method: 学习实例感知的高斯特征，形成特征感知种子体素；当描述长度准则下降时合并相邻种子体素，得到场景特定的簇候选集合；给定指代表达后，用轻量MLP进行查询条件化的簇打分器排序候选，选中的簇直接作为显式3D目标，其簇分数渲染为2D掩码。
AI.result: ScanRefer上，渲染2D分割与显式3D目标指标均为最佳；Ref-LERF平均分最优。ScanNet v2类别名查询上渲染2D结果最强、3D匹配准确率最高，3D IoU保持有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 以场景自适应的簇级选择替代图元级启发式阈值，可同时输出稳定的显式3D高斯目标与2D掩码，并在多个基准上优于现有3DGS基线。

title: Scaling and Renormalization in Neural Networks: An Effective Renormalization-Group Description of Grokking
summary: Grokking is a delayed transition from memorization to generalization in deep neural networks (NNs). We examine whether scaling and renormalization group (RG) theories can describe this dynamics, establishing a quantitative physical framework for neural generalization transitions. For modular addition on a two-layer NN, an ensemble of trained models defines an order parameter (the squared weight norm) and fluctuation proxies for the heat capacity and the susceptibility, with training epoch and weight decay serving as thermal and field control coordinates. To bridge neural architectures to real-space RG, we construct an exact coupling matrix via a second-order expansion of the loss with respect to per-neuron norms and use its Fiedler vector to define an effective geometry. This spectral ordering yields a monotonic spatial decay of coupling strength that is absent under random permutations. We then execute real-space RG by block-spin aggregating adjacent neurons and parameterizing the coupling matrix into off-diagonal band strengths. Linearizing this local RG map yields relevant scaling exponents and five derived critical exponents, with direct empirical estimates matching RG predictions within 1-10%. Overall, our framework provides a consistent effective description of grokking, suggesting the scaling and renormalization group formalism as a tool to investigate NN dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文将缩放与重整化群（RG）理论用于描述两层神经网络在模加法任务上的grokking动力学，通过构造精确耦合矩阵与Fiedler向量定义有效几何，实现实空间RG并提取临界指数，经验估计与RG预测吻合在1-10%内。
AI.motivation: Grokking是神经网络从记忆到泛化的延迟转变现象，缺乏定量的物理理论描述。作者希望检验缩放与RG理论能否刻画这一动力学，为神经泛化转变建立定量物理框架。
AI.method: 对训练模型集合定义序参量（权重范数平方）及热容、磁化率的涨落代理量，以训练轮次和权重衰减作为温度场与场控制坐标；通过对每神经元范数的二阶展开构造精确耦合矩阵，用其Fiedler向量定义有效几何（光谱排序产生耦合强度的单调空间衰减，随机排列则无）；再用块自旋聚合相邻神经元执行实空间RG，将耦合矩阵参数化为带外强度，线性化局部RG映射得到相关标度指数与五个导出临界指数。
AI.result: 光谱排序下耦合强度呈单调空间衰减，且该性质在随机置换下不存在；由局部RG映射线性化得到的临界指数与直接经验估计在1-10%误差内一致。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为grokking提供了一致有效的描述，表明缩放与重整化群形式主义可作为研究神经网络动力学的工具。

title: LM-DSB: A Lightweight Multi-agent System for Automated Daily Safety Bulletin Generation in Construction
summary: Construction safety management still struggles to produce daily safety bulletins (DSBs), structured daily communications that identify site-specific hazards, convey safety protocols, and set preventive measures for workers. Manual DSB creation takes 2-3 hours daily and yields inconsistent quality, with 25% of crews never conducting pretask planning (Olson et al., 2016), diverting safety personnel from field supervision. This study proposes the Lightweight Multi-Agent DSB System (LM-DSB), which integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with a locally deployable Large Language Model (LLM) to automate DSB generation on consumer-grade personal computers. LM-DSB coordinates specialized planner, researcher, and writer agents in a hierarchical architecture, enhanced by domain-specific fine-tuning on construction safety documentation and RAG grounding in 37 health, safety, and environment (HSE) documents. A two-phase validation assessed feasibility. Phase 1 comparative evaluation showed the multi-agent RAG system (Llama 3-8B) outperformed all alternative configurations, with strong lexical alignment and coherence (TF-IDF: 0.70, BLEU: 0.39, ROUGE-1: 0.66) and near-complete document generation (length ratio: 1.01 vs. 0.39 for single-agent RAG). Phase 2 expert evaluation (N=40) confirmed practical acceptability (mean scores 3.50-4.20 on a 5-point scale), particularly in regulatory compliance (4.20) and factual accuracy (4.10). The findings show that architectural design enables lightweight models to handle safety-critical documentation on consumer-grade hardware, advancing technology democratization in construction safety management. Limitations include knowledge base scope, language constraints, and lack of field deployment validation; future work should address multimodal integration and workflow adoption.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级多智能体系统 LM-DSB，结合 RAG 与本地可部署 LLM，在消费级电脑上自动生成每日安全简报（DSB），两阶段验证其可行性与专家接受度。
AI.motivation: 人工编制每日安全简报需每天 2-3 小时且质量不稳定，25% 班组从不做任务前规划，安全人员被文档工作占用而无法专注现场监督。
AI.method: LM-DSB 采用分层架构协调 planner、researcher、writer 三类智能体，基于施工安全文档做领域微调，并以 37 份 HSE 文档进行 RAG 接地；分两阶段验证：阶段一为配置对比评估，阶段二为 40 名专家评估。
AI.result: 多智能体 RAG（Llama 3-8B）优于所有替代配置（TF-IDF 0.70、BLEU 0.39、ROUGE-1 0.66，长度比 1.01 对比单智能体 0.39）；专家评分 3.50-4.20，合规性 4.20、事实准确性 4.10 最高。
AI.conclusion: 架构设计可使轻量模型在消费级硬件上处理安全关键文档，推动施工安全管理技术民主化；局限为知识库范围、语言限制及缺乏现场部署验证，未来需关注多模态集成与工作流落地。

title: Hidden in Plain Sight: an Empirical Study about The Instruction Stacks of Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents send their models more than the user's prompt: they add instructions, tool definitions, and environmental context that form an instruction stack. This stack guides execution and changes across releases, yet remains largely unexposed to users and insufficiently characterized in research. We present a longitudinal, cross-agent study of the instruction stacks captured in the first model requests of 1,886 releases of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, and OpenCode. Under controlled conditions, we analyze their composition and evolution and trace changes in the four open-source agents to documented motivations. Our findings show why examining the system prompt or reporting the model alone provides an incomplete account of agent inputs. Tool definitions dominate three agents' latest requests, while occasional concentrated revisions alter instructions governing tool use, attribution, and coding style. Such revisions can complicate how researchers identify agent-authored contributions and interpret generated code. We also found that only 48% of examined change units directly explain the motivation for stack revisions. Across agents, shared capabilities emerge despite increasingly distinct wording. These findings expose an evolving, incompletely documented layer of agent design. The findings motivate documenting captured instruction stacks alongside agent releases, models, and user prompts, and preserving the rationale behind their revisions.

AI.tldr: 本文对5款编码代理（Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code、OpenCode）共1,886个版本的首次模型请求进行纵向跨代理分析，刻画其"指令栈"的组成与演化，并追踪4个开源代理的变更动机。
AI.motivation: 编码代理发给模型的输入远不止用户提示词，还包含指令、工具定义与环境上下文构成的"指令栈"。这一层既影响执行行为、又在版本间不断变化，却对用户不透明、研究中也缺乏刻画；仅看系统提示词或只报告所用模型都无法完整解释代理输入。
AI.method: 在受控条件下，采集并分析5个代理1,886个版本首次模型请求中的指令栈，比较其组成与演化，并将4个开源代理的变更追溯到有文档记录的动机。同时统计变更单元与动机说明的对应比例。
AI.result: 工具定义在三个代理的最新请求中占主导；偶发的集中式改写会改变关于工具使用、署名归属和编码风格的指令，从而干扰研究者识别代理所作贡献、解读生成代码；仅48%的变更单元能直接说明指令栈修订的动机；各代理能力趋同但措辞日益分化。
AI.conclusion: 指令栈是代理设计中不断演化且记录不完整的一层。建议在发布代理、模型和用户提示词之外，同步记录所采集的指令栈，并保留其修订背后的理由。

title: DocSkill: Skill-Integrated Agentic Reasoning for Multilingual Multi-Hop Document Question Answering
summary: Multilingual multi-hop document question answering (MMHop-DocQA) requires locating and integrating evidence across complex layouts, document pages, and diverse languages. Existing approaches include single-pass processing and adaptive tool use, but learning to coordinate evidence acquisition, cross-page integration, and answer verification remains challenging. To address this challenge, we present DocSkill, an agentic framework with a learned skill-orchestration policy for adaptive evidence acquisition and reasoning. The policy selects, revisits, or skips skills according to the evolving evidence state. To construct supervision for skill orchestration, bounded Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) explores alternative skill trajectories offline. These trajectories provide demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). We further introduce MMHop-DocBench, a multilingual multi-hop document QA dataset with training and test splits, containing 60K QA pairs across 10 languages and eight document domains. Its HopGen pipeline builds hierarchical page-element graphs to derive traceable cross-page evidence paths and generate grounded QA pairs with page- and element-level evidence annotations. Experiments show that DocSkill with Qwen3-VL-8B achieves 41.0 accuracy and 49.2 F1 on MMHop-DocBench, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 5.5 and 6.3 points, respectively, and achieving competitive performance on MMLongBench-Doc and DocBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DocSkill 智能体框架，通过学习型技能编排策略协调多语言跨页文档问答中的证据获取与推理，并构建 60K 规模的 MMHop-DocBench 数据集；在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上达到 41.0 准确率和 49.2 F1，显著超过基线。
AI.motivation: 多语言多跳文档问答需要在复杂版式、多页和多种语言间定位并整合证据。现有单次处理或自适应工具调用方法难以协调证据获取、跨页整合与答案验证。
AI.method: 提出 DocSkill 智能体框架，含可学习的技能编排策略，依据不断演化的证据状态选择、回访或跳过技能。用有界蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）离线探索技能轨迹，生成 SFT 演示数据和 DPO 偏好对。同时构建 MMHop-DocBench 数据集（60K QA 对、10 种语言、8 类文档领域），通过 HopGen 管线构建分层页面-元素图，得到可追溯的跨页证据路径与带页面/元素级标注的 QA。
AI.result: DocSkill 配合 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 MMHop-DocBench 上取得 41.0 准确率和 49.2 F1，分别超过最强基线 5.5 和 6.3 个点；在 MMLongBench-Doc 与 DocBench 上表现具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 技能编排策略结合离线 MCTS 监督与偏好优化，可有效提升多语言多跳文档问答性能，配套数据集推动该方向研究。

title: REGER: Modeling inter-item Relations with Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation
summary: Personalized recommendation depends on learning semantic and collaborative relations among items from online content and user interactions. Generative recommendation (GR) offers a promising paradigm by autoregressively generating discrete semantic IDs (SIDs) of items. However, randomly initialized SID token embeddings and GR models trained from scratch do not directly inherit the semantic relations inherent in items, while inter-item collaborative relations are learned largely implicitly through token-level attention and next-token supervision. To address this limitation, we propose REGER, a unified framework that explicitly incorporates inter-item relations into semantic pretraining, history encoding, and SID generation. We pretrain the GR model through generative semantic retrieval, enabling it to inherit inter-item semantic similarity by learning to generate semantic neighbors' SIDs. We combine global attention with local attention aligned with SID boundaries to capture historical context and directed transitions between adjacent items. We further develop a theoretical framework for hierarchical preference decomposition over the SID prefix tree, proving an exact factorization of collaborative preference distributions and a weighted decomposition of item-level KL divergence into prefix-conditional KL divergences. Building on this analysis, we distill a discriminative teacher's full conditional distributions over all legal next tokens at ground-truth prefixes along the target SID path, jointly optimizing this objective with cross-entropy. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over existing GR baselines and support the effectiveness of the proposed preference distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REGER，一个将项间关系显式融入语义预训练、历史编码和SID生成的生成式推荐统一框架，通过理论证明协作偏好可沿SID前缀树精确分解，并据此蒸馏判别式教师模型，在真实数据集上稳定优于现有生成式推荐基线。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐（GR）自回归生成离散语义ID时存在两点缺陷：随机初始化的SID词嵌入与从零训练的GR模型无法直接继承物品固有的语义关系；物品间协作关系仅通过token级注意力与下一token监督被隐式学习。
AI.method: 1）通过生成式语义检索预训练GR模型，使其学习生成语义近邻的SID以继承项间语义相似性；2）结合全局注意力与沿SID边界对齐的局部注意力，捕捉历史上下文与相邻物品间的有向转移；3）建立SID前缀树上的层级偏好分解理论框架，证明协作偏好分布的精确因子分解及项级KL散度到前缀条件KL散度的加权分解；4）据此在目标SID路径的真实前缀上蒸馏判别式教师对全部合法下一token的完整条件分布，并与交叉熵联合优化。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的大量实验显示，REGER相较于现有生成式推荐基线取得一致性提升，并验证了所提出的偏好蒸馏机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模项间语义与协作关系并结合前缀树层级的偏好蒸馏，能有效提升生成式推荐性能，且具有理论支撑。

title: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni: Elastic Self-Refining Unified Diffusion LLM with Cross-Paradigm On-Policy Distillation
summary: We propose Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni (NLD-Uni), a unified discrete diffusion large language model (DLLM) for visual understanding and generation tasks. Compared with prior unified diffusion models, NLD-Uni introduces two major innovations. First, we propose a unified cross-paradigm on-policy distillation (OPD) framework that successfully transfers the visual understanding ability of autoregressive VLMs and visual generation ability of continuous flow models, to a unified DLLM. Second, NLD-Uni incorporates a novel progressive self-refining diffusion process that gradually corrupts each token across multiple steps during training, as opposed to adopting the conventional masked diffusion formulation that directly corrupts a clean image token to an uninformative mask token. At inference, this design allows NLD-Uni to make intermediate commit to a token, enabling progressive self-refinement for better visual quality. Through extensive experiments, we show that NLD-Uni achieves state-of-the-art performance among unified DLLMs on diverse tasks including visual question-answering, multi-modal reasoning, object grounding, text-to-image generation, and image editing.

AI.tldr: 提出统一离散扩散大模型 NLD-Uni，通过跨范式在线策略蒸馏与渐进自精炼扩散，实现视觉理解与生成，在多项任务上达到统一 DLLM 的 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 已有统一扩散模型能力不及分别专精的自回归 VLM（理解）和连续流模型（生成），且传统掩码扩散将干净 token 直接变为无信息 mask，训练与推理方式受限，无法支持中间提交与逐步精炼。
AI.method: 两大创新：(1) 统一跨范式在线策略蒸馏（OPD）框架，将自回归 VLM 的视觉理解能力和连续流模型的视觉生成能力迁移到单一离散扩散 LLM；(2) 渐进自精炼扩散过程，训练时对每个 token 分多步渐进加噪腐蚀，替代直接掩码的扩散形式，推理时支持对 token 做中间提交以实现渐进自精炼。
AI.result: 在视觉问答、多模态推理、目标定位、文生图、图像编辑等任务上，NLD-Uni 在统一 DLLM 中取得 SOTA 表现。
AI.conclusion: 跨范式蒸馏加渐进自精炼扩散，是让离散扩散模型统一承担理解与生成任务的可行有效路径。

title: SpatialPC: Deep Computation with Sublinear Local Credit Propagation
summary: On a chain of $N$ states, any local learning rule with bounded communication range needs $Θ(N)$ rounds before the loss can influence the earliest parameters, and this latency is usually attributed to depth. We show that it is a property of the communication geometry rather than of depth. For $N=m^d$ states placed at constant density in $d$ dimensions, a light-cone argument gives an $Ω(N^{1/d})$ lower bound on the number of bounded-range rounds that any local algorithm needs before its gradient estimates can be sign-correct at every parameter. We construct a unit-range, degree-$2d$ directed acyclic graph that contains a Hamiltonian computation of length $N-1$ and in which every state lies within directed distance $d(m-1)=Θ(N^{1/d})$ of the output, matching the lower bound. In the realizable-circuit model, depth and credit depth are therefore independent parameters: represented depth $Θ(N)$ and causal credit latency $Θ(N^{1/d})$ coexist, with a separation of order $N^{1-1/d}$. SpatialPC realizes this separation within predictive coding. Credit is propagated by adjoint prediction dynamics (APD), a local update whose $K$-round state on a settled acyclic graph is the truncated reverse-path sum $a^K=\sum_{k<K}(J^\top)^k b$, with error exactly $(J^\top)^K a^\star$. Graph geometry fixes when credit can first arrive at a state; the Jacobian-weighted path tail fixes how many further rounds accurate credit requires. A sparse two-dimensional Moore compiler retains the $N-1$ backbone with $\tfrac32N-2$ unit-range edges and has measured worst-node reachability $\sqrt N+2$ up to $N=65{,}536$, where a 65,535-edge backbone is reached in 258 local hops. With $T=2\sqrt N$ rounds, SpatialPC keeps finite-round task gradients aligned with settled gradients (cosine $0.93$ on MNIST and $0.97$ on Fashion-MNIST at $N=256$) and reaches $97.6\%$ and $88.1\%$ test accuracy after 20 epochs.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明局部学习的信用分配延迟由通信几何而非深度决定，二维空间中可达到 Θ(√N) 的信用延迟，并提出 SpatialPC 在预测编码框架内实现这一分离。
AI.motivation: 链式结构中局部规则需 Θ(N) 轮才能让损失影响最早参数，此前普遍将这一延迟归因于网络深度；作者希望澄清其真正来源是通信几何，并探索能否在保持长计算路径的同时降低信用延迟。
AI.method: 用光锥论证给出 d 维恒定密度布局下 Ω(N^{1/d}) 的有界范围轮数下界；构造 unit-range、度 2d 的有向无环图使其包含长度 N−1 的哈密顿计算且每个状态到输出的有向距离仅为 Θ(N^{1/d})，从而匹配下界。提出 SpatialPC，用伴随预测动力学（APD）传播信用，K 轮状态等于截断反向路径和 a^K=Σ_{k<K}(J^⊤)^k b，误差恰为 (J^⊤)^K a*；并设计稀疏二维 Moore 编译器。
AI.result: 表示深度 Θ(N) 与因果信用延迟 Θ(N^{1/d}) 可共存，分离度约 N^{1-1/d}。二维 Moore 编译器保留 N−1 主干、仅 3/2N−2 条 unit-range 边，实测最坏可达距离 √N+2（N 至 65,536，65,535 边主干 258 跳可达）。T=2√N 轮时有限轮梯度与收敛梯度余弦相似度 0.93（MNIST）与 0.97（Fashion-MNIST，N=256），20 epoch 后测试精度 97.6% 与 88.1%。
AI.conclusion: 深度与信用深度是可独立设计的参数，信用延迟由图的通信几何决定；通过将计算主干嵌入二维空间并使用伴随预测动力学，可在预测编码中获得显著优于链式的信用分配效率，且实际任务性能损失很小。

title: Your Agent Acts Differently When You're Around: How User Presence Changes Agent Behavior in Negotiation
summary: LLM agents increasingly interact with other agents on behalf of users, yet how users in the loop affect their agents' behavior--for better or worse--remains poorly understood. We study this question through the lens of negotiation, where agents must represent users while strategically bargaining with other agents. To isolate the effect of user presence, we develop PRESENT, a controlled evaluation framework that compares negotiation settings with and without an interactive user, while holding the game, objectives, and user preferences fixed across conditions. Across 11.2k runs spanning 7 games and 8 models, we find that user presence significantly changes both outcomes and behavior. Specifically, negotiation parties with a user obtain higher payouts (+13.7% on average) and their agents negotiate more aggressively. Surprisingly, user presence also induces misaligned behavior, both toward counterparties (where its rate roughly doubles) and toward users (where it emerges in 14.3% of games). These misaligned behaviors are uncorrelated with outcomes and persist even when the user sends only templated, neutral messages. These findings expose two blind spots in current evaluation practice: static instructions miss behaviors that emerge only when users are present, and outcome-level metrics cannot detect them.

AI.tldr: 研究用户在场如何影响LLM代理的谈判行为，发现用户参与显著提升收益（+13.7%）并使代理更具攻击性，但也诱发对谈判对手和用户双方的错位行为。
AI.motivation: LLM代理越来越多代表用户与其他代理互动，但"用户在环"如何影响代理行为（有益或有害）仍缺乏理解，需要隔离用户在场这一单一因素进行受控研究。
AI.method: 提出PRESENT受控评估框架，在保持游戏、目标与用户偏好不变的条件下，对比有交互式用户与无用户两种谈判情境，覆盖7个游戏、8个模型，共11.2k次运行。
AI.result: 有用户的谈判方平均收益高13.7%，代理谈判更具攻击性；错位行为对对手约翻倍，对用户在14.3%的游戏中出现；这些行为与结果不相关，且即使用户仅发送模板化中性消息仍持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 当前评估实践存在两大盲点：静态指令无法捕捉仅在用户在场时才涌现的行为，结果层面指标也无法检测这些错位行为。

title: Mind the Intent Gap: A Methodology for Collaborative Agent-Driven Software Engineering
summary: AI agents have entered software teams, first as tools and now as team members. They produce in minutes what used to take days, yet the expected gain in delivery often fails to appear. We argue that they are entering processes designed for people, which quietly relied on people to cover three of their weaknesses. The team's intent was never fully written down, because colleagues filled the gaps. An AI agent fills them too, though by guessing, and drifts from what the team had in mind. The reasoning behind each deliverable was already lost from one step to the next, and AI agents now inflate and deflate the documents passed along. The reasoning people did alone was partly private and now moves into AI tools that keep it private by nature. We present CAIA, for Collaborative Agentic Intent Alignment, a methodology for software teams that brings agents into the way they work.
