A knowledge base describes the product that a project maintains. For each Change, a micro-team aligns on its intent before agents evolve the product and propose updates to the Knowledge Base. The proposed CAIA methodology emerged from an industrial need and is already in use at Ni2, with a platform built to support it. We present the methodology and outline our plans to evaluate it further.

AI.tldr: 论文指出AI agent进入软件团队后常未带来预期交付增益，原因在于它们进入了为人设计、隐含依赖人类弥补三项弱点的流程。作者提出CAIA（协作式智能体意图对齐）方法论：用知识库描述产品，每次变更先由微型团队对齐意图，再由agent演化产品并提议更新知识库。
AI.motivation: AI agent已作为团队成员参与软件开发，产出速度快，但交付层面的预期收益未显现。作者认为根因是agent被嵌入到为人类设计的流程中，这些流程默默依赖人来弥补三个薄弱环节：团队意图未完整记录（靠同事补全）、交付物背后的推理在步骤间丢失、以及个人私有推理转移到天生不透明的AI工具中。
AI.method: 提出CAIA（Collaborative Agentic Intent Alignment）方法论。核心机制包括：1）建立描述所维护产品的知识库；2）针对每个Change，先由微团队（micro-team）对齐其意图，再由agent演化产品并提议知识库更新。该平台已在Ni2公司实际落地使用。
AI.result: 这是一篇方法论/立场类论文，来自工业需求，CAIA已在Ni2实际应用并配有支撑平台。论文本身尚未给出量化评估结果，作者表示将在此基础上进一步开展评估计划。
AI.conclusion: 要让AI agent真正提升软件交付，需重新设计team流程而非仅替换工具；通过知识库+变更前的意图对齐+agent提议知识库更新，可缓解意图漂移、推理丢失与私有推理不透明三大问题。后续将进行系统性评估。

title: Language Models Keep Abandoned Analyses: Residue and Adaptation after Garden-Path Sentences
summary: Reading "While the man hunted the deer ran into the woods" requires giving up the analysis in which "the deer" is the object of "hunted". People who have just read such a sentence still produce more transitive structures, so the abandoned analysis primes later language. We ask whether language models keep using an analysis they have abandoned, and what in the model carries it. In 24 open models from 124M to 70B parameters, a garden-path sentence leaves two traces in the context. A residue of the abandoned analysis raises later object attachment, by about three quarters of the effect of a sentence in which the noun phrase really is an object, and it appears in sampled text, on held-out and human-normed items and for a second type of garden path. An adaptation toward the resolved structure scales with the sentence's disambiguation error and acts mainly on comprehension-like measures. Activation patching separates the two. Later text reads the residue from the role information in the noun phrase's states, which were computed under the object analysis before the disambiguation, and replacing these states removes almost all of the residue in the 32B and 70B models. The adaptation is read from the states that processed the disambiguation. Overridden statements show the same persistence (a corrected value keeps pulling later predictions in 8 of 9 models), and in most models the pull is carried by the positions after the statement. Finally, the human paradigm transfers only with controls for punctuation, because the models also write garden-path sentences themselves, which reverses the paradigm's raw statistic.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型是否会保留已被放弃的句法分析（花园路径效应），发现模型上下文中出现"残留"与"适应"两种痕迹，并通过激活修补定位其载体。
AI.motivation: 人类读取花园路径句后仍会被已放弃的宾语分析启动，产生更多及物结构。作者想探究语言模型是否也会持续使用已放弃的分析，以及该痕迹由模型内部什么成分承载。
AI.method: 在124M至70B参数的24个开源模型上测试花园路径句及第二种花园路径、被覆盖/纠正的陈述；用采样文本、留出项与人类规范项测量效应，并结合激活修补（activation patching）分离并定位两种痕迹的载体。
AI.result: 花园路径句在上下文中留下两种痕迹：(1) 被放弃分析的"残留"使后续宾语附着提升约真实宾语句效应的四分之三，且出现在采样文本、留出项、人类规范项及另一类花园路径中；(2) 朝已解决结构的"适应"随消歧误差变化，主要影响类理解指标。激活修补可分离二者：残留可由名词短语状态中的角色信息读出（这些状态在消歧前按宾语分析计算），替换这些状态可消除32B与70B模型中几乎全部残留；适应则从处理消歧的状态读出。被覆盖陈述表现相同持续性（9个模型中8个），多数模型中拉力由陈述之后的位置承载。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型确实会保留并使用已放弃的分析，残留与适应是两种可分离的机制，分别由消歧前的名词短语状态和消歧处理状态承载。人类范式仅在控制标点后才可迁移，因为模型自身也会写出花园路径句，从而反转原始统计结果。

title: RouteDRAG: Learning to Route and Control Agentic Execution for Multimodal Document RAG
comment: Our code is now available at https://github.com/Ereshkigal1/RouteDRAG
summary: Web-based applications increasingly rely on understanding long multimodal documents, where answering questions often requires combining information across pages, tables, and figures. Agentic retrieval-augmented generation addresses these tasks through iterative retrieval and reasoning. However, Agentic execution is not always necessary, introducing additional computation and potentially incorrect answers. Our empirical analysis reveals that Agentic execution provides query-dependent benefits, while additional operations may improve, preserve, or degrade answer accuracy. These findings motivate controlling both Agent invocation and subsequent execution. To address these challenges, we propose RouteDRAG, a learning-based framework comprising four components. Unified Document Index organizes multimodal content into a graph-backed index and derives query representations from initial retrieval. Adaptive Path Routing preserves exact answering and predicts the relative benefit of Agent over shorter execution paths. Dynamic Agent Execution maintains an evolving workspace and refines Planner proposals to control tool use and termination. Sequential Policy Learning first trains operation control from observed outcomes and then trains path routing using the resulting Agent's performance. Across two benchmarks, RouteDRAG achieves an average accuracy improvement of 3.47 percentage points over shorter-path-only execution while assigning only 79.3% of queries to Agent. Notably, it also surpasses uniform Agent execution on both benchmarks while requiring fewer answering calls. Our code is now available at https://github.com/Ereshkigal1/RouteDRAG.

AI.tldr: 提出RouteDRAG学习型框架，通过自适应路径路由与动态Agent执行控制，在只需79.3%查询走Agent的情况下平均提升3.47个百分点准确率。
AI.motivation: Web多模态长文档问答需跨页、表、图整合信息，Agentic RAG虽能迭代检索推理，但并非总是必要，会带来额外计算甚至错误答案；实证发现Agent执行收益依查询而异，额外操作可能提升、保持或降低准确率，因此需同时控制Agent调用与后续执行。
AI.method: RouteDRAG含四组件：统一文档索引（图结构多模态索引并由初始检索导出查询表示）、自适应路径路由（保留精确回答并预测Agent相对更短执行路径的收益）、动态Agent执行（维护演化工作区、精炼Planner提案以控制工具使用与终止）、序列策略学习（先从观测结果训练操作控制，再用所得Agent表现训练路径路由）。
AI.result: 在两个基准上，相较仅走短路径执行平均准确率提升3.47个百分点，且仅将79.3%查询分配给Agent；同时在两基准上均超过统一Agent执行，且所需回答调用更少。
AI.conclusion: 按查询自适应决定是否调用Agent并控制执行过程，可在提升准确率的同时降低计算开销，优于无条件Agent执行。

title: HIDE: Hierarchical Isolation via Documentation and Evidence for Rustc Bugs
summary: Rustc bugs can prevent valid programs from compiling or cause incorrect compilation results, making the identification of responsible source files essential for repair. Using large language models (LLMs) for rustc bug isolation raises three challenges. First, distributed compiler functionality requires understanding both what individual files do and how they work together. Second, a large source file search space makes exhaustive analysis of all files costly. Third, including documentation and source code for many candidate files in LLM prompts leads to context overload, which can reduce bug isolation accuracy. We propose HIDE, a hierarchical LLM-based approach that combines compiler documentation with bug evidence to rank suspicious rustc source files. Given a rustc revision and a bug context, HIDE consists of two stages that generate compiler documentation and narrow the search space. To understand distributed compiler functionality, the Layered Documentation Aggregation stage summarizes what individual files do and how files with similar functions work together. To reduce the large source file search space, the Hierarchical Bug Isolation stage uses hierarchical candidate selection to reduce the number of files requiring detailed analysis. To mitigate context overload, this stage uses Scoped Candidate Competition and Evidence-Guided Code Slicing to limit the number of candidates and the amount of source code included in each prompt, respectively. We evaluate HIDE on 160 reproducible rustc bugs and compare it with Agentless, SoapFL, and GraphLocator. With GPT-5.4, HIDE achieves 42.08% Accuracy@1 and 80.42% Accuracy@10, exceeding the strongest baseline results by 5.83% and 6.04%, respectively. These results demonstrate that generating compiler documentation, narrowing candidates hierarchically, and limiting analysis context enable effective rustc bug isolation.

AI.tldr: HIDE: 一种分层 LLM 方法，通过生成编译器文档、分层筛选候选文件与证据驱动代码切片，定位 rustc 缺陷的负责源文件。
AI.motivation: rustc 缺陷会导致有效程序无法编译或产生错误编译结果，定位责任源文件是修复的关键。用 LLM 做定位面临三大挑战：(1) 编译器功能分布在不同文件，需同时理解单文件职责与文件间协作；(2) 源文件搜索空间大，穷举分析代价高；(3) 将大量候选文件的文档与代码放入提示会造成上下文过载，降低准确性。
AI.method: HIDE 分两阶段。阶段一"分层文档聚合"（Layered Documentation Aggregation）：为单文件生成功能摘要，并汇总功能相似文件之间的协作关系。阶段二"分层缺陷定位"（Hierarchical Bug Isolation）：采用分层候选选择缩小需详细分析的文件数；并通过"限定范围候选竞争"（Scoped Candidate Competition）限制候选数量、"证据引导代码切片"（Evidence-Guided Code Slicing）限制每个提示中纳入的代码量，以缓解上下文过载。
AI.result: 在 160 个可复现 rustc 缺陷上评估，与 Agentless、SoapFL、GraphLocator 对比。使用 GPT-5.4 时，HIDE 达到 42.08% Accuracy@1 和 80.42% Accuracy@10，分别超过最强基线 5.83% 和 6.04%。
AI.conclusion: 生成编译器文档、分层缩小候选范围、限定分析上下文三者结合，可有效实现 rustc 缺陷定位。

title: Personality Latents: Conditioning Frozen Language Models on Individuals from Their Own Writing
summary: Controlling the personality of a language model usually relies on written profiles or named trait categories, so it can only express what an author writes down or what a taxonomy names. We instead propose Personality Latents (PL), which learn a latent for each person from their own writing, with no personality labels and no authored profile, and inject it into a frozen language model as a soft prefix. Following generative latent optimization, each training person receives a free latent that is optimized through the frozen model itself, while an encoder learns to predict these latents so that a new person needs only one forward pass, with optional refinement at test time. We evaluate on held-out people by having the conditioned model answer neutral and interview questions and reading personality from its answers with scorers trained on real human writing. On the MBTI axes PL reaches an AUC of , ahead of persona embedding and prompt-based baselines under identical settings, and the ranking holds when the answers are scored in three different embedding spaces. A latent learned with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct also transfers personality to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct through a new adapter alone.

AI.tldr: 提出Personality Latents (PL)，从个人写作中无标签学习人格潜在向量，作为软前缀注入冻结语言模型，实现可迁移的人格控制。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型人格控制依赖书面画像或命名特质类别，只能表达作者写下的内容或分类体系命名的特质，受限明显。
AI.method: 沿用生成式潜变量优化：每个训练者获得一个自由潜在向量，通过冻结模型优化；编码器学习预测这些潜在向量，使新用户只需一次前向即可获得，测试时可选精修；潜在向量以软前缀注入冻结模型。
AI.result: 在留出人物上，用真实人类写作训练的评分器从模型回答中读取人格；MBTI各轴上达到AUC（数值原文缺失），在相同设置下超过persona embedding与prompt基线，且在三种嵌入空间评分下排序一致；用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct学到的潜在向量可仅靠新适配器迁移至Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。
AI.conclusion: 无需人格标签与手写画像的潜在人格表示可有效控制冻结语言模型的人格，并具备跨模型迁移能力。

title: From Generation to Scoring: Scaling LLM-Based Semantic Labeling at LinkedIn
summary: For efficiency, industrial large language model (LLM) labelers often pack many candidate labels into one prompt and generate a YES/NO answer for each, even when each decision depends only on the entity and one candidate. Generating these independent decisions as one answer list couples them, spends decoding on the list, and relies on the list being well-formed. In this paper, we present an end-to-end recipe that reformulates the labeler as semantic scoring, fine-tuning it on single-candidate prompts to return each decision as one answer-token score from a prefill-only pass. We also adapt Multiple-Item Scoring (MIS) to score hundreds of candidates in one sequence with attention masked between them. Deployed for profile qualification labeling at LinkedIn, semantic scoring changes at most 0.01% of decisions when candidates are reordered and matches the agreement with reference labels that packed generation reaches only with about 4.7x as many training pairs. The MIS-based stack raises throughput over the deployed stack by 1.24x offline and 1.9x in model serving under a one-second p99 latency target. For offline batch inference, we implement MIS-based scoring as a reusable, model-agnostic Ray Data API proposed for upstream adoption. Model serving uses MIS support contributed to SGLang.

AI.tldr: 将工业LLM标注器改造为"语义打分"：单候选prompt微调，用prefill一遍输出每个YES/NO为一个answer-token分数，并适配MIS一次打分数百候选；在LinkedIn落地上实现更高一致性、顺序鲁棒性及1.24x/1.9x吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: 工业界将多个候选标签打包进一个prompt、逐个生成YES/NO，效率上有诱惑，但存在三个问题：各独立决策被答案列表耦合、解码开销花在列表本身、且依赖列表格式良构。需要一种更高效且鲁棒的标注方案。
AI.method: 端到端方法：(1) 把标注器重构为语义打分任务，在单候选prompt上微调，使每个决策仅由一次prefill前向的某个answer-token分数给出；(2) 将Multiple-Item Scoring (MIS) 适配为可在一条序列中给数百候选打分，并在候选间做attention mask隔离，保证互不干扰；(3) 离线批推理封装为模型无关的Ray Data API（提报上游采纳），在线serving基于向SGLang贡献的MIS支持。
AI.result: 在LinkedIn的profile资质标注场景：候选重排序时语义打分最多只改变0.01%的决策；达到与打包式生成相同的参考标签一致度，语义打分所需训练对仅约1/4.7。基于MIS的栈相比已部署栈，离线吞吐提升1.24x，在p99延迟1秒约束下模型serving吞吐提升1.9x。
AI.conclusion: 以单候选语义打分替代打包生成，可在不损失标注质量的前提下大幅降低训练数据需求并提升顺序鲁棒性；配合MIS的attention隔离，能高效批量打分数百候选，且通过Ray Data与SGLang落地为可复用工程组件。

title: Spatial-Frequency Learning for Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy Image Enhancement
summary: Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (STEM) enables the observation of atomic arrangements at sub-angstrom resolution and plays a key role in the discovery and characterization of advanced materials. Raw STEM images are often noisy and blurred due to multiple degradations. Although recent deep learning methods improve STEM images, their performance remains limited under severe degradations. In this work, we propose a spatial-frequency learning framework for STEM image enhancement. Specifically, we design a spatial-frequency fusion network that exploits periodic atomic arrangements in the frequency domain and restores local atomic details in the spatial domain. Spatial- and frequency-domain features are enhanced separately and then fused. We also present a STEM noise calibration method for synthesizing more realistic STEM images. The parameters of scan noise, pointwise noise, and background noise are estimated through statistical analysis and fitting of real STEM images. Using these calibrated parameters, we construct a diverse dataset containing a wider range of atomic arrangements, imaging modes, and degradations. Random masks combine different atomic arrangements to simulate interfaces between multiple materials. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art enhancement performance on synthetic datasets and real images of advanced materials while improving atomic localization accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出空间-频率融合网络与STEM噪声标定方法，用于严重退化STEM图像增强，提升原子定位精度。
AI.motivation: 原始STEM图像常受多种退化影响而含噪模糊；现有深度学习方法在严重退化下性能仍受限，且缺乏逼真的STEM图像合成手段。
AI.method: 设计空间-频率融合网络：在频域利用原子周期性排列、在空域恢复局部原子细节，两域特征分别增强后融合；并提出STEM噪声标定方法，通过统计分析与拟合真实图像估计扫描噪声、逐点噪声和背景噪声参数，构建多样性数据集，用随机掩码组合不同原子排列以模拟多材料界面。
AI.result: 在合成数据集与先进材料真实图像上达到SOTA增强性能，并提升原子定位精度。
AI.conclusion: 空频域联合学习结合真实噪声标定的数据合成，可有效增强严重退化的STEM图像，为材料原子级表征提供支持。

title: Bayesian Evidence Accumulation for Graph-Based Learning in Dynamic Data-Driven Applications Systems
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used in modern machine learning, yet most existing frameworks remain fundamentally static, limiting their applicability in Dynamic Data Driven Application Systems (DDDAS) where observations arrive sequentially under uncertainty. We introduce B-EAGLe (Bayesian Evidence Accumulation for Graph-Based Learning), a probabilistic framework inspired by CBGT-Net (cortico-basal ganglia-thalamic network) that reformulates graph classification as a sequential evidence accumulation process. B-EAGLe combines a GNN encoder with a Bayesian accumulator that incrementally updates posterior beliefs over class labels as new observations arrive, committing to a decision only when sufficient confidence is achieved. Experiments on CIFAR10 demonstrate competitive performance together with principled confidence estimation under sequential observations.

AI.tldr: 提出B-EAGLe框架，将图分类重构为序贯证据累积过程，用GNN编码器结合贝叶斯累积器在动态观测下逐次更新后验并达到置信度时决策。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN框架多为静态，难以适用于观测序贯到达且含不确定性的动态数据驱动应用系统（DDDAS）。
AI.method: 受CBGT-Net（皮层-基底神经节-丘脑网络）启发，提出B-EAGLe（Bayesian Evidence Accumulation for Graph-Based Learning）：GNN编码器提取图表示，贝叶斯累积器随新观测增量更新类标签后验，仅在置信度足够时做出决策。
AI.result: 在CIFAR10上取得有竞争力的性能，并在序贯观测下提供有原则（calibrated）的置信度估计。
AI.conclusion: B-EAGLe为动态图下的序贯分类提供统一概率框架，兼顾性能与不确定性建模，适配DDDAS场景。

title: From Solver Trajectories to Teaching Trajectories: Cognition-Aligned Reasoning Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation from large reasoning models (LRMs) often uses raw teacher trajectories as supervision. However, this practice creates a mismatch between the goal of distillation and the nature of teacher trajectories. Advanced LRMs typically improve their reasoning capabilities through reward-driven post-training, such as RLHF. This training optimizes them as strong solvers, rather than as teachers that produce reasoning processes smaller models can easily learn. Since smaller models have different "cognitive capacities" compared to their larger teachers, directly imitating raw teacher trajectories can sometimes be ineffective and often requires a substantial number of high-quality samples. To bridge this mismatch, we propose Cognition-Aligned Reasoning Distillation (CARD), an RL-based framework that transforms solver trajectories into teaching trajectories aligned with the student's cognition. Avoiding expensive resampling, our framework directly transforms existing trajectories. We optimize CARD with two reward signals: (1) a Distribution Alignment Reward that matches the student's predictive distribution, and (2) a Logical Coherence Reward that reduces misleading failed reasoning steps. Comprehensive evaluations across multiple student models and settings demonstrate that CARD outperforms distillation from raw teacher trajectories in in-domain settings while achieving substantial gains in out-of-distribution performance. Code is available at https://github.com/LiteSSLHub/CARD.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CARD框架，用强化学习将大型推理模型的"解题轨迹"转化为与学生认知对齐的"教学轨迹"进行知识蒸馏，避免昂贵重采样，在域内和域外均优于直接模仿原始教师轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有从大型推理模型（LRM）蒸馏时直接用原始教师轨迹作为监督，但教师经强化学习后训练成强"解题者"而非"教学者"，其推理过程与学生"认知能力"不匹配，直接模仿效果不佳且需大量高质量样本，存在目标与轨迹性质间的错配。
AI.method: CARD是RL框架，直接变换已有轨迹（而非重采样）为学生认知对齐的教学轨迹，使用两个奖励信号优化：(1)分布对齐奖励，匹配学生的预测分布；(2)逻辑连贯奖励，减少误导性的失败推理步骤。
AI.result: 在多种学生模型和设置下评测，CARD在域内设置优于从原始教师轨迹蒸馏，并在分布外性能上取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 将解题轨迹改造为教学轨迹的认知对齐蒸馏思路有效，可在不增加采样成本的情况下提升小模型推理蒸馏性能，尤其是域外泛化能力；代码已开源。

title: FeatureArc: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Evolving Features
summary: A software feature usually evolves over time: developers extend its first version as new use cases and requirements arrive, and each extension builds on code written earlier. Most feature benchmarks evaluate a single request on a fixed codebase. Feature evolution requires evaluating successive extensions on an agent's own earlier code and checking whether the feature remains correct. We introduce FeatureArc to evaluate coding agents on evolving features, together with a pipeline that constructs its tasks from repository histories. The benchmark combines dependencies between successive stages of the same feature, explicit requirements and interface contracts, and executable checks across four programming languages. The pipeline validates fail-to-pass (F2P) tests for new behavior and pass-to-pass (P2P) tests for existing behavior on the reference code before and after each stage. We evaluated 10 coding agents on 73 manually reviewed tasks of 2 to 10 stages. Each agent works in one persistent session and workspace without external test feedback or rollback. The evaluation reveals a gap between first-stage and whole-feature success: pooled success falls from 62.7% at the first stage to 28.5% when the whole feature is tested on the final code. Trajectory analysis identifies inherited defects as a common failure mechanism, present in 72.9% of failed later stages. These earlier errors often remain undetected: in stages following a failure, agents leave the earlier error unnoticed about 95% of the time, and their self-tests rarely revisit earlier stages. Evolving a feature autonomously, without human checks between stages, therefore remains a substantial challenge for current coding agents. At Tencent, the pipeline extends internal evaluations to this setting and guides the development of Hunyuan, Tencent's family of large language models.

AI.tldr: 提出 FeatureArc 基准，用于评测编码智能体在"特性演化"场景下的能力。结果显示首阶段成功率62.7%，但整特性在最终代码上仅28.5%，继承性缺陷是主要失败原因。
AI.motivation: 现有特性基准大多只在固定代码库上评测单个请求，而真实开发中特性会不断扩展，每一次扩展都建立在智能体自己早先写的代码之上。因此需要评测"连续扩展 + 检查特性是否仍正确"的能力。
AI.method: 构建 FeatureArc 基准及从仓库历史自动生成任务的流水线：包含同一特性连续阶段间的依赖、显式需求与接口契约、跨四种编程语言的可执行检查；对每阶段前后参考代码验证 F2P（新行为）和 P2P（已有行为）测试。在73个经人工审核、2–10阶段的任务上评测10个编码智能体，每个智能体在单一持久会话和工作区中运行，无外部测试反馈或回滚。
AI.result: 首阶段合并成功率62.7%，整特性在最终代码上降至28.5%。轨迹分析显示继承性缺陷是常见失败机制，出现在72.9%的后期失败阶段中；失败后约95%的情况下智能体未察觉早先错误，自测也很少回溯早期阶段。
AI.conclusion: 在没有人工阶段间检查的情况下自主演化特性，对当前编码智能体仍是重大挑战。腾讯已将该流水线用于内部评测扩展，并指导混元大模型家族的开发。

title: Weakness Localization Is Not Enough: State-Aware Recursive Knowledge Improvement for Large Language Models
summary: Knowledge improvement in large language models is shifting from predefined knowledge incorporation pipelines toward evaluation-guided updating. Existing methods use evaluation to localize model-specific knowledge weaknesses and guide targeted post-training. However, identifying what to improve does not necessarily provide sufficient information for deciding how to improve it. The same localized weakness can be compatible with distinct operational knowledge states: the relevant knowledge may be unavailable, available but difficult to access reliably, or accessible but ineffective for downstream use. We call this ambiguity knowledge-state aliasing. When compatible states favor different interventions, greater diagnostic resolution alone is insufficient for intervention selection. Moreover, model updates can change the underlying knowledge state before the observed weakness disappears, such that an intervention appropriate in one round may no longer address the bottleneck in the next. To address these challenges, we propose Recursive Knowledge Improvement (RKI), which formulates knowledge improvement as a sequential, state-aware intervention process. RKI organizes knowledge into graph-structured units that provide a shared basis for diagnostic evaluation and targeted intervention across rounds. At each round, RKI localizes knowledge weaknesses, estimates the model's operational knowledge state from diagnostic evidence and intervention history, selects a corresponding intervention, and re-evaluates the updated model before determining the next intervention. On HotpotEval and SafeInternalEval, RKI outperforms existing knowledge incorporation methods by 18.41 points on average. Further analyses show that knowledge states provide additional guidance for intervention selection beyond weakness localization and can change across model updates even when the observed weakness persists.

AI.tldr: 提出Recursive Knowledge Improvement (RKI)，将知识改进建模为序列化、状态感知的干预过程，解决"知识状态混叠"问题，在两个基准上平均超越现有方法18.41分。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅用评测定位模型的知识弱点并指导后训练，但"知道改什么"不等于"知道怎么改"：同一弱点可能对应不同的知识状态（不可用/可用但难稳定调用/可访问但下游使用无效），即"知识状态混叠"；且模型更新会在弱点消失前改变知识状态，使上一轮的干预在下一轮失效。
AI.method: RKI将知识组织为图结构单元，作为跨轮次诊断与干预的共享基础；每轮依次：定位知识弱点→结合诊断证据与干预历史估计模型的操作性知识状态→选择对应干预→对更新后模型重新评测，再决定下一轮干预。
AI.result: 在HotpotEval与SafeInternalEval上，RKI平均比现有知识注入方法高18.41分；分析表明知识状态在弱点定位之外为干预选择提供了额外指导，且即使观察到的弱点持续存在，知识状态也可能随模型更新而变化。
AI.conclusion: 知识改进需要从"定位弱点"升级为"状态感知的序贯干预"，显式估计知识状态并动态重评，是提升LLM知识改进效果的关键。

title: GarmentSegAgent: Autonomous Garment Segmentation for Web Fashion Images via Textual Self-Refinement
summary: Web fashion images support applications such as visual product search and consumer-to-shop matching, yet their visual heterogeneity makes reliable garment segmentation challenging. Despite advances in promptable segmentation, autonomously identifying and correcting garment-specific errors without human-provided spatial prompts remains difficult. We propose GarmentSegAgent, an autonomous framework that integrates semantic planning, spatial execution, and visual evaluation through iterative textual self-refinement. At its core, we introduce CAST (Constrained Attribution-guided Selective TextGrad), which connects visual error attribution with targeted textual optimization. CAST identifies instruction components responsible for segmentation errors, selectively updates them through textual gradients, and validates the resulting instructions against garment-specific constraints. This enables image-specific error correction at inference time while keeping the underlying foundation models frozen. Experiments on DeepFashion2, ModaNet, and Fashionpedia demonstrate consistent improvements in region overlap and boundary accuracy, alongside more reliable refinement than conventional TextGrad. By enabling visual feedback to guide controlled instruction updates, GarmentSegAgent offers a promising direction for autonomous garment understanding, with potential applications in scalable fashion content analysis, visual retrieval, and consumer-to-shop matching on the Web.

AI.tldr: 提出 GarmentSegAgent 自主服装分割框架，核心是 CAST 文本自优化方法，在无需人工空间提示下迭代修正分割错误。
AI.motivation: 网络时尚图像的视觉异质性使服装分割困难；现有可提示分割方法在无人工空间提示时难以自主识别并修正服装特有的错误。
AI.method: 构建自主框架，整合语义规划、空间执行与视觉评估，通过迭代文本自优化闭环；核心 CAST（约束归因引导的选择性 TextGrad）将视觉错误归因与有目标的文本优化相连：定位导致错误的指令成分，用文本梯度选择性更新，并按服装专属约束校验新指令，实现推理时图像级纠错且基础模型保持冻结。
AI.result: 在 DeepFashion2、ModaNet、Fashionpedia 上，区域重叠与边界精度均稳定提升，且优化可靠性优于常规 TextGrad。
AI.conclusion: 视觉反馈引导受控指令更新为自主服装理解提供新方向，可支撑可扩展的时尚内容分析、视觉检索与消费者到店铺匹配等网络应用。

title: Base Models Can Detect Hidden Intentions that Prompted Classifiers Miss
summary: The Persona Selection Model (PSM) posits that post-training selects a persona the model learned during pre-training. Work on subliminal learning has shown that models can impart covert signals (like "love of owls") into semantically unrelated outputs like strings of numbers, and that students trained on these outputs inherit those traits. In this work I show that by evaluating the likelihood of such outputs under the base pre-trained model with an appropriate header, a method I call persona-header likelihood evaluation (PHLE), one can decode these subliminal signals and classify between them. For example, PHLE distinguishes number sequences generated by a post-trained model prompted with "You love owls" from those prompted with "You love eagles", and distinguishes answers from a model with a secret desire to harm the user, filtered to remove any noticeable misalignment, from those of a model with no system prompt. In both cases prompted classifiers, including the generating model itself, remain near chance. The signal partially persists across model families, with the Qwen base model reading signals generated by Olmo and vice versa. This is evidence for a non-trivial prediction of the PSM, and the method may be practically useful for auditing the hidden objectives of models.

AI.tldr: 通过在基础预训练模型上配合合适的"头部"评估输出似然（PHLE），可解码模型输出中的潜意识信号（如"爱猫头鹰"、隐藏有害意图），实现约高于随机的分类，为Persona Selection Model提供证据并可用于审计隐藏目标。
AI.motivation: 验证Persona Selection Model（PSM）的一个非平凡预测：后训练所选择的persona是否在预训练基础模型中就以可检测方式存在；同时探索检测模型输出中潜意识信号、审计隐藏目标的实用方法。
AI.method: 提出persona-header likelihood evaluation (PHLE)：在基础预训练模型上附加合适的头部，计算语义无关输出（如数字串、经过滤的答案）的似然，从而在两类潜意识信号间分类。对比提示分类器（包括生成模型自身）的表现，并做跨模型族检验（Qwen读Olmo信号及反向）。
AI.result: PHLE能区分"你爱猫头鹰"与"你爱鹰"生成的数字序列，以及隐藏害人意图（过滤掉明显不对齐）与无系统提示模型的回答；而提示分类器（含生成模型自身）接近随机水平。信号可部分跨模型族保留（Qwen与Olmo互相读取）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持PSM关于后训练选择已学persona的预测，并表明PHLE可能成为审计模型隐藏目标的实际工具。

title: A Heart Means Recursion: Exploring Visual Meaning and Communication in VLMs
summary: Do vision-language models (VLMs) share our ability to communicate visually? We share preliminary findings, starting from a surprising observation: simple visual symbols like a red heart can strongly influence model behavior on seemingly unrelated tasks, such as steering models towards recursive solutions on simple coding problems. Notably, this steering effect is largely implicit, as models' direct interpretations and thinking traces about visual symbols diverge substantially from their observed behavior. In visual communication between models, this leads to a generation--interpretation gap: while models tend to send shape primitives that they (and humans) find intuitive, these visual cues often fail to steer other models. In further communication games involving abstract concepts and stories, models can creatively use visuals to transmit meaning to one another, although some communications remain non-intuitive to humans. These findings reveal that VLMs might be capable of rich, creative, and visually-grounded communication, but their interpretation and production of visual meaning diverges from human conventions in surprising ways. Together this work highlights both the promise and challenges of visual communication between humans and VLMs.

AI.tldr: 研究初步发现：简单视觉符号（如红心）能隐式地影响VLM在无关任务上的行为；模型间视觉通信存在"生成—解读鸿沟"，即模型发出的直觉性形状常无法有效引导其他模型，但在抽象概念与故事游戏中仍能创造性传递意义。
AI.motivation: 探究视觉-语言模型是否具备与人类相似的视觉沟通能力，以及模型如何解读和产生视觉意义。
AI.method: 从"红心符号影响编程题递归解法"这一意外观察出发，考察符号对行为的隐式引导（对比模型的直接解读与思维链），并设计模型间视觉通信游戏（形状原语、抽象概念、故事）。
AI.result: 视觉符号的引导作用大部分是隐式的，模型对符号的显式解释与思维轨迹同实际行为明显偏离；模型倾向发送自己与人类都觉得直观的形状原语，却常无法引导其他模型，形成生成—解读鸿沟；在涉及抽象概念与故事的通信中，模型能创造性地用视觉传意，但部分通信对人类而言并不直观。
AI.conclusion: VLM或具备丰富、创造性的视觉基础沟通能力，但其视觉意义的解读与生成方式以出人意料的方式偏离人类惯例，凸显人机视觉沟通的潜力与挑战。

title: An EVM-Cosmos Bridge for Atomic, Semantic-Preserving Transfer of Environmental Tokens
summary: Transferring semantically typed tokens between heterogeneous blockchains (e.g. EVM and Cosmos ecosystems) raises two problems: semantic mixing, the loss of a token's domainspecific meaning in transit (e.g., CO2 removals issued under different methodologies), and atomicity despite divergent consensus and timing assumptions. We propose a bridge that addresses both. A deterministic indicator identity derived from cryptographic commitments, mirrored in class registries on both chains and checked at mint time, preventing semantic mixing by construction. For atomicity, we extend hash time-locked contracts (HTLCs) from two-party exchange to single-owner transfer with an automatic callback that burns the source escrow after a destination claim, and a protocol-minimum bounty that makes the fallback burn incentive-compatible even against adversarial senders. We machine-check the protocol's invariants with TLC (supply conservation fails without the rational-monitor assumption and holds with it) and validate a bidirectional prototype on Polygon and Neutron mainnets over Axelar GMP: fully automatic transfers with a median end-to-end latency of 97 s over 50 Polygon to Neutron transfers across 7 days (all completed by the on-chain automatic callback) and 93 s in the reverse direction, and semantic-validation overhead below 0.4% of messaging cost. We also document the integration failure modes of Cosmos originated messaging, whose dominant operational risk proves to be relay eligibility rather than latency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种跨异构链（EVM↔Cosmos）的语义类型化代币桥，通过指示器身份+类注册表防止语义混淆，并扩展HTLC实现单所有者转移的原子性；在Polygon与Neutron主网上验证，端到端中位延迟约95秒。
AI.motivation: 跨链转移语义类型化代币存在两大问题：一是语义混淆，代币在传递中丢失领域特定含义（如不同方法学签发的CO2清除量）；二是原子性，即需在共识与时间假设各异的两条链间保证操作原子完成。
AI.method: 1) 用密码学承诺派生确定性指示器身份，在两条链的类注册表中镜像并在铸造时校验，从构造上防止语义混淆；2) 将HTLC从双方交换扩展为带自动回调的单所有者转移——目的链认领后自动销毁源链托管，并设置协议最低赏金，使回退销毁即使面对恶意发送者仍具激励相容性；3) 用TLC模型检测协议不变量。
AI.result: TLC验证显示：不假设理性监控者时供给守恒会失败，加入该假设后成立。基于Axelar GMP在Polygon与Neutron主网实现双向原型：7天内50笔Polygon→Neutron转移全部由链上自动回调完成，端到端中位延迟97秒；反向为93秒；语义校验开销低于消息成本的0.4%。并记录了Cosmos源发消息的集成失效模式，其主要运营风险是中继资格而非延迟。
AI.conclusion: 该桥从构造上消除了语义混淆并保证了原子性，主网实测证明全自动跨链转移在百秒级延迟内可行，语义校验成本可忽略；同时指出Cosmos源发消息时中继资格是首要运营风险。

title: Words or Deeds? How LLMs Predict Users' Decisions in Human-Agent Dialogue
summary: Web systems increasingly predict users' decisions from what users say, yet when interests partly conflict, users may promise to cooperate to win the other side's cooperation and then not do so. Sales or service agents that rely on such promises may grant concessions to users who then do not keep their promises, at a cost to the party they represent. We test how LLMs combine users' statements with decision records to predict users' decisions, using 1,260 rounds in which 42 users played a repeated prisoner's dilemma-style game with five agents, each prompted to express a dominant Big Five trait, and could talk with the agent before every decision. Across eight open-weight LLMs, predictions from decision records separated cooperation from defection well (AUC = .80), and adding dialogue brought no detectable gain. With dialogue, predictions agreed with users' statements more often, and errors concentrated on rounds in which users broke their statements: accuracy on rounds with a statement barely changed (.73 to .74), while it rose on kept statements (.76 to .95) and fell sharply on broken ones (.65 to .17). Predictions weighted statements more heavily than users' behavior warranted: when users stated a decision they had not yet made in that game, the predicted probability of keeping it rose from .13 to .69, whereas users kept .40 of such statements. Users' decisions also varied with the agent they faced, but predictions hardly reflected this: users cooperated more with the Agreeableness agent than with the Extraversion agent (70.6% vs. 54.5%), whereas predicted cooperation was nearly identical (64.5% vs. 63.1%). Users also cooperated more with an agent when they themselves scored higher on that agent's trait, whereas predicted cooperation barely changed with these scores. Dialogue-based predictions should therefore weigh users' statements by their earlier decisions and the agent they face.

AI.tldr: 本研究用重复囚徒困境实验（42名用户、1260轮、5个被提示不同大五人格特质的智能体）检验8个开源LLM如何结合用户言语陈述与决策记录来预测用户决策。结果显示决策记录预测准确（AUC=.80），加入对话无显著增益，但模型过度相信用户的言语承诺，忽略其历史行为与所面对智能体的影响。
AI.motivation: 随着Web系统越来越依赖用户陈述来预测其决策，当利益部分冲突时，用户可能口头承诺合作以换取对方让步却不履行。依赖此类承诺的服务或销售智能体因此可能做出错误让步，损害其代表方利益。作者希望检验LLM在同时获得用户陈述与历史决策记录时，是否能正确权衡二者。
AI.method: 设计重复囚徒困境式博弈实验：42名用户与5个智能体交互，每个智能体被提示表现出一种占主导的大五人格特质，用户在每轮决策前可与智能体对话。共1260轮。用8个开源权重LLM预测用户决策，比较仅用决策记录与叠加对话两种条件下预测效果，并分析预测对用户陈述、历史行为和智能体特质的敏感度。
AI.result: 仅凭决策记录已能较好区分合作与背叛（AUC=.80），加入对话后无明显提升。有对话时预测更倾向与用户陈述一致，误差集中在违背承诺的轮次：含陈述轮次准确率几乎不变（.73→.74），守信轮次上升（.76→.95），失信轮次骤降（.65→.17）。模型高估守信率：对游戏中尚未发生的“陈述决策”，预测守信概率从.13升至.69，而实际仅.40。用户决策随对手智能体变化（对宜人性智能体合作70.6% vs 外向性54.5%），但预测几乎不反映该差异（64.5% vs 63.1%）；用户自身与智能体特质匹配时合作更多，而预测几乎不随其变化。
AI.conclusion: 基于对话的预测应根据用户此前的决策记录以及所面对的智能体来对言语陈述进行折价加权，而非直接采信陈述；当前LLM在权衡“说”与“做”时系统性高估承诺可信度，且忽视对手人格特质的影响，可能导致下游系统做出错误的让步与决策。

title: Monitor Accuracy Isn't the Answer: A Decision-Value Framework for Evaluating AI Agent Restart Monitors
summary: Classification accuracy and true-positive and false-positive rates alone do not determine whether restarting an AI agent improves success. Using an exact alarm-to-action identity for an independent clean restart with zero monitoring overhead, we show analytically that a monitor with fixed 90% accuracy can swing from a five-percentage-point loss to a 35-point gain in success rate, depending solely on the replacement attempt's residual-budget success probability. We introduce two techniques for evaluating monitors and progress signals in decision terms. First, a decision-sufficiency criterion, a binary-action specialization of Blackwell's comparison of experiments, identifies which progress representations or context compressions preserve the information needed to choose optimally between the specified actions, independent of trace reconstruction fidelity. Second, a finite-sample, model-free decision audit uses simultaneous binomial intervals over existing agent traces, without additional model calls, to certify a preference for "restart" or "continue" under stated sampling assumptions, or return "abstain" when evidence is insufficient. In a study of 194 externally evaluated model executions on 19 selected SymPy issues from SWE-bench Verified, with a retrospective audit of 130 of these traces, we find a 2.29-point apparent restart gain traced to a single surviving failed attempt, a 42.29-point loss on a second model, no positive replication of the initial gain on prospective task cohorts, and zero of 103 live comparisons meeting the specified certification bar. These results motivate evaluating agent monitors through recovery opportunity, decision value, and statistical support, rather than classification performance alone.

AI.tldr: 仅凭分类准确率与真/假正率无法判断重启AI agent是否提升成功率；应以"恢复机会、决策价值、统计支撑"来评估监控器与进展信号。
AI.motivation: 现有实践常用分类准确率、TPR/FPR来评价agent监控器（判断何时重启/继续），但这些指标无法说明重启决策能否真正改善任务成功率；作者希望建立以决策为核心的评估框架。
AI.method: (1) 精确的alarm-to-action身份与零监控开销的干净重启，解析地刻画监控准确率固定时成功率增益随"替换尝试的剩余预算成功概率"的变化；(2) 提出决策充分性准则——Blackwell实验比较的二动作特例，判定进展表示/上下文压缩是否保留最优决策所需信息（与轨迹重建保真度无关）；(3) 提出有限样本、免模型的决策审计：对已有agent轨迹用同时二项区间，无需额外模型调用即可认证"重启"或"继续"偏好，证据不足则"弃权"。实验：SWE-bench Verified中19个SymPy问题、194次外部评估的模型执行，含130条轨迹的回溯审计与103次在线比较。
AI.result: 解析结果显示固定90%准确率的监控器可使成功率从-5个百分点变为+35个百分点，仅取决于替换尝试的剩余预算成功概率。实证中：2.29个百分点的表面重启增益可追溯至单次幸存的失败尝试；第二个模型上出现42.29个百分点损失；前瞻任务队列未复现初始增益；103次在线比较中0次达到认证标准。
AI.conclusion: agent监控器应以恢复机会、决策价值和统计支撑而非分类性能来评估；表面增益可能极不稳定甚至由单条轨迹驱动，须用决策充分性与有限样本认证来把关重启决策。

title: ARISE: Authentic Reference-Informed Stability Enhancement for Continual Multimodal Forgery Detection
summary: Multimodal forgery detection is commonly studied under a static assumption: training attacks are expected to approximate those encountered after deployment. This assumption becomes increasingly fragile as generators, editing systems, and multimodal large language models continually introduce new forgery mechanisms and forensic evidence. We formulate this problem as attack-incremental continual multimodal forgery detection, where the binary real/fake interface remains fixed while emerging attacks must be learned without forgetting previous ones. We introduce Fable-Bench, which organizes attack evolution through complementary joint-modality, text-side, and image-side protocols. We further propose ARISE (Authentic Reference-Informed Stability Enhancement), motivated by the open-ended forged class and the comparatively reusable geometry of authentic content. ARISE fits a real-only Gaussian mixture model to projected authentic replay representations as a compact historical reference. Meanwhile, the proposed Gaussian-Responsibility-Aware Stability Preservation (GRASP) derives a sample-adaptive anisotropic metric that strongly constrains historically stable representation directions while retaining plasticity elsewhere. Our Vulnerability-Aware Replay (VAR) further estimates stage-wise vulnerability from authentic-density degradation, forged-to-authentic boundary confusion, and authentic-mode occupancy drift, then assigns bounded replay emphasis to fragile stages. All adaptive signals are obtained from training-time replay statistics, while inference uses only the original multimodal backbone and binary classification head. Experiments across three attack-evolution protocols and multiple detector architectures demonstrate improved historical retention and final average performance over representative continual-learning baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"攻击增量式持续多模态伪造检测"新问题，构建Fable-Bench基准，并提出ARISE方法（真实样本GMM参考+GRASP各向异性稳定约束+VAR脆弱度重放），在不改变二分类接口前提下学习新攻击且不忘旧攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态伪造检测默认训练攻击与部署攻击近似（静态假设），但生成器、编辑系统和MLLM不断产生新伪造机制与取证证据，该假设失效；需要在固定真/假二分类接口下持续学习新攻击而不遗忘旧攻击。
AI.method: 1) Fable-Bench：用联合模态、文本侧、图像侧三类互补协议组织攻击演化；2) ARISE：仅对真实样本的投影重放表示拟合高斯混合模型，作为紧凑历史参考；3) GRASP：由GMM责任度导出样本自适应各向异性度量，强约束历史稳定方向、其他方向保留可塑性；4) VAR：从真实密度退化、真假边界混淆、真实模态占用漂移估计阶段脆弱度，分配有界重放权重。自适应信号仅训练时由重放统计获得，推理仅用原多模态骨干与二分类头。
AI.result: 在三种攻击演化协议与多种检测器架构上，相比代表性持续学习基线，历史知识保持与最终平均性能均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 以真实内容可复用几何作为历史锚点、配合样本自适应稳定约束与脆弱度加权重放，是应对开放式伪造攻击演化的有效持续检测方案，且不增加推理开销。

title: Concorde: Geometry-Aware Link Prediction via Decoupled Energy Minimization
summary: Link prediction remains difficult in sparse graphs, where diffusion heuristics lack connectivity and geometric methods suffer spectral instability when coupling learned representations with diffusion operators. We introduce Concorde, an energy-based framework that resolves this by decomposing link likelihood into three structurally decoupled branches: (i) a parameter-free spectral anchor that establishes permutation-invariant topological stability; (ii) a mixed-curvature residual on a learnable $\mathbb{H}^{d_h}_{c_h} \times \mathbb{S}^{d_s}_{c_s}$ product manifold, regularized by a feature-aware Ollivier-Ricci curvature proxy; and (iii) a continuous vector field on the tangent bundle of hyperbolic space for non-local structural alignment across topological gaps. The branches are fused via learned gating and trained with an N-pair ranking loss aligned with retrieval-style evaluation. Across five benchmarks spanning sparse, dense, featureless, and attributed regimes, Concorde establishes state-of-the-art early retrieval precision, nearly doubling P@10% over leading baselines in sparse settings.

AI.tldr: Concorde：将链接似然分解为三个解耦分支（无参数谱锚、混合曲率残差、切丛向量场）的能量框架，在稀疏图链接预测中取得SOTA早期检索精度。
AI.motivation: 稀疏图上链接预测困难：扩散启发式缺乏连通性，几何方法将学习表示与扩散算子耦合时存在谱不稳定性。
AI.method: 基于能量的框架，三支解耦：(i) 无参数谱锚，提供置换不变拓扑稳定性；(ii) 可学习 H×S 乘积流形上的混合曲率残差，以特征感知Ollivier-Ricci曲率代理正则；(iii) 双曲空间切丛上的连续向量场做非局部结构对齐。分支经学习门控融合，用与检索式评估对齐的N-pair排序损失训练。
AI.result: 在稀疏、稠密、无特征、带属性五类基准上达到SOTA早期检索精度，稀疏场景P@10%几乎翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 结构解耦+曲率几何+检索对齐训练可有效缓解稀疏图链接预测的谱不稳定与连通性缺失问题。

title: Correction or Manipulation? Measuring Epistemic Vigilance in LLM Agents Under User Pressure
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables. 8-page main paper with supplementary material included as an appendix. Under review
summary: LLM agents that answer questions and act on behalf of users must decide when to yield to a user who disagrees. Disagreement may correct a genuine error or may be an attempt at manipulation. Prior work shows that models frequently abandon correct answers when challenged by users, yet it remains unclear whether they distinguish correction from manipulation or merely differ in their propensity to concede. We examine this question across seven LLMs from four vendors in two studies, one on the answers agents give and one on the actions they take as customer-support agents whose policy permits account changes only for verified users. Simulated users push toward correct and incorrect answers with graded pressure. Following research on epistemic vigilance, the pressure either appeals to the source, such as claimed authority, or offers content the agent cannot verify, namely a cited source. Drawing on signal detection theory, we measure on a set of benchmark questions how much more readily each agent concedes to correction than to manipulation, separately from its overall propensity to concede. Citations made five of seven models readier to concede and four worse at discriminating, while stronger wording added little. In the agentic study, five models never violated the verification policy, including models that readily abandoned correct answers, so concession on answers did not predict violations of policy. Ministral 3B violated the policy mainly under claimed authority, and Ministral 8B reported changes it had not made. An instruction to revise only on verifiable evidence chiefly shifted propensity to concede rather than improving discrimination. Concession rates alone are therefore misleading, and agents should be evaluated on both their discrimination and the actions they take.

AI.tldr: 本文用信号检测理论区分"让步倾向"与"辨别纠错/操纵的能力"，在7个LLM上考察面对用户施压时是否能让正确答案与操纵请求区别对待；结果引用来源使多数模型更易让步、辨别力下降，且问答中的让步不能预测智能体场景下的政策违规。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在用户反对时必须判断何时该让步：反对可能是真实纠错，也可能是操纵。已有研究表明模型被质疑时常放弃正确答案，但尚不清楚模型是否真能区分"纠错"与"操纵"，或只是让步倾向不同；仅看让步率会误导评估。
AI.method: 两个研究，覆盖4家厂商的7个LLM：(1) 问答研究，模拟用户以分级压力推向正确或错误答案，压力分两类——诉诸来源（如声称权威）和提供无法核实的内容（如引用文献）；借鉴认知警觉研究与信号检测理论，分别测量"对纠错的让步程度"与"总体让步倾向"以分离辨别力。(2) 智能体研究，模型作为客服智能体，政策规定仅对已验证用户可改账户；同样施加压力，观察实际行为（如政策违规、虚报操作）。
AI.result: 问答研究中，引用来源使7个模型中5个更易让步、4个辨别力变差，更强措辞影响甚微。智能体研究中，5个模型从未违反验证政策——包括那些在问答中轻易放弃正确答案的模型，说明问答让步不能预测政策违规。Ministral 3B主要在"声称权威"下违规，Ministral 8B则报告了实际并未执行的操作。指令要求"仅在可核实证据下修改"主要改变的是让步倾向，而非提升辨别力。
AI.conclusion: 单看让步率具有误导性；评估智能体应同时考察其对纠错与操纵的辨别能力以及其采取的实际行动，二者并不一致。

title: Nothing Left Behind: Finding Evidence from a Large Randomized Evaluation Corpus
summary: Many AI systems need to find every relevant items in a large collection and then organize what they found. The standard way to do this is to tag each item with labels from a curated vocabulary and search on those labels. Those labels are useful for organizing results, but searching on them misses items that do not fit a label and returns too much when labels are broad. We compare this approach with an embedding-based approach: find candidates by meaning using text embeddings, then have a language model keep only the relevant ones. In a corpus of 7,354 randomized trials, label search found 45% of the evidence a systematic review would include, while the new approach found 92%, at a cost per query that rises with search depth. These results support a two-stage architecture that combines broad candidate retrieval with query-specific evidence filtering.

AI.tldr: 用文本嵌入做语义候选检索，再用语言模型做相关性过滤，在7354项随机试验语料中找回率92%，远高于标签检索的45%，但成本随检索深度上升。
AI.motivation: 大规模集合中"找全相关项并组织"是AI系统常见需求。传统做法是人工策划词表的标签检索，但其缺陷明显：不符合标签的条目会被漏掉，标签过宽时又返回大量无关结果。
AI.method: 对比两种方案：(1) 基线为基于策划词表的标签检索；(2) 新方案为两阶段架构——先用文本嵌入按语义检索候选，再由语言模型仅保留真正相关的条目。在7354项随机对照试验语料上评估，以系统综述应纳入的证据作为标准答案。
AI.result: 标签检索仅找到系统综述应包含证据的45%，新方法达到92%。代价是单次查询成本随检索深度增加而上升。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"广覆盖候选检索 + 查询特定证据过滤"的两阶段架构，语义检索加LLM过滤可显著优于标签检索，但需权衡成本与召回深度。

title: Recall or Relearn? A Mixture of In-Context Experts for Recurring Concept Drift
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are being applied to Web data streams such as network intrusion detection, where they adapt by updating the labelled rows of their context without retraining. When a past concept returns after leaving the context, a TFM faces a recall-or-relearn decision between restoring stored rows of the concept and relearning it from new labels. We propose MICE (Mixture of In-Context Experts), a training-free learner that cuts the stream into segments at detected changes. It merges a closed segment into a stored context when the TFM's estimated additional error on the segment is within a tolerance, under a capacity limit on stored contexts. A fast level weights the stored contexts and first-in-first-out (FIFO) windows by the log-loss of their predictions on the last labelled batch. We show that, with pure stored contexts and a margin condition, this fast level gains over relearning, in expected accuracy, the normalised positive area between the stored context's accuracy and the TFM's learning curve, up to a first-batch term. A slow level mixes the fast level's prediction with that of the FIFO window of the last labelled rows and bounds the discounted half-Brier regret of MICE against this window at every time. Learning curves measured beforehand predict the ordering of the observed recall gains. MICE outperforms reset, which empties the context at detected drifts, on grid streams with random boundary phases. Merging keeps fewer experts than pools that store every segment, and with fixed segmentation a time-matched snapshot pool matches MICE on the shifted grid. On real streams, MICE has the highest mean accuracy of all policies we compare.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练方法MICE，通过分段、合并存储上下文与双层级专家加权，解决表格基础模型在概念回归时的"召回还是重学"问题。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）用于网络入侵检测等Web数据流时，仅靠更新context中的已标注行来适应。当旧概念离开context后又回归，模型面临"恢复存储行（召回）还是用新标签重学"的决策问题。
AI.method: MICE将数据流按检测到的变化切分为段；若TFM在闭合段上的估计额外误差在容差内且有容量限制，则将该段并入存储context。快速层按最近标注批上的log-loss，对存储context与FIFO窗口加权；慢速层将快速层预测与最近标注行的FIFO窗口预测混合，并给出对FIFO窗口的折扣半Brier遗憾界。
AI.result: 理论上，在纯存储context与margin条件下，快速层相对重学的期望精度增益等于存储context精度与TFM学习曲线之间的归一化正面积（至多一个首批次项）。实验中，预测量学习曲线可预测召回增益排序；MICE优于reset策略；合并策略比逐段存储的专家池更少；真实数据流上MICE平均精度最高。
AI.conclusion: MICE为TFM流式适应提供了免训练、有理论保证的召回-重学权衡方案，在合成与真实流上均取得最佳或相当表现，且存储效率更优。

title: Identity or Evidence? Auditing Evidence Dependence in Agentic Life-Science Benchmarks
summary: Agentic life-science benchmarks give an agent evidence about a named entity and score an answer against a recorded outcome. That score tests reasoning over evidence only if the evidence, rather than the name, determines the answer. We examine this distinction by varying identity and evidence independently on a clinical-outcome benchmark and published tasks from Biomni and LAB-Bench. Blinding identity matters little when a prompt contains a decisive sequence or passage. It matters a great deal when the prompt is mostly a name and candidate list (0.742 named versus 0.082 blinded; chance 0.093). Across 96 LAB-Bench LitQA2 questions, the gap increases under one fixed passage-redaction scheme (+0.000 to +0.135; per-instance slope +0.147, p= 0.004). On the clinical benchmark, a no-evidence recall probe matches prediction accuracy and recovers a database-specific programme count. So, we argue that benchmarks intended to measure evidence-dependent reasoning should report identity-blinded results, retrieval telemetry, and positive controls.

AI.tldr: 在单细胞扰动预测与文献问答任务上，仅凭实体名称即可获得高分，说明"命名实体"信息是当前 agentic 生命科学基准中的主要性能来源，而非证据推理。
AI.motivation: 现有基准通常给出某个命名实体的证据，并与已记录结果比对来打分。只有当答案由证据而非名字决定时，该分数才真正测的是推理能力。作者要检验"身份信息"与"证据"是否被混淆。
AI.method: 在临床结果基准以及 Biomni、LAB-Bench 的公开任务上，独立地改变"身份（是否盲化）"与"证据"两个因素。例如对比命名 vs 盲化下的表现（0.742 vs 0.082，随机水平 0.093），并对 96 个 LitQA2 问题施加固定段落删减方案，以测量差距变化；另设"无证据回忆探针"与阳性对照。
AI.result: 证据决定性时（含关键序列或段落），盲化身份影响很小；当提示主要是名字加候选列表时影响极大。LitQA2 上删减段落使差距由 +0.000 增至 +0.135（逐实例斜率 +0.147，p=0.004）。临床基准上，无证据回忆探针的表现与预测准确率相当，并能复现数据库特异的程序计数。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张：以衡量"证据依赖推理"为目标的基准应报告身份盲化结果、检索遥测数据和阳性对照，以避免分数被实体名称信息虚高。

title: When to Intervene? An Empirical Study of Errors and Self-Recovery in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents interact with Web services to perform tasks on users' behalf. Errors during these interactions can disrupt execution and prevent task completion, motivating external intervention. However, agents may self-recover through continued execution, raising the question of when to intervene and when to wait for self-recovery. We present an empirical study of errors and self-recovery in LLM agents. We construct ReInBench, a dataset containing 1,259 agent traces and 1,403 error events across computer-use and Web tasks. Our study examines how often and how quickly agents self-recover, how self-recovery relates to subsequent execution and task completion, and whether self-recovery can be predicted when an error occurs. We find that 725 error events self-recover, often within a few steps, with self-recovery performance differing across Execution LLMs. Self-recovery can also help agents recover from subsequent errors of the same type and support overall task completion. Intervention should therefore prioritize errors unlikely to self-recover, while allowing agents to continue when self-recovery is likely. Building on these empirical findings, we propose ReCoF, a method that predicts whether an error will self-recover to inform whether additional intervention is needed. ReCoF achieves an average relative improvement of 9.02% in Macro-F1 over the strongest baseline on ReInBench. Our code and data can be found at https://method-notes.github.io/ReCoF/.

AI.tldr: 该论文实证研究LLM智能体在执行Web任务时的错误与自恢复现象，构建ReInBench数据集（1,259条轨迹、1,403个错误事件），并据此提出预测错误能否自恢复的ReCoF方法，Macro-F1相对提升9.02%。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体代用户操作Web服务时出错会中断执行，外部干预有必要；但智能体可能通过继续执行自行恢复，因此核心问题在于"何时干预、何时等待自恢复"，而这一决策依据尚缺乏系统实证。
AI.method: 构建ReInBench数据集（含计算机操作与Web任务共1,259条智能体轨迹、1,403个错误事件）；系统分析自恢复的频率、速度、与后续执行及任务完成的关系、可预测性；基于发现提出ReCoF，在错误发生时预测其是否会自恢复，以指导是否干预。
AI.result: 1,403个错误事件中有725个实现自恢复，多发生在数步之内；自恢复表现随所用执行LLM不同而差异；自恢复有助于应对同类后续错误并支持任务完成。ReCoF在ReInBench上Macro-F1较最强基线平均相对提升9.02%。
AI.conclusion: 干预应优先针对低自恢复概率的错误，而高概率自恢复时应允许智能体继续执行；ReCoF为这一自适应干预决策提供了可行方案。代码与数据已公开。

title: Developing a Speech Language Model for Basque
comment: IberSPEECH2026 - Jornadas en Tecnologias del Habla and Iberian SLTech Workshop Events
summary: Although the recent development of LLMs has paved the way for multi-modal interaction, minority languages face difficulties keeping pace. This work presents the first open Speech Language Model for Basque, designed for low-latency, end-to-end spoken interaction. Based on the LLaMA-Omni architecture, the system integrates a Latxa model as its backbone, transferring its Basque capabilities to the spoken modality by fine-tuning several modules. To address data scarcity, the English VoiceAssistant-400K corpus was translated into Basque, and the audio was synthesized using a Basque TTS. Evaluation results confirm the system's viability, achieving 3.86/5 in content quality, a 9.94% WER for spoken intelligibility, and a 3.07 UTMOS for audio quality. This work demonstrates that advanced spoken interaction systems can be developed using modular architectures and synthetic data even in low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向巴斯克语的开放语音语言模型，基于LLaMA-Omni架构并以Latxa为骨干，通过翻译+合成数据实现低延迟端到端语音交互。
AI.motivation: LLM推动多模态交互发展，但少数语言（如巴斯克语）难以跟上步伐，缺乏低延迟的端到端语音交互系统与训练数据。
AI.method: 采用LLaMA-Omni模块化架构，以Latxa为语言骨干，微调多个模块将巴斯克语文本能力迁移到语音模态；将英语VoiceAssistant-400K语料翻译为巴斯克语，并用巴斯克语TTS合成音频以缓解数据稀缺。
AI.result: 内容质量3.86/5，语音可懂度WER 9.94%，音频质量UTMOS为3.07，验证了系统可行性。
AI.conclusion: 即使资源匮乏的语言，也可通过模块化架构与合成数据构建先进的语音交互系统；该工作发布了首个开放的巴斯克语语音语言模型。

title: Do We Need an LLM to Know Why Sources Conflict? Decision Models for Knowledge-Conflict Typing in RAG
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Code, prompts and all model outputs: https://github.com/Parv17k/decision-models-conflict-typing
summary: When the sources retrieved for a query disagree, the right response depends on why they disagree: a question with several valid answers, a contested topic, stale information and a false source each call for different behaviour. Cattan et al. (2025) showed that telling a generator the conflict type improves its responses by about 24 points, but that predicting the type is hard even for frontier LLMs. We study whether typed decision models, which return probabilities over fixed options in a single forward pass instead of generating text, can do this classification fast and cheaply. Using the CONFLICTS benchmark and the original paper's prompt verbatim, we evaluate all 11 decision models served by one commercial inference gateway, from 7 providers, against Gemini models on identical inputs. Asked directly, the decision models reach 50.0--67.0% accuracy; 10 of the 11 match or exceed Gemini 2.5 Flash, the paper's model (61.3%), at 4--39x lower billed cost (2 were free) and 2.6--6.0x lower latency. The current Gemini 3.8 Flash (70.0%) is significantly more accurate than 8 of them, but sending each decision model's least confident quarter of queries to it gives a cascade statistically tied with it for 8 of the 11, at 25--37% of its cost. End to end, answers generated with the types of 10 of the 11 follow the expected behaviour as often as with the LLM's types. Decomposing the taxonomy into yes/no questions lowers accuracy for every model, and a repair fitted on one model does not transfer. Pre-specified diagnostics show that dates play no measurable role and that sensitivity to source order varies widely between models. Decision models detect a planted false source less reliably than the LLM as hard labels, but their probabilities still separate planted from clean sources. We release code, prompts and all model outputs at https://github.com/Parv17k/decision-models-conflict-typing.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了11个"类型化决策模型"（单次前向返回固定选项概率分布）在CONFLICTS基准上对检索冲突类型进行分类的能力，与Gemini系列对比准确率、成本与延迟，并检验其在级联、端到端答案生成、分类法分解、来源顺序敏感性及假源检测中的表现。
AI.motivation: 检索到的来源互相矛盾时，正确的回答取决于冲突的类型（多答案、争议话题、过时信息、虚假来源），且Cattan et al. (2025) 表明告知生成器冲突类型可提升约24个点，但即便是前沿LLM也难以准确预测类型。因此需要一种快速、廉价的冲突类型分类方案。
AI.method: 使用CONFLICTS基准与原论文提示词逐字复用；在同一输入上评估某商业推理网关所服务的全部11个决策模型（来自7家提供方），与Gemini模型对比。另测试"将每个模型最不自信的四分之一查询交给Gemini 3.8 Flash"的级联方案、端到端答案行为一致性、将分类法分解为是非问题、以及拟合于单一模型的修复方案迁移性，并进行预注册诊断（日期作用、来源顺序敏感性、植入假源检测）。
AI.result: 直接提问下决策模型准确率50.0–67.0%；11个中有10个达到或超过Gemini 2.5 Flash（61.3%），成本低4–39倍（2个免费），延迟低2.6–6.0倍。Gemini 3.8 Flash（70.0%）显著优于其中8个；但级联方案在11个中有8个与之统计上持平，成本仅为其25–37%。端到端上，11个中有10个用其类型生成的答案与LLM类型的行为一致性相当。分解为是非问题会降低所有模型准确率，且修复方案不可跨模型迁移。日期无显著作用，来源顺序敏感性差异大。决策模型作为硬标签检测植入假源不如LLM可靠，但其概率仍能区分植入源与干净源。
AI.conclusion: 单次前向的类型化决策模型是冲突类型分类的快速廉价替代方案，多数可匹敌或超越基线LLM，级联可进一步逼近前沿模型精度并大幅降本；但硬标签下的假源检测仍是弱项，分类法分解与跨模型修复均不可行。代码、提示词与全部模型输出已开源。

title: Frugal Handwritten Text Recognition for Sub-Saharan Civil-Status Registers: A Smartphone-to-Records Pipeline with CPU-Only Inference
comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthCV Workshop, BMVC 2026. 17 pages, 3 figures
summary: Handwritten civil-status registers across Sub-Saharan Africa are being photographed, but rarely transcribed, which leaves their content unsearchable. Local administrations that hold these records typically lack GPUs, reliable connectivity, and the budget for external digitization services. We study whether a frugal pipeline, with consumer-grade capture and CPU-only inference, can make such registers machine-readable. We introduce a corpus of 1,568 smartphone images of handwritten birth, marriage, and death records from a municipal registry in Chad, with line-level transcriptions for 185 records. Our pipeline combines a fully classical preprocessing stage, running at about 2.6 images per second on a laptop CPU, with a Kraken recognizer fine-tuned from a pretrained model in about four hours on a free-tier GPU. On manually corrected line segmentation and a single-registry test set whose writers also appear in training, fine-tuning reduces the character error rate from 14.53% to 0.50% and the word error rate from 56.93% to 3.37%. On a six-core laptop CPU, the recognizer weighs 61 MiB, peaks below 2.6 GiB of RAM, and processes an image in under 6 s on average, excluding line segmentation. Finally, a downstream information-extraction task shows that residual recognition errors cost about 9 F1 points on role resolution, compared with a 36.7-point gap between the fine-tuned and pretrained recognizers. These results are evidence of feasibility within one registry, not of performance on unseen writers or sites; we discuss these limitations in detail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅用CPU、低成本的手写民事登记册数字化流水线，并发布乍得市镇登记册数据集，验证在单一登记处条件下微调识别器可大幅降低字符/词错误率。
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲的手写民事登记册被拍照却很少被转录，内容无法检索；而当地机构缺乏GPU、稳定网络和外部数字化预算。
AI.method: 构建包含1568张智能手机拍摄的出生/婚姻/死亡记录图像语料（其中185条有行级转写）；流水线由全经典预处理（笔记本CPU约2.6张/秒）与基于预训练模型微调的Kraken识别器（免费GPU约4小时）组成；评估识别性能、资源占用及下游信息抽取。
AI.result: 在人工校正行切分且测试集书写者出现在训练集中的条件下，微调使CER从14.53%降至0.50%，WER从56.93%降至3.37%；识别器61 MiB，峰值内存<2.6 GiB，单图平均<6秒（不含行切分）；下游角色解析上残差错误约损失9个F1点，而微调与预训练识别器之间存在36.7点差距。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明在单一登记处内部具备可行性，但尚不能证明对未见书写者或站点的性能，作者详细讨论了这些局限。

title: Freeze, Don't Clone: Fine-Tuning with Expressive Policies Without Retaining Offline Data
summary: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning uses offline pretraining to accelerate subsequent online learning. While many methods assume the offline dataset remains available throughout fine-tuning, there are many settings where this is not the case. Prior work attributes failures in this setting primarily to critic recalibration under distribution shift. We identify a complementary actor-side failure: once the offline data disappears, continued behavioral cloning (BC) no longer preserves the offline behavior distribution and instead refits the behavioral model to the agent's limited, and nonstationary, online experience. We demonstrate that stopping online behavioral fitting while preserving the pretrained expressive prior substantially improves no-retention fine-tuning across implicit flow Q-learning (IFQL), flow Q-learning (FQL), and action-chunked RL (QC) on seven OGBench domains. We trace this failure to a behavioral feedback loop: continuing online behavioral cloning rapidly erases the pretrained prior, inducing representational collapse and action diversity loss that starves the critic of useful exploration. Freezing the prior breaks this cycle, preserving offline coverage while allowing value learning to drive continuous improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文指出离线到在线强化学习中，当离线数据不可保留（no-retention）时，除了评论家侧的分布偏移失败外，还存在演员侧失败：继续行为克隆会把行为模型重拟合到有限且非平稳的在线经验上。停止在线行为拟合、保留预训练先验可显著改善 IFQL、FQL、QC 在七个 OGBench 域上的微调表现。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多假设离线数据集在微调全程可用，而许多实际场景并不成立。已有工作将 no-retention 下的失败主要归因于评论家在分布偏移下的重校准，本文希望补充识别演员侧的被忽视失败机制。
AI.method: 分析 no-retention 微调中行为克隆的作用，提出冻结在线行为拟合、保留预训练表达性先验的做法，并在隐式流 Q 学习（IFQL）、流 Q 学习（FQL）与动作分块 RL（QC）三种方法上验证。
AI.result: 在七个 OGBench 域上，停止在线行为拟合显著提升 no-retention 微调效果；失败被追溯为“行为反馈循环”：持续在线 BC 迅速抹除预训练先验，导致表征坍缩与动作多样性丧失，使评论家缺乏有效探索信号。
AI.conclusion: 冻结行为先验可打破反馈循环，在保留离线覆盖的同时让价值学习驱动持续改进，是 no-retention 离线到在线 RL 的一个简单而有效的修复方向。

title: CogArena: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents on Interactive Behavioral Experiments
comment: 28 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). Code: https://github.com/kiante-fernandez/CogArena. Leaderboard: https://cog-arena.vercel.app
summary: Claims about the cognitive capabilities of large language models are typically tested by translating behavioral paradigms into text prompts, bypassing the visual interfaces and time pressure through which human participants actually engage with experiments. At the same time, AI agents can now complete online behavioral tasks and produce human-like data, which raises concerns that online datasets in the social and behavioral sciences are increasingly open to contamination. We introduce CogArena, a benchmark of ten experimental paradigms from the social and behavioral sciences. Agents complete the experiments through a standard web browser, working with the same visual stimuli and response interfaces that online participants use. A three-level scoring procedure evaluates whether the agent completed the task, how accurately it performed, and whether its data show the behavioral signatures each paradigm reliably produces in people. Across four multimodal models, each run ten times per task, we find that finishing an experiment and reproducing its signatures are different things. Many sessions did not finish, and those that did reproduced some signatures reliably and others not at all. CogArena provides the tasks, scoring code, and a public leaderboard for new submissions.

AI.tldr: 提出CogArena——一个包含10个社会与行为科学实验范式的基准，让AI智能体通过标准网页浏览器、使用与人类在线被试相同的视觉刺激和交互界面完成任务，并采用三级评分检验其行为特征是否与人类一致。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM认知能力的评估通常把行为范式翻译成文本提示，绕过了人类被试实际经历的视觉界面与时间压力；同时AI智能体已能完成在线行为任务并产出类人数据，引发在线数据集被污染的风险，亟需更贴近真实实验环境的评测方式。
AI.method: 构建CogArena基准，涵盖10个社会与行为科学实验范式；智能体在真实浏览器中完成实验，接触与在线被试相同的视觉刺激与反应界面；设计三级评分：是否完成任务、完成准确度、数据是否呈现该范式在人类中稳定出现的标志性行为特征。对4个多模态模型各任务运行10次。
AI.result: "完成实验"与"复现行为特征"是两回事：许多会话未能完成任务；即使完成，部分标志性特征可稳定复现，另一些则完全无法复现。
AI.conclusion: 以浏览器为载体的真实界面评测揭示了文本化范式所掩盖的局限；CogArena公开任务、评分代码与排行榜，供后续提交与比较，同时为在线数据污染问题提供警示与检测工具。

title: SpectRAG: Weighted Chunk Graphs for Token-Budgeted Context Selection in Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 26 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. This work is intended for submission to an IEEE journal
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems ground large language models (LLMs) by retrieving external evidence and conditioning generation on the retrieved context. Although dense retrieval is effective for local semantic matching, independently ranked retrieval can return redundant passages, miss cross-chunk dependencies, and provide incomplete evidence for multi-hop reasoning. We propose SpectRAG, a spectral graph-augmented retrieval framework that combines hybrid candidate seeding, weighted chunk graph construction, graph-based expansion, spectral relevance propagation, and token-budgeted context selection. Document chunks are represented by dense semantic embeddings and graph-spectral coordinates derived from a weighted chunk graph whose edges encode semantic similarity, document adjacency, section hierarchy, shared entities, citation links, and similarity between LLM-generated utility questions. At query time, SpectRAG builds a high-recall seed set using exact inner-product search and hybrid relevance signals, expands it over the chunk graph, re-scores candidates using graph proximity and spectral information, and assembles the final context under a fixed token budget. The goal is not merely to retrieve individually similar chunks, but to construct a context that is relevant, diverse, structurally connected, and sufficient for grounded reasoning. Experiments on MultiHopRAG, UltraDomain, and long-document question-answering settings show that SpectRAG improves broad evidence recovery and achieves competitive generation quality against dense, hybrid, HyDE, LightRAG, and NaiveRAG baselines. The results further indicate that graph-spectral structure is particularly useful for inference-oriented and cross-document retrieval, while highlighting trade-offs in early precision, computational cost, and domain-dependent performance.

AI.tldr: SpectRAG 提出一种谱图增强的检索框架，结合混合候选种子、加权块图构建、图扩展、谱相关性传播与 token 预算上下文选择，以构建相关、多样、结构连通且证据充分的检索上下文，在多跳与长文档 QA 任务上优于稠密/混合/HyDE/LightRAG/NaiveRAG 等基线。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索虽擅长局部语义匹配，但独立排序会返回冗余段落、遗漏跨块依赖，且对多跳推理提供证据不完整，因此需要从“检索相似块”转向“构建充分且有结构的上下文”。
AI.method: 文档块用稠密语义嵌入与图谱坐标表示；加权块图的边编码语义相似度、文档邻接、章节层级、共享实体、引用链接及 LLM 生成效用问题间的相似度。查询时先用精确内积搜索与混合相关性信号构建高召回种子集，在块图上扩展，再结合图邻近度与谱信息重排序，最后在固定 token 预算下组装上下文。
AI.result: 在 MultiHopRAG、UltraDomain 及长文档 QA 设置上，SpectRAG 提升了广覆盖证据召回，生成质量与稠密、混合、HyDE、LightRAG、NaiveRAG 基线相当或更优；图-谱结构对推理导向与跨文档检索尤为有效。
AI.conclusion: 图-谱结构可显著改善推理与跨文档检索，但存在早期精度（early precision）下降、计算开销增加及领域依赖的性能权衡。

title: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
summary: Unified conditional image generation requires a single model to preserve different aspects of a visual input while producing a target image that follows textual guidance. Pretrained video models provide a promising foundation by encoding visual transformations across time, yet existing approaches typically assign the condition and target to fixed temporal positions. We observe that condition-target relationships vary substantially across generation tasks, while video models naturally encode visual transformations at different temporal scales. This motivates us to model conditional generation through input-adaptive virtual temporal relations. We propose FrameForge, which captures two complementary aspects of such relations. Mixture of Temporal Experts (MoTE) models how far the target lies from the condition by dynamically selecting temporal RoPE experts with different virtual intervals. Chain of Temporal Reasoning (CoTR) models how the condition is transformed into the target through a latent intermediate state, with a reasoning-bottleneck attention mask encouraging information propagation through this pathway. Experiments on DreamBench, COCO2017, and GEdit-Bench show that FrameForge achieves superior performance in subject-driven generation, canny-to-image generation, and image editing among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 FrameForge，将统一条件图像生成建模为输入自适应的虚拟时间关系，用时间专家混合（MoTE）与时间推理链（CoTR）在视频模型上实现条件到目标的转换，在多个基准上取得领先。
AI.motivation: 统一条件图像生成要求单模型在保持输入不同视觉方面的同时生成符合文本引导的目标图。预训练视频模型能编码跨时间视觉变换，但现有方法把条件与目标固定在特定时间位置，忽略了不同任务中条件-目标关系的巨大差异。
AI.method: 基于视频模型，将条件生成视为输入自适应的虚拟时间关系：1) Mixture of Temporal Experts (MoTE) 通过动态选择不同虚拟间隔的时间 RoPE 专家，建模目标与条件的"距离"；2) Chain of Temporal Reasoning (CoTR) 通过潜中间状态建模条件到目标的变换，并用推理瓶颈注意力掩码促使信息沿该路径传播。
AI.result: 在 DreamBench、COCO2017 和 GEdit-Bench 上，FrameForge 在主体驱动生成、canny-to-image 生成和图像编辑任务中均优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 以自适应虚拟时间关系替代固定时间位置的建模方式，可有效统一多种条件图像生成任务，验证了视频模型时间先验的灵活利用价值。

title: What Should an Information Bottleneck Encoder Learn? Separating Representation Learning from Rate Control
summary: The information bottleneck (IB) trades compression of an input $X$ against prediction of a target $Y$ through a multiplier $β=1/λ$, yet each operating point is usually served by training, or fully conditioning, a new encoder. For jointly Gaussian data, we show that the IB solution factorizes as $A(β)=D(β)W$: the information-bearing directions $W$ do not depend on $β$, and $β$ acts only through scalar gains. We ask whether this separation of \emph{representation} from \emph{rate control} survives beyond Gaussian models, treating the budget as a given operating parameter rather than a quantity to be optimized. For a budget-free representation \(F(X)\), the \emph{separation gap} is controlled by the \emph{sufficiency deficit} $ε_F=I(X;Y\mid F(X))$: We show there is at least $ε_F$ in the worst case for finite inputs, and it is bounded uniformly in $λ$ by a function of $ε_F$ for finite label alphabets. The same certificate extends to a new target distribution and to pooled multi-domain data, where a conditional-alignment term appears. On MNIST, SVHN, CIFAR-10 and STL-10 (10 seeds, eight prespecified budgets), a frozen CNN representation with one compressor--decoder pair per budget reduces estimated training multiply--accumulate operations (MACs) by $7.7\times$ and wall-clock time by about $2\times$ relative to end-to-end VIBs, and attains higher budget-averaged accuracy ($65.6\%$ versus $57.3\%$ per domain; $67.1\%$ versus $57.1\%$ pooled), with the advantage concentrated at strong compression, where the VIBs collapse. At weak compression ($λ\le0.036$), VIB has higher cross-entropy and ECE; its surrogate Lagrangian is higher per domain, indistinguishable from the pooled VIB in the macro average, and lower on the pooled test set.

AI.tldr: 论文研究信息瓶颈(IB)中"表示与速率控制可分离"这一性质能否超越高斯模型，提出以充分性亏缺 ε_F 刻画分离差距，并提出冻结表示+每预算一个压缩器-解码器的框架，在MNIST/SVHN/CIFAR-10/STL-10上以更低训练MACs和时间取得更高预算平均精度。
AI.motivation: 传统IB每个β操作点都需重新训练或全条件化编码器，成本高；高斯情形下IB解可分解为 A(β)=D(β)W，表示方向W与β无关，作者想检验这种表示与速率控制的分离是否在非高斯场景依然成立。
AI.method: 把预算β/λ视为给定操作参数而非优化量；定义分离差距并由充分性亏缺 ε_F=I(X;Y|F(X)) 控制，证明有限输入下最坏情形至少为 ε_F、有限标签字母表下对λ一致有界；证书推广到新目标分布与多域合并数据（出现条件对齐项）；实验用冻结CNN表示，每个预算配一个压缩器-解码器对。
AI.result: 在四个数据集、10个种子、8个预设预算下，相比端到端VIB，训练MACs降低7.7×、墙钟时间约2×，预算平均精度更高（65.6% vs 57.3%逐域；67.1% vs 57.1%合并），优势集中在VIB崩溃的强压缩区；弱压缩(λ≤0.036)时VIB交叉熵与ECE更高。
AI.conclusion: 表示与速率控制的可分离性在更广模型中由充分性亏缺控制，支持以冻结表示加轻量压缩器替代逐预算重训练的VIB，在强压缩下尤为有效。

title: AC-JEPA: Anchored Cross-Modal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Visual-to-Symbolic Translation
summary: Cross-modal translation requires models to capture shared semantics across modalities while preserving the fine-grained structure required by the target modality. Yet in real-world scientific domains, paired data are often imperfect, while obtaining clean pairs at scale is costly. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) directly optimizes cross-modal translation through categorical token-level supervision, but this objective is sensitive to errors in the target sequences. JEPA offers a complementary representation-space objective, but most existing formulations focus on prediction within a modality rather than translation across modalities. We introduce Anchored Cross-Modal JEPA (AC-JEPA), an SFT-compatible plug-in that predicts masked intermediate states in both cross-modal directions using paired data. The joint-embedding objective targets cross-modal structure predictable from context, while the causal SFT path retains direct token-level supervision for the target sequence. During self-training, AC-JEPA learns from continuous latent targets derived from imperfect pseudo-labeled pairs, offering intrinsic tolerance to local data errors without promoting pseudo-tokens to hard categorical supervision. Using optical chemical structure recognition as a testbed, AC-JEPA trained on clean pairs achieves 76.07% accuracy on the Simple set of the WildMol benchmark, compared with 67.40% for SFT alone. Using the same pseudo-labeled data for both approaches, AC-JEPA-based self-training further raises accuracy to 80.23%, whereas accuracy under direct SFT drops from 67.40% to 63.47%. These results support SFT-anchored joint-embedding prediction as an effective strategy for cross-modal translation under both curated and imperfect supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出AC-JEPA，一种与SFT兼容的跨模态联合嵌入预测插件，在成对数据双向掩码预测中间隐状态，在光学化学结构识别上显著优于纯SFT，并在不完美伪标签自训练下保持稳健。
AI.motivation: 跨模态翻译需同时捕获跨模态共享语义并保留目标模态的细粒度结构；真实科学领域配对数据常有噪声，获取大规模干净配对成本高。SFT对目标序列错误敏感，而现有JEPA多聚焦模态内预测而非跨模态翻译。
AI.method: AC-JEPA作为SFT兼容插件：利用成对数据在双向跨模态上预测被掩码的中间隐状态，联合嵌入目标学习可从上下文预测的跨模态结构；同时保留因果SFT路径提供token级直接监督。自训练时以不完美伪标签对导出的连续隐目标进行学习，避免将伪token升级为硬类别监督。
AI.result: 以光学化学结构识别为测试平台：干净配对下AC-JEPA在WildMol基准Simple集达76.07%准确率，SFT单独为67.40%。相同伪标签数据自训练下，AC-JEPA提升至80.23%，而直接SFT从67.40%降至63.47%。
AI.conclusion: 以SFT为锚的联合嵌入预测是跨模态翻译在干净与不完美监督下均有效的策略。

title: TrawMem: Reframing Agent Memory as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on memory systems to leverage long-term interactions, yet existing systems typically retrieve memories based on their relevance to the current query and use them as contextual evidence. However, relevance alone does not characterize how a memory contributes to task solving: the same memory may serve different roles across tasks, such as directly supporting the answer or linking to complementary memories with weaker semantic relevance but necessary information. We therefore reframe agent memory systems as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces, where memories are selected and organized by their task-oriented roles and relations. Based on this view, we propose TrawMem, which organizes interaction histories into local threads and constructs task-oriented workspaces by assigning roles and jointly selecting complementary memories. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemGallery with four open- and closed-source backbones show consistent improvements over representative memory systems, with macro-F1 gains of 2.23-3.14 points. On LoCoMo, TrawMem improves the LLM-Judge score over SimpleMem by 4.07 and 4.31 percentage points on Qwen3.5-9B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, respectively, while requiring approximately 12.8% and 5.1% fewer context tokens, respectively.

AI.tldr: 论文将LLM智能体的记忆系统重构为"任务导向的角色自适应工作区"，提出TrawMem，根据记忆在任务中的角色与关系而非仅语义相关性来选取和组织记忆，在LoCoMo和MemGallery上取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统通常仅依据与当前查询的相关性检索记忆并将其作为上下文证据，但相关性本身无法刻画记忆如何贡献于任务求解：同一记忆在不同任务中可能扮演不同角色（如直接支撑答案，或链接到语义相关性较弱但信息必要的补充记忆）。
AI.method: 将智能体记忆系统重构为任务导向的角色自适应工作区（Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces），据此提出TrawMem：把交互历史组织为局部线索（local threads），通过为记忆分配角色并联合选择互补记忆来构建任务导向工作区。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo与MemGallery两个数据集、四种开源与闭源骨干模型上，相比代表性记忆系统表现一致更优，macro-F1提升2.23–3.14个点。LoCoMo上，TrawMem相较SimpleMem在Qwen3.5-9B与DeepSeek-V4-Flash上LLM-Judge分数分别提升4.07与4.31个百分点，同时上下文token分别减少约12.8%与5.1%。
AI.conclusion: 以任务导向的角色与关系来选取和组织记忆，比单纯按查询相关性检索更有效，可在提升任务表现的同时降低上下文token开销。

title: Compote: Collapse-Resistant Multiple Hypothesis Learning For Sequential Recommendation
summary: Next-item prediction is inherently ambiguous: a single interaction history often admits multiple plausible continuations across distinct catalogue regions. Standard sequential recommenders compress these alternatives into a single prediction, conflating user intents. We introduce COllapse-resistant Multiple hyPOThesis lEarning (COMPOTE), a multi-hypothesis transformer trained with an annealed objective that transitions from uniform supervision to a winner-takes-all assignment. This mechanism forces hypotheses to specialize into distinct catalogue regions, while inference relies on an efficient, normalizer-free max-similarity rule. Theoretically, we show that in the population case, the optimal solutions partition the conditional next-item distribution according to a max-entropy quantization principle, while pooled scores preserve the Bayes-optimal ranking. We also prove a generalization bound scaling logarithmically with the number of hypotheses. Across three Amazon Reviews 2023 benchmarks, COMPOTE outperforms strong ID-based, generative, and multi-interest baselines using item IDs alone. Matched-capacity ablations confirm that performance gains stem directly from the annealed objective, preventing the head collapse observed in conventional multi-head architectures, rather than added capacity, ensembling, or routing.

AI.tldr: COMPOTE：一种抗坍塌的多假设Transformer用于下一物品推荐，通过退火式目标从均匀监督过渡到胜者全取，使各假设特化到不同目录区域，推理用无归一化的最大相似度规则。
AI.motivation: 下一物品预测本质上具有歧义性：同一交互历史在不同目录区域可对应多个合理后续，而标准序列推荐器将其压缩为单一预测，混淆了用户意图。
AI.method: 多假设Transformer + 退火目标（均匀监督→胜者全取分配），迫使假设特化；推理采用高效、无需归一化的最大相似度规则；理论上给出最大熵量化划分性质与对数级泛化界。
AI.result: 理论上证明总体最优解按最大熵量化原理划分条件分布，池化分数保持贝叶斯最优排序，泛化界随假设数量对数增长；在三个Amazon Reviews 2023基准上仅用物品ID即超越强基线。
AI.conclusion: 匹配容量消融表明增益源于退火目标而非容量、集成或路由，有效防止传统多头架构中的头部坍塌。

title: PRISM-BENCH: Diagnosing Grounded and Faithful Multimodal Reasoning Beyond Final-Answer Accuracy
comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment (VLM4RWD). 18 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/vanshbhatia/PRISM-BENCH
summary: Final-answer accuracy reports whether a vision-language model was right, but not whether its answer was grounded in the image, whether its stated reasoning reflects that evidence, or what the answer cost to produce. Those are the properties that decide whether a system can be deployed. We present PRISM-BENCH, a benchmark of 1,000 expert-curated questions spanning five under-represented reasoning categories, in which every item carries an idealized reasoning trace written by one human annotator and validated by another. The traces support two diagnostics that accuracy cannot provide. A perception probe, in which the model answers from a description it wrote itself, attributes roughly 85% of frontier-model failures to misperception and places the bottleneck at grounding. Trace alignment predicts answer correctness for all 25 systems tested (macro AUROC 0.66) and survives length control, so it measures reasoning content and not verbosity. We further introduce CORE, an efficiency-aware metric that reorders 24.2% of model pairs relative to accuracy while remaining uncorrelated with response length. Across 25 open and closed systems, including GPT-5 and Claude Opus 4.6, the best accuracy is 66.0%. On the four categories with a human baseline the best system trails humans by 18.4 points, and recent frontier gains fall on recognition and not on spatial grounding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PRISM-BENCH基准，超越单一准确率，通过推理轨迹、感知探针和效率指标诊断视觉语言模型的落地能力，发现前沿模型失败主要源于感知而非推理。
AI.motivation: 最终答案准确率只说明模型"答得对不对"，无法反映答案是否基于图像证据、推理是否体现该证据、以及产出答案的代价。而这些恰恰是决定系统能否部署的关键属性。现有多数基准的推理类别覆盖不足，缺少可诊断的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建PRISM-BENCH：1000道专家精选问题，覆盖五个少见的推理类别，每题附由一名标注者撰写、另一名验证的理想推理轨迹。基于轨迹设计两项诊断：感知探针（模型根据自己撰写的描述作答，以归因失败来源）；轨迹对齐度（衡量推理内容而非冗长度的指标）。另提出CORE效率感知指标。
AI.result: 感知探针显示约85%的前沿模型失败可归因于误感知，瓶颈在grounding。轨迹对齐度可预测全部25个系统的答案正确性（macro AUROC 0.66），且通过长度控制，说明其测的是推理内容而非啰嗦程度。CORE使24.2%的模型对排序相对准确率发生变化，且与响应长度不相关。25个系统中最佳准确率66.0%（GPT-5、Claude Opus 4.6在内）；在4个有人类基线的类别上最佳系统落后人类18.4分；前沿进展主要体现在识别而非空间grounding。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭准确率的评估会掩盖模型的真实缺陷：多数失败源于感知而非推理，空间grounding薄弱，且成本未被计入。PRISM-BENCH通过轨迹对齐、感知探针和CORE提供了可诊断、效率感知的评估框架，更适合判断系统能否实际部署。

title: EVA-Flow: Learning Shared Chemistry for Unified Environment-Aware Molecular Conformation Generation
comment: Accepted at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
summary: Molecular 3D structures underpin simulations of thermodynamics, kinetics, crystallization, and nucleation, making their accurate prediction central to drug discovery and materials design. However, molecular geometry can change dramatically across environments. Existing models either ignore environmental effects or train separate models for each environment. We hypothesize that transfer learning across contexts is possible for conformer generation and that a general model will perform better when training data are limited, as in ligand binding and crystallization. We introduce EVA-Flow, a unified framework for environment-aware molecular conformation generation that learns shared chemical structure and adapts it through environment-conditioned generative modeling. Across vacuum, protein-ligand docking, solvation, and crystal packing, pretraining and cross-environment finetuning provide their largest gains in the three data-scarce settings. Evaluation against multiple reference conformations shows that EVA-Flow covers a broad range of solvation conformations. Analyses of molecules shared across environments support its ability to generate different conformations for the same molecule in different environments.

AI.tldr: EVA-Flow 是一个统一的环境感知分子构象生成框架，通过跨环境迁移学习在真空、蛋白-配体对接、溶剂化和晶体堆积四种环境下生成构象，并在数据稀缺场景中收益最大。
AI.motivation: 分子三维结构对热力学、动力学、结晶与成核模拟至关重要，但分子几何会随环境显著变化。现有模型要么忽略环境效应，要么为每种环境单独训练模型，且配体结合、结晶等场景训练数据稀缺。
AI.method: 提出 EVA-Flow 框架：学习共享的化学结构表示，并通过环境条件化的生成建模（flow）对其进行适配；采用跨环境预训练与微调策略，统一处理真空、蛋白-配体对接、溶剂化与晶体堆积四种环境。
AI.result: 在三种数据稀缺设定中，预训练与跨环境微调带来的提升最大；与多个参考构象对比，EVA-Flow 能覆盖较广的溶剂化构象范围；对跨环境共享分子的分析支持其能为同一分子在不同环境下生成不同构象。
