AI.conclusion: 环境间迁移学习在构象生成中是可行的，统一模型在数据有限时表现更优，验证了环境条件化生成建模的有效性。

title: MedConstBench: Benchmarking How Constitutions Steer LLMs in Medical Ethics
summary: As large language models advance rapidly, they are increasingly used to answer medical questions, and many such models are now deployed locally. Once a model is deployed, its behavior is governed mainly by the ethical policy written into its constitution. However, most existing work focuses on factual correctness rather than the trade-off between competing ethical values. Even benchmarks that do evaluate ethics treat it as a fixed property of the model rather than as a variable, so how a constitution reshapes medical-ethics behavior remains largely unexplored. We introduce MedConstBench, a medical-ethics benchmark that treats the deployment constitution as a controlled variable, is organized around Beauchamp's four principles, and is scored by human-calibrated multi-model peer review. It includes MedDilemma, our own dataset of clinical dilemmas, and supports a systematic analysis of how constitutions steer LLMs. Evaluating ten open-source LLMs under four constitutions, we find that the effect of a constitution is dimension-selective and model-dependent, and that no constitution is universally optimal. Motivated by these findings, we propose a do-no-harm adaptive selector that chooses a constitution per model, matching the per-model oracle while guaranteeing a worst-case floor and generalizing to unseen models at low cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MedConstBench，一个将"部署宪法（constitution）"作为可控变量的医疗伦理基准，围绕 Beauchamp 四原则组织，采用人工校准的多模型同行评审打分；并基于发现提出 do-no-harm 自适应宪法选择器。
AI.motivation: LLM 广泛用于回答医疗问题且常本地部署，部署后行为主要受写入宪法中的伦理策略支配；但现有工作多关注事实正确性，忽视竞争性伦理价值间的权衡，且已有伦理基准把伦理当作模型的固定属性而非可控变量，因此"宪法如何重塑医疗伦理行为"尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 构建 MedConstBench：①将部署宪法作为受控变量；②以 Beauchamp 四原则（自主、不伤害、有利、公正）组织评测；③用人工校准的多模型同行评审打分；④提出并纳入自建临床困境数据集 MedDilemma；⑤在 10 个开源 LLM、4 种宪法下做系统评测；⑥提出 do-no-harm 自适应选择器，按模型挑选宪法。
AI.result: 宪法效应具有维度选择性且依赖具体模型，不存在普遍最优的宪法；所提 do-no-harm 自适应选择器达到逐模型 oracle 水平，同时保证最差情况下限，并能以低成本泛化到未见模型。
AI.conclusion: 将宪法视为可调变量是研究医疗伦理对齐的有效视角；因宪法效果因模型而异，应按模型自适应选择宪法，而 do-no-harm 选择器提供了性能与安全下限兼顾的可行方案。

title: DocXEval: A Systematic Evaluation of Explainability in Multimodal Document Understanding
summary: Multimodal transformer models have driven unprecedented performance breakthroughs in modern document understanding. However, the inherent black-box nature of these models remains a major obstacle to their safe deployment in high-stakes sectors. Despite significant progress in explainability for vision and language tasks, explainable AI (XAI) research tailored to multimodal document understanding has received little attention. To address this gap, we present \ourframework{}, the first comprehensive explainability framework that adapts existing XAI methods and evaluation metrics to the multimodal (text, layout, and image) document understanding context, while introducing efficient multi-target adaptations of both methods and metrics for domain-specific tasks such as semantic entity recognition. Using \ourframework{}, we systematically evaluate 13 XAI methods across 3 document understanding tasks, 8 datasets, 4 models, and 17 evaluation metrics, and find that only a few methods perform consistently across all evaluation criteria, with Occlusion emerging as the most faithful and interpretable method overall. Through a dedicated meta-evaluation, we observe moderate to strong agreement among several faithfulness and complexity metrics while identifying certain ones that produce unreliable results. Finally, through multiple dataset-wide diagnostic analyses, we uncover key insights into model behavior, including the contribution of individual modalities across tasks and labels, spatial attribution patterns around target entities, and potential dataset biases. Overall, this work serves as both a benchmark and a practical guide for future XAI research in multimodal document understanding. To support reproducibility, we publicly release our code at https://github.com/saifullah3396/docxeval/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向多模态文档理解（文本、布局、图像）的可解释性框架，系统评测13种XAI方法与17种评估指标，发现Occlusion方法整体最忠实、最可解释，并揭示多项模型行为与数据偏差洞见。
AI.motivation: 多模态Transformer在文档理解上性能优异，但其黑箱特性阻碍了在高风险领域的部署；而针对多模态文档理解的XAI研究（方法与评估）严重不足。
AI.method: 构建综合可解释性框架，将现有XAI方法与评估指标适配到多模态文档场景，并为语义实体识别等领域任务提出高效的多目标适配版本；在3个任务、8个数据集、4个模型、17个指标上系统评测13种XAI方法，并进行元评估与数据集级诊断分析。
AI.result: 仅少数方法在所有评估标准下表现一致，Occlusion整体最忠实且最可解释；多项忠实性与复杂度指标间存在中到强一致性，部分指标结果不可靠；诊断分析揭示各模态贡献、目标实体周围的空间归因模式及潜在数据偏差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为多模态文档理解的XAI研究提供了基准与实践指南，并公开代码以支持可复现性。

title: GradCO: Behavior-Aware Gradient-Conflict Offloading for Text-Based Person Anomaly Search
summary: Text-based Person Anomaly Search (TPAS) retrieves a target pedestrian using natural-language descriptions of appearance and normal or anomalous behavior. Unlike conventional text-based person retrieval, TPAS must preserve identity cues while distinguishing fine-grained behaviors. It presents two challenges: same-identity, different-behavior hard negatives cause gradient conflict during granular alignment, while strong appearance cues can obscure weak behavioral evidence during aggregation. We propose GradCO (behavior-aware Gradient-Conflict Offloading), comprising three complementary components. Behavior-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE) forms appearance, normal-behavior, and anomalous-behavior streams whose roles are learned from retrieval objectives without expert-specific semantic labels. Conflict Offload Learning (COL) uses pair-conditioned offload anchors in similarity computation to reduce the conflicting-gradient burden on the main text representations. Hierarchical Intent Alignment (HIA) aggregates expert similarities and features using query-conditioned weights. Experiments on five TPAS/TIPR benchmarks show GradCO significantly surpasses SOTA methods and validate our design.

AI.tldr: 提出 GradCO（行为感知梯度冲突卸载）框架用于文本行人异常搜索（TPAS），通过 B-MoE、COL、HIA 三组件缓解同身份异行为难负样本的梯度冲突与外观掩盖行为证据问题，在五个基准上显著超越 SOTA。
AI.motivation: TPAS 需同时保持身份线索并区分细粒度行为，存在两大挑战：同身份不同行为的难负样本在细粒度对齐中引发梯度冲突；强外观线索在特征聚合时掩盖弱行为证据。
AI.method: GradCO 包含三部分：(1) Behavior-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE)，构建外观、正常行为、异常行为三条专家流，其角色由检索目标学习得到，无需专家语义标签；(2) Conflict Offload Learning (COL)，在相似度计算中引入对条件化的卸载锚点，减轻主文本表示上的冲突梯度负担；(3) Hierarchical Intent Alignment (HIA)，用查询条件化权重聚合专家相似度与特征。
AI.result: 在五个 TPAS/TIPR 基准上，GradCO 显著超越现有 SOTA 方法，并通过实验验证了各设计组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GradCO 通过梯度冲突卸载与层级意图对齐有效解决 TPAS 中的细粒度行为区分难题，为行为感知的行人检索提供了有效方案。

title: Decoupling Consistency and Conflict across MLLM Layers for Fake News Detection
summary: The trustworthiness of Web content faces a growing threat from multimodal fake news. Real news usually shows aligned image-text semantics, while fake news often contains a few conflicts at varying levels, such as mismatches in objects, scenes, events, and claims. However, existing methods usually treat consistency and conflict in a coarse and static way, limiting their ability to capture sparse conflicts and adapt to varying conflict levels. Inspired by the distinct knowledge encoded across layers in large language models, we propose Multi-Level Consistency and Conflict Decoupling (MLCCD), which captures conflicts at different levels from different layers of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Specifically, we first use the MLLM's final decision representation to select visual and textual tokens relevant to the task, preventing irrelevant content from diluting sparse conflicts. Then, we preserve tokens whose representations change sharply between adjacent layers, capturing the knowledge each layer adds. Finally, we decouple this knowledge into consistency and conflict evidence and aggregate each across layers with its own router, adapting to varying conflict levels. Experiments on three benchmarks show that MLCCD outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出MLCCD方法，利用MLLM不同层编码的知识，多层级解耦一致性与冲突证据，以检测多模态假新闻。
AI.motivation: 多模态假新闻中真实新闻图文语义一致，而假新闻存在少量、多层级（物体、场景、事件、主张）的冲突。现有方法将一致性与冲突处理得粗糙且静态，难以捕捉稀疏冲突、适应不同冲突层级。
AI.method: 1）用MLLM最终决策表示选取任务相关的视觉与文本token，避免无关内容稀释稀疏冲突；2）保留相邻层间表示变化剧烈的token，捕捉每层新增知识；3）将知识解耦为一致性与冲突证据，并各用独立router跨层聚合，以适应不同冲突层级。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，MLCCD优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 多层级、动态解耦一致性与冲突的思路能有效提升多模态假新闻检测性能。

title: Bridging Exploration and Loss of Plasticity in On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms have been observed to lose the ability to adaptively learn from new data, a phenomenon termed Loss of Plasticity (LoP). While many metrics have been shown to correlate with it, the causal mechanisms and the geometric conditions from which it can arise have not been clearly identified. We analyze LoP in Proximal Policy Optimization with isotropic Gaussian policies, the state-of-the-art formulation for many continuous action spaces in RL. We report multiple metrics which characterize the effect that the policy standard deviation $σ$ has on LoP, and we also suggest related explanations for the effectiveness of widely adopted LoP mitigation techniques. We observe a significant effect of $σ$ on the extent of LoP, and accompany this with both theoretical and experimental supporting arguments. Our experimental validation consists of LoP benchmark evaluations against standard baselines as well as real-world policy deployment on a 7-DoF robotic arm.

AI.tldr: 本文在PPO中使用各向同性高斯策略，研究策略标准差σ对可塑性丧失(LoP)的影响，给出度量指标与理论/实验解释，并验证对LoP缓解技术的解释。
AI.motivation: 深度RL存在可塑性丧失(LoP)现象，已有许多相关度指标，但其因果机制及产生LoP的几何条件尚不清晰；作者希望针对连续动作空间中常用的PPO+各向同性高斯策略厘清LoP成因。
AI.method: 分析PPO各向同性高斯策略中σ对LoP的作用，提出多个刻画该效应的度量指标，给出理论论证并结合实验；实验包括标准基线对比的LoP benchmark评估，以及7自由度机械臂上的真实部署。
AI.result: 观察到σ对LoP程度有显著影响，并有理论与实验支持；同时为常用LoP缓解技术的有效性提供相关解释。
AI.conclusion: σ是影响PPO中可塑性丧失的关键因素，可据此理解LoP的几何条件及缓解方法的有效性，并在真实机器人任务中验证。

title: ATEMPO: Amortized Transfer Entropy Model Per-lag Over-Time
summary: When one time series informs another, the delay at which that information arrives determines if models can utilize this relationship effectively. A source may be strongly predictive at one delay but uninformative at neighboring lags. Therefore, fixed input windows may obscure this structure by bundling informative and irrelevant history together. Transfer entropy (TE) can recover these delays by measuring how much a source's past tells us about a target beyond the target's own history. However, existing TE estimators require separate fits across source and conditioning depths, with further estimation on local windows to track delays over time. We introduce ATEMPO, a diffusion-based transfer entropy estimator amortized over lags and time. ATEMPO samples source and conditioning depths during training and conditions explicitly on temporal position, allowing a single score network to estimate the full TE surface without refitting. Differencing this surface recovers when information arrives. Across synthetic datasets with ground-truth TE, ATEMPO achieves the lowest mean relative error among baselines, and on datasets with known lags, ATEMPO achieves $0.98\pm0.04$ lag-detection accuracy. ATEMPO requires a single fit across source depths $K=6$ and target depths $L=3$, whereas existing estimators require 18 separate fits to evaluate the same $K \times L$ grid. On three systems with time-varying lag, ATEMPO is the only estimator to maintain perfect lag-detection accuracy across all evaluated window lengths. These recovered delays improve downstream forecasting: ATEMPO-selected inputs reduce MSE on WEATHER-5K by 7.25%, while 120 selected inputs outperform the benchmark's 240-feature default by 4.6%. Across three brain-computer interface tasks, using ATEMPO-selected lags achieves the highest or equal-best $R^2$, improving mean $R^2$ by 4.1% relative to the strongest competing baseline.

AI.tldr: ATEMPO 是一个基于扩散模型的传递熵估计器，在所有滞后与时间点上摊销，一次拟合即可估计完整的传递熵曲面，从而恢复时变信息延迟并提升下游预测。
AI.motivation: 时间序列间信息传递存在特定延迟，固定输入窗口会把有用历史与无关历史捆绑在一起，掩盖该结构。传递熵可恢复延迟，但既有估计器需在源深度与条件深度上分别拟合并对局部窗口逐一估计，代价高且难以跟踪时变延迟。
AI.method: 提出 ATEMPO：训练时随机采样源深度 K 与条件深度 L，并显式以时间位置为条件，让单一评分网络（扩散模型）估计完整 TE 曲面而无需重拟合；对该曲面做差分即可定位信息到达时刻。
AI.result: 在含真值 TE 的合成数据上平均相对误差最低；已知滞后数据集上滞后检测精度 0.98±0.04。评估 K=6、L=3 的 18 格网格仅需一次拟合（基线需 18 次）。三个时变滞后系统中，在所有窗口长度下保持完美滞后检测精度。下游：WEATHER-5K 上 MSE 降低 7.25%，120 个选中输入优于基准 240 特征默认设置 4.6%；三个脑机接口任务上取得最高或并列最高 R²，平均 R² 提升 4.1%。
AI.conclusion: ATEMPO 以摊销式扩散估计实现高效、可跟踪的传递熵曲面估计，恢复的延迟在预测与脑机接口任务中均带来实际收益，兼具效率与准确性。

title: CASEL: Consequence-Aware Selective Execution for Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 2026 5th International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data Application and Software Engineering (CBASE 2026)
summary: Tool-using language agents increasingly modify external systems, yet most runtime safeguards allocate scrutiny by generic uncertainty scores or coarse mutation heuristics. We introduce CASEL (Consequence-Aware Selective Execution Layer), a model-agnostic runtime allocation policy that combines calibrated failure probability, state-dependent consequence, reversibility, ambiguity, and evidence freshness to choose, for each proposed tool call, among direct execution, verification, sandboxing, clarification, approval, and abstention by minimizing a per-mode cost. We formalize direct execution as selective prediction and state and test the validity conditions of a finite-sample threshold and a trajectory risk ledger. In a controlled simulation over 20 seeds with 120,000 test actions each, in which every method has the same intervention menu and the same compute cost, CASEL reduces harmful-side-effect trajectories from 14.75 percent for an uncertainty-ranked gate to 7.02 percent and mean normalized harm from 0.184 to 0.123. A gate ranked by the product of failure probability and consequence reaches similar harm (5.82 percent, 0.120) but sends 45 percent more actions to human approval, and removing reversibility-aware routing raises the rate to 15.53 percent. A trajectory-level risk budget, in contrast, increases harm at equal cost (11.82 percent). Intervention effectiveness is assumed, not measured: the results rank allocation rules under the simulator's assumptions and do not establish deployment effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出CASEL，一个模型无关的运行时分配策略，对每个工具调用按"失败概率×后果×可逆性×歧义×证据时效"最小化代价，在直接执行/核验/沙箱/澄清/审批/拒答间选择；模拟中危害轨迹率由14.75%降至7.02%。
AI.motivation: 工具型语言智能体日益修改外部系统，但现有运行时防护多依据通用不确定性分数或粗略变更启发式来分配审查资源，未能区分后果严重性与可逆性。
AI.method: 将直接执行形式化为选择性预测，联合校准失败概率、状态相关后果、可逆性、歧义与证据新鲜度，为每种干预模式定义代价并择优；同时给出有限样本阈值的有效性条件与轨迹级风险账本。在20个种子、每法12万测试动作、干预菜单与计算成本均相同的受控模拟中对比。
AI.result: 有害副作用轨迹率从不确定性排序门控的14.75%降至7.02%，平均归一化危害0.184→0.123；"失败概率×后果"门控危害相近（5.82%，0.120）但人工审批多45%；去掉可逆性感知路由升至15.53%；轨迹级风险预算在等成本下反而升至11.82%。
AI.conclusion: 在相同干预与成本下，后果感知的分配优于不确定性排序；但干预有效性系假设而非实测，结论仅为模拟假设下的规则排序，未证明部署有效性。

title: JevRec: Linguistic Encoding with Jev-like Decision Modeling for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) represents items as semantic identifiers (SIDs) and autoregressively generates the next item's SID from interaction history. However, most methods assign the same SID length to all items despite highly unequal interaction frequencies. This uniform design repeatedly incurs the cost of fine-grained codes for popular items, while shortening codes to reduce this cost also compresses the semantic representations of long-tail items. Inspired by the compact forms of frequent expressions in natural language, we propose JevRec to encode items as variable-length words and generate the next item from interaction context. Linguistic encoding retains frequency-dependent semantic prefixes from shared codebooks, producing shorter SIDs for popular items and richer descriptions for long-tail items. Yet predicting a sequence-level length and generating token-level content impose different optimization requirements that may conflict under a shared output head. Our Jev-like decision modeling component therefore predicts a length distribution with a dedicated head and generates content conditioned on length through a separate head while sharing the interaction-history representation. Experiments on three public datasets show that JevRec outperforms all compared baselines across the evaluated recommendation metrics. Further analyses show lower training and inference time than TIGER and reduced gradient conflict between length and content prediction.

AI.tldr: JevRec 将商品编码为可变长度语义标识（SID），按交互频率自适应长度，并用 Jev 式长度分布+内容分头生成，提升生成式推荐的准确性并降低成本。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐对所有商品使用相同长度的 SID，但交互频率差异极大：热门商品反复承担细粒度编码的代价，若统一缩短又会压缩长尾商品的语义表达。
AI.method: 受自然语言中高频表达形式简省的启发，将商品建模为可变长度"词"，从共享码本中保留与频率相关的语义前缀。设计 Jev 式决策建模：用专属 head 预测序列级长度分布，用另一独立 head 在该长度条件下生成 token 内容，二者共享交互历史表示以缓解优化冲突。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上，JevRec 在所有评估的推荐指标上优于全部对比基线；训练与推理时间低于 TIGER，且长度预测与内容预测间的梯度冲突减弱。
AI.conclusion: 频率自适应的变长 SID 结合解耦的长度/内容决策建模，是提升生成式推荐效果与效率的有效方案，值得在更多场景验证。

title: LCM-Promo: An LLM-Based Uplift Model for Promotion Allocation
comment: 4 pages, 2 tables. Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026 (Industrial Track)
summary: We present LCM-Promo, an LLM-based uplift model for promotion allocation. LCM-Promo is a task-specific Large Commerce Model (LCM): a finetuned LLM trained on transactional commerce data to predict user intent and promotion response. It learns monotonic promotion-response curves from production logs by interpreting single-token outputs as conversion-threshold probabilities, while conditioning on session context such as day and delivery shift. In a production A/B test on churn reactivation, LCM-Promo increased conversion by 1% and reduced promotion cost by 6% relative to the Segment-EMA production baseline.

AI.tldr: LCM-Promo是基于微调大语言模型（Large Commerce Model）的促销分配uplift模型，从生产日志中学习单调的促销响应曲线，并在流失唤醒的线上A/B测试中将转化率提升1%、促销成本降低6%。
AI.motivation: 促销资源分配需要准确估计用户对促销的增量响应（uplift）。传统基线（如Segment-EMA）难以充分利用交易数据与上下文信息，也难以刻画符合业务直觉的单调促销-响应关系，从而造成转化损失和促销成本浪费。
AI.method: 将通用LLM在交易型商业数据上微调为任务特定的Large Commerce Model。模型以会话上下文（如日期、配送时段）为条件，把单token输出解释为"转化阈值概率"，从而从生产日志中直接学出单调的促销-响应曲线，并基于该曲线预测用户意图与促销响应，用于促销分配。
AI.result: 在流失唤醒场景的线上A/B测试中，相对Segment-EMA生产基线，转化率提升1%，促销成本下降6%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明将LLM微调与单调阈值建模范式结合，可在真实生产系统中同时提升转化效率并降低促销成本，为LLM在营销uplift建模与资源分配中的应用提供了落地证据。

title: LabWorld: Learning Interactive 4D Worlds for Scientific Experimentation
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. Suozhi Huang and Kelsey Fu contributed equally
summary: Autonomous scientific agents must not only reason about experiments but also interact with the physical environments in which they are executed. Existing laboratory simulators typically rely on manually constructed assets and predefined procedures, while laboratory videos capture real equipment, layouts, and interactions but leave this information implicit in pixels. We introduce LabWorld, an agent-driven Real2Sim framework for reconstructing interactive 4D laboratory worlds from monocular RGB video. LabWorld recovers reusable 3D assets, a metric scene, time-varying object states, and procedure events. Multi-frame observations provide complementary evidence for asset and scene reconstruction, while motion reconstruction combines visual and geometric observations with event constraints encoding the spatial and temporal requirements of laboratory interactions. We evaluate LabWorld on real pipetting and vortexing videos collected in our laboratory against general-purpose agentic and dedicated reconstruction baselines. For pipetting, LabWorld achieves a mean Mask IoU of 0.501, exceeding the strongest baseline by 0.033. For vortexing, it achieves a mean Tube-Length-Normalized PCK-AUC of 0.638, exceeding the strongest baseline by 0.035. On five pipetting videos, event-conditioned reconstruction increases the fraction of modeled physical constraints satisfied from 14.3% (5/35) to 100% (35/35). The resulting worlds expose geometry, motion, articulation, and events as explicit, editable state for replay, inspection, and future embodied scientific systems.

AI.tldr: LabWorld 是一个由智能体驱动的 Real2Sim 框架，从单目 RGB 视频重建可交互的 4D 实验室世界（可复用 3D 资产、度量场景、时变物体状态与流程事件）。
AI.motivation: 自主科学智能体不仅需推理实验，还需与物理实验环境交互。现有实验室仿真器依赖手工资产与预定义流程，而实验室视频虽包含真实设备、布局与交互信息，却只以像素形式隐式存在。
AI.method: 利用多帧观测为资产与场景重建提供互补证据；运动重建结合视觉与几何观测，并引入编码实验交互时空要求的事件约束；在自采的真实移液与涡旋视频上，与通用智能体式及专用重建基线对比评估。
AI.result: 移液任务平均 Mask IoU 达 0.501，超最强基线 0.033；涡旋任务 Tube-Length-Normalized PCK-AUC 达 0.638，超最强基线 0.035；5 段移液视频中事件条件重建使满足物理约束的比例从 14.3%（5/35）提升至 100%（35/35）。
AI.conclusion: 重建所得世界以显式、可编辑状态暴露几何、运动、关节与事件，可支持回放、检视及未来具身科学系统。

title: Confidence Is Not a Promise: A Reference Audit of Typed Decision Models
comment: 51 pages, 11 figures. Code, derived data, preregistration notes and frozen answers: https://github.com/pcbrom/typed-deciders-audit and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23676316
summary: Typed decision models return a probability distribution over options supplied by the caller, and software tends to act on that number as if it were a guarantee. We measure what it licenses, comparing the open-weight Laya, in five checkpoints, with Jev 1.13, available only through an API. A probability licenses a statement about groups of decisions, not about one decision, and a gate that promises an accuracy among the cases it decides alone keeps that promise only with a lower bound checked on data like its traffic. Across 190 exchangeable evaluations, a threshold chosen by point estimate breaks the promise in 147, Learn then Test keeps it in all of them, and a Beta lower-bound rule decides more items on average than Learn then Test in 128 and fewer in none, without its guarantee. Calibrated in English, Jev keeps a promise of 95% in 8 of 51 locales. Ordinary typing noise breaks a promise calibrated on clean text, and, in exploratory runs, training with noise raises the noisy accuracy with no loss on clean text. In four further domains, a fine-tuned Laya needs from 250 to 8,000 labels to be non-inferior to Jev, and does not get there on LIAR2. Under drift, the preregistered claim for a Bayesian retraining loop is not supported: the loop avoids needless retraining where the change does not degrade the model, at a cost equivalent to recalibration alone, and re-qualifying the threshold in every window keeps the promise more often where it does. On the monthly series of M3, neither decider predicts the direction of the next value better than a constant answer. Confidence separates right from wrong answers with an AUROC from 0.80 to 0.96, but it does not select faithful explanations, and exact coalition games of single decisions show what an explanation can still say through an API that rounds to two decimals. We release the frozen answers with a datasheet, a promise check and the code.

AI.tldr: 论文检验类型化决策模型输出的概率分布究竟能"许可"什么承诺：概率只对群体而非单个决策有效。通过190组可交换评估发现，点估计选阈值在147组违背承诺，Learn then Test 全部守住，Beta 下界规则在无保证下平均决策更多。
AI.motivation: 软件常把模型输出的概率当作保证来行动，但这种解读缺乏依据。作者想量化概率真正能支撑何种统计承诺，并检验校准与承诺在跨语言、噪声、漂移等真实条件下的稳健性。
AI.method: 对比开放权重 Laya（五个检查点）与仅 API 可用的 Jev 1.13；在190组可交换评估上比较点估计阈值、Learn then Test 与 Beta 下界规则；跨51个语言环境测试校准承诺；考察打字噪声与噪声训练；在四个额外领域测试微调所需标签量；在漂移下检验贝叶斯重训循环的预注册主张；用 M3 月度序列检验方向预测；评估置信度对正确性（AUROC）及对忠实解释的选择能力。
AI.result: 点估计阈值在147/190组违背承诺，Learn then Test 全部守住；Beta 下界规则平均决策数在128组更多、零组更少但无保证。英语校准的 Jev 在51个语言环境中仅8个维持95%承诺。噪声破坏干净文本上的校准，但噪声训练可提升噪声准确率且不损失干净性能。微调 Laya 需250至8000标签才不劣于 Jev，LIAR2 上未能达到。漂移下预注册的贝叶斯重训主张未获支持，逐窗口重新认证阈值更能守住承诺。M3 上两种决策器均不如常数预测方向。置信度 AUROC 0.80–0.96，但不能挑选忠实解释。
AI.conclusion: 模型概率不足以作为单决策保证，需用有统计保证的阈值方法（如 Learn then Test）并在真实流量与漂移下持续重新认证；跨语言校准与解释忠实性仍是显著缺口。作者发布冻结答案、数据表、承诺检查与代码以供复现。

title: God Does Not Play Dice: Enforcing Batch Invariance in Agentic Kernel Generation
summary: Large language model (LLM) serving systems dynamically batch user requests for GPU execution, so the same request may be processed alongside different requests across runs. If the GPU kernels lack batch invariance (BI), this changing batch context can alter the numerical output for an unchanged input, undermining reproducibility. Existing kernel generation agents focus on correctness and efficiency but \emph{overlook BI}. We find 19 confirmed BI violations among 83 batch-applicable released artifacts. To address this limitation, we propose \tool, which combines contract-guided static dependency analysis with dynamic validation of bitwise consistency across batch contexts. \tool is designed as a plug-in component for general kernel agents, allowing their original optimization capabilities to be reused while adding BI enforcement. We integrate it as successive acceptance gates in the optimization loop, rejecting structurally risky or dynamically non-invariant candidates before performance benchmarking and returning feedback to the agent. Experiments across three agent frameworks under baseline and BI-aware generation on real world LLM serving tasks show that \tool improves the BI pass rate from 67.6\% to 91.9\% while retaining 91.8\% of the baseline geometric mean speedup. These results demonstrate that \tool can be incorporated into kernel optimization by agents as an additional reliability objective alongside correctness and speed.

AI.tldr: 提出 \tool，一种可插拔组件，通过合约引导的静态依赖分析+跨批次上下文比特级一致性动态验证，为核生成代理强制批次不变性(BI)，将BI通过率从67.6%提升至91.9%，并保留91.8%的加速比。
AI.motivation: LLM服务系统动态批处理使得同一请求在不同批次上下文中被处理，若GPU核缺乏批次不变性(BI)，则相同输入会产生不同数值输出，破坏可复现性。现有核生成代理只关注正确性与效率，忽视BI；作者发现83个可批处理发布工件中有19个确认违反BI。
AI.method: \tool结合合约引导的静态依赖分析与跨批次上下文比特级一致性的动态验证，作为通用核代理的插件模块，在优化循环中作为连续验收门，在性能基准测试前拒绝结构上有风险或动态非不变的候选，并向代理返回反馈。
AI.result: 在三个代理框架、基线与BI感知生成条件下，于真实LLM服务任务上实验：BI通过率从67.6%提升至91.9%，同时保留基线几何平均加速比的91.8%。
AI.conclusion: \tool可作为正确性与速度之外的额外可靠性目标，被核优化代理集成，表明BI可被有效纳入代理驱动的核优化流程。

title: Self-Keyed In-Parameter Memorization for External Memory-Free Dialogue Recall in Frozen Language Models
summary: A large language model maintains conversational content in an external storage that is outside the model and grows as the dialogue continues. This work assumes an environment where a language model has no external memory and no prior knowledge of the future question or its answer. The motivation is to research whether a dialogue can be stored in the model parameters and later answer a question about it. This work proposes self-keyed in-parameter memorization (SKIM), a closed-form method in which the model generates its own questions about each dialogue turn and writes those questions into its parameters as the keys that later retrieve the turn's content. Generating many varied questions for each turn allows a later user question to match one even when phrased differently, and its answer is recalled from the parameters alone. Evaluated on five language models, SKIM recalls most stored dialogue turns from later user questions, and it answers from the model parameters without any external storage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SKIM，一种让语言模型把对话内容写入自身参数、无需外部存储即可在后续提问时回忆答案的闭式方法。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型依赖外部存储保存对话内容且存储随对话增长；作者想探究在无外部记忆、且事先不知道未来问题及答案的条件下，能否把对话存进模型参数本身并在之后作答。
AI.method: 自键参数内记忆（SKIM）：对每个对话轮次，模型自动生成多个多样的自问问题，并将这些问题作为“键”以闭式方式写入模型参数；后续用户提问只要与某个生成问题匹配（即便措辞不同），即可从参数中检索并回忆该轮内容。
AI.result: 在五个语言模型上评估，SKIM 能根据后续用户问题回忆出大多数存储的对话轮次，且完全依靠模型参数作答，不使用任何外部存储。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明对话信息可以真正编码进模型参数并用于后续问答，为无外部记忆的对话记忆机制提供了可行方案。

title: WithinVAE: Compact Visual Autoencoding with Self-Distilled Semantics
summary: Visual autoencoders must balance reconstruction fidelity, compactness, and semantic structure. Existing semantic tokenizers typically inherit semantics from pretrained recognition encoders, whose invariances can discard the appearance detail required for inversion. We show that this inheritance is unnecessary: semantic structure can be learned inside an autoencoder's own reconstructive representation. We introduce WithinVAE, a compact variational visual autoencoder with a sequential bottleneck, DINO/iBOT-style self-distillation from an exponential-moving-average copy of the autoencoder itself, and position-dependent token masking to achieve a 4-fold compression ratio, which is free of pretrained representation encoder or external semantic target. On ImageNet-1K at $256\times256$, WithinVAE improves all four reported reconstruction metrics over RPiAE including PSNR by 1.36 dB, while using half its latent scalar capacity. Under frozen evaluation, the same latents improve linear probing by 6.5 points over RPiAE and 5.1 points over our reconstruction-only baseline, attributing the semantic gains to self-distillation rather than architecture or external supervision. An auxiliary latent-to-latent model reproduces the ordered-compression trend, and a pixel-to-latent model transfers the objective to a pretrained generative space. These results separate the origin of semantic supervision from its use: a compact visual autoencoder can organize semantic structure without borrowing a recognition representation.

AI.tldr: WithinVAE 证明语义结构可在自编码器自身的重建表示内学习，无需借用预训练识别编码器，在更小潜变量容量下同时提升重建与语义质量。
AI.motivation: 现有语义 tokenizer 通常继承预训练识别编码器的语义，但其不变性会丢弃可逆所需的外观细节；论文质疑这种继承是否必要。
AI.method: 构建紧凑变分视觉自编码器：序贯瓶颈 + 自EMA副本的 DINO/iBOT 式自蒸馏 + 位置相关 token 掩码，实现 4 倍压缩，不使用预训练编码器或外部语义目标。
AI.result: ImageNet-1K 256×256 上四项重建指标全面优于 RPiAE，PSNR 提升 1.36 dB 且潜标量容量仅一半；冻结评估下线性探针较 RPiAE 提升 6.5 点、较纯重建基线提升 5.1 点；辅助实验复现有序压缩趋势并迁移到预训练生成空间。
AI.conclusion: 语义监督的来源与其使用可分离：紧凑视觉自编码器能在不借识别表示的情况下组织语义结构，语义增益源于自蒸馏而非架构或外部监督。

title: AHEAD: Adaptive Neural Acceleration for Large-Scale Linear Programming
summary: Large-scale linear programs with millions of variables and constraints strain time and memory budgets. First-order methods such as the primal-dual hybrid gradient scale to this regime because they avoid matrix factorizations, but they require many iterations. Learned accelerators can reduce these iterations, yet fewer iterations do not guarantee a shorter solve. Learning inference also takes time, and running the accelerator longer trades solver time for inference time. Existing unrolled accelerators handle this trade-off poorly: each layer processes every variable and constraint, the predicted iterates still need solver refinement, and every instance runs the same layers. We therefore ask: What neural accelerator design achieves end-to-end speedups on large-scale linear programs across sizes and target accuracies? We introduce AHEAD, an accelerator that predicts step sizes for first-order linear programming solvers while keeping their update rules. Its weight-shared predictor reads compact solver statistics and rescales the primal and dual step sizes, so each warm-start iteration stays inexpensive and a short warm-start phase hands the solver a warm start. A learned handoff policy sets the number of warm-start iterations for each instance and target accuracy, after which the solver finishes under its own termination criterion. On packing linear programs with up to $10^7$ variables, AHEAD achieves $6.5$--$11.6\times$ end-to-end speedups over Gurobi's first-order solver from a cold start, including on instances of unseen sizes and distributions. The gains extend to PageRank linear programs and hold across difficulty levels and target accuracies.

AI.tldr: AHEAD 是一种为大规模线性规划一阶求解器预测步长的神经加速器，通过权重共享的轻量预测器与学习式关闭策略，在端到端上实现 6.5–11.6 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 百万级变量与约束的线性规划受时间与内存限制；一阶方法（如 PDHG）无需矩阵分解但迭代次数多。已有展开式加速器存在弊端：每层处理全部变量与约束、预测迭代仍需求解器精修、所有实例跑相同层数，且推理本身耗时，减少迭代不等于缩短求解时间。
AI.method: 提出 AHEAD：保留一阶求解器更新规则，仅用权重共享的预测器读取紧凑求解器统计量，对原始与对偶步长进行重缩放，使每次热启动迭代开销低；短热启动阶段后将结果交给求解器；再用学习式交接策略为每个实例和目标精度决定热启动迭代次数，之后由求解器按自身终止准则完成。
AI.result: 在变量数达 10^7 的 packing 线性规划上，冷启动下相对 Gurobi 一阶求解器实现 6.5–11.6 倍端到端加速，并泛化到未见过的规模与分布；增益也扩展到 PageRank 线性规划，并在不同难度与目标精度下保持。
AI.conclusion: 面向端到端速度而非单纯减少迭代的轻量、可调热启动设计，能有效加速大规模线性规划求解并具备跨规模、跨精度的泛化能力。

title: Grounding LLM Agents in Business Processes: Process-Aware Knowledge Graphs for Reliable Multi-Step Service Invocation
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents that call enterprise APIs must select the correct endpoints, follow process order, use valid payload keys, and choose coded values from predefined lists. However, current retrieval-augmented service discovery treats endpoints independently and therefore misses process and schema constraints. We address this limitation by integrating Open Data Protocol (OData) metadata and Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) reference processes in a typed property graph. A hybrid retriever identifies candidate endpoints using dense embeddings and follows process edges to retrieve subsequent endpoints. We evaluate the method on 42 enterprise services with process-chain ground truth. For queries with low lexical overlap between the query and downstream entities, it improves Recall@3 by 5.7 points (n=74), with consistent gains across embedding models and cut-offs. It matches dense retrieval on other queries and provides no improvement on OpenAPI services without a process layer, indicating that the gains arise from process structure. We also evaluate an LLM agent on 81 multi-step queries. It completes 38.7% of tasks, compared with 10.3% for a chunk-based baseline. In an elicitation probe, providing valid code lists eliminates invented codes but leaves invalid keys in 46% of write runs. Full typed context reduces invalid calls to 3% (3 of 101 runs), with no invented codes. These results show that exposing process and schema constraints during retrieval improves the reliability of agent-driven API calls.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将OData元数据与BPMN流程模型整合为类型化属性图，并采用混合检索器沿流程边检索后续端点，从而在企业API发现中显式引入流程与模式约束，显著提升LLM智能体调用API的可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体调用企业API时需正确选择端点、遵循流程顺序、使用合法payload键并从预定义代码表中取值。但现有检索增强的服务发现方法将各端点独立处理，忽略了流程顺序与模式约束，导致下游端点漏检和非法调用。
AI.method: 构建类型化属性图，融合OData元数据与BPMN参考流程；使用稠密嵌入的混合检索器先定位候选端点，再沿流程边检索后续端点。在42个企业服务（含流程链真值）上评测；另用81条多步查询评测LLM智能体，并做代码表提示的elicitation探针实验。
AI.result: 在查询与下游实体词面重叠低的场景下，Recall@3提升5.7个百分点（n=74），且跨嵌入模型与截断值一致；其他查询上与稠密检索持平；无流程层的OpenAPI服务无提升，说明增益来自流程结构。智能体完成率38.7%，chunk-based基线为10.3%。仅提供代码表可消除编造代码但仍有46%写调用含非法键；完整类型化上下文将非法调用降至3%（101次中3次），且无编造代码。
AI.conclusion: 在检索阶段显式暴露流程与模式约束，能提升智能体驱动API调用的可靠性；增益可归因于流程结构而非单纯的检索增强。

title: The State and Fate of Multilingual, Contextual Evaluation in the NLP World
comment: Published at Conference on Language Modelling, 2026. Can be found at https://openreview.net/forum?id=s7fKZHgYsB
summary: Multilingual evaluation benchmarks are the primary instrument for assessing whether large language models generalize beyond English, yet the adequacy of these benchmarks has received little systematic scrutiny. We present a data-driven audit of 51 recent multilingual benchmarks spanning 242 datasets and 219 languages, organized around three pillars: coverage, representativeness, and rigor. Our analysis reveals that coverage is wide but thin with 36% of evaluated languages appearing in only a single benchmark, entire regions (Oceania, the Americas, Central Asia) are near-zero, and a stark task equity gap leaves low-resource languages evaluated on only 1-3 task categories versus 14 for high-resource languages. Representativeness is structurally compromised: translation from English remains the dominant construction strategy where 56% of all dataset-language instances are translated introducing artifacts and English-centric framing, while culturally grounded content is concentrated in a handful of community-driven benchmarks with narrow language scope. The ecosystem thus forces a trade-off between breadth and validity. Rigor is undermined by benchmark contamination, including translated benchmark leakage and parallel corpus overlap that evade surface-form detection. We synthesize these findings into concrete recommendations for building evaluation frameworks that are natively constructed, culturally grounded, contamination-aware, and designed to serve the communities whose languages they claim to evaluate. The dashboard with all the metadata collected can be found at https://aka.ms/multilingual-evals.

AI.tldr: 对51个近期多语言基准（242个数据集、219种语言）进行数据驱动审计，从覆盖度、代表性、严谨性三方面揭示多语言评测生态的系统性缺陷，并提出改进建议。
AI.motivation: 多语言评测基准是判断大模型能否超越英语泛化的核心工具，但其充分性此前缺乏系统审视，需要量化评估现有基准是否真正覆盖并公平对待各语言社区。
AI.method: 审计51个近期多语言基准，覆盖242个数据集与219种语言，围绕覆盖度、代表性、严谨性三支柱进行元数据分析，并构建含全部元数据的可视化面板。
AI.result: 覆盖广而薄：36%的语言仅出现在单一基准中，大洋洲、美洲、中亚等区域近乎为零，低资源语言仅1–3类任务而高资源语言达14类；代表性受损：56%的数据集-语言实例由英语翻译而来，文化根基内容集中于少数语言范围狭窄的社区驱动基准；严谨性受污染威胁，包括翻译基准泄漏与平行语料重叠，可规避表层形式检测。
AI.conclusion: 多语言评测生态被迫在广度与有效性之间取舍。作者提出应构建原生构造、文化扎根、感知污染、服务目标语言社区的评价框架，并公开元数据面板。

title: 4D Reconstruction with Events & RGB
comment: Accepted at NeVi 2026 workshop at the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
summary: Reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes over time (4D reconstruction) from a single moving camera is central to robotics and AR/VR applications, yet state-of the-art feed-forward methods rely solely on RGB frames and therefore inherit the failure modes of conventional cameras, including motion blur and temporal aliasing under fast or non-uniform camera and object motion. Event cameras report per-pixel brightness changes asynchronously at microsecond resolution, offering a complementary signal that is largely immune to these artifacts, but whether this modality can be incorporated into existing RGB based 4D reconstruction pipelines without a full architectural redesign remains an open question. In this preliminary study, we investigate a minimal extension: we augment Monst3R, an existing RGB-only 4D reconstruction model, with an additional event-camera input branch, leaving the rest of the architecture unchanged. Across 3 benchmark datasets, this simple RGB-event fusion reduces Abs Rel by 3.4% on average relative to the RGB-only Monst3R baseline, and a sensitivity analysis shows that the improvement grows with the magnitude of camera and object motion, with the largest gains observed under high object motion conditions where RGB-only reconstruction degrades most. These early results suggest that even a lightweight, non-invasive fusion of event data can meaningfully improve 4D reconstruction robustness, motivating a more thorough architectural investigation in future work.

AI.tldr: 在RGB-only的4D重建模型Monst3R上仅增加一个事件相机输入分支，其余架构不变，即可平均降低Abs Rel 3.4%，且提升随相机/物体运动加剧而增大。
AI.motivation: 单目移动相机的动态3D场景重建（4D重建）对机器人与AR/VR很重要，但现有前馈方法仅依赖RGB帧，继承了传统相机的缺陷（运动模糊、快速或非均匀运动下的时间混叠）。事件相机以微秒级分辨率异步记录亮度变化，几乎不受这些伪影影响，但能否在不重构整体架构的前提下融入RGB 4D重建流程尚不清楚。
AI.method: 初步研究，提出最小化扩展：在已有的RGB-only 4D重建模型Monst3R上添加一个额外的事件相机输入分支，保持其余架构完全不变，实现简单的RGB-事件融合。
AI.result: 在3个基准数据集上，该RGB-事件融合相较RGB-only Monst3R基线平均降低Abs Rel 3.4%；敏感性分析显示提升随相机与物体运动幅度增大而增大，在高物体运动条件下增益最大，而该条件下RGB-only重建退化最严重。
AI.conclusion: 早期结果表明，即使轻量、非侵入式地融合事件数据，也能实质提升4D重建鲁棒性，值得在后续工作中开展更深入的架构研究。

title: Reliability-Aware Short-Term Glycemic Risk Prediction Using an Anchor-Based Comparative Framework of Sequence, Multimodal, and State-Updating Digital-Twin Models
comment: 36 pages, including figures, tables, and references. Research article on reliability-aware glycemic-risk prediction using sequence models and multimodal digital twins
summary: Anticipating short-term hypoglycemic and hyperglycemic risk is essential for proactive diabetes management. However, existing machine learning approaches often use inconsistent evaluation protocols and emphasize predictive performance over reliability. This study introduces an anchor-based benchmarking framework integrating longitudinal glucose sequences and multimodal patient information. Using the T1DiabetesGranada dataset, 5,503,441 standardized prediction anchors were constructed from 736 individuals with type 1 diabetes to evaluate hypoglycemia and hyperglycemia prediction at 30-, 60-, and 120-minute horizons. Three neural architectures, a Hybrid LSTM-Transformer, a Multimodal Digital Twin, and a State-Updating Digital Twin with gap-aware longitudinal state progression, were compared under identical patient-level validation protocols. Beyond predictive performance, the evaluation examined calibration, classification thresholds, explanation reliability, cross-model disagreement, and robustness to controlled perturbations. No statistically significant predictive differences were observed after Holm correction, although the models exhibited complementary reliability characteristics. The Multimodal Digital Twin achieved the lowest mean Brier score, while the State-Updating Digital Twin demonstrated the lowest mean expected calibration error (ECE-10). The Hybrid LSTM-Transformer showed strong explanation faithfulness and stability under its temporal attribution protocol. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating digital-twin models beyond predictive accuracy and emphasize the need for reliability assessment and external validation before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出基于锚点的基准评测框架，在T1DiabetesGranada数据集上构建550万个标准化预测锚点，对三种神经网络模型在30/60/120分钟时域的低血糖与高血糖预测进行统一比较，并从校准、阈值、解释可靠性、模型分歧和鲁棒性等维度评估其可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习方法在糖尿病血糖预测中评测协议不一致，且过度强调预测性能而忽视可靠性，难以支撑临床部署。
AI.method: 构建融合纵向血糖序列与多模态患者信息的锚点式基准框架；基于T1DiabetesGranada数据（736名1型糖尿病患者）生成5,503,441个标准化预测锚点；在统一患者级验证协议下比较Hybrid LSTM-Transformer、Multimodal Digital Twin和带缺口感知纵向状态更新的State-Updating Digital Twin三种架构，并评估性能、校准、分类阈值、解释可靠性、跨模型分歧及受控扰动下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 经Holm校正后模型间预测性能无统计学显著差异；但可靠性特征互补：Multimodal Digital Twin的Brier分数最低，State-Updating Digital Twin的ECE-10最低，Hybrid LSTM-Transformer在其时间归因协议下解释忠实度与稳定性较强。
AI.conclusion: 数字孪生模型评估不应止于预测精度，需重视可靠性评估与外部验证，方可在临床部署前确保可信性。

title: ADTGuard: Adaptive Depth-Time Safeguard for Streaming Inference in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate fluent responses to diverse user requests, yet streaming may expose users to harmful content before generation is complete. Existing guardrails face two limitations in this setting. First, post-hoc moderation at response or chunk boundaries delays intervention, risking harmful exposure when content is released before verification. Second, even with token-level detection, coarse response-level supervision does not specify when harmful content begins, while fixed-layer readouts may miss relevant safety signals at other depths. To address these limitations, we introduce ADTGuard, which checks each token before release, progressively refines token-level training targets, and adapts layer selection to the current prefix. ADTGuard models risk across depth and time through Depth-Time Safety Dynamics (DTSD), which integrates safety evidence across layers at each token and uses it to guide risk accumulation over successive tokens. To adapt the choice of observation layers to the current prefix, we propose the Causal Depth Router (CDR). With only response-level labels available, we further develop Risk-Onset Target Refinement (RTR) to progressively construct token-level training targets for both components. Through extensive experiments across multiple safety benchmarks, we demonstrate that ADTGuard consistently achieves strong streaming detection performance, matching or surpassing state-of-the-art safeguards while requiring only 16M trainable parameters and maintaining competitive per-token latency.

AI.tldr: ADTGuard 提出逐 token 流式安全护栏，通过深度-时间安全动态建模与因果深度路由，在仅有回复级标签下实现低延迟、低参数量的流式有害内容检测。
AI.motivation: 流式生成中，事后或分块审核会延迟干预，导致有害内容在被验证前已暴露；而即使做到 token 级检测，粗粒度的回复级监督无法指示有害内容何时开始，固定层读取也可能错过其他深度的安全信号。
AI.method: 提出 ADTGuard：逐 token 释放前检查；核心为 Depth-Time Safety Dynamics (DTSD)，在每个 token 处整合各层安全证据，并据此引导跨 token 的风险累积；Causal Depth Router (CDR) 按当前前缀自适应选择观测层；Risk-Onset Target Refinement (RTR) 在仅有回复级标签时逐步构造 token 级训练目标。
AI.result: 在多個安全基准上，ADTGuard 持续取得强流式检测性能，匹配或超越 SOTA 护栏，仅需 16M 可训练参数，并保持有竞争力的逐 token 延迟。
AI.conclusion: ADTGuard 表明将深度与时间维度的安全信号联合建模、并结合前缀自适应层选择，可在低开销下有效实现流式安全防护。

title: Hierarchical Low-Rank Reparameterization for Parameter-Efficient
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables, including references and appendices
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods adapt large models by introducing a small number of trainable parameters. However, we find that these parameters still contain redundancy and can be further compressed while maintaining strong task performance. To this end, we propose a novel hierarchical low-rank reparameterization method. Its core idea is to reorganize the trainable parameters of PEFT methods into an approximately square matrix and then express it via a low-rank decomposition, which can be applied recursively. This forms a multi-level structure with factors compressed level by level, drastically reducing the number of trainable parameters. In our experiments, we combine this reparameterization with LoRA, DoRA, MoSA, and RaSA. We evaluate commonsense reasoning on LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, with additional GSM8K math reasoning experiments on LLaMA-3.1-8B. Under comparable trainable-parameter budgets, our method combined with LoRA or DoRA achieves better performance. Furthermore,when the parameter count of the original methods is compressed by approximately an order of magnitude, our method can still maintain competitive task performance and even surpass the corresponding baselines in average accuracy across the eight commonsense reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出分层低秩重参数化方法，将PEFT的可训练参数重组为近似方阵并递归低秩分解，逐级压缩参数，与LoRA/DoRA/MoSA/RaSA结合后以更少参数取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: PEFT方法（如LoRA）引入的可训练参数本身仍存在冗余，可以在保持任务性能的同时进一步压缩。
AI.method: 将PEFT方法的可训练参数重新组织为近似方阵，通过低秩分解表示并递归应用，形成逐级压缩因子的多级层次结构，大幅减少可训练参数量；可与LoRA、DoRA、MoSA、RaSA结合。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-3.1-8B与Qwen2.5-7B上评测常识推理（另在LLaMA-3.1-8B上做GSM8K数学推理）。同等可训练参数预算下，与LoRA或DoRA结合性能更优；参数量压缩约一个数量级时仍保持竞争力，八项常识推理基准的平均准确率甚至超过对应基线。
AI.conclusion: PEFT参数存在可压缩冗余，分层低秩重参数化是一种通用、模型无关的插件式压缩方案，能在极小参数预算下维持甚至超越原方法性能。

title: Adapting Video Models for Robot Control via Motion-guided Asymmetric Prediction
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video generative models for robotic control by jointly predicting future visual observations and actions. The visual prediction objective plays a key role in adapting pretrained video representations to the target robot domain. Yet standard visual prediction inherited from video pretraining treats all visual regions uniformly, despite their differing relevance to robotic control. We therefore investigate the spatial allocation of visual supervision in WAMs and show that focusing supervision on dynamic regions can substantially improve policy performance. Building on this finding, we introduce Motion-Guided Asymmetric Prediction (MoGAP), which augments WAM training with motion-focused visual prediction. MoGAP allocates noise asymmetrically across regions, training the model to reconstruct more heavily corrupted dynamic regions using less corrupted static regions as context. MoGAP is trained alongside standard video-action prediction through a training-only auxiliary prediction path within the shared video diffusion backbone. It uses motion cues derived directly from training videos, requiring neither an external teacher nor additional modalities. Across robot manipulation benchmarks and WAM architectures, MoGAP consistently improves policy performance, increasing success rates on the GR-1 tabletop benchmark from 38.8% to 47.5% for Fast-WAM (Wan2.2-5B) and from 52.3% to 62.3% for Cosmos3-Nano.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究World Action Models (WAMs)中视觉监督的空间分配问题，发现将监督集中在动态区域可显著提升策略性能，并提出Motion-Guided Asymmetric Prediction (MoGAP)，通过非对称噪声分配让模型利用低噪声静态区域重建高噪声动态区域，在多个机器人操作基准上一致提升成功率。
AI.motivation: WAMs借助预训练视频生成模型进行机器人控制，联合预测未来视觉观测与动作。但从视频预训练继承的标准视觉预测对所有视觉区域一视同仁，忽略了不同区域对机器人控制的相关性差异，因此需要研究视觉监督的空间分配方式。
AI.method: 提出MoGAP：在WAM训练中增加运动聚焦的视觉预测。具体做法是对不同区域非对称地分配噪声，训练模型以较低损坏的静态区域为上下文，重建损坏更重的动态区域；该辅助预测路径仅在训练时存在，内嵌于共享视频扩散主干的额外分支。运动线索直接来自训练视频，无需外部教师模型或额外模态，并与标准视频-动作预测联合训练。
AI.result: 在多个机器人操作基准与不同WAM架构上，MoGAP一致提升策略性能：在GR-1桌面基准上，Fast-WAM (Wan2.2-5B)成功率由38.8%提升至47.5%，Cosmos3-Nano由52.3%提升至62.3%。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉监督聚焦于动态区域是提升WAM策略性能的有效方向；MoGAP作为一种无需额外教师或模态、仅训练时生效的轻量增强方法，具有良好的通用性与可移植性，可用于改进现有WAM架构。

title: Follow the Herd: A Data-Driven Approach for Actionable Recourse
summary: As machine learning systems make increasingly greater decisions about people's lives, it is critical to provide users with actionable recourse about how they can achieve their desired outcomes. This problem is currently tackled by relying on expensive human supervision which involves hand-designing a cost function before searching for low-cost actions that achieve the desired outcome. In this paper, we propose \textit{``Data-Driven Action Recourse"} (DDAR), the first approach for providing action recourse without requiring costly supervision from humans about action costs. We build upon the notion that highly likely trajectories in the historical user data should be associated with lower costs. With this, DDAR first builds a dynamics model of historical user trajectories. Under this model, it then searches for trajectories that achieve the desired outcome. In experiments, we find that this simple approach recommends plausible action recourse without requiring human supervision, achieving lower action costs than the existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出DDAR，一种无需人工成本标注、直接从历史用户轨迹数据中学习并推荐可执行行动建议（action recourse）的方法。
AI.motivation: 机器学习系统越来越多地决定人们的生活，因此需要向用户提供可执行的行动建议以达成期望结果。现有方法依赖昂贵的人工监督，需先手工设计成本函数再搜索低成本动作。
AI.method: 基于"历史数据中高概率轨迹应对应较低成本"的假设：先构建历史用户轨迹的动力学模型，再在该模型下搜索能达成期望结果的轨迹作为行动建议。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法无需人工监督即可推荐合理的行动建议，且行动成本低于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 简单的数据驱动方式可替代昂贵的人工成本设计，实现有效且低成本的行动建议推荐。

title: Text Generation in Low-Resource Languages Using Human-Curated Vocabularies
summary: Synthetic text generation offers a promising approach to alleviating data scarcity in low-resource languages. However, its effectiveness is inherently limited for languages that are scarcely represented, or entirely absent, in an LLM's pretraining data. At the same time, many such languages have human-curated vocabularies that provide rich lexical and semantic information, often accompanied by grammatical information such as part-of-speech labels. In this work, we ask whether LLMs can leverage these resources to generate coherent text in extremely low-resource and unseen languages. We introduce a framework that combines human-curated vocabularies with a small number of human-written exemplars that provide syntactic signals, while sampling candidate words according to a Zipfian distribution. Across languages with varying levels of resource availability, we evaluate the generated text using lexical diversity, off-target ratio, and human judgments of fluency. Our results show that reasoning-enabled LLMs can generate fluent text even in extremely low-resource languages, with particularly strong results at the sentence level and promising performance at the paragraph level. Our findings highlight a practical pathway for bootstrapping synthetic data in low-resource languages, expanding the amount of usable text even when existing digital resources are extremely limited. Our source code is available at https://github.com/michaelsinanta/vocab2text.

AI.tldr: 提出vocab2text框架，结合人工整理词表、少量范例和Zipfian采样，让LLM为极低资源或未见语言生成合成文本。
AI.motivation: 合成文本可缓解低资源语言数据稀缺，但对预训练中极少或完全未出现的语言效果有限；而这类语言常有人工词表和词性标注等丰富信息，值得探索LLM能否利用。
AI.method: 框架将人工词表与少量提供句法信号的人工写作范例结合，并按Zipfian分布采样候选词；在资源水平不同的语言上，用词汇多样性、偏离目标比例和人工流畅度判断评估生成文本。
AI.result: 具备推理能力的LLM即使在极低资源语言中也能生成流畅文本，句子级效果尤其强，段落级表现有前景。
AI.conclusion: 为低资源语言引导合成数据提供实用路径，在数字资源极有限时扩大可用文本量；代码已开源。

title: SAGE: Semantic-Augmented Geometric Experts for Point Cloud Registration
summary: Point cloud registration is an essential task for scene reconstruction, requiring the alignment of partially overlapping point clouds. Under low-overlap conditions, this task remains challenging because existing geometry-only methods cannot distinguish geometrically similar but semantically distinct structures (e.g., TV corners vs. desk corners and chair legs vs. table legs), resulting in incorrect correspondences. To address this geometric ambiguity, we present Semantic-Augmented Geometric Experts (SAGE), which integrates frozen pre-trained point cloud semantic representations into the registration pipeline without requiring additional sensors or fine-tuning the semantic encoder. To effectively leverage these semantic distinctions, SAGE employs a Semantic-Guided Mixture of Experts (SG-MoE) architecture. Through semantic-aware routing, SG-MoE enables each expert to specialize in distinct semantic-geometric patterns, reducing mismatches that confound geometry-only methods. With a structure-aware estimator, SAGE achieves the highest registration recall on 3DLoMatch while remaining competitive on 3DMatch. When evaluated with the same number of refinement iterations, SAGE further achieves the highest inlier ratio and registration recall on both benchmarks. These results indicate that frozen semantic representations provide effective cues for resolving geometric ambiguity in low-overlap registration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGE，将冻结的预训练语义表示与几何专家混合架构结合，用于低重叠点云配准，在3DLoMatch上取得最高配准召回率。
AI.motivation: 低重叠点云配准中，仅用几何的方法无法区分几何相似但语义不同的结构（如电视角与桌角、椅腿与桌腿），产生错误对应关系。
AI.method: 引入冻结的预训练点云语义表示，无需额外传感器或微调语义编码器；设计语义引导的专家混合架构（SG-MoE），通过语义感知路由使各专家专精于特定语义-几何模式；配合结构感知估计器。
AI.result: 在3DLoMatch上取得最高配准召回率，在3DMatch上保持竞争力；在相同细化迭代次数下，两个基准上的内点率和配准召回率均为最高。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的语义表示能为解决低重叠配准中的几何歧义提供有效线索。

title: SpecLST: Spectral-Enhanced Long-Short Term Spatio-Temporal Multimodal Modeling for Traffic Forecasting
summary: Modeling multi-scale dynamics in urban road networks is essential for intelligent transportation systems but is often hindered by the computational cost of long-range historical context and the challenge of fusing heterogeneous modalities. Existing spatio-temporal frameworks face a trade-off between sequence length and memory overhead, while frequently neglecting the transient effects of exogenous factors such as road incidents and weather. To address these limitations, we propose SpecLST, a frequency-enhanced long-short-term spatio-temporal multimodal framework. SpecLST leverages a fast Fourier transform-based frequency-domain representation module to efficiently encode multi-week historical dependencies, bypassing the memory bottlenecks of standard attention mechanisms over raw long sequences. Heterogeneous context is integrated through attention-based fusion, followed by a sparse Mixture-of-Experts backbone with graph augmentation for spatio-temporal representation learning. Additionally, a frequency-enhanced residual head isolates high-frequency transients, improving sensitivity to abrupt traffic anomalies. At the 60-minute horizon, SpecLST achieves mean relative error reductions of 14.10% in MAE, 10.35% in RMSE, and 15.78% in MAPE across eight neural forecasting baselines and four datasets, with the dataset- and metric-specific average reductions ranging from 5.63% to 22.21%.

AI.tldr: 提出SpecLST——频率增强的长短期时空多模态框架，用FFT编码多周历史依赖、注意力融合异构上下文、稀疏MoE+图增强建模，并分离高频瞬态，60分钟预测上MAE/RMSE/MAPE平均降低14.10%/10.35%/15.78%。
AI.motivation: 城市路网多尺度动态建模对智能交通至关重要，但长程历史上下文计算开销大、异构模态融合困难。现有方法在序列长度与内存开销间难以平衡，且常忽略道路事故、天气等外生因素的瞬态影响。
AI.method: 1) 基于FFT的频域表示模块高效编码多周历史依赖，规避原始长序列上标准注意力的内存瓶颈；2) 注意力融合异构上下文；3) 稀疏混合专家(MoE)骨干+图增强进行时空表征学习；4) 频率增强残差头分离高频瞬态，提升对突发交通异常的敏感性。
AI.result: 在60分钟预测horizon上，对比8个神经预测基线与4个数据集，MAE降14.10%、RMSE降10.35%、MAPE降15.78%；按数据集与指标细分的平均降幅为5.63%–22.21%。
AI.conclusion: 频域建模+多模态融合+稀疏MoE与高频残差头的组合能有效兼顾长程依赖效率与瞬态异常敏感性，在多数据集多基线设置下稳定优于现有方法。

title: InfraDev: Can Coding Agents Develop AI Infrastructure, and How Can We Tell?
summary: Coding agents are beginning to develop the production-grade AI infrastructure that trains and serves large models, yet existing benchmarks cover only single kernels or single-GPU tasks, and grade with tests and prompts that misjudge both correct and incorrect patches. We introduce InfraDev, a benchmark of 36 tasks built from real-world pull requests to Megatron-LM, vLLM, and verl, covering infrastructure development for training, inference, and reinforcement learning. Each task asks an agent to reimplement a real change that spans many files and must run correctly across many GPUs. To grade such changes, we jointly synthesize hidden probes, which enforce the requirements the original tests leave unchecked, and a prompt that states every interface the probes call without revealing the solution. We also design a shared execution environment that reuses dependencies and artifacts across tasks, cutting storage by 52-57% and build time by 13-14% on Megatron-LM and vLLM. Across six frontier models, the best resolves only 38.9% of the tasks; the probes reject 32% of the submissions that pass every official test, and with the original pull request descriptions as prompts, no model resolves a single task. Failure analysis shows that structural and state errors dominate and that agents' own tests rarely check memory, time, or traffic. Turning these findings into an agent skill raises the resolved rate of a frontier model on the Megatron-LM tasks by 10.5%.

AI.tldr: 提出 InfraDev 基准，含 36 个来自 Megatron-LM、vLLM、verl 真实 PR 的多文件、多 GPU 基础设施开发任务，并联合合成隐藏探针与接口提示来更准确评分；六种前沿模型最佳仅解决 38.9%，说明该领域仍极具挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体基准仅覆盖单 kernel 或单 GPU 任务，且用测试与提示评分时会误判正确与错误的补丁；而智能体已开始开发训练/服务大模型的生产级 AI 基础设施，需要匹配真实复杂度的评测。
AI.method: 从 Megatron-LM、vLLM、verl 的真实 PR 构造 36 个跨多文件、需多 GPU 正确运行的训练/推理/强化学习基础设施任务；联合合成隐藏探针（覆盖原测试未检查的要求）与不泄露解法但声明所有探针调用接口的提示来评分；设计跨任务复用依赖与产物的共享执行环境。
AI.result: 共享环境在 Megatron-LM 与 vLLM 上分别减少 52-57% 存储、13-14% 构建时间；六种前沿模型最高仅解决 38.9% 任务；隐藏探针拒绝了 32% 通过全部官方测试的提交；以原始 PR 描述作提示时无模型解决任何任务；失败以结构和状态错误为主，智能体自写测试很少检查内存、时间或通信量。
AI.conclusion: InfraDev 揭示了基础设施编码任务上评测与能力的双重缺口；将失败分析转化为智能体技能可使某前沿模型在 Megatron-LM 任务上的解决率提升 10.5%。

title: What Survives Distillation? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study of GPT-2 and DistilGPT-2
summary: Knowledge distillation compresses large language models into compact students that preserve aggregate metrics, yet the mechanistic consequences of depth-reduction distillation remain largely uncharacterized. This work applies linear CKA, logit lens analysis, attention pattern decomposition, sparse autoencoder feature statistics, and activation patching to compare GPT-2 and its six-layer student DistilGPT-2 across two canonical circuits: the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) circuit and the Greater-Than (GT) circuit. The results reveal a compression-collapse dichotomy: the IOI circuit suffers complete mechanistic collapse (DistilGPT-2: 35.2% accuracy vs. 94.8%, zero name-mover preservation), while the GT circuit survives with 87.7% task performance recovery through active remapping of the teacher's layer-9 comparison head into student layer~4 (mean Pearson r = 0.945). These findings demonstrate that circuit compressibility governs mechanistic survival under distillation, and that aggregate metrics are insufficient diagnostics for circuit integrity.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过多种机制性可解释性工具对比GPT-2与DistilGPT-2，揭示深度蒸馏对不同电路存在"压缩-坍缩"二分现象：IOI电路机制完全崩解，而GT电路通过将教师第9层比较头重映射到学生第4层而存活。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏能保持聚合指标，但深度缩减蒸馏对模型内部机制（电路）的影响尚不清楚；聚合指标可能掩盖电路完整性受损的问题，需要机制层面的诊断。
AI.method: 以GPT-2与六层学生DistilGPT-2为对象，针对IOI电路与Greater-Than电路，综合运用线性CKA、logit lens、注意力模式分解、稀疏自编码器特征统计与激活修补（activation patching）进行对比分析。
AI.result: IOI电路机制完全坍缩（准确率35.2% vs. 94.8%，name-mover保持率为零）；GT电路任务性能恢复87.7%，教师第9层比较头被主动重映射至学生第4层（平均Pearson r=0.945）。
AI.conclusion: 电路的"可压缩性"决定其在蒸馏下的机制存活性；聚合指标不足以诊断电路完整性，机制性分析对评估蒸馏模型是必要的。

title: Haste Makes Waste? Towards Safe Few-Step Text-to-Image Models
summary: While few-step distilled text-to-image models have gained traction due to their fast generation times, the speed-up implications on their unsafe generation rates remain unknown. We uncover an inherent tension between speed and safety: few-step models are often more unsafe than their teachers, and reducing the number of inference steps consistently raises unsafe generation rates. We further find that acceleration makes unsafe concepts harder to erase in few-step models, with existing concept-erasure methods markedly less effective than in teachers. We offer a mechanistic diagnosis for why erasure methods fail on few-step models, finding that the fragility of few-step models' generation process and the way generation guidance is usually distilled into those models may hinder established concept-erasure methods. To address the speed-safety trade-off, we propose DICE (Distillation-Integrated Concept Erasure), a post-distillation erasure method tailored for few-step models. DICE aligns both its latent construction and its generation-preservation loss with the distillation method that produced the model, keeping erasure faithful to few-step models. DICE demonstrates strong results in our evaluation. For example, on FLUX Schnell, DICE reduces unsafe-generation rate to 0.046 (vs. at least 0.161 for prior erasure methods we test), while mostly preserving benign generation quality.

AI.tldr: 少步蒸馏文生图模型在加速的同时会系统性提升不安全生成率，且现有概念擦除方法在其上失效；作者从机制上诊断原因并提出 DICE，将擦除与蒸馏过程对齐，在 FLUX Schnell 上将不安全生成率降至 0.046 并基本保持良性生成质量。
AI.motivation: 少步蒸馏文生图模型因生成快而流行，但其加速对安全性（不安全生成率）的影响尚不清楚。论文揭示了速度与安全之间的内在张力：少步模型往往比其教师模型更不安全，且推理步数越少，不安全生成率越高；同时加速使不安全概念更难被擦除。
AI.method: 先机制性诊断擦除方法在少步模型上失效的原因：少步模型生成过程的脆弱性，以及生成引导通常被蒸馏进模型的方式，阻碍了既有概念擦除方法。据此提出 DICE（Distillation-Integrated Concept Erasure），一种面向少步模型的后蒸馏擦除方法，使其潜在表示的构造与生成保持损失同产生该模型的蒸馏方法对齐，从而让擦除与少步模型特性相匹配。
AI.result: DICE 在评估中表现强劲。例如在 FLUX Schnell 上，不安全生成率降至 0.046，而所测试的先前擦除方法至少为 0.161，同时基本保持良性生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 少步加速与安全性存在权衡：加速提升不安全生成率并降低现有擦除方法有效性。通过使擦除方法与蒸馏过程对齐（DICE），可在少步模型上实现更有效的不安全概念擦除，同时保留生成质量。

title: When Can a Learned Design Surrogate Be Trusted in a Self-Driving Microfluidics Laboratory? An Offline Closed-Loop Framework Built and Tested on Six Public Tables
comment: 68 pages, 15 figures, 26 tables. Code, frozen protocols, deviation registers, number ledger and artifacts: https://github.com/LibertychaserUS/microfluidic-native-physics (tag v0.5.5-preprint)
summary: Self-driving laboratories couple a learned design surrogate to an instrument, and on every new target domain it must answer four questions: when it can be trusted, how many target measurements it needs, which to make first, and when to stop adapting, switch models or escalate. We state a framework making each measurable (a competence ratio, a budget $k^*(\varepsilon)$, a time-to-target and a priced decision) and instantiate it without wet experiments on six public droplet-microfluidic and liposome tables as offline laboratories: 107 leave-one-group tiers whose rows are hidden labels. A sealed, pre-registered programme (two sealed negative validations and a pre-registered test on three more tables) and seven frozen closed-loop protocols, each run twice, yield 23 findings. Shift cost is stratified by shift type; no label-free statistic certifies individual candidates; random-split model-family rankings predicted neither the sealed nor the loop rankings. Warm-start residual boosting returns a surrogate to $1.25\times$ its development reference within 20 target rows in 94% of chemistry tiers (27% under a strict noise-floor reading), 90% of laboratory and 40% of device tiers, and a budget planned from the shift type on other tables is not measurably worse on a new one. In the loop, one gain survives drift and shuffled-label controls on all tiers, carried by the sparsely sampled ones: proposing at once and warm-starting on every measurement reaches a 10% target in 2.80 measurements against 3.31 for the reference, and in 5.72 against 11.35 for random proposals on 301 hard units at a 3% tolerance. No label-free acquisition rule survives the shuffled-label control, no interval-aware proposal or other model family does better, and no threshold rule on the tested diagnostics beats always continuing once escalation is priced. No wet-lab validation is claimed.

AI.tldr: 提出一个自动驾驶实验室（自驱动实验室）的可测量框架，用离线"实验室"（公开微流控与脂质体数据表）验证代理模型的可信性、预算、采样与停止/升级决策，并给出23条发现。
AI.motivation: 自驱动实验室把学习到的设计代理模型与仪器耦合，每进入新目标域都需回答四个问题：何时可信、需多少目标测量、先测哪些、何时停止适应/换模型/升级。现有工作缺乏使这些问题可量化、可比较的框架与无湿实验的严格验证。
AI.method: 构建包含能力比、预算k*(ε)、time-to-target与定价决策的框架；在六张公开液滴微流控与脂质体数据表上作为离线实验室实例化，形成107个留一组（leave-one-group）层级（行标签被隐藏）。采用封存、预注册方案（两项封存负验证+在另三张表上的预注册测试）、七个冻结闭环协议各运行两次，共得23条发现。
AI.result: 迁移成本按迁移类型分层；无免标签统计量可认证单个候选；随机划分的模型族排序既不能预测封存排序也不能预测闭环排序。热启动残差提升在20行目标内使代理回到其开发参照的1.25×，化学层级94%（严格噪声底读法27%）、实验室层级90%、器件层级40%；由其他表格的迁移类型规划的预算在新表上无可测劣势。闭环中仅一项增益通过漂移与标签打乱对照：即刻提议+每次测量热启动，10%目标达成为2.80次测量（参照3.31），3%容差下301个困难单元为5.72 vs 随机提议11.35。
AI.conclusion: 无免标签采集规则通过标签打乱对照；无区间感知提议或其他模型族更优；一旦对升级定价，任何基于测试诊断的阈值规则都不优于"始终继续"。未声称任何湿实验验证。

title: Learning to Formalize: Bridging Open-Ended Workloads and Fast Decision Models
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, only for concept verification now
summary: Decision models offer fast choices over sup- plied alternatives, while general-purpose large language models interpret open-ended tasks through flexible generation and reasoning at the cost of sequential decoding. Many work- loads expect a generative backend to determine what can be done and therefore provide no well-defined candidate list. We bridge this in- terface gap with a small candidate formalizer trained on offline teacher-generated lists. The formalizer constructs explicit, validated alter- natives from task context, and a frozen deci- sion model selects an entry. A motivating com- parison with official TypeSafe Jev-1.13.0 on 200 CALVIN-D test episodes reports 11% suc- cess with generic motions versus 46.5% with DeepSeek V4 Flash pose candidates. Sepa- rately, a six-arm privileged-state evaluation on 1,011 CALVIN-D validation annotations finds that a locally deployed decision model can achieve at most 52.6% task success rate with the fine-tuned formalizer, compared with 11.8% without it, and the end-to-end latency is kept to 2.09 s, whereas Qwen3.5-27B is 3.67 s with the exact experiment setting.

AI.tldr: 论文提出小型"候选形式化器"，在离线教师生成列表上训练，从任务上下文中构造显式、可验证的候选集合，再交由冻结的决策模型选择，从而衔接生成式后端与决策模型的接口鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 决策模型只能从给定候选中快速选择，而通用大模型能灵活处理开放式任务但需串行解码、延迟高；许多负载并无明确定义候选列表，需生成式后端决定"能做什么"，二者存在接口不匹配。
AI.method: 训练小型候选形式化器（基于离线教师生成的候选列表），从任务上下文构造并验证显式备选方案，由冻结决策模型从中选择一项；在CALVIN-D上做官方TypeSafe Jev-1.13.0对比，并进行六组特权状态评估（1011条验证标注）。
AI.result: 200个CALVIN-D测试回合中，通用运动成功率11%，DeepSeek V4 Flash姿态候选达46.5%；六组特权状态评估中，微调形式化器使本地决策模型最高成功率为52.6%（无形式化器仅11.8%），端到端延迟2.09s，而Qwen3.5-27B在同一设置下为3.67s。
AI.conclusion: 显式候选形式化可显著提升决策模型的可用性与任务成功率，同时保持低延迟，是连接生成式能力与高效决策的可行方案。

title: Decision Models as Judges for Hallucination Detection
summary: Large language models are widely used as judges of model outputs (LLM-as-a-Judge), but they are costly and can hallucinate or be overconfident. Decision models are a potential alternative. They return a predefined verdict with a probability for each label instead of free-form text and are much cheaper and faster. We test this promise on hallucination detection. We build binary benchmarks for five hallucination types (9,852 items from six datasets) and compare five decision models with the generative judge gpt-6-sol. Performance depends strongly on the type: the best decision model matches gpt-6-sol in balanced accuracy on context inconsistency and comes within 3 percentage points on factual errors, but trails it by 4-8 points on logical and instruction inconsistency. Decision-model probabilities are overconfident, though less so than the GPT-6 models, and separate correct from incorrect decisions only moderately. We also find that a confidence cascade of decision models improves on the best single model by 1.9-3.3 points on three types and matches or exceeds gpt-6-sol at 1-3% of its cost. Overall, decision models are a practical low-cost judge for some hallucination types but need to be validated before use.

AI.tldr: 本文在幻觉检测任务上比较五种决策模型与生成式评判模型 gpt-6-sol，发现决策模型在某些幻觉类型上可媲美甚至低成本超越生成式评判，且置信度级联可进一步提升表现。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge 成本高且可能产生幻觉或过度自信，决策模型（输出预设判定及各标签概率）更便宜快速，但其能否替代生成式评判尚不清楚，作者以幻觉检测为场景验证这一潜力。
AI.method: 构建覆盖五类幻觉的二分类基准（来自六个数据集共 9,852 条样本），对比五种决策模型与生成式评判 gpt-6-sol；分析概率校准性，并设计决策模型的置信度级联（confidence cascade）策略。
AI.result: 性能强烈依赖幻觉类型：最佳决策模型在上下文不一致上与 gpt-6-sol 持平，事实错误上差 3 个百分点，但在逻辑与指令不一致上落后 4–8 个百分点；决策模型概率过度自信（但优于 GPT-6 系列），区分正误仅中等水平；置信度级联在三种类型上比最佳单模型提升 1.9–3.3 个百分点，并以 1–3% 成本达到或超过 gpt-6-sol。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型可作为部分幻觉类型的实用低成本评判器，但使用前需针对具体类型进行验证。

title: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
summary: Diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) process their entire input at every denoising step. Since visual tokens make up 89-97% of this input on the benchmarks we study, most of the decoding computation is spent repeatedly processing the same image. Visual token pruning methods partially relieve this burden by removing part of the visual tokens, but they lose the removed information and still process the remaining image at every step. To measure how often the image is actually needed, we compare LLaDA-V's predictions with and without the image at every decoding step and find that removing the image changes a token being unmasked at only 22.8% of steps on average and at as few as 7.9%. We therefore propose LOWN, a decoding method that decides at every step whether to process the image and how many tokens to unmask. LOWN predicts the masked tokens without the image and processes the image only when this prediction disagrees with the last image-conditioned prediction. Agreement certifies the earlier prediction for reuse, and the number of certified tokens sets how many are unmasked in that step. We further observe that the need for the image differs across benchmarks, so LOWN's adaptive decision is needed rather than a fixed schedule. Without training or a tuned threshold, LOWN retains 99.6% of LLaDA-V's score on ten benchmarks at 35.3% of the decoding FLOPs on average. LOWN also generalizes across LLaDA-based DVLMs, composes orthogonally with visual token pruning, and runs under key-value caching for further efficiency gains. Code and project page are available at https://hyeon9698.github.io/LOWN/

AI.tldr: 提出LOWN解码方法，通过每步判断是否需要处理图像，在保留99.6%性能的同时仅用35.3%解码FLOPs。
AI.motivation: 扩散视觉语言模型（DVLM）每步去噪都处理整个输入，视觉token占89-97%，导致大量重复计算；现有视觉token剪枝丢失信息且仍需每步处理剩余图像。作者发现图像仅约22.8%的步骤真正影响unmask结果。
AI.method: LOWN在每一步先无图像预测masked tokens，仅当该预测与上一次有图像条件预测不一致时才处理图像；一致则复用先前预测，认证的token数量决定该步unmask多少token。无需训练或调阈值。
AI.result: 在十个基准上保留LLaDA-V 99.6%的分数，平均仅用35.3%的解码FLOPs；可跨LLaDA系DVLM泛化，与视觉token剪枝正交组合，并支持KV缓存加速。
AI.conclusion: 自适应决定何时使用图像比固定调度更优（因需求跨基准不同），LOWN是一种简单、免训练的通用加速解码方法。

title: Persistence, Exposure, and Credit Routing in Linear Temporal Predictive Coding
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps)
summary: Temporal Predictive Coding (tPC) networks offer a layer-local alternative to backpropagation. For linear tPC, we show, by applying tools from cellular sheaf theory, that temporal credit assignment is a tug-of-war between spatial displacement and temporal errors, whose ratios are modulated by persistence and exposure operators $P$ and $Q$. Spatial inference therefore gives us the effective recurrent transition $F=PA$, whilst future credit is filtered by $P^\ast$. This creates a persistence--error tradeoff in spatial modes: under non-amplifying invariant recurrence, modes that preserve influence over long delays simultaneously fail to expose that influence strongly as temporal error. Recurrence can circumvent this via routing between persistent and exposed modes.

AI.tldr: 用细胞层论(cellular sheaf theory)分析线性tPC网络，将时间信用分配刻画为空间位移误差与时间误差的"拔河"，其比例由持久/暴露算子P、Q调制。
AI.motivation: tPC网络是反向传播的层局部替代方案，但线性tPC中时间信用分配的机制缺乏理论理解，需揭示其内在动力学结构。
AI.method: 对线性tPC应用细胞层理论工具进行理论推导，引入持久算子P与暴露算子Q，得到有效循环转移F=PA及未来信用经P*滤波的结论。
AI.result: 空间模态存在"持久—误差权衡"：在非放大不变循环下，能长时间保留影响力的模态无法将其强烈暴露为时间误差。
AI.conclusion: 循环可通过在持久模态与暴露模态间路由来绕开该权衡。

title: Aligning Large Language Models for Safety in African Languages: A Case Study of Hausa
summary: Safety alignment research for large language models (LLMs) remains concentrated on high-resource languages, leaving open how existing alignment methods perform in low-resource, culturally distinct settings. We study this question for Hausa, a language spoken by more than 200 million people across West Africa. We introduce HausaSafeLM, one of the first Hausa safety preference dataset, built from 10,000 prompts derived from PKU-SafeRLHF: 3,000 human-corrected (gold) and 7,000 machine-translated (silver) examples spanning six harm macro-categories. Using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, we compare supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and SFT followed by Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) under both data regimes, evaluating on 500 harmful and 200 benign Hausa prompts.We find that the untuned base model appears highly safe by refusal-rate metrics alone, but this reflects limited Hausa generation ability rather than genuine alignment: its refusals are almost uniformly low quality. SFT improves both refusal fluency and precision and benefits substantially from the larger, noisier silver-tier data, while DPO sharpens refusal precision but comes at a steep, largely data-invariant cost to linguistic quality. No single configuration jointly maximizes safety, helpfulness, and fluency. Our results suggest that current alignment techniques teach models when to refuse more readily than how to do so fluently in underrepresented languages, and that refusal-rate metrics alone are an unreliable signal of safety in low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 针对豪萨语（西非200M+使用者）构建首个安全偏好数据集HausaSafeLM（10K提示：3K人工校正gold+7K机翻silver，6类危害），在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上比较SFT与SFT+DPO，发现未调优模型"高拒答率"实为生成能力不足的假象，SFT提升拒答流畅度与准确性，DPO提升拒答精确率但显著损害语言质量，无单一配置能同时最优安全/有帮助/流畅。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全对齐研究集中于高资源语言，低资源、文化差异显著场景下对齐方法效果未知。作者以豪萨语为例填补这一空白，并质疑仅靠拒答率衡量安全的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建HausaSafeLM数据集（源自PKU-SafeRLHF的10,000条提示：3,000人工校正gold + 7,000机器翻译silver，覆盖六大危害类别）；以Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct为基座，在两种数据条件下对比SFT与SFT+DPO；在500条有害与200条良性豪萨语提示上评估。
AI.result: 未调优基座模型单看拒答率显得很"安全"，但拒答几乎全部质量低劣，实为豪萨语生成能力有限所致，而非真正对齐。SFT同时提升拒答流畅度与精确率，并显著受益于更大、更嘈杂的silver数据；DPO提升拒答精确率，却以严重且基本与数据规模无关的语言质量下降为代价。没有任何单一配置能同时最大化安全、有帮助性与流畅性。
AI.conclusion: 当前对齐技术更擅长教会模型"何时拒答"，而非"如何用低资源语言流畅地拒答"；在低资源场景中，仅凭拒答率指标判断安全性是不可靠的信号。研究呼吁低资源语言安全对齐需重视生成质量与多维指标评估。

title: SAGE: Saliency-Annealed Gated Encoder for Universal Vision Recognition
summary: When adapting self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs) to dense prediction, existing methods often treat the ViT as a passive feature extractor and may underuse the rich priors encoded in its representations, including saliency, global context, and high-frequency details. We propose SAGE (Saliency-Annealed Gated Encoder), an enhanced ViT-Adapter backbone that explicitly exploits these priors through three complementary innovations: (1) a saliency-guided architecture that extracts DINO-style class-token (CLS) saliency to guide feature gating and high-frequency enhancement, together with dynamic multi-layer aggregation and a local-detail branch; (2) an annealing-based training paradigm designed to improve convergence and feature quality during early training while reducing feature drift later in training; and (3) a two-stage, quality-aware training mechanism that smoothly transitions from focal loss to Varifocal Loss (VFL) within a single training run. Across the evaluated tasks (Fig.~\ref{fig:fig_com}), SAGE achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) or competitive results on COCO (62.8 box AP and 55.3 mask AP), COCO keypoint estimation (78.5 AP), ADE20K (60.3 mIoU for semantic segmentation and 44.9 mask AP for instance segmentation), TinyImageNet classification (94.76\% Top-1 accuracy), and DIOR-R oriented object detection (78.8 AP$_{50}$). The same backbone is used across tasks, with task-specific decoders. To the best of our knowledge, SAGE is the first framework to achieve multi-task state-of-the-art results on Huawei Ascend NPUs. Code and pretrained models will be released after internal review.

AI.tldr: SAGE 提出一种显式利用自监督 ViT 先验（显著性、全局上下文、高频细节）的增强型 ViT-Adapter 主干，在多个密集预测任务上达到 SOTA 或竞争性结果，并首个在华为昇腾 NPU 上实现多任务 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有将自监督 ViT 适配到密集预测的方法把 ViT 当作被动特征提取器，未充分利用其表示中蕴含的显著性、全局上下文和高频细节等丰富先验。
AI.method: 三项互补创新：(1) 显著性引导架构——利用 DINO 风格 CLS token 显著性指导特征门控与高频增强，结合动态多层聚合和局部细节分支；(2) 退火式训练范式——早期改善收敛与特征质量、后期减少特征漂移；(3) 两阶段质量感知训练——单次训练中从 focal loss 平滑过渡到 Varifocal Loss。
AI.result: COCO 62.8 box AP / 55.3 mask AP；COCO 关键点 78.5 AP；ADE20K 语义分割 60.3 mIoU、实例分割 44.9 mask AP；TinyImageNet 94.76% Top-1；DIOR-R 旋转目标检测 78.8 AP50。同一主干配任务特定解码头。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以统一主干实现多任务 SOTA/竞争性能，并首次在华为昇腾 NPU 上达成多任务 SOTA；代码与预训练模型将在内部审查后发布。

title: Repulsive Population Policy Gradients for Behaviorally Diverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: The goal of Quality-Diversity Reinforcement Learning (QD-RL) is to find a population of high-performing policies that solve a decision-making problem in diverse ways. Despite recent progress, QD-RL methods predominantly rely on evolutionary operators--including black-box optimizers, mutations, and crossovers--to facilitate exploration and induce diversity. Scaling these methods becomes increasingly costly as policies and behavior spaces grow larger. Building on the Soft QD view of quality-diversity optimization, we introduce \textbf{Re}pulsive \textbf{P}opulation \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization (\textbf{RePPO}), which adapts PPO to jointly optimize a compact population of diverse, high-quality policies using a population-dependent, dynamically shaped reward. On standard continuous-control tasks, RePPO achieves a strong quality-diversity tradeoff compared with state-of-the-art QD-RL methods. Ablations further characterize this tradeoff by examining how each component affects individual quality and collective diversity. To assess RePPO's scalability, we extend our evaluation to learning from pixels and fine-tuning large language models. In pixel-based tasks, where large policies make most traditional QD-RL methods infeasible, RePPO maintains quality on par with standard PPO while achieving substantially higher diversity. Its successful application to language model fine-tuning further demonstrates, for the first time, that QD-RL methods can scale to this domain. Together, these results show that directly optimizing compact populations with RePPO provides a scalable approach to QD-RL across increasingly complex domains.

AI.tldr: RePPO 将 PPO 扩展为种群依赖、动态塑形的奖励，直接联合优化一个紧凑的策略种群，无需依赖进化算子，从而实现可扩展的 Quality-Diversity 强化学习。
AI.motivation: 现有 QD-RL 方法主要依赖黑盒优化、变异、交叉等进化算子来探索和诱导多样性，随着策略规模和行为空间增大，扩展成本越来越高，因此需要一种可扩展的 QD-RL 方法。
AI.method: 基于 Soft QD 视角，提出 Repulsive Population Policy Optimization（RePPO），把 PPO 适配为用种群依赖且动态塑形的奖励，联合优化一个小规模的高质量、多样化策略种群，替代进化算子。
AI.result: 在标准连续控制任务上，RePPO 取得与 SOTA QD-RL 方法相当甚至更好的质量-多样性权衡；消融实验刻画了各组件对个体质量与集体多样性的影响；在像素输入任务中（大型策略使多数传统方法不可行），质量与标准 PPO 持平但多样性显著更高；并首次成功将 QD-RL 应用于大语言模型微调。
AI.conclusion: 直接以 RePPO 优化紧凑策略种群是一种可扩展的 QD-RL 方案，能扩展到像素环境和大语言模型微调等复杂领域。

title: Polarity--Time Interaction and Multi-Level Reliability for Event-Based Spacecraft Pose Estimation
summary: Sparse event responses produce uneven keypoint errors whose effects on spacecraft pose depend on correspondence geometry and the reliability of successive observations. We present a reliability-aware framework connecting polarity--time localization, geometric recovery, event--CAD refinement, and trajectory optimization. A three-branch representation combines positive events, negative events, and recent-event timing through cross-branch attention and gating, followed by spatiotemporal aggregation. An ordered semantic-point head estimates relative correspondence precision for geometrically constrained pose recovery. Event-edge and CAD-projection agreement then guide local pose refinement under keypoint-geometry safeguards. At the sequence level, a ten-dimensional descriptor combines heatmap shape, reprojection consistency, and geometric conditioning to set time-aligned observation scales. On the official SPADES challenge test set, the complete system achieves a combined pose score of 0.0474, approximately 5.4\% below PASAN+IRIS. Validation ablations reduce the score from 0.0772 for base localization with uniform PnP to 0.0514 for the complete cascade; on identical single-frame observations, quality weighting reduces the score from 0.0549 with constant-weight optimization to 0.0514.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可靠性感知框架，将极性-时间定位、几何恢复、事件-CAD精化和轨迹优化串联，用于航天器位姿估计，在SPADES挑战赛上取得0.0474的综合位姿分数。
AI.motivation: 稀疏事件响应导致关键点误差分布不均，而误差对航天器位姿的影响取决于对应几何结构和连续观测的可靠性，因此需要在定位与位姿优化中显式建模可靠性。
AI.method: 三分支表示（正事件、负事件、近期事件时序）经跨分支注意力与门控融合并时空聚合；有序语义点头估计对应精度；事件边缘与CAD投影一致性引导局部位姿精化；序列层面用十维描述子（热图形状、重投影一致性、几何条件）设定时间对齐的观测权重。
AI.result: SPADES官方测试集综合位姿分数0.0474，比PASAN+IRIS低约5.4%；消融显示基础定位+均匀PnP为0.0772，完整级联降至0.0514；相同单帧观测下，质量加权将0.0549降至0.0514。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模逐对应可靠性和序列级观测质量能显著提升事件相机航天器位姿估计精度，验证了可靠性感知级联设计的有效性。

title: REGLAT at ArGuard Shared Tasks: An Ensemble-Based Model Integrating NER for Harmful Content Detection in Arabic
comment: System description paper for REGLAT submission for ArGuard shared task 2026
