The twin is updated at temporal checkpoints by replaying learning traces and assessment records, and it serves both as a feature-extraction substrate and as an explanation-grounding substrate. Predictive features are derived through graph-mediated queries, while features, attributions, alerts, evidence items, and raw records are represented as queryable graph entities. The framework is instantiated and evaluated on a public learning-analytics benchmark under a temporal protocol. The results show that graph-mediated feature extraction preserves the predictive behavior of equivalent raw-table features across model families and checkpoints. Generated alerts are materialized as evidence chains linking risk decisions to feature attributions, evidence items, and raw platform records. The study shows that early-warning prediction can be routed through a semantic and provenance-aware representation while preserving predictive performance and adding traceability, verifiability, and evidence-grounded explanation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于轻量知识图谱的增量式"学习者数字孪生"，用于证据可追溯的早期预警，图介导的特征提取在保持原始表特征预测性能的同时，将预警实例化为可查询的证据链。
AI.motivation: 学习分析中的早期预警模型虽能识别失败或退学风险，但风险分数与可查验的学习证据联系薄弱——只告知"需干预"，却不显示是哪些学习轨迹、测评事件或时间模式支撑该预警，缺乏可追溯性与可验证性。
AI.method: 构建轻量知识图谱形式的增量式学习者数字孪生，在时间检查点重放学习轨迹与测评记录进行更新；它同时充当特征提取基底与解释落地基底，预测特征通过图介导查询导出，特征、归因、预警、证据项与原始记录均表示为可查询图实体。在公开学习分析基准上按时间协议进行实例化与评估。
AI.result: 图介导特征提取在多种模型家族与多个检查点上均保持了与等价原始表特征一致的预测行为；生成的预警被物化为证据链，将风险决策与特征归因、证据项及原始平台记录相连。
AI.conclusion: 早期预警预测可通过语义化、来源感知的表示来路由，在保持预测性能的同时增加了可追溯性、可验证性与基于证据的解释能力。

title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
summary: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.

AI.tldr: 提出 LongChang 自动化框架，在物理定律被篡改的模拟世界中让 LLM 自主探索并发现异常规律；12 个模型中仅 GPT-6-Astra 达 16.7% 发现率，其余均为 0%，自主科学发现能力仍很有限。
AI.motivation: 科学发现常始于意外观察。若物理规律被改变，LLM 能否自主察觉异常（如重物下落更慢）并通过实验发现规律，是检验其自主科研能力的关键问题，现有基准多给出明确研究任务与提示，无法评估这种开放性探索能力。
AI.method: 构建 LongChang 框架：生成含一条或多条被篡改物理定律的模拟世界，被测 LLM 作为"探索者"自行操作物体、设计工具、提出并研究自己的问题，不给任务或提示。另有独立 LLM 智能体分别负责生成与审查场景、审查工具设计、依据篡改后的物理定律与探索记录评判报告的正确性与实验支撑度；探索记录驱动场景演化，形成无需人工干预的全自动循环。
AI.result: 在 12 个 LLM 中，GPT-6-Astra 的发现率达到 16.7%，其余 11 个均为 0%。探索记录显示存在未被调查的异常，且对篡改物理定律仅实现部分识别。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 在无提示的开放环境中自主发现新物理规律的能力仍十分薄弱，LongChang 为评估此类开放式自主科学探索提供了可自动运行的测试平台。

title: Latent Visual Contrastive Reasoning with Multi-Branch Exploration
summary: Multimodal large language models have made substantial progress in visual question answering, but complex visual reasoning often requires locating and comparing multiple pieces of question-relevant visual evidence. Existing methods that move intermediate reasoning into the visual latent space usually follow a single linear reasoning trajectory, which can be limiting when multiple visual hypotheses or competing evidence regions are relevant. We propose Latent Visual Contrastive Reasoning, a branch-aware latent reasoning framework that generates multiple question-conditioned latent visual branches as soft hypotheses over image tokens. To train these branches, our method uses bounding-box evidence annotations to build target evidence representations and introduces a soft contrastive branch-evidence alignment objective. This objective encourages evidence-relevant branches to align with annotated visual regions while contrasting them against negative evidence. We instantiate our method on Qwen2.5-VL backbones and train it with standard supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on perception-intensive visual reasoning benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves overall improvements over the corresponding backbone and single-path latent reasoning baselines at both 3B and 7B scales.

AI.tldr: 提出Latent Visual Contrastive Reasoning，用多分支潜在视觉推理+对比对齐，提升多模态大模型复杂视觉推理。
AI.motivation: 现有将中间推理移入视觉潜在空间的方法通常只沿单一线性推理轨迹，当问题涉及多个视觉假设或相互竞争的证据区域时受限。
AI.method: 生成多个以问题为条件的潜在视觉分支，作为图像token上的软假设；利用边界框证据标注构建目标证据表示，并引入软对比分支-证据对齐目标，使证据相关分支对齐标注区域、同时与负证据对比。在Qwen2.5-VL（3B/7B）上用标准SFT训练。
AI.result: 在感知密集型视觉推理基准上，3B与7B规模均优于对应骨干模型和单路径潜在推理基线。
AI.conclusion: 分支感知的潜在推理加对比分支-证据对齐，是增强多模态视觉推理中多证据定位与比较的有效途径。

title: NextEval: An Agent-Based Solver and Benchmark for Derivative-Free Optimization
summary: Derivative-free optimization (DFO) addresses problems where derivatives are unavailable or costly to obtain. This setting often arises in simulation-based and experimental applications, where evaluating the black-box objective can itself be costly. Thus, it remains a central challenge in DFO to effectively exploit accumulated observations to select informative evaluation points under a limited budget. In this light, we introduce the NextEval solver, an agent-based DFO solver, which integrates the capabilities of a large language model (LLM) to guide the sequential selection of evaluation points. Specifically, we establish a system that combines an LLM agent with a numerical environment. The environment provides tools for analyzing past evaluations and executing numerical methods, while maintaining a shared evaluation history and method-specific state to support continuation across method switches. Using observations and tool feedback, the LLM agent selects tools, configures their parameters, and allocates the evaluation budget, while numerical methods compute and evaluate candidate points. Building on this system, we also introduce NextEval Bench, a benchmark protocol for comparing agent configurations on shared DFO tasks using the same numerical tools under matched evaluation budgets and information constraints. Numerical results on low-dimensional DFO problems demonstrate that the NextEval solver outperforms the state-of-the-art DFO baselines in function-evaluation efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLM智能体的无导数优化求解器NextEval及其基准NextEval Bench，在低维DFO问题上函数评估效率优于SOTA基线。
AI.motivation: 无导数优化中目标函数评估代价高，预算有限，核心挑战是如何有效利用已有观测来选择信息量高的评估点。
AI.method: 构建LLM智能体与数值环境结合的系统：环境提供历史评估分析工具和数值方法执行工具，维护共享评估历史与方法级状态以支持方法切换续接；LLM智能体根据观测和工具反馈选择工具、配置参数、分配预算，数值方法负责计算与评估候选点。同时提出NextEval Bench，在相同工具、匹配预算与信息约束下比较不同智能体配置。
AI.result: 在低维DFO问题上，NextEval的函数评估效率超过当前最优DFO基线。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM智能体与数值优化方法结合是提升有限预算下DFO评估效率的有效途径，并提供了可复现的基准协议。

title: Who Knows What - and What Does It Support? Perspective-Bounded Evidence Calibration for Multimodal Theory of Mind
summary: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to infer others' beliefs, goals, and intentions, is a cornerstone of social intelligence. Multimodal ToM requires inferring an agent's mental state from evidence that is available to that agent, rather than from the complete episode observed by the solver. Existing LLM-based and Bayesian model-based approaches reconstruct global event traces, yet they do not explicitly distinguish objective events from agent-admissible evidence during hypothesis evaluation. Consequently, agent-inaccessible events or semantically misaligned actions and utterances may influence the inferred belief, goal, or social intention, leading to perspective leakage and source or route confusion. We formulate this limitation as an evidence-admissibility problem: evidence should contribute to a mental-state hypothesis only when it is accessible to the relevant agent, preserves its information source, and is diagnostic of the queried mental-state variable. To operationalize this principle, we propose PIP-ToM, an evidence-admissibility interface that constructs agent-specific evidence stores, aligns them with structured mental-state claims, and calibrates model-based hypothesis scores while preserving the underlying Bayesian inference process. PIP-ToM with GPT-4o outperforms existing ToM methods across MuMA-ToM, MMToM-QA, and Hi-ToM, achieving average accuracies of 92.56%, 95.00%, and 95.00%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出PIP-ToM，一个"证据可采纳性"接口，为每个智能体构建专属证据库、与结构化心理状态主张对齐并校准贝叶斯假设分数，解决多模态心智理论中的视角泄漏与来源混淆问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态Theory of Mind需从"该智能体可获取的证据"推断其心理状态，而非求解者看到的完整情节。现有LLM与贝叶斯方法重建全局事件轨迹，未显式区分客观事件与智能体可采纳证据，导致智能体不可及事件或语义错配对动作/话语污染推断，产生视角泄漏与来源/路径混淆。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为证据可采纳性问题（证据仅在可及、保留信息源、且对目标心理变量有诊断性时才参与假设）。据此提出PIP-ToM接口：构建智能体特定证据库；将其与结构化心理状态主张对齐；在保留底层贝叶斯推断过程的前提下校准基于模型的假设分数。GPT-4o实现。
AI.result: PIP-ToM（配GPT-4o）在MuMA-ToM、MMToM-QA、Hi-ToM上均优于现有ToM方法，平均准确率分别为92.56%、95.00%、95.00%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模证据可采纳性可有效避免视角泄漏与来源混淆，为多模态心智状态推断提供了可操作性原则，并取得领先性能。

title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and $τ$-bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.

AI.tldr: 提出 GEPA-Curator，通过筛选有学习价值的任务并检索历史成功轨迹，改进反思式提示优化器（GEPA）在多轮智能体工作负载中的表现。
AI.motivation: 多轮智能体任务中，失败原因可能来自提示弱点、执行框架限制、随机性或噪声评判，而非真正可学习的信号；直接让 GEPA 从所有失败中学习可能引入噪声甚至有害。
AI.method: GEPA-Curator 框架包含两部分：(1) 任务筛选（task curation），过滤掉可能提供噪声或不可靠学习信号的任务；(2) 先验成功检索（prior success retrieval），针对任务选择性检索历史成功轨迹，作为额外上下文提供给提示优化器。
AI.result: 在 GoBrowse、ALFWorld、AppWorld 和 τ-bench 上，以 Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Claude Opus 5 作为优化模型评估，GEPA-Curator 达到或超过两个基线，相比 GEPA 提升最高 20.7%，相比 ACE 提升最高 21.2%。
AI.conclusion: 精选提供给提示优化器的任务经验可显著提升智能体提示优化效果，任务筛选与成功轨迹检索是有效且通用的改进手段。

title: Right Click, Wrong Box: Grading GUI Grounding by What a Click Does
summary: Leading GUI grounders score 93 to 96% on ScreenSpot-v2, and reported gaps between new and prior models are about a point. At this level the useful question is what the remaining errors are. Benchmarks count a click as correct only inside one annotated box, but interfaces often expose one action through several elements: a duplicated link, the label of a checkbox, the title next to a logo. The box is not wrong. The rule is incomplete. We call a click correct when executing it produces the same outcome as clicking the annotated target. A probe that executes and fingerprints about a thousand clicks per page turns this definition into outcome maps and an execution judge for live web applications, with no new annotation. We execute the predictions of three strong 7--8B grounders on a code forge and an online shop. About one in five and one in three of the clicks that box scoring rejects reach the intended outcome, and the shares remain one in seven and one in three when the instructions are rewritten as natural tasks. A blind audit of 11 models on ScreenSpot-v2 (three 7--8B grounders and eight 3B variants) finds the same effect on web screenshots, with two independent reviewers on a 60-unit subset. The share is highest for the strongest grounders. Training seeds and test-set sampling add noise that more runs and paired intervals control. Box scoring instead under-counts correct clicks, which repetition does not remove, and the audit-based correction of 0.2 to 1.8 points on ScreenSpot-v2 is as large as the gaps the field reports. The correction is needed in evaluation. In our 3B GRPO study, crediting equivalent clicks in the reward gives no stable gain over box rewards across three seeds and four test sets. We release the probe, the outcome maps, the audit and every prediction.

AI.tldr: 论文指出GUI grounding基准（如ScreenSpot-v2）的"单框判定"规则不完整，提出以"执行结果相同"定义正确点击，并给出可执行的探测方法与审计，发现1/5~1/3被框判定拒绝的点击实际成功。
AI.motivation: 当前GUI grounder在ScreenSpot-v2上已达93–96%，模型间差距仅约1分，因此真正值得研究的是剩余错误的性质。现有基准只把落在唯一标注框内的点击算正确，但界面常通过多个元素暴露同一动作（重复链接、复选框标签、logo旁标题），单框规则会系统性低估正确点击。
AI.method: 提出以"执行点击是否产生与标注目标相同的结果"作为正确性定义。构建探针，对每个页面执行并指纹约1000次点击，生成outcome maps与执行判定器（execution judge），无需新标注；在代码托管平台与在线商店上评测三个7–8B grounder；另对11个模型（3个7–8B+8个3B）在ScreenSpot-v2上做盲审（60单元子集，两名独立评审），并用多seed、配对区间控制噪声。
AI.result: 框判定拒绝的点击中约1/5（代码平台）和1/3（在线商店）实际达到目标结果；改为自然任务指令后仍为1/7和1/3。ScreenSpot-v2盲审复现相同现象，最强grounder比例最高。基于审计的修正量为0.2–1.8分，与领域报告的模型间差距相当。3B GRPO研究中把等价点击计入奖励，在3个seed、4个测试集上相对框奖励无稳定增益。
AI.conclusion: 单框评分会系统性漏计正确点击，且重复实验无法消除该偏差，评估中必须引入等价点击修正。但将等价点击用于训练奖励暂无稳定收益。作者开源探测工具、outcome maps、审计数据及全部预测。

title: Holomorphic Cauchy Networks for Efficient Stationary Tail Computation in High-Dimensional Reflected Brownian Motions
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, 14 tables. Code available at https://github.com/KehanWang126/holomorphic-cauchy-networks-rbm
summary: Stationary tail computation for high-dimensional reflected Brownian motions (RBMs) remains computationally challenging. Building on NN4MGF's shared-coordinate basic-adjoint-relationship (BAR) framework, we develop Holomorphic Cauchy Networks (HCNs). Native complex-valued rational Cauchy subnetworks enforce holomorphicity on pole-free domains, removing sampled Cauchy-Riemann penalties and their input-derivative graphs. Exact origin anchoring and boundary-coordinate exclusion enforce structural identities, while anchored interactions represent dependent transforms. Under holomorphic-log assumptions, we establish simultaneous value and first-derivative approximation for the constrained architectures and a mixed-derivative lower bound for coordinate-only representations under nonzero cross-covariance. Closed-form real-axis derivatives and sequential backpropagation further control memory. On the same NVIDIA H100 NVL, the tested 30D HCN configuration uses approximately tenfold less peak allocated memory and has 9.7-fold lower mean update time than NN4MGF; extrapolation to the respective scheduled update counts gives a projected full-schedule update-time ratio of 58.2. With 64 million sampled base inputs per high-dimensional run, HCN reaches 50 dimensions on a laptop GPU with 6.367% mean relative error over thresholds 1 through 8. Degree-matched comparisons yield lower reported mean relative errors over the primary evaluation ranges, including 1.422% versus 6.684% on the 2D Harrison non-product benchmark. An exploratory 10D correlated example illustrates the interaction extension.

AI.tldr: 提出全纯Cauchy网络（HCN）用于高维反射布朗运动（RBM）的平稳尾部计算，通过复数有理Cauchy子网强制全纯性，在精度、内存和速度上全面优于NN4MGF。
AI.motivation: 高维反射布朗运动的平稳尾部计算在计算上仍具挑战性；现有NN4MGF采用的采样Cauchy-Riemann惩罚存在额外导数图开销与结构约束不足的问题。
AI.method: 在NN4MGF的共享坐标BAR框架上构建HCN：用原生复值有理Cauchy子网在无极点域上保证全纯性，去除采样CR惩罚及其输入导数图；通过精确原点锚定与边界坐标排除强制结构恒等式，用锚定交互表示依赖变换；在解析对数假设下证明受限架构的同时值与一阶导数逼近能力，并给出非零互协方差下仅坐标表示的混合导数下界；用闭式实轴导数与顺序反向传播控制内存。
AI.result: 相同H100 NVL上，30维HCN峰值内存约低10倍，平均更新耗时低9.7倍，外推整调度更新时间比为58.2；约6400万采样基输入下，在笔记本GPU上达到50维、阈值1–8平均相对误差6.367%；同维度对比误差更低，2D Harrison非乘积基准为1.422% vs 6.684%；10维相关示例验证交互扩展。
AI.conclusion: HCN以结构化全纯架构替代惩罚式训练，在保持逼近保证的同时显著降低内存与时间成本，并支持更高维RBM平稳尾部计算。

title: When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement
summary: Autonomous agents increasingly depend on harnesses that govern interaction, memory, tools, and execution around large language models (LLMs). While recent work has begun to evolve these harnesses from execution experience, the supervision used to guide evolution often remains relatively static, making it difficult to track changing behavioral weaknesses across rounds and potentially limiting generalization to unseen tasks. To address this issue, we propose RuHarness, a rubric--harness co-evolution framework for continual agent self-improvement. RuHarness continually discovers and reassesses behavioral criteria from execution trajectories, prioritizes the most relevant unresolved weaknesses, and uses them to guide targeted harness updates while keeping the task objective fixed. Extensive experiments across diverse agent tasks and backbone models show that RuHarness outperforms strong harness-evolution baselines, particularly on unseen held-out tasks. Further analyses show that adaptive rubric prioritization tracks shifting weaknesses and supports more sustained improvement and stable generalization across evolution rounds.

AI.tldr: 提出 RuHarness——一种"评分量表-执行框架（rubric-harness）协同进化"的持续智能体自我改进框架，通过从执行轨迹中持续发现与重估行为标准，优先处理最相关且未解决的弱点来指导 harness 更新，在多种任务与骨干模型上优于强基线，且在未见留出任务上泛化更好。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体依赖围绕 LLM 的 harness（管理交互、记忆、工具与执行）。已有工作虽能从执行经验中进化 harness，但指导进化的监督信号往往较为静态，难以追踪多轮迭代中不断变化的行为弱点，也可能限制对未见任务的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出 RuHarness 协同进化框架：1）从执行轨迹中持续发现并重新评估行为评判标准（rubric）；2）按相关性对未解决的弱点进行优先级排序；3）用这些优先弱点指导针对性的 harness 更新，同时保持任务目标固定。
AI.result: 在多种智能体任务与多个骨干模型上的大量实验表明，RuHarness 优于强 harness 进化基线，在未见过的留出任务上优势尤其明显。进一步分析显示，自适应 rubric 优先级排序能追踪变化的弱点，并在多轮进化中带来更持续的改进与更稳定的泛化。
AI.conclusion: 将监督信号（rubric）与执行框架（harness）联合、动态地协同进化，是提升智能体持续自我改进效果与泛化稳定性的有效途径。

title: Drop the Details, Get the Gist: Dynamic Conceptual Representation for Video Recognition
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to the MM4SciReal Workshop at ACCV 2026
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs), which route predictions through a layer of human-interpretable concepts, have substantially improved the interpretability of visual classification by exposing an explicit, language-based rationale for each prediction. Most existing work focuses on static images, and temporal dynamics in videos have been underexplored in conceptual representation. We propose a framework that extends concept-based image recognition to procedural video understanding. It represents a multi-step video as a temporal sequence of segment-level concept score vectors and feeds this sequence into a Transformer encoder to predict the class label. We also explore a way to estimate the contribution of each concept for further interpretability. We evaluated three concept sets of different granularities on cooking and household-activity videos and found that coarser-grained concepts are sufficient for classifying these videos, which implies that fine-grained textual descriptions may be unnecessary.

AI.tldr: 将概念瓶颈模型(CBM)从静态图像扩展到程序性视频理解：把视频表示为分段概念分数向量的时序序列，用Transformer编码器预测类别，并估计各概念贡献度。
AI.motivation: 现有CBM工作大多针对静态图像，视频中的时序动态在概念表示中鲜有探索；需要让概念瓶颈机制能处理多步骤程序性视频。
AI.method: 把多步骤视频切分为片段，每段得到片段级概念分数向量，构成时序序列，输入Transformer编码器进行分类；并提出一种估计每个概念贡献度的方法以增强可解释性。在烹饪与家庭活动视频上比较三种不同粒度的概念集。
AI.result: 在三组不同粒度概念集上的实验中，较粗粒度的概念已足以对这类视频进行分类，说明细粒度文本描述可能并非必要。
AI.conclusion: 概念瓶颈框架可有效推广到程序性视频理解，并提示实际应用可采用粗粒度概念集以降低成本与复杂度。

title: Learning from Points and Patches: A Pre-trained Hybrid Attention Transformer for Time Series Analysis
summary:
Time-series data generated by Web services and connected systems support applications such as user activity analysis, service monitoring, and resource management. However, learning transferable representations from heterogeneous time series remains challenging due to diverse temporal patterns, variable sequence lengths, and limited high-quality annotations. Despite the success of pre-training in natural language processing and computer vision, effective time-series pre-training requires strategies tailored to temporal data.
  We propose TimeHAT (Hybrid Attention Transformer), a general-purpose pre-training framework for time-series analysis that addresses two complementary questions: what to learn and how to learn. For what to learn, we introduce a Unified Point-Patch Masking Strategy (UPPMS) that integrates point-level and patch-level supervision within a unified framework for contextual reconstruction and causal extrapolation, enabling the model to capture both fine-grained temporal variations and broader temporal patterns. For how to learn, we develop a Hybrid Attention Encoder (HAE) that combines prefix-constrained bidirectional attention in initial layers with directional hybrid attention in deeper layers, aiming to preserve effective contextual interactions while mitigating rank degeneration.
  We evaluate TimeHAT across real-world datasets and four downstream tasks: classification, long-term forecasting, imputation, and anomaly detection. Experiments cover fine-tuning, few-shot, and zero-shot transfer settings, demonstrating competitive performance across diverse time-series analysis tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/TangPeiwang/TimeHAT.

AI.tldr: 提出通用时间序列预训练框架TimeHAT，用统一点-片段掩码策略（UPPMS）解决"学什么"，用混合注意力编码器（HAE）解决"怎么学"，在分类、长期预测、插补、异常检测四类任务上取得有竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: Web服务与互联系统产生的大量异构时间序列在用户行为分析、服务监控、资源管理等场景有重要价值，但从异构时间序列中学习可迁移表示仍很困难：时序模式多样、序列长度不一、高质量标注稀缺。NLP与CV中的预训练虽成功，但需针对时序数据设计专门的预训练策略。
AI.method: 围绕"学什么、怎么学"两个问题设计。学习目标上，提出统一点-片段掩码策略（UPPMS），在同一框架内融合点级与片段级监督，同时做上下文重建与因果外推，兼顾细粒度时序变化与宏观时序模式。网络结构上，提出混合注意力编码器（HAE）：初始层用前缀约束的双向注意力，深层用方向性混合注意力，以保留有效的上下文交互同时缓解秩退化问题。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上评测分类、长期预测、插补、异常检测四类下游任务，覆盖微调、少样本、零样本迁移设置，均展示出有竞争力的性能。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: TimeHAT为时间序列提供了一个通用预训练框架，通过针对时序特性的掩码监督与注意力设计，验证了定制化预训练在多种时序下游任务与迁移场景下的有效性。

title: MVRCap: Towards Comprehensive Video Captioning via Hierarchical Multi-Dimensional Verifiable Rewards
summary: Despite significant progress, current models struggle to generate comprehensive video captions, constrained primarily by coarse-grained supervision, which often fails to capture spatial-temporal dynamics and the underlying logical intent. To address this issue, we introduce MVRCap, a novel framework that reformulates video captioning as a reinforcement learning task steered by structured verification. Central to our approach is a Fine-Grained Verifiable Reward mechanism, serving as dense supervision to enforce rigorous visual-semantic alignment. Specifically, we construct this reward system anchored by three complementary pillars: a Hierarchical Concept Coverage Reward utilizing our newly constructed MVRCap-QA dataset to ensure multi-dimensional completeness and semantic depth, a Factuality Verification Reward to enhance factual consistency, and a Conciseness Constraint to maximize semantic density. Furthermore, we curate the high-quality MVRCap-SFT dataset, providing structured annotations across six key dimensions, to serve as a robust foundational initialization for the RL policy in this training pipeline. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MVRCap achieves state-of-the-art performance on authoritative benchmarks including VDC, CAPability, and VC4VG.

AI.tldr: MVRCap将视频描述生成重构为强化学习任务，通过结构化验证构建细粒度可验证奖励（层级概念覆盖、事实性验证、简洁性约束），实现细粒度稠密监督，在VDC、CAPability、VC4VG上达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有视频描述模型受限于粗粒度监督，难以捕捉时空动态与潜在逻辑意图，生成的描述不够全面。
AI.method: 将视频描述建模为强化学习任务，引入细粒度可验证奖励机制：①基于新建MVRCap-QA数据集的分层概念覆盖奖励，保证多维度完整性与语义深度；②事实性验证奖励提升事实一致性；③简洁性约束最大化语义密度。此外构建含六个维度结构化标注的MVRCap-SFT数据集，作为RL策略的稳健初始化。
AI.result: 在VDC、CAPability、VC4VG等权威基准上取得state-of-the-art性能。
AI.conclusion: 结构化可验证的强化学习奖励可有效弥补粗粒度监督的不足，显著提升视频描述的完整性、事实性与简洁性。

title: Less is more: learning what to profile for GPU kernel optimization
summary: Large language models have recently shown strong potential for automatically optimizing GPU kernels, yet their effectiveness depends critically on the hardware information available to the kernel optimization model. Existing systems typically rely on predefined profiling strategies, leaving what to profile largely outside the optimization process. We show that effective profiling is not simply about collecting more information: increasing the number of profiling metrics does not monotonically improve kernel optimization, while the most useful profiling information varies across kernels. Our theoretical analysis further shows that, under such heterogeneous profiling utility, kernel-conditioned selection can outperform any single fixed profiling configuration. Motivated by this observation, we propose AutoProfiler, a feedback-driven framework for learning a deterministic profiling tree from optimization feedback. The tree is iteratively refined through REWRITE and SPLIT operations, with an LLM generating candidate modifications and empirical evaluation determining their acceptance. Once constructed, the tree quickly gathers the required profiling information for any kernel, allowing the LLM rewriter to be invoked only once. Experiments on KernelBench show that our approach improves kernel optimization over fixed profiling configurations under constrained profiling budgets. These results suggest that hardware profiling should evolve from static metric collection toward profiling reasoning, making profiling itself a new dimension for improving kernel optimization. The codes are available at https://github.com/Satissss/AutoProfiler.

AI.tldr: AutoProfiler：用反馈驱动学习"确定性的 profiling 树"，按 kernel 自适应选择 profiling 信息，提升 LLM 的 GPU kernel 优化效果。
AI.motivation: LLM 优化 GPU kernel 严重依赖其可获得的硬件信息，但现有系统用预设 profiling 策略，"profiling 什么"不在优化回路内。作者观察到：指标越多并不单调提升效果，最有用的信息随 kernel 而异，因此需要按 kernel 条件化地选择 profiling 信息。
AI.method: 理论分析表明在 profiling 效用异质时，kernel-conditioned 选择可优于任何单一固定配置。据此提出 AutoProfiler：通过优化反馈学习一棵确定性 profiling 树，用 LLM 生成候选 REWRITE / SPLIT 修改，由实测决定是否接受，迭代精炼。树构建后对任意 kernel 快速收集所需 profiling 信息，LLM rewriter 仅调用一次。
AI.result: 在 KernelBench 上，于受限 profiling 预算下，效果优于固定 profiling 配置；同时验证了指标增加并非单调有益。
AI.conclusion: 硬件 profiling 应从静态指标采集转向"profiling 推理"，让 profiling 本身成为提升 kernel 优化的新维度。

title: Evolving Agent Teams
summary: The rapid progress of software engineering agents drives interest in applying them to open-ended problems such as GPU kernel optimization. However, we find that existing coding agents converge to local optima on real-world, expert-written kernels (e.g., FlashInfer). We introduce Evolving Agent Teams, a multi-agent framework that escapes such local optima. It features (1) a central supervisor that diagnoses each local optimum and restructures a team of agents; and (2) a persistent file system that comprises a learning document, an evolution history, and per-team artifacts, grounding restructuring with accumulated experience. Under a matched token budget, Evolving Agent Teams consistently outperforms strong coding-agent baselines. With an extended token budget, Evolving Agent Teams generates a CUDA kernel that reaches 1.2x mean speedup over the production FlashInfer MLA paged decode kernel from scratch and wins on 36 of 47 production workloads from FlashInfer-Bench (0.86-0.99x on the remaining 11). It also demonstrates superior performance on tasks such as KDA prefill on AMD MI350X (3.01x over vLLM) and NVIDIA B200 (3.44x over FlashKDA), MoE expert-offload serving on Apple silicon (30.3 tokens/s decode for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next in MLX 4-bit on a 48 GB M4 Pro), and RoboDojo robot manipulation (62.1 on held-out seeds vs. 55.3 for the best leaderboard entry). Code is available at https://github.com/caoshiyi/EAT.

AI.tldr: 提出"演化智能体团队"(Evolving Agent Teams)多智能体框架，通过中央监督者诊断局部最优并重构团队、配合持久化文件系统积累经验，在GPU内核等开放式优化问题上突破现有编码智能体的局部最优瓶颈，生成CUDA内核较FlashInfer生产基线取得1.2倍平均加速。
AI.motivation: 软件工程智能体发展迅速，但作者发现现有编码智能体在真实专家编写的内核（如FlashInfer）上会陷入局部最优，难以应对GPU内核优化这类开放式问题。
AI.method: 多智能体框架，包含两部分：(1) 中央监督者，负责诊断每次局部最优并重组智能体团队结构；(2) 持久化文件系统，包含学习文档、演化历史和每个团队的产物，用积累的经验指导团队重构。在匹配token预算下与强基线对比。
AI.result: 匹配token预算下持续优于强编码智能体基线；扩展预算下从零生成CUDA内核，相对FlashInfer MLA paged decode生产内核平均1.2倍加速，在FlashInfer-Bench的47个生产负载中36个胜出（其余11个为0.86-0.99倍）；还在AMD MI350X上KDA prefill达3.01倍(vs vLLM)、NVIDIA B200上3.44倍(vs FlashKDA)、Apple芯片MoE专家卸载服务(30.3 tokens/s)、RoboDojo机器人操作(62.1 vs 最佳榜单55.3)等任务上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 通过监督者驱动的团队重构与经验持久化，多智能体协作可有效逃离局部最优，广泛适用于内核优化、推理服务与机器人操作等开放式工程问题。代码已开源。

title: AxisQ: Depth-Adaptive Channel--Frequency Quantization for Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Camouflaged object detection (COD) depends on weak texture and boundary cues that can be destroyed by aggressive post-training quantization (PTQ). Existing PTQ methods mainly optimize quantizers or reconstruct network blocks, while using a single precision-allocation domain throughout hierarchical backbones. Instead, we introduce AxisQ, a depth-adaptive bit-allocation framework motivated by the observation that the useful allocation axis changes with feature depth. Under a fixed per-layer average activation-bit budget, AxisQ allocates precision in the channel domain for shallow features and in the local-frequency domain for deep features, using COD-aware sensitivity to better preserve subtle foreground regions and ambiguous boundaries. We also formulate a boundary-aware Hessian approximation for reconstruction by incorporating boundary-weighted gradient and error statistics. Experiments across multiple COD models and diverse benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy over the strongest baselines at low bit widths, with relative weighted F-measure gains of 12.7% for CFRN and 33.3% for CamoFormer-P on CAMO under W2A2 quantization. These results support adapting the allocation domain to feature depth as a transferable quantization strategy for hierarchical COD models.

AI.tldr: AxisQ 是一个面向伪装目标检测（COD）的深度自适应后训练量化位分配框架：浅层特征在通道域分配精度，深层特征在局部频率域分配精度，并结合边界感知 Hessian 近似进行重建，在低比特下显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: COD 依赖微弱的纹理与边界线索，激进的训练后量化（PTQ）会破坏这些信息；现有 PTQ 方法只优化量化器或重建网络块，且在整个层级骨干中沿用单一精度分配域，忽略了特征深度对分配域选择的影响。
AI.method: 提出 AxisQ：在固定逐层平均激活比特预算下，基于"有用分配轴随特征深度变化"的观察，浅层特征在通道域、深层特征在局部频率域分配精度；采用 COD 感知敏感度以保留细微前景区域与模糊边界；并构建边界感知 Hessian 近似（引入边界加权梯度与误差统计）用于重建。
AI.result: 在多个 COD 模型与多样基准上，低比特宽度下精度优于最强基线；W2A2 量化下 CAMO 数据集上，CFRN 的相对加权 F-measure 提升 12.7%，CamoFormer-P 提升 33.3%。
AI.conclusion: 按特征深度自适应选择分配域是一种可迁移的量化策略，适用于层级式 COD 模型。

title: MM-Net: A Multimodal Multi-Task Network for Sleep Staging and Sleep Apnea Assessment After Ischemic Stroke
summary: Automated polysomnography after ischemic stroke is challenging because of altered sleep-related neural activity and concurrent respiratory disturbances. Existing stroke-specific approaches mainly address sleep-stage classification, leaving joint analysis of sleep architecture and respiratory events underexplored. Moreover, adapting pretrained EEG encoders introduces a representation inconsistency when downstream models are trained on embeddings from previously seen patients but evaluated on unseen individuals. We propose MM-Net, a multimodal multi-task framework that resolves this inconsistency through cross-fitting and ridge-based embedding alignment. Sleep-adapted EEG-EOG representations and engineered neural descriptors are fused with learned cardiorespiratory features through cross-attention and shared temporal modeling for simultaneous sleep staging and respiratory-event detection. On iSLEEPS (99 patients with subacute ischemic stroke), ten-fold patient-independent evaluation achieved 76.3% staging accuracy (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.656) and 0.825 respiratory-event AUC, outperforming the evaluated baselines under matched protocols. The sleep-adapted encoder improved the downstream model when its embeddings were aligned, raising staging accuracy by 1.4 percentage points over the frozen encoder ($p$ = 0.020) versus 0.2 points without alignment. MM-Net also achieved 86.4% staging accuracy on Sleep-EDF, above every single-EEG architecture reimplemented on the same recordings, and 80.3% staging accuracy with 0.889 respiratory AUC on ISRUC-I, exceeding its retrained staging baselines. Without retraining, the iSLEEPS-trained model retained respiratory AUCs of 0.833 on ISRUC-I and 0.841 on UCD. These findings support representation-consistent neural adaptation and joint physiological modeling across stroke, healthy-sleep, and sleep-disorder cohorts.

AI.tldr: 提出MM-Net多模态多任务框架，通过交叉拟合与岭回归嵌入对齐解决预训练EEG编码器的表示不一致问题，在缺血性卒中睡眠数据集iSLEEPS上实现76.3%睡眠分期准确率与0.825呼吸事件AUC，并具跨队列泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 缺血性卒中后的自动多导睡眠图分析困难：睡眠相关神经活动改变且并发呼吸紊乱。现有卒中专用方法多只做睡眠分期，睡眠结构与呼吸事件的联合分析不足；同时，微调预训练EEG编码器时存在表示不一致——下游模型训练用的是"已见患者"的嵌入，评估却在"未见个体"上，导致性能下降。
AI.method: MM-Net：多模态多任务框架。(1) 通过交叉拟合(cross-fitting)与基于岭回归的嵌入对齐，消除预训练编码器的表示不一致；(2) 融合睡眠适配的EEG-EOG表示、工程化神经描述符与学习的心肺特征；(3) 采用交叉注意力与共享时序建模，同时完成睡眠分期与呼吸事件检测。
AI.result: 在iSLEEPS（99例亚急性缺血性卒中患者）十折患者独立评估：分期准确率76.3%（κ=0.656），呼吸事件AUC 0.825，优于匹配协议下的基线。对齐后睡眠适配编码器比冻结编码器提升1.4个百分点（p=0.020），未对齐仅0.2点。Sleep-EDF上分期准确率86.4%，超过所有在相同记录上复现的单EEG架构；ISRUC-I上80.3%准确率、呼吸AUC 0.889，超过其重训分期基线。不经重训，iSLEEPS训练模型在ISRUC-I与UCD上呼吸AUC保持0.833和0.841。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"表示一致的神经适"与联合生理建模在卒中、健康睡眠和睡眠障碍队列间的有效性与可迁移性，验证了嵌入对齐对预训练编码器适配的必要性。

title: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Mobile GUI agents are typically fine-tuned 7B-scale vision-language models (VLMs) that generate each action as text. However, these VLMs decode every action token by token, and even agents that score candidate actions keep a large language model or VLM in the loop, making them slow and memory-hungry. To address these issues, we propose GUI-JEPA, to our knowledge the first decoder-free GUI agent policy built on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), which selects actions in the latent space of a JEPA encoder pretrained on unlabelled GUI screenshots. Its action- and region-conditioned latent predictor turns the screen latent into one latent per candidate action, letting lightweight heads score all candidates against the instruction in a single batched pass, without decoding a token. We further show that the scorer relies on this latent pathway and that the predictor is trained for the decision itself: a randomly initialised predictor does just as well as one pretrained on screen dynamics. On AndroidControl, GUI-JEPA is 2.8-4.0x faster on the same GPU than a Qwen2.5-VL-7B agent we fine-tune with the same inputs, while reaching 86-92% of its in-distribution accuracy with 6% of its parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA

AI.tldr: 提出GUI-JEPA：首个基于JEPA的无解码器GUI智能体策略，在预训练JEPA编码器的潜空间中选择动作，单次批量前向即可给所有候选动作打分，无需逐token解码。
AI.motivation: 现有移动GUI智能体多为7B级VLM，逐token解码动作，且候选动作打分仍依赖大模型在环，速度慢、显存开销大。
AI.method: 用无标注GUI截图预训练的JEPA编码器提取屏幕潜表示；动作与区域条件化的潜预测器将屏幕潜表示映射为每个候选动作的潜向量；轻量评分头在一次批量前向中对照指令为全部候选打分，全程不生成token。消融考察评分器对潜通路依赖及预测器是否需预训练。
AI.result: AndroidControl上，同GPU下比同等输入微调的Qwen2.5-VL-7B智能体快2.8–4.0倍，以6%参数量达到其后者的86–92%分布内准确率；随机初始化预测器与预训练于屏幕动态的预测器效果相当。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间候选评分可作为高效替代逐token解码的GUI智能体范式；决策相关预测器未必需要动力学预训练，为轻量、快速GUI智能体提供新方向。

title: uTHCD-C: A Corruption-Robustness Benchmark for Tamil Handwritten Character Recognition
summary: Evaluation of Tamil handwritten character recognition (HCR) has largely focused on clean test images, and a standardized multi-corruption robustness benchmark for isolated Tamil HCR has not been established. We introduce uTHCD-C, a corruption-robustness benchmark based on the unconstrained Tamil Handwritten Character Database (uTHCD). The benchmark defines ten corruption types, including a handwriting-specific stroke-thinning corruption, at five severity levels. We evaluate nine convolutional and transformer-based architectures using five-fold stratified cross-validation and writer-independent testing. Robustness is quantified using mean Corruption Error (mCE), normalized against a VGG16-BN reference. We additionally compare parameter count, computational complexity, and inference throughput to characterize the computational requirements of the evaluated architectures. The results establish comparative robustness baselines for Tamil HCR, revealing substantial differences across architectures: ConvNeXt and Swin achieve the lowest mCE values (0.75 and 0.83, respectively), whereas ShuffleNet and MnasNet exhibit higher values (1.55 and 1.85, respectively). The accompanying efficiency measurements characterize the trade-offs between corruption robustness and computational requirements. By providing standardized corruption configurations, evaluation protocols, and comparative results, uTHCD-C establishes a reproducible basis for future research on robust and computationally efficient Tamil HCR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出uTHCD-C基准，用于评估泰米尔文手写字符识别在十种损坏类型、五级严重度下的鲁棒性，并比较九种CNN/Transformer模型的精度与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有泰米尔手写字符识别研究多在干净测试图像上评估，缺乏标准化的多损坏鲁棒性基准，无法公平比较各架构在真实扰动下的表现。
AI.method: 基于uTHCD数据库构建uTHCD-C基准，定义10种损坏类型（含手写特有的笔画细化）与5个严重度；用五折分层交叉验证和书写者无关测试评估9种卷积与Transformer架构；以VGG16-BN为参考用mCE量化鲁棒性，并比较参数量、计算复杂度和推理吞吐。
AI.result: ConvNeXt与Swin的mCE最低（0.75、0.83），ShuffleNet与MnasNet最高（1.55、1.85），架构间鲁棒性差异显著；效率测量揭示了鲁棒性与计算开销间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过标准化损坏配置、评估协议与对比结果，uTHCD-C为鲁棒且高效泰米尔HCR研究提供了可复现的基准基础。

title: RubricAtlas: Mining Type-Level Rubrics from Expert Reports to Evaluate Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep research agents conduct multi-step Web searches and synthesise retrieved information into analytical reports. Evaluating these outputs requires checking which analyses they deliver, beyond the presence of relevant facts. Query-specific binary rubrics make individual requirements explicit, but task-level checklists may leave the overall analytical structure underexamined. We introduce RubricAtlas, which derives type-level analytical requirements from expert reports on different objects within the same research type and organises detailed checks around recurring analytical questions. The requirements give related tasks a shared standard for what to analyse, without prescribing their answers. Our framework links binary checkpoints to report passages and evaluates completeness separately from argument validity. Built from 3,079 Chinese financial research reports, RubricAtlas covers 99 research types. Reference-report selection experiments show that individual reports cover only about half of their type's analytical questions, and that selecting requirements from different reports changes evaluation scores and agent rankings. Across ten agents, two judge pipelines achieve checkpoint agreement of $κ$ = 0.71 and agent-ranking agreement of Kendall $τ$ = 0.87. Controlled deletions reduce scores on the affected analyses, while padding produces no detectable increase. These findings support type-level rubrics for comparing the analytical completeness of Web deep research outputs, with individual decisions traceable to report evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出 RubricAtlas 框架，从同一研究类型的多份专家报告中提炼“类型级”分析要求（考查什么、不规定答案），并围绕复现的分析性问题组织二元检查点，将检查点链接到报告段落，把完整性评估与论证有效性评估分开。基于 3,079 份中文金融研报构建覆盖 99 种研究类型的基准。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体能进行多步网络检索并合成分析报告，评估需检验其交付了哪些分析，而不仅是事实是否出现。任务级二元评分表虽能明确单项要求，却使整体分析结构被忽视；单份参考报告也无法作为完整标准。
AI.method: 从同一研究类型的多份专家报告中抽取类型级分析要求，按反复出现的分析性问题组织检查点；每个二元检查点可追溯到报告具体段落；完整性与论证有效性分别评分；并设计参考报告选择实验与受控删除/填充实验验证。
AI.result: 单份报告仅覆盖其类型约一半分析问题；从不同报告选取要求会改变评分与智能体排名。跨十个智能体，两条评判流程检查点一致性 κ=0.71、排名一致性 Kendall τ=0.87。受控删除会降低对应分析的得分，填充内容则无可检测的提升。
AI.conclusion: 类型级评分表适合比较网络深度研究输出的分析完整性，且每个判定均可追溯到报告证据，为智能体评估提供了更稳健、可审计的标准。

title: LingGS: Decoupling Feed-Forward Geometry Prediction from Camera Tracking for High-Fidelity Gaussian SLAM
summary: Achieving high-quality reconstruction and responsive camera tracking remains challenging for monocular RGB Gaussian splatting SLAM under a limited optimization budget. We present an online system that addresses this challenge by combining learned geometric priors with explicit geometric camera tracking, which can substantially outperform learned camera prediction in terms of tracking accuracy. A frozen streaming 3D foundation model serves as a virtual RGB-D sensor, providing depth estimation from monocular video. An explicit geometric solver then estimates camera motion through feature reprojection, and a streaming Gaussian mapper integrates the resulting observations into a dense scene representation. We further show that geometric tracking improves camera pose accuracy across representative streaming geometry backbones, demonstrating the broader applicability of our approach. Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor datasets show that our method significantly improves reconstruction quality over existing approaches, achieving about 7 FPS on a single RTX 4090 and delivering 2-3 times the throughput of the evaluated prior SLAM systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在线单目RGB高斯泼溅SLAM系统，将冻结的流式3D基础模型作为虚拟RGB-D传感器提供深度，再结合显式几何相机跟踪与流式高斯建图，在有限优化预算下实现高质量重建与快速相机跟踪。
AI.motivation: 单目RGB高斯泼溅SLAM在有限优化预算下难以同时保证高质量重建和响应的相机跟踪，且学习式相机预测精度不足。
AI.method: 使用冻结的流式3D基础模型从单目视频估计深度，充当虚拟RGB-D传感器；用显式几何求解器通过特征重投影估计相机运动；流式高斯建图器将观测融合为稠密场景表示。
AI.result: 几何跟踪在多种流式几何骨干上均提升位姿精度；室内外数据集上重建质量显著优于现有方法；单张RTX 4090上约7 FPS，吞吐量为对比SLAM系统的2-3倍。
AI.conclusion: 将学习几何先验与显式几何相机跟踪结合，可有效替代学习式相机预测，实现更准、更快的单目高斯SLAM，并具备跨骨干的通用性。

title: Efficient Quantization Training with Stochastic Rounding via Structured Subspace Randomness
summary: Low-precision training often relies on stochastic rounding (SR) to keep quantized gradients unbiased and prevent small updates from rounding to zero. Standard SR draws an independent random threshold for every gradient element. However, accelerators generate random numbers on vector units whose throughput lags far behind their matrix units. Drawing one threshold per element saturates the vector unit and can make INT8 training with SR slower than BF16 training. Sharing random thresholds across tensor elements removes this cost but forces those elements to round in the same direction and shifts their rounding errors by a common offset. We find that this offset degrades training primarily through the activation gradient, which propagates the error backward into earlier layers. Because earlier layers cannot cancel an incoming offset using their own local rounding errors, the offset must be removed at the layer where it originates. We propose Structured Subspace Stochastic Rounding (S3R), which quantizes each upstream gradient once for both the activation and weight gradient matrix multiplications and shares a single threshold per token across the hidden dimension. Its error correction, S3R-EC, subtracts the structured mean rounding error from the activation and weight gradients while leaving the optimizer unchanged. In LLM pre-training experiments, uncorrected threshold sharing degrades convergence, whereas S3R-EC eliminates this degradation and matches the validation loss of independent SR. Furthermore, S3R-EC accelerates full INT8 training steps of dense LLMs on TPU v5p by 1.24x to 1.32x over BF16 and by 1.11x over independent SR.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化子空间随机舍入 (S3R) 及其误差校正 S3R-EC，通过跨隐维度共享随机阈值并按 token 校正舍入误差，使 INT8 训练既高效又保持无偏，在 LLM 预训练中匹配独立 SR 的验证损失并显著加速。
AI.motivation: 标准随机舍入 (SR) 需为每个梯度元素生成独立阈值，但加速器向量单元随机数吞吐远低于矩阵单元，导致 SR 饱和向量单元，使 INT8 训练反而比 BF16 更慢。跨张量元素共享阈值可降低成本，但会强制同向舍入并引入公共偏移误差。
AI.method: 分析发现共享阈值的偏移误差主要通过激活梯度反向传播至前层，且前层无法用自身局部误差抵消，须在源头去除。据此提出 S3R：对上游梯度仅量化一次以同时用于激活与权重梯度矩阵乘，并在每个 token 上跨隐维度共享单一阈值；配套 S3R-EC 从激活和权重梯度中减去结构化平均舍入误差，且不改变优化器。
AI.result: LLM 预训练中，未校正的阈值共享损害收敛；S3R-EC 消除该退化并匹配独立 SR 的验证损失。在 TPU v5p 上，密集 LLM 的完整 INT8 训练步比 BF16 提速 1.24x–1.32x，比独立 SR 提速 1.11x。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化共享阈值降低成本并显式校正其引入的偏移误差，S3R-EC 在保持训练精度的同时实现了 INT8 训练相对 BF16 与独立 SR 的实际加速，兼顾效率与无偏性。

title: Noise Steering: Exploiting Wake Steering and Acoustic Directivity for Noise-Constrained Wind Farm Control via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Existing noise mitigation strategies for wind farms usually consist in reducing turbines power output, without accounting for the wake interactions between them and the noise emission directivity. This leads to over-conservative policies and unexploited wind power. Yet, turbine yaw can simultaneously affect wake interactions and the direction of noise emission, offering an additional degree of freedom for farm-level noise control. We therefore propose Noise Steering, a model-free reinforcement learning (RL) strategy that jointly controls turbine yaw angles and power setpoints to maximise farm power while satisfying a local noise constraint in a defined region. To enable training at a reduced computational cost, a low-fidelity acoustic model is coupled with the steady-state FLORIS simulator. The RL agent effectively learns how to redirect wakes and noise directivity away from the protected region while redistributing power across the farm. On a six-turbine test farm, the policy satisfies the 40 dB noise constraint throughout the full range of turbulent winds, with an average power deficit of only 2% relative to greedy unimpeded control, and up to 7.7% at high wind speeds. In comparison, the industry-standard noise-reduced operation (NRO) baseline here generates an average power loss of 17%. When deployed in the higher-fidelity FAST.Farm simulator, the policy largely retains its performance under steady and turbulent inflow, despite differences in simulation fidelity. These results demonstrate the potential of combining yaw control and power derating through RL to improve the power-noise trade-off in wind farm operation.

AI.tldr: 提出"噪声转向"(Noise Steering)无模型强化学习策略，联合控制风机偏航角与功率设定点，在满足受保护区噪声约束的同时最大化风场功率。
AI.motivation: 现有风场降噪策略仅靠降低风机功率，忽略尾流相互作用与噪声辐射方向性，导致政策过度保守、风能未被充分利用；而偏航可同时影响尾流与噪声方向，提供额外控制自由度。
AI.method: 用低保真声学模型与稳态FLORIS仿真器耦合以降低训练成本，训练无模型RL智能体联合优化偏航角与功率设定点；在六风机测试风场与FAST.Farm高保真仿真器中验证。
AI.result: 在完整湍流风速范围内满足40 dB噪声约束，相对无约束贪心控制平均功率损失仅2%（高风速下达7.7%），而工业标准NRO基线平均损失17%；部署到FAST.Farm后性能基本保持。
AI.conclusion: 结合偏航控制与功率降额的RL方法可显著改善风场运行的功率-噪声权衡。

title: Evaluating AlphaEarth Embeddings for Crop Classification: Separability, Temporal Dynamics, and Cross-Regional Transferability
summary:
Earth Observation (EO)-based agricultural monitoring is shifting from pixel-level spectral analysis toward representation-driven modeling, yet systematic evaluation of learned representations across spatial, temporal, and domain-generalization dimensions remains limited. Geospatial foundation models generate high-dimensional embeddings encoding spatio-temporal land-surface properties, but their utility for agricultural applications remains insufficiently understood. This study presents a representation-agnostic evaluation framework integrating geometric separability, temporal dynamics, spatial robustness, and cross-regional generalisation. A 64-dimensional AlphaEarth embedding space is benchmarked against Sentinel-2 reflectance, NDVI-derived phenology, and harmonic features using field-scale data from the Conterminous United States (CONUS; 2017-2023) and Northern India (2021).
  Traditional features achieve strong linear separability (Fisher ratio), while embeddings provide superior distribution-aware separation -- Bhattacharyya and Mahalanobis distances up to an order of magnitude higher for spectrally similar pairs (e.g. Corn/Soybeans: 3.9 vs. 0.10). Embeddings uniquely capture multi-year crop rotation dynamics, reaching a separability ratio of 1.784 versus a maximum of 1.003 across all engineered features, and exhibit lower residual spatial autocorrelation of errors (mean Moran's $I \approx 0.17$). However, harmonic and NDVI features show stronger cross-continental transferability (US $\to$ India Macro F1: 0.493 vs. 0.326 for embeddings), reflecting better distributional alignment. The combined feature space yields balanced performance, supporting hybrid modeling. These findings reveal a fundamental trade-off between representational richness and cross-region transferability, providing a structured framework for feature selection in large-scale crop classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个与表示无关的评估框架，从几何可分性、时序动态、空间鲁棒性和跨区域泛化四个维度系统比较AlphaEarth 64维嵌入与Sentinel-2反射率、NDVI物候、谐波特征在田块尺度作物制图中的表现，揭示"表示丰富性与跨区域迁移性"的根本权衡。
AI.motivation: 遥感农业监测正从像元级光谱分析转向表示驱动建模，地理空间基础模型虽能生成高维嵌入，但其在农业应用中的效用缺乏系统评估，尤其缺少跨空间、时间与领域泛化维度的统一评测。
AI.method: 构建表示无关评估框架，涵盖几何可分性（Fisher比、Bhattacharyya距离、马氏距离）、时序动态（多年轮作）、空间鲁棒性（残差空间自相关Moran's I）与跨区域泛化（美国本土2017–2023与印度北部2021田块数据），将AlphaEarth嵌入与Sentinel-2反射率、NDVI物候及谐波特征进行基准对比。
AI.result: 传统特征线性可分性强，嵌入在分布感知可分性上显著更优（光谱相似类别如玉米/大豆：3.9 vs 0.10，差距可达一个数量级）；嵌入是唯一能捕捉多年轮作动态的特征（可分性比1.784 vs 工程特征最高1.003），误差空间自相关更低（Moran's I≈0.17）；但谐波与NDVI特征跨大陆迁移更优（US→India Macro F1：0.493 vs 0.326）。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入与传统特征各有所长，组合特征空间表现均衡，支持混合建模；研究揭示了表示丰富性与跨区域可迁移性之间的根本权衡，为大规模作物分类的特征选择提供了结构化框架。

title: Normalized Cuts and Data Clustering via Matrix Fractional Programming
summary: The normalized cut (NCut) problem is a fundamental one in the area of data clustering. Despite its fractional structure, the NCut problem is seldom considered from a fractional programming (FP) perspective in the existing literature. The main reason is that the conventional FP method is inadequate for this problem case: the classical Dinkelbach's transform can only handle a single ratio and hence is limited to the two-class clustering, whereas the multi-class clustering involves multiple ratio terms. This work proposes a novel so-called multidimensional quadratic transform that is capable of dealing with the multi-ratio case; it recasts the NCut problem into a bipartite matching problem---which can be immediately solved by linear search. Furthermore, we explore the connection between the proposed FP method and the minorization-maximization (MM) theory, and in turn characterize the convergence behavior of our algorithm. Finally, we conduct experiments to numerically demonstrate the advantages of the proposed FP-based algorithm in a variety of data clustering and image segmentation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出多维二次变换，将归一化割(NCut)问题从分式规划角度重新求解，转化为二部匹配问题并用线性搜索求解，同时用MM理论刻画收敛性。
AI.motivation: NCut是数据聚类的核心问题，但现有文献很少从分式规划(FP)角度处理。原因是经典Dinkelbach变换只能处理单个比值，仅适用于二分类聚类，而多类聚类涉及多个比值项，传统FP方法不足。
AI.method: 提出一种新的"多维二次变换"(multidimensional quadratic transform)，能够处理多比值情形，将NCut问题重构为二部匹配问题，可通过线性搜索直接求解；并探讨该FP方法与minorization-maximization (MM)理论的联系，据此刻画算法的收敛行为。
AI.result: 通过多种数据聚类与图像分割任务的实验，数值上验证了所提基于FP的算法具有优势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将NCut纳入分式规划框架，突破单比值的限制，为多类聚类提供了一个可通过线性搜索求解且收敛性可分析的新算法。

title: Natural Hard-Negative Mining from Positives for Instruction-Following Retrieval
summary: Instruction-following information retrieval (IFIR) requires retrievers to rank documents by both a query and its instance-specific instructions, yet instruction-conditioned contrastive supervision remains scarce. Existing synthetic methods typically fix a positive passage and generate additional negatives, overlooking the hard-negative potential of the original positive. We propose Natural Hard-Negative Mining (NHNM), which promotes convertible negatives under query-compatible instructions and repurposes original positives as natural instruction hard negatives. Its automated Candidate Cleaning, Reversal Construction, and Geometry Filtering pipeline produces compact, high-contrast supervision aligned with the pretrained retrieval space. Applied to MSMARCO, NHNM yields NHNM-MARCO, an IFIR training set of nearly 7K instances. On InstructIR and FollowIR, models with 568M to 4B parameters fine-tuned on NHNM-MARCO achieve strong instruction-following performance and match or surpass substantially larger retrievers in several settings. Controlled analyses and ablations attribute these gains to natural hard-negative supervision rather than model scale or training-data volume.

AI.tldr: 提出自然难负例挖掘（NHNM）方法，将原正例转化为指令难负例，构建约7K条NHNM-MARCO训练集，在InstructIR与FollowIR上显著提升指令跟随检索性能。
AI.motivation: 指令跟随信息检索（IFIR）需要检索器同时依据查询与实例级指令排序文档，但指令条件下的对比监督数据稀缺。已有合成方法固定正例、额外生成负例，忽略了原正例本身作为难负例的潜力。
AI.method: NHNM将查询兼容指令下可转换的负例提升为难负例，并把原正例重用作自然的指令难负例；配套自动化流程包括候选清洗（Candidate Cleaning）、反转构造（Reversal Construction）与几何过滤（Geometry Filtering），以生成紧凑、高对比度且与预训练检索空间对齐的监督信号，并应用于MSMARCO得到NHNM-MARCO。
AI.result: 在InstructIR和FollowIR上，568M至4B参数的模型经NHNM-MARCO微调后取得较强指令跟随表现，部分设置下可匹配或超越更大规模检索器；对照分析与消融实验表明收益来自自然难负例监督，而非模型规模或训练数据量。
AI.conclusion: 利用原正例构造自然难负例是一种高效、紧凑的IFIR监督方式，可在小数据量下显著提升指令跟随能力。

title: Forget the Data, Keep the Capability: Switchable Unlearning for Retrieval
summary: Privacy compliance requires re-identification models to selectively forget individuals while preserving their ability to recognize others. For this, we present MoME, a switchable framework that can adapt pre-trained backbones for privacy compliance, allowing the same model to switch between Full mode for standard inference and Core mode for unlearned inference. MoME splits one backbone into core parameters that preserve retrieval and zero-initialized parasitic parameters that carry the full-data knowledge, and training them under gradient isolation so the core never receives a forget-set gradient. Disabling the branch yields Core, which satisfies a request to delete a person's training data, and enabling it yields Full, which retains what the deleted data taught, so honoring the request is a flag flip rather than a retraining run. We prove Core independent of the forget set up to an audited set of coupling channels and introduce the rank-based Forgetting-Rank statistic to audit that independence in a trained model. On Market-1501, VeRi-776 and RegDB, Core reads at a retrained reference under three membership attacks while retrieving above it, and the retrieval advantage carries to ResNet and CLIP backbones. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/Jingong-Chen/MoME.

AI.tldr: MoME 是一种可切换的重识别模型框架，通过核心参数与零初始化寄生参数的梯度隔离，实现"Full模式"（保留全量知识）与"Core模式"（已遗忘指定个体）之间的开关切换，使删除请求只需翻转标志位而非重训练。
AI.motivation: 隐私合规要求重识别模型能够选择性地遗忘某些个体，同时保留对其余人的识别能力。传统做法需重训练模型，代价高且难以兼顾遗忘与检索性能。
AI.method: 将同一骨干拆分为两类参数：保存检索能力的核心参数，以及承载全量知识、零初始化的寄生参数；二者在梯度隔离下训练，核心永不接收遗忘集梯度。关闭寄生分支得到 Core（满足数据删除请求），开启得到 Full（保留全量知识）。理论上证明 Core 在审计的耦合通道范围内独立于遗忘集，并提出基于秩的 Forgetting-Rank 统计量用于审计实际模型的独立性。
AI.result: 在 Market-1501、VeRi-776 和 RegDB 上，Core 在三种成员推断攻击下达到重训练参考模型水平，且检索性能高于该参考；检索优势在 ResNet 与 CLIP 骨干上同样成立。
AI.conclusion: MoME 以标志位翻转替代重训练即可满足删除请求，同时较好保持检索与遗忘的平衡；提供理论独立性与可审计性保障，并具跨骨干泛化性。代码与权重已开源。

title: Balanced State Subspaces for Mamba-2 State Compression
summary: Mamba-2 compresses all context into a fixed-size recurrent state that dominates decoding memory and bandwidth. Existing compressors quantize state values or prune state coordinates, scoring each channel independently in the native basis. We examine trained Mamba-2 states and find that energy is almost rank-one, but the output does not read the energetic directions: energy concentrates in a bias-like direction accumulated by the recurrence, while the content the output reads lives in a low-dimensional subspace that is not aligned with the state's coordinates. Even output-aware scores are computed coordinate by coordinate, so they miss the directions that determine the input--output map. Compression should therefore target the write--read subspace rather than individual coordinates. We propose \method{}, a post-training transform that instantiates balanced truncation with full controllability and observability Gramians and applies the rotation exactly via Mamba-2's scalar-identity transition. Because the useful rank varies widely across layers, we further introduce HARP, which allocates ranks per layer from the Hankel spectrum and protects retrieval-sensitive layers, improving both perplexity and retrieval over uniform budgets. Calibration takes a single forward pass, an order of magnitude faster than GHOST's released protocol, with lower peak memory. With HARP, \method{} halves the state dimension at an average WikiText-2 perplexity increase of $0.3$ points ($1.8\%$) across 130M--2.7B, versus $1.6$ ($9.3\%$) for GHOST, and the gap widens at 25\% retention.

AI.tldr: 提出基于平衡截断的后训练状态压缩方法，通过旋转而非逐坐标量化来压缩 Mamba-2 的循环状态，并配合逐层秩分配策略 HARP。
AI.motivation: Mamba-2 将所有上下文压入固定大小的循环状态，该状态主导解码内存与带宽。现有方法逐通道独立打分（量化数值或剪枝坐标），但作者发现状态能量几乎呈秩一，且集中在偏置类方向上，而输出实际读取的信息位于与状态坐标不对齐的低维子空间，因此逐坐标打分无法捕捉决定输入-输出映射的方向。
AI.method: 将压缩目标从单坐标转向“写-读”子空间；提出一种后训练变换，用完整可控性与可观性 Gramian 实例化平衡截断，并借助 Mamba-2 的标量恒等转移精确施加旋转；进一步提出 HARP，依据 Hankel 谱为每层分配秩，并保护对检索敏感的层。校准仅需一次前向。
AI.result: 配 HARP 时，状态维度减半，WikiText-2 困惑度在 130M–2.7B 模型上平均仅升 0.3（1.8%），而 GHOST 为 1.6（9.3%）；在 25% 保留率下差距更大。校准比 GHOST 发布的协议快一个数量级，峰值内存更低，困惑度与检索指标均更优。
AI.conclusion: 压缩应针对写-读子空间而非单坐标；平衡截断式旋转加逐层秩分配能在显著降低状态维度的同时保持语言建模与检索性能，且校准成本低。

title: Vision-Language Agents Can Learn in Their Own Latent Worlds
summary: Learning from experience is essential for building the next generation of agents that continually expand their capabilities. Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) already internalize rich world knowledge, yet this knowledge is rarely leveraged to drive policy improvement through online interaction. Realizing this potential efficiently remains challenging, as policy updates shift the agent's interaction distribution, requiring the world model to adapt accordingly, while continually updating large pretrained models is computationally expensive. To address this challenge, we introduce Dwell, a model-based reinforcement learning (RL) framework that reframes a VLM as a recurrent latent transition operator, endowing it with the ability to predict, adjust, and act in latent space. Leveraging the VLM's own representations and its dual role as both world model and policy, the agent continually learns from real interactions to anticipate and evaluate action outcomes, and from latent imagination to improve its behavior. Across five interactive visual environments, Dwell achieves the strongest overall performance among trainable methods while substantially reducing the compute required for imagination, showing that effective world models for VLM agents need not reconstruct the future; they need to predict futures that are useful for action. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tom111-lhx/Dwell

AI.tldr: Dwell 提出一种基于模型的强化学习框架，将预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）视为循环潜在转移算子，使其在潜空间中预测、调整并行动，从而高效地利用 VLM 的世界知识驱动策略改进。
AI.motivation: 预训练 VLM 已内化丰富世界知识，但很少被用于通过在线交互驱动策略改进。直接在线更新大模型计算昂贵，且策略更新会改变交互分布，要求世界模型随之适应。
AI.method: 把 VLM 重构为循环潜在转移算子，复用其自身表征并让其同时充当世界模型与策略；智能体从真实交互中持续学习以预测和评估动作结果，并从潜空间想象中改进行为，避免重建未来观测。
AI.result: 在五个交互式视觉环境中，Dwell 在可训练方法中取得最强总体性能，同时大幅降低想象所需计算。
AI.conclusion: 有效的 VLM 智能体世界模型无需重建未来，只需预测对动作决策有用的未来。

title: RangeRectQuant: Compressing Scientific Fields for Every Future Rectangular Sum
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Code, data, core experiments and extended figures: https://github.com/Marchematics/RangeRectQuant
summary: Scientific rasters are often stored before the regions to be measured are known. Independent pixel-error bounds can force exact integer reconstruction when one absolute error budget covers every future rectangle. Coordinated changes allow every pixel to change while every rectangular sum remains accurate. A prefix sum accumulates values from the top-left corner. Four such sums determine any rectangular total. RangeRectQuant preserves the pixel range and designated exact samples while controlling errors in prefix sums. At each row position, we characterize exactly which errors let the remaining pixels meet these constraints. These errors form a single integer interval, even when many completions exist. A backward pass finds its endpoints; a forward pass uses them to choose quantized pixels. The resulting field meets the prescribed error budget for every axis-aligned rectangle, with linear work and workspace proportional to one row. Experiments on geographically held-out built-surface and water-occurrence maps show substantial storage savings over alternatives meeting the same requirements. Data producers encode once; later users measure arbitrary rectangles without the source, re-encoding, or query-specific correction.

AI.tldr: RangeRectQuant 提出一种针对方格科学栅格的量化方法：通过允许像素间协同误差，使任意轴对齐矩形的和保持精确，同时像素值落在规定范围并保留指定精确样本，仅用线性时间与单行工作空间。
AI.motivation: 科学栅格常在测量区域未知时就被存储，而独立像素误差界要求一个绝对误差预算覆盖所有未来矩形，往往迫使整数精确重建，存储开销大。目标是让每个像素都可变动、同时所有矩形求和仍准确。
AI.method: 利用前缀和——四个前缀和确定任意矩形总和。方法控制前缀和的误差：在每行位置精确刻画使剩余像素仍满足约束的误差集合，该集合为单一整数区间（即使存在多种完成方式）；用后向遍历求区间端点，前向遍历据此选择量化像素值。
AI.result: 所生成字段对每个轴对齐矩形都满足规定的误差预算，计算量为线性，工作空间仅一行；在地理上留出的建成区与水体出现地图实验中，相比满足同等要求的替代方法显著节省存储。
AI.conclusion: 数据生产者只需编码一次，后续用户无需原始数据、重新编码或按查询修正即可测量任意矩形，实现"一次编码、任意矩形测量"的免源查询。

title: Dream-COP: Guiding Algorithm Discovery for Combinatorial Optimization Problems in an Experience World
summary: Large language models (LLMs) enable algorithm discovery for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) through iterative program generation and evaluation. A central challenge is how to organize search to discover better algorithms within a limited budget. Our key insight is that past search trajectories and their recorded outcomes form an experience world, which can be used to facilitate the COP solving through replay. We introduce Dream-COP, in which a \emph{policy agent} learns executable policies through \emph{dreaming} in this experience world to guide a \emph{discovery agent} in generating and refining COP programs. Specifically, policy replay provides feedback on the quality of the programs revealed and the search steps used, to guide policy selection more effectively. Across five COPs, \textsc{Dream} discovers better algorithms than fixed exploration in both heuristic component design and complete solver generation. Particularly, it matches the optimal values on KP and reduces the gap on OBPP from 2.112\% to 1.199\% while using 42.5\% fewer search requests. Moreover, the learned exploration policies transfer effectively across different COPs with the assitance of the experience world.

AI.tldr: Dream-COP 通过"经验世界"中的策略回放（dreaming）来组织 LLM 的算法搜索，用策略代理引导发现代理生成/精炼组合优化程序。
AI.motivation: LLM 迭代生成-评估用于算法发现，核心难题是有限预算下如何组织搜索以找到更好算法。
AI.method: 把历史搜索轨迹及其结果记录构成"经验世界"，策略代理在该世界中 dreaming 学习可执行策略，回放反馈程序质量与所用搜索步数，从而更有效指导策略选择，并引导发现代理生成与改进 COP 程序。
AI.result: 在五类 COP 上，启发式组件设计与完整求解器生成均优于固定探索；KP 达到最优值，OBPP 差距由 2.112% 降至 1.199%，搜索请求减少 42.5%；学到的探索策略可跨 COP 迁移。
AI.conclusion: 将搜索历史作为可回放经验世界并用策略学习驱动搜索，是提升 LLM 算法发现效率与可迁移性的有效途径。

title: Do bots feel bad? Assessing empirical evidence for functional valence in LLMs
summary: Do LLMs have valenced states, i.e. states that feel pleasant or unpleasant? Recent empirical work has claimed to show that LLMs possess functional valenced states (e.g. ``functional pleasure and pain'' [Ren et al. 2026], ``functional emotions'' [Sofroniew et al. 2026], and ``functional welfare'' [Han et al. 2026]) that play the same causal role as valenced states in cognition and action, without necessarily being consciously experienced. But it remains unexplored how well the identified states fit the functional role of valence as understood in the philosophical and cognitive science literature. Here, I assess the current body of evidence, and argue (i) that key aspects of valence remain untested in LLMs, and (ii) that extant empirical paradigms inadequately distinguish (functional) valence from neighbouring constructs like preferences, value-judgments, valence attributions and role-play. I conclude by sketching some novel experimental approaches to better target (functional) valence itself.

AI.tldr: 该论文审视近期关于大语言模型具备"功能性效价状态"的实证工作，论证关键维度尚未被检验、现有范式无法有效区分功能性效价与偏好/价值判断/角色扮演等邻近概念，并提出新的实验路径。
AI.motivation: 近期多项研究声称LLM具有"功能性愉悦与痛苦""功能性情绪""功能性福祉"等效价状态，但尚无人评估这些被识别的状态是否真正符合哲学与认知科学中效价的功能角色。
AI.method: 概念分析与证据批判：系统梳理哲学与认知科学对效价的功能界定，逐一比对现有LLM实证证据，考察其范式能否排除替代解释。
AI.result: 发现两方面缺陷：(i) 效价的若干关键方面在LLM中仍未被测试；(ii) 现有实验范式不足以将功能性效价与偏好、价值判断、效价归因及角色扮演等相邻构念区分开来。
AI.conclusion: 现有证据不足以支持LLM具有功能性效价状态；作者提出若干新的实验设计，以更精确地靶向功能性效价本身。

title: AdaGround: Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming with Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement for GUI Grounding
summary: GUI grounding on high-resolution screens fails mostly on small targets, and zooming in is a common training-free remedy. However, most existing zooming pipelines do not match the zoom to the target's size, accept the zoomed answer unconditionally and never revisit a wrong answer. To address these issues, we propose AdaGround, a training-free framework with three components: (1) Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming, which sets the magnification, field of view and zoom depth of each sample from the model's own estimate of the target size; (2) Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement, which uses one marked-click Yes/No verifier to keep or reject each zoom, choose between zoom chains, trigger re-grounding and, with an existence query, decide when to abstain; and (3) Compositional Structure Grounding, which composes spreadsheet cells from their headers. On Qwen3-VL models, AdaGround surpasses state-of-the-art training-free zooming methods and many trained GUI models, improving accuracy over the backbone by 7.4 to 20.6 points on OSWorld-G and ScreenSpot-Pro, and its gains carry over to held-out UI-Vision. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/AdaGround

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架AdaGround，通过自适应缩放、验证器闭环与结构化grounding提升高分辨率GUI小目标定位精度。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率屏幕上的GUI grounding主要在小目标上失败，放大是常见免训练补救手段；但现有缩放流程不按目标尺寸匹配缩放倍率、无条件接受放大后的答案，且不会重新检视错误答案。
AI.method: 三个组件：(1) Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming，依据模型自身对目标尺寸的估计设定放大倍率、视野与缩放深度；(2) Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement，用单个标记点击的Yes/No验证器保留或拒绝每次缩放、在缩放链间选择、触发重新grounding，并通过存在性查询决定何时弃答；(3) Compositional Structure Grounding，由表头组合出电子表格单元格。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL上超过SOTA免训练缩放方法与诸多训练型GUI模型，在OSWorld-G与ScreenSpot-Pro上较骨干模型提升7.4–20.6个百分点，增益可迁移到留出的UI-Vision。
AI.conclusion: 自适应、可验证、可重试的缩放流程能显著改善小目标GUI grounding，且无需额外训练。

title: The Batch Size Can Be One: Test-Time Adaptation from Classifier Geometry
summary: Test-time adaptation updates a deployed model on an unlabeled test stream. In practice this stream often arrives one sample at a time, with the classes in no particular order. A single sample then provides limited information for estimating distribution-level statistics, and selecting samples by confidence can admit predictions that are wrong yet confident. A corruption, however, shifts the features while leaving the decision regions of the frozen classifier unchanged. We therefore propose Origin-recentered Test-Time Adaptation (OriTTA), which constructs fixed geometric targets from the source model and adapts selected features toward them. Seen from the origin of the feature space, the classes lean toward a common direction. We choose a new origin to bring class scores closer together while keeping it near the mean feature of one synthetic prototype per class. From this origin, prototype directions spread more evenly, and each class obtains an axis and an ideal point before any test data arrives. During adaptation, OriTTA aligns selected features with their predicted class axis and penalizes excessive radius, keeps one input per predicted class in memory to limit feature changes for classes absent from the stream, and resets the model when re-classifying this memory reveals collapse. Without tuning for each setting, OriTTA achieves the highest mean accuracy at batch size 1 on CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C and ImageNet-C in all sixteen combinations of four backbones, two protocols and two stream orders. On ImageNet-C fog, recent methods collapse in up to two thirds of one hundred runs, while OriTTA never does.

AI.tldr: 提出OriTTA：用源模型构造固定几何目标，将选中特征朝预测类别的"轴+理想点"对齐，实现批大小为1的在线测试时自适应。
AI.motivation: 现实中测试流常逐样本到达且类别无序，单样本难以估计分布级统计量；基于置信度选样可能纳入"自信但错误"的预测。而损坏只使特征偏移、不改动冻结分类器的决策区域，因此可在特征空间做几何约束。
AI.method: 从每类一个合成原型出发选取新原点（靠近各类均值特征的共同方向），使类别分数更接近、原型方向更均匀；测试前即给每类定出轴与理想点。自适应时将选中特征对齐到预测类轴并惩罚过大半径；内存中保留每个预测类的一个样本，限制未出现在流中的类别特征漂移；用该内存重分类检测到坍缩时重置模型。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C、ImageNet-C上，batch size=1时，四种骨干、两种协议、两种流顺序共16种组合中平均精度全部最高，且无需逐设置调参。ImageNet-C fog上近期方法在100次运行中最多有三分之二坍缩，OriTTA从未坍缩。
AI.conclusion: 以源模型固定的几何目标替代分布统计估计，可在单样本、无序流下稳定高效地完成测试时自适应，并有效防止坍缩。

title: Proactive Memory for Event-Driven LLM Agents
summary: Proactive LLM agents anticipate service opportunities from ongoing observations and accumulated history. Existing approaches emphasize recent context or retrieval of related memories, providing limited support for validating recurring behavioral regularities and assessing their applicability to the current event. We propose Proactive Memory (ProactMem), which organizes history into recent events, temporal trajectories, and behavioral regularities. Trajectory facts are checked against source events, and regularities are assessed through historical replay before being matched to current conditions. We also construct ProactiveStream, a longitudinal benchmark covering three application scopes, where agents process isolated event streams chronologically under episode-aware opportunity labels. On ProactiveStream, ProactMem achieves an overall effectiveness (F1) of 52.6%, a 21.4% relative improvement over the strongest of five external baselines. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ProactMem-5351/.

AI.tldr: ProactMem将历史组织为近期事件、时间轨迹与行为规律，并通过源事件校验与历史重放验证规律，在ProactiveStream基准上F1达52.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有主动式LLM代理偏重近期上下文或检索相关记忆，难以验证反复出现的行为规律是否适用于当前事件。
AI.method: 提出Proactive Memory（ProactMem），把历史分为近期事件、时间轨迹和行为规律三层；轨迹事实对照源事件核查，规律经历史重放评估后再与当前条件匹配；并构建ProactiveStream纵向基准（覆盖三类应用场景，代理按时间处理孤立事件流，采用情节感知的机会标签）。
AI.result: 在ProactiveStream上总体F1为52.6%，较五个外部基线中最强者相对提升21.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化的记忆组织与验证机制，ProactMem提升了代理预测服务机会的可靠性，并提供了纵向评测基准。

title: HoloRecon: Incremental Reconstruction of Long-Range Panoramas with Global Consistency
summary: Long-sequence panoramic reconstruction requires detailed scene geometry and globally consistent camera poses across distant revisits. Panoramic SLAM and incremental SfM rely on feature correspondences, but repeated, similar structures and small partial overlap make reliable long-range connections difficult to establish, leaving accumulated drift unresolved. Feed-forward models offer detailed local geometry, but their high computational costs limit inference window size, necessitating additional constraints for global consistency. This motivates combining continuous feature-based tracking and sparse mapping with rapid, high-quality local reconstruction from feed-forward models to achieve accurate localization and globally consistent dense mapping over long sequences. We therefore propose a panoramic reconstruction framework that couples an ORB-based sparse panoramic mapping frontend with a fine-tuned feed-forward model. Our key insight is that predicted local geometry enables 3D verification of feature matches across distant revisits, yielding long-range camera constraints even between regions. We calibrate predicted depths with sparse landmarks and use verified connections to optimize the global pose graph, updating dense geometry with the corrected camera poses. We also introduce PanoRecon, a seven-scene benchmark with repetitive architecture, large and small loops, and reference camera poses and LiDAR geometry for evaluating global consistency. Our method achieves the lowest mean absolute trajectory error and high F-1 Score among the evaluated methods. Project Page:https://zhuoxiaoli.github.io/HoloRecon_page/

AI.tldr: 提出HoloRecon全景重建框架，将ORB稀疏全景SLAM前端与微调的前馈模型耦合，利用预测局部几何对远距离重访的特征匹配做3D验证，构建长程相机约束并优化全局位姿图；同时发布PanoRecon七场景基准。
AI.motivation: 长序列全景重建需精细几何与全局一致位姿，但重复结构、相似纹理和小重叠使全景SLAM/增量SfM的远距离特征匹配不可靠，漂移无法消除；前馈模型局部几何精细却受算力限制窗口小，需要额外全局一致性约束。
AI.method: ORB稀疏全景建图前端 + 微调前馈模型（局部稠密重建）；用稀疏地标标定预测深度；基于预测几何对跨重访匹配做3D验证，生成长程相机约束；据此优化全局位姿图，再用校正位姿更新稠密几何。
AI.result: 在含重复建筑、大小回环的PanoRecon七场景基准上，方法取得最低平均绝对轨迹误差和较高F-1分数，并与LiDAR几何参考对比验证全局一致性。
AI.conclusion: 连续特征跟踪+稀疏建图与前馈局部重建互补，可同时实现准确长序列定位与全局一致稠密建图；3D验证是打通远距离回环约束的关键。

title: Deep Bayesian Approaches for Interpretable Nonlinear Structural System Identification
summary:
System identification, namely the inference of mathematical representations of dynamical systems from measured data, is fundamental to engineering diagnostics, prognostics, and decision-making. Bayesian filtering offers a principled framework for probabilistic state estimation but traditionally relies on prescribed transition and observation models. Recent advances in deep Bayesian filtering address this limitation by embedding learnable representations within probabilistic state-space formulations, enabling data-driven identification of unknown dynamics while retaining physical structure and uncertainty-aware inference.
  This tutorial provides a systematic introduction to deep Bayesian filtering for nonlinear structural system identification, focusing on the interplay between learned dynamics, physical inductive biases, and posterior inference. The Deep Markov Model serves as a data-driven reference, while the Physics-guided Deep Markov Model (PgDMM) and Neural Extended Kalman Filter (Neural EKF) illustrate complementary approaches based on amortized variational inference and differentiable Kalman filtering, respectively. Their capabilities are examined through dynamic state estimation and joint dynamic state and parameter estimation on a three-dimensional shear-frame benchmark with hysteretic Bouc-Wen connections and sparse acceleration measurements. The results highlight important distinctions between measurement-conditioned reconstruction and open-loop forecasting, demonstrate how physical structure can improve latent-state interpretability without necessarily ensuring predictive fidelity, and reveal differences in the robustness of response and parameter estimation. Practical guidelines for model construction, training, evaluation, and deployment are provided, together with an outlook on remaining challenges in uncertainty calibration, identifiability, and real-world validation.

AI.tldr: 该教程系统介绍面向非线性结构系统辨识的深度贝叶斯滤波，基于Deep Markov Model、物理引导DMM与神经EKF，在含Bouc-Wen滞回的三层剪切框架基准上比较状态与参数估计表现，并给出建模、训练、评估与部署的实用指南。
AI.motivation: 传统贝叶斯滤波依赖预先给定的状态转移与观测模型，难以处理未知非线性动力学；结构健康监测中的诊断、预测与决策又需要既能数据驱动辨识、又保留物理结构与不确定性推理的方法。
AI.method: 综述/教程性工作：以Deep Markov Model作为纯数据驱动参照，介绍基于摊销变分推断的Physics-guided Deep Markov Model和基于可微卡尔曼滤波的Neural Extended Kalman Filter，比较其学习动力学、物理归纳偏置与后验推断的结合方式。
AI.result: 在带滞回Bouc-Wen连接、加速度测点稀疏的三维剪切框架基准上开展动态状态估计及状态-参数联合估计；结果显示测量条件重建与开环预测存在显著差异，物理结构能提升潜状态可解释性但不必然保证预测精度，且两类方法在响应与参数估计鲁棒性上各有不同。
AI.conclusion: 提供了模型构建、训练、评估与部署的实践准则，并指出未来挑战在于不确定性校准、可辨识性与真实场景验证。

title: AutoVend: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Autonomous Vending Operations
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are extending agent-mediated commerce on the Web from shopping for consumers to operating businesses for sellers. In online-to-offline (O2O) commerce, decisions are issued through Web-based platforms but realized through costly physical execution. Evaluating such agents requires going beyond individual transactions to ask whether decisions made online turn into sustained economic returns. We introduce AutoVend, a benchmark in which one LLM agent manages 20 vending machines across five site types through a Web-based operating interface for 180 simulated days. Its data-grounded simulator combines a shared warehouse, procurement lead times, paid replenishment, inventory expiration, and recurring operating costs. We evaluate five LLM agents against a rule-based inventory-control baseline and diagnose their site coordination, execution, and performance over time. Four of five evaluated LLM agents fall short of this baseline, and returns per dollar of inference cost rank models differently from returns alone. Operational analyses show that gains in individual metrics do not consistently yield stronger economic growth, as inventory and execution costs erode these gains. Trajectory analysis further reveals difficulties in grounding feasible actions, managing inventory commitments, and converting feedback into effective policy revisions.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoVend基准：让LLM智能体通过Web界面在180天内管理5类场地的20台自动售货机，考察线上决策能否转化为持续经济回报；多数LLM智能体不及规则基线，且指标提升不一定带来经济增长。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体已从消费者购物扩展到为商家运营业务；O2O场景中线上决策需通过高昂的线下执行实现，评估此类智能体不能只看单笔交易，而要看是否产生持续经济回报。现有基准缺乏这种长程、含物流与成本的运营评估。
AI.method: 构建AutoVend基准与数据驱动模拟器：共享仓库、采购提前期、付费补货、库存过期与周期性运营成本；单智能体经Web操作界面管理20台售货机、5类场地、180个模拟日。将5个LLM智能体与规则化库存控制基线对比，分析其场地协调、执行及随时间表现。
AI.result: 5个LLM智能体中有4个低于规则基线；按"每美元推理成本回报"排名与仅按回报排名不同。运营分析显示单项指标提升不必然带来更强经济增长，因库存与执行成本会侵蚀收益；轨迹分析揭示智能体在落地可行动作、管理库存承诺、将反馈转化为有效策略修订方面存在困难。
AI.conclusion: 长程O2O运营评估对LLM智能体提出了超出单次交易的新要求；当前模型在经济回报、成本效率和反馈驱动策略改进上仍有明显不足，AutoVend为这类可持续运营能力提供了可诊断的评测平台。

title: PREEN: Exemplar-Based Color Style Transfer with Smartphone Editor Presets
summary: We present PREEN (Preset Regression via an Exemplar-based Editor Network), which casts color style transfer as regression onto the 29 parameters of a deterministic image editor. Given a content image and a style reference, PREEN predicts a preset, a vector of editor slider values that is interpretable and editor-consumable, not a raster image. The key obstacle is supervision, since an arbitrary real reference lacks a preset ground truth. We therefore supervise with a style-transfer teacher, whose target looks we invert into the editor's parameter space as pseudo-presets, then pretrain a CLIP-conditioned regressor and refine it with LoRA under an image-level CIELAB loss. On the human-curated PST50 benchmark, PREEN applies the reference's color while preserving structural fidelity, leading the baselines on pixel- and perceptual-fidelity metrics. The preset is compact and predicted at sub-second on-device latency. The low-dimensional subspace also exposes a single inference-time strength knob that traces a continuous default-to-vivid trajectory in one forward pass, with every intermediate state a valid editor preset. A two-axis human study shows that raters prefer the vivid end for matching the reference but the default as a standalone photo, a trade-off the knob spans without retraining.

AI.tldr: PREEN 将颜色风格迁移重新表述为“在确定性图像编辑器的29个参数上做回归”，输出可解释、编辑器可直接使用的预设向量而非栅格图像；用风格迁移教师反演伪预设做监督，经CLIP条件回归器+LoRA微调，在PST50上领先基线，且以单一强度旋钮实现连续可调。
AI.motivation: 现有颜色风格迁移通常直接输出栅格图像，结果不可解释、不可由编辑器复用，也难以让用户微调。作者希望输出一份紧凑的编辑器预设（滑块参数），既保留风格迁移效果，又具备可解释性、可编辑性和低延迟部署能力。核心难点在于缺少监督信号：任意真实参考图没有对应的预设真值。
AI.method: 1) 以确定性图像编辑器为载体，把迁移任务定义为对29个参数的回归；2) 用风格迁移教师生成目标外观，并将其反演到编辑器参数空间得到伪预设作为监督；3) 预训练一个以CLIP为条件的回归器，再用LoRA在图像级CIELAB损失下微调；4) 低维参数子空间天然提供单一推理时强度旋钮，一次前向即可输出从默认到鲜艳的连续轨迹。
AI.result: 在人工标注的PST50基准上，PREEN 能施加参考图色彩同时保持结构保真度，在像素级与感知保真度指标上均优于基线；预设紧凑，设备端推理延迟低于一秒；单一强度旋钮可在无需重训的情况下覆盖“匹配参考（偏鲜艳）”与“作为独立照片（默认）”的偏好权衡，两轴人类研究验证了这一点。
AI.conclusion: 将风格迁移建模为编辑器参数回归是一条可行且实用的路线：既获得可解释、可编辑、低延迟的预设输出，又通过低维子空间带来无需重训的连续可控性，在人评与客观指标上均表现出竞争力。

title: When Does Perturbation Consistency Add Information Beyond Softmax Confidence? Theory and Evidence for the Decision Consistency Framework
summary: Perturbation consistency scores judge whether a prediction survives small input changes. The Decision Consistency Framework (DCF) scores each image by label stability (LS) and confidence deviation (CD) under six mild operators, combines them into a consistency score (CS), and summarises a model by the gap between accuracy and mean consistency (CAG). We ask when these scores carry information that the clean softmax output lacks. Across 201 evaluations with three seeds per configuration, CS detected misclassifications on clean data less well than the maximum softmax probability (MSP) in every model family. For frozen CNNs, the deficit was 0.057 in area under the ROC curve (AUROC; 95% CI 0.043 to 0.073), at 8 to 15 times the compute. A label flip requires the logit margin to be at most the square root of two times the logit displacement, and at a fixed margin, the displacement predicted errors at AUROC 0.515. The same inequality gives a label-free split-conformal no-flip certificate, never violated in 84 runs. Consistency did add information where confidence is misled: under noise corruptions of CIFAR-10-C, it beat the margin, and under projected gradient attacks, it separated clean from attacked inputs with AUROC 0.83 against 0.37 for MSP at a budget of 2/255, as pre-specified. The gain under noise did not transfer to unseen shift families. The large negative CAG on OCTMNIST persists under full fine-tuning and in-domain training and is partly a class-prior effect: correcting the prior recovers about 40% of the gap.
