AI.tldr: 本文系统检验"扰动一致性分数"是否提供干净softmax输出之外的信息：在201组评估中，一致性分数(CS)检测误分类的能力在所有模型家族中都劣于MSP；但在噪声腐蚀和对抗攻击等置信度失效场景下，一致性确实提供额外信息，并给出一个无标签的保形"不翻转"证书。
AI.motivation: 扰动一致性框架（DCF）被广泛用来评估模型鲁棒性，但其分数是否携带干净softmax置信度（MSP）所缺乏的信息尚不清楚。作者希望明确这些一致性分数何时真正有信息、何时只是昂贵冗余。
AI.method: 提出DCF：对每张图用六个轻量算子计算标签稳定性(LS)和置信度偏差(CD)，合成一致性分数(CS)，并用准确率与平均一致性之差(CAG)刻画模型。进行三随机种子、201次评估的对照实验，比较CS与MSP的误分类检测AUROC；理论分析标签翻转所需的logit margin条件，并据此构造无标签split-conformal不翻转证书；在CIFAR-10-C噪声腐蚀、PGD攻击和OCTMNIST先验偏移下测试。
AI.result: 所有模型家族中CS检测误分类均劣于MSP；冻结CNN上AUROC差距0.057（95%CI 0.043–0.073），而算力高8–15倍。固定margin下位移预测错误的AUROC仅0.515。保形不翻转证书在84次运行中无一被违反。噪声腐蚀下CS胜过margin，PGD（2/255预算）下CS分离干净/攻击输入AUROC 0.83，MSP仅0.37；但噪声增益不能迁移到未见偏移族。OCTMNIST上大幅负CAG在全微调与域内训练下仍存在，校正类别先验可恢复约40%的差距。
AI.conclusion: 一致性分数不是干净置信度的替代品，也不是通用鲁棒性指标；其价值集中在置信度被误导的场景（噪声、对抗输入）。理论分析揭示了分数失效的机制，CAG中的部分差异是类别先验伪影。使用DCF应限定在明确的信息增益场景，并警惕高算力与偏移不迁移问题。

title: Dense Representation Learning and Differentiable Shape Modeling for Spine Landmark Detection
summary: Spine landmark detection from spinal X-ray is a key step for estimating spine deformation severity, for building biomechanical models, and for pre-operative planning. We reframe anatomical landmark detection as a pixel-level contrastive representation learning problem, matching dense pixel embeddings with landmark prototypes. Surprisingly, even with a generic U-Net backbone, this formulation results in more discriminative heatmaps compared to the traditional heatmap regression paradigm, leading to improved discrimination between vertebral corners on distinct vertebra. Furthermore, we combine the resulting heatmaps with learnable shape priors over the global configuration of spinal landmarks to resolve ambiguities in landmark locations, yielding a simple and practical approach to spinal landmark detection. Our approach is competitive, in terms of landmark accuracy and clinical parameter estimation, with the state-of-the-art on the public AASCE dataset and on two private spinal X-ray datasets. Our code and pre-trained weights are available at https://github.com/BioMedTP/Pix2Point.

AI.tldr: 该论文将脊柱X射线解剖标志点检测重构为像素级对比表示学习问题，用稠密像素嵌入与标志点原型匹配，并结合可学习全局形状先验消除歧义，在公开AASCE及两个私有数据集上取得有竞争力结果。
AI.motivation: 脊柱X射线标志点检测是估计脊柱变形严重程度、构建生物力学模型和术前规划的关键步骤。传统热图回归范式难以区分不同椎体上的椎角等相近标志点，存在定位歧义。
AI.method: 把解剖标志点检测视为像素级对比表示学习：将稠密像素嵌入与标志点原型进行匹配，生成更具判别性的热图（即使使用通用U-Net骨干）；再将热图与可学习的全局脊柱标志点构型形状先验结合，以消解标志点位置歧义，形成简单实用的检测流程。
AI.result: 与热图回归相比产生更具判别性的热图，更好区分不同椎体上的椎角；在公开AASCE数据集和两个私有脊柱X射线数据集上，标志点精度与临床参数估计均达到与SOTA相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: 像素级对比表示学习加形状先验是一种简单、实用且有竞争力的脊柱标志点检测方案，代码与预训练权重已开源（Pix2Point）。

title: When Is a Cheap Fairness Edit Safe? Screening Post-Hoc Edits in Two-Sided Matching Markets
summary: Two-sided matching systems, such as admissions pipelines, allocate opportunities jointly. Reducing a protected at tribute's influence usually requires encoder retraining. We study a closed-form linear projector that does this at inference time. For markets that stay vertically ordered before and after the edit, we bound the mean welfare change by the edit-induced appeal shift and an explicit remainder. A probabilistic refinement replaces worst-case constants with a data-dependent deviation term. A pre-deployment screen combines a verticality test with a welfare sweep and returns PASS, KILL, or OUT-OF-SCOPE. An exact tier requires every opportunity to rank applicants by appeal, and a graded tier admits near-vertical markets. On 30 held-out synthetic markets, the screen agrees with every pre-specified regime verdict, with no observed false PASS. On 60 exactly vertical markets, no bound is violated, and the probabilistic bound is informative in 69% to 87% of configurations. On 2700 configurations from three realistic markets, which do not reach the exact tier, no plug-in bound expression is violated. A closed-form factorization stays within graded scope in 90% to 100% of instances, whereas two-tower and graph neural network encoders fall outside it in every instance. Architecture choice thus appears to affect whether a post-hoc edit is admissible.

AI.tldr: 论文研究一种在推理阶段可用的闭式线性投影器，用于降低双边匹配市场中受保护属性的影响而无需重训编码器，并给出福利变化界及部署前筛查机制。
AI.motivation: 双边匹配系统（如招生）联合分配机会；减少受保护属性的影响通常需要重训编码器，成本高且不可行，因此希望在推理时以闭式方法完成编辑。
AI.method: 提出闭式线性投影器，在推理时编辑匹配偏好；对编辑前后保持垂直序的市场，用编辑导致的吸引力偏移加显式余项来界定平均福利变化；给出概率化改进（数据依赖偏差项）；设计部署前筛查：垂性检验＋福利扫描，输出PASS/KILL/OUT-OF-SCOPE；划分精确层（所有机会按吸引力排序申请人）与分级层（允许近似垂直市场）。
AI.result: 30个留出合成市场上筛查与预设判定全部一致，未观察到错误PASS；60个精确垂直市场上无界被违反，概率界在69%–87%配置下有信息量；三个真实市场2700个配置（未达精确层）无插件界表达式被违反；闭式分解在90%–100%实例中处于分级范围，而two-tower与图神经网络编码器全部落在范围外。
AI.conclusion: 架构选择影响事后编辑是否可接受；闭式分解式编码器适配该编辑框架，而two-tower与GNN编码器不适配，为部署前安全筛查提供了可操作判据。

title: Guided-RLVR: Guided Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong empirical gains in improving the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) on tasks such as mathematics and programming. However, recent studies have shown that RLVR rollouts often collapse onto a narrow set of reasoning trajectories, limiting the explored reasoning space. Motivated by findings that thinking tokens at critical steps serve as critical structural elements in LLM reasoning pathways, we propose Guided-RLVR, a novel approach that augments RLVR with a lightweight controller. The controller strategically injects semantically meaningful steering tokens into the sampling distribution, encouraging the model to approach problems from multiple reasoning perspectives and thereby expanding the exploration space. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Guided-RLVR consistently outperforms existing RLVR methods while producing more diverse reasoning trajectories.

AI.tldr: Guided-RLVR通过轻量控制器在采样中注入语义引导token，拓展RLVR的推理探索空间，在数学与代码任务上优于现有方法且轨迹更多样。
AI.motivation: RLVR虽在数学、编程等推理任务上带来显著提升，但其rollout常坍缩到少数推理轨迹，限制了探索的推理空间。
AI.method: 受"关键步骤的thinking token是推理路径关键结构元素"这一发现启发，提出Guided-RLVR：在RLVR基础上增加一个轻量控制器，向采样分布中策略性地注入语义有意义的引导token，促使模型从多推理视角解题。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码生成基准上，Guided-RLVR一致优于现有RLVR方法，并产生更多样的推理轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 通过引导token注入可有效缓解RLVR探索坍缩问题，在保持性能提升的同时增强推理多样性。

title: Mining the Nineteenth Century for the Thirteenth: Register-Scale Forced Alignment and HTR Bootstrapping via Legacy Regesta and Antiquarian Editions
summary: Handwritten text recognition (HTR) for the registers of Pope Honorius III depends on modern expert transcriptions, which exist only for regnal years 1-2 of Reg. Vat. 9. For the remaining registers, nineteenth-century scholarship offers Pressutti's regesta and partial editions. On fol. 1-203, where both layers exist, we measure what this legacy layer can contribute, on transcriptions that we first audit against it, and find a division of labor across three tiers. At the orthographic tier, raw editions are at best neutral for adapting a recognizer to the second regnal year and harmful without replay, whereas projection onto curial spelling with replay of modern source lines turns them into zero-label adaptation targets: pooled over all 134 year-2 sides, the WER falls by 1.50 points (95% CI -1.84 to -1.15), closing 33% of the gap to an oracle; the spelling changes at the year split, through the scribe or the transcriber, whereas the hand changes visibly only at fol. 191r. At the lexical tier, the corpus-wide legacy lexicon contains 82.2% of the out-of-vocabulary words of unedited entries and flags recognition errors with 66.7% precision, and labels from pre-trained medieval NER models, distilled into the recognizer's NER head, reach F1 82.1% on an expert validated benchmark, level with the best tagger applied after recognition. At the topological tier, Pressutti's regests, the closing datum clauses, and the regests' dates converted to the chancery's Roman form find 73.9% of entry starts in the recognized line stream, and edition agreement estimates a CER of 7.80% beyond fol. 203. Antiquarian scholarship thus cannot replace modern transcription, but it can steer, check, and segment HTR across the untranscribed registers.

AI.tldr: 本文评估十九世纪Pressutti文献等"旧学术层"对教宗Honorius III登记册手写文本识别（HTR）的价值，发现其可在正字、词汇、拓扑三个层级分别用于适配识别器、检错与标注、切分和估计CER，但无法替代现代专家转录。
AI.motivation: Honorius III登记册仅Reg. Vat. 9的第1-2年有现代专家转录，其余册仅有Pressutti regesta与部分旧版校勘；作者希望量化这一"遗留层"能否在未转录部分辅助HTR。
AI.method: 在fol. 1-203双层数据上，先审计现代转录，再分三层实验：(1)正字层——用投影到教廷拼写并replay现代行文本的旧版数据作零标签适配，比较WER与oracle差距；(2)词汇层——检验全语料遗留词典对未编辑条目OOV词的覆盖率与错误检测精度，并把中世纪NER模型蒸馏进识别器NER头；(3)拓扑层——用regesta、结尾日期条款及罗马数字日期定位条目起止，并据版本一致性估计CER。
AI.result: 正字层：134个第2年页面上WER下降1.50点（95% CI −1.84至−1.15），弥合33%的oracle差距；拼写变化出现在年份交界，而书写风格仅在fol. 191r可见改变。词汇层：遗留词典覆盖未编辑条目OOV词82.2%，错误检测精度66.7%；蒸馏NER头F1达82.1%，与最佳后处理标注器持平。拓扑层：条目起始定位率73.9%，估计fol. 203之后CER为7.80%。
AI.conclusion: 旧学术资料不能替代现代转录，但可对未转录登记册的HTR起到引导、校验与切分作用，形成三层协作分工。

title: TACO-Graph: Automated Construction of Text-Atributed Graphs
summary: Graph-structured representations of text data have become foundational across machine learning, yet it remains unclear how to systematically construct a graph from a given dataset for a target task. Choices about which entities become nodes, which relationships become edges, and what text each node contains can substantially affect downstream performance. In practice, finding optimal constructions often requires expert knowledge or manual trial and error. We introduce TACO-Graph, a decision tree framework for learning which graph construction choices are most effective for a given dataset and task. Specifically, we focus on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) constructed from multi-attribute tabular data. TACO-Graph enumerates valid TAG representations, scores each using fast proxy evaluation on small representative subsets, and trains an interpretable decision tree on those scores. Across five datasets spanning citation networks, product reviews, and bibliographic relationships, our decision trees predict construction quality on separately drawn evaluation samples with mean Spearman $ρ$ above $0.9$ for node classification and above $0.8$ for GraphRAG retrieval. Our trees systematically identify which constructions perform better across both GNN and GraphRAG tasks, and the full pipeline is released as an open-source library to support evaluation on new tasks and datasets at https://github.com/AmiriHayes/text_attributed_graphs. TACO-Graph provides a systematic and interpretable guide for determining how to convert tabular data to text-attributed graphs for downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: TACO-Graph 提出用决策树方法系统学习"如何把表格数据构造成文本属性图"，通过枚举构图方案+小样本代理评估+可解释决策树，高效识别最优构图选择。
AI.motivation: 图结构文本表示在机器学习中很常用，但如何从给定数据集构造图（哪些实体作节点、哪些关系作边、节点含哪些文本）缺乏系统方法，通常依赖专家知识或反复试错，且不同构造选择显著影响下游性能。
AI.method: 聚焦多属性表格数据构造的文本属性图（TAG）。TACO-Graph 首先枚举所有合法 TAG 表示，对每种表示在小型代表性子集上用快速代理评估打分，再基于这些分数训练可解释决策树，学习哪些构造选择对特定数据集与任务更有效。
AI.result: 在引文网络、商品评论、文献关系等五个数据集上，决策树在独立抽样上预测构图质量的 Spearman ρ 均值：节点分类 >0.9，GraphRAG 检索 >0.8；并能系统识别在 GNN 与 GraphRAG 任务中表现更好的构造方式。全流程已开源。
AI.conclusion: TACO-Graph 为将表格数据转化为文本属性图提供系统且可解释的指导，减少专家依赖与试错成本，并开源支持新任务/数据集上的评估。

title: AI-Assisted Discovery of CNOT Decompositions for Quantum Permutations on Constrained Topologies
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, To appear in AIQxQIA 2026
summary: Efficient quantum circuit compilation is challenging for quantum computers, where limited qubit connectivity can introduce substantial overhead in the implementation of logical operations. Recent AI-assisted synthesis methods have shown considerable potential for reducing circuit complexity, but their role in uncovering principles that can guide the design of new deterministic compilation algorithms remains largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate this perspective for the synthesis of quantum permutations into CNOT circuits under constrained qubit connectivity. Using AlphaCNOT as an exploratory tool, we identify a recurring decomposition for remote transpositions that improves on the construction based on adjacent SWAP routing. For two qubits at graph distance $d>1$, the discovered pattern yields a topology-legal implementation using at most $6d-4$ CNOT gates, compared to the $6d-3$ gates required by the corresponding SWAP-based construction. We formalize this observation through a constructive proof to define Global Transpositions, a deterministic synthesis method that searches for a minimum-cost decomposition of an entire permutation into topology-aware logical transpositions. The resulting method subsumes optimal SWAP routing within its synthesis model and provides certified upper bounds on the topology-constrained CNOT cost. Our experiments also reveal circuits that cannot be expressed as concatenations of independently synthesized transpositions. Instead, these circuits exploit intermediate linear transformations that temporarily leave the permutation subgroup and combine partial effects of multiple logical operations, a mechanism we call intermediate CNOT fusion. Our results show that AI-assisted synthesis can support not only circuit optimization, but also the discovery of reusable identities, provable constructions, and hidden mechanisms in quantum circuit compilation.

AI.tldr: 本文以 AlphaCNOT 为探索工具，研究受限量子比特连通性下量子置换到 CNOT 电路的合成，发现远程换位（transposition）的可复用分解模式（至多 6d-4 个 CNOT，优于 SWAP 路由的 6d-3），并将其形式化为确定性方法 Global Transpositions，同时揭示"中间 CNOT 融合"机制。
AI.motivation: 量子比特连通性受限导致逻辑操作编译开销大。AI 辅助合成虽能降低电路复杂度，但其在"揭示可指导设计新确定性编译算法的原理"方面的作用尚未被充分探索。作者希望在受限连通性下合成 CNOT 置换这一场景中填补这一空白。
AI.method: 以 AlphaCNOT 作为探索工具，观察远程换位的反复出现的分解模式；通过构造性证明将其形式化，提出 Global Transpositions 这一确定性合成方法——将整个置换分解为拓扑感知的逻辑换位并搜索最小代价分解，其合成模型涵盖最优 SWAP 路由。
AI.result: 对图距离 d>1 的两量子比特，发现模式给出拓扑合法的实现，至多 6d-4 个 CNOT 门，而基于相邻 SWAP 路由的构造需 6d-3 个；Global Transpositions 提供拓扑约束下 CNOT 代价的经认证上界。实验还发现存在无法表示为独立合成换位之串联的电路，它们利用暂时离开置换子群的中间线性变换，即"中间 CNOT 融合"。
AI.conclusion: AI 辅助合成不仅能优化电路，还能帮助发现可复用恒等式、可证明的构造以及量子电路编译中的隐藏机制；Global Transpositions 为确定性编译提供了有理论保证的构造与上界。

title: Explicit Regional Representations For Video Quality Assessment
comment: Preprint. This work is an initial version and may be updated in future revisions
summary: End-to-end video quality assessment (VQA) methods leave the regional evidence underlying their predictions largely implicit. We introduce an explicit pixel-level regional representation for VQA, instantiated as a Quality-Relevance Heatmap (QRH) that combines localized degradation evidence with perceptual priors under vision-language model guidance, without requiring pixel-level annotations. We apply QRH to existing VQA models through two deterministic fragment-sampling strategies: distribution-preserving sampling approximates the original sampler's QRH-score distribution without retraining, while quality-aware sampling prioritizes regions with high QRH scores and is paired with fine-tuning. Experiments with DOVER on multiple benchmarks show that the former closely approximates predictions averaged over random samples, while the latter improves most evaluated metrics across popular VQA benchmarks. These results support explicit regional representations as a useful interface for downstream VQA.

AI.tldr: 提出像素级区域表示QRH（质量-相关热图），无像素级标注即可为VQA提供显式区域证据，并通过两种确定性片段采样策略应用于现有VQA模型。
AI.motivation: 端到端VQA方法的区域证据是隐式的，缺乏可解释性与可用的区域表示接口。
AI.method: 在视觉-语言模型引导下，将局部退化证据与感知先验结合，构建无像素标注的Quality-Relevance Heatmap（QRH）；设计两种确定性片段采样策略：分布保持采样（无需重训练，近似原采样器QRH分数分布）与质量感知采样（优先高QRH区域，配合微调）。
AI.result: 以DOVER在多个基准上实验：分布保持采样可紧密近似随机采样的平均预测；质量感知采样在多数主流VQA基准指标上取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式区域表示可作为下游VQA的有效接口。

title: Log-Derivative Trick for Parametric Markov Chains
summary:
Optimizing expected rewards and reachability probabilities in parametric Markov chains (pMCs) is central to the analysis and synthesis of probabilistic systems with loops. While traditional symbolic synthesis approaches--such as parameter lifting and rational function generation--suffer from scalability bottlenecks, gradient-based optimization emerges as an effective alternative. However, existing gradient-based techniques still rely on symbolic gradient computation--such as solving large linear systems--over the global state space, inheriting scalability limits. Finite-horizon approximation is possible but introduces uncontrollable bias.
  In this paper, we introduce a scalable Monte Carlo gradient estimator based on a measure-theoretic generalization of the log-derivative trick. We prove that our estimator provides unbiased gradient estimates under almost-sure termination and standard regularity conditions. Crucially, our method avoids global state-space materialization and linear system solving entirely: it operates purely along sampled trajectories, requiring only black-box evaluations of local transition probabilities (or densities) and their derivatives. Unlike existing pMC techniques that are fundamentally restricted to finite discrete systems, our measure-theoretic framework naturally extends to continuous and general $σ$-finite state spaces. Empirical evaluations on synthetic discrete pMCs and continuous-state case studies demonstrate that our method scales to state spaces far beyond the reach of existing solvers, significantly reducing execution time without introducing bias.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于测度论对数导数技巧的蒙特卡洛梯度估计器，无需物化全局状态空间或解线性系统，即可无偏地优化参数化马尔可夫链的期望奖励与可达概率，并可扩展到连续状态空间。
AI.motivation: 参数化马尔可夫链（pMC）中期望奖励与可达概率的优化是概率系统分析与合成的核心，但参数提升、有理函数生成等符号方法可扩展性差；现有梯度方法仍需在全局状态空间上做符号梯度计算（如求解大型线性系统），同样受限于规模；有限时域近似又会引入不可控偏差。
AI.method: 提出一种可扩展的蒙特卡洛梯度估计器，基于对数导数技巧的测度论推广；在几乎必然终止与标准正则条件下证明其梯度估计无偏；方法完全沿采样轨迹运行，仅需对局部转移概率（或密度）及其导数做黑盒求值，避免全局状态空间物化与线性系统求解；测度论框架可自然推广到连续及一般σ-有限状态空间。
AI.result: 在合成离散pMC和连续状态案例上，方法可扩展到远超现有求解器能力的状态空间，显著降低执行时间且不引入偏差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将梯度优化从有限离散pMC推广到连续/一般σ-有限状态空间，提供无偏、仅需轨迹采样的可扩展优化途径，为大规模概率系统合成提供了新方向。

title: Correctness Conditioning as Selection in Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness Evaluation
summary: Restricting chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness evaluation to correctly answered instances changes the population being measured. We study this selection step in a seven-variable structural causal model and derive the exact observed gap $Δ= \operatorname{Cov}(A, C)/P(C=1)$. The model distinguishes difficulty confounding from shortcut-induced collider bias and states the conditional-independence assumption needed to express the gap through latent response propensities. A protocol review of 18 papers distinguishes answer-correctness restrictions from agreement-based selection, benchmark construction, and training-data filtering. We evaluate four sub-ceiling deployments on arithmetic tasks and observe positive selection gaps in all four. The primary GLM-5.3 run yields a +7.4 percentage-point gap ($n = 1000$, $p < 0.0001$), and pooled Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel analysis gives OR = 1.70 ($p < 10^{-6}$). An assumption-free covariance decomposition assigns 42.8% of the GLM-5.3 gap to between-stratum variation in interventionable-operation count, leaving the majority unattributed. When counterfactual compliance is observable for every instance, evaluating all traces directly estimates population faithfulness without correctness filtering.

AI.tldr: 论文研究CoT忠实性评估中"仅保留答对样本"这一选择步骤的因果偏倚，用七变量结构因果模型推导出选择间隙Δ=Cov(A,C)/P(C=1)，并在实验中观察到四个部署均存在正向选择间隙，同时给出无需正确性筛选的直接估计方案。
AI.motivation: 将CoT忠实性评估限制在答对实例上，会改变被度量的总体，使评估结果不再是总体忠实性；需要厘清该选择步骤带来的偏倚来源与大小。
AI.method: 构建七变量结构因果模型，区分难度混杂与捷径引发的对撞偏倚，给出用潜在响应倾向表达间隙所需的条件独立假设；推导精确间隙公式Δ=Cov(A,C)/P(C=1)；综述18篇论文的评估协议以区分正确性限制与基于一致性选择、基准构建、训练数据过滤等方法；在算术任务上评估四个亚上限部署，采用GLM-5.3主实验（n=1000）、合并Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel分析，以及无假设协方差分解。
AI.result: 四个部署均出现正向选择间隙；GLM-5.3主实验间隙为+7.4个百分点（n=1000, p<0.0001），合并CMH分析OR=1.70（p<10^-6）；无假设协方差分解显示42.8%的间隙可归因于可干预操作数量在层间的变异，多数间隙仍未归因。
AI.conclusion: 正确性筛选会系统性地改变忠实性度量，产生正向选择间隙且难以完全解释；当对每个实例都能观察到反事实合规性时，应直接评估所有轨迹以估计总体忠实性，而无需正确性过滤。

title: LearnPrunerV2: Learnable Progressive Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable multimodal capabilities but suffer from prohibitive computational overhead due to the massive number of visual tokens. While token pruning is a promising solution, existing methods still suffer from two major drawbacks: 1) unreliable pruning criteria that fail to accurately localize task-specific regions due to inherent attention biases or query-agnostic designs, and 2) suboptimal pruning strategies that employ rigid, non-adaptive schedules, overlooking the dynamic evolution of token redundancy across different model depths. To address these challenges, we propose LearnPrunerV2, which extends the previous two-stage heuristic framework (LearnPruner) into a fully learnable architecture. Specifically, we integrate lightweight learnable modules into every layer of the VLM backbone, which estimate token importance by fusing intrinsic visual saliency with extrinsic query relevance captured via a shadow token. By uncovering a consistent staircase redundancy pattern across VLM layers, we further introduce Budget-Deterministic Pruning (BDP) to establish a hardware-friendly schedule with fixed per-layer budgets. Extensive experimental results across various benchmarks and VLMs demonstrate that LearnPrunerV2 consistently outperform previous state-of-the-art methods. Notably, LearnPrunerV2 preserves 99.8% of the original performance when pruning 77.8% of visual tokens on LLaVA-v1.5, achieving a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出完全可学习的视觉token剪枝架构LearnPrunerV2，结合内在视觉显著性与查询相关性评估token重要性，并用固定每层预算的BDP调度，在LLaVA-v1.5上剪掉77.8%视觉token仍保留99.8%性能。
AI.motivation: VLM因视觉token数量庞大导致计算开销过高；现有剪枝方法存在两大缺陷：(1) 剪枝准则不可靠，受注意力偏置或与查询无关设计影响，无法准确定位任务相关区域；(2) 剪枝策略僵化非自适应，忽略token冗余随模型深度动态变化。
AI.method: 将前作LearnPruner的两阶段启发式框架扩展为完全可学习架构：在VLM骨干每一层嵌入轻量可学习模块，融合内在视觉显著性与通过shadow token捕获的外在查询相关性来估计token重要性；并发现跨层一致的"阶梯式冗余模式"，据此提出预算确定剪枝(BDP)构建每层固定预算的硬件友好调度。
AI.result: 在多种基准和VLM上持续超越先前SOTA；在LLaVA-v1.5上剪除77.8%视觉token时仍保留99.8%原始性能，实现更优的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 全可学习的重要性估计加固定预算的层级调度能有效解决剪枝准则不可靠与调度僵化问题，在极高剪枝率下保持近乎无损性能，具备实用价值。

title: HeteGCD: Statistics-Aware Dual-Prototype Learning for Generalized Category Discovery on Heterophilous Graphs
summary: Heterophilous graphs are prevalent in real-world applications, where connected nodes often exhibit dissimilar attributes or belong to different classes, posing significant challenges to conventional graph learning methods based on homophily. This limitation becomes particularly pronounced in generalized category discovery (GCD), which requires models to recognize known classes and discover novel ones using labels from known classes only. However, existing graph GCD methods typically rely on aforementioned homophily-based inductive biases, which are ill-suited to heterophilous graphs. Meanwhile, although current heterophilous graph learning methods exploit diverse neighborhood signals, their selection and fusion are often guided by supervision across all classes, including novel classes whose labels are unavailable in GCD. These limitations raise a key question: how can heterogeneous neighborhood information be effectively leveraged for category discovery without any novel-class supervision? To answer this question, in this study we propose HeteGCD, a new statistics-aware dual-prototype learning perspective for generalized category discovery on heterophilous graphs. The key idea is to examine both statistics of local attribute differences and neighborhood class distribution to extract discriminative information in feature and probability spaces simultaneously. Specifically, a gated dual-stream encoder integrates both node attributes and local attribute-difference statistics to learn informative node representations. Afterwards, a dual-prototype classifier combines feature-based similarity with distribution-based consistency to support category discovery. Experiments on five heterophilous graphs show that HeteGCD achieves competitive performance against 24 baseline combinations.

AI.tldr: 提出 HeteGCD，从统计感知的双原型学习视角，在异质图上进行广义类别发现（GCD），无需新类监督即可利用异构邻域信息。
AI.motivation: 真实图常为异质图（相连节点属性/类别不同），而现有图 GCD 方法依赖同质性归纳偏置，不适配异质图；现有异质图方法又依赖包含新类的全类监督来筛选融合邻域信号，而 GCD 中新类标签不可用。因此关键问题是如何在无新类监督下有效利用异构邻域信息做类别发现。
AI.method: HeteGCD：①同时考察局部属性差异统计与邻域类别分布，在特征空间和概率空间提取判别信息；②门控双流编码器融合节点属性与局部属性差异统计学习节点表示；③双原型分类器结合基于特征的相似性与基于分布的一致性来支持类别发现。
AI.result: 在五个异质图数据集上，与 24 种基线组合相比，HeteGCD 取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 统计感知的双空间（特征+概率）双原型学习可绕开新类监督，为异质图上的广义类别发现提供有效方案。

title: OpenGray: a benchmark for evaluating the decisions of radiotherapy planning agents
comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 1 table, and the supplementary material (19 tables, 5 figures). Ancillary files: the paper in Markdown, structured results with the sentence each comes from, and an llms.txt index for AI agents
summary: Background and purpose: Radiotherapy planning agents based on large language models (LLMs) decide when to submit a plan or request review but are evaluated mainly by dose. This study developed OpenGray, a benchmark of planning tasks with known correct decisions. Materials and methods: OpenGray adds tasks with known answers to the OpenKBP-Opt head-and-neck dataset, including two contradictions with dose goals proven incompatible and a feasible control with a stored plan meeting every hard goal. Four systems, from a rule-based planning script to a full LLM agent, were evaluated on 30 patients, the LLM-based ones with a commercial (Terra) and a local (Ministral 3 8B) LLM. Decisions, achieved dose, problem recognition, and technical failures were recorded and also read from logs of 39 stereotactic radiosurgery runs of SAGE, a clinical LLM agent. Results: With Terra, the script preceded by an LLM review and the full agent had decision accuracies of 95.4% and 92.1%, respectively, yet escalated only 50% (95% confidence interval, 25-75%) and 25% (10-40%) of overlap contradictions, which required arithmetic on the anatomy. All four systems submitted every feasible control, but 24% of these plans missed a hard goal that the stored plan had met. In four SAGE runs, one goal failed at every attempt; the agent identified it in every reply but had no action for stopping. Conclusions: Favorable aggregate scores concealed specific decision failures. Planning agents should be evaluated on their decisions as well as their dose and given an explicit action for stopping and requesting review.

AI.tldr: OpenGray基准显示，基于LLM的放疗计划智能体总体决策准确率虽高（92–95%），但在需要解剖算术的重叠矛盾上升级召回率低（25–50%），且24%的可行对照计划漏掉硬约束；应同时评估决策与剂量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的放疗计划智能体主要按剂量评估，缺乏对"何时提交/何时请求复核"这类决策正确性的检验，导致聚合分数掩盖具体决策失败。
AI.method: 在OpenKBP-Opt头颈数据集上构建OpenGray基准，加入有已知答案的任务：两个已证明剂量目标不可兼容的矛盾任务，以及一个存储计划满足全部硬目标的可行对照；在30例患者上评估从规则脚本到完整LLM智能体共四套系统（LLM分别用商用Terra与本地Ministral 3 8B），记录决策、实际剂量、问题识别与技术故障，并解析39次SAGE立体定向放疗运行日志。
AI.result: Terra配置下，"LLM复核+脚本"与完整智能体决策准确率分别为95.4%和92.1%，但对重叠矛盾的升级率仅50%（95%CI 25–75%）和25%（10–40%）；四套系统均提交了全部可行对照，但其中24%的计划未达到存储计划已满足的硬目标；SAGE四次运行中某目标每次均失败，智能体每次都识别出问题却无停止动作。
AI.conclusion: 良好的聚合分数掩盖了特定的决策失败；计划智能体应按决策与剂量双重评估，并为其提供明确的停止和请求复核动作。

title: GPA-VGGT: Geometry-Preserving Acceleration of VGGT
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Project page: https://noheat61.github.io/GPA-VGGT/
summary: Feed-forward geometry models such as VGGT recover camera parameters, depth maps, and point maps from one to hundreds of views in a single forward pass, making them powerful backbones for multi-view 3D perception. However, VGGT's global attention is quadratic in the number of frames and dominates end-to-end runtime on long sequences, which has motivated a range of training-free efficiency methods such as token merging. These methods, however, come with a drop in accuracy that makes them hard to use in place of VGGT. We propose GPA-VGGT, a training-free acceleration method that replaces global attention in early blocks with frame attention augmented by a shared cross-frame K/V set. In the remaining blocks, we merge only keys and values while preserving all queries, restore the attention mass of the tokens each merged key represents, and randomly project the matching metric to 128 dimensions to reduce matching cost. Across diverse multi-view geometry tasks, GPA-VGGT provides training-free acceleration at speedups comparable to prior work while preserving the information required for precise geometric estimation, retaining over 99% of VGGT's pose accuracy under AUC@3.

AI.tldr: GPA-VGGT 是一种无需训练的加速方法，通过用帧内注意力加共享跨帧 K/V 替换早期块中的全局注意力，并在后续块中仅合并 K/V、保留全部 query，从而在保持高精度的情况下加速多视角几何模型。
AI.motivation: VGGT 等前馈几何模型的全局注意力复杂度随帧数呈二次增长，在长序列上主导端到端运行时间。现有的 token merging 等免训练加速方法会导致精度下降，难以替代原始 VGGT。
AI.method: 提出 GPA-VGGT：(1) 在早期块中用帧内注意力加一个共享的跨帧 K/V 集合替代全局注意力；(2) 在剩余块中只合并 keys 和 values，保留所有 queries；(3) 恢复每个被合并 key 所代表 token 的注意力质量；(4) 将匹配度量随机投影到 128 维以降低匹配开销。全程无需训练。
AI.result: 在多样的多视角几何任务上，GPA-VGGT 达到与已有方法相当的加速比，同时保留精确几何估计所需的信息，在 AUC@3 指标下保留超过 99% 的 VGGT 位姿精度。
AI.conclusion: GPA-VGGT 表明，通过针对性地改造注意力结构而非简单丢弃或合并 token，可以在免训练条件下实现显著的效率提升，同时几乎不损失几何估计精度，使其成为可替代 VGGT 的实用加速方案。

title: RankFormer: Rethinking Time Series Transformers through Representation Capacity Analysis and Progressive Decoding
summary: Multivariate time series forecasting plays a critical role in Web and cyber-physical systems, where large-scale services and IoT infrastructures generate complex temporal data. Transformer-based models have achieved strong empirical performance in this domain, yet the principles governing the expressive capacity of their learned representations remain insufficiently understood. Moreover, many existing models rely on simplified decoding strategies, including channel-independent modeling and direct projection heads, which limit their ability to capture complex multivariate dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose RankFormer, a novel encoder-decoder architecture for multivariate time series forecasting. We establish a rank-based analysis framework to investigate how tokenization, embedding, and attention designs affect the representation capacity of time series Transformers. Our analysis reveals that patchification increases the potential representation capacity by aggregating multiple temporal observations into each token, while subsequent encoding operations determine how much of this capacity is realized. Guided by these insights, we develop a rank-enhancing encoder with Hourglass Attention to improve rank stability during information interaction. Furthermore, we introduce the Interactive Progressive Decoder (IPD), which improves future trajectory modeling through global-guided cross-channel interaction and progressive refinement. Extensive experiments on real-world long-term forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that RankFormer achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art methods. Code repository: https://github.com/TangPeiwang/Rankformer.

AI.tldr: 提出RankFormer编码器-解码器架构，通过秩（rank）分析框架揭示分词、嵌入与注意力对表示能力的影响，并用Hourglass Attention和交互式渐进解码器提升多变量时间序列预测。
AI.motivation: Transformer在时间序列预测中表现好，但其表示能力的原理理解不足；同时现有模型常用通道独立建模和直接投影头等简化解码策略，难以捕捉复杂多变量动态。
AI.method: 建立基于秩的分析框架，研究tokenization、embedding和attention设计对表示容量的影响；据此设计秩增强编码器（含Hourglass Attention以提升交互中的秩稳定性），并引入交互式渐进解码器IPD（全局引导的跨通道交互与渐进精化）。
AI.result: 分析发现patchification通过将多个时间观测聚合为token提升潜在表示容量，后续编码操作决定其实现程度；在真实长期预测基准上，RankFormer与SOTA方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 秩视角为理解时序Transformer表示能力提供理论依据，并指导编码器与解码器设计，实现有竞争力的多变量长期预测性能。

title: Prospector: learning a compact graph traversal policy for scientific reasoning
summary: Scientific reasoning in specialized engineering fields depends on knowledge scattered across the literature, often proprietary and absent from frontier LLM training data. In such domains, frontier models tend to give generic answers. Knowledge graphs (KGs) can ground LLM reasoning. Because a graph is too large to provide in full, typical LLM+KG systems preselect a portion, deciding relevance before reasoning begins. Here we train a compact model, Prospector, to reason over a domain knowledge graph by traversing it step by step, seeking evidence in light of what it has already found. Prospector calls a small set of tools one at a time to progressively build its context, and answers with a chain of evidence that can be checked edge by edge against what its tools retrieved from the graph. On a knowledge graph built from the semiconductor-manufacturing literature, Prospector approaches the strongest off-the-shelf models given the same graph and tools, and it far exceeds off-the-shelf models answering closed-book or from a pre-selected portion of the graph. Although trained only on the semiconductor graph, Prospector transfers to unseen knowledge graphs from three other distinct fields: bio-inspired materials, per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and materials properties. Served on a single GPU, Prospector answers faster and at a fraction of the cost of a hosted service, while keeping proprietary data on the owner's hardware. We find that the policy's latent state is indicative of its next move on both seen and unseen graphs, and modulating the latent state can steer the policy from one behavior mode to another. These results suggest a practical LLM + KG paradigm for scientific and engineering reasoning over private data, in which a compact model trained on a graph from published literature transfers its traversal to unseen graphs that stay with their owners.

AI.tldr: 训练小型模型 Prospector，在领域知识图上逐步遍历检索证据，实现可核查的科研推理，并可跨领域迁移、低成本本地部署。
AI.motivation: 专业工程领域（如半导体制造）知识分散于文献且多为专有，未进入前沿LLM训练数据，导致模型只能给出泛泛回答。KG可接地LLM推理，但图太大无法整体输入，常见做法是在推理前预选子图，即"先决定相关性再推理"，存在局限。
AI.method: 训练紧凑模型Prospector，在领域KG上逐步遍历：一次调用一个小工具，依据已有发现寻求证据，渐进构建上下文；输出边可逐条对照图检索结果核查的证据链。在半导体制造文献构建的KG上训练，并在生物启发材料、PFAS、材料性质三个未见KG上测试迁移。单GPU部署。另分析策略潜状态与下一步动作的关系，并做潜状态调制实验。
AI.result: 在相同图与工具条件下接近最强现成模型，远超闭卷或基于预选子图回答的现成模型；可迁移至三个未见领域KG；单GPU服务比托管服务更快更便宜且数据留在本地；潜状态可预测下一步动作（含未见图），调制潜状态可切换行为模式。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种实用的LLM+KG范式：由图训练的紧凑模型将遍历能力迁移到他人私有、未见的图上，适用于私有数据的科学与工程推理。

title: RePAIR: Inverting Backdoor Attacks in Semantic Segmentation
comment: 26 pages total, 9 pages main paper, 2 figures
summary: Despite significant advances in computer vision, semantic segmentation models remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks, posing a security risk. These attacks redirect pixels of a chosen victim class to an attacker-specified target class when a trigger is present, while preserving clean predictions. Existing defenses are largely derived from image classification, while dedicated segmentation defenses remain scarce and typically require retraining or model modification. We introduce RePAIR, a post-hoc, label-free, attack-unaware defense based on the observation that backdoor-induced shifts can be stronger in the classifier head than in internal representations, leaving recoverable victim-class semantics. RePAIR infers the victim-target relation from an unlabeled, potentially contaminated image pool, constructs a safety-approved semantic reference, and localizes suspicious pixels by comparing head predictions with internal semantic evidence. It then applies feature-space and output corrections toward the inferred victim semantics, while conservative localization and output constraints limit changes to benign predictions. We model the attack as adversarial probability transport and repair as its approximate reversal, deriving bounds and sufficient conditions for localization, residual attack success, clean-side changes, defense-induced target predictions, and attack-unaware pair identification. Experiments across segmentation architectures and attack settings show that RePAIR substantially reduces attack success while largely preserving clean performance.

AI.tldr: RePAIR 是一种无需重训练、无需标签、无需知道攻击细节的后处理防御方法，利用后门在分类头比内部表征更明显的特点，从可能被污染的无标注图像池推断受害者-目标类关系，修复被重定向的像素，同时保持正常预测。
AI.motivation: 语义分割模型易受后门攻击，触发器出现时会把选定受害者类像素重定向到攻击者指定的目标类，同时保持干净预测不变。现有防御多来自图像分类，专用的分割防御稀少且通常需要重训练或修改模型。
AI.method: 基于"后门诱发的偏移在分类头比内部表征更强、受害者类语义可恢复"的观察。RePAIR 从无标注且可能被污染的图像池推断受害者-目标关系，构建经安全审核的语义参考，通过比较分类头预测与内部语义证据定位可疑像素，然后对特征空间和输出施加朝推断出的受害者语义的修正；保守的定位和输出约束限制对正常预测的改变。并将攻击建模为对抗性概率传输，修复为其近似逆过程，推导关于定位、残余攻击成功率、干净侧改变、防御诱发的目标预测以及攻击无关配对识别的界与充分条件。
AI.result: 在多种分割架构和攻击设置下，RePAIR 大幅降低攻击成功率，同时基本保持干净性能。
AI.conclusion: RePAIR 提供了实用的后处理防御范式，理论分析与实验结果共同支持其有效的分割后门防御能力。

title: Conservative Dueling Bandits: Preference Learning under Baseline Constraints
summary: Contextual dueling bandits learn from pairwise comparisons, the same feedback used to fine-tune language models from human preferences. Standard algorithms explore aggressively and can show users two poor options. We study conservative contextual dueling bandits, which require that, at every round, the cumulative score of the better displayed item stay above a $(1-α)$ fraction of a trusted baseline's. An item's score is its probability of beating the best available item, so the constraint depends only on utility differences and needs no absolute rewards. This also changes how safety can be certified: we show that transferring the safety test of the conservative bandit algorithm CLUCB unchanged can incur linear regret, even when the baseline's utilities are known exactly. For linear utilities, we develop MaxInP-BC, which certifies scores through utility gaps and, when it must fall back, pairs the baseline with an informative partner so that fallback rounds still drive learning. It is safe with high probability at all times, with regret $\tilde{O}(d\sqrt{T}/κ)$ plus an additive cost of conservatism that does not grow with the horizon. For general utility classes, we develop BTIGW-BC, which turns the guarantee of an online logistic-regression oracle into cumulative safety certificates. It is safe at all times, makes finitely many fallbacks, and has sublinear regret whenever the oracle's logistic regret is sublinear. In experiments, both satisfy the constraint, which their unconstrained counterparts often violate, at a moderate cost in regret.

AI.tldr: 研究保守型上下文对决老虎机（conservative contextual dueling bandits），要求每轮展示较优物品的累积得分不低于可信基线得分的(1-α)比例；提出MaxInP-BC（线性效用）和BTIGW-BC（通用效用类）两种算法，保证任时刻安全，并证明溢出成本不随T增长。
AI.motivation: 标准对决老虎机算法探索激进，可能向用户展示两个都很差的选项，在人类偏好微调等场景中不安全。同时，直接沿用CLUCB的安全性检验会导致线性遗憾（即使基线效用已知），因此需要重新设计安全认证方式。
AI.method: 得分定义为物品击败当前最佳物品的概率，使约束仅依赖效用差、无需绝对奖励。线性情形下提出MaxInP-BC，用效用间隙认证得分，并在回退时把基线与有信息量的伙伴配对，使回退轮仍促进学习；通用效用类下提出BTIGW-BC，将在线逻辑回归oracle的保证转化为累积安全证书。
AI.result: MaxInP-BC以高概率全程安全，遗憾为Õ(d√T/κ)加不随T增长的保守性附加代价；BTIGW-BC全程安全、仅有限次回退，且当oracle逻辑遗憾次线性时总体遗憾次线性。实验中两者均满足约束（无约束对照常违反），遗憾代价适中。
AI.conclusion: 保守约束可在仅依赖效用差的得分定义下有效实现，且不牺牲长期学习效率；安全认证需专门设计而非直接迁移CLUCB，两种算法分别覆盖线性与通用效用类，扩展了对决老虎机的安全学习框架。

title: SFE-O: An Ontology for Knowledge-Grounded AI in Supercritical CO$_2$ Biomass Extraction and Fractionation
summary: Supercritical CO$_2$ extraction (CO$_2$-SFE) offers a sustainable route for recovering high-value compounds from biomass while limiting the use of conventional organic solvents, but its design and interpretation require heterogeneous knowledge spanning biomass properties, operating conditions, mass transfer, and product fractionation, typically fragmented across technical reports, engineering models, external databases, and expert practice. This paper introduces SFE-O, a modular Web Ontology Language (OWL 2) ontology for supercritical CO$_2$ biomass extraction, structured around interconnected Biomass, Process, and Product dimensions and extended with explicit representations of process topology, parameter provenance, external and internal mass-transfer phenomena, and the Constant Extraction Rate (CER) / Falling Extraction Rate (FER) mechanisms. Computational dependencies among process quantities are represented explicitly, without embedding numerical solving in the ontology, so that input, measured, computed, externally retrieved, and fitted parameters remain traceable. SFE-O reuses established semantic resources (ChEBI, QUDT, OWL-Time, PROV-O) and is evaluated through a worked example that instantiates a real pilot-scale extraction batch, a reasoner-based consistency check, and a competency-question SPARQL query. The resulting knowledge model provides a machine-actionable foundation for querying, consistency checking, and mechanistic explanation of SFE processes, and establishes a knowledge layer that could support future ontology-grounded AI reasoning, a direction this paper motivates but does not evaluate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SFE-O，一个面向超临界 CO2 生物质萃取的模块化 OWL 2 本体，围绕生物质、过程与产物三维度组织，显式刻画工艺拓扑、参数溯源、传质现象及 CER/FER 机制，并通过实例、推理机一致性与 SPARQL 查询进行验证。
AI.motivation: 超临界 CO2 萃取是可持续的生物质高值成分回收路线，但其设计与解释涉及生物质性质、操作条件、传质与产物分馏等多学科知识，这些知识分散在技术报告、工程模型、外部数据库与专家经验中，缺乏统一、可机器操作的表示。
AI.method: 构建模块化 OWL 2 本体 SFE-O，围绕 Biomass、Process、Product 三个互联维度组织；显式表示工艺拓扑、参数来源（输入、实测、计算、外部检索、拟合）、外部与内部传质现象及 CER/FER 机制；显式建模过程量之间的计算依赖但不在本体中嵌入数值求解；复用 ChEBI、QUDT、OWL-Time、PROV-O 等语义资源。
AI.result: 通过一个真实中试规模萃取批次的实例化用例、基于推理机的一致性检查以及能力问题的 SPARQL 查询对本体进行评估。
AI.conclusion: SFE-O 提供了一个可机器操作的知识模型，支持 SFE 过程的查询、一致性检查与机理阐释，并为未来基于本体的 AI 推理奠定知识层基础；该 AI 应用方向仅为动机，尚未评估。

title: Select-TTT: Query-Conditioned Selective Fast Weight Updates for In-Place Test-Time Training
summary: Test-time training (TTT) enables a deployed language model to internalize incoming context on-the-fly into a small set of fast-weight parameters, rather than merely treating it as transient context for attention. In-Place TTT recently made this idea practical for large language models by repurposing the down-projection of standard MLP blocks as fast weights. However, we find that its benefit largely disappears on realistic web long-context question answering. We attribute this to In-Place TTT's uniform write schedule: every chunk is written with equal strength, so irrelevant content dilutes query-relevant information in fast-weight memory. Building on this insight, we propose Select-TTT, a model-agnostic, query-conditioned rule for In-Place TTT that scales each chunk's write strength by its relevance to the user query. This relevance signal requires no supervision and no new parameters: it is read directly from the model's frozen output head, as the probability mass that a chunk's hidden states assign to the query tokens. A temperature-scaled softmax turns these scores into learning-rate multipliers, leaving the chunk-wise, context-parallel computation of In-Place TTT intact. Select-TTT consistently improves long-context question answering on two benchmarks and two backbones. These findings highlight the value of query-conditioned fast weight writes for practical test-time training on long-context question answering, which is also potentially promising for long-horizon agent tasks involving multiple user queries over evolving contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出Select-TTT，用查询相关性调节In-Place TTT中每个chunk的写入强度，无需监督和新参数，在长上下文QA上稳定提升。
AI.motivation: In-Place TTT虽将MLP下投影复用为fast weights使TTT实用化，但在真实网页长上下文QA中收益几乎消失；作者归因于其统一写入调度：所有chunk等强度写入，无关内容稀释了fast-weight记忆中与查询相关的信息。
AI.method: 提出Select-TTT：一种模型无关、以查询为条件的In-Place TTT写入规则。用冻结的模型输出头读取每个chunk隐状态分配给查询token的概率质量，作为无需监督、无需新参数的相关性信号；经温度缩放softmax转为学习率乘子，按相关性缩放各chunk的写入强度，同时保持原有的chunk级上下文并行计算。
AI.result: 在两个基准、两种骨干模型上，Select-TTT均持续提升长上下文问答表现。
AI.conclusion: 查询条件的fast-weight写入对实用的长上下文QA测试时训练有价值，并有望用于涉及多用户查询、上下文不断演化的长时程智能体任务。

title: Ground-to-Satellite Knowledge Distillation for Crop Classification under Temporal and Geographic Shift
summary: Continuous and up-to-date crop type mapping is essential for agricultural monitoring but is often hampered by limited reference data. The growing availability of ground-level field photographs offers a promising way to address this challenge. When combined with satellite time series, these images provide complementary perspectives on the same parcel, capturing crop characteristics from distinctly different perspectives. However, field photographs are not always available for each satellite pixel at inference time, limiting their potential in scalable crop type mapping. We investigate whether ground photographs can provide privileged supervision for crop classification built on pretrained satellite embeddings. A photo teacher based on frozen CLIP features supervises classifiers trained on AlphaEarth and TESSERA representations; photographs are used only during training. On a paired field photo and satellite imagery dataset with 17 crop classes, knowledge distillation consistently improves over satellite-only classification; for frozen embeddings the margin grows under temporal shift, reaching up to +5.5 macro-F1 points, and widens in geographic holdouts (+3.7 vs +3.0 in-distribution). These results show that ground-view supervision can complement satellite embeddings and improve their robustness without changing inference requirements.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究能否用地面照片作为"特权监督"提升基于预训练卫星嵌入的作物类型分类，且推理阶段无需照片。
AI.motivation: 连续、最新的作物类型制图对农业监测至关重要，但受限于参考数据不足。地面照片与卫星时间序列可互补，然而推理时并非每个卫星像元都有对应实地照片，限制了其可扩展性。
AI.method: 采用基于冻结CLIP特征的照片"教师模型"，通过知识蒸馏监督在AlphaEarth和TESSERA表示上训练的分类器，照片仅在训练阶段使用。
AI.result: 在含17类作物的配对照片-卫星影像数据集上，蒸馏始终优于仅用卫星的分类；冻结嵌入下时间偏移时提升最高达+5.5 macro-F1，地理留出场景提升更大（+3.7 对比分布内+3.0）。
AI.conclusion: 地面视角监督可补充卫星嵌入，在不改变推理要求的前提下提升其鲁棒性。

title: Nonlinear Direct Feedback Alignment for Scalable Backpropagation-Free Training
summary: Backpropagation (BP) remains the predominant algorithm for training deep neural networks, but it is biologically implausible and suffers from the backward locking problem, constraining parallelization across layers. Direct Feedback Alignment~(DFA), which propagates the global output error directly to each hidden layer via fixed feedback matrices, has emerged as a promising alternative for addressing these limitations. However, a significant performance gap persists between DFA and BP, which we attribute to the limited ability of fixed feedback matrices to capture the nonlinear transformation from hidden representations to the network output. To address this limitation, we propose Nonlinear Direct Feedback Alignment (NDFA), which constructs each hidden-layer feedback using a lightweight nonlinear surrogate subnetwork. To enhance the effectiveness of the feedback throughout training, we further propose a learning strategy to update the surrogate subnetwork, thereby better approximating the underlying nonlinear transformation. Extensive experiments across residual networks and vision transformers on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, and ImageNet datasets demonstrate that NDFA consistently outperforms existing DFA-based methods and substantially narrows the performance gap to BP, while maintaining efficient parallel training. The code is available at https://github.com/YanFan321/NDFA.

AI.tldr: NDFA用轻量非线性替代子网络构造隐藏层反馈，并提出其更新策略以更好逼近从隐表示到输出的非线性变换，显著缩小DFA与BP的差距。
AI.motivation: BP存在生物不合理性与反向锁定问题，限制层间并行；DFA用固定反馈矩阵直接传递全局误差，但固定矩阵难以刻画隐表示到输出的非线性变换，造成与BP的性能差距。
AI.method: 为每个隐藏层用轻量非线性代理子网络构造反馈通路，替代固定随机反馈矩阵；并设计学习策略在训练过程中更新这些代理子网络，使其更好地近似真实的非线性变换。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、SVHN、ImageNet上，针对残差网络与视觉Transformer，NDFA一致优于现有DFA类方法，显著缩小与BP的差距，同时保持高效并行训练。
AI.conclusion: 非线性代理反馈可有效弥补固定反馈矩阵的表达不足，是提升前向对齐类算法性能的可行方向，并保留并行训练优势。

title: WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
summary: Scaling supervised training for working agents requires diverse professional tasks that yield reliable expert demonstrations. However, missing or inconsistent task information can obstruct teacher execution and weaken the resulting supervision. We propose WorkFactory, a scalable framework for constructing coherent and executable professional tasks. Starting from professional intents, information-level planning builds an information support graph to guide task instantiation, explicitly representing the dependencies and locations of information required for the intended outputs. Probe executions then identify support failures and guide repairs while preserving the intended work. We construct 112,686 tasks spanning 612 occupations and use the collected teacher trajectories to fine-tune Qwen models at 4B, 27B, and 35B-A3B scales, yielding the WorkPilot family. All three models improve over their respective base models across four professional-work benchmarks, with WorkPilot-35B-A3B improving from 879 to 1565 Elo on GDPval-AA v2.1. Scaling analyses reveal model-dependent diminishing returns, with execution length first increasing and then decreasing. Controlled component analyses show that planning and repair reduce probe-diagnosed task environment defects and improve downstream performance. The data and models are available at https://github.com/IQuestLab/WorkFactory.

AI.tldr: 提出 WorkFactory 框架，从专业意图出发构建连贯可执行的专业任务，生成 112,686 条任务并微调出 WorkPilot 模型族。
AI.motivation: 扩展工作型智能体的监督训练需要多样且带可靠专家示范的专业任务，但任务信息缺失或不一致会阻碍教师执行并削弱监督质量。
AI.method: 以专业意图为起点，进行信息级规划，构建信息支持图来显式表示目标输出所需信息的依赖与位置，用于指导任务实例化；随后通过探测性执行发现支持失败并引导修复，同时保持原定工作意图。
AI.result: 构建覆盖 612 种职业的 112,686 条任务，用教师轨迹微调 Qwen（4B、27B、35B-A3B）得到 WorkPilot 系列；三个模型在四个专业工作基准上均优于各自基座，WorkPilot-35B-A3B 在 GDPval-AA v2.1 上 Elo 从 879 提升至 1565。规模分析显示收益存在模型相关的边际递减，执行长度先增后减。
AI.conclusion: 规划与修复组件经受控分析验证可减少任务环境缺陷并提升下游性能，数据与模型已开源。

title: API-TAIL: Detecting Model Substitution in LLM APIs through Temperature-Aligned Likelihood Tails
summary: Commercial language model APIs return only text, allowing a provider to cut costs by quietly routing a fraction of user requests to a cheaper substitute model while billing for the advertised one. Detecting such partial substitution is challenging because honest providers also alter the output distribution through undocumented decoding and serving choices, such as temperature scaling, sampling truncation, repetition and presence penalties, and default system prompts, forcing an audit to test against a composite null of legitimate configurations rather than a single reference. Our key insight is that these legitimate variations primarily shift response typicality across the entire batch, whereas partial substitution injects individual responses that remain anomalous under the claimed model. Building on this, we introduce API-TAIL, a typicality audit that first absorbs batch-level shifts by aligning a single effective temperature to center standardized surprisal scores across the audited batch, and then flags the endpoint if the number of remaining tail responses exceeds a threshold calibrated across legitimate configurations. Evaluated on real-world commercial APIs, API-TAIL reliably controls false alarms across diverse honest providers while detecting even low-rate partial substitution with a small query budget, substantially outperforming existing rank- and MMD-based audits that lose detection power under the same composite calibration.

AI.tldr: 提出API-TAIL典型性审计方法，通过对齐批次级有效温度吸收合法配置变化，再依据剩余尾部响应数量检测商业LLM API的"部分替换"作弊行为，在真实API上可低误报、小查询预算地检测低比例替换。
AI.motivation: 商业语言模型API只返回文本，提供商可悄悄将一部分用户请求路由到更便宜的替代模型却按宣称模型计费。检测这种部分替换很困难，因为诚实提供商也会通过未公开的解码与服务设置（温度缩放、采样截断、重复/存在惩罚、默认系统提示）改变输出分布，审计须针对"合法配置"的复合零假设而非单一参考分布。
AI.method: 关键洞察：合法变化主要整体性地移动整批响应的典型性，而部分替换注入的是在宣称模型下仍属异常的个别响应。API-TAIL先通过将单一有效温度对齐来居中标准化意外性（surprisal）分数，吸收批次级偏移；再依据跨合法配置校准的阈值，判断剩余尾部响应数量是否超限，从而标记端点。
AI.result: 在真实商业API上评估，API-TAIL在多种诚实提供商下可靠控制误报，并能以较小查询预算检测到低比例部分替换，显著优于在同样复合校准下失效的基于秩（rank）和MMD的审计方法。
AI.conclusion: 批次级典型性对齐加尾部计数检验是应对复合零假设下部分替换审计的有效思路，API-TAIL在误报控制与检测功效上均优于现有方法。

title: Interpretable Deep Learning Models for Breast Cancer Diagnosis Using Medical Imaging
summary: Deep learning shows promise for breast cancer diagnosis, but limited interpretability hinders clinical adoption. We benchmark ten ImageNet-pretrained models (ResNet50, VGG19, InceptionV3, DenseNet121, Xception, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, ViT, and Swin Transformer) for benign-versus-malignant classification on the BreakHis histopathology dataset using a patient-level split, and explain their predictions with Grad-CAM, LIME, Integrated Gradients, and LRP. DenseNet121 performed best, with 99.4% test accuracy and an AUC-ROC of 0.999, and significantly outperformed all other models (p < 0.001). Transformer-based models trailed the CNNs. The explanations consistently highlighted nuclei-rich and glandular regions of diagnostic relevance. Combining transfer learning with explainable AI can thus yield accurate, interpretable tools for breast cancer diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 该文在BreakHis乳腺癌组织病理数据集上，以患者级划分基准评测十种ImageNet预训练模型（CNN与Transformer），并用Grad-CAM、LIME、积分梯度、LRP解释预测；DenseNet121以99.4%准确率、0.999 AUC-ROC显著领先，各解释方法一致聚焦核密集与腺体区域。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在乳腺癌诊断中有前景，但可解释性不足阻碍临床落地；同时缺少对多种预训练架构在患者级划分下的系统性、可解释性对比评测。
AI.method: 在BreakHis组织病理数据集上（患者级划分）做良恶性二分类，基准测试10个ImageNet预训练模型（ResNet50、VGG19、InceptionV3、DenseNet121、Xception、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet、ConvNeXt、ViT、Swin Transformer），并用Grad-CAM、LIME、Integrated Gradients与LRP进行事后解释与对比。
AI.result: DenseNet121表现最佳：测试准确率99.4%、AUC-ROC 0.999，且显著优于其他所有模型（p < 0.001）；Transformer类模型整体不及CNN；四种解释方法一致高亮核密集、腺体等具诊断意义的区域。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习结合可解释AI可在乳腺癌诊断中同时提供高精度与可解释性工具；但结论基于单一数据集、单一患者级划分与事后解释方法，跨数据集、多中心与临床验证仍待开展。

title: Generative Refinement Learning for Temporal Interpolation in Scientific Machine Learning
comment: Accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research
summary: Computationally expensive simulations and real-world observations often provide data at a lower temporal resolution than downstream tasks require. Averaging observations at fixed grid points can introduce errors, and motion estimates alone do not determine how the physical field values change. In this work, we study whether learning to correct a simple numerical interpolation improves the reconstruction of intermediate scientific fields. Our model, interpolative FLow EXpert (iFLEX), first estimates the missing field by taking a weighted average of the two observations at each grid point, giving more weight to the observation closer to the requested time. During training, subtracting this estimate from an observed intermediate field gives the residual that a conditional diffusion model learns to generate. Both observations condition the model, together with the target time, the interval between observations, and available physical parameters. To reconstruct an unobserved intermediate field, the generated residual is added to the weighted average. We evaluate iFLEX on Navier-Stokes Kraichnan turbulence, Shanghai radar precipitation, and sea surface temperature. Across these datasets, iFLEX achieves lower reconstruction error than the evaluated baselines, including optical-flow and diffusion models developed for video frame interpolation in computer vision. In a controlled turbulence comparison at a Reynolds number of 36,000, learning the residual reduces relative Frobenius norm error from about 13.7 for direct field generation to 10.5, with the diffusion backbone and training setup held fixed. Code is available at https://github.com/paulpuren/iflex.

AI.tldr: 提出 iFLEX，通过学习修正简单数值插值残差来重建科学场的时间中间帧，性能优于光流和视频插帧基线。
AI.motivation: 科学仿真与观测数据的时间分辨率常低于下游任务需求，固定网格点平均会引入误差，而仅靠运动估计无法确定物理场值的变化。
AI.method: 先对两帧观测按时间距离加权平均得到初始估计；训练时从真实中间场减去该估计得到残差，用条件扩散模型学习生成该残差。模型以两帧观测、目标时间、观测间隔及可用物理参数为条件；重建时将生成的残差加回加权平均。
AI.result: 在 Navier-Stokes Kraichnan 湍流、上海雷达降水、海表温度三个数据集上误差均低于基线（含光流法与计算机视觉视频插帧扩散模型）。在 Re=36000 湍流对照中，固定扩散骨干与训练设置，学习残差使相对 Frobenius 误差从约 13.7 降至 10.5。
AI.conclusion: 将时间插值作为先验、扩散模型仅学习残差，是重建科学中场数据的有效且更易学习的范式。

title: LiveSearch: Questions as Executable Verifier Code for a Live Benchmark of Professional-Source Financial Search Agents
summary: In finance, the answer that matters is usually the current one: prices, rates, and disclosures hold only as of a given day, so retrieving up-to-date facts is a core capability of a financial agent. Yet most financial benchmarks overlook timeliness. They fix each answer at annotation time, so the gold goes stale as markets move and, once leaked into training data, rewards recall rather than search and analysis. We introduce LiveSearch, a live benchmark that stores each question as executable verifier code: a typed program of calls to a professional financial data service, followed by a declarative extractor. The question is frozen, while its gold answer is determined by executing the program against professional financial data at evaluation time, and a daily job re-executes it with no human or language model in the loop. A memorized answer is thus likely outdated, and a model must reach the current one through tools and analysis. Construction is equally automatic: a language model only verbalizes programs enumerated from real tool responses and never chooses an answer. Under general web search, six contemporary tool-calling models reach 70.9% to 76.7% answer accuracy. Over three consecutive days, 70% of served questions change their gold value, and even under tolerance-aware matching, a literally reused earlier snapshot fails on a majority of questions within a single day. Per-question tracking uncovers dynamic shifts in correctness masked by aggregate accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出LiveSearch，一个将问题存为可执行验证码程序的实时金融基准，答案在评测时执行程序动态生成，避免标准答案过期与记忆刷分问题。
AI.motivation: 金融场景中价格、利率等答案只对特定日期有效，检索最新事实是核心能力。但现有金融基准在标注时固定答案，导致金标准随市场变化而过期，且一旦泄漏进训练数据，模型只需记忆而非检索与分析即可得分。
AI.method: LiveSearch将每个问题存为可执行验证代码：由对专业金融数据服务的类型化调用程序加声明式提取器组成。问题文本被冻结，金标准答案在评测时对专业数据执行该程序动态确定，并由每日任务无人/无模型自动重跑。模型仅将真实工具响应中枚举出的程序语言化，从不选择答案，构建过程全自动。
AI.result: 在通用网络搜索下，六个当代工具调用模型达到70.9%–76.7%的答案准确率。连续三天中70%的题目金标准值发生变化；即便采用容差匹配，直接复用旧快照在单日内也会在多数题目上失败。逐题追踪揭示出被聚合准确率掩盖的正确性动态波动。
AI.conclusion: LiveSearch通过可执行验证码机制实现了答案的实时性与防记忆性，暴露了静态基准与聚合指标的缺陷，为金融智能体提供了更贴近真实时效要求的评测方式。

title: GraftRay: Physically Based Mesh Insertion into Gaussian Splatting Scenes via Path Tracing
summary: Inserting virtual objects into scenes reconstructed via 2D or 3D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS/3DGS) is a key capability for content creation, AR, and synthetic data generation. However, realistic insertion requires the object to be seamlessly lit by the scene and, conversely, to cast physically plausible shadows onto it. Existing approaches either harmonize appearance in image space, sacrificing multi-view consistency, or approximate scene illumination with an environment map at the insertion point, which cannot represent near-field area lights such as windows and lamps that dominate indoor lighting. To address this, we present GraftRay, a unified method for physically consistent insertion of mesh objects into indoor scenes represented by either 2D or 3D Gaussians. We recover scene materials and surface normals with diffusion-based priors, and explicitly model spatially-extended emitters, solving their radiance in closed form. A hybrid renderer then jointly path-traces the scene Gaussians and inserted meshes, producing view-consistent shading, interreflections, and soft shadows. On FIPT, GraftRay sets a new state of the art, outperforming recent baselines such as ComGS and EAG-PT in rendering fidelity and shadow accuracy, while maintaining highly competitive rendering efficiency.

AI.tldr: GraftRay 提出统一方法，将网格物体物理一致地插入由 2D/3D Gaussian Splatting 重建的室内场景，显式建模近场面光源并混合路径追踪生成视图一致的着色与软阴影。
AI.motivation: 现有物体插入方法要么在图像空间做外观协调而牺牲多视图一致性，要么用插入点的环境贴图近似光照，无法表示窗户、灯具等主导室内照明的近场面光源。
AI.method: 用扩散先验恢复场景材质与表面法线，显式建模空间延展发射体并闭式求解其辐射度；用混合渲染器联合路径追踪场景高斯基元与插入网格。
AI.result: 在 FIPT 上取得新 SOTA，在渲染保真度与阴影精度上优于 ComGS、EAG-PT 等近期基线，同时保持有竞争力的渲染效率。
AI.conclusion: GraftRay 统一支持 2D 与 3D 高斯表示，实现视图一致的着色、相互反射与软阴影，验证了近场面光源显式建模对真实感插入的重要性。

title: Robust LLM Data Selection via Content-Invariant Gradient Attribution
summary: Gradient-based data attribution has become an important tool for high-quality data selection in the instruction fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), as it estimates the contribution of training examples through their influence on model optimization. However, we find that existing global gradient attribution methods suffer from surface-form bias: minor changes to semantically irrelevant details, such as wording or formatting, can produce highly inconsistent attribution scores even when the underlying content remains unchanged. To address this issue, we propose Content-Invariant Gradient Attribution (CIGA), a robust framework for instruction data selection. CIGA first identifies layers whose gradients are both influential for attribution and stable under semantics-preserving surface-form perturbations, thereby reducing formatting noise in gradient features. It then dynamically fuses these attribution signals with semantic representations of the input, combining optimization-level influence with content-level information. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that CIGA produces more stable rankings under surface-form perturbations while preserving downstream capabilities and improving average performance. CIGA also reduces attribution cost, offering a robust and efficient approach to data selection for LLM instruction tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出内容不变梯度归因框架CIGA，用于指令微调的数据选择，缓解现有全局梯度归因方法对表面形式（措辞、格式）敏感的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于梯度的全局归因方法存在"表面形式偏差"：语义无关的措辞或格式微调会导致归因分数高度不一致，影响数据选择质量。
AI.method: CIGA分两步：1）识别既对归因有影响力、又在保持语义的表面扰动下梯度稳定的层，降低格式噪声；2）将这些归因信号与输入的语义表示动态融合，结合优化层影响与内容层信息。
AI.result: 多基准实验表明，CIGA在表面扰动下排序更稳定，保留下游能力并提升平均性能，同时降低归因成本。
AI.conclusion: CIGA为LLM指令微调数据选择提供了一种鲁棒且高效的方法。

title: Rènyi-Regularized Flow-Based Variational Inference for Bayesian Calibration
summary: Variational inference with normalizing flows provides a flexible posterior approximation for Bayesian model calibration, but struggles when the posterior has several modes separated by regions of low probability mass. We study this behavior in a two-parameter twin experiment and regularize the variational objective. Under Gaussian observation errors and a Gaussian prior, the corresponding minimization objective is the expected Tikhonov calibration objective minus the differential entropy of the approximating distribution. However, the expected Tikhonov term favors concentration near one of the modes, while entropy maximization does not guarantee multimodality. We introduce a regularization term based on Rényi divergence that encourages the approximate posterior to cover the prior support. In the connected bimodal case, a flow approximation represents both modes; in the case with well-separated modes, the flow and Gaussian mixture frequently miss one mode. The introduced regularization reduces the near-collapse fraction from 50% to 25%. While the regularization improves mode coverage in this experiment, it changes the Bayesian variational objective, introduces a trade-off in approximation accuracy, and does not provide a general solution to mode collapse.

AI.tldr: 本文研究归一化流变分推断在双峰后验下的模式塌缩问题，提出基于Rényi散度的正则项以鼓励近似后验覆盖先验支撑，使塌缩比例从50%降到25%，但缓解并非通用解法。
AI.motivation: 归一化流变分推断虽灵活，但当后验存在多个被低概率区隔开的模式时表现不佳（模式塌缩）。作者希望在一个简单的双参数孪生实验中理解这一现象并加以缓解。
AI.method: 在双参数孪生实验（高斯观测误差、高斯先验）中分析变分目标：其最小化目标等价于期望Tikhonov标定目标减去近似分布的微分熵，并指出期望Tikhonov项倾向集中于单一模式、熵最大化并不能保证多峰性。为此引入基于Rényi散度的正则项，促使近似后验覆盖先验支撑。
AI.result: 在连通的雙峰情形下，流近似能表示两个模式；在模式间高度分离的情形下，流和高斯混合模型经常漏掉一个模式。引入正则化后，近塌缩比例由50%降至25%。
AI.conclusion: 正则化在该实验中改善了模式覆盖，但改变了贝叶斯变分目标、在近似精度上引入权衡，且并非解决模式塌缩的通用方案。

title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
summary: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. However, synthesizing targeted, high-quality training data for these tasks remains difficult and costly. Our key insight is that these tasks share an underlying capability, which we call connecting evidence: identifying relevant visual facts, binding them to the correct entities, recovering their relations, and composing them into an answer. Crucially, targeted training data are far easier to synthesize for this capability than for these tasks themselves. To strengthen this capability, we propose EvidenceConnect, an easy-to-implement data synthesis framework that uses zoomed views of related regions within a single image to generate questions requiring comparison, aggregation, or chaining of visual evidence. To ensure quality, a reference answer is retained only when independent VLMs agree on it, and region-ablation tests discard questions whose answer survives the removal of selected regions. We then train base VLMs on the resulting data with RLVR, obtaining Zooming without Zooming v2 (ZwZ2). Although the synthesized data are not tailored to any downstream benchmark, ZwZ2 improves fine-grained and spatial perception, with further gains on embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, multimodal agent tasks, and general visual reasoning. These results establish EvidenceConnect as an effective framework for supervising evidence connection and suggest that strengthening this shared capability leads to more generalizable multimodal perception.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvidenceConnect 数据合成框架，利用同图局部放大视图生成需比较/聚合/串联视觉证据的问题，并以多VLM一致性与区域消融过滤高质量数据，再经 RLVR 训练得到 ZwZ2，在空间感知、长上下文、具身与智能体任务上广泛提升。
AI.motivation: 空间感知与多模态长上下文理解是具身智能与多模态智能体的基础能力，但针对这两类任务的训练数据合成困难且成本高。
AI.method: 提出共享能力"connecting evidence"（定位相关视觉事实、绑定实体、恢复关系并组合成答案）；据此设计 EvidenceConnect：用单图内相关区域的放大视图构造需比较、聚合或链式推理的问题；质量保障采用独立VLM答案一致性筛选与区域消融测试（去掉关键区域后答案仍成立的题目被丢弃）；再用 RLVR 训练基座VLM。
AI.result: 合成数据未针对任何下游基准定制，ZwZ2 仍提升细粒度与空间感知，并在具身空间推理、多模态长上下文理解、多模态智能体任务与通用视觉推理上带来进一步增益。
AI.conclusion: EvidenceConnect 是监督证据连接能力的有效框架，强化这一共享能力可带来更可泛化的多模态感知能力。

title: Does LLM Pre-Training Typically Occur at the Edge of Stability?
summary: Quadratic approximations provide a common lens for studying neural network optimization, but recent evidence challenges their predictive validity. In full-batch gradient descent with learning rate (LR) $η$, Cohen et al. (2021) observed the Edge of Stability (EoS), where the largest Hessian eigenvalue concentrates near $2/η$, seemingly at odds with classical stability conditions predicted by quadratic approximations. In this work, we revisit the fidelity of quadratic approximations as a model of neural network training dynamics, with a particular focus on their failure modes in LLM training. We first highlight a distinct failure mode of the quadratic approximation, where persistent negative curvature causes the quadratic dynamics to diverge regardless of the LR, even though the real dynamics remain stable. We term this phenomenon the Edge of Convexity (EoC). After removing the effect of this LR-independent instability, we then propose a generalized definition of Edge of Stability (EoS) for stochastic training with adaptive optimizers, based on whether increasing the LR induces significant divergence in the quadratic dynamics while leaving the real dynamics largely unchanged. Across different LLM pretraining runs with various model sizes up to 787M, we find that (1) EoC is always observed across LLM pretraining, and (2) EoS is also prevalent but not universal: it disappears when the LR becomes sufficiently small (e.g., after decay) or when the batch size falls below a critical threshold that has a positive correlation with the critical batch size. Together, these findings characterize when and how quadratic approximations fail and provide a foundation for future work on understanding training dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视二次近似作为神经网络训练动力学模型的可靠性，在LLM预训练中发现两种失效模式：与学习率无关的"凸性边缘"(EoC)以及泛化的稳定性边缘(EoS)，后者在LR足够小或批量低于临界阈值时消失。
AI.motivation: 二次近似常用于研究神经网络优化，但近期证据（如EoS现象中最大Hessian特征值集中于2/η，与经典稳定性条件矛盾）挑战其预测有效性。作者希望系统刻画二次近似在LLM训练中的失效模式。
AI.method: 在full-batch梯度下降中识别持续负曲率导致的二次动力学发散现象（EoC）；剔除该与LR无关的不稳定性后，针对自适应优化器的随机训练提出泛化的EoS定义——以"增大LR时二次动力学显著发散而真实动力学基本不变"为判据；在最大787M参数的多种LLM预训练实验中检验。
AI.result: (1) EoC在所有LLM预训练中普遍存在；(2) EoS也普遍但非绝对：当LR足够小（如衰减后）或批量低于某个与临界批量正相关的阈值时，EoS消失。
AI.conclusion: 研究刻画了二次近似何时以及如何失效，为未来理解训练动力学奠定基础。

title: Does Your Generalist Skill Optimizer Really Incentivize Agentic Tasks? Rethinking Skill Optimization via Bipartite Attribution
summary: Skill optimizers adapt an agent to long-horizon tasks, such as repairing a terminal environment, by rewriting its skill, a natural-language procedure in its context, and keeping the edits that raise success on a small dev set. On such tasks success is noisy, so a gain on a small dev set does not show that an edit helps, and a success score does not show what the edit costs. We introduce BiPA, which replays an optimizer's acceptance rule on candidates identical to its seed to measure what selection alone reports, and records each episode as a bipartite graph of turns and the text they read to trace extra input tokens to the behavior behind them. Across three optimizers, three agentic benchmarks and two models, the learned skills succeed about as often as their hand-written seed, 0.1 points higher on average. Their dev gains vanish on test: keeping the best of several candidates on at most 30 tasks reports gains this large even when none changed. They read about 16% more input tokens: the optimizers almost always add rules, half to re-check work and some to act one call at a time, and the agent follows them as extra turns, each re-sending the whole conversation. Four principles follow: accept an edit only if its gain exceeds what selection alone reports; charge it for the turns it adds, not for its length; let the editor delete and merge rules; show it what earlier rules cost. Code is available at https://github.com/valleysprings/BiPA.git.

AI.tldr: 提出BiPA，用"重放接受规则"衡量小验证集上选择偏差带来的虚假增益，并用二部图追踪编辑带来的额外输入token成本。发现技能优化器学到的技能相比手写种子几乎无提升，dev增益在测试集上消失，且多消耗约16%输入token。
AI.motivation: 长期任务（如修复终端环境）上的成功信号噪声大，小dev集上的增益无法证明编辑真有帮助，而成功分数也无法反映编辑的代价（额外token/轮次）。需要区分"选择本身"能带来的虚假增益，并把成本追溯到具体行为。
AI.method: BiPA方法：1) 将优化器的接受规则重放到与其种子完全相同的候选上，测出仅由选择（best-of-n）产生的增益；2) 将每个episode记录为"轮次—所读文本"的二部图，把额外输入token归因到相应行为。在3个优化器、3个agentic基准、2个模型上评估。
AI.result: 学到的技能与手写种子成功率相当（平均高0.1分）；dev增益在测试集上消失——在≤30个任务上保留多个候选中最佳者，即使候选无实质变化也能报告同等增益；输入token增加约16%，优化器几乎总是"加规则"（一半用于复查工作，一些用于一次调用只做一步）， agent将其执行为额外轮次，每轮重发整个对话。
AI.conclusion: 提出四条原则：仅当增益超过选择基线时才接受编辑；按新增轮次而非规则长度计成本；允许编辑器删除与合并规则；向编辑器展示早期规则的成本。代码开源。

title: Learning to Code the World: Harness Evolution for Compositional 3D Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing editable and compositional 3D scenes from a real image requires jointly reasoning about geometry, object structure, and spatial relationships. We introduce SceneEvolve, a framework that represents 3D scenes as executable code and improves reconstruction by evolving the harness around a small open-source agent. SceneEvolve combines SceneAct, a compositional semantic action interface built on parameterized primitives, hierarchical composition, and semantic spatial relations, with SceneHarness-RSI, which leverages a stronger teacher agent to iteratively evolve the harness using feedback from development-set reconstructions. Throughout harness evolution, the model parameters, action semantics, and execution backend remain fixed. The resulting harness provides a reusable reconstruction procedure that enables the small open-source model to reconstruct unseen scenes without parameter updates or teacher assistance. Across two in-domain datasets and one out-of-domain dataset, SceneEvolve with the comparatively compact Qwen3.8-27B model improves all four evaluated reconstruction metrics while reducing mean inference time by 47.0% relative to the base model. More notably, despite relying on a substantially smaller model, SceneEvolve achieves 32.3% higher reconstruction quality than the large proprietary GPT-5.6-Sol model, while reducing mean equivalent deployment cost by 59.8%. Furthermore, the harness evolved using Qwen3.8-27B also generalizes to Kimi-K3, achieving comparable reconstruction performance to GPT-6-Astra. The project page is https://haoyu-agent.github.io/SceneEvolve.

AI.tldr: SceneEvolve 将 3D 场景重建表示为可执行代码，通过师生式"harness 进化"让小开源模型无需参数更新即可重建可编辑、可组合的 3D 场景，性能与效率均超大型闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 从单张真实图像重建可编辑、可组合的 3D 场景需要同时推理几何、物体结构与空间关系，对模型能力要求高；小开源模型难以直接胜任，而重训练或依赖大模型推理成本高。
AI.method: SceneEvolve 把 3D 场景表示为可执行代码，由两部分组成：(1) SceneAct——基于参数化基元、层次化组合与语义空间关系的组合式语义动作接口；(2) SceneHarness-RSI——用更强的教师 agent 依据开发集重建反馈迭代进化 harness。进化过程中模型参数、动作语义与执行后端保持固定，最终得到可复用、可迁移的重建流程。
AI.result: 在两个域内数据集和一个域外数据集上，Qwen3.8-27B + SceneEvolve 四项重建指标全面提升，平均推理时间降低 47.0%；相比 GPT-5.6-Sol，重建质量高 32.3%，等效部署成本低 59.8%；同一 harness 迁移到 Kimi-K3 亦达到接近 GPT-6-Astra 的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过在固定模型与动作语义的前提下进化"执行 harness"，可用小模型低成本获得高质量、可编辑的组合式 3D 场景重建，且进化产物具备跨模型泛化性。

title: GraphRAGProv: GraphRAG Meets How-Provenance
summary: GraphRAG systems often use knowledge graphs to retrieve relevant context for an LLM that produces the final answer. That makes answers more inscrutable and therefore less appealing for domains where transparency is paramount. We present GraphRAGProv, an architecture that executes SPARQL queries over source-grounded RDF graphs to compute answers and their how-provenance polynomials. These polynomials record which statement occurrences were used and how they were combined. Because each occurrence is linked to its source text, users can follow these links to check whether the extracted statements reflect the text and whether the query combines them to answer the question. Querying thereby becomes a way to inspect and evaluate the text-to-graph transformation. Our interactive demo examines 400 cases from two multi-hop QA benchmarks, revealing extraction and query errors even when the final answer is correct.

AI.tldr: GraphRAGProv 通过在源文本锚定的 RDF 图上执行 SPARQL 查询来计算答案及其 how-provenance 多项式，使 GraphRAG 推理过程可追溯、可审查。
AI.motivation: GraphRAG 用知识图谱为 LLM 检索上下文，但答案不可解释，在透明度要求高的领域缺乏吸引力。
AI.method: 在源文本锚定的 RDF 图上执行 SPARQL 查询，同时计算答案的 how-provenance 多项式，记录使用了哪些语句出现及其组合方式；每条语句链接回源文本供用户核对。
AI.result: 交互式 demo 在两个多跳 QA 基准的 400 个案例上，揭示出即便最终答案正确也存在的抽取错误与查询错误。
AI.conclusion: 查询本身成为检查和评估文本到图谱转换过程的手段，从而提升 GraphRAG 的可解释性与可信度。

title: Systematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding for Representation Learning in Neurodegenerative Diseases
summary:
Early identification of neurodegenerative disorders using structural T1-weighted MRI is essential for timely clinical intervention, yet supervised deep learning models often struggle to generalize due to limited annotations and scanner-induced distribution shift. Self-supervised learning offers a promising alternative; however, existing approaches are largely adapted from natural image paradigms, relying on contrastive objectives or generic masked reconstruction with voxel-wise losses, which may not fully capture the distributed morphometric patterns associated with neurodegeneration.
  We introduce SYMBA (SYstematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding), a self-supervised pretraining framework specifically designed for structural brain MRI. SYMBA integrates anatomically constrained masking, a multi-scale structural similarity (MS-SSIM) reconstruction objective, and a progressive curriculum that transitions from local anatomical detail to global brain morphology. These components explicitly incorporate neuroanatomical structure into the self-supervised objective rather than relying on generic image priors.
  Pretrained on 6,953 T1-weighted MRI scans from nine heterogeneous cohorts, SYMBA is evaluated using frozen linear probing on two independent unseen datasets, enabling a strict assessment of out-of-distribution generalization. Across multiple clinical tasks, SYMBA consistently outperforms recent neuroimaging foundation models, achieving 0.930 AUROC for Alzheimer's disease classification, 0.772 for mild cognitive impairment conversion prediction, and strong performance in amyloid status prediction. In low-label regimes, SYMBA demonstrates high sample efficiency, reaching approximately 0.90 AUROC for AD/CN classification using only six labeled subjects.

AI.tldr: 提出SYMBA，一个面向结构性脑MRI的自监督预训练框架，结合解剖约束掩码、MS-SSIM重建目标和渐进式课程，在冻结线性探测下实现强OOD泛化。
AI.motivation: 结构T1 MRI的神经退行性疾病早期识别依赖监督深度学习，但标注稀缺与扫描仪导致的分布偏移使模型泛化差；现有自监督方法多借用自然图像范式（对比学习或基于体素损失的通用掩码重建），难以捕捉神经退行性变相关的分布式形态学模式。
AI.method: SYMBA整合三个组件：解剖学约束的掩码策略、多尺度结构相似性（MS-SSIM）重建损失、以及从局部解剖细节到全局脑形态的渐进式课程，将神经解剖结构显式嵌入自监督目标。用来自9个异质队列的6,953例T1 MRI进行预训练，并在两个独立未见数据集上以冻结线性探测评估。
AI.result: 在多项临床任务上持续优于近期神经影像基础模型：AD分类AUROC 0.930，MCI转化预测0.772，淀粉样蛋白状态预测表现良好；低标注场景下样本效率高，仅用6名标注受试者即可在AD/CN分类达到约0.90 AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 将神经解剖先验显式融入自监督目标，比通用图像先验更适合结构性脑MRI，可在严格OOD评估下取得强泛化与高样本效率。

title: HiLo-RD: Cross-Budget Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: We propose HiLo-RD (High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation) to improve masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) under a limited generation budget. Unlike autoregressive models, MDLMs choose both what to generate and where to commit it. This creates two coupled challenges: predicting useful content before reasoning is complete, and deciding when to fix answer tokens that shape later predictions. We identify budget-induced premature commitment: even when a correct solution fits, the model can fix answer fragments near the window boundary before resolving intermediate steps. These fragments become context for later predictions and redirect subsequent reasoning. Existing post-training methods do not directly transfer the stronger trajectories that the same model follows with a larger window. HiLo-RD addresses this gap by (1) pairing large-window teacher states with cropped small-window views and (2) matching their hidden representations at committed positions. This supervision guides both token prediction and commitment order without an external teacher. Across mathematics benchmarks, HiLo-RD improves low-budget accuracy and shortens responses; these gains extend to code generation without code-domain training. On GSM8K, accuracy rises by 9.4 percentage points as mean readable length falls by about 25%. Attention diagnostics and fixed-budget order interventions support the proposed mechanism. Together, these results show that large-window reasoning can improve small-window decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出HiLo-RD，通过对齐大窗口教师状态与小窗口视图的隐表示，缓解MDLM在有限预算下的过早承诺问题，提升低预算准确率并缩短回答。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型(MDLM)需同时决定生成什么内容和在何处提交(commit)；有限生成长度预算下会出现"预算诱导的过早承诺"——模型在推理未完成前就固定了窗口边界附近的答案片段，这些片段成为后续预测的上下文并误导推理方向。现有后训练方法无法迁移同一模型在大窗口下更强的轨迹。
AI.method: HiLo-RD（高到低预算表示蒸馏）：(1)将大窗口教师状态与裁剪后的小窗口视图配对；(2)在已提交位置上匹配二者的隐表示。该监督同时指导token预测与提交顺序，且无需外部教师模型。
AI.result: 数学基准上低预算准确率提升、回答更短；增益可迁移至代码生成（未做代码域训练）。GSM8K上准确率提升9.4个百分点，平均可读长度下降约25%。注意力诊断与固定预算的顺序干预实验支持所提机制。
AI.conclusion: 大窗口推理可改善小窗口解码；HiLo-RD为有限预算下的MDLM提供了一种有效的自蒸馏式后训练方案。

title: Learning to Look Beyond Screens: Transferable Visual Observation from GUI Grounding
summary: Visual perception is evolving from passive recognition toward active, task-oriented observation. We investigate GUI grounding as a scalable source of spatial supervision for learning observation behaviors that transfer beyond interfaces. We introduce LBS (Look Beyond Screens), a vision-language model trained through supervised initialization on teacher-generated GUI grounding trajectories, followed by reinforcement learning for multi-turn crop-and-inspect decisions. Under fixed inference settings, LBS models based on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.8-27B consistently improve over their corresponding baselines. Gains beyond supervised fine-tuning transfer to PerceptionBench for both backbones and to HR-Bench and ChartQAPro for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, supporting observation strategies that generalize beyond GUI-specific imitation. Further analysis suggests complementary roles for the two stages: SFT establishes visual inspection primitives, while RL improves their downstream effectiveness. These findings support GUI grounding as a practical supervision paradigm for transferable active visual perception and broader multimodal reasoning. Our code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/UI-Venus/tree/LBS and https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/LBS-27B, respectively.

AI.tldr: LBS 将 GUI grounding 作为可扩展的空间监督来源，通过 SFT 初始化 + RL 多轮裁剪观察，学得可迁移的主动视觉观察行为。
AI.motivation: 视觉感知正从被动识别转向主动、任务导向的观察；作者希望找到一种可扩展的监督来源（GUI grounding），来学习能泛化到界面之外的空间观察策略。
AI.method: 提出 LBS 视觉语言模型：先在教师模型生成的 GUI grounding 轨迹上做监督微调初始化，再用强化学习优化多轮 crop-and-inspect（裁剪-检视）决策。基于 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 与 Qwen3.8-27B 两个骨干。
AI.result: 固定推理设置下，两个骨干均稳定优于对应基线；超越 SFT 的增益在两个骨干上均迁移到 PerceptionBench，并在 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 上迁移到 HR-Bench 与 ChartQAPro。
AI.conclusion: SFT 建立视觉检视原语，RL 提升其下游效用，两阶段互补；GUI grounding 可作为可迁移主动视觉感知及更广泛多模态推理的实用监督范式。代码与模型已开源。

title: LLM knowledge for improved Out-of-Distribution Tabular Prediction - A Cross-Validated Regularisation Approach
summary: Prediction models degrade when the deployment population differs from the one used to train them, and training data cannot say which feature-response relationships will transfer. Expert elicitation is slow and unscalable. We ask whether coefficient priors elicited from large language models (LLMs) improve out-of-distribution (OOD) prediction as the shrinkage target of a regularised regression instead of zero, across five tabular datasets split on real covariates, selecting providers and prior structures by source-domain cross-validation alone.
