The priors help on four of five datasets, by up to 7.9% OOD mean squared error, and ten of twenty-four prior-informed results resolve the mean improvement at conventional confidence; single-deployment intervals are much wider. On classification the gain is in probabilistic accuracy, not ranking, and control tests with corrupted priors attribute the benefit to feature-specific content rather than scale. Two findings temper this. Variation across candidate priors exceeds the average benefit, yet cross-validation margins fall below their own noise, so selection avoids the worst prior rather than finding the best. On three datasets the prior improves in-domain accuracy as much as out-of-domain, making it better regularisation than shift correction. Only where the training data are large enough that the in-domain gain disappears does elicited knowledge demonstrably improve transfer. Code, priors and results: https://github.com/hugohammer/llm-priors-ood.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验用LLM elicited的系数先验替代零作为正则化收缩目标，能否改善分布外(OOD)预测；在5个表格数据集上4个有帮助（最多降低7.9% OOD MSE），但收益多为更好正则化而非真正的迁移纠偏。
AI.motivation: 预测模型在部署分布与训练分布不一致时退化，而训练数据本身无法说明哪些特征-响应关系可迁移；专家 elicitation 慢且难以扩展，因此探索用 LLM 作为可扩展的知识来源。
AI.method: 从大语言模型 elicitation 系数先验，作为正则化回归的收缩目标（代替零）；在五个按真实协变量划分的表格数据集上评估，仅用源域交叉验证选择 LLM provider 与先验结构；另做损坏先验的对照实验，区分特征特异性内容与尺度效应。
AI.result: 5个数据集中4个受益，OOD MSE 最多改善7.9%；24个先验结果中10个在常规置信度下均值改善显著，单次部署区间则宽得多。分类任务中收益体现在概率精度而非排序能力；对照实验表明收益来自特征特异性内容而非尺度。候选先验间的方差大于平均收益，而交叉验证的边际低于其自身噪声，故选择只能避免最差先验而非找到最佳。3个数据集上域内精度提升与域外相当。
AI.conclusion: LLM 先验主要表现为更强的正则化而非分布漂移纠正；只有在训练数据足够大、域内增益消失时，才能确证 elicited knowledge 真正改善了迁移。整体效果有限且不稳定，需谨慎解读。

title: TCM-DiagCommit: A TCM-SD-Derived Benchmark for Evidence-Conditioned Syndrome Selection and Commitment
summary: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) syndrome differentiation is usually evaluated as static final-label selection over complete clinical records. This setting hides three diagnostic behaviors: whether a model distinguishes semantic-neighbor syndrome labels from easy random distractors, whether it updates predictions as evidence fields are revealed, and whether it should commit under uncertainty. We introduce TCM-DiagCommit, a benchmark derived from the public TCM-SD/ZY-BERT resource while retaining its source syndrome labels; it converts 1,834 source cases into 23,842 task rows over 148 syndrome labels. The benchmark combines random, profile-neighbor, and full-vocabulary candidate ladders with staged t1/t2/t3 evidence. It also includes fixed-label tongue/pulse perturbations and insufficient-evidence variants. A benchmark-defined action contract scores commit, acquire, defer, and abstain. Across five zero-shot DirectLLM calibrations, random10 top-1 accuracy is 63.2% to 66.4%, but hard20 falls to 24.7% to 30.3% and full148 to 14.8% to 22.3%; on hard20, WT(all) wrong-terminal commits remain 62.2% to 74.3%. These results show that final-answer accuracy alone is insufficient for diagnostic benchmark evaluation: answer selection, evidence use, and benchmark commitment scoring should be measured separately.

AI.tldr: 提出TCM-DiagCommit基准，将1834例中医源病例构造为23842条任务，用随机/近邻/全词表候选阶梯与分阶段证据，分别评测答案选择、证据使用与承诺行为。
AI.motivation: 传统中医证候辨识被当作对完整病历的静态标签选择，掩盖了三种诊断行为：能否区分语义近邻证候与随机干扰项、能否随证据逐步揭示更新预测、能否在不确定时做出承诺或弃权。
AI.method: 基于公开TCM-SD/ZY-BERT资源（保留原始证候标签），构建148类证候、23842行的基准；设计random、profile-neighbor、full-vocabulary候选阶梯与t1/t2/t3分阶段证据，加入固定标签的舌象/脉象扰动和证据不足变体；以基准定义的动作契约对commit、acquire、defer、abstain打分。
AI.result: 五种零样本DirectLLM校准下，random10 top-1为63.2%–66.4%，hard20降至24.7%–30.3%，full148为14.8%–22.3%；hard20上WT(all)错误终局承诺率仍达62.2%–74.3%。
AI.conclusion: 仅看最终答案准确率不足以评估诊断基准，答案选择、证据利用与承诺评分应分开度量。

title: TriDifNet: A Unified Three-Task Diffusion Network for End-to-End RGB-T Perception
summary: Infrared--visible (IR--VIS) multi-modal perception supports robust scene understanding under challenging illumination. Infrared and visible images are often misaligned due to platform motion, viewpoint changes, and modality-dependent distortions, causing registration errors to propagate into subsequent fusion and detection stages. We propose TriDifNet, a unified three-task diffusion network for end-to-end RGB-T perception. To the best of our knowledge, TriDifNet is the first diffusion-based network that jointly optimizes registration, fusion, and detection for misaligned RGB-T pedestrian perception. TriDifNet consists of three diffusion-based modules, i.e., the Registration Diffusion Module (RegDM), the Fusion Diffusion Module (FusDM), and the Detection Diffusion Module (DetDM). RegDM aligns the unaligned infrared image to the optical reference by estimating a dense deformation field. FusDM performs residual conditional diffusion to generate a detection-oriented fused representation with optical structural cues and complementary infrared saliency. DetDM formulates pedestrian detection as an iterative denoising process in bounding-box space. To couple the three tasks, TriDifNet introduces a closed-loop optimization mechanism, where detection semantics guide fusion and registration, and the fusion result further regularizes geometric alignment. A stage-wise progressive training strategy and a lightweight Nash multi-task learning (Nash-MTL)-based late-stage refinement are further adopted to balance registration, fusion, and detection optimization. Extensive experiments on the KAIST multispectral pedestrian benchmark show that TriDifNet achieves superior downstream detection performance under misaligned RGB-T settings. Against strong system-level competitors, TriDifNet achieves 65.44\% Recall, 57.55\% mAP$_{50}$, and 26.83\% mAP$_{50:95}$.

AI.tldr: TriDifNet：首个联合优化配准、融合与检测的三任务扩散网络，用于未对齐RGB-T行人感知。
AI.motivation: 红外-可见光多模态感知在恶劣光照下鲁棒，但平台运动、视角变化与模态差异导致图像错位，配准误差会传播到融合与检测阶段。现有方法通常分阶段处理三任务，未端到端联合优化。
AI.method: 提出统一三任务扩散网络，含RegDM（用密集形变场将红外对齐到光学参考）、FusDM（残差条件扩散生成面向检测的融合表示，保留光学结构线索与红外显著信息）、DetDM（在边界框空间中将检测建模为迭代去噪）。引入闭环优化机制：检测语义引导融合与配准，融合结果又正则化几何对齐；配合阶段式渐进训练与轻量Nash-MTL后期微调平衡多任务优化。
AI.result: 在KAIST多光谱行人基准上，于未对齐RGB-T设置下取得优于强系统级竞争者的下游检测性能：Recall 65.44%、mAP50 57.55%、mAP50:95 26.83%。
AI.conclusion: 扩散框架可有效串联配准-融合-检测三任务，闭环耦合与渐进训练策略能缓解错位误差传播，实现端到端鲁棒的RGB-T行人感知。

title: SetGRPO: Calibrating Grader-Induced Policy Optimization
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning uses fine-grained grader feedback to train large language models on open-ended tasks, but grader randomness can alter GRPO updates in ways that score discrepancies alone cannot characterize. Because GRPO jointly normalizes rewards within each response group and combines the resulting training coefficients with response-level gradients, a scoring discrepancy can shift the coefficients of the entire group and induce policy-dependent update changes. Selective execution further affects the direction-reversal risk of retained updates. To address this, we propose Set-Valued Group Relative Policy Optimization (SetGRPO). It comprises three modules: (a) Joint Reward Set Calibration constructs a joint uncertainty set for the training coefficients; (b) Geometry-Guided Safe Recovery maps candidate coefficients into the current policy's local update geometry and determines the largest safe recovery ratio for each response group; and (c) Selective Risk-Gated Optimization selects a global threshold through independent risk calibration to control the conditional direction-reversal risk of accepted updates while preserving the original GRPO objective. Under exchangeability, SetGRPO provides finite-sample marginal coverage for the joint coefficient set and simultaneous risk control across candidate thresholds. On ten open-ended benchmarks spanning three domains, SetGRPO achieves the highest macro average among all compared training methods on both Qwen3.5 and Llama3.2 model families.

AI.tldr: SetGRPO：针对rubric-based RL中评分器随机性对GRPO更新的影响，提出联合奖励集校准、几何引导安全恢复与选择性风险门控优化三模块方法，实现有限样本覆盖与方向反转风险控制，在十个开放式基准上取得最高宏平均。
AI.motivation: Rubric-based RL用细粒度评分器反馈训练开放式任务上的大模型，但评分器随机性会以仅靠分数差异无法刻画的方式改变GRPO更新：GRPO在响应组内联合归一化奖励，并将训练系数与响应级梯度相乘，单个评分差异会移动整组系数并引发依赖策略的更新变化；选择性执行还会影响被保留更新的方向反转风险。
AI.method: 提出Set-Valued Group Relative Policy Optimization（SetGRPO），含三个模块：(a) 联合奖励集校准，为训练系数构造联合不确定性集合；(b) 几何引导安全恢复，将候选系数映射到当前策略的局部更新几何中，为每个响应组确定最大安全恢复比例；(c) 选择性风险门控优化，通过独立风险校准选取全局阈值，在保留原始GRPO目标的同时控制被接受更新的条件方向反转风险。
AI.result: 在可交换性假设下，SetGRPO为联合系数集提供有限样本边际覆盖，并在候选阈值间实现同时风险控制；在覆盖三个领域的十个开放式基准上，于Qwen3.5与Llama3.2两个模型家族中均取得优于所有对比训练方法的宏平均最高分。
AI.conclusion: SetGRPO通过把评分器不确定性显式建模为系数集合、结合更新几何约束与统计风险门控，在保持原GRPO目标的前提下稳健化训练，实验验证其跨模型家族与多领域基准的有效性。

title: RPSD: Retrieval-Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation with Optimal Transport
summary: Sequential recommendation predicts a user's next interaction from historical behavior. Recent LLM-based methods recast this task as generative recommendation and increasingly adopt reinforcement learning such as GRPO for post-training. However, these methods suffer from two limitations, namely credit-blind optimization, where a sequence-level reward is shared across all generated tokens, and collaborative-blind supervision, where each training signal is derived from a single user and ignores behavioral patterns shared across similar users. To address both issues, we propose Retrieval-Privileged on-policy Self-Distillation (RPSD). For credit-blind optimization, we introduce on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), in which a teacher with privileged knowledge re-evaluates the student's on-policy response, and the token-level confidence difference between the student and teacher reshapes the shared sequence-level advantage into token-specific credit. However, the privileged knowledge in vanilla OPSD is still derived from a single user, leaving collaborative-blind supervision unresolved. We therefore ground the teacher in collaborative behavioral evidence from similar users. Specifically, we use temporally aware optimal transport (OT) to compare interaction trajectories across users by jointly considering item similarity and temporal structure, and further apply diversity-aware selection to retain complementary trajectories as privileged evidence. In this way, on-policy self-distillation provides fine-grained token-level credit, while OT enriches the teacher with structured cross-user evidence. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to bring on-policy self-distillation to sequential recommendation and to use cross-user behavior as its privileged signal. Extensive experiments across multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that RPSD achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出RPSD方法，用检索增强的在线自蒸馏解决LLM序列推荐中"信用盲"和"协同盲"两大问题，达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成式序列推荐采用GRPO等强化学习后训练，存在两个局限：(1)信用盲优化——序列级奖励被均摊到所有token；(2)协同盲监督——训练信号仅来自单个用户，忽视相似用户间的共享行为模式。
AI.method: (1)在线自蒸馏(OPSD)：由拥有特权知识的教师重新评估学生的在线策略响应，利用学生与教师之间的token级置信度差异，将序列级共享优势重塑为token特定信用；(2)协同证据接地：用时间感知最优传输(OT)结合物品相似度与时间结构，跨用户比较交互轨迹，并通过多样性感知选择保留互补轨迹作为教师特权证据。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明RPSD达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将在线自蒸馏引入序列推荐，并首次以跨用户行为作为其特权信号；token级信用与OT结构化跨用户证据相结合，有效缓解两大局限。

title: SplatScout: Query-Driven Part-Level Referring Segmentation in Gaussian Scenes
summary: Existing referring segmentation methods on Gaussian scenes primarily target whole objects, relying on segmenter-generated candidates from which a vision-language model (VLM) selects. Such predetermined fixed candidates may omit fine-grained parts needed as targets or cues for identifying objects. We introduce SplatScout, a query-driven, closed-loop approach that places perception under VLM control. The model actively selects views, directs segmentation, and inspects rendered 3D results to refine its predictions. For part-level evaluation, we introduce PartRef-ScanNet++, comprising 261 manually verified queries across 12 ScanNet++ scenes with mesh-derived ground truth. On PartRef-ScanNet++, SplatScout achieves 0.538 mIoU, substantially outperforming existing methods. Ablations demonstrate the benefits of iterative refinement, while comparisons across VLM backbones highlight the importance of effective tool-feedback utilization. SplatScout also achieves higher scores on four existing referring benchmarks. Code and the PartRef-ScanNet++ benchmark are available at https://github.com/kaust-violab/SplatScout.

AI.tldr: SplatScout：VLM 控制的查询驱动闭环高斯场景指代分割，支持部件级目标，并引入 PartRef-ScanNet++ 基准。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯场景指代分割方法仅针对整体物体，依赖分割器生成的固定候选再由 VLM 选择，这些预定义候选可能缺少细粒度部件，而部件本身可能是目标或识别物体的线索。
AI.method: 提出查询驱动的闭环方法，将感知置于 VLM 控制之下：模型主动选择视角、指导分割、检查渲染的 3D 结果以迭代修正预测；同时构建 PartRef-ScanNet++，含 12 个 ScanNet++ 场景中 261 条人工核验查询及网格导出的真值。
AI.result: 在 PartRef-ScanNet++ 上 mIoU 达 0.538，显著优于现有方法；四个已有指代基准上也取得更高分数。消融显示迭代细化有效，不同 VLM 主干对比表明有效利用工具反馈很重要。
AI.conclusion: 将感知控制权交给 VLM、形成视图选择—分割—检查的闭环，可突破固定候选限制实现细粒度部件级指代分割；代码与基准已开源。

title: When All Rollouts Fail: Policy-Compatible Joint Decoding for Hard-Problem Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) derives its learning signal from binary rewards via on-policy exploration and becomes a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning of large language models. Yet it faces a learning cliff on problems beyond model's current ability: when every rollout fails, the samples reveal nothing about a correct solution, and group-relative estimators (e.g., GRPO, RLOO) collapse the update to zero advantage. Expert trajectories offer a remedy, but they are incompatible with the current policy and often lie in the student's low-probability regions, so the surviving updates demand large parameter shifts and decay into surface-level imitation rather than transferable reasoning. We argue that a useful learning signal on hard problems must be both verifiably correct and sufficiently compatible with the current policy. We propose Policy-Compatible Reinforcement Learning (PICO), which performs distribution-constrained joint decoding: expert data guides decoding at the token level while preserving the student's relative token probabilities, and a dynamic top-k mechanism confines the sampling distribution under a finite divergence budget, yielding trajectories that are verified and policy-compatible by construction. These trajectories are optimized jointly with on-policy rollouts under a mixed-behavior objective that mitigates their distribution mismatch via importance sampling. Experiments across reasoning diverse datasets and agentic benchmarks demonstrate that PICO consistently outperforms standard RLVR and prior off-policy baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 PICO，通过分布约束的联合解码把专家数据转成“可验证且与当前策略兼容”的轨迹，缓解硬题上 RLVR 的学习悬崖。
AI.motivation: RLVR 在超出模型当前能力的难题上遇到“学习悬崖”：所有 rollout 都失败时组相对估计器（GRPO、RLOO）优势为零、更新消失；而直接用专家轨迹又位于学生低概率区、不兼容当前策略，导致需大参数偏移、退化为表层模仿。因此难题上的有效学习信号必须既正确可验证又与当前策略足够兼容。
AI.method: 1）分布约束的联合解码：token 级用专家数据引导解码，同时保留学生相对 token 概率；2）动态 top-k 在有限散度预算内约束采样分布，使轨迹在构造上既被验证通过又策略兼容；3）将这类轨迹与 on-policy rollout 以混合行为目标联合优化，并用重要性采样缓解分布失配。
AI.result: 在多样推理数据集与 agentic 基准上，PICO 一致优于标准 RLVR 及既有 off-policy 基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 把专家指导纳入受散度约束的策略兼容解码，可在保持可验证性的同时获得可学习的困难样本信号，为 RLVR 突破能力边界提供可行路径。

title: ReForest: Interpretability Meets Reasoning in Isolation Forest
summary: Statistical anomaly detection methods like Isolation Forest are efficient but suffer from a critical semantic gap. They identify numerical rarities but fail to understand the contextual meaning of data, often missing subtle, context-dependent anomalies. Conversely, Large Language Models possess strong semantic reasoning capabilities but are prohibitively expensive and slow for large-scale deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose ReForest, a novel framework that synergizes the statistical efficiency of Isolation Forest with the reasoning power of LLMs. ReForest transforms the latent decision paths of Isolation Forest into natural-language explanations, enabling an LLM to refine anomaly detection through an uncertainty-aware dynamic ensemble. This approach allows the model to adaptively weigh statistical and semantic signals based on uncertainty-driven instance-level confidence. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets (Healthcare, Finance) demonstrate that ReForest significantly outperforms baselines, achieving an average 21% improvement in Recall and a 10% gain in F1-score. Our framework not only improves detection performance but also enhances model transparency by grounding semantic narratives in statistical evidence, providing interpretable rationales essential for high-stakes decision-making.

AI.tldr: ReForest 将 Isolation Forest 的决策路径转为自然语言解释，交由 LLM 进行语义推理，并通过不确定性感知的动态集成在实例级别加权统计与语义信号，兼顾效率与语义理解。
AI.motivation: 统计类异常检测（如 Isolation Forest）高效但存在语义鸿沟，只能识别数值稀有而难以捕捉依赖上下文的细微异常；LLM 语义推理强但大规模部署成本高、速度慢。需弥合二者。
AI.method: 把 Isolation Forest 的潜在决策路径转换为自然语言解释输入 LLM，使 LLM 借助语义推理精化检测结果；采用基于不确定性驱动的实例级置信度，动态集成统计信号与语义信号并自适应赋权。
AI.result: 在医疗、金融等四个真实数据集上显著优于基线，Recall 平均提升 21%，F1 提升 10%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在提升检测性能的同时，以统计证据为语义叙述提供依据，增强模型透明度，为高风险决策提供可解释理由。

title: A First-Step Bias Restores Lost Diversity in Diffusion Model Distillation
summary: Distribution-matching distillation enables high-quality image generation in only a few denoising steps. However, distilled student models often map different initial noise samples to similar outputs under the same prompt. To locate where diversity is lost, we compare the teacher and student along the sampling trajectory. The largest measured reduction in the response to different initial noises occurs during the first, high-noise step. When we replace the first step with the teacher's corresponding trajectory and leave the final three student steps unchanged, most of the output diversity returns. This suggests that the first step is a key point for restoring diversity. Motivated by this finding, we introduce \emph{ReSeed}, a post-distillation method that adds a seed-response bias adapter only to the first student step and aligns its velocity with the teacher's first-interval secant velocity. All student weights and later denoising steps remain unchanged. We evaluate ReSeed on three text-to-image models (SD3-Medium, SD3.5-Medium, and FLUX.1-dev) and one text-to-video model (Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B). For a distilled 4-step FLUX.1-dev model, \emph{ReSeed} requires only $0.00196\%$ additional trainable parameters relative to the base model and is trained on 8,000 prompt--noise pairs, while keeping the distilled student fully frozen and requiring no target images, perceptual losses, or adversarial losses. It improves DINO diversity by $48.3\%$ while maintaining competitive visual quality. These results show that substantial diversity can be recovered through a lightweight, data-efficient tuning of only the first denoising step, without finetuning the full student model.

AI.tldr: ReSeed：只在蒸馏学生模型的第一步加一个极轻量的种子响应偏置适配器，对齐教师首段割线速度，就能恢复少步生成模型的多样性。
AI.motivation: 分布匹配蒸馏能用少量去噪步生成高质量图像，但学生模型常把不同初始噪声映射到相似输出，多样性严重下降。作者想定位多样性究竟在哪一步丢失。
AI.method: 沿采样轨迹比较师生对不同初始噪声的响应，发现最大缩减发生在首个高噪声步；用教师首步替换学生首步后多样性大多恢复。基于此提出ReSeed后蒸馏方法：仅在第一步的输入上挂一个种子响应偏置适配器，并将其速度对齐教师的"首区间割线速度"，学生权重与后续去噪步全部冻结不变。
AI.result: 在SD3-Medium、SD3.5-Medium、FLUX.1-dev三个文生图模型和Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B文生视频模型上验证。4步FLUX.1-dev上仅需相对基座0.00196%的可训练参数、8000个提示-噪声对训练，无需目标图像、感知损失或对抗损失；DINO多样性提升48.3%，视觉质量保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 多样性损失集中于第一步去噪，仅对第一步做轻量、数据高效的调优即可大幅恢复多样性，无需微调整个学生模型，为少步蒸馏的多样性修复提供了简单有效的方案。

title: Tail Cues, Principal Corrections: Plug-and-Play Rectification for Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation (OSTTA) operates on non-stationary target streams where covariate and semantic shifts coexist. Existing TTA methods often obtain adaptation signals by updating model parameters or maintaining mutable memories, which can be costly and vulnerable to unknown samples. We present TALOR, a lightweight, backward-free rectification module that uses the source linear head as a geometric anchor. The head-induced basis decomposes each normalized feature into high-gain principal coordinates and low-gain tail coordinates. TALOR estimates a soft-routed affine correction in the principal subspace, combining a regime-level principal bias with a tail-conditioned slope that captures sample-level tail-to-principal coupling. Using weighted ridge regression, it subtracts this drift estimate from the principal coordinates, reconstructs the feature and feeds it into the source head. On the ImageNet-C benchmark with six csOOD datasets, TALOR outperforms the next-best UniEnt by 2.2% H-score while running 2.5x faster and using only 12% of its GPU memory; as a post-correction plug-in, it further boosts COME to 68.4% H-score with only 2% additional memory overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级、无反向传播的校正模块TALOR，以源模型线性分类头作为几何锚点，在主子空间进行软路由仿射校正，实现开放集测试时适应。
AI.motivation: 开放集测试时适应(OSTTA)面对协变量与语义偏移共存的目标流，现有方法依赖更新参数或维护可变记忆获取适应信号，成本高且易受未知样本影响。
AI.method: 利用源线性头诱导的基将归一化特征分解为高增益主坐标与低增益尾部坐标；在主空间估计软路由仿射校正（状态级主偏置+尾部条件斜率），用加权岭回归得到漂移估计，从主坐标中减去后重构特征并送入源分类头。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-C与6个csOOD数据集上，H-score比次优UniEnt高2.2%，速度快2.5倍，GPU显存仅占12%；作为后校正插件可将COME提升至68.4% H-score，额外显存开销仅2%。
AI.conclusion: TALOR以低开销、无反向传播的方式有效实现开放集测试时适应，且可作为插件兼容现有方法。

title: Aligning Institutional Power and Operational Ability
summary: To be socially sustainable, Agentic AI systems require normative designs that align responsibilities with the ability to fulfil them. Identifying incongruences such as unsatisfiable expectations or privilege escalation is crucial in avoiding normative pitfalls. In this study, we discuss design dimensions suitable for describing multi-agent systems in light of this norm-ability alignment requirement. We propose a formal framework centred on process-oriented modelling and institutional power for the analysis of a given normatively relevant process, discuss strategies for repairing it, and elaborate on how the symmetrical relation between operational process and institutional state affects the lifecycle of normative positions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以过程建模与制度性权力为核心的形式化框架，用于分析多智能体系统规范与能力的一致性，识别不可满足期望、权限升级等规范陷阱，并讨论修复策略与规范位置的生命周期。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI 要社会可持续，规范设计必须让责任与履行能力相匹配；现实中存在不可满足期望、权限升级等规范不一致，易导致规范陷阱，缺乏合适的描述与分析工具。
AI.method: 讨论适用于描述多智能体系统的设计维度；提出面向过程的形式化框架，以制度性权力刻画规范位置；据此分析给定规范相关过程，识别 norm-ability 不一致并提出修复策略；并分析操作过程与制度状态之间的对称关系如何影响规范位置生命周期。
AI.result: 给出可用于识别规范不一致的概念与形式化工具，提出相应修复策略，并刻画了操作过程与制度状态的对称关系对规范位置生命周期的影响（摘要未提供实证结果）。
AI.conclusion: norm-ability 一致性应作为多智能体系统规范设计的核心准则；过程导向建模加制度性权力可支撑不一致的诊断与修复，并为规范位置的动态演化提供理论基础，服务于社会可持续的 Agentic AI 设计。

title: V-LUMEN: Visual Lookup Memory for Embedding Scaling in Vision-Language Models
summary: Embedding-level scaling expands the capacity of language models through lookup-based memory rather than by increasing model depth, width, or dense computation. Extending this idea to vision-language models (VLMs) is challenging because visual features are continuous, spatially structured, and query-dependent, unlike discrete text tokens that naturally support n-gram lookup. We introduce V-LUMEN, a visual lookup memory for VLMs. V-LUMEN discretizes visual features with a frozen codebook, builds spatially aware memory keys through spatial aggregation-based hashing, and modulates them with text-conditioned relevance signals; all addressing is non-parametric, and the retrieved embeddings are fused into the backbone through a gated residual pathway. On five reasoning-intensive benchmarks, V-LUMEN substantially improves a frozen Qwen3-VL-2B backbone and transfers zero-shot to three benchmarks whose images are disjoint from the training data. At a matched parameter budget, moving part of a LoRA or MoE adapter's capacity into V-LUMEN preserves accuracy on two backbones, indicating that external visual memory is an independent capacity axis rather than a stronger adaptation method. Because lookup cost is constant in table size and incurred only once at prefill, this capacity grows in storage rather than in per-token compute. Code is available at https://github.com/miso-choi/V-Lumen.

AI.tldr: V-LUMEN 为视觉语言模型引入基于查找表的视觉记忆，通过离散化视觉特征、空间感知哈希构建记忆键并用文本条件调制，在冻结主干上通过门控残差融合检索到的嵌入，实现以存储换容量的扩展。
AI.motivation: 嵌入级扩展（lookup-based memory）能在不增加模型深度、宽度或密集计算的情况下扩展语言模型容量，但视觉特征连续、具有空间结构且依赖查询，无法像离散文本 token 那样直接做 n-gram 查找，因此需要为 VLM 设计专门的视觉查找记忆。
AI.method: V-LUMEN 包含三个部分：(1) 用冻结码本对视觉特征做离散化；(2) 通过空间聚合式哈希构建空间感知的记忆键；(3) 用文本条件相关性信号对记忆键进行调制。所有寻址均为非参数化，检索到的嵌入通过门控残差路径融合进骨干网络。
AI.result: 在五个推理密集型基准上显著提升冻结的 Qwen3-VL-2B 主干；零样本迁移到三个图像与训练数据不重叠的基准。在匹配参数预算下，将 LoRA 或 MoE 适配器部分容量转移给 V-LUMEN 在两个主干上均保持精度。查询开销与表大小无关且仅在 prefill 阶段发生一次。
AI.conclusion: 外部视觉记忆是一种独立的容量扩展轴，而非更强的适配方法；其容量增长体现在存储而非每 token 计算上，为 VLM 提供了一条可扩展的嵌入级记忆路径。

title: Multibranch Ensemble Head in Vision Foundation Models for Efficient Cucumber Phenological Stage Classification
summary: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) pretrained with self-supervised learning, such as DINOv2, provide highly transferable features, yet adapting them to small, domain-shifted datasets is still challenging. We propose a regularizing multibranch ensemble head: a training and inference scheme that pairs low- and high-capacity branches, samples a single branch stochastically at each training step, and averages both branches in probability space at inference. The design adds negligible parameters and essentially no inference overhead over a single heavy head, while improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off under data-scarce conditions. Accurate classification of plant growth stages is critical for precision agriculture, enabling timely decisions on fertilization, irrigation, and harvesting. Therefore, as a challenging practical case we use cucumber phenological stage classification, in which flowers and fruits are frequently occluded by foliage, and stage transitions manifest primarily as subtle changes in leaf morphology. The NALEF Food Safety dataset contains images of five cucumber growth stages captured under diverse real-world conditions. On it we evaluate a broad range of backbones, including DINOv2 and DINOv3 ViT and ConvNeXt variants, against strongly supervised counterparts (ResNet, EfficientNet, ViT). The proposed DINOv2 ViT-S with multibranch head achieves a Macro F1 of 0.978 and Cohen's Kappa of 0.971, matching the performance of models more than ten times larger in parameters and GFlops, while requiring only 12.2 GFlops and 22.3M parameters, making it deployable on smartphones and edge devices for phenological stage classification.

AI.tldr: 提出多分支集成头（multibranch ensemble head）正则化方案，用低成本/高成本双分支训练、推理时概率空间平均，将DINOv2等视觉基础模型高效适配小样本人脸/领域偏移数据；在黄瓜物候期分类上以12.2 GFlops、22.3M参数达到Macro F1 0.978、Kappa 0.971。
AI.motivation: 自监督预训练的视觉基础模型（如DINOv2）特征迁移性强，但在小规模、领域偏移的数据集上适配仍困难；同时实际部署（如智慧农业中的黄瓜物候期识别）需要高精度且轻量的模型，面临精度-效率权衡问题。
AI.method: 设计正则化多分支集成头：训练时搭配低容量与高容量两条分支，每步随机采样单条分支训练；推理时在概率空间对两分支输出求平均。仅增加可忽略的参数与几乎为零的推理开销。以黄瓜物候期分类为实践案例（花/果常被叶片遮挡、阶段转换体现为细微叶形变化），在NALEF Food Safety数据集（五阶段）上对比DINOv2/DINOv3、ViT/ConvNeXt及ResNet、EfficientNet、ViT等有监督骨干。
AI.result: DINOv2 ViT-S + 多分支头取得Macro F1 0.978、Cohen's Kappa 0.971，匹敌参数与GFlops超十倍的模型，仅需12.2 GFlops与22.3M参数，可部署于智能手机与边缘设备。
AI.conclusion: 多分支集成头以极小代价改善小样本、领域偏移条件下的精度-效率权衡，验证了VFM轻量化适配在农业物候期分类中的实用性与边缘部署可行性。

title: Hyperparameter and Neural Architecture Search via Evolutionary Optimization for Reinforcement Learning: HPNAS-RL
summary: In this study, we propose a dual-branch evolutionary framework that simultaneously performs Neural Architecture Search (NAS) and Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) for Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Autonomous Driving (AD) tasks. While NAS has shown strong potential in automating architecture design for Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), its application to RL remains limited, especially in scenarios that require joint optimization of architectural and training dynamics. Building on our prior work on Evolutionary Multi-Objective NAS (EMNAS), the proposed framework evolves discrete network architectures and continuous hyperparameters in parallel under a unified multi-objective search strategy. In this setup, NAS targets the convolutional layers of the RL policy network - responsible for visual feature extraction, while HPO focuses on optimizing critical RL hyperparameters. To accelerate convergence and improve generalization, we incorporate parallel evaluation and a teacher-student policy transfer mechanism. Experiments in a high-fidelity driving simulator show that the joint NAS-HPO framework consistently outperforms standalone NAS, yielding policies with higher rewards, fewer parameters, and improved stability. These results highlight the benefits of jointly optimizing model structure and training dynamics for scalable and effective RL agent design.

AI.tldr: 提出双分支进化框架，对自动驾驶RL策略网络同时进行NAS与超参数优化。
AI.motivation: NAS在CNN上潜力大，但在RL（尤其需同时优化结构与训练动态的自动驾驶场景）应用有限；原EMNAS仅优化架构。
AI.method: 双分支进化：一支进化卷积层离散架构（视觉特征提取），一支进化RL连续超参数，统一多目标搜索；并行评估+师生策略迁移加速收敛与泛化。
AI.result: 在高保真驾驶模拟器中，联合框架稳定优于单独NAS，奖励更高、参数更少、稳定性更好。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化模型结构与训练动态可带来可扩展且高效的RL智能体设计。

title: Uncovering Why LLMs Fail: From Internal Mechanisms to Adversarial Reasoning Trajectories
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are usually evaluated by final-output correctness or safety, yet an endpoint label does not reveal how a failure develops throughout the reasoning process. We therefore ask whether ordinary reasoning failures and adversarially induced failures can be characterized using the same internal coordinates. Towards this end, we in this paper study a white-box diagnostic framework CauTrace to disclose the root-cause of why LLM fails from three fundamental inspections: Functional States, Propagation of Representation, Temporal-State Coordination and Reasoning Trajectory. First, seven functional states are creatively defined to represent the support and constraint processing in LLMs. Second, the propagation of representation change measures how the changes among the seven states persist across subsequent Transformer blocks. Third, temporal-state coordination and trajectory topology characterize when the commitment and verification occur relative to the support, and how the dominant state sequence evolves over the full inference process. Finally, we evaluate CauTrace on both clean reasoning failures and paired adversarial perturbations. Across Qwen and LLaMA-family models, the failed traces show weaker Attention-MLP agreement on support-state updates and less verification activity relative to commitment, while the exact representation-level signatures and timing shifts vary by architecture. Held-out repair and steering tests demonstrate consistent operational signals that were in line with our claims for certain models and specific settings, with aligned steering producing the predicted directional changes in process measures. Overall, CauTrace provides a unified diagnostic framework for analyzing failure dynamics through changes in support, commitment, and verification, which would shed light on the in-depth research on LLM security.

AI.tldr: 提出白盒诊断框架 CauTrace，从功能状态、表征传播、时序状态协调与推理轨迹三方面刻画 LLM 推理失败的内部根因，并在 Qwen 与 LLaMA 系列模型上对比普通错误与对抗扰动错误。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 评测只看最终输出的正确性或安全性，端点标签无法揭示失败在推理过程中如何发展；作者希望验证普通推理失败与对抗诱导失败能否用同一套内部坐标来刻画。
AI.method: CauTrace 包含三类检查：（1）创造性定义七种功能状态，表征 LLM 中支持与约束的处理；（2）表征变化传播，度量七种状态间的变化如何在后续 Transformer 层中持续；（3）时序状态协调与轨迹拓扑，刻画承诺与验证相对于支持出现的时机，以及主导状态序列在完整推理过程中的演化。在干净推理失败与配对对抗扰动上评估。
AI.result: 在 Qwen 与 LLaMA 系列模型上，失败轨迹表现出支持状态更新时 Attention-MLP 一致性更弱、相对于承诺的验证活动更少；但具体表征签名与时序偏移随架构而异。留出集上的修复与引导实验在部分模型和设置下给出一致信号，对齐引导产生了预测方向上的过程指标变化。
AI.conclusion: CauTrace 提供了通过支持、承诺、验证的变化来统一分析失败动态的诊断框架，为 LLM 安全深入研究提供启发；但代表征签名与时序偏移具有架构依赖性，修复/引导信号仅在部分模型与设置下成立。

title: MCP-Net: Real-Time Coronary Perception Network and Topological Analysis for Robotic Guidewire Navigation
summary: Coronary guidewire navigation during percutaneous coronary intervention requires continuous interpretation of vessel anatomy, guidewire position, and target stenosis under two-dimensional X-ray fluoroscopy. While existing approaches commonly address vessel segmentation or device localization as separate tasks, a robotic system requires a more structured perception of the coronary scene to support downstream navigation. In this work, we present a simulation-driven framework centered on a Multi-Task Coronary Perception Network (MCP-Net) for robotic guidewire navigation, integrating coronary vessel segmentation, vascular topology extraction, and roadmap generation. Starting from three-dimensional coronary CT angiography, we generate simulated fluoroscopy images containing vascular structures, simulated guidewires, stenotic lesions with varying severity, and diverse vascular geometries, together with simulation-derived ground truth. MCP-Net jointly performs coronary vessel segmentation, guidewire-tip localization, and stenosis localization from a single fluoroscopic frame. These predictions are subsequently converted into a structured vascular graph containing centerlines, bifurcations, endpoints, branch directions, and branch angles. By associating the predicted stenosis with this graph, the framework generates a roadmap from the automatically selected graph root toward the target lesion. The results demonstrate that the proposed framework can jointly recover coronary perception targets and transform them into an interpretable vascular representation suitable for downstream robotic navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出仿真驱动的多任务冠状动脉感知框架MCP-Net，从单帧X光图像联合分割血管、定位导丝尖端与狭窄，并构建血管图生成导航路径图。
AI.motivation: PCI中导丝导航需在二维X光下持续解读血管结构、导丝位置与目标狭窄；现有方法多将血管分割与器械定位作为独立任务，缺乏面向机器人导航的结构化场景感知。
AI.method: 从三维冠脉CTA生成含血管、模拟导丝、不同严重程度狭窄及多样几何的仿真透视图像并附带仿真真值；MCP-Net在单帧图像上联合执行血管分割、导丝尖端定位与狭窄定位；将预测转换为含中心线、分叉点、端点、分支方向与角度的结构化血管图，并将狭窄与图关联，从自动选定的图根节点生成通往病灶的路径图（roadmap）。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架可联合恢复各项冠状动脉感知目标，并转换为可解释的血管表示，适用于下游机器人导航。
AI.conclusion: 仿真驱动的多任务感知+结构化血管图是连接底层视觉与机器人导航的有效范式；摘要未给出定量指标，需正文验证其精度与泛化性。

title: Agent-Conditioned Routing: Diverse Reasoning Paths Within One Frozen Model
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Extended version of a paper accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (non-archival)
summary: Generating several solutions can expose alternative methods, but additional trajectories often paraphrase one dominant approach. We investigate whether the conditional capacity of a frozen sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) model can provide such diversity from one problem prompt, without user-assigned roles, prescribed methods, fine-tuning, or model copies. Agent-Conditioned Routing (ACR) assigns $m$ parallel trajectories persistent, untrained shared/private expert-eligibility masks while preserving the learned, input-dependent token router. On a screened 126-question multi-mode mathematics and physics benchmark, with model judges reading the reported derivations in full, we count the number of problems yielding at least two distinct primary methods among soft-correct solutions in four trajectories. ACR reaches approximately twice as many such problems as the strongest temperature setting under GLM 5.3 (37.3 versus 18.7), and 1.67 times as many under GPT-5.6 Sol (45.00 versus 27.00), at matched output budgets. A blinded four-expert audit on a stratified sample of 30 problems also finds more multi-method solutions with ACR on both backbones, with lower correctness. Matched-eligibility ablations show modest multi-method count advantages for ACR, while token-resampled masks attain higher correctness. An informed sequential prompt elicits more diversity still, using previous solutions and explicit requests for alternative methods. ACR adds about 160 KiB of mask state. In a three-problem microbenchmark capped at 1,024 tokens, its latency and peak VRAM usage remain within 3% of batched temperature sampling.

AI.tldr: Agent-Conditioned Routing (ACR) 通过给冻结的稀疏 MoE 模型的并行轨迹分配未被训练过的共享/私有专家可用性掩码，在单一问题提示下产生多种解题方法，多样性大约是强温度采样的两倍。
AI.motivation: 多次采样通常只是换一种说法重复同一个主导解法，缺乏真正的方法多样性。作者希望在不分配角色、不指定方法、不微调、不复制模型的前提下，利用冻结稀疏 MoE 模型的条件容量从同一提示中挖掘方法多样性。
AI.method: 为 m 条并行轨迹分配持续存在的、未经训练的共享/私有专家资格掩码，同时保留模型已学习的、依赖输入的 token 路由器。在筛选出的 126 题多模式数学与物理基准上，用模型评审完整阅读推导，统计四条轨迹中软正确解里至少含两种不同主要方法的题目数。另做盲审、匹配资格消融与效率测试。
AI.result: 在同等输出预算下，ACR 的多方法题目数约为最强温度设置的两倍：GLM 5.3 上 37.3 对 18.7；GPT-5.6 Sol 上 45.00 对 27.00（1.67 倍）。30 题分层样本的四专家盲审同样显示 ACR 在两个骨干上多方法解更多，但正确率更低。匹配资格消融中 ACR 多方法计数略优，而 token 重采样掩码正确率更高。带提示的顺序追问能带来更多多样性。ACR 仅增加约 160 KiB 掩码状态；在 1,024 token 的三题微基准中，延迟与峰值显存与批量温度采样的差距在 3% 以内。
AI.conclusion: 对冻结 MoE 做专家资格掩码可以在几乎零开销下提升解法多样性，代价是正确率下降；结合顺序提示可进一步提升多样性。

title: MRI-to-CT Translation of Spinal Images via Anatomy-Guided Pseudo-Pairing and Adversarial Diffusion
summary:
Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is routinely used to diagnose spinal disorders, but surgical planning often requires Computed Tomography (CT) for better visualization of vertebral bone anatomy. Synthesizing CT from MRI could avoid additional radiation exposure and streamline preoperative assessment.
  We propose a three-stage framework for spine MRI-to-CT synthesis. First, an anatomy-guided vertebral matching system identifies similar sagittal MRI and CT slices using spine segmentations and aligns them through rigid registration, creating pseudo-paired data from unpaired scans. Second, these pairs train an adversarial diffusion model for MRI-to-CT translation. Third, synthesized slices are assembled into 3D volumes and refined by a network that improves inter-slice continuity and structural coherence.
  The framework was trained on over 10,000 unpaired sagittal MRI and CT slices and evaluated on 1,911 slices from 83 MRI volumes spanning all spinal regions. Assessment combined distribution-based measures with vertebral segmentation metrics. Compared with diffusion alone, the proposed approach increased binary 3D vertebral Dice from 0.666 to 0.739. Volumetric post-processing reduced visible discontinuities between stacked slices and improved vertebral coherence in axial and coronal views.
  Combining anatomy-guided pseudo-pairing, adversarial diffusion and 3D refinement improves spine MRI-to-CT synthesis. Vertebral matching primarily enhanced anatomical alignment and fidelity, while volumetric refinement improved 3D consistency. These findings support further development of MRI-derived CT-like visualization for preoperative planning, particularly to preserve fine intensity details while maintaining volumetric coherence.

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段框架：解剖引导的椎体匹配生成伪配对MRI-CT数据、对抗扩散模型进行MRI→CT转换、3D体积后处理精修，提升脊柱MRI合成CT的解剖保真度与三维一致性。
AI.motivation: MRI常用于脊柱疾病诊断，但术前规划需CT以更清晰显示椎体骨解剖。由MRI合成CT可避免额外辐射暴露并简化术前评估。核心难点在于MRI与CT数据多为非配对采集，且切片级合成结果缺乏三维连续性。
AI.method: 1）解剖引导的椎体匹配系统：利用脊柱分割在非配对扫描中寻找相似的矢状位MRI与CT切片，经刚性配准对齐，构建伪配对数据；2）用这些配对训练对抗扩散模型完成MRI→CT转换；3）将合成切片拼装为3D体积，并由精修网络改善层间连续性与结构一致性。训练用超10,000张非配对矢状切片。
AI.result: 在覆盖全脊柱区域的83个MRI体积共1,911张切片上评估，结合分布类指标与椎体分割指标。相比单用扩散模型，二元3D椎体Dice从0.666提升至0.739；体积后处理减少了堆叠切片的可见不连续，改善了轴位与冠状位的椎体连贯性。
AI.conclusion: 解剖引导伪配对+对抗扩散+3D精修三者结合可有效提升脊柱MRI-to-CT合成质量：椎体匹配主要增强解剖对齐与保真度，体积精修主要改善3D一致性。结果支持进一步发展基于MRI的CT样可视化用于术前规划，尤其需在保持体积连贯性的同时保留细微强度细节。

title: Provenance Signatures for Low Rank Adaptations of Image Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have revolutionized the generation of realistic artificial images. Efficient techniques such as Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can modify these models for particular use cases, making them more diverse and widely usable. At the same time, open base models may be adapted to deliver biased, harmful or illegal images in an online service. In this paper, we develop a protocol to detect when a service may be using an adaptation of an otherwise standard model. We describe the precise setup and threat model for this provenance question and define two different problems arising due the presence of multiple model families and multiple adaptations. In contrast to previous works that have considered model identification within lists of known candidate models, we consider the realistic open world scenario where the set of possible adaptations and alternative models are unknown. Using a hypothesis testing approach, our protocols can distinguish between the base model, a LoRA adaptation and other completely different families of models. For this test, we develop a black box signature of the models based only on intrinsic dimension of sets of images generated by the models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种黑盒协议，利用图像集合的内在维度作为模型签名，在开放世界场景下判断在线服务是否使用了某基础模型的 LoRA 改编版本。
AI.motivation: LoRA 等高效适配技术让开放基础模型可被轻易改造成生成偏激、有害或非法图像的服务，但此前模型识别方法假设候选集合已知，无法应对适配版本与替代模型均未知的真实开放世界场景。
AI.method: 明确溯源的设置与威胁模型，提出由多模型族与多适配引起的两类问题；采用假设检验框架，仅基于模型生成图像集合的内在维度构建黑盒签名，无需访问模型权重。
AI.result: 该协议能够区分基础模型、LoRA 适配版本以及完全不同的其他模型家族，并突破了以往仅在已知候选列表中做识别的限制。
AI.conclusion: 基于内在维度的黑盒签名是在开放世界中追溯扩散模型改编来源的可行手段，为监管与取证提供了可操作的检验方法。

title: Clearing the FoG: Training KG Agents to Retrieve the Evidence Behind Their Answers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can answer many factual questions correctly, but a correct answer is not necessarily a supported one. For an LLM agent, a knowledge graph (KG) plays two roles: as a source of answers, it supplies facts that the model lacks; as a source of evidence, it supplies the supporting triples that make an answer traceable and auditable. However, existing KG agents treat the KG only as a source of answers: their training data carries answers but not evidence, and their training rewards check the answer but not the retrieved evidence, so agents often answer correctly without retrieving the supporting triples. We propose FoG, a framework that trains KG agents to retrieve the evidence behind their answers. FoG consists of evidence-grounded synthesis, a KG interaction agent, and an evidence-coverage process reward (ECPR): the synthesis recursively hides explicit entities behind verifiable sub-questions, so that every question carries its supporting triples by construction; the agent records the triples returned by the KG; and ECPR credits each supporting triple to the turn that first retrieves it. Experiments on three KGQA benchmarks demonstrate that FoG enables 3B--4B open-source agents to outperform substantially larger baselines in answer accuracy and evidence coverage, with zero-shot cross-KG transfer.

AI.tldr: FoG:训练知识图谱(KG)智能体不仅给出正确答案，还要检索出支撑答案的证据三元组。通过证据接地合成、KG交互智能体与证据覆盖过程奖励(ECPR)实现。
AI.motivation: 现有KG智能体只把KG当答案来源：训练数据只有答案无证据，奖励只检验答案不检验检索证据，导致答案正确但缺乏可追溯、可审计的支撑三元组。
AI.method: 框架含三部分：(1)证据接地合成——递归地把显式实体隐藏在可验证子问题后，使每个问题天然携带其支撑三元组；(2)KG交互智能体——记录KG返回的三元组；(3)证据覆盖过程奖励ECPR——将每个支撑三元组归功于首次检索到它的那一轮。
AI.result: 在三个KGQA基准上，3B–4B开源模型在答案准确率与证据覆盖率上大幅超越更大基线，并具备零样本跨KG迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 将证据检索纳入训练数据与奖励设计，可让小规模开源KG智能体同时获得高准确率与可审计的证据支撑，并泛化到未见KG。

title: Exploring the Limits of the Delta Learning Hypothesis: Single-Pair Generator Biases in Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) typically relies on preference pairs generated from diverse model pools and ranked by an external LLM judge. The recently proposed delta-learning hypothesis suggests that comparable supervision can instead be obtained from a single pair of models by treating the larger model's response as preferred. We investigate the limits of this approach across model families and scales. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that fixed model pairs introduce systematic, generator-dependent biases that are predictive of the preference label independent of response quality. Consequently, DPO trained on single-pair data consistently underperforms multi-model preference data, despite the larger generator producing higher-quality responses, and we trace this gap to training dynamics consistent with reward hacking on these biases. We further show that simply increasing the number of generators, even without an external judge, is enough to partially mitigate this effect. Our results highlight generator diversity as a critical factor in preference-data construction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究用单一模型对（delta-learning）构造偏好数据替代多模型池+LLM评判的可行性，从理论上证明固定模型对会引入可预测标签的系统性生成器偏差，并实证表明单对数据训练的DPO持续劣于多模型偏好数据，增加生成器数量可部分缓解。
AI.motivation: DPO依赖多模型池生成偏好对并由外部LLM评判，成本高。新提出的delta-learning假设认为可用单一模型对（大模型回答视为偏好）获得可比监督。作者要检验该方法的适用边界，尤其是跨模型家族与规模时的可靠性。
AI.method: 理论分析固定模型对引入的生成器依赖偏差（与回答质量无关但可预测偏好标签）；在多个模型家族与规模上进行实证，比较单对偏好数据与多模型偏好数据训练的DPO表现，并分析训练动态（与对这些偏差的reward hacking一致），再测试增加生成器数量的影响。
AI.result: 固定模型对带来系统性、依赖生成器的偏差，可独立于质量预测偏好标签；单对DPO一致劣于多模型偏好数据，即使大生成器回答质量更高；差距可追溯到与reward hacking一致的训练动态；仅增加生成器数量（无需外部评判）即可部分缓解。
AI.conclusion: 生成器多样性是偏好数据构建的关键因素；单一模型对的delta-learning监督存在本质局限，扩展生成器来源是更可靠的替代方向。

title: Physics Guided Diffusion Model Based Exposure Interpolation for High Dynamic Range Imaging
summary: Ghosting artifacts are an open problem for popular multi-shot based high dynamic range (HDR) imaging. An effective solution is to capture two large-exposure-ratio (LER) standard dynamic range (SDR) images simultaneously via a single-shot. Brightness order reversal (BOR) artifacts are generated when the two LER images are directly fused together. It is crucial to interpolate an image with an exposure time in between the exposure times of two LER images. In this paper, a novel physics-guided diffusion model based exposure interpolation algorithm is proposed to address the BOR artifacts. An initial image is interpolated by a physics-driven component, and the residual high-frequency details are generated by a new diffusion model based component. The new diffusion model is based on the correlation analysis of generative models and includes a new predicted target to reduce the variation of the Pearson correlation between the noisy data and the target, as well as the amplification factor of the fitting error. Compared with existing neural augmented exposure interpolation algorithms on top of convolution neural networks, the proposed exposure interpolation algorithm has an inherent advantage to generate more high frequency information. Experiment results validate the proposed exposure interpolation algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理引导的扩散模型曝光插值算法，通过物理驱动组件插值初始图像、扩散模型生成残差高频细节，以消除多曝光HDR融合中的亮度顺序反转（BOR）伪影。
AI.motivation: 多帧HDR存在鬼影伪影，单次拍摄两张大曝光比（LER）SDR图像可缓解鬼影，但直接融合会产生亮度顺序反转（BOR）伪影，因此需要在两幅LER图像曝光时间之间插值出一幅中间曝光图像。
AI.method: 提出物理引导的扩散模型曝光插值算法：先用物理驱动组件得到初始插值图像，再由新的扩散模型组件生成残差高频细节。该扩散模型基于生成模型的相关性分析，设计了新的预测目标，以降低噪声数据与目标之间Pearson相关系数的波动以及拟合误差的放大因子。
AI.result: 与现有基于卷积神经网络的神经增强曝光插值算法相比，该方法在生成高频信息方面具有固有优势，实验结果验证了所提曝光插值算法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 物理引导的扩散模型曝光插值可有效消除BOR伪影并生成更丰富的高频细节，为单次拍摄LER-HDR成像提供了可行方案。

title: Gaussian Process Bandits for Constraint Black Box Lever Optimization
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Includes results from a large-scale randomized controlled trial in a production environment
summary: Optimizing discrete allocation weights across competing segments of a shared budget is a fundamental challenge in resource-constrained, sequential decision-making environments. In practice, this optimization is often hindered by delayed, noisy, and aggregate feedback, alongside strict operational constraints on how frequently weights can be adjusted. Because of the resulting combinatorial action space and extreme data sparsity, classical multi-armed bandit algorithms that evaluate arms independently are rendered highly inefficient. To overcome these limitations, we propose a segmentation-agnostic approach utilizing Gaussian Process Upper Confidence Bound (GP-UCB) algorithms. By placing a Gaussian Process prior on the reward function, our method effectively shares information across neighboring configurations, drastically reducing the necessary exploration horizon. In this paper, we bridge the gap between theoretical bandit research and production-scale deployment. We first introduce a high-fidelity synthetic simulator to evaluate various kernel configurations under stationary, drifting, and reactive environments, identifying a composite Matérn + Linear kernel as the most robust choice for overcoming local noise and global shifts. Finally, we validate our findings through a large-scale Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT) in a live production environment. Our empirical results demonstrate that the GP-UCB approach delivers a statistically significant efficiency lift compared to a standard $\varepsilon$-greedy baseline, offering a highly practical solution for real-world black-box lever optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究共享预算下离散分配权重的在线优化问题，提出基于高斯过程上置信界（GP-UCB）的分段无关方法，通过模拟器和生产环境A/B测试验证其显著优于ε-greedy基线。
AI.motivation: 资源受限的序贯决策中，分配权重优化面临延迟、噪声、聚合反馈以及调整频率受限等约束；组合动作空间巨大且数据极度稀疏，传统多臂老虎机独立评估各臂的方法效率极低。
AI.method: 在奖励函数上施加高斯过程先验，实现相邻配置间信息共享以缩短探索周期；构建高保真合成模拟器，在平稳、漂移和反应性环境中对比多种核配置，选出Matérn+Linear复合核；最后通过大规模在线随机对照试验（RCT）验证。
AI.result: 模拟与生产RCT均表明，GP-UCB相比标准ε-greedy基线取得统计显著的效率提升，复合Matérn+Linear核在克服局部噪声与全局漂移方面最稳健。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了理论bandit研究与生产规模部署之间的差距，为真实黑盒杠杆优化提供了高实用性的解决方案。

title: Constraining the Commit Boundary: A DIO/ODI-Informed Authorization Guardrail for Agentic Entity Resolution
summary:
Agentic Entity Resolution (ER) systems iteratively plan actions, retrieve evidence, revise hypotheses, and propose graph mutations. An erroneous identity hypothesis may condition later retrieval and produce apparent confirmation. This paper proposes a Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI)-informed authorization boundary between evidence available for agent reasoning and evidence eligible to authorize persistent identity-changing mutations.
  A domain-governed constraint-binding function maps selected reconstruction-failure distinctions to explicit identity-preserving constraints. An abstract two-phase supervisor permits a commit only when claim-specific authorization-eligible evidence supports every required proposition, relevant conflicts are resolved, the operation remains within its authorized scope, and relevant state and policy versions remain valid. Admission as UNVERIFIED does not confer authorization eligibility. Separate claim-specific promotion governs evidentiary use; insufficient support or unresolved material conflict leads to deferral.
  The contribution is a specification connecting diagnostic-to-constraint mapping, evidence promotion, proposition coverage, conflict handling, scope binding, and commit-time version integrity. A proposed evaluation protocol is designed to assess the mapping's incremental value beyond generic authorization and conventional identifier rules. This is a conceptual architecture without implementation or empirical validation, not a theorem of semantic correctness. Its property depends on domain-policy adequacy, evidence promotion, and enforcement. It does not prevent erroneous hypotheses or hypothesis-conditioned retrieval; dependency-aware evidence flow remains future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向Agentic实体解析(ER)的"数字身份优化(DIO)与数字身份本体(ODI)"授权边界架构，将可推理证据与可授权持久变更的证据分离，通过两阶段监督器与命题覆盖、冲突消解、范围绑定和版本完整性规则控制提交。属概念性架构，尚无实现与实证。
AI.motivation: Agentic ER中，错误的身份假设会污染后续检索并产生"假性确认"（hypothesis-conditioned retrieval），即自证实偏差。需要机制防止未充分验证的假设被用于授权持久性身份变更。
AI.method: 提出领域治理的约束绑定函数，把重建失败区分映射为显式身份保持约束；设计抽象两阶段监督器：仅在每个必需命题都有声明特定、授权合格证据支持，冲突已解决、操作在授权范围内、状态与策略版本有效时才允许提交。UNVERIFIED准入不等于授权资格；声明特定的晋升机制管理证据可用性。
AI.result: 贡献为一套规格说明，连接诊断到约束映射、证据晋升、命题覆盖、冲突处理、范围绑定与提交时版本完整性；并提出评估协议以检验其对通用授权与常规标识符规则的增量价值。无实现或实证结果。
AI.conclusion: 该架构不保证语义正确性，其性质依赖领域策略充分性、证据晋升与执行机制；不能阻止错误假设或假设条件化检索，依赖感知的证据流为未来工作。

title: EnergyCal: Taming Loss Spikes in Muon-Family Optimizers for Sparse MoE Training
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language-model training can exhibit large loss spikes with Muon-family optimizers. We introduce EnergyCal, a lightweight rule that attenuates routed-expert updates according to the normalized squared Frobenius norm of their finite-step Newton-Schulz directions. EnergyCal leaves the spectral transform unchanged and adds no persistent optimizer state. We evaluate it on a 4B-parameter MoE model. Against a development-selected, lower-learning-rate MuonH recipe, EnergyCal-MuonH reduces mean thresholded loss-spike burden by 99.51% and final geometric-mean perplexity by 4.06%, with a modest throughput cost. With plain Muon at matched nominal learning rate and weight decay, the reduction in mean spike burden averages 95.98% across the two tested exponents, accompanied by small endpoint improvements. These findings support stabilization both with and without Hyperball in the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: EnergyCal 是一种轻量规则，按路由专家更新方向的归一化平方 Frobenius 范数衰减其更新，用于抑制 Muon 家族优化器训练稀疏 MoE 语言模型时的 loss spike。
AI.motivation: 稀疏 MoE 语言模型在 Muon 家族优化器下训练时会出现明显的 loss spike，需要一种不改变谱变换、不增加持久优化器状态的稳定化手段。
AI.method: EnergyCal 根据路由专家有限步 Newton-Schulz 方向的归一化平方 Frobenius 范数来衰减其更新幅度；保持谱变换不变，且不引入额外持久优化器状态。在 4B 参数 MoE 模型上评估，对比开发集选出的较低学习率 MuonH 配方，以及与名义学习率、权重衰减匹配的普通 Muon。
AI.result: 相对开发集选定的低学习率 MuonH 配方，EnergyCal-MuonH 将平均阈值化 loss spike 负担降低 99.51%，最终几何平均困惑度降低 4.06%，仅有适度吞吐代价；在匹配名义学习率与权重衰减的普通 Muon 下，两个测试指数上平均 spike 负担降低 95.98%，并伴随小幅终点改进。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的设定中，无论是否结合 Hyperball，EnergyCal 都能有效稳定 MoE 训练；但结论局限于 4B 规模与所测指数，泛化性仍需进一步验证。

title: MixSIS: Mixed-supervised instance segmentation
comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. Code available at https://github.com/chwilms/MixSIS
summary: Weakly-supervised instance segmentation (WSIS) based on either box-, point-, or image-level annotations has been proposed to overcome the labor-intensive annotation process in fully-supervised instance segmentation. Despite decent results, most WSIS methods only focus on a single annotation level, ignoring that some objects are easy to spot from point annotations, while others require box or even mask annotations. Therefore, we propose the Mixed-Supervised Instance Segmentation (MixSIS) task, which allows a flexible mix of annotation levels (image, point, box, and mask) within a dataset. MixSIS has a high practical relevance, as it allows optimizing the annotation process by annotating challenging objects in more detail, while saving time on simpler instances with less detailed annotations. To address MixSIS, we propose AnnotationsMixer (AnnsMixer) as a baseline. AnnsMixer is a truly mixed-supervised instance segmentation system, which generates pseudo mask annotations from all annotation levels, even mixed within a single image. We evaluate AnnsMixer on both WSIS and MixSIS tasks, largely outperforming state-of-the-art methods. In three case studies, we also demonstrate how the unique features of MixSIS and AnnsMixer can substantially reduce the annotation time (-90%) or improve the results (+34%) in instance segmentation with a simple annotation rule or leveraging heterogeneous data. Our code is available at https://github.com/chwilms/MixSIS

AI.tldr: 论文提出混合监督实例分割任务MixSIS，允许在一个数据集内灵活混合image、point、box和mask四种标注级别，并提出AnnsMixer作为基线方法，从任意标注级别（甚至同一图像内混合）生成伪mask标注。
AI.motivation: 现有弱监督实例分割（WSIS）方法大多只聚焦单一标注级别，忽略了不同目标的标注难度差异：有些目标用点标注即可轻易识别，有些则需要框甚至mask标注。若能按目标难度灵活选择标注级别，可显著优化标注流程。
AI.method: 提出MixSIS任务，支持数据集内image/point/box/mask四种标注级别的灵活混合。提出AnnsMixer基线系统，真正实现混合监督实例分割，可从所有标注级别生成伪mask标注，且支持单张图像内的标注级别混合。
AI.result: 在WSIS和MixSIS任务上均大幅超越SOTA方法。三个案例研究表明，MixSIS与AnnsMixer的独特特性可通过简单标注规则将标注时间减少90%，或利用异构数据将实例分割结果提升34%。
AI.conclusion: MixSIS任务具有高度实用价值，能够按目标难度分配标注精度，AnnsMixer作为有效基线验证了混合监督范式的优越性与应用潜力。

title: TDLM: Adaptive Temporal Integration for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models repeatedly compute representations for unresolved tokens, but conventional denoisers do not explicitly retain these representations for reuse across steps. We introduce Temporal Self-Conditioning Diffusion Language Model (TDLM), which lets each unresolved position attend to its own history of hidden representations within a frozen denoiser. This gives later predictions access to computation already performed. Training uses self-generated trajectories and a simple cross-entropy objective for tokens revealed between consecutively sampled decoding steps, while causal temporal attention permits parallel evaluation during training. On LLaDA, the temporal modules add only approximately 0.84% trainable parameters. Across LLaDA and Dream, the main comparison shows up to 7.15$\times$ faster generation than the corresponding original diffusion language model, with competitive answer quality on the evaluated tasks. These results motivate temporal memory as a practical way to make more effective use of repeated denoising computation.

AI.tldr: 提出TDLM，让掩码扩散语言模型中未解析的token通过因果时序注意力访问自身历史隐表示，实现跨去噪步骤的计算复用，在LLaDA上仅增约0.84%参数即可获得最高7.15倍加速。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型在每一步都会对未解析token重复计算表示，但传统去噪器并不显式保留这些表示以供后续步骤复用，造成重复计算浪费。
AI.method: 在冻结的去噪器内，为每个未解析位置引入对其自身隐表示历史的时序自条件机制；训练时使用自生成轨迹，并对相邻采样解码步之间被揭示的token采用简单交叉熵目标；因果时序注意力使训练可并行求值。
AI.result: 在LLaDA上时序模块仅增加约0.84%可训练参数；在LLaDA与Dream上，相比原扩散语言模型最高实现7.15倍生成加速，并在所评估任务上保持有竞争力的答案质量。
AI.conclusion: 时序记忆是一种实用手段，能让重复去噪计算得到更有效的利用，兼顾加速与质量。

title: Beyond the Readout: A Latent Numerical Frame Shared Across Modality and Operation
summary: When a multimodal model computes 17+35 from text or 91-39 from a rendered image, it produces the same answer, 52. Does it use one internal concept of number for both, or separate machinery for each path? Similarity metrics such as RSA or CKA cannot settle this question. They give the same score to identical and to rotated directions, and two representations can look alike only because both prepare the same output digits. We therefore use causal interventions. For four conditions (text or image, addition or subtraction), we learn a small subspace of Gemma4-12B-it's residual stream in which swapping coordinates swaps the model's answer. The subspaces answer three questions. First, do the conditions write numbers along the same directions? They do not. Reusing a subspace from text in an image on the same operation recovers only 53.2% of its causal effect. A single rotation and rescaling maps one subspace onto the other and raises recovery to 91.4%, so the conditions share one geometry expressed in different coordinates. Second, does this shared geometry only reflect the digit the model is about to print? To test this, we split each subspace into 9 directions that the output layer reads to choose the next digit and 13 directions that it cannot see. The 13 hidden directions still carry the number, yet changing them barely alters the digit being written. Third, what are these hidden directions for? A model must emit a multi-digit answer one digit at a time, so it can compute the full result early and keep it in reserve. When two numbers share their first digit, swapping the number in the hidden directions leaves the digit being written intact and redirects the next digit in 77.6% of cases. The model thus forms an abstract numerical concept upstream and unfolds it across time: multimodal representations share meaning through relational geometry across distinct coordinate frames.

AI.tldr: 本文用因果干预方法探究多模态模型对数字的表示：文本与图像路径并非共享同一组坐标，但可通过一次旋转+缩放互相映射，说明二者共享同一几何、不同坐标框架；表示中存在输出层读不到的13个"隐藏方向"，用于提前算好并分时展开多位数答案。
AI.motivation: RSA、CKA等相似性指标无法区分"同一概念"与"旋转后方向"，也可能被相同的输出数字准备过程所混淆，因此需要因果手段来判断多模态模型是否使用统一的数字概念。
AI.method: 在Gemma4-12B-it的残差流上，针对4种条件（文本/图像 × 加/减）学习小子空间，交换坐标即可交换模型答案；再检验跨条件子空间的可迁移性；将子空间拆为输出层可读的9个方向与不可见的13个方向，并做交换干预。
AI.result: 文本子空间直接用于图像仅恢复53.2%因果效应，经一次旋转+缩放后恢复率达91.4%；13个隐藏方向仍携带数字信息但几乎不改变当前书写的数字；两数首位相同时，换隐藏方向可保持当前位不变并使下一位被改写，成功率77.6%。
AI.conclusion: 模型形成了抽象的数字概念，并经不同坐标框架下的关系几何实现跨模态共享语义，再随时间逐步展开多位数结果。

title: Self-Regularized Flow Language Models
summary: We introduce SERF (Self-Regularized Flow Language Models), a simple self-supervised framework for improving continuous diffusion language models by exploiting the denoising trajectory itself. While continuous flow-based language models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, their training objectives typically rely on supervision from clean target tokens, leaving the denoising trajectory underexploited as a learning signal. SERF addresses this limitation through noisy-to-clean self-distillation: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher receives a cleaner version of the student's noisy input along the same interpolation path and provides additional supervision. We investigate two variants: SERF-L, which aligns the student's intermediate representations with deeper teacher representations, and SERF-P, which aligns their output token distributions, either at the student's output or at an early student layer. All variants augment the standard training objective without requiring external pretrained models or modifying the inference procedure. Experiments across three continuous language-model paradigms (one-hot FLM, latent ELF, and hyper-spherical S-FLM) demonstrate substantial improvements in training efficiency, generation quality, and few-step generation. In particular, SERF achieves up to 7.7x wall-clock training acceleration on OpenWebText, improves MAUVE by 24.3% and GSM8K accuracy by up to 28.8%, and matches baseline performance with up to 64x fewer sampling steps. These results establish noisy-to-clean self-distillation as an effective approach to improving continuous diffusion language models.

AI.tldr: SERF：通过“噪声到干净”自蒸馏利用去噪轨迹本身来提升连续扩散语言模型的训练效率与生成质量。
AI.motivation: 连续流式语言模型的训练目标主要依赖干净 token 的监督，去噪轨迹本身作为学习信号被忽视，未被充分利用。
AI.method: 提出自正则化流语言模型 SERF：用 EMA 教师在学生噪声输入的更干净版本上提供额外监督；两种变体 SERF-L（中间表示与更深教师层对齐）和 SERF-P（输出 token 分布对齐，可在输出或早期层）；不引入外部预训练模型，不改变推理流程。
AI.result: 在 one-hot FLM、latent ELF、超球 S-FLM 三种范式上均显著提升：OpenWebText 上最高 7.7 倍实际训练加速，MAUVE 提升 24.3%，GSM8K 准确率提升最多 28.8%，采样步数最多减少 64 倍仍匹配基线。
AI.conclusion: 噪声到干净自蒸馏是提升连续扩散语言模型的有效方法，可同时改善训练效率、生成质量和少步采样。

title: GCSR-OCC: Geometry Calibration and Semantic Routing for Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction represents scene geometry and semantics in a unified voxel grid, enabling recognition beyond predefined categories. One approach reconstructs scenes with 3D Gaussians and converts them into voxel occupancy. However, Gaussian scale inflation and excessive overlap can distort voxel occupancy predictions, while semantic mixing can arise within Gaussians spanning multiple categories and during 3D--2D semantic feature alignment. We propose GCSR-OCC, which combines geometry calibration and multi-mode query-conditioned semantic routing for indoor occupancy prediction from a single RGB image. The Evidence-Conserving Gaussian-to-Occupancy operator (EC-G2O) uses kernel mass normalization, $p$-norm aggregation, and a learnable gain to suppress scale inflation and excessive local evidence accumulation while calibrating occupancy responses. Multi-mode Query-First Gaussian Semantic Routing (MM-QGSR) matches multiple semantic modes per Gaussian to text queries and aggregates query-specific evidence into voxels through a learnable text-conditioned router. Fine-grained subclass queries and smoothed semantic aggregation further refine voxel-level predictions. Without 3D semantic annotations, GCSR-OCC achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary occupancy prediction on Occ-ScanNet, with 63.31% geometric IoU and 27.44% semantic mIoU. It also reduces geometric aggregation latency from 19.76 ms to 12.88 ms. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: GCSR-OCC：单张RGB图像开放词汇3D占据预测，用EC-G2O几何校准与MM-QGSR多模式语义路由解决高斯尺度膨胀、过度重叠和语义混叠问题，在Occ-ScanNet达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法先用3D高斯重建场景再转体素占据，但高斯尺度膨胀与过度重叠会扭曲占据预测；跨越多个类别的高斯以及3D-2D语义特征对齐过程会产生语义混叠。
AI.method: 提出GCSR-OCC，包含两部分：证据守恒高斯到占据算子EC-G2O（核质量归一化、p范数聚合、可学习增益，抑制尺度膨胀与局部证据过度累积并校准占据响应）；多模式查询优先高斯语义路由MM-QGSR（为每个高斯匹配多个语义模式到文本查询，经文本条件可学习路由器聚合查询特证据到体素），并用细粒度子类查询与平滑语义聚合精化体素预测。
AI.result: 无需3D语义标注，在Occ-ScanNet上取得开放词汇占据预测SOTA：几何IoU 63.31%，语义mIoU 27.44%；几何聚合延迟由19.76 ms降至12.88 ms。
AI.conclusion: 几何校准与多模式语义路由能有效缓解高斯占据预测中的几何失真与语义混叠，在无3D语义监督下实现高效高精度的开放词汇室内占据预测。

title: Algorithmic Monoculture in Machine Learning-based Site-Specific Fertilizer Recommendation
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Economics for Machine Learning (EconML)
summary: Machine learning recommendations are often evaluated one model at a time, despite deployment across interconnected decision makers. For continuous NPK fertilizer prescriptions, correlated errors can aggregate across farms and generate systemic costs. A model of shared and farm-specific recommendation errors links expected social loss to model adoption shares; the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index characterizes concentration effects when common model errors are independent and predictive risks are equal. A covariance-generalized formulation captures the dependence between model families. A two-model threshold characterizes when privately optimal monoculture is socially dominated, and a convex portfolio rule limits average private predictive regret. Nine model families across five Moroccan cereal systems provide a benchmark-based calibration. Under illustrative parameters and a 10% regret cap, accuracy-constrained diversification lowers modeled social loss in all five systems by 10.89-41.53% (mean 19.41%). Uniform allocation reduces modeled loss in this setting, but breaches the regret cap in every crop. Correlation sensitivity shows that highly dependent model errors attenuate the benefits of diversification. These counterfactual outcomes are not estimates of agronomic or monetary welfare; the framework identifies adoption architecture and error dependence as ecosystem-level evaluation variables.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个共享+农场特异误差模型，将推荐模型的采纳结构与社会损失关联，用HHI与协方差推广刻画模型错误集中/相关性，并给出双模型阈值与凸组合投资规则；在摩洛哥五个谷类系统的九类模型上标定，精度约束下的多样化使模拟社会损失降低10.89–41.53%（均值19.41%）。
AI.motivation: 机器学习推荐通常被逐个模型评估，但实际部署中多个决策者互联，相关误差会在农场间聚合形成系统性成本；因此需要把"采纳结构"与"误差依赖"作为生态系统级评估变量，而非只看单模型精度。
AI.method: 构建共享成分与农场特异成分的推荐误差模型，将期望社会损失与模型采纳份额挂钩；在共同误差独立且预测风险相等时用Herfindahl-Hirschman指数刻画集中效应；进一步用协方差推广形式捕捉模型族之间的依赖；推导双模型阈值判定"私人最优单一化"何时被社会性支配，并提出限制平均私人预测遗憾的凸组合分配规则；以五个摩洛哥谷类系统的九类模型族做基准标定。
AI.result: 在示例参数与10%遗憾上限下，受精度约束的多样化在全部五个系统中降低模拟社会损失10.89–41.53%（均值19.41%）；均匀分配虽有降损但每个作物都突破遗憾上限；相关性敏感性分析显示高度依赖的模型误差会削弱多样化收益。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把采纳架构与误差依赖识别为生态系统级评估变量，说明精度约束下的多样化可缓解系统性损失；作者强调这些反事实结果并非农艺或货币福利的估计。

title: M4Bench: Evaluating Procedural Specification for Clinical EHR Derivation Agents
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 10 pages main text, 33 pages total. Code: https://github.com/hannesill/m4/tree/m4bench-neurips2026-camera-ready/benchmark . Evidence: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hannesill/m4bench-evidence
summary: Clinical research over electronic health records depends on derived variables whose definitions sit outside the schema, in item codes, time windows, missingness rules, and output-grain choices that change cohorts and downstream conclusions. We introduce M4Bench, 28 clinical derivation tasks across 15 task families on MIMIC-IV and eICU, to test whether AI coding agents can reproduce such derivations and how clinician-reviewed agent skills change their results. Its controls decompose the value of skills into specification completeness, delivery format, and schema familiarity. In a Docker-isolated Codex campaign (GPT 5.4 Mini and GPT 5.5), skills raise reward by 0.136 over the no-skill baseline, with 26 of 28 tasks improving. Specification completeness accounts for most of this gain: on an eight-task control subset, an operational spec alone raises reward by 0.162, and skills add only 0.024 on top, indistinguishable from zero. On a ten-task subset, decoy skills score like no skill and raw reference SQL nearly matches targeted skills, arguing against generic context or the skill format as the explanation. Schema obfuscation and restructuring preserve 86% and 70% of the skill gain (GPT 5.4 Mini, 26 MIMIC-IV tasks), a descriptive robustness check rather than a bound on memorization. A descriptive Claude Code replication on all 28 tasks (Opus 4.7 and Sonnet 4.6, 560 runs) is directionally consistent (+0.120, 21 of 28 tasks improving). These gains are partial agreement with the reference, not completed tasks: only 25 of 280 with-skill and 13 of 280 no-skill Codex runs pass every strict check, and skills barely change which rows agents return (key F1 +0.003). Skills are released as a versioned, clinician-reviewable markdown delivery format, with a family-level reference-validity audit. M4Bench releases tasks, skills, evaluation code, and sanitized per-run evidence as an open-source benchmark.

AI.tldr: M4Bench 提出 28 个 EHR 临床衍生变量任务，检验 AI 编码智能体能否复现衍生逻辑，并量化"技能"（skill）提示的作用来源；发现技能带来的收益主要来自规格完整性，而非格式或模式记忆。
AI.motivation: 电子健康记录的临床研究中，衍生变量的定义（条目代码、时间窗、缺失规则、输出粒度）位于数据库模式之外，会显著影响队列与结论，但缺乏系统评测智能体能否正确复现这些衍生逻辑的基准。
AI.method: 构建 M4Bench：MIMIC-IV 与 eICU 上 15 个任务族的 28 个衍生任务；设置对照分解技能的收益来源（规格完整性、交付格式、模式熟悉度）；采用 Docker 隔离的 Codex 实验（GPT 5.4 Mini、GPT 5.5），并做诱饵技能、原始参考 SQL、模式混淆/重构等消融，以及在 Claude Code 上的复现实验（Opus 4.7、Sonnet 4.6，共 560 次运行）。
AI.result: 技能相对无技能基线提升奖励 0.136，28 个任务中 26 个改善；八任务对照子集上仅操作规格即提升 0.162，技能额外仅贡献 0.024（与零不可区分）；诱饵技能等价于无技能，原始参考 SQL 接近定向技能；模式混淆与重构分别保留 86% 与 70% 的收益；Claude Code 复现方向一致（+0.120，21/28 改善）。但严格全项通过率低（有技能 25/280，无技能 13/280），关键行 F1 仅 +0.003。
AI.conclusion: 技能收益主要源于规格的完整性而非技能形式或模式记忆，且提升仅体现为与参考的部分一致，远非任务完成；作者以版本化、可临床审核的 markdown 形式发布技能，并开源任务、评估代码与脱敏运行证据。

title: FastBEVFusion: Simple Multi-Modal Fusion for 3D Object Detection at 50 FPS
summary: Reliable real-time 3D object detection based on LiDAR and camera data is critical for safety in autonomous driving, where systems must accurately perceive their surroundings with minimal latency. Many state-of-the-art systems achieve high-quality detection results but fail to meet real-time constraints, limiting their practical use. To address this challenge, we propose FastBEVFusion, a simple, fast, and robust fusion system for 3D object detection. Based on modality-specific features, FastBEVFusion projects these features into semi-aligned modality-specific BEV spaces, without relying on a computationally intensive and potentially error-prone depth estimation. Given these BEV spaces, we propose a light-weight, soft, and dynamic fusion module based on cross-attention, which adapts dynamically to the scene context and enables feature fusion across the entire BEV spaces. Experiments on the complex nuScenes dataset show that FastBEVFusion outperforms state-of-the-art real-time systems, and achieves over 50 FPS without deployment libraries. Additionally, our system shows strong robustness to calibration errors, making FastBEVFusion a powerful 3D object detection system for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: FastBEVFusion：将LiDAR与相机特征投影到半对齐的模态专用BEV空间，用轻量跨注意力软融合，超过50 FPS且在标定误差下鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需低延迟、可靠的3D检测。现有SOTA精度高但难以满足实时约束，且融合常依赖计算量大、易错的深度估计。
AI.method: 将各模态特征投影到半对齐的模态专用BEV空间，避免深度估计；提出基于跨注意力的轻量、软性、动态融合模块，自适应场景上下文并在整个BEV空间融合。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上优于现有实时系统，无部署库情况下超过50 FPS，且对标定误差表现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: FastBEVFusion在实时性与鲁棒性上取得良好平衡，适合真实世界3D检测应用。

title: DCKV: Learned Transform Coding of the Prompt KV Cache in Hybrid Language Models
summary: Hybrid language models keep a key-value (KV) cache only in their few full-attention layers, but this cache is still the part of a prompt's state that grows with the prompt and that must be stored or moved to reuse it. We present DCKV, a differentiable codec for the KV cache and the first KV-cache codec that is trained end to end. Its transform, its quantizer and its entropy models, which are conditioned on the prompt tokens and on already decoded neighbouring positions, are optimized together against the frozen language model, both for the code length that the entropy models assign and for the change of the model's output. On Qwen3.5-2B, DCKV stores a compressed token in more than 55 times fewer bytes than bf16 at a loss of at most 1.8 points on three long-context benchmarks, and in more than 100 times fewer bytes at a loss of at most 3.6 points.

AI.tldr: DCKV：首个端到端训练的可微KV缓存编解码器，在混合语言模型的少量全注意力层KV缓存上实现55倍以上（≤1.8点损失）乃至100倍以上（≤3.6点损失）的压缩。
AI.motivation: 混合语言模型仅在全注意力层保留KV缓存，但该缓存仍是随prompt增长、需存储或迁移以复用的状态部分，因此压缩它对长上下文场景的存储与传输成本至关重要。
AI.method: 提出可微分的KV缓存编解码器：变换、量化器与熵模型（以prompt token及已解码的相邻位置为条件）在冻结语言模型下联合优化，损失同时考虑熵模型分配的码长和模型输出的变化，实现端到端训练。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-2B上，较bf16以55倍以上更少字节存储压缩token时三个长上下文基准损失≤1.8点；100倍以上压缩时损失≤3.6点。
AI.conclusion: 端到端学习式KV缓存压缩可在极低码率下保持长上下文性能，为混合模型KV缓存的高效存储与复用提供了可行方案。

title: Concordat: Typed Sessions for LLM Agents
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Code, benchmark harness and results: https://github.com/miladsikaroudi/concordat
summary: Agents built on large language models are increasingly allowed to take consequential actions: cancelling bookings, issuing refunds, changing accounts. The rules that govern those actions, such as "obtain the customer's explicit confirmation before changing anything", are usually stated in the prompt and followed only as reliably as the model chooses to follow them. We present Concordat, a Python library that treats an agent as an object whose interface is a finite-state protocol, in the spirit of typestate and session types, and enforces that protocol on the model at run time. On every turn the model is offered only the tools that are legal in the current protocol state, calls outside that set are rejected before they have side effects, decisions reserved for humans can only be requested, and token and tool-call budgets are charged and split linearly across handoffs. Protocols are checked when they are defined, and a subclass of an agent is rejected if it could bypass its parent's protocol, a behavioural form of Liskov substitution. We evaluate a Concordat agent against the standard agent of tau-bench on its 50 airline tasks, adding simulated customers who pressure the agent to skip confirmation. The standard agent made changes without the required "yes" in 13 of 50 tasks with gpt-4.1 and in 29 of 128 task-runs with Claude Haiku 5.5; the Concordat agent made none, with no significant difference in task success. tau-bench's own reward did not detect most of these violations. Concordat is open source.

AI.tldr: Concordat 是一个 Python 库，将 LLM 智能体建模为具有有限状态协议接口的对象，在运行时强制约束模型行为，使越权、未经确认的破坏性操作在产生副作用前被拒绝。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体的行为规则（如"修改前须获得明确确认"）仅写在提示词里，模型只能"尽量"遵守，不可靠且在产生副作用后无法挽回。需要一种从系统层面而非提示层面保证规则被执行的方法。
AI.method: 借鉴 typestate 与会话类型思想，把智能体接口定义为有限状态协议并在运行时强制：每轮仅向模型提供当前状态下合法的工具；越界调用在产生副作用前被拒；需人工决策的只能请求；token 与工具调用预算被计费并按线性比例跨交接分配；协议在定义时即检查，子类若可能绕过父类协议则被拒绝（行为式 Liskov 替换）。
AI.result: 在 tau-bench 的 50 个航空任务上评测，并加入施压跳过确认的模拟客户：标准智能体在 gpt-4.1 下有 13/50 任务、Claude Haiku 5.5 下有 29/128 次运行在未获"yes"时做了修改；Concordat 智能体为 0 次，且任务成功率无显著差异。tau-bench 自带奖励未能检测出大多数此类违规。
AI.conclusion: 将协议约束从提示词迁移到运行时的类型化接口，可在不损失成功率的前提下消除违反确认等关键行为违规，且现有基准奖励对该类问题存在检测盲区；Concordat 已开源。

title: Mechanistic Failure Modes of Weight Pruning in Transformer Language Models
summary: Pruned language models are judged almost entirely by accuracy and perplexity, which assumes that preserved output behaviour implies preserved internal computation. We test this assumption with a factorial pruning study on GPT-2, crossing two importance criteria (magnitude, random), two component types (attention heads, MLP neurons) and three sparsity levels (3%, 50%, 70%). Using the fully characterised indirect object identification (IOI) circuit as ground truth, we measure circuit integrity with activation patching, path patching and direct logit attribution. We find two qualitatively distinct failure modes. Magnitude head pruning >= zeroes the circuit: output-facing heads are removed, and the model falls to near-chance. Magnitude neuron pruning at 30% inverts it: all 26 circuit heads remain intact, but Name Mover contributions flip sign, and the model systematically prefers the wrong name (17.7% accuracy). Perplexity ranks it as less damaged than random head pruning (74.6 vs 140.1). A replication of the Greater-Than circuit shows that the critical component type depends on the circuit's architecture. These results show that output metrics and structural checks can both miss mechanistic damage, motivating circuit-level causal analysis as a complementary evaluation of compressed language models.

AI.tldr: 该研究用GPT-2的IOI电路做因子剪枝实验，发现幅度剪枝会造成两种截然不同的机制性破坏（电路归零与电路反转），而这些破坏在困惑度等输出指标和组件保留的结构检查中均无法被发现。
AI.motivation: 剪枝模型通常只用准确率和困惑度评估，隐含假设"输出行为保留即内部计算保留"。作者要检验这一假设是否成立，即压缩后的模型是否可能在输出指标尚可的情况下出现内部电路的机制性损伤。
AI.method: 在GPT-2上做2×2×3析因剪枝：重要性准则（幅度/随机）×组件类型（注意力头/MLP神经元）×稀疏度（3%、50%、70%）。以已充分刻画的间接宾语识别（IOI）电路为真值，用激活修补、路径修补和直接logit归因测量电路完整性；并复现Greater-Than电路以检验结论的可推广性。
AI.result: 发现两类质的不同的失效模式：幅度头剪枝≥某阈值时"电路归零"——面向输出的头被移除，性能降至近随机水平；幅度神经元剪枝30%时"电路反转"——26个电路头全部完好，但Name Mover贡献变号，模型系统性偏好错误名字（准确率17.7%），而困惑度仅74.6，反而被判定比随机头剪枝（140.1）损伤更小。Greater-Than电路复现表明关键组件类型取决于电路架构。
AI.conclusion: 输出指标与结构检查都可能漏掉机制性损伤，因此需要电路级因果分析作为压缩语言模型评估的补充手段；"保留组件"不等于"保留计算"，"保留输出"也不等于"保留机制"。

title: INTR++: INterpretable TRansformer with better Accuracy, Interpretability, and Adaptability
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)
summary: Interpretable Transformers often perform well in domain specific settings but lose effectiveness beyond that. Achieving ViT-like broad applicability requires models with consistent performance across domains. Recent works on Interpretable Transformers, INTR and Prompt-CAM, were developed keeping domain adaptability in mind. Prompt-CAM leverages learnable prompts to promote adaptability. However, these prompts are fixed in nature and therefore struggle to adapt to domains with substantial variation in input image characteristics, resulting in reduced interpretability. To address this limitation, we propose INTR++, which extends Prompt-CAM by incorporating a lightweight Prompt Adapter Module (PAM). PAM enables prompts to be adaptive by enriching them with domain-specific knowledge, thereby ensuring consistent interpretability across diverse domains including those with varying image characteristics such as medical imaging, micro-scopic imaging, and remote sensing imagery. INTR++ retains the standard architecture and end-to-end learning of Interpretable Transformer based models, while adding only a small number of additional parameters compared to Prompt-CAM. We demonstrate that INTR++ delivers consistent improvements in all aspects across domains like animals, plants, medical imaging, microscopic imaging, remote sensing imagery and object-centric data.

AI.tldr: 提出INTR++，在Prompt-CAM基础上加入轻量级Prompt Adapter Module（PAM），使可学习提示能注入领域特定知识，从而在医学、显微、遥感等多领域保持一致的Transformer可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释Transformer（如INTR、Prompt-CAM）虽注重领域适应性，但Prompt-CAM的可学习提示是固定/静态的，难以适应输入图像特征变化大的领域，导致可解释性下降。作者希望实现ViT般的广泛适用性，即在跨领域（图像特征差异大）情形下保持一致的性能与可解释性。
AI.method: INTR++扩展Prompt-CAM，增加轻量级Prompt Adapter Module（PAM）。PAM通过用领域特定知识丰富提示使其自适应；模型保留标准可解释Transformer架构与端到端学习方式，仅比Prompt-CAM增加少量参数。
AI.result: 在动物、植物、医学影像、显微影像、遥感和以物体为中心的数据等多个领域上，INTR++在所有方面均取得一致的性能提升；同时仅增加很少的参数量。
AI.conclusion: 让提示自适应（通过PAM引入领域知识）是提升可解释Transformer跨领域一致性的有效途径；INTR++在保持架构简洁和参数高效的同时，实现了跨不同图像特征领域的稳定可解释性。

title: Live-OPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Proactive Streaming Large Video Models
summary: Streaming multimodal assistants must make response decisions while events are still unfolding. They need to recognize when the available evidence warrants a response, produce an appropriate continuation, and remain silent otherwise. Supervised fine-tuning learns from recorded assistant turns, but does not directly train on the response prefixes produced by the evolving policy itself. We introduce Live-OPSD, an on-policy self-distillation method that uses privileged hints available only during training to supervise the policy on its own outputs. The policy first generates a continuation from the streaming context alone. The same model then re-evaluates that continuation with a hint describing the relevant evidence, and the resulting distributions guide the unhinted policy. On Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B, Live-OPSD attains an average score of 59.64 on LiveProBench, 5.26 points above the strongest continued-SFT baseline, and stays competitive on OVO-Bench (65.84). These results indicate that guiding the policy on its own outputs with privileged hints improves both when and how a streaming assistant responds.

AI.tldr: Live-OPSD：一种on-policy自蒸馏方法，用仅训练时可得的"特权提示"监督流式多模态助手的自身输出，提升其"何时应答"与"如何应答"的能力。
AI.motivation: 流式多模态助手需在事件仍在发展时决定是否应答。监督微调仅从记录的助手回合学习，无法直接训练策略自身生成的前缀，导致对自身输出分布缺乏适配。
AI.method: Live-OPSD先在仅有流式上下文、无提示条件下由策略生成续写；同一模型再结合描述相关证据的特权提示（仅训练可用）重新评估该续写；用两者分布差异指导无提示策略，实现 on-policy 自蒸馏。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B 上，LiveProBench 平均得分 59.64，比最强持续SFT基线高 5.26 分；OVO-Bench 得 65.84，保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 用特权提示在策略自身输出上给予指导，可同时改善流式助手是否应答与时机的判断及应答质量，验证了 on-policy 自蒸馏在该任务上的有效性。

title: From Interaction to Capability: Task Advancement as State and Supervision for GUI Agents
summary: GUI memory should preserve the results of past actions and learn reusable operations. This is difficult in long-horizon workflows, where agents must use information across applications and useful operations are interleaved with failed attempts. We introduce Task Advancement Memory (TAM), which defines task advancement as verified task progress, and supports ongoing task execution and learns reusable operations.
