During execution, Task Advancement State represents how verified task progress changes the remaining goals, allowing the agent to build on earlier achievements across applications. After each task, advancement supervision identifies and abstracts the interactions that produced a verified local result. The learned operations preserve the relation between required inputs, expected outcomes, and verification conditions. This retains locally successful operations from both successful and failed tasks. On MobileWorld GUI-only tasks, Advancement State alone raises success from 12.0% to 28.2%. Full TAM achieves a 17.6% relative gain in task success over the strongest evaluated baseline and reduces lifecycle tokens per solved task by 38.7%. On SPA-Bench, TAM achieves state-of-the-art task success in the single-app English Level 3 setting.

AI.tldr: 提出任务推进记忆（TAM），以"已验证的任务进展"定义任务推进，支持跨应用长时程执行并学习可复用操作。
AI.motivation: 长时程GUI工作流中，代理需跨应用复用信息，而有用的操作常与失败尝试交织，现有记忆难以保存过去动作结果并学习可复用操作。
AI.method: TAM包含两部分：执行期用"任务推进状态"表示已验证进展如何改变剩余目标，使代理能跨应用在既有成果上继续；任务后用推进监督识别并抽象出产生已验证局部结果的交互，学习保留输入、预期结果与验证条件之间关系的可复用操作，从而保留成功与失败任务中的局部成功操作。
AI.result: MobileWorld纯GUI任务上，仅用推进状态即使成功率从12.0%升至28.2%；完整TAM相较最强基线任务成功率相对提升17.6%，每个已解任务的整个生命周期token减少38.7%；SPA-Bench单应用英文Level 3设置达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 以"已验证进展"为核心的状态表示与操作抽象，可显著提升长时程GUI代理的成功率并降低token开销，验证了从失败任务中提取可复用局部操作的可行性。

title: VGIQA: Fine-Grained Image Quality Assessment with Visual Grounding Rewards
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables; main paper: 4 figures and 4 tables, appendix: 1 figure and 2 tables
summary: Image quality assessment (IQA) aims to evaluate the perceptual visual quality of images. Recently, the rapid development of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has significantly advanced the IQA field. By integrating chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and reinforcement learning (RL), these models can generate more accurate and interpretable results while relying on less training data. However, existing MLLM-based methods are predominantly constrained to holistic, image-level evaluations and lack the capability to produce fine-grained, localized assessments, which substantially limits their practical applicability. To address this limitation, we propose VGIQA, a novel IQA model endowed with both local and global quality assessment capabilities. VGIQA is trained via a two-stage paradigm comprising a cold-start phase followed by reinforcement learning. Driven by carefully designed local quality assessment reward functions, our model exhibits exceptional image quality understanding on VGSR-2K, a new dataset we propose specifically for local quality evaluation, significantly outperforming existing open-source MLLMs such as Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct and Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct. Furthermore, the local quality evaluation task can effectively enhance the model's performance on the degradation perception task.

AI.tldr: 提出VGIQA，一种兼具局部与全局质量评估能力的多模态大模型IQA方法，采用冷启动+强化学习两阶段训练，并构建局部质量评估数据集VGSR-2K。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MLLM的IQA方法主要局限于整图级别的整体评价，缺乏细粒度、局部化的评估能力，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: VGIQA采用两阶段训练范式：先冷启动，再进行强化学习，并设计专门的局部质量评估奖励函数；同时提出用于局部质量评估的新数据集VGSR-2K。
AI.result: 在VGSR-2K上表现出优异的图像质量理解能力，显著优于Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct、Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct等开源MLLM；且局部质量评估任务能有效提升模型的退化感知性能。
AI.conclusion: VGIQA实现了局部与全局质量评估的统一，验证了局部评估任务对退化感知的促进作用，为细粒度IQA提供了可行方案。

title: On the VC Dimension of Autoregressive Linear Threshold Functions
summary: Linear threshold functions (LTFs) are a canonical class of Boolean predictors. In the autoregressive setting, the same LTF reads the most recent $d$ bits, generates the next bit, and returns the bit produced after $T$ steps. While the one-step class has VC dimension $d$, for general $T$ the counting upper bound is $O(d^2)$. We prove that the VC dimension is $Θ(d^2)$ for every $T\ge d^2$, resolving the quadratic gap for deterministic autoregressive LTFs. We then adapt the same technique to show an exponential separation between deterministic and stochastic autoregressive models: replacing the sign of LTFs by logistic sampling can increase the VC dimension of the final majority prediction class from quadratic to exponential in $d$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明确定性自回归线性阈值函数（LTA）在T≥d²时VC维恰为Θ(d²)，并为随机（logistic采样）版本给出了指数级分离。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型（同一函数反复读取最近d位、生成下一位）的一般T情形，此前仅有O(d²)的计数上界与一步情形VC维d之间相差二次的间隙，缺乏紧确结果；同时确定性与随机自回归类的表达能力差异未被刻画。
AI.method: 利用线性阈值函数与几何/组合工具构造下界实例，证明当T≥d²时最终预测类的VC维达到Ω(d²)，与计数上界O(d²)匹配；进而将同一技术迁移到用logistic采样替代sign的随机模型。
AI.result: 证明了对于所有T≥d²，确定性自回归LTF的VC维为Θ(d²)，封闭了二次间隙；并证明把sign换成logistic采样可使最终多数预测类的VC维从d的二次增长提升到d的指数增长，形成指数级分离。
AI.conclusion: 确定性自回归LTF的VC维在T≥d²时已是二次最优；随机化（logistic采样）虽只做微小改动，却能带来指数级的表达能力跃升，说明随机性在自回归模型中具有本质作用。

title: TeamGym: A Gym for Team Decision-Making by AI Agents with Distributed Information
summary: Many real-world decisions require teams to integrate information distributed across participants. Yet AI agents are still primarily trained and benchmarked in isolation. We introduce TeamGym, an environment for evaluating and training language model-based agents on team decision-making problems constructed from real-world legal, finance, medical, and software engineering corpora. TeamGym introduces a method to identify a minimal set of facts, each element of which is necessary and all of which are collectively sufficient for a correct final decision, which we call pivotal information. This enables TeamGym to both control the distribution of pivotal information and track how well agents identify and integrate pivotal information when making team decisions. Examining 8 language models on 12 source corpora, we find that current AI agents often fail to effectively share information: Distributing pivotal information across participants lowers success rate by 22.9 percentage points on average relative to giving the same information to a single model (a communication gap). We also document that participants do not effectively retrieve decision-relevant information on their own: A team's success rate is lowered by a further 19.9 points when participants must identify and extract pivotal information from source material rather than receiving it directly (a retrieval gap). To help remedy these deficits, we use TeamGym to train policies through reinforcement learning on team decision loss. Across two policy-training experiments, we find that training improves final-decision quality and induces emergent coordination in participation, speaker selection, and communication, even though the reward evaluates only the final decision.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 TeamGym，一个基于真实法律、金融、医疗与软件工程语料构建的团队决策评测与训练环境，通过"关键信息"（pivotal information）控制信息分布，发现并量化了 LLM 智能体的通信缺口与检索缺口，并用团队决策损失进行强化学习训练来缓解这些缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现实决策常需团队整合分散在成员间的信息，但 AI 智能体主要在孤立条件下训练和评测，缺乏对团队协作能力的系统评估与改进手段。
AI.method: 构建 TeamGym 环境，从真实法律、金融、医疗、软件工程语料生成团队决策任务；提出识别"关键信息"（每条必要、整体充分）的方法，以控制关键信息分布并追踪智能体的识别与整合能力。在 12 个语料上评测 8 个语言模型，并通过强化学习在团队决策损失上训练策略（两组实验）。
AI.result: 相对于把相同信息交给单一模型，将关键信息分散给多个参与者会使成功率平均下降 22.9 个百分点（通信缺口）；若参与者还需自行从原始材料中提取关键信息，成功率再降 19.9 个百分点（检索缺口）。强化学习训练可提升最终决策质量，并在参与、发言选择和沟通上涌现出协调行为，尽管奖励仅评估最终决策。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 智能体在信息共享与自主检索方面存在显著不足；TeamGym 既能诊断这些缺陷，也能通过以最终决策为奖励的强化学习有效训练团队协作能力并诱发涌现式协调。

title: Uncovering Shortcut Amplification in Video RLVR through the Lens of Perceptual Uncertainty Collapse
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for enhancing the video reasoning capability of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). Despite its empirical effectiveness, we show that outcome-level optimization can introduce an undesirable shortcut amplification effect, whereby models increasingly favor text-prior answers even when they are not supported by the visual evidence. To characterize this behavior, we investigate the training dynamics of video RLVR through the lens of perceptual uncertainty, analyzing how predictive uncertainty evolves under video-conditioned and text-only contexts. Our analysis identifies a perceptual uncertainty collapse phenomenon, in which RL training continuously sharpens the model's answer distribution while the uncertainty reduction attributable to visual evidence progressively diminishes. A further gradient-direction analysis reveals that such confidence enhancement becomes increasingly less aligned with visually grounded uncertainty reduction and is instead dominated by text-prior compression. Motivated by these findings, we propose Bifocal Self-distillation Policy Optimization (BSPO), a self-distillation framework that regulates policy updates with two complementary distributional signals. Specifically, BSPO derives empirical reasoning principles from intra-group correct and incorrect rollouts to identify reasoning-sensitive tokens, and introduces shortcut-aware visual perturbation to penalize predictions that remain invariant when task-relevant visual evidence is weakened. By adaptively reweighting the original RL advantage, BSPO preserves the task-solving benefits of RLVR while promoting updates that are both reasoning-sensitive and visually grounded. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of BSPO in improving video reasoning performance and strengthening visual faithfulness.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示视频RLVR中的"感知不确定性坍缩"与捷径放大现象，并提出BSPO自蒸馏方法来修正策略更新。
AI.motivation: RLVR虽提升LMM视频推理，但结果级优化会导致捷径放大：模型越来越偏向文本先验答案，即便缺乏视觉证据支持。
AI.method: 通过感知不确定性视角分析训练动态（视频条件 vs 纯文本条件），并进行梯度方向分析。据此提出BSPO：从组内正确/错误rollout中提取经验推理原则以识别推理敏感token，并引入捷径感知的视觉扰动来惩罚视觉证据被削弱时仍不变的预测，自适应重加权原始RL优势。
AI.result: 实验验证BSPO提升视频推理性能并增强视觉忠实度（visual faithfulness）。
AI.conclusion: 结果级RLVR存在不确定性坍缩与文本先验压缩问题；BSPO以推理敏感+视觉 grounded 的双重信号调节更新，兼顾任务收益与视觉忠实。

title: 3D-SceneQ: Empowering 3D LLM With Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning and Multi-Modal Feature Enhancement
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Published in IEEE Transactions on Multimedia
summary: Current 3D scene understanding pipelines typically concatenate vast numbers of 3D object tokens with text tokens and feed the resulting sequence to a Large Language Model (LLM). However, existing 3D-LLMs for scene understanding encounter two major limitations: (i) excessive inclusion of task-irrelevant object data, introducing noise that reduces reasoning accuracy and increases hallucinations; and (ii) reliance solely on point cloud data, which inherently lacks the rich semantic information available in complementary 2D modalities, such as color, material properties, texture, and high-level contextual relationships. To address these challenges, we introduce 3D-SceneQ, a 3D LLM that unifies adaptive token pruning with multimodal semantic enrichment, markedly advancing scene understanding, reasoning, and grounding. Specifically, we propose a Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning (QGAP) module that adaptively selects task-relevant objects based on the intended meaning of user instructions, leveraging a learnable latent query to retain critical information while effectively suppressing irrelevant noise. In addition, we introduce a Multi-modal Object-level Feature Enhancement (MOFE) module, which integrates 2D feature embeddings from pre-trained models into 3D representation to enrich object-level semantic information. Evaluations show that 3D-SceneQ outperforms current state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks (e.g., +5.7 CIDEr on Scan2Cap and +17.0 EM@1 on SQA3D), demonstrating its remarkable capabilities in various 3D language reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出3D-SceneQ，通过查询引导的自适应token剪枝（QGAP）与多模态物体级特征增强（MOFE），解决3D-LLM中冗余物体token噪声和点云语义不足问题，在Scan2Cap、SQA3D等基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景理解流程将海量3D物体token与文本token拼接输入LLM，存在两大缺陷：(i) 引入大量任务无关物体数据，带来噪声，降低推理准确率并加剧幻觉；(ii) 仅依赖点云，缺乏2D模态中丰富的颜色、材质、纹理及高层上下文等语义信息。
AI.method: 1) Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning（QGAP）：依据用户指令意图，利用可学习潜在查询自适应选择任务相关物体，保留关键信息并抑制无关噪声；2) Multi-modal Object-level Feature Enhancement（MOFE）：将预训练2D模型的特征嵌入融合进3D表示，丰富物体级语义。两者统一于3D-LLM框架中。
AI.result: 在多个基准上超越现有SOTA，例如Scan2Cap上CIDEr提升5.7，SQA3D上EM@1提升17.0，在多种3D语言推理任务中展现出较强能力。
AI.conclusion: 自适应token剪枝与多模态语义增强的结合能显著提升3D场景理解、推理与定位性能，验证了减少冗余token与引入2D语义信息对3D-LLM的有效性。摘要未提及具体局限。

title: GNN-Guided Network Reduction for Centralized Urban Traffic Routing
comment: Submitted for review to Computers & Operations Research
summary: We consider the centralized traffic routing (CTR) problem, where a central planner assigns routes to origin-destination (OD) vehicle flows to minimize congestion-dependent segment cost. Prior work formulates CTR efficiently as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP), but scaling this formulation to the full road network is computationally prohibitive within an operational time budget. Bounded Routes and Smart Routes speed up optimization using precomputed reduced networks; however, these methods do not account for vehicle information within each OD flow. Motivated by this gap, we propose a learning-based urban network reduction approach. A dedicated graph neural network (GNN) first scores road segments for each OD flow using the road network and vehicle-flow information. Highly ranked segments are then incorporated into complete OD routes, and the original segment-flow MILP is solved on the resulting reduced road network. The GNN thus guides the reduction of the road network, while the solver enforces feasibility and determines the routing. Experiments on four real urban networks -- Prague-Dejvice, London, New York, and Sydney -- show that the proposed approach achieves the smallest relative objective difference to the $30$-second full-graph reference in every city under both traffic regimes. Averaged across cities, this difference is more than six times lower than that of the best competing method. Moreover, traffic simulation results show that the optimization gains of the proposed method lead to more efficient routing, with the highest aggregate arrival rate and a competitive trip duration per arrival percentage point.

AI.tldr: 提出基于图神经网络的城路网约简方法，为每个OD流打分筛选路段，再在约简网络上求解MILP，实现快速且高质量的集中式交通路由。
AI.motivation: CTR的MILP形式在完整路网上计算代价过高，难以在运行时间预算内求解；已有的Bounded Routes和Smart Routes等约简方法未利用每个OD流内的车辆信息。
AI.method: 用专用GNN结合路网与车辆流信息为每个OD流对路段打分，将高分路段纳入完整OD路径，在约简路网上求解原始路段流MILP；GNN负责引导约简，求解器保证可行性与最终路由。
AI.result: 在Prague-Dejvice、London、New York、Sydney四个真实路网、两种交通情形下，与30秒全图参考解的相对目标差最小；跨城市平均比最佳对比方法低六倍以上；交通仿真显示聚合到达率最高、每次到达百分点行程时间具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 学习方法可有效约简城市路网，在保持解质量的同时提升CTR的可扩展性，并带来实际路由效率收益。

title: Timestral
summary: We introduce Timestral, a family of four time series foundation models for probabilistic forecasting, with 5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M parameters. Timestral sets a new state of the art on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench, where Timestral-209M and Timestral-123M take the top two places on every metric. We achieve this with three ingredients: Decoupled Horizon Forecasting (DHF), which separates prediction tokens from the causally encoded context, so that longer horizons are trained without masking context and each observed value is both a forecast target and context for later forecasts; a covariate framework that natively supports known-future covariates within a causal architecture; and a two-stage pipeline that pretrains exclusively on a diverse, large-scale synthetic corpus before post-training on a mix of real and synthetic data with extended context. This report describes the model design and its benchmark results. Weights for all four models are available on Hugging Face and inference code on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出Timestral系列（5M/28M/123M/209M）概率预测时间序列基础模型，在GIFT-Eval、TIME、fev-bench三基准上均刷新SOTA，209M与123M各指标排名前二。
AI.motivation: 现有时序基础模型在长horizon预测中需对上下文进行掩码，限制了上下文利用效率；且因果架构难以原生支持已知未来协变量。
AI.method: 三要素：(1) Decoupled Horizon Forecasting (DHF)，将预测token与因果编码上下文分离，长horizon训练无需掩码上下文，每个观测值既作预测目标又作后续预测的上下文；(2) 原生支持已知未来协变量的协变量框架；(3) 两阶段流程：先在大规模多样化合成语料上预训练，再用真实+合成混合数据及扩展上下文进行后训练。
AI.result: 在GIFT-Eval、TIME、fev-bench上取得新的SOTA，Timestral-209M与Timestral-123M在所有指标上包揽前两名；四个模型权重已发布于Hugging Face，推理代码开源在GitHub。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦预测与上下文、原生协变量支持及合成预训练+真实后训练的两阶段范式，可在较小参数规模下实现时序概率预测的领先性能，并已开放模型与代码。

title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
summary: Language model agents are post-trained and deployed through a harness, the prompts, tools, and control logic that present a task to the model and execute its outputs. Harnesses are often revised and judged by how an already trained model performs under them, which assumes that what the model learned under one harness carries over to the next. We ask what a policy learns from its harness and what survives when the harness changes. Under KL-regularized control, we show that the log odds of an optimal policy recover how strongly its harness favors each action over the others, so a trained policy carries the preferences of its harness. Deployed return then equals the ceiling of the harness, the best return it offers, minus the mismatch of the policy, the return lost to its own suboptimal decisions. Training changes only the mismatch, while changing the harness moves both terms. Comparing harnesses with a fixed model therefore mixes what each harness offers with how well that model uses it. In MiniWoB++, post-training makes a model's preferences specific to its training harness. Reversing the order of the observation fields leaves every optimal decision unchanged yet lowers a trained model's success from 85.0% to 19.2%. Conversely, every new harness that a fixed-model comparison rejects but that raises the ceiling outperforms the original agent after further training under it, and ceiling and mismatch measured beforehand predict these gains. For coding-agent harnesses on Terminal-Bench Lite, ceiling minus mismatch estimated with a stronger model as a stand-in for the optimum reproduces the accuracy ranking, while either term alone does not. Code is available at https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"harness"视角的政策理论分析：KL正则控制下，最优策略的log odds反映harness对各动作的偏好强度；部署回报 = harness天花板 − 策略失配。训练只改变失配项，换harness同时改变两项。实验在MiniWoB++与Terminal-Bench Lite上验证该分解的预测力。
AI.motivation: 现有工作常以"固定模型在新harness下的表现"来评价和修改harness，隐含假设模型在旧harness学到的偏好可迁移到新harness。作者质疑这一假设，追问：策略从harness中学到了什么？换harness后哪些学到的内容能保留？
AI.method: 1）在KL正则化控制框架下证明：最优策略的log odds可恢复harness对每个动作的相对偏好，即策略承载了harness的偏好；2）推导部署回报 = harness天花板（其可提供的最佳回报）− 策略失配（自身次优决策造成的损失）；3）实证：MiniWoB++上仅反转观测字段顺序（理论上不改变任何最优决策），测试训练模型的成功率变化；4）用进一步训练验证被固定模型比较否决但抬高天花板的harness；5）Terminal-Bench Lite上用更强模型近似最优，估计天花板与失配，检验二者之差能否复现准确率排序。
AI.result: MiniWoB++中反转观测字段顺序使成功率从85.0%骤降至19.2%，尽管所有最优决策不变；每个被固定模型比较否决但抬高天花板的harness，在进一步训练后均超越原智能体，且事先测得的天花板与失配可预测增益；Terminal-Bench Lite上"天花板−失配"复现了编码agent harness的准确率排序，而单独任一术语无法做到。
AI.conclusion: 策略学到的是harness特异的偏好，而非可迁移的任务能力；固定模型下比较harness会把"harness提供什么"和"模型用得多好"混为一谈。应分别评估天花板与失配，并以之和来评判harness及训练后的潜力。

title: Advancement or Acceleration? How Data Curation Improves LLM Training
summary: While data curation is widely credited with improving large language model training, a basic question remains unresolved: does curation expand what a model can ultimately learn, or merely reach the same solution faster? In this paper, we formalize this distinction between advancement (improving the attainable performance) and acceleration (reaching the same performance with less data). Through an analytic characterization and real-world LLM experiments, we show that advancement requires a correctable train-target gap. When the baseline training and target objectives coincide, no curation policy improves the endpoint, although curation may still accelerate training. This reframes advancement as a property of the curation task rather than the curation method. Under a common gap-centric view of data mixture and selection, we operationalize this condition as the $Δ$-test, an observable discrepancy between the uncurated baseline's training and target losses that is computable prior to expensive curation. Across extensive experiments, an appreciably nonzero $Δ$ predicts persistent gains, whereas gains near $Δ=0$ tend to diminish as the training budget grows. Beyond individual methods, our findings recenter data curation on the task itself and point to target-set construction as a promising direction for shaping what curation can achieve.

AI.tldr: 数据策展是提升性能（advancement）还是加速收敛（acceleration）？本文证明前者需存在"可纠正的训练-目标差距"，并提出可预先计算的可观测Δ检验。
AI.motivation: 业界普遍认为数据策展能改善LLM训练，但一个基本问题未解决：策展究竟是扩展了模型最终能学到的能力上限，还是仅更快到达同一解。这一区分对数据工作投入方向有根本意义。
AI.method: 形式化区分advancement（提升可达性能）与acceleration（以更少数据达到同样性能）；通过解析刻画与真实LLM实验分析二者条件；在"差距中心"的数据混合与选择视角下，将条件操作化为Δ-test——即未策展基线训练损失与目标损失之间的可观测差异，可在昂贵策展前计算。
AI.result: 解析表明，advancement需要存在可纠正的训练-目标差距；当基线训练与目标目标一致时，任何策展策略都无法提升终点，只能加速。实验中，显著非零的Δ预示持续增益，而Δ≈0处的增益随训练预算增大而消退。
AI.conclusion: advancement是策展任务（而非策展方法）的属性；应将数据策展重新聚焦于任务本身，并把目标集构建作为塑造策展效果的关键方向。

title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
summary: When an LLM group's discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria. On hidden-profile tasks both look attractive, because how widely a fact is held is confounded with whether it helps. We introduce CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 templates with automatically verified answer keys, in which the ownership of supporting, decoy, and irrelevant facts is crossed while their text is held fixed (480 tasks). Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and two DeepSeek models, both heuristics fail in predictable places. Selecting by relevance readmits decoys, because decoys are on topic: even a perfect relevance filter loses 23 to 31 points to rarest-first selection in the classic hidden-profile configuration. Rarest-first selection is no better than random selection on average and wins only where the rare facts happen to be the useful ones. In both cases accuracy follows the balance of evidence the memory keeps, not the policy that kept it. The decision model adds a third failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to facts attributed to many agents. Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random with line order fixed, raises accuracy in the classic configuration by 13 to 24 points. In natural discussions the evidence is lost before any memory acts: the complete transcript yields lower accuracy than no notes at all.

AI.tldr: 论文提出诊断性基准CrossProfile（60个模板、480个任务），检验LLM群体讨论压缩为短记忆时的选择策略。发现"选最稀有"和"选与决策标准相关"两种启发式均在可预测处失效：相关过滤会重新引入诱饵事实，稀有优先平均不如随机；最终准确率取决于记忆保留的证据平衡，而非保留策略；决策模型还存在社会证明偏差，去除归因标签可提升13-24分；自然讨论中证据在记忆介入前已丢失。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体讨论需压缩成短记忆交给最终决策者，但"记忆应保留什么"缺乏清晰准则。在hidden-profile任务中，"稀有度"与"有用性"相互混淆，使两种直观启发式（选最稀有事实、选与标准相关事实）表面上都很有效，难以评估其真实优劣。作者需要可控的基准来解耦这些因素，揭示启发式的失效机理。
AI.method: 构建CrossProfile基准：60个模板、自动验证答案键、480个任务。通过交叉分配支持性、诱饵和无关事实的"归属"（由哪些智能体持有）而保持其文本固定，从而解耦"持有广度"与"是否有用"。在Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B和两个DeepSeek模型上评测稀有优先、相关性过滤等策略，并做去除/随机重排归因标签的消融实验。
AI.result: 相关性过滤因诱饵在主题上相关而重新引入诱饵，即便完美的相关过滤器也比重稀有优先在经典hidden-profile配置下低23-31分；稀有优先平均不优于随机，仅在稀有事实恰好有用时获胜。两种情况下准确率都取决于记忆保留的证据平衡而非策略本身。决策模型存在社会证明偏差，对多数智能体持有的事实加权；去除归因标签或在固定行序下随机重排，在经典配置下提升准确率13-24分。自然讨论中，完整转录的准确率甚至低于完全不做笔记。
AI.conclusion: 记忆选择策略的价值不足以决定最终准确率，关键在于所保留证据的整体平衡；决策者应避免基于归因数量的社会证明偏差；自然讨论场景中证据在记忆机制发挥作用前已流失，需从源头的讨论与信息呈现方式改进。

title: Zhengrong-Spatial-Aware 1.0: Advancing 3D Multimodal Intelligence
summary: This report presents the implementation and validation of two end-to-end multimodal adaptation pipelines for 3D-aware visual question answering on a custom spatial dataset. The first pipeline fine-tunes HiSpatial-3B, which augments RGB observations with metric-scale 3D point maps; the second adapts Qwen3-VL through memory-efficient QLoRA-based supervised fine-tuning. The completed engineering stack covers dataset conversion, image-annotation alignment, monocular geometry preprocessing, instruction construction, mixed-domain training, checkpoint management, batch inference, and automated evaluation. On the target spatial benchmark, HiSpatial adaptation increases overall accuracy from 1.73% before fine-tuning to 79.89% at 3,600 steps. On a separately collected styled split, accuracy improves from 14.9% to 55.1%, indicating transfer beyond the original training set. The Qwen3-VL pipeline is likewise implemented end-to-end for both 8B- and 32B-scale models using mixed-domain QLoRA adaptation. The resulting accuracy improves from 20.74% to 45.27% for Qwen3-VL-8B and from 30.79% to 47.60% for Qwen3-VL-32B. Together, these results establish two complementary and reproducible adaptation pipelines for geometry-aware and general-purpose multimodal spatial reasoning. These results establish a reproducible engineering foundation for subsequent work on metric 3D reasoning, spatial grounding, and domain-adapted multimodal systems, while also identifying training-data composition as a central factor in preserving general multimodal capability during specialization.

AI.tldr: 本文实现并验证了两套端到端多模态适配流水线用于3D感知的视觉问答：一是基于HiSpatial-3B（RGB+度量尺度3D点图），二是基于Qwen3-VL的QLoRA监督微调。自定义空间基准上，HiSpatial准确率由1.73%升至79.89%（3600步），风格化测试集由14.9%升至55.1%；Qwen3-VL-8B由20.74%升至45.27%，32B由30.79%升至47.60%。
AI.motivation: 面向度量3D推理与空间定位的专用化需求，需要一个可复现、覆盖数据转换到自动评测的完整工程栈，并比较"几何增强专用模型"与"通用大模型QLoRA适配"两条互补路线，同时考察专业化训练中数据配比对通用能力的保持影响。
AI.method: 构建两套流水线：(1) 微调HiSpatial-3B，将RGB观测与度量尺度3D点图结合；(2) 通过内存高效的QLoRA监督微调适配Qwen3-VL（8B与32B）。工程栈涵盖数据集转换、图像-标注对齐、单目几何预处理、指令构建、混合域训练、检查点管理、批量推理与自动评测，采用混合域数据训练。
AI.result: 目标空间基准上HiSpatial整体准确率1.73%→79.89%（3600步）；独立采集的风格化切分上14.9%→55.1%，显示跨集迁移。Qwen3-VL-8B 20.74%→45.27%，Qwen3-VL-32B 30.79%→47.60%。
AI.conclusion: 两条流水线互补且可复现，为度量3D推理、空间定位与领域自适应多模态系统提供了工程基础；同时指出训练数据组成是专业化过程中保持通用多模态能力的关键因素。

title: CaLLM: Continual Adaptation of LLMs via Non-Parametric Adapter Routing
comment: Accepted at 5th Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents (CoLLAs), Main Conference Track, 2026
summary: Continual adaptation of large language models (LLMs) to evolving task distributions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting remains an open problem. Existing strategies often struggle to scale or lack a robust mechanism for zero-shot task-to-expert assignment. We introduce CaLLM, a framework that resolves these tensions by combining metric-based meta-learning with modular parameter isolation via lightweight adapters. First, CaLLM projects each input batch into a task-agnostic embedding space to find its nearest prototype. It then routes the batch to the specific adapter specialized for that data distribution. This formulation provides (i)~controllable cross-task interference by design, (ii)~constant computational complexity regardless of task count, (iii)~seamless integration of novel distributions through prototype expansion, and (iv)~regime agnosticism as the local routing decision enables a unified approach to both online and offline settings. Our experiments demonstrate that this routing mechanism discovers semantically coherent task groupings while facilitating constructive interference between similar tasks, and keeping overhead at a minimum. Across diverse and fine-grained continual learning benchmarks, CaLLM consistently outperforms traditional isolation and replay methods, establishing prototype-based modular routing as a principled and scalable approach to lifelong adaptation of LLMs.

AI.tldr: CaLLM结合度量元学习与轻量适配器模块化参数隔离，用原型路由实现LLM持续适配。
AI.motivation: LLM需持续适配演化任务分布且避免灾难性遗忘，现有方法难以扩展、缺乏鲁棒的零样本任务-专家分配机制。
AI.method: 将输入批次投影到任务无关嵌入空间找最近原型，路由到对应分布特化的适配器；通过原型扩展接入新分布，统一在线/离线场景。
AI.result: 路由机制发现语义一致的任务分组并促进相似任务间建设性干扰，开销极小；在多类细粒度持续学习基准上稳定优于传统隔离与回放方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于原型的模块化路由是LLM终身适配的原则性、可扩展方案。

title: What Improves During Pretraining? Tracking Knowledge Acquisition with Point-in-Time Models
comment: Accepted to AACL 2026. This version corrects minor errors in the appendix
summary: Language models pretrained on web corpora collected over multiple years learn both general and domain-specific knowledge. How these different kinds of knowledge are learned as pretraining progresses remains unclear. Recent point-in-time models trained on web snapshots from different years provide a way to probe how knowledge prevalence varies over time. Using these models, we propose a temporal variability score (TVS), defined as the coefficient of variation of an item's negative log-likelihood across models. A higher score suggests that the knowledge may be less consistently represented across years of web text. We evaluate six benchmarks covering diverse topics using six models from multiple open-source model families. We find that low- and high-TVS items are learned similarly early in training, but high-TVS items improve faster later on. At the end of the pretraining run, high-TVS items outperform low-TVS items in 34 of 36 model-benchmark settings, with an average advantage of 7.3 points of chance-normalized accuracy. This pattern is most robust on knowledge-intensive tasks, even when comparing items of similar difficulty. Our findings reveal differences in how knowledge is learned over the course of pretraining, with temporal variability providing a diagnostic of these learning dynamics beyond aggregate benchmark scores.

AI.tldr: 提出时间变异性分数(TVS)衡量知识在不同年份网络语料模型间的负对数似然波动，发现高TVS知识在预训练后期提升更快、最终表现更好。
AI.motivation: 预训练于多年网络语料的语言模型同时学到通用与领域知识，但这些不同类型知识在预训练过程中如何被学习仍不清楚。不同年份网络快照训练的时间点模型提供了探究知识流行度随时间变化的手段。
AI.method: 定义TVS为其负对数似然在各时间点模型间的变异系数，TVS越高说明该知识在不同年份网络文本中表征越不一致。在6个涵盖多主题的基准、6个来自多个开源模型族的时间点模型上进行评估。
AI.result: 低TVS与高TVS条目在训练早期学习情况相似，但高TVS条目在后期提升更快；预训练结束时，36个模型-基准设置中有34个高TVS条目表现更优，平均优势为7.3个chance-normalized准确率点。该模式在知识密集型任务上最稳健，即使控制条目难度后仍成立。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了预训练过程中知识学习的差异，表明时间变异性可作为一种超越聚合基准分数的学习动态诊断指标。

title: TopoField: Technical Report for ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D Challenge
comment: Technical Report for ECCV OpenSUN3D Workshop SceneFun3D Benchmark Challenge
summary: Functional segmentation requires locating small interactive parts, such as knobs, buttons, and sockets, in indoor point clouds and returning confidence-ranked instance masks. A point-wise semantic predictor produces a continuous probability field, whereas the benchmark evaluates a discrete set of scored instances. This creates a substantial field-to-instance gap. We present TopoField, a deterministic decoder built on top of VOLT. TopoField first converts 13 test-time forward passes into a semantic consensus field, then decodes instance candidates from the consensus geometry, and finally ranks the candidates in a class-aware manner. The augmentation stage retains the processed-point identity of every fragment prediction, accumulates probabilities in a common point array, normalizes by coverage count, and fuses the resulting caches. The decoding stage separates high-confidence cores from broader support regions, constructs a symmetric radius-pruned point graph, and uses a multi-source graph-geodesic partition to split support regions that contain multiple seeds. On 561 ground-truth instances across 30 validation scenes, an IoU-0.5-valid candidate exists for 67.2% of instances, and top-1 coverage is 20.0%. These complementary measurements motivate joint attention to candidate construction and ranking. TopoField achieves 28.286% AP, 41.383% AP50, and 47.558% AP25. TopoField achieved second place on the ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D Challenge.

AI.tldr: TopoField：基于VOLT的确定性解码器，将点云连续概率场转化为带分数的实例掩码，在ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D挑战赛获第二名（AP 28.286%）。
AI.motivation: 功能分割需要定位室内点云中的小部件（旋钮、按钮、插座）并输出按置信度排序的实例掩码。但逐点语义预测器产出连续概率场，而评测需离散的带分实例集合，存在显著的"场到实例"鸿沟；同时候选构建与排序两方面均需改进。
AI.method: 在VOLT之上构建确定性解码器：1) 增强阶段将13次测试时前向转为语义共识场，保留各片段预测的处理点身份，在公共点数组中累加概率并按覆盖次数归一化后融合缓存；2) 解码阶段分离高置信核心与支撑区域，构建对称半径剪枝点图，用多源图测地分区拆分含多种子的支撑区域；3) 类感知候选排序。
AI.result: 30个验证场景共561个真值实例中，67.2%存在IoU-0.5有效候选，但top-1覆盖率仅20.0%，说明候选构建与排序需共同关注。最终取得AP 28.286%、AP50 41.383%、AP25 47.558%。
AI.conclusion: 该确定性解码流程有效弥合场到实例的差距，在SceneFun3D挑战赛中排名第二；分析表明排序环节仍是主要瓶颈。

title: Meta Models: Models that Model Learning
summary: Every neural-network training run produces not only a model, but also evidence about how models learn. Can these accumulated experiments enable us to predict and compare new training runs before executing them? We study meta-models: models that predict the learning behavior of other models. From this perspective, final-performance prediction, learning-curve prediction, and hyperparameter selection are different queries to the same training response function. We take a first, humble empirical step toward this goal: treating real language-model training records as native numeric data, we find that an off-the-shelf tabular in-context learner, TabPFN, can match or outperform a fine-tuned LLM meta-model in multiple evaluated settings. Whereas recent work fine-tunes LLMs on tokenized configurations at a cost of tens to hundreds of GPU-hours, TabPFN requires seconds of fit-and-predict time without task-specific weight updates. We argue that meta-modeling is better treated as its own numeric modality rather than as a text task for LLMs. Going one step further, augmenting TabPFN with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) further improves accuracy on selected prediction tasks. Finally, we pre-registered a forecast of the Marin Hero Run, a 535B-parameter public training run, whose ground truth is revealed point by point as training progresses, putting meta-model predictions to the test against training outcomes not yet observed at the time of forecasting.

AI.tldr: 该论文把"元模型"（预测其他模型训练行为的模型）视为一种独立的数值模态，发现现成表格上下文学习器 TabPFN 在多个任务上能匹敌甚至超越微调 LLM 元模型，且耗时仅数秒；叠加 KAN 可进一步提升精度，并对 535B 参数训练运行做了预注册预测。
AI.motivation: 每次神经网络训练不仅产出模型，还产出关于模型如何学习的证据。作者希望利用累积的历史训练实验，在真正执行前预测和比较新的训练运行。作者主张最终性能预测、学习曲线预测和超参数选择本质上是同一训练响应函数的不同查询，而近期工作用 LLM 对 token 化配置做微调，代价高达数十至数百 GPU 小时，效率低下。
AI.method: 将真实语言模型训练记录当作原生数值数据而非文本任务处理；使用现成表格上下文学习器 TabPFN 直接拟合并预测，无需任务特定权重更新；进一步将 TabPFN 与 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) 结合以增强预测能力；并与在 token 化配置上微调的 LLM 元模型进行对比。最后对 535B 参数公开训练运行 Marin Hero Run 做预注册预测，随训练进展逐点揭示真值进行检验。
AI.result: TabPFN 在多个评估设置下匹配或超越微调的 LLM 元模型，而只需数秒的拟合与预测时间，相比后者数十至数百 GPU 小时的微调成本大幅降低；在部分预测任务上，TabPFN 加 KAN 的增强版本精度进一步提升。Marin Hero Run 的预注册预测提供了对新训练结果的真实前瞻性检验。
AI.conclusion: 元建模更适合被当作独立的数值模态来处理，而不是交给 LLM 作为文本任务完成。简单的表格上下文学习器（TabPFN）即可成为高效且具竞争力的元模型基线，结合 KAN 可进一步增强，预注册预测则为该方向提供了严格的外部验证范式。

title: KPPax: preprocess differentiable kinetic ODE for machine learning in atmospheric chemistry
summary: Atmospheric chemical mechanisms are commonly distributed in the language of the Kinetic PreProcessor (KPP), which generates efficient Fortran or C code but does not fit into the differentiable programming frameworks in which machine-learning models are developed. We present KPPax, a kinetic preprocessor that generates differentiable, just-in-time compiled, and vectorisable chemistry code in JAX from mechanisms written in the KPP language. KPPax evaluates the rate law with sparse operations in log space, which keeps it differentiable, and integrates the stiff system with the implicit solvers and the forward- and reverse-mode adjoints of the \texttt{diffrax} library, so that exact sensitivities are obtained without hand-derived adjoint code. We demonstrate two applications with the POLLU benchmark mechanism. In the first, the Fisher information matrix computed from an automatically differentiated Jacobian predicts, before any fit, which of the 25 rate coefficients a flow-tube-like design can identify, and noisy synthetic estimation confirms the predicted uncertainties of the nine identifiable rate coefficients to within about 30\% while revealing clusters of fast reactions of which only ratios are constrained. In the second, a neural-network correction of an emission inventory is trained offline on per-scenario 4D-Var retrievals and then fine-tuned online through the chemical model, which reduces the error of the biogenic correction by a factor of 2.4--5 and recovers information on low-temperature emissions that the individual retrievals lose. KPPax makes KPP mechanisms directly usable for parameter estimation and hybrid physics--machine-learning modelling.

AI.tldr: KPPax 是一个将 KPP 化学机理语言编译为 JAX 可微、即时编译、可向量化代码的动力学预处理器，支持精确敏感性与混合物理-机器学习建模。
AI.motivation: KPP 机理通常生成 Fortran/C 代码，无法融入机器学习常用的可微编程框架，导致敏感性/参数估计需手工推导伴随代码。
AI.method: 在 log 空间用稀疏运算计算速率定律以保持可微性；耦合 diffrax 的隐式刚性求解器与前向/反向伴随，自动获得精确敏感性，无需手工伴随。
AI.result: 以 POLLU 基准为例：由自动微分雅可比得到的 Fisher 信息矩阵在拟合前预测 25 个速率系数中哪些可识别；含噪合成估计验证了 9 个可识别系数的预测不确定度（约 30% 以内），并揭示仅比值可约束的快反应簇。另一应用中，神经网络排放清单修正经离线 4D-Var 检索训练并在线微调，生物源修正误差降低 2.4–5 倍，并恢复个体检索丢失的低温排放信息。
AI.conclusion: KPPax 使 KPP 机理可直接用于参数估计与混合物理-机器学习建模。

title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
comment: 28 pages. Models are available on HuggingFace (at https://huggingface.co/google/embeddinggemma-2) and LiteRT (at https://huggingface.co/litert-community/embeddinggemma-2-740m-litert-lm)
summary: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.

AI.tldr: 提出开源多模态嵌入模型 EmbeddingGemma 2，将文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合原生映射到统一空间，在各模态基准上达到新 Pareto 前沿并支持资源受限部署。
AI.motivation: 现有嵌入模型多为单一模态专用或依赖大规模参数，缺乏在文本、图像、音频、视频及混合模态上统一且高效表示的能力，也缺少面向资源受限环境的灵活性。
AI.method: 引入简化的逐层嵌入（per-layer embeddings）；采用多阶段课程学习，按模态与目标逐步推进训练，以兼顾单模态、跨模态与混合模态质量；设计支持选择性模态编码器加载、可调视觉 token 预算、可截断嵌入维度与量化权重。
AI.result: 在全模态综合嵌入基准上建立新的 Pareto 前沿，性能优于专用模型及参数量为其 2–12 倍的更大模型；并通过消融实验分析关键设计决策。
AI.conclusion: EmbeddingGemma 2 在多模态统一表示上兼具质量与效率，并提供部署灵活性；模型已开源以促进后续研究。

title: Vision-Language-Action or World-Action? Just Action Models
summary: The vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) communities debate whether control policies should inherit pretrained knowledge from vision-language models or from visual generators. The debate, however, bundles three separable choices: backbone initialization, the objective applied to future observations, and whether the machinery for that future loss is kept at inference. A gap between a VLA and a WAM therefore cannot simply be attributed to any one of them. We show that decoupling these choices yields a common framework for both families, which we term Just Action Model (JAM): a pretrained visual backbone with an action expert, trained with an action loss and a foresight loss. The foresight loss trains current-observation features to predict frozen encodings of the recorded future through a prediction head discarded after training, so no visual generation is involved in either training or inference, and the backbone can be chosen freely. We first compare objectives within fixed policy architectures, then evaluate the foresight recipe across backbone families. The resulting JAM policies outperform their matched FastWAM and ImageWAM counterparts on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and achieve similar or slightly higher success rates on RoboTwin. Compared with FastWAM, JAM improves the success rates from 97.0%/55.3%/91.2% to 98.2%/64.5%/91.4%, respectively. With cached foresight targets, JAM reduces estimated online training FLOPs per sample per update by 73% relative to FastWAM. Our results show that future supervision improves control without visual generation or additional inference machinery, and strong foresight performance is attainable with either generator-initialized or vision-language backbones. Project Page: https://y0uroy.github.io/JAM

AI.tldr: 该论文将VLA与WAM之争解耦为骨干初始化、未来观测目标、推理期机器三个独立选择，提出统一框架JAM：预训练视觉骨干+动作专家，用动作损失与"预见损失"训练，推理时丢弃预测头，无需视觉生成。
AI.motivation: VLA与WAM社区争论控制策略应继承视觉语言模型还是视觉生成器的预训练知识，但这一争论把三个本可分离的选择捆绑在一起，导致VLA与WAM之间的性能差异无法归因于任何单一因素。作者希望厘清这些选择各自的贡献。
AI.method: 提出Just Action Model (JAM)：预训练视觉骨干加动作专家，联合优化动作损失与预见损失。预见损失让当前观测特征通过一个预测头去预测记录未来观测的冻结编码，该预测头训练后丢弃，因此训练与推理均不涉及视觉生成，骨干可自由选择。作者先在固定策略架构内比较目标函数，再跨骨干家族评估预见配方。
AI.result: 在LIBERO与LIBERO-Plus上，JAM优于对应的FastWAM和ImageWAM；在RoboTwin上成功率相当或略高。相比FastWAM，三档成功率从97.0%/55.3%/91.2%提升至98.2%/64.5%/91.4%。使用缓存的预见目标时，JAM将每次更新的单样本在线训练FLOPs估计降低73%。
AI.conclusion: 未来监督可在无视觉生成、无额外推理机器的情况下改善控制，且生成器初始化或视觉语言骨干均可获得较强的预见性能，说明VLA与WAM的差异可被分解并统一。

title: LinMix: Data Mixing as Linear Domain Attribution
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale
summary: Language model performance depends strongly on the mixture of domains in the pretraining data corpus. Popular data mixing methods select these domain weights by training many small proxy models on random mixes and then fitting a regression model to predict performance from the mix. We recognize this practice as a domain attribution problem, where the regression measures each domain's contribution to the target metric. Through this lens, the standard Dirichlet sampling of proxy data mixes is a poor regression design that requires tuning and cannot support a linear fit for hundreds of domains. Building on classical optimal experimental design, we introduce LinMix, which samples mixes at the vertices of the capped simplex so that each domain is at its cap or absent. This hyperparameter-free vertex sampling decorrelates domain effects, enabling an interpretable linear model whose coefficients are the domain attributions. The optimal mix given by LinMix provably keeps only domains with positive attribution values and requires no search over candidate mixes. We further establish the optimality of vertex sampling, and prove that Dirichlet sampling inflates the attribution error when its mixes concentrate around the prior data mix. Pretraining experiments with 1B-parameter OLMo2 and 4B Qwen3.5 language models show that LinMix outperforms Dirichlet-based data mixing across reasoning, code, and math benchmarks, with relative gains of 46% on MBPP and 14% on GSM8K. At 288 fine-grained domains, only vertex sampling supports a linear fit, and LinMix improves benchmark accuracy by 11% on average over the best nonlinear baseline.

AI.tldr: LinMix 将数据混合领域权重选择视为领域归因问题，用截断单纯形顶点采样替代 Dirichlet 采样，得到可解释线性模型并直接给出最优混合。
AI.motivation: 预训练语料领域配比强烈影响语言模型性能，但现有方法需训练大量随机混合的代理模型再回归预测，Dirichlet 采样设计差、需调参，且无法支持数百个领域的线性拟合。
AI.method: 基于经典最优实验设计，提出 LinMix：在截断单纯形的顶点处采样混合（每个领域取上限或缺失），无需超参数；顶点采样解耦领域效应，拟合系数即领域归因；并给出理论分析证明顶点采样最优、Dirichlet 采样在混合集中于先验配比时放大归因误差。
AI.result: 给定归因后最优混合可证明只保留正归因领域、无需搜索；1B OLMo2 与 4B Qwen3.5 实验中，LinMix 在推理、代码、数学基准上优于 Dirichlet 方法，MBPP 相对提升 46%、GSM8K 提升 14%；288 个细粒度领域时仅顶点采样支持线性拟合，平均准确率比最佳非线性基线高 11%。
AI.conclusion: 数据混合应被视为实验设计问题；顶点采样既理论最优又实用，可在高维领域空间提供可解释归因并直接导出最优配比。

title: Subspace Clifford Networks
summary: In this work, we propose Subspace Clifford Networks, a reformulation that replaces global cyclic rolling with grouped subspace interactions. Instead of sampling sparse cyclic diagonals across the entire $D$-dimensional channel space, we project the features into an aligned space $\R^{\tilde{D}} = \bigoplus_{g=1}^{G} V_g$ partitioned into $G$ low-dimensional groups $V_g \cong \R^k$ with $k \in \{2, 3, 4\}$. Within each $k$-dimensional group, we compute all $\binom{k}{2}$ wedge coordinates and concatenate them with $\operatorname{SiLU}$-activated coordinate-wise products, while sandwiching the grouped interaction between learnable $1\times 1$ linear projections to enable cross-group channel mixing. This design reduces intermediate feature expansion from $2|\mathcal{S}|D$ (typically $10D$ for 5 shifts) down to $1.5\tilde{D}$ ($k=2$), $2.0\tilde{D}$ ($k=3$), or $2.5\tilde{D}$ ($k=4$). Furthermore, exploiting the small, fixed group size $k \in \{2, 3, 4\}$, we implement a fused CUDA kernel that evaluates the forward interaction and a recomputation-based analytical backward pass using thread-local variables without allocating global-memory buffers for elementwise intermediates. Finally, we extend the backbone from an isotropic columnar layout to a multi-resolution Hierarchical Clifford Network with configurable per-stage subspace dimensions. Experiments on CIFAR-100 show that the proposed models substantially reduce parameter count and training time across both regimes, while the hierarchical variants also improve classification accuracy over the evaluated shift-based hierarchical baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 Subspace Clifford Networks，用分组低维子空间交互替代全局循环移位，并配套融合 CUDA 核与分层多分辨率骨干，在 CIFAR-100 上降低参数与训练时间、且分层版本精度更优。
AI.motivation: 原 Clifford 网络采用全局循环滚动，在 D 维通道上采样稀疏循环对角线，导致中间特征扩张大（典型为 2|S|D ≈ 10D）、计算与内存开销高，且各向同性柱状布局缺少多分辨率结构。
AI.method: 将特征投影到对齐空间 R^{D̃}=⊕V_g，分成 G 个 k 维组（k∈{2,3,4}）；组内计算全部 C(k,2) 个楔积坐标并与 SiLU 激活的逐坐标乘积拼接，外层用可学习 1×1 线性投影实现跨组通道混合；利用固定小组尺寸实现融合 CUDA 核：前向交互单核完成，反向用基于重计算的解析梯度、以线程局部变量避免全局内存中间缓冲；骨干由各向同性柱状布局扩展为多分辨率 Hierarchical Clifford Network，支持逐阶段配置子空间维度。
AI.result: 中间特征扩张由 2|S|D（5 次移位时约 10D）降为 1.5D̃（k=2）、2.0D̃（k=3）、2.5D̃（k=4）；CIFAR-100 实验中，两种设置下参数量与训练时间均显著下降，分层变体相对所评估的基于移位的分层基线还提升了分类精度。
AI.conclusion: 以分组子空间交互重构 Clifford 算子可在大幅压缩扩张与显存的同时保持甚至提升性能，配合定制 CUDA 核与分层骨干，是一种高效可扩展的替代方案。

title: HDVS: semi-supervised semantic segmentation via heterogeneous dual-branch voting supervision
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Published in Visual Intelligence
summary: Semi-supervised semantic segmentation, which aims to utilize large volumes of unlabeled images to achieve accurate segmentation results with fewer human annotations, has attracted increasing attention. Prior methods were primarily based on the assumption that the pseudo-labels generated by each branch were sufficiently reliable to supervise the remaining branches. However, there is a concern that the errors in pseudo-labels could accumulate during co-training, potentially resulting in suboptimal performance. To this end, we present a novel framework called heterogeneous dual-branch voting supervision (HDVS), which is designed to enhance the reliability of pseudo-labels and mitigate the issues arising from pseudo-labeling. Specifically, based on the cross-supervision framework, we introduce a voting mechanism that correlates pseudo-labels from heterogeneous branches to produce pseudo-labels with enhanced reliability. Concurrently, we employ a feature communication module to introduce perturbations at the feature level in each branch to maximize prediction diversity across the dual branches while maintaining convergence. Comprehensive evaluations of the proposed HDVS on two benchmark datasets (PASCAL VOC 2012 and Cityscapes) demonstrate its superiority to the state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出异构双分支投票监督框架HDVS，通过投票机制提升伪标签可靠性，缓解协同训练中的伪标签误差累积问题，在PASCAL VOC 2012与Cityscapes上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有半监督语义分割方法多假设各分支生成的伪标签足够可靠以监督其他分支，但伪标签错误在协同训练中会累积，导致性能次优。
AI.method: 基于交叉监督框架，引入投票机制关联异构分支的伪标签以生成更可靠的伪标签；同时采用特征通信模块在各分支特征层面引入扰动，在保持收敛的同时最大化双分支预测多样性。
AI.result: 在PASCAL VOC 2012和Cityscapes两个基准数据集上的综合评估表明，HDVS优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: HDVS通过提升伪标签可靠性并增强分支预测多样性，有效缓解伪标签误差累积问题，验证了异构双分支投票监督在半监督语义分割中的有效性。

title: Crop Yield Prediction Using Regression Models: A Comparative Evaluation of Model Performance
comment: Experimental evaluation of crop-yield prediction using regression models
summary: Reliable crop-yield prediction can support agricultural planning and resource allocation. This study evaluates five regression models for predicting crop yield from environmental, crop-related, and agricultural management variables. The dataset initially contained 1,000,000 observations and ten variables, with 231 observations having negative target values removed during preprocessing. Categorical variables were represented using one-hot encoding, and Boolean variables were converted into binary values. The models considered were multiple linear regression (LR), random-forest regression (RF), decision-tree regression (DT), ridge regression, and lasso regression. Their performance was evaluated using 80:20 and 70:30 training-testing splits based on the coefficient of determination (R-squared), mean squared error (MSE), and root mean squared error (RMSE). Applying an 80:20 split, LR achieved a test R-squared of approximately 0.9130 and a test RMSE of 0.5008. Applying a 70:30 split, lasso regression yielded the highest test R-squared (approximately 0.9131) and the lowest test RMSE (approximately 0.5008), with performance almost identical to LR and ridge regression. DT also showed improved test performance under the 70:30 split, whereas RF exhibited a substantial gap between training and testing performance. These results indicate that the evaluated linear regression model provides competitive baselines for this dataset. Further experimentation, including validation testing, will help determine the models' performance and predictability.

AI.tldr: 本研究用五种回归模型（线性回归、随机森林、决策树、岭回归、Lasso）预测作物产量，在80:20与70:30划分下评估，线性模型（LR/岭/Lasso）性能最优且相近（R²≈0.913，RMSE≈0.5008），RF过拟合明显。
AI.motivation: 可靠的作物产量预测有助于农业规划与资源分配，需评估不同回归模型在该任务上的适用性。
AI.method: 使用含100万条、10个变量的数据集，剔除231条负目标值；类别变量独热编码，布尔变量转二进制。对比多元线性回归、随机森林、决策树、岭回归、Lasso，以R²、MSE、RMSE在80:20和70:30训练-测试划分下评估。
AI.result: 80:20划分下LR测试R²≈0.9130、RMSE≈0.5008；70:30划分下Lasso测试R²最高（≈0.9131）、RMSE最低（≈0.5008），与LR和岭回归几乎相同；决策树在70:30下有所改善，随机森林训练与测试差距大。
AI.conclusion: 线性回归模型在该数据集上提供了有竞争力的基线；后续需加入验证测试以更充分确定各模型的性能与可预测性。

title: Representing the Unseen: Rethinking Visual Imagination for Spatial Reasoning
summary: Visual world models increasingly support spatial reasoning by generating RGB views of unobserved states. However, RGB has become the default interface largely because it is well suited for visual generation, rather than necessarily being the most effective representation for downstream reasoning. Different spatial questions may benefit from different representations of the same imagined state: top-down geometry can facilitate global distance comparisons, while panoramic views provide broader context for reasoning about open space. To isolate the role of representation in spatial imagination, we introduce ImagiRep, a simulator-grounded benchmark of 922 questions spanning seven question types across two settings, Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration, providing oracle RGB and six alternative representations (e.g., depth, panoramic views, and top-down geometry) of the same unobserved state. This controlled comparison reveals that even accurate imagined RGB does not guarantee accurate spatial reasoning, and different questions benefit from different representations. Similar trends hold for representations derived from world-model-estimated states. Notably, estimated RGB alone can mislead spatial reasoning, while alternative representations retain complementary benefits. Building on these findings, we introduce GEARS, a lightweight test-time strategy for adaptive representation selection, outperforming existing spatial imagination methods and showing that reasoning about unseen states requires more than generating RGB views.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ImagiRep基准，在受控条件下比较RGB与六种替代表示（深度、全景、俯视几何等）对空间想象推理的影响，发现准确想象RGB不保证准确空间推理、不同问题适配不同表示；并提出轻量测试时自适应表示选择策略GEARS。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉世界模型默认用RGB作为想象未观测状态的接口，但这主要因为RGB适合生成而非最适合下游推理；相同想象状态下不同空间问题可能受益于不同表示，表示的作用此前未被孤立研究。
AI.method: 构建基于模拟器的基准ImagiRep：922个问题、7种问题类型、2种设定（视角想象与跨视角整合），对同一未观测状态提供oracle RGB及六种替代表示，进行控制变量比较；并对世界模型估计状态得到的表示重复比较；在此基础上提出GEARS——测试时自适应表示选择策略。
AI.result: 即使RGB想象准确，空间推理也未必准确；不同问题类型偏好不同表示（俯视几何利于全局距离比较，全景提供开放空间上下文）。从世界模型估计状态导出的表示呈相似趋势；估计RGB单独使用可能误导推理，而替代表示保留互补收益。GEARS优于现有空间想象方法。
AI.conclusion: 对未见状态的推理不能只依赖生成RGB视图，表示选择本身是关键因素；应针对问题自适应选择表示。ImagiRep提供受控评测框架，GEARS给出轻量实用的改进方向。

title: GameVerse: A Minute-Scale Gameplay Dataset for Long-Horizon Interactive World Modeling
summary: Recent advances in interactive world models have made it possible to generate controllable, dynamic environments from action inputs. Yet current models struggle to maintain coherence beyond roughly one minute of rollout, a limitation rooted not in model capacity but in the scarcity of long-horizon training data. Existing gameplay video datasets typically consist of clips under ten seconds, with captions that describe whole clips in coarse and undifferentiated text, which is insufficient for controllable long-horizon generation. We address this with GameVerse, a minute-scale gameplay video dataset purpose-built for long-horizon interactive world modeling. GameVerse contains 69.7K clips spanning 1,655 hours and 349.6 million frames across diverse first- and third-person gameplay, including 1,358 hours of continuous two-minute sequences, an order of magnitude longer than prior datasets. Clips pass through a unified pipeline of scene-consistent segmentation, quality filtering, camera pose estimation, and event-based caption annotation. Each clip is paired with a temporally stable camera trajectory that remains coherent across minutes, together with captions that separate static scene context from dynamic foreground events and align to event boundaries rather than fixed time windows. Comprehensive analysis shows that GameVerse surpasses existing public datasets in scale, diversity, and annotation quality. Experiments further demonstrate that training on GameVerse substantially extends the temporal horizon of interactive world models.

AI.tldr: 提出GameVerse，分钟级游戏视频数据集，用于长时程交互式世界建模。
AI.motivation: 当前交互式世界模型在约一分钟后的推演中难以保持连贯，根源在于长时程训练数据稀缺：现有游戏视频数据集多为不足10秒的片段，且配以粗略、不分层的整段描述，无法支撑可控的长时程生成。
AI.method: 构建GameVerse数据集：69.7K片段、1,655小时、3.496亿帧，涵盖第一/第三人称玩法，其中1,358小时为连续两分钟序列。采用统一流水线：场景一致分割、质量过滤、相机位姿估计、事件级字幕标注；每段配有跨分钟时间稳定的相机轨迹，字幕区分静态场景上下文与动态前景事件，并按事件边界而非固定时间窗对齐。
AI.result: 综合分析表明GameVerse在规模、多样性和标注质量上超越现有公开数据集；实验表明在其上训练可显著延长交互式世界模型的时间跨度。
AI.conclusion: 长时程连贯性瓶颈在于数据而非模型容量，GameVerse通过分钟级、事件对齐、位姿稳定的数据显著提升世界模型的长时程生成能力。

title: Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data
summary: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on instruction data can quietly erode their safety, even when no training example looks harmful. Because this safety-degrading data looks benign, standard content filters struggle to catch it. We tackle this problem by developing SimpleLoRIF, a scalable gradient embedding method that identifies fine-tuning examples whose gradients align with unsafe behavior. By simplifying a low-rank attribution method and restricting backpropagation to the final four transformer blocks, SimpleLoRIF can embed datasets on the order of a million examples, boosting gradient attribution from a small-scale analysis tool into a practical filter for full post-training datasets. We first validate it on emergent misalignment, where we find that gradients can connect insecure-code training data to the broadly harmful behaviors that appear after fine-tuning, with AUC as high as 0.865 in the gradient space of misaligned models. We then use SimpleLoRIF to build SafeTulu, a version of Tulu 3 with the 20% of examples most gradient-aligned with unsafe responses removed. Training on SafeTulu reduces GCG attack success rate by up to 22% across Qwen, Llama, and Olmo, outperforming both LLM-as-a-judge and prior gradient-based filtering, while largely preserving or even improving capability. Finally, we analyzed the removed data and identify possibly under-studied sources of safety degradation, such as tool-execution failures and narrative arithmetic. We release SafeTulu along with a Hugging Face Space that lets researchers build their own customized versions of SafeTulu to fine-tune on, such as by changing the removal fraction or filtering only certain subsets.

AI.tldr: 提出 SimpleLoRIF，一种可扩展的梯度嵌入方法，用于识别指令微调数据中"看似无害但会侵蚀安全性"的样本，并基于此构建 SafeTulu 数据集。
AI.motivation: 在指令数据上微调 LLM 会在无任何有害样本的情况下悄然削弱模型安全性，而这类数据表面无害，标准内容过滤器难以检测。
AI.method: 简化一种低秩归因方法，并将反向传播限制在最后四个 Transformer 块，从而把梯度归因扩展到百万级样本；用梯度与不安全行为对齐程度筛选数据，构建 SafeTulu（Tulu 3 中移除与不安全响应梯度最对齐的 20% 样本）。
AI.result: 在涌现性失配上验证：梯度可将不安全代码训练数据与后续广泛有害行为关联，AUC 达 0.865；在 Qwen、Llama、Olmo 上，SafeTulu 将 GCG 攻击成功率降低最多 22%，优于 LLM-as-a-judge 和既有梯度过滤方法，且能力基本保持甚至提升。
AI.conclusion: SimpleLoRIF 将梯度归因从分析工具变为实用的全量后训练数据过滤器；分析被移除数据还发现工具执行失败、叙事算术等未被充分研究的安全退化来源，并发布 SafeTulu 及可定制化的 Hugging Face Space。

title: EnvSched: Environment-Aware Scheduling for Rollout-Efficient Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: As executable environments for language agents scale, generating and verifying their rollouts becomes increasingly expensive. Under finite rollout budgets, this raises an important question: can data management at the environment level make agentic reinforcement learning (RL) more efficient by organizing, evaluating, and scheduling task instances together with the environments that determine their tools, states, transitions, and verification? To address this question, we introduce EnvSched (Environment-aware Scheduling), an online scheduler that learns from rollout history. EnvSched assigns scheduling value through two complementary modeling choices: exploitation prioritizes tasks likely to provide informative reward differences, while coverage spreads each batch across underobserved environments and interaction patterns. EnvSched organizes environment--task pairs as nodes in a dual-relation graph, with within-environment edges capturing task semantics and shared tool, state, and verifier structure, and cross-environment edges capturing abstract execution and reward topology. By propagating historical rollout statistics along both edge types, it predicts within-task reward variance. These predictions guide a scheduler that allocates each batch to tasks with high predicted reward variance and underobserved environments and tasks. Environment quotas and a similarity penalty further limit concentration and redundancy, yielding informative and diverse batches without additional pilot rollouts. In RL on Qwen3-8B, EnvSched achieves an average score of 48.81 across BFCL-v3, tau-Bench, and ACEBench-Agent after 40 training steps, exceeding the highest score attained by random task selection after 120 steps. It also improves downstream performance across model sizes at the same training budget.

AI.tldr: 提出 EnvSched，一种环境感知的在线调度器，通过构建环境-任务双关系图并利用历史 rollout 统计预测任务内奖励方差，在有限 rollout 预算下提升 agentic RL 的数据效率。
AI.motivation: 语言 agent 的可执行环境规模扩大，生成与验证 rollout 的成本越来越高；在有限 rollout 预算下，需要从环境层面（组织、评估、调度任务及其环境）做数据管理来提升 agentic RL 效率。
AI.method: EnvSched 在线调度器：将环境-任务对作为双关系图节点，环境内边刻画任务语义与共享工具/状态/验证器结构，跨环境边刻画抽象执行与奖励拓扑；沿两类边传播历史 rollout 统计以预测任务内奖励方差；调度兼顾利用（高预测方差、信息量大的任务）与覆盖（欠观察环境与交互模式），并加入环境配额与相似度惩罚以限制集中和冗余，无需额外试点 rollout。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上做 RL，训练 40 步后在 BFCL-v3、tau-Bench、ACEBench-Agent 上平均分为 48.81，超过随机任务选择训练 120 步的最高分；相同训练预算下各模型规模的下游性能均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 环境级数据管理与在线调度可显著提升 agentic RL 的 rollout 效率；通过图结构传播奖励方差预测并平衡利用与覆盖，能在更少训练步数下取得更优且更泛化的效果。

title: Taming Noise Initialization for Zero-shot Video Restoration with Image Diffusion Priors
summary: Recent advances in diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in restoring high-quality images in a zero-shot manner. Unfortunately, extending this success to video restoration is challenging due to the substantial computational resources required to pre-train video diffusion models. A rising trend seeks to address video restoration by utilizing a pre-trained image diffusion model, initiating restoration from either frame-wise independent or identical Gaussian noise. Yet, these approaches often fall short, as such simple noise initiations fail to capture and utilize the inherent temporal correlations within degraded video frames. In this work, we propose taming noise initialization for zero-shot video restoration, which preserves the intrinsic temporal correlations by generating initial noises directly using DDIM inversion on the corrupted video frames themselves. Building on this, we introduce an adaptive noise blending strategy that suppresses degradation patterns encoded during DDIM inversion while gradually steering the noise toward a Gaussian distribution. To further emphasize temporal consistency, we propose measurement-guided trajectory attention to better align features across frames. Extensive experiments on multiple video restoration tasks demonstrate that our method outperforms existing zero-shot approaches, consistently achieving superior results on the DAVIS, REDS4, and Set8 datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出"驯服噪声初始化"的零样本视频复原方法：用DDIM反演受损视频帧生成保留时序相关的初始噪声，配合自适应噪声混合与测量引导轨迹注意力，在DAVIS/REDS4/Set8上优于现有零样本方法。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型预训练成本过高，而借用图像扩散模型做视频复原时，现有逐帧独立或相同高斯噪声的初始化方式无法捕捉并利用退化视频帧间的固有时间相关性。
AI.method: 1) 直接对受损视频帧做DDIM反演生成初始噪声，以保留内在时序相关性；2) 自适应噪声混合策略，抑制反演中编码的退化模式并将噪声逐步引导向高斯分布；3) 测量引导的轨迹注意力，增强跨帧特征对齐以提升时间一致性。
AI.result: 在多个视频复原任务的DAVIS、REDS4、Set8数据集上，均取得优于现有零样本方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 合理的噪声初始化是零样本视频复原的关键，通过反演式噪声初始化与跨帧轨迹注意力可显著提升复原质量与时间一致性。

title: On the Sparsity of Direct Preference Optimization: Weight Disentanglement in the NTK Regime
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has been widely adopted for aligning language models with human preferences. Recent empirical work has revealed that DPO induces remarkably sparse parameter updates, yet no theoretical explanation for this phenomenon has been offered. We analyze DPO's optimization dynamics under a neural tangent kernel linearization and show that the logistic structure of the DPO loss gives rise to an implicit maximum-margin bias. Building on this observation, we introduce the concept of dual sparsity: the DPO update direction is a sparse linear combination (data-level sparsity, driven by support vectors) of sparse gradient feature vectors (parameter-level sparsity, arising from gradient cancellation between preferred and dispreferred responses). We formalize this structure in our main theorem, bound the number of support pairs by a margin-dependent spectral quantity, and present a framework relating dual sparsity to weight disentanglement---a condition favorable for model merging. Experiments on GPT-2 Small and Medium and on 7--9B instruction-tuned models (Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B, Gemma-2-9B) with the Anthropic HH-RLHF and UltraFeedback datasets confirm both sources of sparsity, and experiments on GPT-2 show that DPO reduces cross-task interference by up to $35{\times}$ compared to supervised fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上解释了DPO为何产生稀疏参数更新：在NTK线性化下，DPO损失的logistic结构导致隐式最大间隔偏置，产生"双重稀疏性"（数据级稀疏由支持向量驱动，参数级稀疏由preferred/dispreferred响应的梯度抵消导致），并关联到权重解耦，利于模型合并。
AI.motivation: 近期实证发现DPO会诱导异常稀疏的参数更新，但缺乏理论解释。作者希望填补这一空白，并理解稀疏性对模型合并等下游应用的潜在益处。
AI.method: 在NTK线性化框架下分析DPO优化动力学，证明DPO损失的logistic结构产生隐式最大间隔偏置；提出"双重稀疏性"概念，主定理形式化更新方向为稀疏梯度特征向量的稀疏线性组合，并用间隔相关的谱量界定支持对数量；建立双重稀疏性与权重解耦的关联框架。实验在GPT-2 Small/Medium及Llama-3-8B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B上，使用Anthropic HH-RLHF和UltraFeedback数据集。
AI.result: 实验验证了数据级和参数级两种稀疏性来源；GPT-2实验表明DPO相比监督微调（SFT）将跨任务干扰最多降低35倍。
AI.conclusion: DPO的稀疏更新源自logistic损失的隐式最大间隔偏置与梯度抵消机制，具有双重稀疏性，并能带来权重解耦、降低跨任务干扰，从而有利于模型合并。

title: TRUCO: A Scalable Lock-Free Algorithm for Parallel Contour Extraction
summary:
Transforming binary masks into geometric contours remains a critical step in many computer vision pipelines, particularly for post-processing high-resolution segmentation outputs. Yet, standard algorithms such as the Suzuki-Abe method are limited by their sequential nature and the overhead of building topological hierarchies. As modern applications transition to high-resolution imaging, there is a critical need for contour extraction that leverages multi-core CPU architectures without the complexity of tile stitching or heavy synchronization.
  This paper presents TRUCO (Threaded Raster Unrestricted Contour Ownership), a lock-free parallel algorithm designed for high-performance geometric boundary extraction. TRUCO introduces a start-point ownership rule, combined with a speculative tracing model, in which threads trace contours downward into adjacent regions and use an upward-termination logic to ensure each contour is processed exactly once.
  Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets, conducted on both consumer and server-grade CPUs, demonstrate that TRUCO significantly outperforms existing baselines. The method achieves speedups of over an order of magnitude compared to the industry standard while maintaining robust scalability on high-resolution scenes across diverse hardware architectures.

AI.tldr: TRUCO 是一种无锁并行轮廓提取算法，通过"起点所有权规则"和投机式跟踪模型，避免了分块拼接与重同步开销，在高分辨率分割结果上比工业标准 Suzuki-Abe 方法快一个数量级以上，且在消费级与服务器级 CPU 上都具备良好可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 二值掩膜到几何轮廓的转换是高分辨率分割后处理的关键步骤，但 Suzuki-Abe 等标准算法本质串行，且需构建拓扑层级带来额外开销。随着成像分辨率提高，亟需利用多核 CPU 并行能力，同时避免分块缝合和复杂同步的代价。
AI.method: 提出 TRUCO（Threaded Raster Unrestricted Contour Ownership）无锁并行算法：采用"起点所有权规则"（start-point ownership）为轮廓分配唯一负责线程，并配合投机式跟踪模型——线程可向下进入相邻区域跟踪轮廓，利用"向上终止"逻辑保证每条轮廓仅被处理一次。
AI.result: 在合成数据与真实数据集上，于消费级和服务器级 CPU 上测试，TRUCO 显著优于现有基线；相比工业标准方法获得超过一个数量级的加速，并在多样化硬件架构的高分辨率场景中保持稳健的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: TRUCO 证明了无需分块与重同步即可实现高效并行的轮廓提取，为高分辨率分割后处理的边界提取提供了实用且可扩展的无锁方案。

title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
summary: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups, whereas SecAlign and ASIDE degrade in few-shot settings. On agentic benchmarks with static attacks, HoS and SecAlign perform similarly and substantially improve the security-utility trade-off over the base model. ASIDE struggles with tool use, achieving only 10% utility. These results show that prompt injection robustness can be achieved and improved through targeted attention interventions.

AI.tldr: 提出 Heads of Security (HoS)，通过少量可学习的 per-head 注意力门控实现指令-数据分离，从而防御提示注入攻击，在鲁棒性、通用性和智能体任务上均优于现有防御方法。
AI.motivation: 提示注入攻击利用模型无法区分可信指令与不可信数据的问题，使模型执行嵌入在不可信内容中的恶意指令。现有微调型防御（如 SecAlign）对自适应攻击脆弱，架构型防御（如 ASIDE）在工具使用等场景下效用严重下降，因此需要一种兼顾鲁棒性与效用的指令-数据分离机制。
AI.method: HoS 在注意力头层面引入一小组可学习的门控，学习每个头应如何在可信 token 与不可信 token 之间重新分配注意力，使模型能处理不可信内容而不执行其中注入的指令。在 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 和 GPT-OSS-20B 上训练并评估，与 SecAlign++（微调型）和 ASIDE（架构型）对比，测试涵盖黑盒攻击 RL-Hammer、白盒攻击 Claudini、标准多选题与 few-shot 效用基准，以及智能体提示注入基准。
AI.result: RL-Hammer 黑盒攻击对 GPT-OSS-20B 的 ASR 达 97%、对 SecAlign 达 85%，而对 HoS 仅 10%；经 autoresearch 强化后的白盒攻击 Claudini 在 HoS 上达到同等 ASR 需约 3 倍 FLOPs。HoS 在标准多选题和提示设置下保持基座模型效用，而 SecAlign 与 ASIDE 在 few-shot 下退化；在静态攻击的智能体基准上，HoS 与 SecAlign 表现相近，显著优于基座模型的安全-效用权衡，ASIDE 则工具使用效用仅 10%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过针对性的注意力干预可以有效实现并提升提示注入鲁棒性，HoS 在抗自适应攻击、保持效用与智能体任务表现之间取得了优于现有防御的平衡。

title: MvT: Event-based Multi-view Projection for Multiple Object Tracking
comment: 16 pages, 20 figures, published to IEEE T-IP
summary: Event cameras are increasingly used for Multiple Object Tracking (MOT), but their asynchronous event output often requires specialized methods. Existing processing methods primarily follow two paradigms, pseudo-frames and event-by-event. The former is the prevailing approach since its data format aligns with images, making image-based techniques applicable. However, it suffers from tracking failures when trajectories overlap or are spatially close on pseudo-frames. Facing this challenge, we propose a multi-view pipeline, Multi-view Tracking (MvT), which preserves the 2D data format to leverage image-based techniques directly while introducing additional spatio-temporal views to resolve tracking ambiguities in a single view. MvT comprises a Multi-view Projection (MvP) module and a Multi-view Fusion (MvF) stage. MvP encodes events into three complementary spatio-temporal views while mitigating the pattern discretization. Within MvF, multi-view results are unified into a 3D coordinate system, and tracklets are associated through an optimization model subject to specific criteria combination. Evaluations on four datasets, including our self-collected Small Objects Dataset (SOD), show that MvT seamlessly integrates image-based methods and outperforms existing non-learning and learning trackers in generalized scenarios, and effectively resolves the single-view tracking ambiguities. Being training-free, MvT is applicable when ground-truth annotation is infeasible, thereby highlighting its practical, data-efficient potential. Code is available at https://github.com/zhazhabiu/MvTracking.

AI.tldr: 提出多视角跟踪流程MvT，用额外时空视角解决事件相机伪帧MOT中轨迹重叠/邻近导致的跟踪歧义，无需训练即可媲美并超越现有跟踪器。
AI.motivation: 事件相机MOT主流采用伪帧范式以复用图像方法，但当轨迹在伪帧上重叠或空间邻近时会出现跟踪失败（单视角歧义）。
AI.method: MvT包含MvP与MvF两部分：MvP将事件编码为三个互补的时空视角并缓解模式离散化；MvF将多视角结果统一到3D坐标系，通过带特定准则组合的优化模型进行轨迹关联。
AI.result: 在四个数据集（含自采集小目标数据集SOD）上，MvT能无缝集成图像方法，在通用场景下优于现有非学习与学习跟踪器，并有效消除单视角歧义。
AI.conclusion: MvT为免训练方法，适用于真值标注不可行的场景，体现了实用与数据高效潜力。

title: A Lightweight Attention-Based CNN with Saliency-Map Interpretability for Skin Cancer Detection
summary: Skin cancer is among the most prevalent and life threatening forms of cancer worldwide. Early and accurate diagnosis significantly improves patient survival rates. However, manual dermoscopic assessment remains challenging due to visual similarity. This study proposes an Explainable AI-driven framework for automated binary classification of skin lesions using a lightweight attention-based convolutional neural network (CNN-Attention). The model integrates channel attention to focus on informative regions of dermoscopic images while maintaining low computational complexity. A publicly available dataset comprising 2,637 training and 660 test images was used, with balanced class weights. The proposed model achieved 87 percent accuracy with 1.95 million parameters and 7.45 MB of storage, matching the best baseline (MobileNet) while using approximately half as many parameters and half as much storage. ROC AUC and PR AUC scores reached 0.9475 and 0.9430, respectively. Additionally, saliency maps were incorporated as an explainability technique to visualize regions that influence model decisions. Comparative analysis with VGG16,VGG19,ResNet101,and MobileNet demonstrates the proposed models effectiveness in balancing classification results, computational efficiency, and interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级注意力CNN（CNN-Attention）用于皮肤镜图像的良性/恶性二分类，以通道注意力降低计算复杂度；在2637训练/660测试图像上达到87%准确率、195万参数、7.45MB存储，与最佳基线MobileNet持平但参数量和存储约减半，ROC AUC 0.9475、PR AUC 0.9430，并用显著图提供可解释性。
AI.motivation: 皮肤癌是全球高发且致命的癌症，早期准确诊断可显著提高生存率；但皮肤镜图像视觉相似度高，人工判读困难，因此需要自动化且可解释、计算高效的分类方法。
AI.method: 构建轻量级通道注意力卷积神经网络（CNN-Attention），在保持低计算复杂度的同时聚焦皮肤镜图像的信息区域；使用公开数据集（2637张训练、660张测试），采用平衡类别权重；以显著图（saliency map）作为可解释性技术，并与VGG16、VGG19、ResNet101、MobileNet进行对比。
AI.result: 准确率87%，参数量1.95M、存储7.45MB，指标与最佳基线MobileNet相当但参数与存储约减半；ROC AUC 0.9475，PR AUC 0.9430；显著图可视化影响决策的区域；对比实验显示在分类性能、计算效率与可解释性之间取得良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该轻量级注意力CNN在皮肤病变二分类中以更低资源成本达到与主流模型相当的精度，并提供可解释性，适合资源受限场景下的辅助诊断应用。

title: Generative Replay for Equilibrium Propagation: Toward Edge-Friendly Continual Learning in Hopfield Networks
summary: Equilibrium Propagation (EqProp) offers a biologically grounded and hardware-aligned alternative to backpropagation for training Hopfield Networks. However, its behavior in continual learning settings remains largely unexplored. This work confronts catastrophic forgetting in EqProp-trained Hopfield Networks from the inside out, eliminating the need for external data buffers or architectural overhead that standard Experience Replay \textbf{(ER)} and Generative Replay \textbf{(Gen-Replay)} inevitably require. We introduce an Energy-Based Generative Replay strategy \textbf{(EB-Gen)} which exploits the intrinsic generative dynamics of Hopfield Networks, allowing a single model to act as both classifier and replay samples generator. Samples capturing past task knowledge are generated by relaxing a frozen copy of the network, enabling rehearsal solely through internally generated pseudo-data. We evaluate the proposed method in the Class-Incremental setting, using the split versions of the MNIST and CIFAR10 benchmarks and compare it with FineTune, Experience Replay, Generative Replay, Sleep-Like Replay Consolidation (SRC) and Joint training. Our results show that EB-Gen significantly improves stability while preserving plasticity, achieving a 75\% and 64\% average accuracy on Split MNIST and Split CIFAR10 respectively. These findings show that Equilibrium Propagation can be adapted to alleviate catastrophic forgetting without forgoing the traits which made it compelling in the first place.

AI.tldr: 本文将平衡传播（EqProp）训练的Hopfield网络用于持续学习，提出能量型生成回放（EB-Gen）抑制灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: EqProp是训练Hopfield网络的一种生物合理且硬件友好的替代反向传播方法，但其在持续学习中的表现尚不清楚；而ER和生成回放需要外部缓冲或额外结构。
AI.method: EB-Gen利用Hopfield网络内在的生成动力学，让同一模型既作分类器又作样本生成器：通过松弛冻结的网络副本生成伪样本，仅凭内部生成数据进行回放，无需外部数据缓冲或架构开销。
AI.result: 在Split MNIST和Split CIFAR10的类增量设置下，EB-Gen相比FineTune、ER、Gen-Replay、SRC与联合训练显著提升稳定性同时保持可塑性，平均准确率分别达75%和64%。
AI.conclusion: EqProp可被改造以缓解灾难性遗忘，同时保留其原有优势特性。

title: Hierarchical Sparse Graph for Multi-dimensional Assignment in Event-based Tracking
summary: Existing event-based tracking methods typically operate in an online manner, associating tracklets across adjacent batches. However, this limited temporal window often leads to failures in challenging scenarios, such as long-term occlusions or missed detections, where broader temporal context should be incorporated for high-precision tracking. To achieve robust and accurate tracking, this paper concentrates on the event-based multi-dimensional assignment that associates tracklets across multiple batches simultaneously. Unlike image-based detectors, event-based detectors can generate multiple correct yet spatially distinct tracklets for a single object per batch. This violates the one-to-one rule in classic data association, making event-based association an underdetermined many-to-many matching problem. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to tackle this NP-hard problem. To address its underdetermined nature, we formulate the assignment problem via fuzzy logic, where pairwise tracklet correlations are quantified through multiple long-range kinematic metrics. This fuzzy design eliminates the need for hard tracking thresholds and enables multiple heterogeneous metrics to be integrated into a unified correlation. By treating tracklets as nodes and their fuzzy correlations as edges, we construct a Hierarchical Sparse Graph (HSG). Building upon the HSG, we pose assignment as a graph partition task, and employ a heuristic solution that measures vertex affinity for partitioning adaptively. The entire pipeline is training-free. Comprehensive experiments on two challenging event datasets, eTram and Ev-UAV, show that our method outperforms existing event-based and most image-based association models. Particularly, it achieves over 2$\times$ the performance of OC-SORT across all metrics in the many-to-many association scenario.

AI.tldr: 针对事件相机跟踪中的多批次关联问题，本文首次将其建模为欠定的"多对多"匹配（NP-hard）问题，通过模糊逻辑量化轨迹相关性并构建层次稀疏图（HSG），以图划分方式启发式求解，全程免训练，在eTram和Ev-UAV上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有事件跟踪多为在线、仅关联相邻批次的轨迹片段，时间窗口过短，在长期遮挡或漏检时易失败；需要引入更广时间上下文。同时事件检测器每批可为同一目标产生多个空间不同但正确的轨迹片段，违背经典一对一关联假设，形成欠定多对多匹配难题。
AI.method: 用模糊逻辑建模分配问题，以多种长程运动学度量量化轨迹对的模糊相关性，避免硬阈值并统一异构度量；将轨迹片段作为节点、模糊相关性作为边构建层次稀疏图（HSG）；把分配转化为图划分任务，采用基于顶点亲和度自适应分区的启发式解法；整个流程免训练。
AI.result: 在eTram和Ev-UAV两个挑战性事件数据集上，方法优于现有事件类及多数图像类关联模型；在多对多关联场景下所有指标均达到OC-SORT的2倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 首次解决事件式多批次多对多关联的NP-hard问题，模糊逻辑+层次稀疏图+图划分的免训练框架实现了高精度、鲁棒的跨多批次事件跟踪，为事件相机长时关联提供了新思路。

title: Beyond Parameter Protection: Fisher-Shaped EWC for Replay-Free Continual Learning
summary: In replay-free continual learning, Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) uses Fisher information matrix (FIM) to protect acquired knowledge by penalizing changes to historically important parameters. However, a local importance estimate at the retained solution does not in general characterize sensitivity after finite parameter displacement. This motivates controlling Fisher sensitivity over a neighborhood of potential future updates. We propose Fisher-Shaped EWC (FS-EWC), which extends the role of FIM from parameter protection to solution formation for future retention. During task learning, FS-EWC minimizes the worst-case empirical FIM trace within a prescribed neighborhood, explicitly favoring solutions that are less sensitive to bounded future displacement. At task completion, trajectory-based model merging constructs the retained solution from multiple optimization states rather than a single terminal iterate, after which FIM is estimated for subsequent consolidation. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that FS-EWC improves performance over EWC, while controlled studies indicate a more favorable stability--plasticity balance and greater tolerance to parameter drift. These results suggest that effective knowledge retention requires both forming solutions with future retention in mind and protecting acquired knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出Fisher-Shaped EWC（FS-EWC），把Fisher信息矩阵从"参数保护"扩展到"解的形成"，在邻域内最小化最坏情况下的FIM迹，并结合轨迹式模型合并构建保留解，提升无回放持续学习性能。
AI.motivation: EWC依赖在当前解处的局部Fisher重要性估计来惩罚参数变动，但局部估计无法刻画有限参数位移后的敏感性，因此需要在未来更新的邻域上控制Fisher敏感性。
AI.method: 任务学习时，在给定邻域内最小化最坏情况的经验FIM迹，偏好对未来有界位移不敏感的解；任务结束时采用基于轨迹的模型合并，从多个优化状态而非单一终态构造保留解，再估计FIM用于后续巩固。
AI.result: 在多个基准上性能优于EWC；受控实验显示更优的稳定性—可塑性平衡，且对参数漂移有更强容忍度。
AI.conclusion: 有效的知识保留既要"带着未来保留的视角形成解"，也要"保护已获得的知识"，二者缺一不可。

title: ScIntBench: Physical Interaction Plausibility in 3D Scene Generation
summary: Existing evaluations of text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation largely emphasize semantic fidelity and physical validity at rest, leaving interaction-time physical reliability insufficiently assessed. To address this gap, we introduce ScIntBench, a unified benchmark centered on interaction readiness: it executes prescribed manipulation actions (e.g., pushing, opening, and surface probing) in physics simulation and measures task success, capability and progress, post-interaction integrity, and dynamic plausibility. Multi-view semantic and static physical evaluations complement these metrics and help explain interaction outcomes. We systematically evaluate 12 state-of-the-art scene generation systems across 10 room types. Our results reveal that strong semantic and static physical performance does not necessarily translate into interaction readiness: a system with near-perfect static plausibility completes only 11.54% of interactions, 7 of the 12 systems produce scenes that cannot support any interaction, and even the best system succeeds in only 36.92% of prescribed tasks. These findings highlight two fundamental challenges in generating interaction-ready scenes: providing the necessary physical interaction capabilities and ensuring reliable physical behavior under active manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 ScIntBench 基准，用交互任务评估文本生成3D室内场景的"可交互性"，发现语义/静态物理表现好并不等于交互可靠性好。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动3D室内场景生成评测主要关注语义保真度和静态物理合理性，忽视了交互过程中的物理可靠性，缺乏对"可交互就绪度"的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建统一基准 ScIntBench：在物理仿真中执行指定操作动作（推动、开门、表面探测等），测量任务成功率、能力与进度、交互后完整性、动态合理性；并以多视角语义和静态物理评测作为补充与解释。
AI.result: 在10类房间、12个SOTA系统上系统评估：静态合理性近乎完美的系统仅完成11.54%交互，12个系统中有7个生成的场景无法支持任何交互，最佳系统成功率仅36.92%。
AI.conclusion: 语义与静态物理表现不能代表交互就绪度；生成可交互场景面临两大挑战——提供必要的物理交互能力，以及保证主动操作下的物理行为可靠性。

title: Variational Optimal Control for Diffusion Guidance
summary: We present a variational control framework that connects sampling-time guidance and reward-based model adaptation through a shared Jacobian pullback. Starting from terminal reward maximization with a path-space KL penalty, the Gibbs variational principle and Doob transform yield a correction to the generative dynamics. A local denoising approximation exposes the pullback that transports output preferences to the controlled variable.
