This construction gives Variational Optimal Guidance (VOG) in state space and extends to Distilled Variational Optimal Control (DVOC) by amortizing locally improved endpoints into model parameters. The resulting controls share a local variational rule: VOG acts through the denoising Jacobian, while DVOC realizes the parameter pullback by endpoint distillation. Under a linear MMSE model, VOG's exact correction lies in the data subspace. On ImageNet, VOG reduces DiT-XL/2 FID from 2.27 to 2.04 at 250 sampling steps and from 7.58 to 4.44 at 25 steps. After 20 updates on Z-Image-Turbo, DVOC improves HPSv3++ and four held-out evaluator scores over the untrained model, with the highest corresponding means among the trained methods compared. These results connect inference-time control and reward adaptation through a common geometric principle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出变分控制框架，通过共享的雅可比回拉（Jacobian pullback）把采样时引导（VOG）与基于奖励的模型适配（DVOC）统一起来，实现生成模型的偏好对齐。
AI.motivation: 推理时引导与基于奖励的模型微调目前是两类割裂的方法，缺乏统一的理论与几何原理来解释二者之间的联系。
AI.method: 从带路径空间KL罚项的终端奖励最大化出发，利用Gibbs变分原理与Doob变换得到生成动力学的修正；通过局部去噪近似得到把输出偏好搬运到受控变量的pullback。由此构造状态空间的VOG，并通过将局部改进的端点摊销进模型参数得到DVOC。
AI.result: 在线性MMSE模型下证明VOG的精确修正位于数据子空间；ImageNet上VOG把DiT-XL/2的FID从2.27降至2.04（250步）、从7.58降至4.44（25步）；Z-Image-Turbo上DVOC经20次更新后提升HPSv3++及四个留出评测分数，均为对比训练方法中最高均值。
AI.conclusion: 推理时控制与奖励适配共享同一局部变分规则（VOG经去噪雅可比，DVOC经端点蒸馏实现参数回拉），二者在几何上统一。

title: CodeCap-Bench: Can Code Serve as a Good Video Caption?
summary: Video captioning aims to preserve visual information through compact descriptions, predominantly using natural language. However, precisely expressing fine-grained spatial structures and temporal dynamics in natural language often leads to lengthy and potentially ambiguous descriptions. In this work, we explore Code as Video Caption, a paradigm where executable programs serve as a complementary representation of visual content through graphical primitives, layout rules, and functions of time. To examine whether code captions effectively preserve video information, we compare them with natural language captions on downstream question answering and video reconstruction tasks. Our results show that code captions achieve superior reasoning accuracy and reconstruction fidelity. Despite these advantages, realizing the potential of code captioning depends on whether current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate faithful code captions. To systematically assess this capability, we introduce CodeCap-Bench, which comprises 323 videos spanning five categories of structured 2D content, along with fine-grained annotations and a multi-level evaluation framework. Extensive experiments reveal that while leading proprietary MLLMs demonstrate promising code captioning capabilities, they still struggle to faithfully capture complex temporal dynamics, with open-source models lagging substantially behind.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"代码作为视频字幕"(Code as Video Caption)范式，用可执行程序（图形图元、布局规则、时间函数）替代自然语言描述视频，并构建CodeCap-Bench评测MLLM的代码字幕生成能力。
AI.motivation: 自然语言难以精确表达细粒度空间结构与时间动态，导致视频字幕冗长且含歧义，需要一种更紧凑、无歧义的互补表示。
AI.method: 将视频描述为可执行代码；在下游问答与视频重建任务上对比代码字幕与自然语言字幕；构建CodeCap-Bench（323个视频、5类结构化2D内容、细粒度标注、多层次评测框架）系统评估主流MLLM。
AI.result: 代码字幕在推理准确率与重建保真度上均优于自然语言字幕；领先的闭源MLLM具备有前景的代码字幕能力，但在复杂时间动态的忠实刻画上仍存困难，开源模型明显落后。
AI.conclusion: 代码是有效的视频表示形式，但其潜力受限于MLLM生成忠实代码字幕的能力；CodeCap-Bench为后续研究提供了标准化评估基准。

title: Physics-Guided Flow Matching: A Generative AI Framework for Global Total Electron Content Forecasting
summary: Accurate forecasting of global total electron content (TEC) is important for space weather monitoring and the reliable operation of satellite communication and navigation systems. We propose a physics-guided generative artificial intelligence (AI) framework for day-ahead global TEC forecasting. The framework builds on flow matching, which learns to gradually transform samples from an initial distribution into new samples that share the statistical characteristics of the target data. The proposed model incorporates ionospheric dynamics described by a partial differential equation (PDE) into this transformation process, guiding the changes between initial and target samples using physical knowledge. The model further combines the physical dynamics with statistical patterns captured from data to learn this transformation, adaptively adjusting their relative contributions at each location. The model is trained and evaluated using one year of global TEC data generated by the Thermosphere Ionosphere Electrodynamics General Circulation Model (TIEGCM). The results demonstrate that our model improves both spatial and temporal forecasting accuracy over representative benchmarks, including statistical, deep learning, and generative AI methods at all lead times and across latitudes. The average root mean square error (RMSE) is 39.2% lower than that of ConvLSTM and 23.8% lower than that of the same framework without physical guidance. The learned contribution weights vary systematically with latitude and across geographic locations, showing how the physical contribution changes across the forecast domain. These findings demonstrate that explicit physical guidance improves generative forecasts of global TEC and highlight the value of incorporating physical dynamics into generative AI modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出一种物理引导的流匹配生成式AI框架，用于提前一天全球TEC预报，通过将PDE描述的电离层动力学融入生成过程并自适应调节物理与数据统计贡献，精度优于ConvLSTM等基准。
AI.motivation: 准确的全球TEC预报对空间天气监测及卫星通信导航系统可靠运行至关重要；现有统计、深度学习与生成式方法未能显式利用电离层物理动力学。
AI.method: 基于flow matching生成模型，将偏微分方程描述的电离层动力学嵌入从初始分布到目标样本的变换过程，以物理知识引导样本演化；同时结合数据统计模式，并在每个空间位置上自适应调整物理动力学与统计模式的相对贡献权重。
AI.result: 使用TIEGCM生成的一年全球TEC数据训练与评估，在所有预报时效和各纬度上，空间与时间精度均优于统计、深度学习和生成式AI基准；平均RMSE较ConvLSTM低39.2%，较无物理引导的同框架低23.8%；学习到的贡献权重随纬度和地理位置呈系统性变化。
AI.conclusion: 显式物理引导能提升全球TEC的生成式预报性能，将物理动力学纳入生成式AI建模具有重要价值。

title: TimeLineXR: An Interactive Exploration of Time in Vision-Language Models
summary: Recently, it has been shown that vision-language models (VLMs) have a certain intrinsic understanding of time. They can estimate the temporal origin of objects and encode time along a low-dimensional, non-linear manifold inside their embedding space~\cite{tekaya2025matter}. That result is quantitative and reproducible, but the structure itself stays out of reach for end users: they cannot see it, query it with their own images, or inspect where a query lands relative to other years on the time axis. We present TimeLineXR, an interactive demonstration that turns this time axis into an explorable 3D scene. A web demo lets users upload or select images and see each placed on a color-coded 3D time axis; a Three.js WebXR scene renders the same time axis as a room-scale representation that can be grabbed, scaled, inspected, and queried by throwing image cards into it. Both clients run the same prediction pipeline against the same cached temporal index: encode the query with CLIP, project it through cosine-kernel KPCA, and snap it to the Bézier time axis. The system turns each image into a point on the time axis, so users can compare where different objects land and read off their estimated first year of appearance.Code source and reproduction steps can be found in: https://github.com/sterngefeuert/timeline-xr.

AI.tldr: TimeLineXR 将 VLM 嵌入空间中隐含的时间轴转化为可交互探索的 3D 场景，提供网页与 WebXR 两种客户端展示图像在时间轴上的定位。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明 VLM 能定量估计物体的时间起源，并在嵌入空间中沿低维非线性流形编码时间，但其结构对终端用户不可见、不可查询，用户无法用自己的图像检视其落在时间轴何处。
AI.method: 系统以 CLIP 编码查询图像，经余弦核 KPCA 投影，再吸附到 Bézier 时间轴上；网页端展示彩色的三维时间轴，Three.js WebXR 场景以房间尺度渲染同一时间轴，支持抓取、缩放、检视以及投掷图像卡片进行查询，两客户端共享同一预测流程与缓存的时间索引。
AI.result: 每张图像被映射为时间轴上的一个点，用户可比较不同物体的落点并读出其估计的首次出现年份。
AI.conclusion: 该演示把抽象的嵌入时间结构变为可看、可查、可交互的空间体验，代码与复现步骤已开源。

title: MLE-World: Predicting Machine Learning Experiment Outcomes with a Learned World Model
summary: AI research agents can propose, execute, and improve programs that solve machine learning tasks. However, executing each candidate program requires training and evaluating ML models, limiting how many candidates an agent can explore at each step. We introduce MLE-World, a world model finetuned from Qwen3.5-4B that predicts a program's terminal output (error traces, training logs, and validation scores) from its code and data description without executing it, together with a confidence score estimating the prediction's correctness. Because a prediction costs one inference call rather than a training run, MLE-World makes test time scaling (TTS) affordable for these agents. We build five TTS policies, guided by MLE-World, that compare several candidates per step by their predicted outputs: Sequential revision, Best-of-N, Pairwise judging, Fusion, and a UCB style rule that also adds an exploration bonus from this confidence score. Since predictions can be wrong, we run a candidate for real only when its confidence score is low. On 17 MLE-bench Lite tasks, MLE-World matches the real terminal output on 77.9% of held out programs, versus 41.1% for much larger prompted models. MLE-World guided TTS achieves up to 22.1% higher observed mean performance than the agent without a world model, with less real execution. Project webpage: https://mle-world.github.io/.

AI.tldr: MLE-World是一个从Qwen3.5-4B微调的世界模型，可在不执行程序的情况下预测ML程序终端输出及置信度，使AI研究智能体的测试时扩展更廉价。
AI.motivation: AI研究智能体每执行一个候选程序都需训练和评估ML模型，成本高昂，限制了每步可探索的候选数量。
AI.method: 从Qwen3.5-4B微调的世界模型，根据代码和数据描述预测程序终端输出（错误轨迹、训练日志、验证分数）并给出置信度。基于该模型设计五种TTS策略：顺序修订、Best-of-N、成对评判、融合，以及加入置信度探索奖励的UCB规则；当置信度低时才真实执行候选。
AI.result: 在17个MLE-bench Lite任务上，对留出程序的终端输出预测准确率77.9%，远超更大提示模型的41.1%；引导TTS使观测平均性能最高提升22.1%，且真实执行更少。
AI.conclusion: 用廉价的推理调用替代真实训练执行，可让AI研究智能体的测试时扩展变得可行且更高效。

title: CTBakeGS: training-free baking of photorealistic CT volume renderings into 3D Gaussian splats
summary: Photorealistic volume rendering of computed tomography (CT) may convey anatomy intuitively, but it needs the CT data, dedicated software and a powerful graphics processor. Three-dimensional Gaussian splatting (3DGS) displays photorealistic scenes in real time on less powerful devices, but existing medical approaches train each scene for minutes to hours. We aimed to convert a CT volume rendering directly into a 3DGS model without training. Splats were placed on an adaptive octree of millimetre-sized cells. Their colour and opacity were computed on the graphics processor with the renderer's lighting, cell opacity was converted analytically into splat opacity, and faint splats were retained stochastically above the 1/255 opacity floor of standard 3DGS rasterisers. Six public CT scans (1.5-mm voxels) were converted with three transfer functions and compared with converged references by peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity and a learned perceptual metric. Two-million-splat models reached a PSNR of 32.6 +/- 0.9 dB for bone, 30.1 +/- 1.0 dB for contrast-enhanced vessels and 32.3 +/- 1.5 dB for skin and bone. A conversion pass (usually two or three per model) took 4-30 s on a current laptop and 9-60 s on a desktop with a 4-GB graphics card. On the laptop, the models rendered at 68 frames per second at 800 x 800 pixels. Training-free conversion produced real-time 3DGS models of photorealistic CT renderings in about a minute or less per conversion pass on ordinary computers, with fidelity that we consider sufficient for interactive viewing.

AI.tldr: 该文提出免训练的CT体渲染转换方法：将CT体数据直接转换为三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）模型，在普通电脑上实现实时逼真渲染。
AI.motivation: CT体渲染虽直观逼真，但依赖原始数据、专用软件和强GPU；现有基于3DGS的医学方法需为每个场景训练数分钟至数小时，效率低。
AI.method: 在毫米级自适应八叉树单元上放置splat；在GPU上用渲染器光照计算颜色与不透明度；将单元不透明度解析地转换为splat不透明度；对低于1/255不透明度下限的微弱splat按概率保留。无需训练。
AI.result: 六例公开CT（1.5mm体素）、三种转换函数：200万splat模型PSNR为骨骼32.6±0.9dB、对比增强血管30.1±1.0dB、皮肤+骨骼32.3±1.5dB；单次转换4–30s（笔记本）、9–60s（4GB显卡台式机）；笔记本上800×800分辨率达68fps。
AI.conclusion: 免训练转换可在约一分钟内于普通计算机上生成实时3DGS模型，保真度足以支持交互式浏览。

title: Action-Value Calibration via Continuation Sharing for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents relies on feedback from sequences of interactions, making credit assignment to individual actions difficult. Existing methods such as GiGPO compare actions at shared states to compute relative advantages, but estimate each action's value from a single sampled continuation. The resulting local credit remains sensitive to decisions made later in the trajectory. To address this problem, we propose ConCal (Continuation Calibration), a recursive continuation-value estimator that incorporates continuation evidence already present in a rollout batch. ConCal matches visits from the same task by their incoming state-action-state transitions, combines shared continuation evidence with each visit's own transition estimate, and propagates calibrated values backward to refine earlier action-value estimates. This reduces dependence on individual sampled continuations and mitigates local credit distortions without additional rollouts. Held-out return diagnostics show lower error in within-group value differences and higher agreement with reference action orderings than estimates based on individual continuations. With Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, ConCal improves success rates over GiGPO by 3.39 and 5.86 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/Yingjian-Chen/ConCal.

AI.tldr: 提出ConCal（续延校准），一种递归的续延价值估计器，利用rollout批次中已有的续延证据校准动作价值，缓解长程智能体的信用分配问题，在ALFWorld和WebShop上分别比GiGPO提升3.39和5.86个百分点。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体的强化学习依赖交互序列反馈，难以将功劳分配到单个动作。GiGPO等方法在共享状态下比较动作来算相对优势，但每个动作的价值仅基于单次采样的续延估计，导致局部信用对轨迹后续决策高度敏感。
AI.method: ConCal递归估计续延价值：按进入的state-action-state转移，将同一任务中的多次访问进行匹配；把共享的续延证据与每次访问自身的转移估计相结合，并将校准后的价值反向传播以修正更早的动作价值估计。无需额外rollout即可降低对单次采样续延的依赖。
AI.result: 留出回报诊断显示，组内价值差异误差更低，且与参考动作排序的一致性更高。基于Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，在ALFWorld和WebShop上成功率较GiGPO分别提升3.39和5.86个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过复用批次内已有续延证据递归校准价值，ConCal在不增加采样成本的前提下缓解局部信用扭曲，提升长程智能体强化学习效果；代码已开源。

title: Segmentation Confidence for Arbitrary CNNs
summary: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) are widely used for medical image segmentation. However, they lack an inherent measure of confidence. Existing methods for estimating prediction uncertainty often require a custom network architecture and/or dedicated training setups and need to be trained from scratch. In addition, the deduction of a single confidence score per input from the uncertainty maps is not always straightforward. In this study, we explore voxel-based uncertainty estimation methods that can be added to existing segmentation pipelines without training from scratch. We also propose a novel method to estimate a single confidence score from the uncertainty maps. Our evaluations on different ROIs and modalities suggest that our confidence score can predict segmentation performance in unseen data.

AI.tldr: 提出可即插即用于现有分割流程的体素级不确定性估计方法，并提出从不确定性图推导单一置信度分数的新方法，该分数可预测未见数据上的分割性能。
AI.motivation: CNN在医学图像分割中广泛应用，但缺乏固有的置信度度量；现有不确定性估计方法通常需要自定义网络结构或专门训练设置，且需从头训练，此外从不确定性图得到单一置信度分数并不直观。
AI.method: 探索可在无需从头训练的情况下加入现有分割流程的体素级不确定性估计方法；并提出一种从不确定性图中估计单一置信度分数的新方法。
AI.result: 在不同ROI和模态上的评估表明，所提出的置信度分数能够预测未见数据上的分割性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法无需重新训练即可为已有分割流程提供不确定性估计与可解释的单一置信度分数，可用于预测分割质量。

title: SimplexLoRA: Dynamic Rank Updating via Alternating Minimization with Simplex Projection
summary: The success of large language models in real-world applications relies on parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), which inserts compact, trainable adapters into selected layers. In this paper, we propose SimplexLoRA, a LoRA variant that adaptively adjusts adapter ranks during fine-tuning based on their learned importance. Unlike standard LoRA, which employs a fixed rank across all layers, SimplexLoRA optimizes per-adapter importance weights on the $n$-scaled simplex during a short warm-up and then freezes them, dynamically allocating capacity where it is most beneficial without increasing the overall parameter budget or inference cost. We evaluate SimplexLoRA across 12 language understanding, summarization, and reasoning tasks using DeBERTaV3, BART-large, Llama 3.1 8B, and Qwen3-8B. Our results show that SimplexLoRA consistently matches or outperforms standard LoRA and recent adaptive baselines, with the largest gains at low ranks. Our code is available at https://github.com/brain-lab-research/SimplexLoRA.

AI.tldr: SimplexLoRA 是一种在微调中依据学习到的各适配器重要性自适应调整秩的 LoRA 变体，在不增加参数预算和推理成本的前提下，于 12 项任务上匹配或超越标准 LoRA 与自适应基线，低秩时增益最大。
AI.motivation: 标准 LoRA 对所有层使用固定秩，无法把容量集中到最需要的层，造成参数分配次优。
AI.method: 在短热身阶段于 n 维缩放单纯形上优化每个适配器的重��权重，随后冻结；据此动态分配容量，不增加总参数预算与推理开销。
AI.result: 在 DeBERTaV3、BART-large、Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen3-8B 上评估 12 项语言理解、摘要与推理任务，稳定匹配或优于标准 LoRA 及近期自适应基线，低秩时增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 简单单纯形加权即可实现有效的自适应秩分配，是一种低成本、易用的 LoRA 改进方案。

title: Sharpness-Aware Muon: Matrix-Aware Optimization with Momentum-Guided Perturbations
summary: Muon is a matrix-aware optimizer that combines momentum with orthogonalization to produce structured update directions with strong empirical behavior. However, it only shapes the geometry of the update itself and does not explicitly control neighborhood worst-case loss or bias training toward flat regions, which are often linked to stronger generalization. To address this limitation, we introduce the sharpness-aware formulation of Muon. We first develop \textsc{MuSAM}, which incorporates Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM)-style perturbation into Muon's orthogonalized update and establishes a principled bridge between sharpness-aware training and matrix-aware optimization. We then show that this formulation faces an efficiency--stability tension: constructing the perturbation requires an extra gradient evaluation, while the perturbation itself is generated from a single minibatch gradient and is therefore noisy. To resolve this issue, we propose \textsc{MoMuSAM}, which turns Muon's momentum from an update variable into a sharpness-probing signal. By using normalized momentum as the perturbation direction, \textsc{MoMuSAM} removes the extra clean-gradient computation and replaces the single-batch perturbation proxy with a temporally aggregated one. We prove that both \textsc{MuSAM} and \textsc{MoMuSAM} attain the same asymptotic first-order stationarity order, and further show that \textsc{MoMuSAM} yields a more stable stochastic linearization than \textsc{MuSAM}. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that sharpness awareness consistently improves Muon.

AI.tldr: 论文为 Muon 优化器引入 sharpness-aware 形式：先提出 MuSAM，将 SAM 扰动注入正交化更新；再提出 MoMuSAM，用归一化动量作扰动方向，省去额外梯度计算并获得更稳定的扰动。二者均保持相同的渐近一阶平稳性，MoMuSAM 随机线性化更稳定，实验中锐度感知稳定提升 Muon。
AI.motivation: Muon 只塑造更新几何，不显式控制邻域最坏损失或偏好平坦区域，而这些通常与更强泛化相关。将 SAM 与矩阵感知优化结合可弥补这一缺口。
AI.method: 提出 MuSAM：在 Muon 正交化更新中引入 SAM 式扰动，建立锐度感知训练与矩阵感知优化的联系。针对其效率—稳定性矛盾（需额外梯度、扰动由单小批量梯度产生而噪声大），提出 MoMuSAM：将 Muon 动量转为锐度探测信号，用归一化动量作扰动方向，去掉额外干净梯度计算，并用时间聚合扰动替代单批扰动。
AI.result: 证明 MuSAM 与 MoMuSAM 达到相同渐近一阶平稳阶；进一步证明 MoMuSAM 的随机线性化比 MuSAM 更稳定。标准基准实验显示锐度感知一致提升 Muon。
AI.conclusion: 锐度感知可有效增强 Muon，MoMuSAM 以动量复用同时解决效率与稳定性问题，是更实用的方案。

title: PerceptRL: Making Visual Perception Rewardable in MLLMs from Answers to Interactions
summary: Fine-grained visual perception remains a bottleneck during post-training of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), as perceptual errors can constrain gains from reasoning-focused optimization. Although image-caption pre-training improves perception, its influence can weaken as subsequent stages change data mixtures and objectives. Continuing caption supervision during post-training is challenging because subjective, information-dense descriptions complicate verifiable reward design. We present PerceptRL, which strengthens perception at two complementary levels. Perception RL uses a multi-agent pipeline to extract verified errors from dense image captions and convert the corresponding visual facts into QA pairs with fixed answer labels and rule-based rewards. Chain QA links correlated errors, while multiple-choice QA combines unrelated errors. A specialized route targets high-error domains with tailored verification, and a domain-agnostic general route covers errors beyond these domains. Perception Agentic RL addresses fine-grained and dense cases unresolved by single-turn Perception RL through multi-turn inspection with visual tools. We observe coordinate drift even in models trained to use tools, where incorrect crops or annotations distort evidence and propagate errors. Coordinate Injection corrects spatial operations in cold-start trajectories, while a grounding-aware process reward supervises intermediate spatial fidelity alongside final-answer correctness. Training proceeds through shared cold-start SFT, single-turn Perception RL, and multi-turn Perception Agentic RL. Across seven benchmarks under a shared tool-use protocol, PerceptRL achieves 71.6% average accuracy, surpassing the base model with the same tools and the strongest evaluated frontier VLM by 15.7 and 5.2 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: PerceptRL 通过多智能体流程将稠密图像描述中的视觉事实转化为可验证 QA，并分单轮感知 RL 与多轮智能体 RL 两级强化 MLLM 的细粒度视觉感知，平均准确率达 71.6%。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型后训练中，细粒度视觉感知仍是瓶颈：感知错误限制推理优化收益；图像描述预训练的效果会因后续阶段数据和目标变化而衰减；而直接在后期用描述监督又难设计可验证奖励（描述主观且信息密集）。
AI.method: 1) Perception RL：多智能体流水线从稠密描述中抽取经核验的错误，将视觉事实转为固定答案标签的 QA，用规则奖励训练；Chain QA 串联相关错误，多选题 QA 组合无关错误；设专门路由处理高错误域并配定制核验，另设域无关通用路由。2) Perception Agentic RL：针对单轮无法解决的细密案例，用视觉工具做多轮检查；提出 Coordinate Injection（在冷启动轨迹中纠正裁剪/标注坐标漂移）和 grounding-aware 过程奖励（同时监督中间空间保真度与最终答案正确性）。训练流程为共享冷启动 SFT → 单轮 Perception RL → 多轮 Agentic RL。
AI.result: 在统一工具使用协议下的七个基准上，平均准确率 71.6%，分别比同工具基线和所评估最强前沿 VLM 高 15.7 与 5.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将主观描述监督转化为可验证的感知 RL，并配合多轮工具智能体训练与坐标/grounding 层面的精细监督，可有效提升 MLLM 的细粒度感知能力。

title: When Is a Relation Worth Trusting? Manipulation Costs, Exposure, and the Trust Trap in Multi-Relational Graph Learning
summary: Multi-relational graph detectors learn from clean data how much to trust each relation, but an adversary pays a different price to manipulate each relation and each action; taking such costs as given, we ask when using a relation is worse than ignoring it. Our first main result proves that degree gating strictly beats every selection or reweighting of a relation when part of the population is isolated on it and the attacker cannot afford to open the gate, and that this window is sharp; on real graphs, validated gating gains exactly on the relations that meet these conditions and nowhere else. Our second shows that a per-node exposure bound, which extends to message passing, tells a platform which relation to harden: exposure per unit cost, computed without any attack, picks the relation whose hardening raises the exact trap threshold most in 15 of 16 cases, against at most 7 for informativeness, cheapness, or an analysis with equal edit costs. Supporting tools give exact worst cases for linear relational models, certified brackets for R-GCN and tree ensembles, and a finite-sample guarantee for adversarial validation, under which clean-trained graph detectors fall below their graph-free counterparts in 58 of 90 settings on six graphs. A selection protocol built on these results is never significantly worse than ignoring the graph; with at most four relations it mostly abstains, as validation alone would, and its cost-aware proposals help when relations are many, so far shown on synthetic graphs. Without cost information, the safe choice is to abstain.

AI.tldr: 给出多关系图检测器的攻击成本感知理论：证明度门控在特定条件下优于任何关系选择/重加权，并提出“单位成本暴露度”指导关系加固，配套精确最坏情况与有限样本保证，最终建议无成本信息时应弃用图结构。
AI.motivation: 多关系图检测器从干净数据学习各关系可信度，但对手对每种关系、每类操作的操纵代价不同；作者据此追问：在给定成本下，使用某关系何时不如忽略它。
AI.method: 研究攻击成本约束下的多关系图检测：第一结论证明当部分节点在该关系上被孤立且攻击者无力打开门控时，度门控严格优于该关系的任何选择或重加权，且该窗口是紧的；第二结论给出可推广到消息传递的逐节点暴露界，用“单位成本暴露度”（无需攻击即可计算）选择需加固的关系；工具层面给出线性关系模型精确最坏情况、R-GCN与树集成的认证上下界、对抗验证的有限样本保证。
AI.result: 真实图上验证门控恰好在满足条件的关系上获益；暴露度/单位成本在16例中15例选出使精确陷阱阈值提升最大的关系（对比方法至多7例）；在90个设定、6张图上，干净训练的图检测器有58个设定劣于无图对应方法；基于这些结果的协议从不显著劣于忽略图，关系≤4时多弃用如纯验证，关系多时成本感知提案有效（目前限于合成图）。
AI.conclusion: 攻击成本决定使用关系的价值：度门控有尖锐的优势窗口，单位成本暴露度可有效指导加固；缺乏成本信息时，安全选择是弃用图结构（abstain）。

title: How Reliable Is Individualized Functional-Network Attribution in Resting-State fMRI Cognitive Prediction in ADNI?
summary: Individualized attribution estimates which functional networks drive a model prediction for a given subject and is often proposed as an interpretable resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) biomarker, but its test-retest reliability is rarely quantified. We evaluate per-subject network-ablation attribution for a frozen resting-state functional connectivity (FC) predictor (Schaefer-200 FC predicting MMSE/ADAS-Cog13) trained on N=875 subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), using, and (iii) a subject-level permutation null. Split-half reliability is near-ceiling (Spearman p=0.948/0.950) but drops on scan-rescan (p=0.609/0.616). Under the mismatched-subject null, correlations remain substantial (p~0.46-0.47), indicating strong population-shared structure, yet matched pairs exceed this null (z~6.6-6.9, p<=10-4). Thus, in ADNI, individualized network attribution contains a modest but non-zero person-specific component atop a strong population-shared pattern. We recommend reporting scan-rescan reliability together with a permutation-null control, rather than within-session proxies alone, to avoid overstating individual specificity.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了基于rs-fMRI的个体化网络归因（网络消融）在ADNI静息态FC预测MMSE/ADAS-Cog13模型中的重测信度，发现split-half信度接近上限（ρ≈0.95），但scan-rescan信度明显下降（ρ≈0.61），且错配被试零模型下仍相关约0.46-0.47，说明个体归因主要由群体共享结构主导，仅含少量但非零的个体特异成分。
AI.motivation: 个体化归因常被提议作为可解释的rs-fMRI生物标志物，但其重测信度很少被量化；若不检验，可能高估归因的个体特异性。
AI.method: 在ADNI N=875受试者上训练冻结FC预测器（Schaefer-200 FC预测MMSE/ADAS-Cog13），评估逐被试网络消融归因；设置三类对照，包括split-half信度、scan-rescan重测信度以及被试级置换零模型（错配配对）。
AI.result: split-half信度接近上限（Spearman ρ=0.948/0.950），scan-rescan下降至ρ=0.609/0.616；错配被试零模型下相关仍达ρ≈0.46-0.47（强群体共享结构），但匹配对被显著高于该零模型（z≈6.6-6.9，p≤10^-4）。
AI.conclusion: 在ADNI中，个体化网络归因包含较小但非零的个体特异成分，叠加在强群体共享模式之上；建议同时报告scan-rescan信度与置换零模型对照，而非仅用同session代理指标，以避免夸大个体特异性。

title: ALADDIN: Adversarial Latent Diffusion Distillation for One-Step Identity Swapping
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 15 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables, including references and appendices
summary: Face swapping transfers a source identity onto a target image while preserving the target's pose, expression, hair, and lighting. The most realistic current methods are diffusion-based, but they need many network evaluations per image. GAN-based methods are fast, yet trained from scratch they must learn realism from the adversarial signal alone and produce visibly weaker results. We present ALADDIN (Adversarial Latent Diffusion Distillation for One-Step Identity Swapping), a one-step face swapper obtained by initialising the generator from a pre-trained multi-step flow-matching model and training it adversarially under identity and target-preservation constraints. We expose a controllable trade-off between identity transfer and target-attribute preservation by training a student model with triplet pseudo-label supervision. We additionally identify a bias in the standard evaluation protocol, which favours methods trained against the same identity encoder used to score them, and re-evaluate all baselines with an independent one. ALADDIN is state-of-the-art among one-step methods in realism and target preservation at comparable identity transfer, and matches the best multi-step model with 28 times fewer network evaluations and an order of magnitude fewer training pairs.

AI.tldr: ALADDIN 提出一种一步式人脸交换方法，通过将预训练多步流匹配模型初始化的生成器进行对抗式蒸馏训练，在身份与目标保持约束下实现高真实感、快速的人脸交换。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型效果好但每张图需多次网络评估（速度慢），GAN 虽快但从零训练只能靠对抗信号学真实感，效果明显较弱。目标是兼顾速度与真实感，并解决现有评估协议的偏差问题。
AI.method: 将生成器从预训练的多步流匹配模型初始化，再在身份约束与目标属性保持约束下进行对抗训练，蒸馏为一步生成器；通过三元组伪标签监督训练学生模型，实现身份迁移与目标属性保留之间的可控权衡；同时用独立身份编码器重评所有基线以消除评估偏差。
AI.result: 在一步式方法中真实感与目标保持达 SOTA，身份迁移相当；与最佳多步模型效果相当，但网络评估次数少 28 倍、训练数据对少一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 把多步流匹配模型的先验与对抗蒸馏结合，可在一分钟内训练出高效高质量的一步人脸交换器，并揭示评估协议中身份编码器耦合带来的偏差。

title: A note on data-efficient finetuning of vision foundation models
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, Accepted at ES-FoMo III: 3rd Workshop on Efficient Systems for Foundation Models at ICML 2025
summary: Adapting foundation models to a new task within or beyond the training domain is the de facto standard for building specialized machine learning models. Recently, Visual Prompting (VP) has emerged as a promising technique for efficient knowledge transfer. As new foundation model families~(like Mamba) get introduced and VP pipelines such as AutoVP reach greater maturity, we find a growing need for a systematic evaluation of current approaches. In this work, we assess the performance of the latest models, comparing them to earlier architectures and alternative fine-tuning methods, to better understand the progress, challenges and opportunities in the field of efficient fine-tuning under resource limitations. Towards this goal, this paper provides a concise empirical overview of the interactions among foundation model families (Attention-, Convolution-, and Mamba-based) and transfer paradigms: VP, Linear Probing (LP), Full Fine-tuning (FFT) and Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Our work builds up on previous findings by broadening the selection of evaluated models and techniques while tuning hyperparameters. In the interest of delivering practical guidelines for the user, we also explore application of prevalent regularization techniques to boost performance in the context of VP.

AI.tldr: 本文对基础模型家族（Attention、卷积、Mamba）与迁移范式（Visual Prompting、Linear Probing、全量微调、LoRA）的交互进行系统的实证评估，并为资源受限下的高效微调提供实践指南。
AI.motivation: 基础模型适配新任务已成为标准做法，Visual Prompting 等高效迁移技术日渐成熟，且新模型家族（如 Mamba）不断涌现，但缺乏对现有方法在新旧模型上系统、公平的对比评估。
AI.method: 构建实证性概览研究：扩大被评估模型（Attention/卷积/Mamba 三类基础模型）与技术（VP、LP、FFT、LoRA）的选择范围，并进行超参数调优；同时在 VP 场景下探索常用正则化技术的应用以提升性能。
AI.result: 给出不同模型家族与迁移范式组合的性能对比，揭示其中的进展、挑战与机会；并展示正则化技术在 VP 中对性能的提升效果。
AI.conclusion: 为资源受限下的高效微调提供系统性经验总结与面向用户的实用指导建议。

title: Bayesian Inference of Expensive Simulators: Survey and Comparison of Design Choices
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures. Accepted for publication in Statistics and Computing. This is the submitted manuscript; the revised version, including changes based on peer review, is available from the authors upon request
summary:
We present a survey of approaches to Bayesian inference with simulator forward models, focusing on settings with prohibitively expensive simulators. In this domain, Bayesian optimization-based methods have emerged as the most promising approach. We unify existing methods into a general framework, enabling consistent reasoning about shared algorithmic structure across the fragmented literature. Within this framework, we identify the primary design choices and perform a systematic empirical comparison of their effects on inference efficiency in terms of required simulation budget.
  A key result of our study is that inference efficiency is often dominated by the choice of surrogate-model response variable, as it directly governs the complexity of the modeled function. Specifically, we demonstrate that the prevalent scalar log-likelihood is a poor response variable, as it discards crucial information. Based on this insight, we introduce the concept of custom \emph{proxy variables}: transformations of simulator outputs engineered to retain more information and provide smoother response surfaces, substantially improving inference efficiency over standard response variables.
  We provide actionable guidance and a numerically robust Julia package to facilitate practical adoption of Bayesian optimization for simulator inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 该综述统一了基于贝叶斯优化的模拟器逆问题推断方法框架，指出代理模型响应变量的选择主导推断效率，并提出保留更多信息的"代理变量"以显著提升效率，同时给出实践指南与Julia软件包。
AI.motivation: 当模拟器极其昂贵、无法承受大量前向模拟时，传统贝叶斯推断效率低下。现有基于贝叶斯优化的方法虽最有前景，但文献零散、缺乏统一理解，且各设计选择对推断效率的影响未被系统比较。
AI.method: 将现有贝叶斯优化式模拟器推断方法统一到一个通用框架中，识别核心设计选择，并以所需模拟预算为指标进行系统性实证比较。基于此提出"自定义代理变量"——对模拟器输出做变换，使响应面更平滑、信息更丰富。另提供Julia软件包。
AI.result: 推断效率主要取决于代理模型响应变量的选择，因为它直接决定被建模函数的复杂度；常用的标量对数似然是较差的响应变量，会丢弃关键信息；自定义代理变量相比标准响应变量可显著提升推断效率。
AI.conclusion: 响应变量设计是昂贵模拟器贝叶斯推断的关键杠杆，应避免直接用标量对数似然；作者提供可操作指南和数值稳健的Julia包以促进方法落地。

title: GroundControl: Satellite-Conditioned Multi-View Diffusion for Reconstruction-Free Novel View Synthesis
summary: Multi-view or video diffusion models have recently emerged as state-of-the-art approaches for novel-view synthesis from sparse image collections. While they can produce high quality images, they tend to hallucinate unrealistic spatial layouts when synthesizing views outside the input views (scene extrapolation). We propose to address this challenge for outdoor scenes by using satellite images as an additional information source to condition the multi-view generative model. We introduce a new satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model that combines conditioning from a satellite image and street-level input images when generating novel-views. Our cross-attention based conditioning allows us to retain pretrained multi-view diffusion priors to generate seamless, realistic, novel views from a handful of source views, while also adhering to the scene layout as seen from satellite images. Our model does not use 3D scene reconstruction, and only relies on posed street and satellite views. Our experiments on outdoor datasets show that our model is better than both satellite-conditioned or street-view conditioned baselines on novel-view synthesis, especially on challenging cases where target views have very little overlap with source views. Project page: https://nianticspatial.github.io/groundcontrol

AI.tldr: 论文提出卫星图像条件化的多视角扩散模型，利用卫星图作为额外信息源约束室外场景的新视角合成，减少外推时的空间布局幻觉。
AI.motivation: 多视角/视频扩散模型在稀疏图像新视角合成中表现优异，但当合成输入视角之外（场景外推）时，容易产生不真实的幻觉式空间布局。作者希望借助卫星图像提供全局布局先验来缓解该问题。
AI.method: 提出卫星条件化的多视角扩散模型，在生成新视角时同时以卫星图像和街景输入图像为条件；采用基于交叉注意力的条件注入方式，保留预训练多视角扩散先验，使少量源视角即可生成无缝真实的新视角，同时遵循卫星图所示的场景布局。方法无需3D场景重建，仅依赖带位姿的街景与卫星视角。
AI.result: 在室外数据集上的实验表明，该模型在新视角合成上优于仅卫星条件化或仅街景条件化的基线，尤其在目标视角与源视角重叠极少的困难场景中优势明显。
AI.conclusion: 卫星图像可作为有效的全局布局先验来约束多视角扩散模型，无需3D重建即可改善室外场景外推的质量与几何一致性。

title: Structured Representation Probing for Risk Anticipation in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end driving policies form structured internal representations of traffic, ego behavior, and road constraints. These representations offer a monitoring interface for anticipating failures, complementing risk signals from trajectories, controls, and manually designed features. We introduce the Structured Representation Probe (SRP), a lightweight monitor that reads actor, ego, and map representations from a frozen policy. SRP learns a separate linear risk direction for each source and aggregates element scores through cardinality-normalized log-mean-exp pooling, retaining sensitivity to salient evidence while reducing dependence on token count. Event-window supervision links the readout to upcoming hard failures, and auxiliary event type heads jointly train the source directions across failure modes. Online alerting uses a single generic score without modifying the driving policy. Bench2Drive experiments on DriveTransformer, UniAD, and VAD show higher frame-level PR-AUC and ROC-AUC than the evaluated runtime baselines. On DriveTransformer at a horizon of 2 seconds, ROC-AUC reaches 0.833 versus 0.715 for temporal consistency, with 2.67% readout runtime overhead. The trained probes also retain the ability to distinguish impending failures on new routes.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化表示探针（SRP），一种轻量监控器，从冻结的端到端驾驶策略的actor、ego、map表示中读取风险方向，实现在线失效预警。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶策略的内部表示蕴含交通、自车行为与道路约束信息，可作为失效预警的监控接口，补充轨迹、控制量和手工特征的不足。
AI.method: SRP为每个来源学习独立的线性风险方向，并用基数归一化的log-mean-exp池化聚合元素得分；采用事件窗口监督将读出与未来硬失效关联，辅以事件类型头联合训练；在线仅用单一通用分数告警，不修改策略。
AI.result: 在Bench2Drive上，DriveTransformer、UniAD、VAD的帧级PR-AUC和ROC-AUC均优于运行期基线；DriveTransformer 2秒预测horizon下ROC-AUC达0.833（时序一致性基线0.715），读出头开销仅2.67%；新路线上仍能区分临近失效。
AI.conclusion: 结构化内部表示是有效的失效预警信号来源，SRP以极低开销实现优于基线的前瞻监控并具备跨路线泛化能力。

title: ReferStream: Interactive Subject Injection for Streaming Video Generation
summary: Injecting new subjects naturally during streaming video generation requires integrating newly supplied visual references into the existing video while preserving established subjects and the scene. Encoding references independently of the current scene provides little guidance for this integration, while keeping their features in persistent memory can interfere with established context. We propose ReferStream, a framework that requires no additional training and combines reference construction using the current scene with transient cache injection. Joint Latent places reference latents in target regions of the latest scene latent, allowing reference features to be extracted in context. Cache Restoration uses these features to condition the injection chunk, then restores the overwritten global cache entries while retaining the newly generated history. This procedure incorporates new visual conditions without retraining the generator or revising emitted frames. We further introduce ReferStream Bench, a new benchmark with scheduled reference arrivals, evolving instructions, and explicit annotations of subject presence for InShot and MultiShot generation. Evaluation follows the event schedule and measures both the fidelity of new subjects and the preservation of established subjects, alongside video quality, text adherence, and count accuracy. Experiments on ReferStream Bench show higher scores for text adherence, subject similarity, and count accuracy than the compared baselines, including offline methods given all references in advance. Project page: https://xushuolin.github.io/ReferStream/.

AI.tldr: ReferStream：无需训练的流式视频生成框架，通过"当前场景构建参考+瞬态缓存注入"实现新主体自然注入，并配套 ReferStream Bench 基准。
AI.motivation: 流式视频生成中需在保留已确立主体与场景的同时注入新视觉参考。独立编码参考缺乏当前场景引导，而长期驻留缓存又会干扰已有上下文。
AI.method: 两个组件：Joint Latent 将参考潜变量放入最新场景潜变量的目标区域，使参考特征在上下文中被提取；Cache Restoration 用这些特征条件化注入块，随后恢复被覆盖的全局缓存条目并保留新生成历史。
AI.result: 在 ReferStream Bench 上，文本遵循、主体相似度与计数准确率均优于基线，包括提前给全部参考的离线方法；同时评估视频质量与已确立主体保持。
AI.conclusion: 免训练、不修改已输出帧即可实现新主体注入，并提出含定时参考到达与演化指令的新基准，为 InShot/MultiShot 生成提供评测标准。

title: WCC: A Learning-Based Framework for Deciding When to Apply Cooperative Coevolution in Large-Scale Optimization
summary: Cooperative Coevolution (CC) and Non-Decomposition Algorithms (NDAs) are two primary approaches for large-scale global optimization (LSGO). Although both have achieved success, they exhibit markedly different performance across problem types and each faces approach-specific limitations, leaving the question of "when to use CC" unresolved. We address this gap with WCC, a novel learning-based framework that dynamically decides when to deploy CC in LSGO. WCC employs a streamlined design for efficient adaptive learning. We formulate the decision as a Markov decision process, designing a targeted feature set, a robust reward, and a tailored network architecture to provide the agent with rich information about the problem state and optimization progress. Our auto-regressive policy enables WCC to perform fine-grained, dynamic switching between CC and NDAs while conditionally allocating the computational budget without expert specifications. WCC shows strong competitiveness and superior generalization across problems, optimization horizons, and baseline optimizers. It realizes a "train-once and reuse" paradigm under a low budget, significantly curbing LSGO cost. Additionally, in-depth analyses yield insights not captured by existing theory, offering practical guidance on when and how to effectively deploy CC.

AI.tldr: WCC是一个基于学习的框架，动态决定在LSGO中何时启用协同进化（CC），通过马尔可夫决策过程与自回归策略实现CC与非分解算法的细粒度切换及预算分配。
AI.motivation: CC与NDA在大规模全局优化中各有优势与局限，性能随问题类型差异显著，"何时使用CC"这一问题尚未解决。
AI.method: 将决策建模为马尔可夫决策过程，设计针对性特征集、鲁棒奖励与定制网络架构；采用自回归策略在CC与NDA间动态切换，并无需专家设定即可条件化分配计算预算。
AI.result: 在跨问题、优化时域与基线优化器上表现强劲且泛化优越；在低预算下实现"一次训练、多次复用"，显著降低LSGO成本。
AI.conclusion: 深入分析给出了现有理论未涵盖的洞见，为何时及如何有效部署CC提供实践指导。

title: The Noise Plane: A Diffusion Bridge Across Exponent and Dispersion
summary: Diffusion-based denoising commonly uses Gaussian perturbations, whereas sensor noise follows diverse signal-dependent statistical laws. In this paper, we propose $p$-Bridge, a unified measurement-indexed diffusion framework for Tweedie noise. The noise exponent $p$ describes the variance--intensity relation, while accumulated measurement $ν$ controls the noise level. Together, they define a noise plane that includes Gaussian, Poisson, and Gamma models. The stochastic bridge connects measurement distributions through independent increments, giving denoising a physical interpretation as progressive measurement accumulation. Both the starting and stopping indices can be specified, allowing restoration from an observed measurement level to a prescribed higher level. Measurement superposition yields a shared reverse-mean update, paired with a deviance-based objective for learning the required conditional mean. A latent compound Poisson--Gamma construction enables sampling at intermediate exponents. A single exponent-conditioned network adapts to different Tweedie noise models without separate training for each exponent. Experiments show that exponent conditioning improves cross-exponent robustness over fixed-exponent models. Using estimated exponents, the shared network achieves robustness comparable to an oracle-selected set of five specialist models. Experiments on synthetic images, FMD fluorescence microscopy, and multi-sensor SAR images further demonstrate its effectiveness across different signal-dependent noise regimes.

AI.tldr: p-Bridge：面向Tweedie噪声的统一、以测量为索引的扩散框架，用于信号相关噪声去噪。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散去噪多用高斯扰动，但传感器噪声遵循信号相关的统计规律（高斯、泊松、Gamma等），需要统一建模。
AI.method: 提出噪声平面（指数p刻画方差—强度关系，累积测量ν控制噪声水平）；用独立增量的随机桥连接测量分布，去噪即逐步测量累积；共享反向均值更新+deviance目标；潜变量复合泊松—Gamma构造实现中间指数采样；单一指数条件网络适配不同Tweedie噪声。
AI.result: 指数条件提升跨指数鲁棒性；用估计指数时共享网络与oracle选择的5个专家模型效果相当；在合成图像、FMD荧光显微、多传感器SAR图像上有效。
AI.conclusion: p-Bridge为信号相关噪声提供统一、可解释且高效的去噪框架，无需为每个指数单独训练。

title: CoS-VQ: Coordinated Shared-Scale Vector Quantization for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) require substantial memory, motivating low-bit weight quantization for efficient deployment. Existing vector quantization (VQ) methods often improve accuracy by increasing the effective coding dimension, which can complicate independent lookup and local codeword updates. We propose CoS-VQ (Coordinated Shared-Scale Vector Quantization), which preserves low-dimensional codewords while jointly optimizing hard indices and their shared scale across positions. The key challenge is scale-induced coupling: the optimal scale depends on the entire codeword combination and, in turn, changes candidate rankings across positions, so pointwise updates can stall even after scale re-optimization. CoS-VQ collects candidates at multiple probe scales and constructs a tangent separable upper bound for the residual-aware quadratic objective. By reducing candidate comparisons to lower envelopes of lines over positive scales, it identifies finitely many representative intervals for joint index--scale updates without exhaustively enumerating codeword combinations. On Qwen3.8-27B, CoS-VQ outperforms QTIP and LLVQ on the evaluated language modeling, coding, and reasoning benchmarks. Ablations from the same initialization further show larger gains from joint updates than from scale-only refinement, highlighting joint selection as an alternative to increasing codeword dimensionality. The code is available at https://github.com/xzktx003/Cos_VQ.

AI.tldr: 提出CoS-VQ，在保持低维码字的同时联合优化硬索引与共享尺度，避免增大有效编码维度带来的复杂度问题，在Qwen3.8-27B上优于QTIP与LLVQ。
AI.motivation: 大模型部署需要低比特权重量化。现有向量量化方法常通过增大有效编码维度提升精度，但这会使独立查表和局部码字更新变得复杂。
AI.method: 针对尺度导致的耦合问题（最优尺度依赖整个码字组合并反过来改变跨位置候选排序），CoS-VQ在多个探测尺度上收集候选，对残差感知的二次目标构造切线可分离上界，将候选比较转化为正尺度上直线的下包络，从而找出有限个代表区间，实现索引-尺度联合更新而无需穷举码字组合。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.8-27B的语言建模、代码与推理基准上优于QTIP和LLVQ；同一初始化下的消融显示联合更新带来的增益大于仅优化尺度。
AI.conclusion: 联合索引-尺度选择可作为提升码字维度的一种替代方案，在低维码字下实现更高精度。

title: As the Story Unfolds: Watching a Film and Identifying Characters as a Human Does
summary: Films introduce characters incrementally as they progress. We study the problem of identifying principal characters and assigning their names directly from the movie itself, without using external cast lists, actor photographs, or pre-built character banks. We introduce the character naming task: given a name mentioned in dialogue and the associated video context, the model must determine which visible character bears that name. This task is challenging because name resolution often depends on cinematic cues such as shot-reverse-shot structure, self-introduction, direct address, third-party reference, gaze, and temporal continuity. We provide a dataset and annotations for evaluating character naming and first character appearances, develop a video-and-dialogue model for the task, and compare it with proprietary multimodal large language models. We further introduce a progressive framework for building a character bank as the film unfolds. Together, these contributions support online, human-like movie understanding in which character identities are inferred from the film itself.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"角色命名"任务：仅凭电影本身的对话与画面，将对话中出现的名字与画面中可见角色对应起来，无需外部演员表、照片或预建角色库；并构建数据集、视频-对话模型及渐进式角色库框架。
AI.motivation: 现有角色识别多依赖外部资源（演员表、演员照片、预建角色库），而电影本身随剧情逐步引入角色，名字解析也依赖镜头反打、自我介绍、直接称呼、第三方指代、视线与时间连续性等电影化线索。作者希望实现类人的在线电影理解，让角色身份从影片自身推断。
AI.method: 提出角色命名任务：给定对话中提到的名字及相关视频上下文，判定哪一可见角色具有该名字。构建用于评价角色命名与首次角色出现的数据集与标注；开发视频-对话模型完成该任务，并与商用多模态大模型对比；进一步提出随影片推进逐步构建角色库的渐进式框架。
AI.result: 提供了角色命名与首次出现评价的数据集及标注，训练了视频-对话模型并与专有多模态大模型进行比较，验证渐进式角色库构建的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务定义、数据集、模型与渐进式框架，支持角色身份由影片自身推断的在线、类人电影理解。

title: Normative Deviation Modeling for EEG-based Depression Detection
summary: Web-enabled digital health services are expanding access to physiological monitoring and mental health screening. However, electroencephalography (EEG)-based major depressive disorder (MDD) detection remains challenging across heterogeneous data sources, where individual variability and acquisition differences may affect disease-related representations. In this work, we investigate the use of healthy normative references for EEG-based MDD detection. Specifically, structural and distributional reference models are independently trained using healthy control (HC) recordings to characterize departures from healthy EEG patterns. We develop two diagnostic approaches that incorporate normative deviations at different representation levels. Scalar-level Normative Deviation-guided Diagnosis (S-NDD) summarizes structural and distributional deviations into scalar scores and integrates them with deep EEG representations. Feature-level Normative Deviation-guided Diagnosis (F-NDD) retains dimension-wise residuals and combines them with deep EEG representations through attention-based aggregation and auxiliary supervision. We also employ target HC-assisted score calibration for cross-source evaluation without updating the trained models. Experiments on two public EEG datasets examine both approaches under subject-independent within-source and bidirectional cross-source settings. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of normative deviation-guided diagnosis across different evaluation settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用健康人群的正常参照模型提升EEG抑郁症检测在不同数据源间的稳健性，提出标量级(S-NDD)与特征级(F-NDD)两种规范偏差引导诊断方法。
AI.motivation: 基于EEG的抑郁症(MDD)检测面临数据源异构挑战，个体差异与采集条件差异影响疾病相关表征，导致跨源泛化困难。
AI.method: 用健康对照(HC)数据训练结构与分布两类正常参照模型以刻画偏离健康模式的程度；S-NDD将偏差汇总为标量分数并与深度EEG表征融合；F-NDD保留逐维残差，通过注意力聚合与辅助监督与深度表征结合；并采用目标域HC辅助的分数校准实现无需更新模型的跨源评估。
AI.result: 在两个公开EEG数据集上，于受试者独立的源内评估及双向跨源评估中，规范偏差引导诊断均表现出有效性。
AI.conclusion: 引入健康规范参照可有效缓解异构数据下的个体与采集差异，提升MDD检测的跨源鲁棒性。

title: MoI-Bench: A Benchmark for Image Generation and Editing on Mobile Devices
summary: Developing on-device image models requires considering practical user needs, task types and device resource constraints. However, existing benchmarks provide limited guidance on identifying capability gaps between on-device models and server-side models. We introduce MoI-Bench, a benchmark grounded in mobile user needs, comprising 64 subtasks and 1150 samples. It defines 16 operations, such as removal and replacement, and eight visual target categories covering content such as portraits and text. These form two orthogonal axes whose applicable combinations define specific tasks, such as removing facial makeup. To better guide model improvement, we further propose MoI-Eval, which introduces task-specific criteria covering instruction following, visual quality and detail preservation. We further construct sample-level evaluation questions and aggregate their scores into overall quality and capability profiles along the operation, target and criteria axes. We evaluate representative on-device and server-side models and measure mobile deployment costs. Results show that this decoupled Operation x Target design provides finer-grained guidance for improving compact models. For example, it highlights the need to prioritize specific capability gaps (e.g., text-replacement) over broad application-level goals (e.g., improving text editing). Unlike conventional benchmarks that rank models using a single score, we introduce a two-dimensional Quality-Deployability capability map to assess models for practical mobile use. The map shows that current on-device models can achieve efficient generation or editing but expanding their task coverage deserves greater attention than further improving deployment efficiency. Further progress requires improving editing quality, particularly identity preservation and text rendering, while broadening task coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出移动端图像编辑基准 MoI-Bench（64 子任务、1150 样本，操作×目标二维分解）及评估方案 MoI-Eval，并构建质量-可部署性二维图谱，指出现有端侧模型应优先扩展任务覆盖与提升编辑质量而非继续优化部署效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基准难以指导识别端侧图像模型与服务器模型之间的能力差距；开发端侧模型需要兼顾真实用户需求、任务类型与设备资源约束，但缺少细粒度、面向移动用户需求的评测体系。
AI.method: 构建 MoI-Bench：16 种操作（如移除、替换）× 8 类视觉目标（如人像、文字）构成两个正交轴，组合定义 64 个子任务、1150 个样本；提出 MoI-Eval，引入任务特定标准（指令遵循、视觉质量、细节保持），并设计样本级评估问题，聚合为总体质量及沿操作/目标/标准轴的能力画像；同时测量移动部署成本，形成二维 Quality-Deployability 能力图谱。
AI.result: 在代表性端侧与服务器侧模型上评测：解耦的操作×目标设计比单一分数排名提供更细粒度改进指引（如指出应优先补足 text-replacement 等具体短板，而非笼统提升文字编辑）；能力图谱显示当前端侧模型已能实现高效生成或编辑，任务覆盖的扩展比进一步提升部署效率更值得关注。
AI.conclusion: 进一步进展需提升编辑质量（尤其身份保持与文字渲染），同时扩大任务覆盖范围；MoI-Bench/MoI-Eval 与质量-可部署性图谱为端侧图像编辑模型的实用化评估与优化提供可操作方向。

title: TRIDENT-Seq: Profile-Matched Prefix-Future Contrast for Label-Efficient Payment Risk Modeling
summary: Ant International accumulates large volumes of transaction history across users and payment businesses. Confirmed fraud and chargeback outcomes, by contrast, are scarce, delayed, and specific to each business. A single encoder pretrained on unlabeled histories could serve all businesses, but only if pretraining captures the behavior that separates risk. Coarse activity differences can make contrastive pretraining on transaction logs too easy: transaction volume, amount, and timing can distinguish a history's continuation from arbitrary candidates without modeling how payment resources are used. We present TRIDENT-Seq, a transaction foundation model trained with Prefix-Future Contrast (PFC). PFC matches each prefix to a summary of its subsequent behavior among candidates with similar activity profiles; activity prediction and dispersion regularization act on the encoder output. Across three production payment businesses, the pretrained encoder improves average precision (AP) and recall at a 0.5% intervention budget over architecture-matched scratch training in all six business-budget settings. With a fixed validation set, it exceeds full-label scratch training in mean AP and recall using 10% of the training labels on Wallet and 25% on Shopping and SME. Pretraining only on another business's histories still helps. Replacing profile-matched candidates with random ones cuts recall from 24.62% to 5.64%. In Ant International's deployment evaluation, recorded amount-based chargeback and overall loss rates are 37.7% and 37.9% lower than those of the previous XGBoost-based system under the same intervention budget.

AI.tldr: 提出TRIDENT-Seq交易基础模型，用Prefix-Future Contrast（PFC）预训练，在标签稀缺场景下显著提升支付风控效果。
AI.motivation: 欺诈与拒付标签稀缺、滞后且业务特定，而交易历史数据量大，适合用单一编码器预训练服务多业务；但粗粒度活跃度差异（交易量、金额、时间）会让对比学习"太容易"，无法学到真正区分风险的资金使用行为。
AI.method: TRIDENT-Seq基于Prefix-Future Contrast（PFC）：将每个前缀与其后续行为摘要匹配，候选来自活跃度画像相似的样本（避免粗粒度特征作弊）；并在编码器输出上加入活跃度预测与分散度正则化。
AI.result: 在三个生产支付业务、六种业务-预算设置下，AP与0.5%干预预算下的召回均优于同架构从零训练；仅用10%（Wallet）、25%（Shopping/SME）标签即超过全标签从零训练；跨业务预训练仍有增益；随机候选替换画像匹配候选使召回从24.62%降至5.64%；线上部署中金额口径拒付率与整体损失率分别比原XGBoost系统低37.7%和37.9%。
AI.conclusion: 去除粗粒度活跃度捷径的对比预训练可学到可迁移的风险相关行为表征，在标签稀缺与跨业务场景下均有显著收益，并已在实际部署中验证有效性。

title: VideoLVR: Latent Visual Reasoning over Grounded Video Evidence
summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially advanced video understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, language-based reasoning traces do not provide a reliable mechanism for models to revisit relevant visual evidence, leading to visual forgetting and impairing their ability to reason over video content. Existing approaches maintain visual grounding during reasoning in two main ways: they either refer to evidence using textual coordinates, which specify symbolic locations rather than the visual content itself, or reinsert cropped regions or frames into the multimodal context, preserving visual details at the cost of substantial context expansion. To address these limitations, we introduce VideoLVR, which constructs latent visual evidence from local regions at relevant video moments, thereby providing visual support for intermediate reasoning steps. To supervise latent visual evidence generation, we introduce a visual token prediction objective that formulates visual token reconstruction as prediction over a vocabulary derived from the input video, thereby unifying visual evidence reconstruction and text generation within the same token prediction framework. This shared prediction framework enables MLLMs to reason over interleaved text tokens and latent visual states while integrating evidence from different moments. We further extend VideoLVR to reinforcement learning by treating sampled visual tokens as actions alongside text tokens and jointly optimizing the policy using final-answer rewards. By efficiently revisiting task-relevant visual information during reasoning, VideoLVR improves video understanding without substantially expanding the multimodal context. Experiments on multiple video benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness, especially on tasks requiring fine-grained visual evidence.

AI.tldr: VideoLVR通过从相关视频片段的局部区域构造潜在视觉证据，并利用视觉token预测目标将其与文本生成统一在同一预测框架下，实现推理过程中对视觉证据的高效重访。
AI.motivation: 基于语言的思维链推理缺乏可靠机制让模型重访相关视觉证据，导致"视觉遗忘"，削弱视频推理能力。现有方案或在文本坐标中给出符号位置而非视觉内容，或重新插入裁剪区域/帧导致上下文大幅膨胀。
AI.method: 从相关视频时刻的局部区域构建潜在视觉证据，为中间推理步骤提供视觉支撑；引入视觉token预测目标，将视觉token重建形式化为在由输入视频导出的词表上的预测，统一视觉证据重建与文本生成；并将方法扩展到强化学习，把采样视觉token与文本token共同作为动作，用最终答案奖励联合优化策略。
AI.result: 在多个视频基准上验证了有效性，尤其在需要细粒度视觉证据的任务上表现突出，同时未显著扩大多模态上下文。
AI.conclusion: VideoLVR使MLLM能在交错的文本token与潜在视觉状态间推理并整合不同时刻的证据，在推理中高效重访任务相关视觉信息，提升视频理解能力。

title: Euclidean Crowding-Driven Adaptive Euclidean-Hyperbolic Graph Learning
summary: Hyperbolic graph representation learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for modeling hierarchical data. Unlike Euclidean space, which exhibits polynomial volume growth, hyperbolic space grows exponentially with radius, naturally accommodating tree-like structures without the geometric distortion known as Euclidean crowding. Despite strong empirical performance, the theoretical mechanisms underlying hyperbolic embeddings remain poorly understood. In this work, we provide a geometric quantifcation research for Euclidean crowding, a generalization-theoretic explanation for the superiority of hyperbolic space on hierarchical data, and further develop an adaptive Euclidean-hyperbolic fusion learning framework toward bridging this gap. Specifically, we \textbf{first} establish a geometric quantification of Euclidean crowding by analyzing layer-wise minimum separation in node embeddings, proving that fixed-dimensional Euclidean embeddings of tree-like graphs inevitably exhibit layer-wise crowding that leads to weaker margin-based generalization bounds. \textbf{Second}, we provide a generalization-bound for the superiority of hyperbolic geometry on hierarchical data. \textbf{Third}, we propose EH-Fusion, a geometry-adaptive framework that lifts Euclidean GNN representations into hyperbolic space via exponential mapping and adaptively fuses both geometries based on node-level neighborhood expansion patterns. Extensive experiments validate our theoretical insights and demonstrate the effectiveness of EH-Fusion on benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 论文从几何量化与泛化理论角度解释双曲空间在层次数据上的优势，并提出自适应欧氏-双曲融合框架 EH-Fusion。
AI.motivation: 双曲图表示学习在层次数据上表现优异，但其理论机制尚不清楚；欧氏空间体积多项式增长导致树状结构的"欧氏拥挤"问题缺乏量化解释。
AI.method: 1) 通过分析节点嵌入的逐层最小间隔，建立欧氏拥挤的几何量化，证明固定维欧氏嵌入树状图必然出现逐层拥挤并导致更弱的基于 margin 的泛化界；2) 给出双曲几何在层次数据上优越性的泛化界；3) 提出 EH-Fusion，用指数映射将欧氏 GNN 表示提升到双曲空间，并基于节点级邻域扩张模式自适应融合两种几何。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了理论洞见，并在基准数据集上展示了 EH-Fusion 的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将欧氏拥挤的量化分析与双曲泛化界结合，为双曲嵌入优势提供理论支撑，并以几何自适应融合框架实现在实践中兼顾两种几何的优势。

title: Perceiving and Predicting Dynamic Sports: Spatiotemporal Intelligence in Vision Models for Egocentric Tennis Video
summary: Agile robots require spatiotemporal intelligence to interpret scenes, reason about interactions, and anticipate future events. Yet it remains unclear how well foundation vision models support these capabilities, particularly from a moving egocentric camera, which is a natural view for robots. To investigate this, we collect an annotated tennis dataset and train a suite of vision models on spatiotemporal tasks. Our dataset contains egocentric video synchronized with five allocentric videos, estimated global positions, labeled contact times, and annotated stroke types. We then evaluate seven prediction tasks from egocentric images: 2D ego player and 3D ball localization, future player and ball trajectories, forehand or backhand stroke anticipation, time to the next ego player ball contact, and 3D ball position at that contact. We compare image encoders, video encoders, and vision-language models with jointly trained prediction heads. The best performing models achieve mean current-frame localization errors of 0.14 m for the ego player and 0.54 m for the ball, future forecasting errors of 0.34 m for the ego player and 0.91 m for the ball over 1.1 s, and a mean contact-time prediction error of 0.14 s. Auxiliary depth information substantially improves 3D ball localization, suggesting that inferring metric depth remains a challenge. Longer image histories do not improve ball forecasting, indicating that representations exploit scene context rather than rely solely on inter-frame motion. Finally, we propose a conditional diffusion model to generate whole-body kinematic tennis motion from vision encoder predictions on egocentric video at real-time rates, adapting movements as predictions are refined. These results move towards a deeper understanding of how foundation vision models can support real-time dynamic robots using egocentric video.

AI.tldr: 该论文收集了一个带标注的网球第一视角数据集，系统评估图像编码器、视频编码器和视觉语言模型在7个时空预测任务上的表现，并提出条件扩散模型由视觉预测生成全身网球运动。
AI.motivation: 敏捷机器人需要时空智能来理解场景、推理交互并预测未来事件，但基础视觉模型（尤其是移动第一视角相机下）能否支撑这些能力尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建含第一视角视频（与5路非第一视角视频同步）、全局位置、接触时刻和击球类型标注的网球数据集；在7个任务上对比图像编码器、视频编码器与视觉语言模型（配联合训练的预测头）；并提出条件扩散模型从视觉预测生成实时全身运动学动作。
AI.result: 最佳模型实现当前帧定位误差：自我选手0.14 m、球0.54 m；1.1秒内未来预测误差：选手0.34 m、球0.91 m；接触时刻预测误差0.14 s。辅助深度显著改善3D球定位；更长的图像历史并未改善球预测，说明模型依赖场景上下文而非单纯帧间运动。
AI.conclusion: 结果为理解基础视觉模型如何基于第一视角视频支撑实时动态机器人提供了深入认识，并展示条件扩散模型可实时生成并随预测修正而调整的全身运动。

title: Channel Selection for Mixture-of-Experts Decoding Needs No Calibration Data
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are bottlenecked by loading routed-expert weights from memory during interactive decoding at small batch sizes. Because most intermediate channels in a routed expert contribute little to any single token, channel selectors predict which channels matter and read only their weights, typically keeping channels above a threshold calibrated on offline data. We show that channel selection needs no calibration data. First, a calibrated threshold does not fix how much a selector reads, because the number of channels passing it varies across inputs; Prox with thresholds calibrated for an 18% read budget actually reads only 12.9% on average across our benchmarks. Second, top-k keeps each token's k highest-scoring channels and needs no calibration data. At the calibrated budget, a selector's top-k version matches or beats its threshold version on the same score in 40 of 43 comparisons at 13% and 18% budgets, including all 23 on generation tasks. The top-k versions also avoid the repetition-loop collapse that calibrated thresholds cause on Gemma 4. Calibrating a threshold thus provides neither of the two things selectors use it for: a known read budget and a consistent accuracy gain at that budget. We furthermore introduce a reader built entirely from the model's weights, which screens channels with a ternary sketch and recovers the skipped ones with a low-rank map. Across three post-trained MoE models, our reader retains 98.1% of full-model accuracy at 17.8% of routed-expert reads, with Triton kernels running MoE blocks 1.60 to 1.90x faster than optimized vLLM at batch one and up to 2.69x at larger batches on the same three models.

AI.tldr: 通道选择无需校准数据：top-k 优于阈值法，并提出完全由模型权重构建的 reader。
AI.motivation: MoE 在小批量交互解码时受限于从内存加载被路由专家权重，需只读取对单 token 重要的通道以降低开销。
AI.method: 分析校准阈值的缺陷（读预算不稳定、增益不一致），改用免校准的 top-k 通道选择；另构建基于三值 sketch 筛选通道、低秩映射恢复跳过通道的 reader，并配 Triton 内核。
AI.result: 校准 18% 预算实际仅读 12.9%；top-k 在同分数下 43 项中 40 项持平或更优，生成任务全部胜出，并避免 Gemma 4 重复循环崩溃；reader 保留 98.1% 准确率、仅 17.8% 读取，MoE 块快 1.60–1.90x（batch 1）、最高 2.69x。
AI.conclusion: 阈值校准既不能保证读预算也不能带来一致精度提升，top-k 与权重自建 reader 是更有效且免校准的方案。

title: Know, then Draw: A New Learning Paradigm for Visual Generation
summary: Visual generation requires both high-level semantic knowledge and fine-grained pixel details. We propose a learning paradigm that assigns these roles to autoregressive pretraining for knowledge acquisition and diffusion post-training for high-fidelity rendering. Within this framework, we study the objective, representation, and scaling of knowledge acquisition and rendering. Controlled comparisons identify autoregression as the stronger pretraining objective for downstream rendering, improving both learning efficiency and final generation quality. We further find that AR-only generation quality does not necessarily correlate with final performance; semantic quality matters more. This motivates a purely semantic tokenizer trained with language supervision alone, without an image decoder or reconstruction loss. We establish compute-optimal scaling laws for knowledge acquisition and rendering, and find that autoregressive pretraining lowers the fitted asymptotic rendering loss compared with pixel diffusion models trained from scratch. Guided by the laws, we train a 3B-parameter text-to-image model with only 6,600 H100 GPU-hours, achieving 86 on GenEval and 87 on DPG-Bench and validating the proposed paradigm at scale.

AI.tldr: 提出“自回归预训练获取知识 + 扩散后训练高质量渲染”的两阶段范式，并给出计算最优缩放律，以6600 H100小时训练3B文生图模型达GenEval 86、DPG-Bench 87。
AI.motivation: 视觉生成同时需要高层语义知识与细粒度像素细节，而单一模型/单一目标难以兼顾，且缺乏对目标函数、表征形式与缩放规律的系统研究。
AI.method: 1) 将语义获取归于自回归预训练、渲染归于扩散后训练；2) 受控比较自回归与扩散等预训练目标；3) 提出仅用语言监督训练的纯语义tokenizer（无图像解码器、无重建损失）；4) 拟合知识获取与渲染的计算最优缩放律。
AI.result: 自回归是更强的预训练目标，提升学习效率与最终质量；AR单独生成质量与最终性能不必然相关，语义质量更关键；AR预训练比从头训练的像素扩散模型有更低的渐近渲染损失；3B模型仅用6600 H100 GPU小时，GenEval 86、DPG-Bench 87。
AI.conclusion: 验证了语义预训练与渲染后训练解耦范式的有效性与可扩展性，为视觉生成提供高效的训练路线与缩放指导。

title: Para-Gaussian Approximations of Random Deep Neural Networks
summary: It is known that randomly initialized neural networks have Gaussian behaviour in the $n\to \infty$ limit. Unfortunately, this approximation can be poor for finite $n$ and gets worse as one goes deeper into the network. In this work, we develop a more accurate approximation that is \emph{slightly} non-Gaussian, which we call the para-Gaussian distribution and is constructed from the Hermite polynomials. We show how this para-Gaussian approximation can lead to a practical recursive method to approximate the deeper layers of the network. Finally, we apply this theory to linear neural networks (where things can be solved exactly) and to ReLU neural networks (where things can be approximated).

AI.tldr: 本文提出「para-Gaussian 分布」——一种基于 Hermite 多项式的"略微非高斯"近似，用以更准确地刻画有限宽度、深层随机初始化神经网络中各层预激活的分布，并给出可实际迭代的近似方法。
AI.motivation: 随机初始化神经网络在宽度 n→∞ 时趋于高斯过程，但有限 n 下该高斯近似误差较大，且随网络加深而累积恶化，需要更精确的分布刻画。
AI.method: 用 Hermite 多项式展开构造 para-Gaussian 分布（对高斯分布的小幅非高斯修正），并据此建立逐层递归传播的近似算法，用于估计网络深层分布。
AI.result: 将该理论应用于线性神经网络（可精确求解）与 ReLU 网络（可近似求解），验证了近似方法的有效性与可计算性。
AI.conclusion: 以 Hermite 多项式为基础的 para-Gaussian 近似能改善有限宽度深层网络的高斯近似精度，为分析随机网络的信号传播提供更实用的递归工具。

title: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Cross-View Temporal Object Correspondence
summary: Cross-view object correspondence identifies the same object across views. However, existing methods often rely on frame-wise matching or sequential tracking, which can propagate correspondence errors under appearance changes or occlusions. Therefore, we introduce cross-view temporal object correspondence, which requires preserving object identity across both views and time from a query mask. To address this, we propose XTrack, a unified framework which repurposes a pretrained video DiT with semantic and spatiotemporal priors for RGB-to-mask latent transport, jointly modeling cross-view matching and temporal tracking. However, naive video DiTs do not guarantee accurate cross-view grounding and often attend to semantically similar yet incorrect objects across views. Thus, we introduce focal cross-view attention alignment, hard negative conditioning, and local context crop strategies to ensure reliable grounding. Finally, beyond these architectural enhancements, we also tackle the lack of dense annotation by introducing a pseudo-label curation pipeline that converts sparse Ego-Exo4D annotations into dense supervision to enable effective video-level training. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of XTrack as a unified framework, ensuring robust temporal consistency and identity preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出跨视角时序物体对应新任务，并构建统一框架XTrack，借助预训练视频DiT联合建模跨视角匹配与时间跟踪。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角对应方法依赖逐帧匹配或序列跟踪，在外观变化或遮挡下易传播匹配错误；且缺乏稠密标注。目标是从查询掩码出发，同时保持跨视角与跨时间上的物体身份一致性。
AI.method: 将预训练视频DiT改造用于RGB到掩码的隐空间传输，结合语义与时空先验；引入聚焦跨视角注意力对齐、困难负样本条件化、局部上下文裁剪以保证可靠定位；并用伪标签策管流程把稀疏的Ego-Exo4D标注转为稠密监督以支持视频级训练。
AI.result: 实验验证XTrack作为统一框架的有效性，具备稳健的时间一致性与身份保持能力。
AI.conclusion: 统一建模跨视角匹配与时间跟踪可缓解误差传播，视频DiT加注意力对齐与稠密伪标签是可行路线。

title: How Many and How Much? Contrastive Learning with Negative Samples for Knowledge Graph Embedding
summary: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE), a fundamental technique for knowledge-centric Web and KG-augmented AI applications, is commonly trained through contrastive learning with negative samples to learn discriminative representations. Despite its empirical success, two crucial questions regarding negative samples remain underexplored: (Q1) how many negative samples should be used for each positive sample and (Q2) how much should each negative sample contribute to learning? To answer these questions, we propose RADAR, a novel contrastive learning framework for KGE models with two effective strategies, respectively: (1) Risk-aware negative budget allocation quantifies false-negative sampling risk by modeling an open-world KG as a stochastic partial observation of its closed-world counterpart and adaptively assigns a negative budget to each positive sample based on its risk; (2) Distribution-calibrated negative weighting assigns negative weights by calibrating the weighting strength for each positive based on two complementary characteristics of the negative-score distribution: dispersion and concentration. Extensive experiments on 3 real-world KGs with 4 KGE models reveal that RADAR achieves the best KGE performance on average across all model--KG combinations and reduces sampled false negatives by over 90% compared with conventional fixed-budget methods.

AI.tldr: RADAR是一个用于知识图谱嵌入(KGE)的对比学习框架，通过风险感知的负样本预算分配和分布校准的负样本加权两个策略，分别回答"每个正样本用多少负样本"和"每个负样本贡献多少"的问题。
AI.motivation: KGE通常用带负样本的对比学习训练，但两个关键问题未被充分探索：(Q1)每个正样本应使用多少负样本；(Q2)每个负样本应对学习贡献多少。固定预算方法还会引入大量假负样本。
AI.method: 提出RADAR框架，包含两个策略：(1)风险感知负样本预算分配——将开放世界KG建模为闭世界对应物的随机部分观测，量化假负样本采样风险，并据风险自适应为每个正样本分配负样本预算；(2)分布校准负样本加权——基于负样本分数分布的两个互补特征（离散度与集中度），校准每个正样本的加权强度以赋予负样本权重。
AI.result: 在3个真实KG和4个KGE模型上的大量实验表明，RADAR在所有模型-KG组合上平均取得最佳KGE性能，且相比传统固定预算方法将采样到的假负样本减少90%以上。
AI.conclusion: RADAR通过自适应负样本预算与校准加权有效提升KGE对比学习的性能与负样本质量，显著降低假负样本比例。

title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
summary: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. However, quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss, fundamentally limiting the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and positioning continuous visual representations as an intrinsic upper bound. Using multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, we revisit this assumption and find quantization error unreliable, as discrete representations with substantially larger errors can achieve better understanding. Instead, the effective bit budget of discrete indices emerges as a key determinant of downstream performance. However, existing quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute progressively less semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this saturation, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks. It continues to improve at larger bit budgets, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2%, respectively, on a nine-metric average. To our knowledge, it is also the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL, including on fine-grained OCR tasks. We further identify the key principles and a practical recipe enabling this competitiveness. These results and insights support the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ

AI.tldr: 本文质疑"量化误差导致语义损失、连续表示是上限"的假设，指出离散token的有效比特预算才是性能关键，并提出因子化向量量化(FVQ)以缓解码本饱和，使离散表示在多模态理解上媲美连续表示。
AI.motivation: 离散视觉token可提供与语言统一的下一token预测接口，但普遍认为量化误差造成不可避免的语义损失，从而把连续视觉表示视为语义保真度的理论上界，限制了离散表示路线的信心与发展。
AI.method: 以多模态理解为语义保真度代理，重新检验量化误差与下游性能的关系；分析码本饱和现象，提出因子化向量量化FVQ：对视觉特征的互补、固定维度视图用对称并行码本进行量化，使比特预算增大时仍能持续提升；并在工业级多模态数据上训练模型，总结实现竞争力的关键原则与实用配方。
AI.result: 发现量化误差不可靠（误差更大的离散表示反而理解更好），有效比特预算才是关键决定因素；FVQ在更大比特预算下持续提升，最终匹配连续表示。模型在九项指标平均上超越UniAR 22.8%、Emu3-Chat 59.2%，在离散表示模型中达到SOTA，并首次与Qwen3-VL等强连续表示模型（含细粒度OCR）具备竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 离散视觉表示并非受限于量化误差，通过提升有效比特预算与缓解码本饱和可达到连续表示水平；这支持离散视觉表示作为大规模原生多模态基础模型基础的潜力，并提供可复现的原则与配方。

title: Honeycomb-Surfels: Compact Hexagonal Primitives for Efficient Scene Rendering and Reconstruction
summary: Novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction have advanced rapidly with radiance fields and splatting, yet their memory and computational demands limit their use in resource-constrained settings. We introduce Hexels: novel planar hexagonal surface elements with a first-order spatial color field for efficient 3D scene and 2D image representation. Hexels exploit locally planar regions with smoothly varying appearance using fewer, larger primitives. Their hexagonal support provides an area- and boundary-efficient domain, while the local color field captures appearance variation within each primitive. Across 34 scenes, Hexels improve PSNR over memory-matched 2DGS by 4.53-7.38 dB across datasets while requiring lower training VRAM. We further ablate Hexels by showing that per primitive, Hexels outperform 2DGS by upto 4.74 dB while using lower training VRAM and having 2.31 times faster FPS. Even in unconstrained settings, Hexels offers complementary quality-memory trade-offs. For efficient 3D surface reconstruction, Hexels reduce error by 28.9% compared with memory-matched 2DGS across 15 DTU scans. On 6 Tanks and Temples surface scenes, Hexels achieves the highest mean F1 among compared methods (34.38%, versus 31.72% for 2DGS). We further also show that Hexels, as a general primitive, improves 2D image representation over Image-GS. Hexels push the Pareto frontier on the quality-efficiency trade-off of surface-aligned primitives.

AI.tldr: 提出 Hexels——平面六边形表面元素，搭配一阶空间颜色场，用更少更大的图元高效表示3D场景与2D图像，在质量-内存权衡上推进Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: 辐射场与splatting在新视角合成和3D重建上进展迅速，但内存与计算开销大，难以用于资源受限场景。现有表面元素多为小尺寸、外观单一，未能充分利用局部平面、外观平滑变化的特性。
AI.method: 设计平面六边形图元：六边形支撑提供面积与边界效率更高的定义域；每个图元内嵌一阶空间颜色场，以建模图元内部的外观变化。以更少、更大的图元覆盖局部平面区域。并作为通用图元迁移到2D图像表示。
AI.result: 34个场景上，同等内存下PSNR比2DGS高4.53–7.38 dB且训练显存更低；单图元对比最高提升4.74 dB、FPS快2.31倍。15个DTU扫描上误差降低28.9%；6个Tanks and Temples场景平均F1最高（34.38% vs 2DGS 31.72%）；2D图像上优于Image-GS。
AI.conclusion: Hexels 以六边形+局部颜色场的组合显著提升表面导向图元的质量-效率权衡，在3D重建、新视角合成与2D图像表示上均具优势，但本文主要聚焦效率与质量的折中而非完全无约束场景的绝对最优。

title: Displacement Moments and Path-Terminal Separation in Brownian Interpolant Sampling
comment: 56 pages, 4 figures; 8-page main text and complete appendices
summary: Brownian stochastic interpolants connect paired endpoint samples, yet their sampling error can depend on displacement moments even when neither endpoint has a first moment. For arbitrary Borel couplings, we prove early-stopped, target-to-output KL guarantees for standard Euler sampling from the true source. A fourth displacement moment gives an explicit $O(N^{-1})$ bound; a second moment suffices for fixed-law convergence as drift error vanishes. For one fixed coupling with no displacement moment above two, original bridge-path KL stays of order one, comparison-path KL is of order $1/\log N$, and terminal KL is at most $C/N^2$ on the same grid. The path decomposition identifies the information about the source discarded by Markov projection. When the original bridge is Markov, current-state Euler sampling instead has a second-moment $O((M_2+d)/N)$ bound; finite-entropy Schroedinger bridges for the probability Brownian reference are included. We also construct a current-state learner with expected output KL consistency from iid endpoint pairs. Numerical diagnostics illustrate the distinct errors. Conditional diffusion identities specify a restoration interface, while image controls find no iterative advantage over cheap probabilistic predictors. Uniform terminal rates for general second-moment couplings remain open.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Brownian stochastic interpolants在端点无有限一阶矩时的采样误差，给出Euler采样的提前停止、目标到输出的KL界，并区分原始桥路径、比较路径与终端KL的不同收敛阶。
AI.motivation: 现有Brownian stochastic interpolant的采样误差可能依赖位移矩，但即使在两端点连一阶矩都不存在的情形下，也需要刻画采样误差；同时要理解Markov投影丢弃了哪些源信息。
AI.method: 对任意Borel耦合，从真实源出发分析标准Euler采样，证明提前停止的目标到输出KL界：四阶位移矩给出O(N^{-1})界，二阶矩在漂移误差消失时足以保证固定分布收敛；构造一个无二阶以上位移矩的固定耦合，分别分析原始桥路径KL、比较路径KL与终端KL；当原始桥为Markov时给出现状态Euler的二阶矩O((M_2+d)/N)界，覆盖概率Brownian参考的有限熵Schrödinger桥；并构造从iid端点对学习的现状态学习器。
AI.result: 四阶位移矩下显式O(N^{-1})早停KL界；二阶矩下固定律收敛。特定耦合中原始桥路径KL保持O(1)，比较路径KL为O(1/log N)，同网格上终端KL至多C/N^2。Markov桥情形现状态Euler有O((M_2+d)/N)界；现状态学习器具有期望输出KL一致性。数值诊断展示了各误差的区别，图像实验未发现迭代方法相对廉价概率预测器的优势。
AI.conclusion: 路径分解揭示了Markov投影所丢弃的源信息；不同KL度量对应截然不同的收敛速率。一般二阶矩耦合下终端KL的统一收敛速率仍为开放问题。

title: Bayes-Adaptive MDPs for Rollout Allocation to Enhance GRPO Training
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has demonstrated strong performance in LLM post-training. However, it allocates a uniform rollout budget to every training question, ignoring variations in question difficulty. As a result, highly difficult questions may receive too few rollouts to generate informative positive reward signals, limiting their contribution to training, while moderately difficult questions often receive more rollouts than necessary. In this work, we formulate the problem of difficulty-aware rollout budget allocation to maximize training utility under the same total rollout budget as standard GRPO. We propose AdaRoll-GRPO, which reformulates rollout allocation as a sequential decision-making problem and leverages a Bayes-adaptive Markov decision process (MDP) to learn an adaptive allocation policy. The learned policy is computed offline and applied during GRPO training without introducing additional online optimization overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple reasoning datasets and LLM architectures demonstrate that AdaRoll-GRPO consistently improves GRPO training performance under a fixed rollout budget, highlighting the effectiveness of adaptive rollout allocation for GRPO in LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaRoll-GRPO，将GRPO的rollout预算分配建模为贝叶斯自适应MDP，学习难度感知的自适应分配策略，在相同总预算下提升训练效果。
AI.motivation: 标准GRPO对每个训练问题分配统一的rollout预算，忽视题目难度差异：高难题rollout过少难以获得正向奖励信号，中等题则rollout冗余，导致训练效用受限。
AI.method: 将rollout分配形式化为序列决策问题，构建贝叶斯自适应MDP来学习自适应分配策略；策略离线计算，训练时直接应用，不引入额外在线优化开销。
AI.result: 在多个推理数据集与多种LLM架构上的实验表明，固定rollout预算下AdaRoll-GRPO能稳定提升GRPO训练性能。
AI.conclusion: 自适应rollout分配对GRPO后训练有效，可在同等预算下提高训练效用。

title: When Visual Evidence Is Insufficient: How Instructions, Post-Training, and Internal Activations Shape Refusal in Multimodal Language Models
summary: For reliable deployment, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should recognize when an image provides insufficient evidence to answer a question and withhold unsupported answers. Yet refusal alone is not necessarily evidence of such recognition: models may refuse because of unrelated safety constraints or without identifying the missing evidence. We study how refusal on visually unanswerable questions is shaped by three sources of control: inference-time instructions, post-training, and internal activation interventions. Across three MLLMs on the MoHoBench benchmark, we systematically manipulate the meaning and placement of refusal instructions, compare supervised and preference-based post-training, and intervene on a refusal-related activation direction derived from naturally answered and refused examples. We find that refusal is highly sensitive to both the meaning and placement of instructions, with model-specific changes at the sample level that are obscured by aggregate refusal rates. Evidence-aware and general refusal instructions have stronger effects than an intentionally mismatched safety instruction. Post-training produces larger increases in refusal, but can also induce responses that combine refusal language with attempted answers. In contrast, activation intervention produces smaller yet transferable changes across prompt conditions, without evidence of indiscriminate refusal on tested visually answerable samples. These findings show that refusal is jointly shaped by external instructions, post-training, and internal representations, highlighting the need to disentangle evidence recognition from a model's learned propensity to refuse.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较推理时指令、后训练与激活干预三种控制源对多模态大模型"视觉不可答问题拒答"的影响，发现三者共同塑形拒答行为，需将证据识别与拒答倾向区分开来。
AI.motivation: MLLM 可靠部署需在图像证据不足时拒绝作答，但拒答本身未必代表模型识别到缺失证据（可能源于无关的安全约束）。因此需研究拒答行为的来源与成因。
AI.method: 在 MoHoBench 上对三个 MLLM 系统操控三类控制源：(1) 改变拒答指令的含义与位置；(2) 比较监督式与偏好式后训练；(3) 基于自然作答/拒答样例导出拒答相关激活方向并做激活干预。
AI.result: 拒答对指令含义与位置高度敏感，样本级变化被聚合拒答率掩盖；证据感知与通用拒答指令效果强于刻意错配的安全指令；后训练提升拒答幅度更大，但会出现"拒答语+尝试作答"混合回复；激活干预效果较小但可跨提示条件迁移，且未在可答样本上出现无差别拒答。
AI.conclusion: 拒答由外部指令、后训练与内部表征共同塑形，未来需将证据识别能力与模型习得的拒答倾向解耦评估。

title: CRISP: Co-designing Pruning and Scheduling for Efficient MoE Inference on Edge Servers
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference on memory-constrained edge platforms is often dominated by expert-weight movement rather than computation. Although each token activates only a small subset of experts, routing is input-dependent, so all experts must remain accessible and memory movement dominates latency.
